tei:div.tei:p: ḍo—— rsha —bhe— kṣa — ———— sdi————— rha bhe — — — dzee rdori chidzha dzi rdzo'iri skeci la spulngawa niri — wa ༷bye rtejitwoci ༷dudro rnosdu — spu nga sa ba satrī/ ༄ raci — bye —ci — — rdo chi6 sprung go'i bo da kyi she sa ri ga da pe skun kha nga /
༄4/ /rdo rjergyalolo gsung rtsom rdzos bsgrogs//krung go'i bod kyi shes rig dpe skrun khang /

lde tsho cildici to ri‘ri /( rterdzo sna— dzña2 ྅tre ca deri 4 / rnyi stsacisku rdori ri ri lnge jimijimirdzi’chi rdo du tho sku /’ wa3 bye rtsedngha tshoṇi rkebye/trī:ri chi 5 tsho jichi 7 ching shaṃṅkacine /—ṭwāṃ ༷༷sta3dī /wa— sna gyu lhasnye/ /phusnyo pa〉 kṣ-i ltarmersha ñtsaci/snye tsho canghru tsho sgyu sna7rme —sgro7 / ri tsho tsho 4 5 — ci ṭī 44ci shā rdziphusdu ci shāri ci3/ tre rīcadisduji ṭwāṃñtsā/rdoṭwāṃ riḥ— tshe kā kyi/shārme ho dhe ho chi 4 4 sna rīrdo tsho ri rithormi8 —’ 4 ྾dro skekṣitshohūṃru rṣa cirdo spre — 33 mitsho —zhe zi thi ji (dzwaskeri kshiṣṭio— rtsom pa po 'a par

1dpo rtsan gsal bshad/mkhas dbang rdo rje rgyal bo ni bod ljongs stod g.yas ru'i char gtogs pa mdog gzhung khrab bla brang chu mig pa zhes pa'i khyim du rab byung bco lnga pa'i chu glang (191 3)lor 'khrungs shing / gzhon nu'i dus su gtsang bkra shis lhun po'i dkyil khang grwa tshang gi tshad ma rig pa'i slob dpom/ dka' chen 'gyur med mchog dang / gtsang stod pa brda sgrod gzhung la mkhas pa dkar lebs drung yig o rgyan rdo rje sogs kyi drung du bod pyi brda sbod rig pa'i gnas la slob gagrer hur brtson gnang zhing / skabs yi/sa/ la dga' ldan pho brang pa'i mkhan drung mkhyin rab dbang phyug dang / dza sag spomyo/ mda' yar 'thel sogs gyi drung yig kyang mdzad/ bod sngongs zhi ba'i bcings bkrol byung rjes 1952lo nas bod ljongs las byed slob grwa'i dge rgan gnang nas bod yig 'dzin grwa mtho rim la bod kyi brda krod rig pa grob khrid mdzad pa dang / 1954lor rgyal sa pe cin du phebs te mi rigs dpe skrun khang khongs bod yig rtsom sgyur khang gi zhu chen gyi 'gan bzhes nas bzhugs/ 1987lor krung go'i bod kyi shes rig zhib 'jug lte gnas kyi spyi'i las 'dzin gzhon pa'i 'gan bzhes/ 1954ro nas da bar lo bzhi bcur nye ba'i ring la khong gis thugs nus gang yod bton nas sgyur yig grangs las 'das pa zhig zhu dag gis gtan la phab pa dang bod

’ 2 rdo rje rgyal po'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/kyi shes rig skor gyi dpe cha mang po zhig rtsom sgrig mdzad de bod kyi shes rig dar 'phel yong bar mdzad rjes chen po bzhag yod pa lags/khong gi thugs la rtsom rgyag pa'am yig sgyur byed dus tshig sbyor gyi 'gro stangs de bod kyi brda sprod rig pa dang mthun dgos par ma zad/ tshig bsdus la go sla ba dang don tshang la 'khrul pa dang bral ba zhig kyang yong ba byed dgos/ de 'dra byung na klog pa po rnams kyis bltas na shes pa dang thos na don go ba yong gi yin snyam du dgongs kyi yod pa red/ der brten khong gis sgyur yig zhu dag mdzad dus rgyun du thug pa'i dka' gnad rnams phyogs bsgrigs mdzad pa dang sprags lo gzhon rnams kyi bod yig chu tshad mtho ru 'gro ba'i rogs ram byed ched sun snang med par dka' gnad gsed bkrol dang gnas lugs dris lan mdzad pa red/ phyogs mtshungs rang nyid phyag las gnang sa'i blo mthun nam mi rigs slob grwa chen mo khag gi dge slob tshos bod kyi brda sprod rig pa'am snyan ngag sogs kyi rigs pa'i gzhung lugs sbyong rgyu'i re 'dun zhus tshe khong gis las zhor gyi dus tshod btsal te khrid bya yig rigs mang po brtsams par gnang bar ma zad dngos su dpe khrid kyang gnang ba red/ khong ni bod kyi brda sprod rig pa byang chub pa'i mkhas dbang zhig yin zhing / de snga brda sprod rig pa'i nying khu 'dzin spel mdzad pa'i thog da dung dbus gtsang khul gyi phal skad gyi tshig mjug la yin red yod 'dug byung bzhag bcas dang / dngos po bdag gzhan/ bya byed tha dad mi dad/ bya byed las gsum sogs skor gyi khyad chos la'ang zhib 'jug gting zab mdzad pa dang sprags de dag gi chos nyid phyogs sdom sa

— daspreskunagasal bshad/ 3mdzad nas rang gi rtsom yig 'ga' zhig gi nang gnas lugs gsal bshad dam bed spyod mdzad pa red/khong gis yig rigs kyi phyag las lo grangs bcu phrag mang por mdzad pa'i ring la zhu dag btang ba'i sgyur yig dang / gzhan gyi tshab tu bris gnang ba'i yig cha'am 'phrin yig mang po byung yod kyang deb 'di'i nang du khong rang nyid kyi rtsom yig mtshon byed bcu grangs tsam ma gtogs bsdus med/klog pa po rnams gzigs bde ba'i ched du rtsom yig de dag sum rtags dang / snyan ngag rtsom yig thar thor bcas khag gsum bgos nas bsgrigs yod/ rtsom gzhi'i 'grel bshad dang brtsams pa'i dus tshod skor rtsom bya so so'i shog ngos dang po'i gsham la bkod yod/spung go'i pod kyi shes rig daspre spyan khang gis/spyi lo1990zla6tshes20la/

1 snyedakar chagasum rtags kyi snying 'grel legs bshad 'dren pa'i po nya zhes bya ba/ ༷༷ 1'go brjod/ 1sum cu pa/ 3sa bcad dang po/ sbyar bya yi rtse/'i rnam bzhag bshad pa/ 3dang po/ ming gzhi bshad pa/ 3gnyis pa/ rjes 'jug bshad pa/ 4gsum pa/ sngon 'jug bshad pa/ 5sa bcad gnyis pa/ sbyor tshul tshig phrad kyi 'jug pa bshad pa/6dang po/ rjes 'jug la bltos nas 'jug pa'i phrad rnam dbye dang bcas bshad pa/ 6gnyis pa/ rjes 'jug la ma bltos pa'i phrad rang dbang can bshad pa/ 20sa bcad gsum pa/ tshig phrad dang / 'a mtha' yod med/ tsheg shad spyor tshul bcas bshad pa/ 26dang tha/ tshig phrad spyor tshul bshad pa/ 26gnyis pa/ 'a mthal 'dor len byed tshul bshad pa/ 28gamum pa/ tsheg shad stor tshulabashad pa/ 28

2rtags 'jug 30sa bcad dang po/ yi ge dbyangs gsal gyi rtags kyi dbye ba bshad pa/ 30sa bcad gnyis pa/ sdon 'ayug gi rtags kyi dbye ba bshad pa dang rtags kyi 'jug pa bshad pa/ 32dang po/ sngon 'jug gi rtags kyi dbye ba brtso/da pa/ 32gnyis pa/ sngon 'jug gi rtags kyi 'jug pa bshad pa/ 33sa bcad gsum pa/ rjes 'jug gi rtags kyi dbye ba bshad pa dang rtags kyi 'jug pa bshad pa/ 48dang po/ rjes 'jug gi rtags kyi dbye ba bshad pa/ 48gnyis pa/ rjes 'jug gi rtags kyi 'jug pa bshad pa/ 48zur bkod/ dus gsum gyi dber brjod re'u mig 74gangs can pa'i baja sprod pa'i bstan bcos sum cu pa dang rtags kyi 'jug pa'i dgongs don dber brjod rang blo'i rtsi bcud ces bya ba/ 96rtags 'jug gi dka' gnad mdor brtsas/ 133sum rtags skor gyi dri ba dris lan/ 145bod kyi sum rtags kyi dka' gnad 'ga' zhig brjod pa/ 189dang po/ bod kyi rig pa'i gzhung lugs spyi'i gnas tshal stomado tsam bshad pa/ 189gnyis pa/ shes bya ris/ pa'i gnas de dag gi gzhi ma yi

3ge'i dgos pa bshad pa/ 194gsum pa/ yi ge 'jug pa'i gnad brgyad bshad pa/ 196bzhi pa/ rtags kyi 'jug pa'i dka' gnad mdor bsdus bshad pa/ 219dang po/ bya byed tha mi dad pa dang tha dad pa'i dbye ba'i skor/ 220gnyis pa/ bya byed tha mi dad pa'i nang gses skor/ 221gsum pa/ bya byed tha dad pa'i nang gses skor/ 224bzhi pa/ bya byed las gsum dbye tshul skor/ 225lnga pa/ dus gsum gyi dbye ba'i skor/ 227drug pa/ dngos po bdag gzhan dang / bya byed las gsum/dus gsum/ skul tshig bcas gzhi gcig gi thog dper brjod pa/ 228bdun pa/ zhar byung du skabs thob kyi 'bri tshul skor/ 233snyan ngag gi rnam bshad gsal sgron/ 234bstan bcos rtsom pa la 'jug pa'i sngon 'gro dang gleng gzhi/234rig gnas spyi dang bye brag tu dbye ba sna tshogs skor/ 237rig gnas rnams kyi ngo bo dang / 'byung khungs/ dgos pa sogs mdor bsdus te bstan pa/ 2451 sgra rigs pa/ 246

42 tshad ma rig pa/ 2483 bzo rig pa/ 2494 gso ba rig pa/ 2505 nang don rig pa/ 2516 mngon brjod/ 2537 sdeb sbyor/ 2548 zlos gar/ 2559 skar rtsis/ 25610 snyan ngag 258gzhung don le'u dang po/ 261dang po/ gzhung don 'chad pa la 'jug pa'i klad kyi don/ 2611 mtshan don/ 2612 'gyur phyag 2623 gzhung 'chad tshul/ 263gnyis pa/ rtsa ba'i sa bcad dang po bstan bcos rtsom pa'i sngon 'akro thog mar dge ba la gsum/ 2641 mchod par brjod pa/ 2642 rtsom par dam bca' ba/ 2653 bstan thatsos brtsams pa'i dgos pa bstan pa/ 266gsum pa/ rtsa ba'i sa bcad gnyis pa bar du dge ba gzhung don lus rgyan skyon gsum las dang po lus spyir bshad pa/ 270

51 lus gzhung gi dbye bas gsum du bshad pa/ 2712 rjod byed skad rigs kyi dbye bas bzhir bshad pa/ 2953 sbyor tshul don gyi dbyu bas gnyis su bshad pa/ 300bzhi pa/ rtsa ba'i sa bcad gnyis pa bar du dge ba gnyis pa lus rgyan skyon gsum bshad pa'i gnyis pa rgyan gyi bye brag thun mong ma yin pa lho shar gyi lam dbyi ba yon tan bcu bstan pa/ 3001 yi ge'i sbyor ba lci ba sbyar ba/ 3022 'jig rten la grags pa'i don can rab tu dwangs pa/ 3063 yi ge 'jam tsub kyi sbyor ba mnyam pa mnyam nyid/ 3084 sgra don gyi nyams dang ldan pa'i snyan pa/ 3126 'jam pa'i yi ge shas che ba'am mang ba shin tu gzhon sa / 3286 don brtag mi dgos par gsal bas don gsal/ 3317 khyad par du 'phags pa'i yon tan rtogs pa rgya che ba/ 3358 tshig sdud kyi 'jug si/ mang ba brdzid pa/ 3389 'jig rten gyi don las 'das shing yid 'phrog pa mdzes pa/ 34410 chos gzhan chos can gzhan la bkod pa ting nge 'dzin/ 350lnga pa/ don bsdu ba/ 3571 lho shar gnyis kyi lam dbyu ba'i skabs kyi don bsdu ba/ 3572 snyan ngag gi rgyu bshad pa/ 359gzhung donasgoso'u gnyis pa/ 363lho shar thun mong du 'dod pa don rgyan so lnga spyir bstan pa/ 363

61 rang bzhin brjod pa bzhi/ 3672 dpe rgyarwa sum cu so gnyis/ 3723 gzugs can gyi rgyan nyi shu tham pa/ 4034 gsal byed kyi rgyan bcu drug — 4205 bskor ba'i rgyan gsum/ 4336 'gog pa'i rgyan nyer gsum/ 4377 don gzhan bkod pa'i rgyan brgyad/ 4608 ldog pa can gyi rgyan bcu/ 467 9 srid pa can gyi rgyan gsum/ 479 10 bsdus brjod kyi rgyan bzhi/ 48311 phul byung gi rgyan bzhi/ 48912 rab btags kyi rgyan drug 49413 rgyu'i rgyan bcu drug 50114 phra mo'i rgyan gnyis/ 51815 cha yi rgyan bzhi/ 52116 rim pa can gyi rgyan gcig 52517 dga' ba'i rgyan gnyis/ 52718 nyams ldan gyi rgyan brgyad/ 52919 gaji bajid can gyi rgyan gcig 53920 rnam grangs brjod pa'i rgyan gcig 54021 kun tu phan pa'i rgyan gcig 54222 rgya che ba'i rgyan gnyis/ 54323 bsnyon dor gyi rgyan gsum/ 546

724 sbyar ba'i rgyan dgu/ 55025 khyad par brjod pa'i rgyan lnga/ 56226 mtshungs sbyor gyi rgyan gnyis/ 56727 'gal ba'i rgyan drug sto 56928 skabs min bstod pa'i rgyan gcig 57629 zol bstod kyi rgyan gsum/ 57730 jis bstan gyi rgyan gnyis/ 53131 lhan cig brjod pa'i rgyan gsum/ 58332 yongs brjes kyi rgyan gcig 58633 shis brjod kyi rgyan gcig 58734 rab spel gyi rgyan gcig 58935 dgongs pa can gyi rgyan gcig 593gzhung don le'u gsum pa/ 598lho shar thun mong du 'dod pa sgra rgyan sogs bshad pa/ 598zung ldan gyi rnam gzhag mdor bstan pa/ 599zung ldan gyi rnam gzhag rgyas par bshad pa/ 6001 thog ma'i zung ldan bar ma chod pa bco lnga/ 6002 thog ma'i zung ldan bar chod pa bcu gsum/ 6143 thog ma'i zung ldan bar du chod cing ma chod pa gsum/ 6254 — gnas gzhan na yod pa'i zung ldan bcu gnyis/ 6295 mtha' thog sbyar ba'i zung ldan gcig 6426 kun tu zung ldan bco lnga/ 6447 'dres pa'i zung ldan gcig 658

88 ldog pa'i zung ldan gsum/ 6609 khyad par gzhan gyi 'khor lo gsum/ 66410 dbyangs sogs nges pa'i bya dka' ba bcu gnyis/ 670rgyan gyi bye brag gsum pa gab tshig bshad pa/ 686gzhung don gsum pa skyon sel bcu dmigs bsal dang bcas pa 722rgyan spyi 'i don bsdu ba/ ༷ 778dgos pa'am 'bras/ bu bshad pa/ 778mtha' mar dge ba mjug bsdu ba dang / mdzad byang / 'gyu ra byang bcas gsum/ 779gzhung gi mjug byang / 781pod kyi yig srol dar tshul brjod pa'i gtam blo gsal dga' ston/ 785yi ge dag po zhig yong ba byed bsam na thog mar yi ge klog stangs kyi sgra dga'adza zhigaspyodagos/ 806tshad ma'i 'byung khungs/ 309sngog 'don byed rin che ba'i bang mdzod/ 817ye shes lha mo dang mgar ba stobs rgyal/ 828

1sum rtags kyi snying 'grel legs bshad 'dren pa'i pho nya zhes bya ba/'go brjod/bde legs su gyur cig shes byar gzigs pa'i spyan yangs la/ /lhag bsam bzang po'i dpal 'bar zhing / /'chad tsod rtsom pa'i spobs pa can/ /skyes mchog rnams la gus btud nas/ /dbyangs garsā la yi ge'i tshogs pa gang / /ming dang tshig tu rab sbyar te/ /shes bya'i sa/nas kun brjod nus pa'i/ /brda sprod gzhung lugs cung zad spro/ /'di ni rang gi myong tshor dran gso ste/ /mkhas pa'i legs bshad 'dren pa'i pho nya dang / /blo gsar don gnyer can gyi nyer mkho yin/ /nongs par gyur kun lung dang rigs pas sol//zhes sngon du 'gro ba'i tshig 'ga' zhig gis sdun bsus te 'dir gleng bar bya ba ni 'di lta ste/ spyir na bod kyi yi ge 'di la sbyar bya yi ge'i rnam grangs dbyangs bzhi dang / gsal byed sum cu tham pa las med cing /sbyor tshul tshig phrad kyi 'jug pa'ang tshan rig gi rang bzhin ldan pa zhig yin pas rjod byed kyi tshig sbyor bde ba dang / brjod bya'i don gsal la 'khrulagazhi med pa/ rig pa'i gnas lnga'am shes bya mtha' dag gi don rna dnghag sa

— 2 rdorjergyalapo'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/'phyug pa med par ston thub pa bcas shig lags kyang / sngon chad spyi tshogs 'phel rgyas kyi shugs rkyen dbang gis bkag rgya nges can zhig yod pas chos tshig gi thad la yongs khyab dang gcig gyur gyi lugs shig yod pa las/ de byings la deng rabs dang mthun par gtan la phebs pa zhig ni ga la yong /der ma zad/ bar skabs shig‘‘g.yon lhung ’gi shugs rkyen thebs pa'i 'og bod yig gi rig pa'i gzhung lugs brda sprod pa'i bstan bcos kyi srol rgyun thad dang / gcig gyur gyi rang bzhin thad gang la'ang nyams dmas chen po byung yod/ bod kyi gtam rgyun du ‘‘yi ge yon tan kun gyi gzhi rtsa yin’’zhes yongs su grags pa ltar yi ge ni shes bya mtha' dag la med du mi rung ba'i rig gnas shig yin zhing / yi ge'i sbyor tshul rnams gsal zhing gtan la phebs pa zhig ma byung na deng skabs chab srid dang / dpal 'byor/ dmag don/ tshan rig lag rtsal bcas 'phel rgyas kyi myur tshad bya 'phur ba lta bu'i skabs 'dir mi rabs snga ma snga ma nas phyi ma phyi ma'i bar yar rgyas su 'gro ba'i shes rig rnams kyi nyams myong phyogs bsdoms kyis yig thog nas rig pa'i gzhung lugs spel rgyu dang brda sprod rgyu'i las 'gan rnams mi 'grub pas rang re'i bya gzhag ji tsam yar rgyas che ba de tsam du yi ger 'bad brtson che ba zhig dgos pa de'i lag len la gzhol ba'i mkhyen ldan rnams kyi dpyad gzhi dang / shes bya'i gnas la 'jug par spro ba'i blo gsar gzhon nu rnams kyi nyer mkho skong ba'i zhabs 'degs su sman pa zhig byung na snyam pa'i lhag bsam gyis kun nas bslangs te bod kyi brda sprod pa'i ba sta na bcos sum rtags kyi yig cha khungs btsan pa sum cu pa'i snying po

sum rtags kyi snying 'grel las sum cu pa/ 3legs bshad ljon pa'i dbang po dang / rtags 'jug gi snying po dka' gnad gsal ba'i me long gzhir byas nas bod yig gi sbyor tshul go bde mdor bsdus su bris pa'o//sum cu pa/swa bracad dad po/ sbyan py-i gi gezhi rnamā gzhag zhatha/da pu/dang po/ ming gzhi bshad pa/rtsa mig dbyangs kyi bya ba gsal po ru/ /byed pa i u e o bzhi/ /gsal byed ka sogs sum cu yin//zhes pa ltar yul gangs can pa'i skad kyi ming tshig brjod pa mtha' dag gi gzhir gyur pa'i yi ger dbye ba phye na dbyangs dang gsal byed gnyis yod cing / dbyangs kyi bya ba gsal por byed mkhan i u e o bzhi ste/gi gu dang / zhabs kyu dang / 'greng po dang / na ro bcas bzhi dang /gsal byed sum cu tham pa ste/ ka kha ga nga / ca dzwa ja nya/ ta thaX da naX/pa pha ba ma/ tsa tsha dza wa/ zha za 'a ya/ ra la sha sa/ ha lta bcas ka mad sum cu tham pa'o/ /de la yig 'bru bzhi bzhir sde pa re brtsis te sde pa phyed dang brgyad yod/ bod yig gi rtsa ba'i ming gzhi dbyangs gsal sum cu so bzhir nges shing / zhar byung du bshad na yi ge de dag ming dang tshig tu bsgrub par bya ba'i phyir ka mad sum cu po de rkyang pa dang / brtsegs ma

4 rdo rje rgyal po'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/dang / 'dogs can bcas kyi rnam gzhag phye na rkyang pa ni gong du bshad zin pa ltar dang / brtsegs ma la ra mgo can rka rga rnga ja rnya rta rda rna ba rma rtsa rdza bcas bcu gnyis dang / la mgo can ska sga lnga lca lja lta lda lpa lha lha bcas bcu dang / sa mgo can ska sga snga snya sta sda sna spa sba sma stsa bcas bcu gcig dang / ya btags can kya khya gya pya phya bya mya bcas bdun dang / ra btags can kra khra gra tra thra dra na pra phra bra za sra shra pho bcas bcu bzhi dang / la btas/sa can kla gla bla zla rla sla bcas drug dang / wa btags can kwa kha ga rtswa nywa dwa twa tshwa zhwa zwa rwa lwa shwa tsā hwa bcas bco lnga dang / ra mgo ya btags can rkya rgya rmya bcas gsum dang / sa mgo ya btags can skya sgya spya sbya spya bcas lnga dang / sa mgo ra btags can skra sgra sna spra sbra smra bcas drug dang /ra mgo dang wa btags can rtswa dang / dmigs bsal rgya skad sogs nas byung ba'i ming tshig 'ga' zhig la mkho ba bod yig la gsar du bsnan pa hpha —s+ho dang / legs sbyar gyi stug po'i yi ge gha dzha rha bha dang / log pa'i yi ge ṭa ṭha ḍa ṇa dzi kṣa bcas kyang bed spyod dgos pa'ang shes par bya dgos lags/ de dag ni ming tshig gi gzhir gyur pas ming gzhi zhes zer ro//gnyis pa/ rjes 'jug bshad pa/rtsa tshig ga nga da na ba ma 'a/ /ra la sa rnams rjes 'jug bcu//zhes pa ltar ming gzhi'i yi ge gang yang rung ba'i rjes su 'jug pa'i

sum rtags kyi snying 'grel las sum cu pa/ 5yi ge ga nga da na ba ma 'a ra ༷ sdu bcas bcu yod/ sbyor tshul ni dper na/'dug mthong / yod/ rgyan/ thob/ gtam/ dga'/ mngar/gsarme/ nas lta bu'o// ༷ rjes 'jug bcu po de'i nang nas dwa dang sru gnyis ni rjes 'jug gi snyelang rjes su 'jug pas yang 'jug ces zer/rtsa tshig da dang sa gnyis yang 'jug ste/ /da ni na ra la gsum dang / /sa ni ga nga ba mar 'thob//ces pa ltar yang 'jug gi yi ge da dang ga gnyis yod/ de'i nang nas da ni rjes 'jug na ra la gsum gyi mthar 'jug ste/ dper na/kund bsgyurd/ bsald lta bu dang / yang 'jug sa ni rjes 'jug ga nga ba ༷ma bzhi'i mthar 'jug ste/ dper na/ phyogs/ gangs/ skyabs /'joms lta bu'o//gsum pa/ sngon 'jug bshad pa/rtsa tshig ga da ba ma 'a sdon 'jug/ces pa ltar ga da ba ma 'a lnga ni ming gzhi'i yi ge'i sngon du'ang 'jug pas sngon 'jug ces zer/ sbyor tshul ni dper na/ gdong / dge/btang / mdun/ 'asbyo lta bu'o//

6 rdo rje rgyal po'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/rga bucad gahaṃspe pu/ sbyon tshulka tshig sdod kyi zhadug pu dazhad pu/dang po/ rjes 'jug la bstos nas 'jug pa'i phrad rnam dbye dang bcas pa bshad pa/1 slar bsdu/rtsa tshig go ngo do no bo mo 'o/ /ro loso to slar bsdu ste/ /rdzogs tshig zla sdud ces kyang bya/ /drag yod to dang mtha' med 'o/ /gzhan rnams ming mtha'i rjes mthun sbyar//zhes pa ltar go ngo do no bo mo 'o ro lo so to bcas yig 'bru bcu gcig po de la slar bsdu snyes zer/ ༷rdzogs tstshage gaXm zla sdud ces kyang zer/ de ltar zer dgos don ni yig 'bru bcu gcig po de ming tshig gang gi mthar sbyar rung skabs bab kyi brjod bya'i don de nyid de tsam gyis rdzogs par ston pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis so/ /sbyor tshul ni rjes 'jug da drag can rnams la to dang mtha' med rnams la 'o sbyor dgos shing / gzhan rnams la ni ming tshig de'i rjes 'jug gang yin pa de dang 'dra ba zhig la na ro yod pa zhig sbyar bas 'thus te dper na/ de na 'dug gī/ ngas mthong to / khyed la yod do/ de yin no/ bsam don 'grub bo/ gos 'di 'jam mo/ slob gnyer la dga' ༷/ 'di gser ro/ de dingul dzwa/ ngas shesaX so/ phyi rol tu phyind to/ de ltar dge'oX lta bu'o//

sum rtags kyi snying 'grel las sum cu ba/ 72 la don/rtsa tshig su ra ru du na la tu/ /la don rnam pa bdun yin te/ /rnam dbye gnyis bzhi bdun pa dang / /de nyid tshe skabs rnams la 'jug /sa su ga ba drag mthar tu/ /nga da na ma ra la du/ /'a dang mtha' med ra dang ru//zhes pa ltar su ra snre du na la tu bcas yig 'bru bdun po 'di rnams rnam dbye gnyis pa las su bya ba dang / rnam dbye bzhi pa dgos ched dang / rnam dbye bdun pa rten gnas dang / rnam dbye gnyis pa'i nang tshan de nyid dang / rnam dbye bdun pa'i nang tshan tshe skabs bcas don lnga la 'jug cing / de dag don la sbyor tshul dper brjod gsham du 'god rgyu dang rjes 'jug la bltos nas sbyor tshul ni don lnga gar gcig pa ste/ dper na/ sa mthar su 'thob pa ni/ phyogs su thon lta bu dang / ga ba drag mthar tu 'thob pa ni/ sbug tu bcug kho nub tu phyin song / rang cag phyi rold tu 'gro lta bu dang / nga da na ma ra la'i mthar du 'thob pa ni/zhong du snyan seng zhus/ bod sdi bsdad/ mig gis g.yas rgeyon du bltas/yang dag pa'i lam du 'gro dgos/ chu 'khor sdi yos 'thag par btang /kho rang yul du log song lta bu dang / 'a dang mtha' med mthar ra dang ru 'thob pa ni/ bya nam mkha' ru 'phur song / bya nam mkhar 'phur song /kha ru so yod/ khas so yod lta bu dang / na la gnyis ni rjes 'jug la bltos ma dgos par ci bder sbyar bas 'thus te dper na/ 'og na sa

8 rdo rje rgyal po'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/gzhi barming / 'brog na nor lug mang / steng na— sprin dkar myo dzes/ khong ༷ bka' 'dri zhus/ dzwa na su yod/ de la bslapre bya rgyobs lta bu dang /gong du bshad pa ltar rnam ༷dbye gnyis bzhi bdun pa sogs kyi nang po /ses dbye tshul lam ngos 'dzin byed stangs cung zad dka' bas slar yang 'grel bshad dang dper brjod sbrags nas so sor bshad na 'di lta ste/(1) rnam dbye gnyis pa las su bya ba ston pa'i la don gyi phrad de ni bya ba'i yul gang zhig la byed pa po zhig gis bya ba byed pa'i tshe bya ba'i yul gtso bor ston pa zhig dgos te/ dper na/ shar phyogs su 'gro/ bum par chu blug rgya lam du phyin/ g.yag ༷ khal bkal/ dgra la 'thab/bod du btang / stag la me mda' brgyab lta bu'o//(2) rnam dbye bzhi pa dgos ched ston pa'i la don gyi phrad de ni byed pa po zhig gis bya ba byed pa'i tshe bya ba des bya ba'i yul de'am de dang 'brel ba'i las la phan 'dogs pa ston pa zhig dgos te/ de'ang bya ba'i yul la phan 'dogs pa ni/ dper na/ zhing la lud brgyab/ bu laX peklenangatan bslabs/ nad pa1 sman bcos byas/ lus la gos gyon lta bu dang /de dang 'brel ba'i las la phan 'dogs pa ni/ dper na/ shing sa/cod byed du sta re nyos/ rab rgal ba la rta glas/ don gsal byed cwa 'grel bshad byas lta bu'o//(3) rnam dbye bdun pa rten gnas ston pa'i la don gyi phrad de ni dngos po gang zhig yin rung de de na gnas pa'am yod pa tsa ma sto/na pa las bya ba byayopa mi na pa zhig dgos te/ dper na/ nags su gcan gzan

sum rtags kyi snying 'grel las sum cu pa/ 9gnas/ gling gar shing sdong yod/ kha snge so yod/ byang duX tshwa mang / ste nga na nyi zla mdzes/ 'brog tu nor phyugs bzang / 'og tu gdan 'jam lta bu'o//(4〉 rnam dbye gnyis pa'i nang tshan de nyid kyi la don gyi phrad de ni bya ba'i yul dang bya ba gnyis ngo bo gcig tu gyur te dbye ba 'byed dnghargyu7 (pe sdo snyepukhe ston pa zhig dgos te/ dper na/ gos/ su gyon/ mngon par mdzes/me sdo 'bar/ rab tu spro/ mngon dhyā gyur/ gong du 'phel/ khyad du 'phags lta bu'o// ༷ (5) rnam dbye bdun pa'i nang tshan tshe skabs kyi la don gyi phrad de ni dus tshod ston par zhugs pa zhig dgos te/ dper na/ rjes su mjal yong / rtag par brtson dgos/ chu tshod dang po la slob grwa tshugasaX/ zla 10ches1 la rgyal khab kyi dus chen red/ gtan du bde ba thob/ yun ring st+ri slob dgos lta bu'o//zhar byung du bshad par bya ba ni/ gzhung 'dir ma bstan kyang b.ri0/da ma thag pa'i la don gyi phrad de dag gi nang nas na la gnyis la don gyi 'jug tshul gzhan yang yod pa las/(1) na sgra dmigs kyis dbye ba'i don du sbyar ba/ dper na/dngos su bshad na/ mdor bsdus na/ de yin na lta bu/ji pho (2) na sgra rgyu mtshan gyi don sdu sbyar ba/ deper na/ me yod na du ba 'byung / 'bad brtson byas na 'bras bu 'thob/ sa bon ma btab na lo tog ga la skye lta bu/

10 rdo rje rgyal po'i gsung rtsom sbyags bsgrigs/(3) na sgra rgyu mtshan don gyis bstan pa'i don du sbyar ba/ dper na/ mkhas pas kyang mi shes na blun pos ga la shes/ byang thang du nas kyang mi skye na 'bras ci la skye/ 'khor lo 'di rtas kyang 'then mi thub na bong bus lta ci smos lta bu/(4) na sgra snga ma de las tshig phyi ma 'gal ba'am ma yin pa sogs ston pa'i don du sbyar ba/ dper na/ mi 'di sngon chad le lo can zhig na da ni brtson 'grus dang ldan pa zhig go /khyed sngon chad dbul ba zhig na da ni phyug po'o/ /khron tu'u 'di dbyar kha tsha ba chen po zhig na da lta ni bsil po red lta bu/(5) na sgra 'os par dka' ba ste mi 'os pa'i chag gam tshod 'dzin pa'i sgo nas tshig don phyi ma nges par byed pa'i don du sbyar ba/ dper na/dgras kyang btud na gnyen rnams lta ci smos/ blun pos kyang rtogs na mkhas pas smos ma dgos/ bslabs kyang mi shes na ma bslabs na ga la shes lta bu/(6) na sgra 'os pa nan gyis bzung nas phyi tshig nges phar byed pa'i don du sbyar ba/ dper na/ mi de la gnyen rnams kyis bstod par byed na dgra bos kyang bstod par byed do/ /don 'di mkhas bas rtogs pa zhig na blun pos kyang rtogs par 'gyur ro/ /rgyal khab 'di dar rgyas che ba zhig na gzhan dag kyang de lta bu yod lta bu/(7) na sgra smon pa'i don du sbyar ba/ dper na/ deng rabs can bzhi po de 'phral mar mngon du 'gyur ba zhig byung na ci ma rung / nga la bu

sum rtags kyi snying 'grel las bum cu pa/ 11yid du 'ong ba zhig byung na dga' ba la ang / lha sar chu glog shugs chen zhig byung na snyam lta bu/(8〉 na sgra the tshom gyi gzhi'i don du sbyar ba/ dper na/ sa rgod 'dir nas shig btab na skyes yong ngam mi yong / ngas re 'dun zhig bton na khos khas blangs e yong / ngas khyim la yi ge zhig btang na 'phrod e 'gro lta bu/(9) la sgra tshig lhag ma 'dren pa lhag bcas kyi don du sbyor ba/dper na/ sems rnal du phab la rtog dpyod gyis/ shing dum bur gtubs la bzo dbyibs thon/ chang btung la kha rog sdod lta bu/(10)la sgra tshig snga phyi mtshams sbyor ba tsam la 'jug pa/ dperañtsan/ bde ba dang ldan la gnod pa med pa/ dwangs la dri ma med pa/mkhas la spobs pa chung ba lta bu/ smra sgo nas bstan pa ltar na na la gnyis 'jug yul da dung kha shas yod kyang / deng skabs kyi tshig sbyor la mkho che ba mi mngon pas ma bris lags/3 i ldan/(1) 'brel sgra/rtsa tshig gi kyi gyi yi 'i lnga po/ /rnam dbye drug pa 'brel sgra ste/ /spyod tshul na ma ra la gyi/ /da ba sa kyi ga nga gi/ /'a dang mtha' merdo 'i dang yi//zhes pa ltar gi kyi gyi sdi 'i bcas lnga po 'di rnams ni rnam dbye drug pa

12 rdo rje rgyal po'i gsung rtsom phyogs/ bsgrigs/'brel sgra zhes ming don phan tshun 'brel ba sto pa'i don la 'jug cing /sbyor tshul ni rjes 'jug na ma ra la bzhi'i mthar sdi 'thob ste/ dper na/ston gyi dus/ lam gyi 'gram/ gur gyi chon thag yul gyi ljongs lta bu/da ba sa gsum gyi mthar kyi 'thob ste/ dper na/ skad kyi gdangs/ yab kyi bka'/ lus kyi stobs lta bu dang / ga nga gnyis kyi mthar gi 'thob ste/dper na/ 'brugaX sdi skad/ nang gi dngos po lta bu/ 'a dang mtha' med kyi mthar 'i dang yi 'thob ste/ dper na/ nam mkha'i sprin/ nam mkha' yi phrion/ ༷rta'i 'gros/ rta yi 'gros lta bu/ de dag ni rjes 'jug la bltos nas 'aXjug tshul dang sbraXgs nas —ming don phan tshun nyabrel ba tsam gcig tu gril ba'i dper brjod yin/ zhib mor dbye na khang steng gi dar cha lta bu rten dang brten pa'i 'brel sgra dang / nyi ma'i 'od lta bu ngo bo gcig pa'i 'brel sgra dang / gser gyi rna rgyan lta bu gzhi mthun gyi 'brel sgra dang /ngaldi lag pa lta bu yan lag dang yan lag can gyi 'brel sgra dang / ras kyi kha dog lta bu chos dang chos can gyi 'brel sgra dang / khyod kyi nor lta bu bdag po dang dngos po'i 'brel sgra sogs mang du yod do//yang / gi kyi gyi yi 'i lnga po de rnam dbye'i don ma yin pa gzhan dag la 'jug pa'ang yod de/ dper na/ 'di bden gyi gzhan rnams ni cha ma ma/chis/ rang cag gi 'akro lam ni spyi tshogs ring lugs yin gyi ma rtsa'i ring lugs ma yin no/ /'di lta bu 'thad mod kyi 'on kyang brtag dgos lta bu phyi tshig 'gal ba'am mi mthun par ston pa sogs kyang yod pa shes dgos so//

sum rtags kyi snying 'grel las sum cu pa/ 13 (2) byed sgra/rtsa tshig de rnams sa mtha' can lnga ni/ rnam dbye gsum pa byed sgra ste/ /sbyor tshul 'brel sgra'i skabs dang mtshungs//zhis pa ltar 'brel sgra'i yig 'bru lnga po de so so ra sa yig re sbyar ba/gis kyis gyis yis 'is lnga po 'di rnams ni rnam dbye gsum pa byed sgra ste byid pa po zhig gis bya ba byas pa ston pa'i don can la 'juX/pho skre / dper na/ dpal ldan gyis bshad/ dom gyis bzas/ 'khor gyis bskor/dgra 'dul gyis nyan par byed/ srid gcod kyis 'bri bzhin rsha red/ khab kyis phug ras kyis btums song / lug gis brdungs yong / rlung gis 'ded/ mdas bsad/ mda' yis bsad/ gris dras/ gri yidzee dras lta bu yin zhing / byid pa po 'di la zhib mor phye na gtso phal gnyis yod de/ dper na/ lcags bzo pas tho bas lcags brdungs lta bu la cha mtshon ma// lcags bzo pa de lcags rdung mkhan byed pa po gtso bo de yin zhing /rdung byed (rdung yas)tho ba de la byed pa po phal ba zer la byed pa'ang zer/de ltar gyi byed pa po gtso phal gnyis kar byed sgra nges par du sbyor dgos so//yang / chang btungs pas bzi lta bu byed sgra rgyu mtshan la 'jug pa dang / nga las khyed lo gsum gyiswā rgan lta bu byed sgra khyad par ston par 'jug pa dang / khyed kyis rtsis bzhes te khong la 'bul rogs sa/nang lta bu gig la khyed kyis rtsis bzhes kyis khong la 'bul rogs gnang lta bu zhig bris na byed sgra lhag bcas la 'jug pa dang / ngas bshad kyis khyod kyis nyon lta

14 rdo je rgyal po'i gsung rtsom cags bsgrigs/ cibu byed sgra phyi tshig 'dren byed kyi phrad du 'jug pa'ang yod pa rnams byed sgra dngos min yang / 'dir bstan rnam dbye gsum pa'i khongs su 'jog dgos so//4 rgyan sdud/rtsa tshig kyang yang 'ang gsum rgyan sdud de/ /ga da ba sa drag rma thar kyang / /nga na ma ra la mthar yang / /'a dang mtha' med 'ang dang yang //zhes pa ltar kyang yang 'ang gsum ni mabyun pa'i tshig rgyan dang / mi mthun pa'i tshig rgyan/ sdud pa'i don bcas la 'jug cing / de'ang rjes 'jug ga da ba sa bzhi'i mthar kyang thob pa ni/ dper na/ 'dug kya nga /yod kyang / btab kyang / byas kyang / brtsald kyang lta bu dang / nga na ma ra la lnga'i mthar yang 'thob pa ni/ dper na/ byung yang / pham yang /mthun yad / 'khor yang / mjal yang lta bu dang / 'a dang mtha' med kyi mthar 'ang dang swāng 'thob pa ni/ dper na/ dga'ang / dga' yang /skyo'ang / skyo yang lta bu'o/ /don la 'jug tshul ni mthun pa'i tshig rgyan dang / mi mthun pa'i tshig rgyan/ sdud pa'i don bcas gsum yod pa 'obs/(1) mthun pa'i tshig rgyan zhes tshig snga phyi gnyis mthun pa zhig gi bar du 'jug pa'i tshig rgyan ni/ dper na/ bslabs kyang bslabs la shes kyang shes/ btab kyang btab la skyes kyang skyes/ skyid kyang skyid la

sum rtags kyi snying 'grel las sum cu pa/ 15dga' yang dga' lta bu/(2) mi mthun pa'i tshig rgyan zhes tshig snga phyi gnyis mi mthun pa zhig gi bar du 'jug pa'i tshig rgyan ni/ dper na/ shes rgya chung yang lhag bsam che/ lo rgas kyang gzugs khams thang / tshig shes spyang don mi shes lta bu/(3) sdud pa zhes tshig zin du yod pa'i kyang yang 'ang gsum gang rung de'i shugs bstan du tshig don gzhan zhig go rgyu yod pa zhig la 'jug pa'i sdud sgra ni/ dper na/ mi de hur brtson yang chen po 'dug der yab kyang bzhugs 'dug khong nga rgyal yang chen po red lta bu'o//5 lhag bcas/rtsa mig te de ste gsum lhag bcas te/ /na ra la sa drag mthar te/ /da de ga nga ba ma 'a/ /mtha' med rnams la sa ste 'thob//ces pa ltar te de ste gsum ni ming tshig gang gi mthar sbyar rung de'i rjes su bstan bya tshig na lhag ma 'dren rgyu yod pa zhig ston pas lhag bcas zhes jir/ de dag rjes 'jug la bltos nas sbyor tshul ni/ rjes 'jug na ra la sa bzhi dang da drag gi mthar te 'thob ste/ dper na/ gyon te/ sbyan rta/ rgyal te/ byas ṭī lta bu dang / da mthar de 'a thob pa ni/dper nadzo/ bshad de lta bu/ ga nga ba ma 'a lnga dang mtha' mid rnams la sa ste 'thob pa ni/ dper na/ lam bkag ste/ gzhu bkang ste/ gos bkab

16 rdo je rgyal po'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/ste/ shing skam ste/ sems dga' ste/ nga'i ma ste lta bu/ lhag bcas de dag don la sbyor tshul la dbye na mtshams spyor lhag bcas dang / dam bca' lhag bcas/ gzhan 'dren lhag bcas bcas gsum yod pa las/(1) mtshams sbyor lhag bcas zhes 'dren byed dang 'dren byu sdodu lke la bya ba dus rim pa can nam cig car du yong ba gang rung zhi ste/ dper na/ 'o/da' 'phangs te phog gos gyon lha phyin/ nyams byas te 'gro lta bu nas sgra dang tshig phrad cing sogs kyi 'jug tshul dang mthun par 'jug pa rnams so//(2) dam bca' lhag bcas zhes pa ni tshig snga ma dam bcas pa de/'i gsal byed dam sgrub byed du tshig phyi ma 'dren pa zhig ste/ —dper na/phyos/ sa ni bzhi ste shar dang / lho dang / nub dang / byang bcas so lta bu dbye ba 'dren pa dang / rtag pa yin lha yod pa gang zhig 'dus byas ma yin pa'i phyir lta bu gtan tshigs 'dren pa dang / rlangs 'khor te rlangs shugs kyis bskor ba'i 'khor lo'o lta bu nges tshig 'dren pa dang / gzhan ma nga rgyasdo/ bshad 'dren pa sogs kyang yod do//(3) gzhan 'dren lhag bcas zhes mtshams sbyor dang dam bca' gnyis su mi gtogs pa'i brjo bya lhag ma yod pa tsam ston pa gzhanā rtsa yog te /wa dper na/ deb de ngas mthong ste klog ma myong / blor chub ste lag len du ma 'khyol/ de dag dgashā ste dka' spyad kyis 'bad darghaṃs ltasabu'o//

sum rtags kyi snying 'grel las sum cu pa/ 176 'byed sdud/rtsa tshig gam ngam dam nam bam mam 'am ram lam sam tam 'byed sdud de/ /sbyor tshul slar bsdu'i skabs dang mtshungs/ /ra ru 'i yi 'ang yang rnams/ /rkang pa mi skong skong ba'i khyad/ /'o 'u 'am gyi gong du tsheg /med dang yod pa'ang de bzhin yin//zhes pa ltar gam ngam dam nam bam mam 'am/ ram lam sam ttam bcas yig 'bru bcu gcig gle de la 'byed sdud ces zer zhing / de dag ming tshig gi mthar sbyor tshul ni slar bsdu'i skabs dang mtshungs te/ dper na/ 'dug gam/ mthong ngam/ yod dam/ yin nam/ 'grub bam/ bsam mam/dga' 'am/ dga'am/ zer ram/ g.yul lam/ byas sam/ gyurd tam lta bu dang / don la sbyor tshul ni 'byed pa dang sdud pa gnyis yod pa las/(1) 'byed pa zhes dbye gzhi gcig las bye brag gnyis sam mang she por 'byed pa ni/ dper na/ dbang po lnga ste/ mig gam/ sna' ma/rna ba'am/ lce'am/ lus bcas so/ /yang 'byed sdud kyi sgra de rnams the tshom dang / 'dri ba dang / gdam nga bcas sogs la 'jug pa'i tshig rnams kyang don gyi khyad par la brtag cing dbye ba 'byed pa'i don can yin pas 'byed pa'i khongs su gtogs te/ dper na/ khyed kyis sum rtags shes sam mi shes lta bu 'dri tshig dang / smyu gu 'di khyed kyi e yin nam lta bu the tshom gyi tshig dang / de ring dgung tshigs la 'bras sam gro zhib gang byung yang chog lta bu gdam nga can sogs kyang rtogs par bya'o//

18 rdo rje rgyal po'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/(2) sdud pa zhes tshig don mang po dbye gzhi'am don gabyugadngha tu rnged 14 ni/ dper na/ mig gam/ sna'am/ rna ba'am/ lce'am/ lus bcas ni dbang po lnga'o lta bu dang / shar ram/ lho'am/ nub ba ma/byang bcas ni phyogs bzhi'o lta bu dang /(3) gong gsal la don gyi ra dang ru dang / 'brel sgra'i 'i dang yi/ rgyan sdud kyi 'ang dang yang rnams skabs gang dang gang la sbyor tshul ci dang ci 'dra zhig byed dgos zer na/ tshig gi rkang pa kha skong dgos na ru dang / yi dang / yis dang / yang rnams sbyor dgos te/ dper na/gling ga ru bskyod/ nga yi dpe cha/ su yis bris/ sgra yang snyan lta bu dang /tshig gi rkang pa kha skong mi dgos na ra dang / 'i dang / 'is dang / 'ang rnams tsheg bar med par sbyor dgos te/ dper na/ gling gar bskyod/nga'i dpe cha/ sus bris/ sgra'ang snyan lta bu dang / de'ang dzas zhes pa'i 'i dngos su mi 'briX bar sa kho na ༷bris te go thub pas skad gsar ༷bcad kyi lugs la yig zor yang ba'i ched du bsdus pa ma gtogs thob thang med pa ma yin pa dang / de bzhin du 'o 'u 'am rnams kyi gong du tsheg yod med kyi khyad par yang tshig gi rkang pa kha skong dgos min gyi dbang gis te/ dper na/ shar du 'gro 'o/ re 'u mig sgra 'am dri lta bu rnams tshig gi rkang pa kha skong dgos pa dang / shar du 'gro'o/ re'u mig sgra'am dri lta bu rnams tshig gi rkang pa kha skong mi dgos pa yirno zhing / rkang pa kha skong dgos min ni tshigs bcad kyi skabs su gal che ba las tshigs lhug la ci bder sbyar bas 'thus so//

sum rtags kyi snying 'gril las sum cu pa/ 197 'byung khungs/rtsa tshig nas las 'byung khungs dgar sdud de/ /'byung khungs dngos la gang sbyar 'thus/ /rigs mthun dgar nas mi mthun las/ /sdud la nas sgra kho na 'jug/ces pa ltar nas dang las gnyis ni 'byung khungs dang / dgar ba dang / sdud pa bcas la 'jug cing / de dag so sor bshad na/(1) gang zhig gang las byung ba'am bral bar ston pa rnam dbye lnga pa 'byung khungs ston pa la nas las gnyis ci bder sbyar bas 'thus te/dper na/ ba las 'o ma 'byung / ba nas 'o ma 'byung / me nag du ba 'phyur/me las du ba 'phyur lta bu dang / 'byung khungs cha 'dra ba rta nasdu lhungs/ rta las lhungs lta bu yin cing / de'i nang nas kyang nas sgra go bde ba 'dug snyam/(2) 'byung khungs kyi yan lag tsam du gyur pa dgar ba ste/ rnam dpye sbyar yul gyi gzhi de nas rigs dang bya ba yon tan rdzas sogs kyi khyad par gang yang rung ba zhig logs su dgar ba la rigs mthun dgar ba dang / rigs mi mthun par dgar ba gnyis yod/ de'i nang nas dgar gzhi dgar chos rigs mthun par dgar ba dper na/ gangs ri'i nang nas jo mo glang ma mtho/ lcags rigs kyi nang nas gser rin thang che/bya rnams kyi nang nas lpags bye'u gshog rtsal zhan lta bu rnamasal — ri tha sgra kho na 'jug cing / dgar gzhi dgar chos rigs mi mthun par dgar ba dper na/ g.yag las glang chen lus stobs che/ chu las ja zhim/ sngar

20 rdo rje rgyal po'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/las da lta skyid lta bu rnams la las sgra kho na 'jug go/(3) gang zhig gang nas 'go brtsams pa de nas bsdu bya rdzogs pa zhig ston pa ni sdud pa ste/ dper na/ pe cing nas lha sa bar lta bu yul sdud pa dang / na ning nas da lo bar lta bu dus sdud pa dang / gcig na sa bcu'i bar lta bu grangs sdud pa yin/ 'di'i gras la'ang nas sgra kho na 'jug cing / rnam dbye lnga pa'i yan lag tsam yin gsungs/8 'bod sgra/rtsa tshig kye dang kwa ye 'bod sgra ste/ /phal cher ming gi thog mar sbyor//zhes pa ltar kye dang / kwa ye dang / wa ye rnams ni 'bod pa gsal byed kyi sgra ste/ rnam dbye dang po ming tsam kho nar 'jug cing / phal cher ming gi thog mar sbyor dgos/ dper na/ kye ma grogs po tshur gson dang / /kwa ye 'dir bzhugs blo mthun tsho/ /wa ye nga yi spun zla rnams lta bu dang / ming gi mtha' mar sbyar yang 'thus te/ dber na/ grogs po legs par mdzod cig kye lta bu'o//gnyis pa/ rjes 'jug la ma bstos pa'i phrad rang dbang can bshad pa/1 ni sgra bshad pa/rtsa tshig ni ni dgar dang brnan pa'i sgra//

sum rtags kyi snying 'grel las sum cu pa/ 21zhes pa ltar ni zhes pa de dgar ba dang brnan pa'i don gnyis la 'jug ste/(1) ni zhes pa ni dgar sa'i gzhi zhig nas mchog tu dgar ༷sga'o/zug/ rngosnozugazug tha/ཿṭa 2sdob/zab nga/'orazug/ jo1 dzi/tshasdo stargabya/ /sdu ngasdob/zeb pa/ hunab/ chub 'jug ste/ dper na/ yon tan can ni mi yi mchog lta bu dgar gzhi mi yi nang nas yon tan can mchog tu dgar rsha dang / bong bu ni dud 'gro'i tha ma 'ig red lta bu dgar gzhi dud 'gro'i nang nas bong bu darmen par dgar ba dang / sngon po ni ljang khu dang tha dad red lta bu dab/ra gzhi ljang khu dang dgar chos sngon po gnyis tha dad tsam du dgar ba lta bu'o//(2) ni zhes pa de ni don gang zhig yin rung de nyid la nan tan du brnan pa 'i donaX la 'jug ste/ dper na/ khyed ni spun zla red/ khyed ni grogs po red/ 'di ni mkhas pa'i khyad chos shigaX red lta bu'o// 2 dang sgra bshad pa/rtsa tshig dang ni sdud 'byed rgyu mtshan dang / /tshe skabs gdam ngag lnga la 'jug /ces pa ltar dang zhes pa de ni sdud pa dang / 'byed pa dang / rgyu mtshan dang / tshe skabs dang / gdam ngag bcas don lnga la 'jug ste/(1) dang zhes pa de don gnyis sam mang po phyogs gcig tu cing wa pa la 'jug pa ni/ dper na/ 'das pa dang / ma 'ongs pa dang / da lta ba rnams tshang ma dus so lta bu/

22 rdo rje rgyal po'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/(2) dang zhes pa de dbye gzhi don gcig nas bye bragaspre gaXdzig sam lke dhe ༷nga por 'byed pa zhig la 'jug pa ni/ dper na/ dus ni 'das pa dang / ma 'ongs pa dang / da lta ba rnams so lta bu'o//(3) dang zhesaX pa de rgyu mtshan ston par 'jug pa ni/ dper na/du ba ma thong ba dang me yod par shes/ sman zas pa dang nad drag song lta bu'o//(4) dang zhes pa de dus tshod ston pa tshe skabs la 'jug pa ni/dper na/ nyi ma shar ba dang las kar phyin/ sgo phye ba dang nang du 'dzul lta bu'o//(5) dang zhes pa de gdam ngag ste gzhan la gdams pa'am skul ba'i tshig dang 'brel nas 'jug pa ni/ dper na/ legs par slobs dang / yid la zungs dang lta bu'o//3 de sgra bshad pa/rtsa tshig ming gi thog ma'i de sgra ni/ /tha snyad 'das ma thag pa dang / /rnam grangs gzhan can gnyis la 'jug/ces pa ltar ming gi thog mar yod pa'i de sgra de ni don mang por 'jug par bshad mod/ mdor bsdus na tha snyad 'das ma thag pa dang /tha snyad rnam grangs gzhan can gnyis dang / don la 'jug pa ltar tha snyad gzhan 'dren lhag bcas gsum la 'jug cing / rtsa tshig tu de sgra ming gi thog mar sbyor tshul gsungs pa ni gtso che ba'i don yin gyi mtha' gcig tu

sum rtags kyi snying 'grel las sum cu pa/ 23ma nges so//(1) tha snyad 'das ma thag pa zhes brjod bya spyi'i don la ma dpyad par rjod tshul de nyad la thad kar btags pa'i dus 'das pa la 'jug pa ni/ dper na/ pha gir zhing pa zhig 'dug de gzhon nu'o/ de gzugs ring ngo / /de ngo zheng che'o/ /de skad gsang ngo lta bu'o//(2) tha snyad rnam grangs gzhan can zhes tshig zin du dngob/ su :she da gsal yang de sgra'i shul du rnam grangs gzhan zhig go rgyu yod par ma tshon par 'jug pa ni/ dper na/ de la ltos shig de ma shod cig de gang red dam lta bu'o//(3) de sgra tha snyad gzhan 'dren lhag bcas la 'jug kyang 'dir rtsa tshig nang du ma bshad pa ni lhag bcas kyi skabs su bshad pas 'thus par dgongs pa ste/ de'ang zhar du bshad na/ lhag bcas kyi sgra de'i shul kyi brjeXdabye bya'i lhag ma zhig 'dren rgyu yod pa tsam las don gzhan mi ston parasna zhe 'jug pa ni/ dper na/ shing bcad de ci zhig byed/ bsdad de yi ge bris/ brjed thor bkod de bzhag lta bu'o//4 spyi sgra bshad pa/rtsa tshig ci ji su gang spyi sgra ste/ /zhig ste slad 'dra phyir la ci/ /snyed srid ltar bzhin skad la ji/ /su ni gang zag gang kun la'o/ /zhes pa ltar ci ji su gang bzhi po de don gyi bye brag dmigs su mi 'dzin par spyi la khyarsha rsha'i don can la 'jug cing / de dag tshig tu bsdebs

24 rdo rje rgyal po'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/nas sbyor skabs zhig dang / ste dang / slad dang / 'dra dang / phyir bcas kyi sngon du ci 'jug ste/ dper na/ 'di ci zhig yin/ da ci ste bya/ deb 'di ci slad bris/ don ci 'dra zhig yin/ nyid ci phyir 'byon lta bu dang /snyed dang / srid dang / ltar dang / bzhin dang / skad bcas kyi sngon du ji 'jug ste/ dper na/ don ji snyed cig yod/ ji srid ma shes bar du slobs/ ji ltar byas na legs/ mkhas pa'i gsurme ji bzhin du byed 'os/ mi de'i ming la rdi skad zer lta bu dang / su ni gang ༷zag ste mi zhig la ma gtogs mi 'jug dper na/ su yis zer/ su la yod/ de su'i red lta bu dang / gang ni dbye ba med par kun la khyab pa ste/ dper na/gang gi ched du las ka byas/ de 'dra ba gang la'ang yod/ khyed gang nas yong ba yin lta bu'o//5 bdag sgra bshad pa/rtsa tshig na ro yod med pa ba ma/ /bdag po'i sgra ste ga da na/ /ba ma sa dang drag mthar pa/ /nga 'a ra la mtha' med la/ /bdag sgra yar gyur pa dang ni/ /cha la pa nyid sbyor ba legs/ /zhes pa ltar pa ba ma gsum dang de dag la na ro sbyar ba po sdo sdo gsum ni sngar ming gi cha shas su med pa zhis/ la gsar du sbyar na bdag po'am byed pa po ston pa'i sgra yin te/ de'ang rjes 'jug ga da na ba ma sa bcas drug dang da drag can gyi mthar pa po gnyis dang / rjes 'jug nga 'a ra la bzhi dang mtha' med rnams kyi mthar bdag sgra yar gyur pa rnams la ba dang

sum rtags kyi snying 'grel las sum cu pa/ 25bang/ga sgra char gyur pa rnams la pa nyid sbyor ba legs zhes gsungs/ de'ang rjes 'jug ga da na ba ma sa bcas dang da drag can mthar pa dang po 'thob pa ni/ dber na/ 'brog pa dang / bod pā/ lam ston pū/ rogs ram pa/ chos pa/ phyi roladzwa pa/ phyug po/ mes sdo/ borno po/ chom po/ 'khyam po lta bu dang / rjes 'jug nga 'a ra la bzhi dang mtha' med rnams la bdag sgra yar gyur pa'i skabs su ba 'thob pa ni/ dper na/ phul byung ba dang / rgya mda' ba/ zlos gar ba/ gsang myul ba/ gsum mdo ba lta bu rnams bdag sgra yar gyur pa dang / tshong pa dang / mda' pa/ gar pa/ 'grul pa/ grwa ༷ lta bu rnams bdag sgra cha tshig yin nga sa so/ /bdag sgra ma yin pa ming mtha'i pa po rnams kyi sbyor tshul yang phal cher gong dang 'dra ste/ dper na/ ltag pa/ gog pa/ grod pa/ skyid po/ glen pa/ blun po/ zla ba/ zla bo sogs lta bu dang / bdag sgra'i mo rtags mtshon pa'i ma dang mo ni rjes 'jug la bltos ma dgos par ci bder sbyar bas 'thus te/ dper na/ chang ༷/ bdag sdo/dpa' sdi lta bu'o//zhar byung du bshad na/ can dang ldan gnyis kyang gang zhig gang la lod pa ston pa'i cha nas bdag sgra dang mtshungs par 'jug ste/ dper na/shes yon/ 'byor pa/ blo gros lta ba'i ming de dag so sor can dang ldan ༄ gnyis gsar du bsnan te sbyar na shes yon can/ shes ldan/ 'byor pa can/ 'byor ldan/ blo gros rgan/ blo ldan zhes su grub pa de dag shes yon sogs kyi ming tsam du ma bahūṃd par shes 6na sogs ldan pa'i gang zag gam mi zhig go ba de dag gi 'jug tshul yang nges par du shes dgos so//

26 rdo rje rgyal po'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/6 dgag sgra bshad pa/rtsa tshig ma mi min med dgag sgra ste/ /ma mi thog ma min med mjug /ma ni bar gyi gsal byed la'ang //zhes pa ltar ma mi min med bzhi ni ming tshig gang zhig la sbyar rung sbyar yul gyi don de ma yin pa'am med par ston pas dgag sgra zhes zer/sbyor tshul ni ma mi gnyis thog mar 'jug ste/ dper na/ ma 'gro/ mi dgos/ mi 'dug lta bu 'gro ba dang / dgos pa/ yod pa bcas bkag nas de'i ldog phyogs rnams ston pa dang / min med gnyis mjug tu 'jug ste/ dpen na/ nga min/ sdug bsngal medu/ bya rgyu med lta bu yin pa dang / yod pa'i ldog phyogs rnams ston pa lta bu dang / ma ni bar gyi gsal byed de ming tshig gang rung gnyis kyi bar du sbyar ba/ dper na/gangs ma char/ ra ma lug la ma lung lta bu sbyar yul gyi tshig don snga phyi gnyis ṅka bkag ste don gzhan zhig ston pa lta bu'o//spe dacad gsun pu/ tshog mid dad / 'a muji' āod sped/tsheg gad sbyon tshuska bucaska zhagad pu/dang po/ mig phrad smyor tshul bshad pa/rtsa tshig tshig phrad zhing sogs nga na ma/ /'a dang ra la mtha'—med mthar/ /zhing zhes zhe'o zhe na zhig /ga da ba dang da drag

sum rtags kyi snying 'grel las sum cu ba/ 21mthar/ /cing ces ce'o ce na cig /sa mthar dmib /sa bsal zhes ma gtogs/ /shing shig she'o she na 'thob/ /'on kyang kha cig lhan cig sogs/ /ming gi cha dang ma nor gces/ /zhes pa ltar tshig phrad la 'jug pa zhing zhes zhe'o zhe na zhig bcas dang / cing ces ce'o ce na cig bcas deng /༷ shing ṅgeg sheX'o she na bcas rnams brjod bde ba dang don ༷gsal bar byed pa'i tshig ༷phrad cig ste/de'ang rjes 'jug nga na ma 'a ra la drug dang mtha' med rnams la zhing zhes zhe'o zhe na zhig rnams 'thob ste/ dper na/ mthong zhing phyung zhes bzang zhe'o/ /de gang zhe na khyung zhig 'dug ces pa rnams lnge mtharaX sbyor tshul yin zhing / de bzhin na ma 'a ra la mtha' med bcas la'ang rigs 'gre'o/ /rjes 'jug ga da ba gsum dang da drag can rnams la cing ces ce'o ce na cig rnams 'thob ste/ dper na/ phog cing chag ces drag ce'o/ /der 'dug sdo na chog cig smros/ zhes pa rnams ga mthar 'jug tshul yin cing / de bzhin da ba da drag can rnams la'ang rigs 'gre'o/ /rjes 'jug sa mthar shing shig she'o she na rnams dang / shes kyi tshab tu zhes bcas 'thob ste/ dper na/ bltas shing byugs zhesdu grags she'o//nam dgoṭasdo she na bab ltos shig lta bu'o/ /de'ang cing dang / zhing dang / shing rnams mtshams sbyor lhag bcas dang 'jug tshul 'dra zhing / zhe na dang / ce na dang /she na rnams ni zer na zhes pa'i don la 'jug zhe'o dang / ce'o dang /she'o rnams sno zer ro zhes pa'i don la 'jug zhes dang ces ni bshad ma yag pa'i tshig der nges bzung ngam nan tan byed pa'i don la 'jug

28 rdo je rgyal po'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/gnyis pa/ 'a mtha' 'dor len byed tshul bshad pa/rtsa tshig rkyang pa 'phul la 'a mtha' dgos/ /gug kyed brtsegs 'dogs can la spongs//zhes pa ltar ming tshig gang rung gi rkyang pa ste/ dbyangs bzhi dang /ra la sa gsum gyi mgo can/ ya ra la wa'i smad 'dogs bcas med pa 'phul can te sngon 'jug gang rung zhig yod pa rnams la 'a mtha' sbyor dgos/ dper na/ dgaphru/ mnga'/ dma' lta bu'o/ /de ltar sbyor dgos don gang yin zer na de dag la 'a mtha' ma sbyar na de rnams kyi ming gzhi ga nga ma rnams rjes 'jug tu gyur te/ dag mang / dam bcas su 'gyur ba'i rgyu mtshan gyis so/ /yang gug ces pa gi gu dang zhabs kyu dang / kyed ces pa 'greng po dang na ro/ bsdogs zhes pa ra la sa gsum gyi mgo can/ 'dogs zhes pa ya ra la wa'i smad 'dogs can bcas la 'a mtha' sbyar mi dgos/ dper na/ 'di/ mgu dge mdo/ rka/ lnga/sna/ rgya/ dgra/ klu lta bu rnams la don thob tu 'a mtha' yod kyang de dag gi 'a mtha' bsduṭa/ rung 'khrul gzhi med par brten skad gsar bcad kyi skabs su de dag gi 'a mtha' rnams yig zor yang ba'i ched du bsdus te dngos su sbyor mi dgos pa byas pas so//gsum pa/ tsheg shad myur tshul bshad pa/tre rtsa tshig lhu pa'i don mang ming mtshams dang / /don 'bring

sum rtags kyi snying 'grel las sum cu pa/ 29'byed dang don zhung rdzogs/ /tshigs bcad ga mthar chig shad bya/ /rdzogs tshig mtha' can lhug pa dang / /tshigs bcad rkang mthar nyis shad 'thob/ /don tshan chen mo rdzogs pa dang / /le'u'i mtshams su bzhi shad dgos/ /nga yig ma gtogs yig shad dbar/ /tsheg med de sogs zhib tu 'bad//ces pa ltar tsheg dang shad kyi sbyor tshul ni/ tshig lhug gi skabs su don mang po'i ming mtshams rnams su shad re 'thob ste/ dper na/ bzo las dang / zhing las dang / dmag don dang / tshan rig lag rtsal bcas sgo kun nas 'phel rgyas gtong dgos lta bu dang / de bzhin du don 'bring 'byed pa dang / don nyung rdzogs mtshams dang / tshigs bcad kyi kang pa'i ga mtha' rnams su'ang shad re sbyar bas 'thus te/ dper na/bdag gis sum cu pa'i rnam dbye dang / tsheg phrad rnams dang / rtags 'jug gi bdag gzhan dus gsusta/ bya byed las gsum bcas bslab par bya'o/ /lta bu dang / rdzogs tshig mtha' can tshig lhug dang / tshigs bcad kyi rkang pa'i mthar nyis shad re 'thob ste/ dper na/ tshig lhug gi skabs su/ gong du bshad pa'i tsheg shad sbyor tshul rnams bdag gis shes par bya'o/ /lta bu dang / tshigs bcad kyi skabs su/ de dag bdag gis shes par bya/ /lta bu dang / don tshan chen mo rdzogs mtshams dang /le'u re'i mtshams su bzhi shad re sbyor dgos te/ dper na/ sum cu pa'i phrad dang rnam dbye'i sbyor tshul rnams rdzogs so// //lta bu dang /྾ ྾ ྾zhos bya ba le'u dang po rdzogs so// //lta bu'o/ /dbu can

30 rdo je rgyal po'i gsung rtsom spyogs bsgrigs/'bri ba'i skabs su ming tshig gi mtha' ma'i nga dang shad kyi bar du tsheg med na ba dang nor dogs kyi tsheg re 'bri dgos pa las/ gzhan rnams la yi ge dang ya/da kyi bar la tsheg mi dgos pa sogs zhib mor 'bad dgos so// //rtags 'jugarga bracad dad po/ ldi gezhi dbyangs gaskalka nyu rtags kyi dasgye bu bragad pu/rtsa tshig spyir na dbyangs mo gsal byed pho//zhes pa ltar spyir na bod yig la dbyangs kyi bya ba gsal por byed mkhan ā li ste i u e o bzhi shes rab kyi rang bzhin mo yin zhing / kā li ste ka kha ga nga / ca cha ja nya/ ta tha da na/ pa pha ba ma tsa tsha dza wa/zha za 'a ya/ ra la sha sa/ ha a bcas gsal byed sum cu tham pa la sde dziphyed dang brgyad yod pa de rnams thabs kyi rang bzhin pho yin no//pho yig sum cu tham pa de'ang nang gses sde tshan lngar dbye dgos te/rtsa tshig de phyir kā li sum cu po/ /pho yi yi ge 'ba' zhig la/ /nang gses sde tshan lngar dbye ste/ /ka ca ta pa tsa rnams pho/ /kha cha tha pha tsha ma ning / /ga ja da ba dza wa zha/ /za 'a ya sha sa rnams mo/ /nga nya na ma shin tu mo/ /ra la ha a mo gsham ste/ /a ni mtshan med ces kyang bya//zhes pa ltar dbyangs gsal gnyis kyi nang nas gsal byed rnams pho — yin pas na pho yi yi ge 'ba' zhig gam rkyang rkyang yin pa sum cu tham pa de snye

sum rtags kyi snying 'grel las rtags 'jug 31nang gses sde tshan lngar dbye na ka ca ta pa tsa lnga pho dang / kha cha tha pha tsha lnga ma ning dang / ga ja da ba dza wa zha za 'a ya rsha sa bcas bcu rgenyis ༷mo ༷dang / nga nya na ma bzhi shin tu rmi dang / rno la hwa a bzhi mo gsham yin zhing / a ni mtshan med dam rtags med ces pa'ang yin no/ /de ltar dbye tshul ni yi ge rnams so sor ngag nas brjod pa'i tshe so so'i skye gnas mgrin pa dang /mchu dang / rkan sogs la phrad pa'i byed rtsol gyi shugs che chung la gzhigs nas dbye dgos shing / des na pho yig rnams sgra shugs che ba dang / ma ning rnams sgra shugs ran pa'am 'bring dang / mo rnams sgra shugs zhan tsam dang /shin tu mo rnams sgra shugs zhan pa dang / mo gsham sgra shugs de las kyang zhan pa dang / a ni sgra shugs ha cang zhan pas sgra med kyang zer ba bcas so//de ltar dbye tshul shes par bya ba'i ched du yi ge'i gnas dang / byed pa/ rtsol ba zhes gsum yod pa de dag kyang bshad na/ yi ge'i gnas brgyad ni mgrin pa dang / sna dang / spyi bo dang / rkan dang / lce dang /so dang / mchu dang / khog pa bcas so/ /de'ang ka kha ga nga 'a ha a bcas bdun gyi skye gnas mgrin pa dang / ca cha ja nya tsa tsha dza zha ya sha i e bcas bcu gnyis kyi skye gnas rkan dang / ta tha da na za la sa bcas bdun gyi skye gnas so dang / pa pha ba ma wa u o bcas bdun gyi skye gnas mchu dang / ra yig gi skye gnas lce rtse dang nye ba'i spyi bo ste lce rtse'i steng phyogs bcas dang / nga nya na ma rnams rang rang gi skye gnas su ma zad sna sgra dang bcas pa'o/ /byed pa ni mgrin pa dang mchu las skyes pa rnams rang rang gi skye gnas kyi byed pa can dang / rkan las skyes pa rnams lce'i dbus

32 rdo rje rgyal po'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/kyi byed pa can dang / so las skyes pa rnams lce rtse'i byed pa can dang / ra yig ni rtse rtse dang nye ba'i byed pa can bcas so//rtsol ba la phyi nang gnyis yod pa las phyi'i rtsol ba ni phyi rol tu sgra thon pa lta bu'i byed rtsol dang ldan pa'i phyir te de la'ang thon che chung gi dbye bas ga nga ja nya da na ba ma dza wa 'a ya ra la ha a i u e o bcas nyi shu tham pa rnams sgra ldan dang / ka kha ca cha ta tha pa pha tsa tsha zha za sha sa bcas bcu bzhi sgra med dang / sgra phyir dbyung ba'i tshe dbugs shugs che chung gi dbang gis kha cha tha pha tsha zha za sha sa ha a i u e o bcas bco lnga srog chen dang /de byings ka ga nga ca ja nya ta da na pa ba ma tsa dza wa 'a ya ra la bcas bcu dgu srog chung dang / de dag las zha za sha sa ha rnams brjod pa'i tshe dbugs dro bar 'byin pas dro ba'ang yin no/ /nang gi rtsol ba ni mgrin pa gdangs nas badzood dgos pa'i phyir a yig ma gtos/sa srog chen gyi yi ge rnams phye ba'i rtsol ba can dang / a yig mgrin pa ma phye bar brjod pa'i phyir btsum pa'i rtsol ba can yin pa sogs rtsa bar bzung ba'i klog tshul dag po zhig dges pa ni gal shin tu che'o// spe bucad gnyis pu/ sngon zhadug gi rtags pye dabhe bu zhazhad pu dad rtags kyi zhadug pu buzhad pu/dang po/ sngon 'jug gi rtags kyi dbye ba bshad pa/rtsa tshig sngon 'jug lnga yi ba yig pho/ /ga da ma ning 'a mo

sum rtags kyi snying 'grel las rtags 'jug 33yig /ma ni shin tu mo yin cho///zhes pa ltar sngon 'jug gi yi ge ga da ba ma 'a lnga'i nang nas ba yig pho dang / ga da gnyis ma ning dang / 'a mo dang / sta shin tu mo bcas so/ /de ltar dbye dgos don yang sngon 'jug rnams rang rang gi 'jug yul ming gzhi'i yi ge dang sbrags nas klog skabs sgra shugs che chung gi dbang gis so//gnyis pa/ sngon 'jug gi rtags kyi 'jug pa bshad pa/sngon 'jug gi rtags kyi 'jug pa bshad pa la bzhi ste/ 'jug yul ming gzhi'i yi ge gang la 'jug par byed pa dang / 'jug byed sngon 'jug gi yi ge gang gis 'jug par byed pa dang / 'jug tshul sgra drag zhan ji lta ba'i sgo nas 'jug par byed pa dang / dgos pa ci phyir 'jug par byed pa ༄bcas bzhi yod pa las/1 gang la 'jug dang gang gis 'jug par byed pa chabs cig tu bshad pa/rtsa tshig de rnams gang la gang 'jug na/ /pho yig ba ni ka ca ta/ /tsa ga nga ja nya da na/ /dza zha za ra sha sar 'jug /ma ning ga ni ca ta tsa/ /nya da na zha za ya sha/ /sar 'jug ma ning da yig ni/ /ka pa ga ba nga mar 'jug /mo yig 'a ni ga ja da/ /

34 rdo rje rgyal po'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/ba dza kha cha tha pha tshar/ /shin tu mo yig ma yig ni/ kha cha tha tsha ga ja da/ /dza nga nya na rnams la 'jug/ces pa ltar sdon 'jug gi yi ge de rnams gang dang gang la 'jug par byed ce na/ sngon 'jug gi pho yig ba de ming gzhi'i yi ge pho ka ca ta tsa bzhi dang / ming gzhi'i yi ge mo ga nga ja nya da na dza zha za ra sha ༷sa bcas bcu gnyis te khyon bsdoms yi ge bcuX drug la 'jug 'dire ming gzhi'i yi ge mo zhes pa'i nang du mo dang / shin tu mo dang / mo gsham bcas gsum ga 'dus yod/ de'ang ka ga gnyis la rkyang 'dogs brtsegs bcas gsum gar 'jug ste/ dper na/༷ bkar/ bgod/ lta bu rkyang 'phul dang /bkyigs/ bgrangs lta bu 'dogs 'phul dang / bsko/ brgal lta bu brtsegs 'phul lo/ /ta tsa da gsum la rkyang brtsegs gnyis su 'jug ste/dper na/ bton/ btsal/ bden lta bu rkyang 'phul dang / brtan/brtson/ bsdoms lta bu brtsegs 'phul lo/ /dwa ja nya na dza rnams la bahūṃgs ma kho nar 'jug ste/ dper na/ brnga/ brjid/ brnyan/bsnar/ brdzangs lta bu'o/ /ca zha sha gsum la rkyang paX kho nar 'jug ste/dper na/ bcad/ bzhad/ barshad lta bu'o/ /za sa gnyis la rkyang 'dogs gnyis su 'jug steX/ dper na/ bzod/ bsal lta bu rkyang 'phul dang / bzlo/ bslad lta bu 'dogs 'phul lo/ /ra yig la 'arngodogs 'phul kho nar 'jug ste/ dper na/ barmiXng lta bu'o//sngon 'jug gi ma ning ga da gnyis nas ga ni ming gzhi'i pho yig ca ta tsa gsum dang / mo yig nya da na zha byā ya | sa brgyad bcas khyon bsdomyo/sa

sumartags kyi snyinga'agrelalasartagasa'ajug bye yongayi ge bcu gcig la rkyang 'phul kho nar 'jug ste/ dper na/ gcod/gatt+waṃr/ gtsang she gnyen/ gdong / gnon/ gzhan/ gzim/g.yang / gshor/ gsar bcas lta bu'o//sngon 'jug gi ma ning da yig ni ming gzhi'i pho yig ka pa gnyis dang /mo yig ga ba da ma bzhi bcas khyon yi ge drug la 'jug cing / de'ang ka pa ga ba ma lngar rkyang 'dogs gnyis su 'jug ste/ dper na/ dkar/dpal/ daswe/ dbar/ dma' lta bu rkyang 'phul dang / dkyis/ dpras/dgyes/ dbyings/ dmyal lta bu 'dogs 'phul/ nga yig la rkyang 'phul kho nar 'jug ste/ dper na/ dngar lta bu'o//sngon 'jug gi mo 'a yig ni ming gzhi'i mo yig ga dwa da ba dza lnga dang /ma ning kha cha tha pha tsha lnga bcas khyon yi ge bcu la 'jug cing / de'ang ga ba kha phru bzhi la rkyang 'dogs gnyis su 'jug ste/ dper na/ 'gan/'byār/ 'khon/ 'phur lta bu rkyang 'phul dang / 'gya5sa/ 'byar/'khrigs/ 'phrul lta bu 'dogs 'phul lo/ /de min da da dza cha tha sa bcas drug la rkyang 'phul kho nar 'jug ste/ dper na/ 'jags/ 'dam/'dzar/ 'chang / 'thag 'tshams lta bu'o//sdon 'jug gi shin tu mo ma yig ni ming gzhi'i ma ning kha cha tha tsha bzhi dang / mo yig ga ja da dzwa nga tso nu bdun bcas khyon yi ge bcu ༷gcig la rkyang 'phul kho nar 'jug ste/ dper na/ mkhar/ mchog mthar/mdzwar/ masmyo/ mdwal/ mdangs/ mdzes/ mngar/ mnyen/mnar lta bu dang / kha ga gnyis la 'dogs 'phul du'ang 'jug ste/ dper

36 rdo rje rgyal po'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/na/ mkhyen/ mgyogs lta bu'o//2 sngon 'jug rnams sgra'i tshul ji lta bu'i sgo nas 'jug pa bshad pa/rtsa tshig ji ltar 'jug par byed ce na/ /pho ni sgra rtsol drag par 'jug /ma ning ran par 'jug pa yin/ /mo ni zhan pa'i tshul gyis te/ /shin tu mo ni mnyam pas so//zhes pa ltar sngon 'jug gi pho yig ba ni rang gi 'jug yul ming gzhi'i yi ge rnams la sgra rtsol drag pa ste sgra rtsol drag po'i sgo nas 'jug ste/ dper na/ bkab/ bsgrubs/ brtan lta bu'o//sngon 'jug gi ma ning ga da gnyis ni rang rang gi 'jug yul ming gzhi'i yi ge rnams la sgra rtsol ran pa ste 'bring gi sgo nas 'jug ste/ dper na/ gcod/ gnyen/ gser/ dpal/ dmar/ dga' lta bu'o//sngon 'jug sgo mo yig 'aX ni rang gi 'jug yul ming gzhi'i yi ge rnams la sgra rtsol zhan pa ste chung ba'i sgo nas 'jug ste/ dper na/ 'khor/'dzin/ dkaun lta bu'o//sngon 'jug gi shin tu mo ma yig ni rang gi 'jug yul ming gzhi'i yi ge rnams la sgra rtsol mnyam pa steX ha cang chung ba'i sgo nas 'jug ste/ dper na/ mchan/ mgon/ mjal lta bu'o//

sum rtags kyi snying 'grel las rtags 'jug 313 sngon 'jug rnams dgos pa ci'i phyir 'jug par byed pa bshad pa/rtsa tshig ci phyir 'jug par byed ce na/ /thog mar 'di ltar shes dgos te/ /las gang zhig la byed pa po/ /gzhan dang dngos su 'brel ba yi/ /dbang du byas nas byed po dang / /de yi byed pa gnyis po ni/ /dngos po bdag yin bya yul dang / /bya ba gnyis po dngos po gzhan/ /de bzhin byed pa po gzhan dang / /dngos su 'brel min ji ltar yang / /bya ba byas zin 'das pa dang / /bya ba byed 'gyur ma 'ongs pa/ /byed bzhin pa ni da lta ba/ /de phyir dus gsum dbye bas ni/ /byed las dang 'brel ngag gi ni/ /sbyor ba kun la khyab pa yin/ /bdag gzhan dbye bas de tsam du/ /khyab pa min yang byed po dang / /bya yul bsdu phyir dbye ba de/ /mdzad nas bdag gzhan dang 'brel ba'i/ /bya byed rnams kyang de khongs bsdus/ /des na dus gsum du dbye ba/ /bdag gzhan dbye bas ma khyab pa/ /bsdu ba'i don du shes dgos par/ /gsungs kyang sngon 'jug 'a yig skabs/ /byed las tsam dang 'brel ba yi/ /dngos po bdag la'ang 'jug pa mthong //zhes pa ltar sngon 'jug rnams dgos pa ci'i byir 'jug par byed ce na/ de sems la nges shing rtogs pa zhig byed pa la thog mar 'di 'dra zhig

38 rdo rje rgyal po'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/shes par byed dgos te/ las ka ga 'dra zhig yin rung byed pa po gzhan dang dngos su 'brel ba dper na/ shing brto bas sta reg shing bcaXd lta bu la cha mtshon na byed pa po ste/ shing gcod mkhan shing bzo ba de dang /de'i byed pa'am lag cha sna re/ gcod pa'i byed las dang bcas pa la ni dngos po bdag ces zerno ba dang / des bya ba bskrurbe par bya ba'i yul te/gcad bya'am gcad rgyu'i shing de la bya ba'i yul lam las zhes zer ba de dang / shing de gcad par bya ba'i byā las sam gcad rgyu'i las ka dang bcas pa la ni dngos po gzhan zhes zer/ yang / byed pa po shing bzo ba de dang / gcod byed sta re/ gcod par byed lta bu'i byed las da lta ba bcas la dngos po bdag ces dang / gcad rgyu'i shing de dang gcad par bya lta bu'i bya las ma 'ongs/ pa gnyis la dngoru ngo ga'/na zhes zer yang chog cing /de dag ni dngos po bdag gzhan gyi dbye tshul lo//dus gsum gyi dbye tshul ni/ byed pa po'am las ka byed mkhan zhig dang dngos su 'brel ba dper na/ shing bcad/ bcad tshar/ bcad do lta bu las ka byas tshar ba ston pa ni dus 'das pa dang / shing gcad rgyu/gartad dgos/ gcad par bya lta bu las ka byed rgyu ston pa ni dus ༷ma 'ongs pa jeng / gasdod baXzhin pa/ gcod sgang red/ gasdod kyi 'dug lta bu las ka byed bzhin pa ston pa ni dus da lta ba'o/ /byedzwa pa po'armi las ka byed mkhanarizhig dang dngos su ma 'brel ba dper na/ shing chad 'dugadzwad song / rtad do lta bu bya ba byung zin pa ston pa ni dus 'das rbe dang /shing rmechad rgyu ram̐d/ 'chad la nye/ 'chad parda 'gyur lta bu bya ba yong rgyu

sum rtags kyi sgringa'agrelalasartagasa'ajug —390ston pa ni dus ma 'ongs pa dang / shing 'chad kyi 'dug 'chad bzhin pa red/ 'chad par byed lta bu bya ba yong bzhin pa ston pa ni dus da lta sgabacas yin/ yang / kho pe cing du 'gro lta bu zhig la cha mtshon na/ 'gro sakhan de byed pā po yin la/ 'gro bar byed pa'i byed las kyang yod kyang 'gro bya'am 'gro bar bya rgyu yang kho rang ma gtogarme gzhan med pas bya byed tha gro dad pa 'di rigarme la kho la byed pa po phal ba'am byed pa tsam zer ba las dngos po bdag gzhan gnyis su dbye rgyu med cing / dus gsum du dbye na/ kho pe cing du phyin song / phyin pa red/ phyin to lta bu bya ba byas zin 'das pa dang / 'gro rgyu red/ 'gro bar nye/ 'gro bar 'gyur lta bu bya ba byed rgyu ma 'ongs pa dzwang / 'asdo skabs/ 'gro bar byed/ 'gro bzhin pa red/ lta bu bya ba byed mus yin pa ston pa ni da lta ba'o//yang / shing de chod cig lta bu bya byed tha dad par 'jug pa'i skul rdig dang / khyod rgyugs ༷ga lta bu bya byed tha mi dad kyang 'gro mkhan gang zag la 'jug pa'i skul tshig yin zhing / sems med kyi bya byed tha mi dad par shing chad cig lta bu'i skul tshig mi 'jug go/ /'o na skul tshig rnams dngos po bdab/ gnan dang dus gsum gang rung du bsdu dgos she na/ de skul byed kyi tshig yin pas dngos po bdag gi khongs su gtogs shing / dus gsum gyi nang du bsdu skabs byed las sdi 'ongs par bsdu bar rigs so/ /rgyu mtshan de dag gi phyir dus gsum gyi dbye bas ni byed las dang 'brel ba'i ngag gi sbyor ba yongs rdzogs la khyab cing / dngos po bdag gzhan gyi

40 rdo rje rgyal po'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/dbye bas ni de tsam du mi khyab ste byed pa po dang 'brel ba'i las dang / bya ba'i yul dang 'brel ba'i las ma gtogs las gzhan te/ byed pa po dang dngos su ma 'brel ba'i las bya byed tha mi dad pa rnams mi 'dus so/ /de'i phyir dus gsum gyi dbye ba de ni bdag gzhan gyi dbye bas ma khyab pa rnarma sa bsdu ba'i don du yin pa shes dgos lags/ de rnams ngos zin po dang sems la nges po zhig ma byung na rtags 'jug gi snying po'am gal che shos bdag gzhan dus gsum gyi gnad don thag chod pa zhig yong gi ma red/ (1) sngon 'jug gi pho yig ba dgos pa ci phyir 'jug par bshad pa/rtsa tshig de ltar nges nas pho yig ba/ /bsgrubs so lta bu 'das pa dang / /bsgrub bya'i lha dang bsgrub par bya/ /zhes sogs dngos po gzhan la 'jug/ces pa ltar sngon 'jug gi pho yig ba ni byed pa po'am las ka byed mkhan gzhan zhig dang dngos su 'brel ba'i bya ba byas zin 'das ༷ dang /dngos ngo/ bdag gzhan gnyis nas gzhan bya ba'i sdil lam lag dang / bya ba bsgrub pa'i ched du 'jug cing / de'ang 'das pa la 'jug pa ni/dper na/ 'bru yis bkung / re ba bskangs/ don bashrībs lta bu rnams kyi nang nas 'bru yis bkang lta bu sngon 'jug ba yig rang gis 'das tshis/ ston pa dang / re ba bskrungs lta bu ni ba yig kho nas 'das tshig ston pa ma yin par yang 'jus/ sa yig dang zung du 'brel nas 'das tshig ston pa red/ dngos po gzhan bya ba'i yul lam las basbrub par bya ba'i ched du

sum rtags kyi snying 'grel las rtags 'jug 41'jug pa ni/ dper na/ bklag bya'i yi ge / bgo bya'i gīs/ bsgrub gi'i don lta bu dang / bya ba'i yul dang rmebrel ba'i bya las gsal byed la 'jug pa ni/ dper na/ bklag pa1 bya/ bgo bar bya/ bsgrub paXr bya lta bu dang / gzhan yang / bza' ba dang / bgo ba/ btung ba sogs bya tshig med kyang bya yul lam las go nus tsam la 'jurge pa'ang ༷mang po yod do//(2) sngon 'jug gi ma ning ga da gnyis dgos pa ci phyir 'jug par bshad pa/rtsa tshig ma ning ga— da gnyis po ni/ /gcod pa po dang gcod par byed/ /gcod par 'gyur dang dkri ba po/ /dkri bar byed dang dkri bar 'gyur/ /zhes sogs dngos po bdag don dang / /gcad bya'i shing dang gcad par bya/ /dkri bya'i snal ma dkri bar bya/ /zhes sogs dngos po gzhan don dang / /gcod bzhin pa dang dkri bzhin pa/ /zhes sogs da lta bsgrub ched 'jug/ces pa ltar sngon 'jug gi ma ning ga du gnyis ni dngosapo bdag gzhan gnyis ka dang / dus da lta ba ston pa'i ched du 'jug ste/ de'ang ga yig de dngos po bdag byed pa po las ka byed mkhan ston par 'jug pa ni/ dper na/ bar du gardirme ba po/ gcir byed/ 'og tu gnon pa sdo/ gnon byed/ shing gcod the po/ gartsed byed lta/ bu dang / rge yig byed pa po dang 'brel ba'i byed las gsal byed laX 'jug pa ni/ dper na/bar du kacir bar byed/ 'og tu gnon rber sdid/ shing gcod par byed

42 rdo rje rgyal po'i gsung rtsom snyogs bsgrigs/lta bu dang / ga yig de dngos po gzhan bya ba'i yul lam las ston par 'jug pa ni/ dper na/ gcad bya'i shing gcad bya/ gnan bya'i dgra bo gnan bya/ gnyer gi'i don gnyer bya lta bu dang / bya ba'i tshul dang 'brerla ba'i byā las ༷gsarme byed la 'jug pa ni/ dper na/ shing gcad pakā bya/ dgra bo gnan par bya/ don gnyer bar bya lta bu'o/ /sngon 'jug gi ma ning da yig dngos po bdag byed pa po las ka byed mkhan ston par 'jug pa ni/ dper na/ snal ma dkri ba po/ dkri byed/ blos dpyod pa po/ dasdod byed/ dpal 'byor dbang ba po/ dbang byed lta bu dang / da yig de byed pa po dang 'brel ba'i byed las gsal byed la 'jug pa ni/ dper na/ snal ma daspu bar byed/ blos dasdod par byed/dpal 'byor dbang bar byed lta bu dang / da yig de dngorme po gzharno bya ba'i yul lam ༷sa stomāṃ param̐ 'jug pa ni/ dper na/ dkri bya'i snal ma/dkri bya/ dpyad bya'i gnad don/ dpyad bya/ dbang bya'i dpal 'byor/dbang bya lta bu dang / bya ba'i yul dnge 'brel ba'i bya las gsal byed la 'jug pa ni/ dper na/ snal ma dkri bar bya/ gnad don la dpyad par bya/ dpal 'byor dbang bar bya rnye du dang / sngon 'jug gi ma ning ga du gnyis po de dus rkyang da lta ba la gtso cher 'jug pa ni/ dper na/gcod kyin 'asdig gcod sgang red/ gnon bzhin pa/ dkri mus su gnes/ dkri gi 'dugaX dbang bzhin pa red lta bu'o// (3) sngon 'jug gi mo 'a yig dgos pa ci phyir 'jug par bshad pa/rtsa tshig mo yig 'a ni 'chad pa po/ /'chad par byed dang 'chad

sum rtags kyi snying 'grel las rtags 'jug 43par 'gyur/ /zhes sogs dngos po bdag dngos dang / /'gro ba po dang 'gro bar byed/ /ces sogs bdag don phal ba dang / /'khyil lo zhes sogs da lta dang / /'khyil bar 'gyur sogs ma 'ongs 'jug/ces pa ltar sngon 'jug gi mo yig 'a ni dngos po bdag dang / dus da lta ba dang ma 'ongs pa rnams ston ched du 'jug ste/ dper na/ snal ma 'khel ba po/ 'khel byed/ dgra la 'thab pa sdo/ 'thab byed/ bya sogs 'dzin pa po/ 'dzin byed lta bu bya byed so so tha daXd du mngon pa rnams dngos po bdag dang / mgo bo 'khor ba po lta bu bya byed tha mi dad pa dngos po bdag tsam ston pa la'ang 'jug pa dang / snal ma 'khel bar byed/ dgra la 'thab par byed/ mgo bo 'khor bar byed lta bu byed pa po dang 'brel ba'i byed las gsal byed la 'jug cing / dus rkyang da lta bar gtso che bar 'jug pa ni 'khel gyin 'dug 'khel bzhin pa red/ 'thab mus yin/ mgo bo 'khor te bsdad yod lta bu dang / dus rkyang ma 'ongs pa la'ang 'jug pa ni mthong ba tsam gyis lam seng bya byed so sor dbye rgyu med pa ltar snang yang / bya ba de ma 'ongs par 'byung rgyu zhig ston pa rnams te/ dper na/ gzhan du 'khyar bar 'gyur/ mgo bo 'khor bar 'gyur/mtha' ma 'bral bar 'gyur lta bu tshig grogasaX can rnams dang / 'asdo/ 'char/ 'byung la sogs pa tshig grogs ma dgos par ma 'ongs pa ston pa'ang yod la/ tshig grogs kyi dbang gis da lta dang ma 'ongs pa ci rigs su 'gyur ba'ang yod de/ dper na/ 'gro bzhin pa dang / 'char bzhin

44 rdo rje rgyal po'i gsung rtsom snyogs bsgrigs/pa/ 'byung bzhin pa lta bu da lta ba dang / 'gro bar 'gyur/ 'char bar 'gyur/ 'byung bar 'gyur lta bu ma 'ongs pa'o//(4) sngon 'jug gi shin tu mo ma yig dgos pa ci phyir 'jug par bshad pa/rtsa tshig shin tu mo yi ma yig ni/ /bdag gzhan dus gsum mnyam par 'jug/ces pa ltar sngon 'jug gi shin tu mo ma yig ni dngos po bdag gzhun gnyis ka dang / dus da lta ma 'ongs 'das pa tshang mar mnyam pa ste mtshungs par 'jug ste/ dper na/ skud pa sogs mthud pa po/ mthud byed lta bu dngos po bdag dang / mthud bya'i skud pa lta bu dngos po gzhan dang /mthud par byed lta bu byed las gsal byed dang / masdod par bya lta bu bya las gsal byed dang / masdod rdin lta bu 'das pa dang / mthud par 'gyur lta bu ma 'ongs pa dang / mthud bzhin pa lta bu da lta ba dang / mthud kha lta bu rnam dbye dang po ngo bo tsarmi ston pa rshacas tshang mar tshig grogs kyi —'gyur ba tsam las sngon 'jug gi nus pa khyad med du 'jug go/yang / rtsa tshig 'on kyang byed po gzhan dngos dang / /'brel ba'i 'das la 'a'i sngon 'jug /med par nges shing ga da nyung / /da lta ba la ba'i sngon 'jug /nyung zhing mgo can da lta bar/ /bas 'phul med par nges pa tsam//zhes pa ltar byed pa po gzhan dang dngos su 'bril ba'i 'das pa la 'a'i sngon 'jug med par nges shing / sngon 'jug ga da gnyis kyis 'das tshig ston pa nyung shas las med/ dus da lta ba ston par ba'i sngon 'jug

sum rtags kyi snying 'thel las rtags 'jug 45shin tu nyung la/ mgo can da lta ba sgrub bzhin pa lta bu rnams la sngon 'jug med par nges tsam zhes gsungs pa ni tha snyad gyi sa bcad rags tsam zhig la dgongs te gsungs pa yin gyi/ dgra la 'thab lta bu bya byed tha dad pa'i 'das pa la sngon 'jug 'a 'jug pa dang / nyams brtas bzhin pa lta bu mgo can da lta bar bas /phul thob pa'ang yod lags so// yang / rtsa tshig gzhan yang bas 'phul can phal cher/ /byed pa po ni da lta dang / /bya yul ma 'ongs par bsdus nas/ /'das la bas 'phul yang 'jug yod/ /da lta ba la gnyis ka med/ /ma 'ongs 'phul yod yang 'jug med/ /skul tshig 'phul med yang 'jug yod/ /skabs 'gar 'das dang skul tshig la/ /sa rkyang sbyar bas 'thus pa'ang yod//ces gsungs pa ltar gzhan yang bya byed tha dad pa'i tshig bas 'phul can phal cher dus gsum gyi nang du bsdus nas rjod skabs byed pa po'am byid pa de dus da lta ba'i nang dang / bya ba'i yul lam las de durme ma 'ongs pa'i nang du bsdus te 'das pa dper na/ bya ba bsgrubs/ lam bstand lta bu rnams la bas 'phul dang yang 'jug gnyis ka yod/ da lta ba dper na/bya ba sdib bzhin pa/ lam ston gyi yod lta bu rnams la sngon 'jug dang yang 'jug gnyis ka med/ ma 'ongs pa dper na/ bya ba bsgrub rgyu/ lam bstan par bya'o lta bu rnams la bas 'amul yod cing yang 'jug med/ bya ba sgrubs shig lam stond cig lta bu skul tshig rnams la sngon 'jug med cing yang 'jug yod/ skabs 'gar 'das pa dper na/ bya ba byas/

46 rdo rje rgyal po'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/ gter du sbas lta bu dang / skul tshig bya ba gyis shig gter du sbos shig lta bu rnams rla sa rkyang sbyar bas 'thus pa'ang yod ces gsungs pa ltar spyi dang bye brag gi khyad par phye nas sbyar dgos pa ji snyed cig mchis pa rnams rtogs sla ba'i ched du dus gsum gyi 'jug tshul re'u mig mdor bsdus shig gsham du 'god rgyu der gzigs par 'tshal/bdag gzhan dus gsum gyi 'jug tshul 'di gal che zhing cung zad dka' ba de dag nges pa rnyed sla ba'i re bas rnam par gsal byed kyi dper brjod cig yang bskyar bkod na/ byed pa po gzhan dang dngos su 'brel ba zhig cha mtshon pa dper na/ mi dmangs bcings 'akrol dmag gis sa mtshams brtan por bsrungs so lta bu'i bsrungs ni dus gsum gyi nang nas/ 'das pa yin la/ srung bzhin pa lta bu da lta ba dang / bsrung rgyu'am bsrung bar 'gyur lta bu ma 'ongs pa dang / srung mkhan nam srung ba po bakhyings 'grol dmag dang / srung byed kyi mtshon cha/ srung bar byede lta bu'i byed las bcas dngos po bdag dang / bsruje bya'i sa mtshams dang /bsrung rgyu'am bsrung bar 'gyur lta bu'i bya las ma 'ongs pa bcas dngos po gzhan bya ba'i yul lam las ༷yin/ sa mtshams srungs shig lta bu ni skul byed kyi tshig yin pas dngos po bdag yin cing / dus gsum gyi nang du sdud skabs byed lag ma 'ongs par bsdu dgos so//yang bahūṃr ༷thengs gcig bshad na/ bkra shis kyis nyin deb nang du rang gi byed sgo rnams gsal por bris yod pa red lta bur zlo mtshorno na/ bkra shis ni byed pa po dngos po bdag dang / 'bri bya rang gi byed sgo rnams

sum rtags kyi snying 'grel las rtags 'jug 47ni dngos po gzhan dang / bris zhes pa ni bya ba byas zin 'das pa ston pa bcas so/ /de'ang bkra shis kyis nyin deb nang du rang gi byed sgo rnams gsal por bris yod pa red ces pa de gzhir byas nas rgyas pa'am gsal por dbye na bkra shis ni 'bri mkhan te byed pa po dngos yin par smos ma dgos/ de ni dngos po bdag yin/ 'dir tshig zin du med kyang 'bri byed smyu gu de byed pa po phal pa'am byed pa yin/ de'ang dngos po bdag yin/ 'bri bar byed lta bu'i byed tshig cig yod na de ni byed las yin/ de'ang dngos rme bdag gi khongs su gtogs/ nyin deb de ni yiX ge 'bri sa bya ba'i yul rnam dbye gnyis pa 'jug yul de yin zhing / du ni la don no/ /'bri bya rang gi byed sgo rnams ni rtags 'jug gi bya ba'i yul lam las zer ba de yin zhing / de ni dngos po gzhan no/ /gal te 'aspri bar bya lta bu'i bya tshig cig yod na de'ang dngos po gzhan yin/ gsal por bris zhes pas spyir btang ngam rab rob cig min par phra zhing zhib par bris zin pa ston pas de ni bya byed las gsum cha tshang ba'i bya ba byas zin 'das pa ston pa yin zhing / gal te 'bri bzhin pa lta bu zhig yod na de ni dus da lta ba dang / 'asdi bar 'gyur lta bu zhig yod na de ni dus ma 'ongs pa dang / bris shīg lta bu zhig yod na de ni skrul tshig go/ /skul tshig de bdag gzhan gnyis su dbye skabs byed las te dngos po bdag gi khongs dang / dus gsum du dbye skabs byed las sdu 'ongs par bsdu dgos so/ /de dag ni sngon 'jug dang yang 'jug gang yin nam yod med dang / ming gzhi'i yi ge de dag 'gyur dang mi 'gyur gyi khyad par sna tshogs yod pa

48 rdo rje rgyal po'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/rnams sbyong bdar zhib phra dang 'brel blo la gsal por nges pa byed dgos so//spe bucad gsun pu/ nees zhadug gi rtagarga kyi dbye bu buzhad pu dang rtags kyi zhadug pu buzhad pu/dang po/ rjes 'jug gi rtags kyi dbye ba bshad pa/rtsa tshig rjes 'jug yi ge bcu po yi/ /ga da ba sa bzhi rnams pho/ /nga ma 'a gsum mo yin zhing / /na ra la gsum ma ning ste/ /zhes pa ltar rjes 'jug gi yi ge ga nga da na ba ma 'a ra la sa bcas bcu po de nang gses dbye na ga da ba sa bzhi pho dang / nga ma 'a gsum mo dang / na ra la gsum ma ning bcas so/ /de ltar dbye dgos don yang rjes 'jig rnams rang rang gi 'jug yul ming gzhi'i yi ge de dag dang sbrags nas klog skabs sgra shugs che chung gi dbang gis te/ dper na/skyogs/ skad/ skyabs/ bkas lta bu rjes 'jug pho yig zhugs pa rnams sgra shugs drag pa dang / rkang / bkram/ dga' lta bu rjes 'jug mo yig zhusas pa rnams sgra shugs zhan pa dang / dkon/ skyor/ bskul lta bu rjes 'jug ma ning zhugs pa rnams sgra shugs bar ma'am 'bring ngo //gnyis pa/ rjes 'jug gi rtags kyi 'jug pa bshad pa/rjes 'jug gi rtags kyi 'jug pa b.rigad pa la bzhi ste/ 'jug byed

sum rtags kyi snyinga'agrelalasartagasa'ajug da po)rjes 'jug gi yi ge gang gis 'jug par byed pa dang / 'jug yul ming gzhi'i yi ge gang la 'jug par byed pa dang / 'jug tshul sgra drag zhan ji lta bu'i sgo nas 'jug par byed pa dang / rjes 'jug rnams dgos pa ci phyir 'jug par byed bcas bzhi yod pa las/1 'jug byed rjes 'jug gi yi ge gang gis 'jug par byed pa bshad pa/rjes 'jug gi yi ge ga nga da na ba ma 'a raspre la saspre bcas bcu po denu/ 'jug ste/ dper na/ ṅgeg khang / rged/ prerno/ cab cob/ cham/mja'/ gnyer/ rtol/ thos lta bu'o//2 'jug yul ming gzhi'i yi ge gang la 'jug par byed pa bshad pa/rtsa tshig ming gzhi'i yi ge kun la 'jug/ces pa ltar ming gzhi'i yi ge ka mad sum cu tham pa thams cad la 'jug ste/ de'ang ka yig la 'jug tshul ni/ dper na/ bkaXg rkyad /bskyod/ skyon/ rkub/ skam/ dka'/ skyur/ skyol/ bskyis/ skya'/lnga ba dang /༷ de lngar ming gzhi'i yi ge spyi byings ༷kun la 'ang rigs 'gre'o/ /sna sa mi 7 gong du skya' zhes 'a mtha' sbyar ba ltar thob kyang / skad gsar bcari ri kye skabs su yig zor yang ba'i ched du bsdus te dngos su mi 'bri ba las don la mi 'thob pa min pas de ltar nges pa byas nas tshig sbyor byed dgos so/ /

50 rdo rje rgyal po'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/3 'jug tshul sgra drag zhan sogs ji lta bu'i sgo nas 'jug par byed pa bshad pa/rtsa tshig ji ltar 'jug tshul gnyis yin te//zhes pa ltar 'jug tshul sgra drag zhan sogs ji lta bu'i sgo nas 'jug par byed pa de la ni sgra yi 'jug tshul dang don gyi 'jug tshul gnyis yod/(1) sgra yi 'jug tshul bshad pa/rtsa tshig dang po sgra yi 'jug tshul ni/ /pho yi ga yig yang 'jug can/ /skyes bu rab dang pho yig ba/ /yang 'jug can ni skyes bu 'bring / /ga ba yang 'jug med pa dang / /da sa'i mtha' can tha ma ste/ /drag pa pho la'ang nang gses kyis/ /drag zhan bar ma sa//sum du dbye/ /de bzhin zhan pa mo la'ang / /nang gses drag zhan gnyis dbye ste/ /nga ma yang 'jug can mo dang / /nga ma yang 'jug med pa dang / /'a mtha' can rnams shin tu mo / /bar ma ma ning na ra la/ /yang 'jug yod dam med kyang rung / /ming gzhi pho yig mthar yod dang / /ming gzhi ma ning rjes su ni/ /yang 'jug dang bcas zhugs pa na/ /drag dang phrad pas drag par 'gyur/ /ming gzhi mo yig rjes su ni/ /yang 'jug med par zhugs pa na/ /zhan dang phrad pas zhan par 'gyur/ /de gnyis 'gyur ba ma ning yin/ /ming gzhi mo yig rjes su ni/ /yang 'jug dang bcas zhugs pa na/ /drag zhan gnyis ka'i cha ldan phyir/ /

sum rtags kyi snying 'grel las rtags 'jug 51mtshan gnyis ma ning zhes su grags/ /ming gzhi ma ning rjes su ni/ /yang 'jug med par zhugs pa na/ /drag zhan gang du'ang mi 'gyur bas/ /mtshan med ma ning zhes su 'dod/ /ces pa ltar dang po sgra yi 'jug tshul la rjes 'jug rnams spyir pho mo ma ning gsum du dbye tshul gong du bstan zin cing / 'dir pho mo ma ning so so'i nang gses dang bcas zhib mor dbye na rjes 'jug pho yig ga la yang 'jug sa zhugs pa dkrigs/ grags/ btags/ lta bu rnams rjes 'jug nang phrad kyi dbang gis sgra drag pa'i drag par 'gyur bas de la skyes bu rab ces dang / rjes 'jug ba yig la yang 'jugs zhugs pa kaubs/bsgrubs/ 'debs lta bu rnams sgra drag pa'i bar mar 'gyur bas skyes bu 'bring zhes dang / rjes 'jug ga ba gnyis la yang 'jug ma zhugs pa bkagabasgrub lta bu dang / rjes 'jug da sa gnyis kyi mtha' can yod/ sngas lta bu rnams sgra drag pa'i zhan par 'gyur bas skyes bu tha swā zhes zer ro//rjes 'jug nga ma gnyis la yang 'jug ga zhugs pa gangag/ khams lta bu ni sgra zhan tsam du 'gyur bas mo tsam dang / nga sta gnyis la yang 'jug ma zhugs pa kong / sgrom lta bu dang / 'a mtha' can dga' lta bu rnams sgra zhan pa'i zhan par 'gyur bas shin tu mo'o//rjes 'jug na ra la gsum ming gzhi'i pho yig gi mthar yang 'jug yod med gnyis kar zhugs pa bstand/ ston/ bskrund/ dkoXn/btsald/ rtsol lta bu dang / ming gzhi ma ning gi mthar yang 'jug dang bcas zhugs pa phyind/ phuld lta bu rnams sgra drag pa dang phrad pas drag

52 rdo rje rgyal po'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/par 'gyur ba dang / ming gzhi mo yig gi mthar yang 'jug med par zhugs pa 'gran/ mngar/ skyel lta bu rnams ming gzhi sgra zhan pa dang phrad pas zhan par 'gyur ba ste de gnyis la 'gyur ba ga ning zhes zer/ na ra la gsum ming gzhi'i mo yig gi mthar yang 'june ldang bcas zhugs pa ༷ 'dzind/ 'byord/ bsgrald lta bu rnams ming gzhi mo yig de rnams sgra zhan pa dang / yang 'jug da yig de sgra drag pa yin pas drag zhan gnyis ka'i cha ldan pa'i dbang gis mtshaXn gnyis ma ning zhes dang / na ra la gsum ming gzhi'i ma ning gi mthar yang 'jug med par zhugs pa phan/'thor/ 'tshal lta bu rnams ni sgra bar ma tsam las drag zhan gang ༷du'ang mi 'gyur bas mardon med ga mi nga zhes zer ro//(2) do na gyi sbyor nghrurla bshad pa/rtsa tshig gnyis pa don la gnyis yod de/ /snga ma gang ltar 'gyur ba dang / /phyi ma gang ltar 'gyur ba'o//zhes pa ltar gnyis pa don gyi 'jug tshul de la'ang snga ma gang ltar 'gyur ba dang / phyi ma gang ltar 'gyur ba gnyis yod pa/(ka) snga ma gang ltar 'gyur ba bshad pa/rtsa tshig snga ma gang ltar 'gyur ba ni/ /rjes 'jug gang la zhugs pa yi/ /ming des bdag gzhan sogs gang ston/ /phal cher ming de'i sngon 'jug gi/ /nus par sbyar nas rtogs par bya//zhes pa ltar snga ma gang ltar 'gyur zer na/ rjes 'jug gi yi ge bcu po de rnams ming gzhi'i yi ge gang zhig ste rkyang 'dogs brtsegs gsum gang
