sum rtags kyi snying 'grel las rtags 'jug 53zhig la sbyar ba'i ming tshig des dngos po bdag gzhan dang dus gsum sogs gang ston nus ni phal cher ming tshig de dag gi sdon 'jug gi nus pas ston pas sngon 'jug lnga'i rjes su 'brangs te sbyar dgos/ dper na/ nang du 'jug pa po/ gasdod byed lta bu dngos po bdag dang / baphywab bya'i don dang / gcad bya lta bu dngos po gzhan dang / don mngags/shing bcad lta bu 'das ḍi dang / shing gasdod bzhin pa/ blos dpyone kyi 'dug lta bu da lha ba dang / rigs pas dpaXg rgyu/ sheg par 'gyur lta bu ma 'ongs pa rnams ga tso bo sngon 'jug gi nus pas ston pas na/ thon mis snga rme sngon 'jug lnga bzhin sbyar zhes gsungs shing / las ka byās/ zas bzas lta bu rjes 'jug rang nyid kyi nus pas dus 'das pa ston pa'ang yod do//(kha) phyi ma gang ltar 'gyur ba bshad pa/rtsa tshig phyi ma ji ltar 'gyur ba ni/ /rjes 'jug pho yis pho yig gi/ /ming mtha' gzhan drang de bzhin du/ /mo yis mo yi ming mtha' drang / /ma ning gis ni ma ning drang / /de rnams rtags mtshungs 'dren tshul te/ /brjod bde 'dren pa'ang shin tu mang //zhes pa ltar rjes 'jug gi yi ge bcu po de dag sbyar ba'i ming tshig des ming mtha' dang / rnam dbye/ tshig phrad sogs ji lta bu'i sgo nas 'dren dgos zer na/ phal che ba'am gtso bo pho mo ma ning gi rtags mtshungs par 'dren da—gos gsungs/ dper na/ dgag pa/ rgod po/ sgrub pa /spas pa lta bu rjes 'jug pho yig gis ming mtha' pho ༷ drangs pa dang / byang

54 rdo rje rgyal po'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/swā/ ṭasdu ga dgas ma lta bu rnams rjes 'jug mos ming mtha' mo swā drangs pa dang / dgun kha dang / gseXr kha/ snol kha lta bu rnams rjes 'jug ma ning gis ming mtha' ma ning kha drangs pa rnams rtags mtshungs 'dren tshul yin zhing / yang lhag ma lta bu phos mo drangs pa dang / thadwa ka sna bu mos pho drangs pa dang / byin pa lta bu ma ning gis pho drangs pa dang / khram kha lta bu mos ma ning drangs pa sogs brjod bde 'dren pa'ang mang po yod par ma zad/ rtags mtshungs 'dren tshul de dag kyang sgra mthun pa'am brjod bde 'dren tshul las ma 'das so//(ga)rnam dbye dang tshig phrad 'dren tshul yang bshad pa/rtsa tshig gzhan yang ming mtha' de nyid kyis/ /rtags mtshungs pa'am sgra mthun pa'i/ /rnam dbye brgyad dang slar bsdu sogs/ /snga ma'i shugs dang mthun par 'dren/ /de dag nang gses gang 'jug ni/ /rnam dbye'am phrad bcas ming tshig de'i/ /mthar sbyar ming don las shes bya//zhes pa ltar gong du ming mtha' 'dren tshul bshad zin cing / gzhan yang ming mtha' de dag gis pho mo ma ning so so'i rtags mtshungs pa'am sgra mthun pa'i sgo nas rnam dbye dang po ngo bo tsam ston pa dang / gnyis pa las su bya ba dang / gsum pa byed sgra dang / bzhi pa dgos ched dang /lnga pa 'byung khungs dang / drug pa 'brel sgra dang / bdun pa gnas gzhi dang / brgyad pa 'bod sgra bcas drang bar bya zhing / de bzhin rnam dbye'i yan lag tu gyur pa'am ma gyur pa'i tshig phrad slar bsdu dang / lhag

— sumartagasakyi snying 'grel las rtags 'jug thu5 bcas dang / 'byed sdud dang / brnan pa dang / bdag sgra dang / dgag sgra dang / sgrub pa dang / tshig rgyan dang / dus te tshe skabs bcas kyi phrad rnams kyang ming tshig snga ma de'i shugs dang mthun par 'dren dgos/ rnam dbye'am phrad de dag gi nang gses gang zhig 'jug par byed pa ni de dag gi mthar sbyar bar bya ba'am sbyar rgyu'i ming don de dag la gzhigs nas shes par bya dgos shing / de dag gi 'dren tshul rnam par gsal ba'i dper brjod dang bcas mdor bsdus su bshad na/(dang po/ ) rnam dbye dang po'i 'dren tshul ni/rtsa tshig de yang chos rnams ngo bo tsam/ /brjod pa rnam dbye dang po ste/ /dper na bum pa ka ba bzhin/ /gsal byed bod kyi sgra la nyung / /zhes pa ltar rnam dbye dang po zhes pa de ga 'dra zhig yin zer na/chos rnams te thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i shes bya rnams kyi ming ngam ngo bo tsam ston pa zhig ste/ dper na/ bum pa/ ka ba/ nyi ma lta bu de la de btags pa'i ming tsam gyi steng nas gang shes par bya ba'i don de rang ston pa tsam zhig las brjod don gzhan mi ston pa zhig ste/ dper na/ bum pa/ ka ba/ nyi ma zhes brjod pa'i tshe na 'di ni bum pa'o/ /'di ni ka ba'o/ /ya gi ni nyi ma'o snyam pa'i blo zhig skye ba'am brda sprod pa tsam las de ltar zer ba'i rgyu mtshan bshad rgyu med pas de'i rigs la 'dod rgyal gyi ming zhes zer ba dang / yang / gser bum/ nyen ka snang byed

56 rdo je rgyal po'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/ces brjod pa'i tshe gser las grub pa'i bum pa yin pas gser bum dang /nyen zon gyi ched du btsugs pa'i ka ba yin pas nyen ka dang / 'jig rten snang bar byed pas na snang byed de lta bu rgyu mtshan la brten nas ming btags pa de rigs la rjes grub kyi ming zhes zer/ de gnyis ni rtsa ba'i ming rigs gnyis yin/ yang / kru'u zhi dang / gung khran tang / en ke si lta bu thog ma'i ming gi 'byung khungs skad gang yin pa de'i sgra rang sor bzhag pa rnams la g.yar ming ngam sgra bsgyur gyi ming zhes zer dgos pa dang / yang / mar le'i ring lugs dang / gzhis rtse kron chus lta bu phyed rgya skad sor bzhag dang phyed don bsgyur byas pa rnams la phyed g.yar phyed bsgyur gyi ming zer dgos pa bcas rigs bzhi yod cing / de dag tshang ma sngar 'o/sa me da bzhin du nan gyis btags pa'i tha snyad yin la tha snyad kyi mtshan nyid shes brjod 'jug gsum yajuo tshang yod pa red/ dper na/shes pa ni 'di ka ba yin no snyam pa la sogs pa dang brjod pa ni 'di ka bagle zheXs pa'i ngag gi sgra dang / 'jug pa ni 'di kaX ba skren no snyam nas khang khyim gyi rgyu char bed spyod pa bcas lta bu rdeng / rgya gar gyi skad la rnam daphye dang po ming gi mthar rkyen zhig sbyor dgos kyang bod skad la ngo po tsam ston pa'i ming kho na las rkyen sbyor mi dgos pas 'dir yang rnam dbye dang po ming gi bye brag ji yod phye ba las rnam dbye dang po grub byed kyi 'phros pa gleng ma dgos lags/(gnyis pa/ ) rnam dbye gnyis pa 'dren tshul bshad pa la ni rnam dbye gnyis pa dang / bzhi pa/ bdun pa bcas kyi rkyen nam phrad su ra ru

sum rtags kyi snyinga'agrelalas rtasas 'jug da wa /thub du na la tu bcas bduo/ po de sa/cis/ pa yin zhing de dag rjes 'judku/ la bltos nas 'jug tshul yang gcig pa yin pas 'dir yang rnam dbye de gsum chabs citha/ tu bshad pa ni/rtsa tshig las dang bya yul don gcig ste/ /de lta'i bya ba'i yul zhig la/ /bya ba byas par sto na pa la/ /gnyis pa las su bya ba dang / /gnyis pa'i nang tshan de nyi da dang / /buzhi pa dgos ched gsum 'dra ya/nga / /bya ba byas pas bya ba'i yul/ /de'am de dang 'brel ba la/ /phan thogs med na sanyis pa ste/ /dper na shar du 'gro lta bu/ /phan thos/sa yod na bzhi pa ste/ / dper tsha/ slong la sbyin lta bu/ /phan thogatwashrī med kyang bya yu la dang / /bya ba ngo bo gcig yin na/ /gnyis pa'i nang tsha na de nyid de/ /dper na 'od du 'tsher lta bu/ /gang zhig gang la brten pa'am/ /gnas dang ngo da pa'i don tsam las/ /bya ba gtan nas mi byed na/ /rnam dbye bdun pa gnas gzhi ste/ /dper na steng du mi 'o da ltar/ /tshe skabs gnyis dang do na 'dra na/ /bdukyo/ pa'i nang tshan tshe skabs te/ /dper na nyin byed shar ba na/ /sa steng smag mu/na mtha' ru skrod/ /rnam dbye gnyis baji/ ba dun pa dang / /de nyid tshe skabs gsal byed sgra/ /su ra ru du na la tu/ /yin zhing phal cher la sgra dang / /mthun pas la don rnam dbye'ang zer/ /'on kyang na la de nyid la / /mi 'jug smra ba'i sgo las ba/ sungs/ / zhes pa ltar las zhes pa dang bya ba'i yul zhes pa ni don gcig ste de—

58 rdo rje rgyal po'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/lta bu'i bya ba'i yul zhig la bya ba byas pa zhig ston pa la ni rnam dbye gnyis pa las su bya ba dang / rnam dbye gnyis pa'i nang tshan de nyid dang / rnam dbye bzhi pa dgos/ ched bcas gsum gar la don gyi phrad su ra ru du na la tu bcas bdun po de 'jug tshul gcig pa yin la/ de dag zhugs pa'i tshig de dag gis don ston tshul yang phyogs 'dra bas 'khrul gzhi yod mod/ 'on kyang dbye ba yod la de ltar dbye'ang dbye dgos/ 'o na ji lta bu'i sgo nas dbye dgos zer na 'di lta ste/bya ba'i yul gang zhig la bya ba zhig byas pa'i tshig des bya ba byase pa de rang ston pa las/ bya ba byas pa de bya ba'i yul de la phan thogs gang yang med na rnam dbye gnyis pa las su bya ba ste/ dper na/ bdag shar du 'a kro lta bu la cha mtshon na/ shar ni 'akro gil dang / du la don/ 'gro ba de bya ba bcas red/ des shar du 'gro ba'i bya ba byed pa tsam ston pa las 'gro ba des shar la phan thogs gang yang med/ de ni rnam dbye gnyis pa las su bya ba'o//yang / bya ba'i yul gang zhig la bya ba zhig byas pa des bya ba'i yul de la phan thogs yod na rnam dbye bzhi pa dgos ched de/ dper na/ slong mo bar zas sbyin lta bu la cha mtshon na/ slong sdo ba ni bya yul dang / ra la don/༷ zas smyen pa de bya ba bcas red/ tshiṅge gi grub tshul rnam dbye gasnyes pa dang khyad par med cing / zas byin pa'i bya ba des sbyin yul slong mo bar phan thob/sa yod —pa red/ de ni rnam dbye bzhi pa dgos ched do//yang / zas chobaza' bar phor pa 'khyer lta bu la cha mtshon na/ phor pa 'khyer ba deṭashaṃ zas

sgro wa sum rtagasakyisnyinga'agreXlas tejinas 'jug 59bza' ba'i bya ba la phan thogs pa ni de dang 'brel ba'i las la phan thogs pa yin pas ༷de'ang rnam dbye bzhi pa'o// yang / bya ba gang zhig byas pa de bya ba'i yul de la phan thogs yod kyang rung med kyang rung / bya ba'i yul rnam dbye sbyor yul de dang bya ba gnyis dbye ba 'byed rgyu med pa ngo bo gcig tu gyur pa zhig ston na de ni rnam dbye gnyis pa'i nang tshan de nyid de/ dper na/ 'od du 'tsher la ba la ༷ ༷ /smu rig cha mtshon na/ 'od ni rnam dbye sbyor yul dang / rtswa la don/ 'tsher bya ba bcas red/ ༷ chig gi grub tshul rnarme dbye gnyis ṅgezhi dang khyad par med cing / mi 'dra ba ni 'tsher ba'i bya ba de rnam dbye sbyar yul 'od de dang tha dad du dbye rgyu med pa 'ode rang du 'tsher bas ngo bo gcig tu gyur pa de red/ de ni rnam dbye gnyis pa'i nang tstshan de nyid do//yang / bya ba dang dngos po gang zhig ste ga 'dra zhib/ yin kyang rung /de yul gang zhig la brten pa'am/ gnas pa‘ne ma/ yod pa'i don tsam ston pa las bya ba byas pa'i don mi ston pa zhig yod na de ni rnam dbye si dun pa gnas gzhi ste/ dper na/ steng khang du mi yod lta bu la cha mtshon na steng khang ni brten par bya ba'i yul laca/ baptan ṅge de yin/ du ni la neo na dang / mi ni rten byed de yin/ de steng khalnge derja yod pa tsam ston nga las bya ba byas pa gang yang ston rgyu med pa 'di lta bu rnams ni rnam dbye bdu na pa gnas gzhi'am rten gnas so//yang / la don gyi yi ge bdun po gang rung zhig zhugs pa'i tshig/ des tshe zhes pa dang skabs zhes pa'i don dang 'dra ba zhig ston na dus tshod sto na

60 rdo rje rgyal po'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/pa tshe skabs zhes pa de yin/ dper na/ nyin byed dam nyi ma shar ba na sa steng gi mun pa thams cad mthar bskrad de med par byas so lta bu la cha marngoon na/ nyi ma shar ba na zhes pa'i na de la don red/ la don gyi na sgra des nyi ma shar ba'i tshe zhes pa dang nyi ma shar ba'i skabs zhes pa dang don mtshungs par ston pas de la ni rnam dbye bdun pa'i nang tshan tshe skabs zhes zer ro//rnam dbye gnyis pa dang / bzhi pa/ bdun pa/ de nyid/ tshe skabs gas la byed kyi rkyen nam sgra su ra ru du na la tu bcas yin zhing de dag phal che ba la sgra dang 'jug pa mthun pas la don gyi rnam dbye'ang zer/ 'on kyang smra go mtshon cha zhes pa'i gzhung du na la gnyis de nyid la mi 'jug ces gsungs yod pa de don la gnas min brtag par bya dgos/ rang nyid kyi lta tshul ltar na rnam dbye gnyis pa dang bzhi pa gnyis la na sgra/ gtan nas mi 'juspu/ snya/ca/ pa 'di'ang dpyad par 'tshal/ rjes 'jug la bltos nas sbyor tshul gong du bshad pa ltar te 'drem/ tshul ni/ dper na/ lho brag shrī phyin/rbab tu 'gril/ pha rold tu phyin lta bu phos pho drangs pa dang / byang du 'gro/ lam cwa na jal/ nam mkha' rlu 'phur/ nam mkhar 'phur/ lha sa sdo yod/ lha sar yod lta bu rnams mos mo drangs pa dang / g.yas sta blta sa/bod du skyid lta bu phos mo drangs pa dang / lhan rtswa 'dzoms/ sgar rtswa bsdad/yul tshu log lta bu ma ༷ning gis mo drangs pa ste la sden gyi skabs 'dirngo rtags mtshungarmo 'dren tshuche dang brjod bde 'dren tshul shas che chung mnyam pa tsam du mngon no//

sum rtags kyi snying 'grel laso rtags 'jug 61(gsum pa/ ) byed sgra 'dren tshul bshad pa la rnam dbye gsum pa dang / drug pa gnyis kyi rkyen nam phrad kyi rtsa ba gi kyi gyi yi 'i lnga po de gcig pa yin zhing / rjes 'jug la bltos nas 'jug tshul yang gcig pa yin pas 'dir rnam dbye de gnyis chabs cig tu bshad par/rtsa tshig rnam dbye gang la sbyor yul des/ /nye 'gyangs gang du bya ba zhig /byas na gsum pa byed sgra ste/ /dper na bdag gis bshad lta bu/ /bya ba gtan nas mi byed par/ /snga phyi 'brel byed tsam ston na/ /rnam dbye drus/ nga 'brel sgra ste/ /dper na bdag gi mig lta bu/ /rnam dbye gsum drus/ mi /sal bye da sgra/ /sa mtha' yod dang med pa yi/ /gi kyi gyi yi 'i lnga yin//zhes pa ltar rnam dbye'i rkyen nam phrad gig kyispres gyig yis 'is rnams sbyar na sbyor yul ming tshig des nye 'gyangs spu/nga rulnge du bye ba byas shā'am byed pa zhig ston pas de ni rnam dbye gsum pa byed sgra ste/ dper na/ bdag gis/ bshad lta bu byed sgra de dang bshad pa'i bya ba gnyis tshig gzhan gyi sa b.re ma chad par yod pa de ni bya ba nye bar byas pa zhes pa de yin la/ bdag gis zhing las dang / 'brog las/ zhor las sogs phyogs mang po'i thad narme bshad pa yin lta bu byed sgra de dang bya ba bshad pa gnyis tshig mang pos bar bcad nas yod pa rnams bya ba 'gyangs par byas pa zhes pa de yin zhing / de dag ni byed pa po zhig gis bya ba byas pa ston pa dang / gri sa bcad lta bu byed pa ston pa rnams ni rnam dbye gsum pa zhes pa de'o/ /yang cirnam dbye'i rkyen nam phrad kyi rtsa ba gi kyi gyi yi 'i lnga po sbyor yul des bya ba

62 rdo rje rgyal po'i gsungartsomaphyogaru/bsgrigs/ —da sdebyas pa ste las ka byas pa zhig mi ston par ming tshig snga phyi 'brel byed tsamyo/ la 'jug pa ni rnam dbye drug pa 'brel sgra ste/ dper na/ bdag gi mig lta bu dbang po mig de dbang po can bdag gi yin pa tsam ston pa'i mirngo tshig snga phyi 'brel byed rnams ni rnam dbye drug pa 'brel sgra zhes pa de'o/ /rnam dbye gsum pa'i rkyen nam phrad gis kyis gyis yis 'is bcas dang rnam dbye drug pa'i rkyen nam phrad gi kyi gyi yi 'i bcas 'dren tshul rjes 'jug da ba sa gsum gyi mthar kyi 'thob pa dper na/ lo tog sad kyis khyer song /sa da kyi/ sprenyen kha 'dug khab kyig btsems/ khab kto mig sgos kyis drorsā//gos sdi gong ba lta bu rnams phoṅge pho drangs pa dang /byu bdag gis rbeshad /bdag gi pha lta bu phos mo drangs pa dang / rkyang gisda bzas/ rkyang gi spu/ sgrom gyis bahūṃr/ sgrom gyi shing / 'ja' yis gang / 'ja' ye gur/༷ 'jasasagaje / 'ja'i gur/ ༷ mi yis bkram/ mi yi lus po/ miXs bshad/ miX'enga'acho ba lta buX rnams mos mo drangs pa dang / ༷ yon tan can khyos bslabs/yon tan can gyi skad cha/ nor gyis phyug nor sdi snying po/ nga rgyal gyis smyo 'dug nga sgrol gyi skad cha red lta bu rnams maX niXlnge gis moX drangs pa'o /༷ /i ldan te byed 'brel gyi 'dren tshul la'ang rtags mtshungs 'dren tshul dang brjod bde 'dren tshul gnyis ka yod do//(bzhi pa/ ) rnam dbye lnga pa 'byung khungs 'dren tshul ni/rtsa tshig gang zhig gang las byung ba'am/ /byer dang lhung ba'i don ldan na/ /rnam dbye lnga pa 'byung khungs te/ /dper na 'al nas thos lta bu/ /gaṭaṭal byed sgra ni nas las te/ /dgar dang

sum rtags kyi snyinga'agrelalasartagasa'ajug da mongasdud pa'ang lnga par gtogs//zhes pa ltar nas las gnyis kyis bya ba dang dngos po gang zhig 'byung slongs sam gzhi gang zhig nas byung ba'am/ byer ba'am/ lhung ba sogs kyi don ldan pa zhig ston na de ni rnam dbye lnga pa 'byung khungs dang / de'i gsal byed kyi sgra ni nas dang las gnyis yin/ dper na/ zhal nas thos/zhal las thos/ sa nag skyes/ sa las skyes lta bu 'byung khungs dngos la nas las gnyis ci bder sbyar bas 'thus/ yang / bya yi nang nas rma bya mardzes/ shing gi nang nas tsan dan dri zhim lta bu dgar gzhi dgar chos rigs mthun pa rnams la nas sgra dang / dbyar las dgun grang / dngul las gser gong che lta bu dgar gzhi dgar chos rigs mi mthun pa rnams la las sgra 'jug yang / pe cin nas lha sa bar/ mgo nag mjug bar lta bu sdud pa la nas sgra kho na 'jug pa rnams kyang rnam dbye lnga pa'i khongs su gtogs shing 'dren tshul ni brjod bde 'dren pa nyid du snang ngo //gzhan yang rnam dbye'i yan lag tu gyur pa'am ma gyur pa'i tshig phrad 'dren tshul ni/rtsa tshig gzhan yang tshig don gong 'og tu/ /bsdu rgyu yod na sdud pa'i sgra/ /dang dang kyang yang 'ang sogs sbyor/ /rnam grangs du mas don bskyar na/ /'byed sdud sgra 'jug dgag pa dang / /bdag don yod na thog mtha' ru/ /pa sde'i rtags rnams ci rig/sa 'jug /rgyan du gyur pa'i tshig phrad kyang / /don la bsnyegs/ pa yod na sbyor/ /de bzhin bstan bya lhag yod na/ /lhag bcas༈ sgra

64 rdo rje rgyal po'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/sbyor tshig don ni/ /rdzogs na slar bsdu'i sgra rnams sbyor//zhes pa ltar gzhan yang tshig don gong 'og tu bsdu rgyu yod na sdud pa'i sgra dang gau dang / kyad yang 'ad / gag ngaXm dam naXm blta mam 'asta ram lasta sa/༷ma tamyo/ rnams sbyo ra dgos te/ dper na/ sgra dad / tshad ma da nga /bzo dang / gso ba dang / nang don bcas ni rig gnas chen po lnga'o lta bu gong ma 'og mar bsdu bar dang sgra sbyar ba dang / khos sgra rig pa shes la rtsis kyad shes/ rtsom 'di tstshag zlur snyan cing don yang zab/ da lo gzugs/ hūṃ bde po byung bar ma zad sems paphrung skyid po ༷byung lta bu 'og ma gong mar bsdu bar kyang yang 'ang gsum sbyar ba dang / rta bdun bdag ponyam/ rta ljang can nam/ snang byed dam/ 'od zer brgya pa rnams nyi magle ming ngo lta bu rnam graXngs du mas don rgecig bskyar skor yang skor du brjod par 'byed sdud kyi sgra 'am dam nam bcas sbyar ba'o//dgag pa dang bdag po'i dorne ston dgos na ming tshig de dag gi gong 'og tu pa sde'i rtags rnams ci rigs te/ ma mi mi na med dang / pa ba ma/ po bo mo bcas ci rigs sbyar dgos te/ daXperno na/ yin pa dgag pa la ma yin zhes dang / byed pa dgag pa la mi byed ces lta bu sdospru/ ma ra dgag pa rnams la ma mi gnyis sbyor dgos shing / byas pa dgag pa la byag medaX ces dang / rshagro ba dgag pa la 'gro gi min zhes lta bu mabha' mar dgag pa rnams la min med gnyis sbyor dgormo/ daXpe deb rtsom mkhan ston pa la rtsom pa po zhes dang / zlos gar 'khrab mkhan ston pa la zlos gar ba zhes dang / ja skol mkhan ston pa la ja ma zhes pa lta bu rnams la mtha'

sum rtags kyi snying 'grel las rtags 'jug 65mar bdag sgra pa ba ma bcas sbyor dgos so/ /rgyan du gyur pa'i tshig phrad rnams kyang don la bsnyegs pa yod na te phan pa yod na sbyor dgos te/dper na/ btab kyang btab la skyes kyang skyes/ btud kyang khro la mdza' yang bslu lta bu mthun pa'i tshig rgyan dang mi ༷mthun pa'i tshig rgyan gsal bar byed pa'i rgyan kyang dang yang sogs sbyar dgos so/ /yang / da dung bstan par bya rgyu'i tshig don lhag ma yod na lhag bcas kyi sgra sbyor dgos te/ dper na/ 'di lta ste/ langs te 'gro lta bu dam bca' dang mtshams sbyor lhag bcas kyi sgra ste te gnyis sogarme sbyoro dgos so/ /yang / bstan bya'i tshig don rdzogs rno slar bsdu'i sgra go ngo do sogs sbyor dgos te/ dper na/'dug go/ ngas mthong do / nga'i dpe cha de khyod la yod do lta bu gang la ci rigs shār sbyor dgos so6/ / rmeo 'o na rnam dbye dang phrad de rnams 'jug tshul nang gses dbye ba ga 'dra zhig byas nas 'byed dgos she na/ rnam dbye'am phrad de dag gi mthar sbyar rgyu'i don gang zhig yin la bstun nas sbyor dgos/ dper na/ming blo bzang zhes pa zhig gi mthar khos byas pa'i bya ba bshad song lta bu zhig 'bri rgyu yod na blo bzang la rnam dbye gsum pa byed sgra rghaṃr te blo bzang gis bshad song zhes 'bri dgos shing / yang / ming de'i ༷rna jug tu ༷yon tan lta bu blo bzang dang 'brel ba yod pa zhig ston rgyu yod na blo bzang la rnam ༷ dbye drug nga/ 'brel sgra sbyar te sngo bzang gi yon ttan 'e/sa 'khro degos/ yang /ming can de la dpa' rtsal lta bu zhig yod pa sto/na rgyu yod na blo bzang la rnam dbye bdun pa gnas gzhi'i la don sbyar te blo bzang la dpa' rtsal yod

66 rdo rje rgyal po'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/ces 'bri dgos pa sogs rigs 'gres nas rtogs par bya dgos pa ni shin tu gal che'o/ /4 rjes 'jug rnams dgos pa ci phyir 'jug par byed pa bshad pa/rtsa tshig dgos pa ci phyir 'jug ce na/ /mo yig dbyangs dang mi ldan na/ /pho yig gsal byed brjod mi nus/ /de phyir dbyangs lngar bzhed pa bde/ /pho yig dbyangs ldan de dag la'ang / /rjes 'jug bcu po ma zhugs na/ /don gyi ngo bo tsam ston pa'i/ /ming dang don gyi khyad par rnams/ /ston pa'i tshig dang don ldan pa'i//ngag gi brjod pa yod min te/ /yi ge'i khongs nas ming dbyung zhing / /ming gi khongs nas tshig phyung ste/ /tshig gis don rnams ston pas so/ /zhes pa ltar rjes 'jug rnams dgos pa ci phyir 'jug ce na/ thog mar yi ge'i 'jug pa spyi'i cha nas bshad na mo yig dbyangs gang rung zhig med par pho yig gsal byed sum cu po kho nas brjod don ston mi thub pa ste ming tshig gang zhig yin rung de la dbyangs shig med thabs med par brten dbyangs yig gi grangs a i u e o bcas lngar nges pa bzung na 'grel bde'o/ /pho yig dbyangs ldan de dag la'ang rjes 'jug gang rung zhig rdzozhugs na don gyi ngo bo tsam ston pa'i ming dang / don gyi khyad par ston pa'i tshig dang / don dang ldan pa'i brjod pa bcas mi yong bas de dag dper

sum rtags kyi snying 'grel las rtags 'jug 67brjod dang sbrags nas bshad na/ yi ge gnyis yan chad cig 'dus nas don gyi ngo bo ston pa'i ming grub pas rjes 'jug rnams yi ge'i khongs nas ming dbyung ba'am ming sbyor ba'i don du 'jug ste/ dper na/ ngag rang /nadu lta bu yi ge gnyis re 'dus nas ming re grub pa dang / lusbu/ goXg/lham lta bu yi ge gsum re 'dus nas ming re grub pa dang / gzhan yang dga' ma dang / rgya gar/ kong yul/ lha ri rtse/ bkra shis/ bsod nams sogs yi ge rmeng po 'durme nas don gyi sdo 6 tsam ༷ston pa'i ming de rnams grub pa'o/ /deng sang pha dang ma/ kha sogs yi ge gcig gis ming ston thub pa ltar snang yang 'di dag la don du pha' dang / ma'/ kha' zhes rjes 'jug 'a yig re 'thob kyang skad gsarno bcad kyi lugs su bsdus te dngos su ma brkod pa las rjes 'jug mi 'thob pa ma red/ yi ge'i tshig sbyor byed skabs de ltar 'thob pa sems la nges nas sbyor dgos so/ /de dag ni yi ge gnyis yan chad cig 'dus nas don gyi ngo bo tsam ston pa'i ming grub tshul yin zhing / ming du ma 'dus nas don gyi ngo bo tsam ston pa'i ming gcig grub pa'ang yod de/ dper na/ krud go gung khran tang lta bu ming gsum 'dus nas tang gcig gi ming grub pa dang /༷ ༷ bopro rwang skyod ljongs lta bu'ang ming gsum 'dus nas ljongs gcig gi ming grub pa dang / krud hwaX mi dmangs sgyi mthun kyāl khaXb lta bu rags rtsis kyi ming0bzhi 'dus nas rgyal khab gcig gi ming grub pa'ang yod cing / de rnams kyang rags rtsis kyis bgrangs pa las da dung zhib mor phye med lags/ de rnams niming tshig gam ming cung zad stabs bde ba rnams so/ /

68 rdo rje rgyal po'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/yang ming tshig stabs bde tsam zhig la don gyi go ba rgya che tsam len dgos pa'ang mang po yod/ dper na/ deng sang gi ming tshig gsar pa thon skyed kyi stobs shugs zhes pa dang / thon skyed kyi 'brel ba zhes pa/ thon skyed byed stangs zhes pa bcas la cha mtshon na/ (1) thon skyed kyi stobs shugs zhes pa ni thon skyed kyi lag cha dang / thon skyed kyi rme cha/ hūṃn skyed kyi nyams myong dang ngal rtsol gyi lag rtsal nges can zhig yod pa'i mi bcas 'dus pa de'i spyi ming red/ ngal rtsol pa mang tshogs ni mi'i rigs kyi spyi tshogs 'phel rgyas kyi dus rim mtha' dag gi thon phyed kyi stobs shugs rtsa bar gyur pa de red/ (2) thon skyed kyi 'brel ba zhes pa ni mi rnams kyis dngos po'i rgyu cha rnams spyi tshogs thorge thorno skyed byed pa'i go rim nang phan tshun bar la chags pa'i 'brel ba der zer/ dere nang du thon skyed rgyu chas dbang ba'i lam lugs kyi rnam pa dang / gral rim khag dang spyi tshogs kyi tshogs khag rnams kyi thon skyed byed skabs kyi go gnas dang / phan tshun gyi 'brel ba/ thon rdzas bgo bsha' rgyag stangs bcas 'dus yod/ (3)thon skyed byed stangs zhes pa ni mi rnams kyis dngos po'i thon skyed byed stanges ༷te/ deX'i nang du thon skyed kyi stobs shugs dang thon skyed kyi 'brel ba'i phyogs gnyis 'dus yod cing / de ni thon skyed kyi stobs shugs dang thon skyed kyi 'brel ba'i rtsod sgrub kyi gcig gyur de red/ thon skyed byed stangs des spyi tshogs kyi lam lugs kyi ngo bo de thag gcod kyi yod/ de lngabu'i ming ring thung ga 'dra zhig yin rung rjes 'jug gi nus par bltos dgos pas rjes 'jug rnams ni yi ge'i khongs nas ming dbyung bar bya ba'i

sum rtags kyi snying 'grel las rtags 'jug 69phyir 'jug go//yang ming du ma 'dus shing de dag phrad dang rnam dbyes mtshams sbyar na don gyi khyad par ston pa'i tshig grub ste/ dper na/ nga rang tsho'i las don gyi 'go khrid byed mkhan srog shing du gyur pa'i sto/bas shugs ni hūṃng go'i gung khran tang yin lta bu don gyi ngo bo tsarmo ston pa'i ming mang ṣpe zhig 'ebrel sgra nesurmo deng / la don gcig ni sgra gcig bcas kyis 8 tshams sbyar te bsgrigs pas don gyi khyad par ston pa'i tshig gcig grub pa yin pas rjes 'jug rnams ni ming gi khongs nas tshig dbyung bar bya ba'i phyi ra 'jug 7 / / /yang / tshig dang tshig 'dus nas brjod pa'am brjod bya'i don mtha' dag rgyas bsdus ci rigs par ston thub ste/ dper na/ deb chu dku spyodir bod yig gi sbyor tshul sum cu pa'i phrad dang rnam dbye rnams dang / rtags 'jug gi bdag gzhan dus gsum sogs tshig re re bzhin mdor bsdus su bris pas sum rtags kyi dngos bstan dgongs don ril po zhig rdzogs nga ra bstan pa yin pas rjes 'jug rnams ni tshig dang tshig 'dus nas brjod bya'i don rnams rdzogs par ston pa'i phyir 'jug go//rjes 'jug rnams ci phyir 'jug skor yang bskyar snying bsdus shig bshad na/ yi ge'i khongs nas ming dbyung zhing / /ming gi khongs nas tshig phyung ste/ /tshig gis don rnams ston pas so/ /ces pa ltar rjes 'jug rnams dgos pa ci'i phyir 'jug par byed ce na/ yi ge gnyis yan chad cig 'dus nas don gyi ngo bo tsam ston pa'i ming bsgrub par bya ba'i phyir te/ ming sbyor ba'i ched dang / ming gnyis yan chad cig 'dus nas

70 rdo rje rgyal po'i gsurirtsomabyogasabasgrigs/ jid wa don gyi khyad par ston pa'i tshig bsgrub par bya ba'i phyir te/ tshig sbyor ba'i ched dang / tshig gcig gam tshig gnyis yan chad cig 'dus nag skabs bab tu bstan bya'i brjod pa'am brjod bya'i don de rgyas bsdus ci rigs par bstan par bya ba'i phyir te don rnams legs par ston pa'i ched du 'jug go//mjug tu yi ge'i 'jug pa spyi'i dgos pa'am rang bzhin dang lhag par du bod kyi brda sprod pa'i bstan bcos 'di nyid brtsams pa'i dgos pa sogs bstan pa ni/rtsa tshig ming tshig brjod pa med na ni/ /thun mong thun mong ma yin pa'i/ /shes bya ston pa'ang med par 'gyur/ /de phyir 'phags yul mkhas rnams kyi/ /rjes su 'brangs nas gsu/ngas pa 'di/ /skye bo kun gyis rtogs gyur cig /tshig gi sgra tsam 'dra na yang / /don la khyad par shin tu che/ de phyir brda darga/ la brten nas/ /ma nor don rnams 'tshol ba gces/ /don la mi rmongs rmongs pa yang / /lugs 'dir mkhas min gyis byed de/ /sgra shes don la mi rmongs zhes/ /mkhas pa'i gsung la yongs su grags/ /'di la ma sbyangs rmongs tshod kyis/ /'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i grwar 'jug pa/ / wa skyes seng lpags gyon pa bzhin/ /nam zhig rjes ngan gsal bar 'gyur/ /de phyir blo gsal don gnyer rnams/ /rtags 'jug dka' gnad gzugs brnyan kun/ /gsal bar 'char ba'i me long 'dir/ /la 'ur gzigs mor spyod dang kye/ /'di la no ngas

sum rtags kyi snying 'grel las rtags 'jug 71pa'i tshogs mchis na/ /gzur gnas mkhas pa'i spyan sngar 'chags/ /cung zad 'bad las thob pa'i dges/ /kun gyis 'di don rtogs par shog/ces pa ste de dag rnams brjod bya dang rjod tshig shin tu gsal bas rtsa 'grel sprags pa'i rgyas bshad dgos pa ma mchis pa bcas rdzogs so//de ltar thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i shes bya ji snyed pa mtha' dag ming dang / tshig dang / brjod pa bcas tshar du dngar ba'i phreng bar spel nas ji lta bar brda sprod pa'i bstan bcos yi ge'i sbyor bar spyang dgos shing / de'ang 'dod rgyal lam rjes grub gang rung du gtogs pa'i ming ngam tha snyad rnams brda dag gsal ba'i gzhung lugs rnams su gtan la phab pa ltar ma 'chol zhing ma 'khrugs par rtogs par bya dgos pa gzhir grub/ ming ngam tha snyad rnams rnam dbye dang tshig phrad sogs kyis rna tshams sbyar nas don gyi khyad par ston pa'i tshig grub tshul dang / tshig gis brjod bya'i don ji ltar ston par byed pa'i tshul thon mi sam bho ṭas sum rtas/sa kyi gzhung du bstan pa rnams dbyangs can grub pa'i rdo rjes mdzad pa'i legs bshad ljon dbang dang dka' gnad gsal ba'i me long du 'khod pa de dag mdor bsdus la go bde ba zhig yin pas 'di tsam zhig shes kyang yi ge'i sbyor ba la mi rmongs pa zhig yong bar brten deb chung 'di'ang de dag rang la gsal bshad byas nas bkod pa lags/ brda sprod pa'i bstan bcos 'di ni shes bya gang la spyad kyang spyad chog pa'i lag cha zhig red la/ su zhig gis

72 rdo je rgyal po'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/spyad kyang spyad chog pa'i lag cha zhig red/ 'jig rten lta tshul la cha mtshon na dngos gtso smra bas kyang spyad chog la sems gtso smra bas kyang spyad chog pa zhig red/ gral rim la cha mtshon na bshu gzhog gral rim gyis kyang spyad chog la bshu gzhog myong ma/khan gral rim gyis kyang spyad chog pa zhig red/bod la cha mtshon na sngon chad bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi dbang sgyur gral rim gyis srid dbang 'dzin byed lag cha zhig red/ da lta ni 'byor med gral rim gyi chab srid la zhabs 'degs zhu byed lag cha zhig red/ lag cha 'di ni gral rim 'thab rtsod la spyad chog pa zhig red la/ thon skyed 'thabartso rtsod la'ang spyad chog pa zhig red/ tshan rig tshod lta la'ang spyad chog pa zhig red/ der ma zad gang gi thad la'ang nges par du spyod dgos pa zhig red/'on kyang rang cag gis brda sprod pa'i bstan bcos 'di skor gleng skabs nges par du phyi rol yul gyi chos nyid dang mthun pa ste/ deng skabs kyi lag len thog spyod byed lag cha kha lo bde po zhig yong ba byed dgos pa de ni galardzoha cang chen po zhig red/ der brten gong du bkod pa'i dper badzoodangarnams kyang go bde la deng rabs dang mthun pa zhig gtso bor bzung nas bkod yod/ 'on kyang bed spyod byed stangs de mi rigs rang nyid kyi skad yig gi rmang gzhi mi dman pa zhig yod pa de gzhir bzung nas byed dgopaspu pa ni smos ci dgos/ brda sprod pa'i gzhung 'di sbyong ba'i dmigs yu kṣa ni thon mis‘‘mnyan bsam bstan pa'i ched du sbyar ’zhes tshig rkang gcig gis bstan pa ltar mnyan pa ste slob dpon sogs gzhan gyis bstan pa rnams tshur nyan pa'i phyir dang / yi ger bris zin pa'i shes bya rnams kyi go don

sum rtags kyi snying 'grel las rtags 'jug 73phyin ci ma log par rtogs thub pa'i phyir dang / bsam pa ste mthong ba'am thos pa'i don rnams rang nyid kyis tshul bzhin bsams nas blang dor la rtso'ajug par bya ba'i phyir dang / bstan pa ste don rnams rang nyid kyi khong du chub nas gzhan la ston pa'am yi ger 'bri ba'i skabs su gsal zhing gnad du 'khel ba zhig yong bar bya ba'i phyir ro/ /gal te gnad don de 'dzin ma thub na gangs chu dkar po 'o mar rlom nas dkrogs kyang mar mi thon pa ltar 'gyur ba las rngo mi thogs pas blo gros dang ldan pa kyiong mas gzab gzab nan nan yod pa zhu/ / / /

zur bkod/ dus gsum gyi dper brjod re'u mig 95na lusdo/ kyi ba spu yan chad bcas skye dngos mtha' dag dang / skye rgu'i blo la spre ba'i rnam rtog bzang ngan la'ang khyab pas de dag la bya byed las gsum dang / dus gsum sogs ji ltar sbyor tshul rnams rigs 'gres nas sbyar bas 'thus shing / de bzhin re'u mig gi tha snyad sbyar gzhi'i nang du sogs sgra yod pa tshang mar re re bzhin zhib bsher gyis dngos su dper brjod bkod yod pa de ma yin par da dung 'god 'os pa ji tsam zhig 'dug par bltas na lag len gyi skabs su sbyang pa sngon song gi 'bras bu gar dgos su spyad chog chog yong ba'i phan thogs chen po yod par brten blo sgo rgya cher phye nas rtogs par bya dgos so/ /zhes sum rtags kyi snying 'grel dus gsum gyi re'u mig dang bcas pa 'di rdo rje rgyal pos 1978lo'i zla 12tshes 15la rdzogs par bris pa'o// //

96gangs can pa'i baja sprod pa'i bstan bcos sum cu pa dang rtags kyi 'jug pa'i dgongs don dber brjod rang blo'i rtsi bcud ces bya ba/na mo gu ru ya/ ji snyed shes bya de snyed la/ /spobs pa'i mchog brnyes gang zhig gis/ /rmongs pa'i blo mun sel ba'i mgon/ /bshes gnyen dam pa'i zhabs la 'dud/ /don gnyis dang ni 'gog lam bden//rig grol yon tan mchog mnga' ba'i/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la/ /rtag tu bdag gis rjes yi rangs/ /'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa' dang / /rgya mtsho'i bu mo sgra ldan ma/ /bdag snying padmo'i tshal yangs su/ /rtsen la dgyes pa'i rol rtsed mdzod/ /ljongs 'di'i mig mchog thu mi sogs/ /dpang gyur dus gsum mkhas dang grub/ /thams cad la yang rab 'dud do/ /'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i spobs pa rtsol/ /gangs can brda sprod sum rtags gzhung / / /bshes mchog gsung gsang bdud rtsi'i ro/ /myong ba'i go don tshigs bcad phreng / /rang blo goms phyir cung zad spro/ /spyir na sbyar bya yi ge la/ /dbyangs dang gsal byed ces gnyis yod/ /bye brag rang cag bod skad la/ /dbyangs kyi bya ba gsal ston

sum rtags kyi dper brjod rang blo'i rtsi bcud/ 9 7 pa/ /i u e o bzhi po ste/ /gi gu zhabs kyu 'greng bu dang / /na ro (rna ru yang zer) dang bcas bzhi yin zhing / /ka li gsal byed sum cu po/ /yig 'bru bzhi bzhir sde pa zer/ /dang po ka kha ga nga dang / /gnyis pa ca cha ja nya dang / /gsum pa ta tha da na dang / bzhi pa pa pha ba ma dang / /lnga pa tsa tsha dza wa dang / /drug pa zha za 'a ya dang / /bdun pa ra la sha sa dang / /ha a gnyis po phyed de ni/ /sde pa phyed dang brgya da ces grags//de las ga nga da na dang / /ba ma 'a ra la sa bcu/ /yi ge kun gyi rjes rnams su/ /'jug pa'i rjes 'jug bcu zhes sam/ /mtha' rten yi ge bcu zhes bya/ /dper na lhag dang chad rkyen 'thab/ /bsgom dka' mkhar 'gyel byas lta bu/ /ma zad da dang sa gnyis po/ /rjes 'jug 'ga' yi rjes su yang / /'jug pa'i yang 'jug gnyis zhes zer//dper na da drag dkond bskurd bsgrald/ /sa ni bsags bsrungs 'bebs goms sogs/ /phal cher 'das pa'i tshig la 'jug/rjes 'jug bcu po de dag nas/ /ga da ba ma 'a rnams ni/ /ming gzhi rnams kyi sngon du yang / /'jug pas sngon 'jug lnga zhes bya/ /dper na gces dngos brjed mnyam 'char/ /lta bu la sogs shes padku bya//sngon rjes bsal ba'i gsal byed lhag /ka kha ca cha ja nya dang / /ta tha pa pha tsa tsha dza/ /wa zha za ya sha sa la/ /bcas rnams ming gzhi kho na las/ /sngon rjes rnams su mi 'jug pas/ /mi 'jug yi ge nyi shur

98 rdo rje rgyal po'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/brjod/ /de rnams sbyar bya yi ge yi/ /rnam gzhag ces su grags de 'o/ /da ni sbyor tshul tshig phrad kyi/ /'jug pa mdor bsdus brjod pa la/ /dang po rjes 'jug la bltos pa'i/ /phrad ni rnam dbye bcas brgyad de/ /de yang slar bsdu la don dang / /i ldan rgyan sdud lhag bcas dang / /'byed sdud 'byung khungs 'bod sgra bcas/ /so sor rim bzhin bshad par bya//dang po slar bsdu'i rkyen nam sgra/ /go ngo do no bo mo 'o/ /ro lo so to bcas bcu gcig /ming tshig gang gi mthar sbyar yang / /brjod don de nyid de tsam gyis/ /bsdu bar song bas slar bsdu ste/ /dper na bdag gis las byas so/ /lta bu bshad bya'i don de nyid/ /re zhig rdzogs par ston pas na/ /slar bsdu'am rdzogs tshig zla sdud zer/ /sbyor tshul rjes 'jug rang rang la/ /na ro sbyor te dper brjod na/ /'dug go byung ngo yod do dang / /rkyen no btab po bsgom mo dang / /dga' 'o mtshar ro gsol lo dang / /byas so ltar dang da drag mthar/ /to sbyor dper na brgyand to dang / /bskurd to bsgrald to de bzhin du/ /mtha' rten med mthar 'o sbyor te/ /dge 'o zhes sogs rigs 'gre 'o//gnyis pa la don rkyen nam sgra/ /su ra ru du na la tu/ /rnam dbye gnyis bzhi bdun pa dang / /de nyid tshe skabs rnams la 'jug /de dag rim bzhin dper brjod na//thang du rta brgyugs zhes brjod tshe/ /bya yul thang du byed po yis/ /rta rgyug btang ba'i bya ba zhig /byas par ston las bya ba des/ /thang la

sum rtags kyi dper brjod rang blo'i rtsi bcud/ 99phan 'dogs mi nus pa/ /gnyis pa las su bya ba'o/ /nad nga ra sman byin zhes brjod tshe/ /sman zhig ster ba'i bya ba des/ /bya yul nad pa de nyid la/ /phan 'dogs dngos su ston pa 'am/ /dgra dpung 'dul bar mtshon thogs zhes/ /mtshon gyis sa/dul bya dgra dpung la/ /phan 'dogs 'gyur ba ma yin kyang / /gdul ba'i bya bar phan 'dogs pa/ /'di 'drar bzhi pa dgos ched zer/ /lha sar jo bo yod lta bu/ /gang zhig gang du yod pa 'am/ /gnas pa tsam zhig ston pa las/ /bya ba gtan nas mi byed pa/ /de ni bdun pa rten gnas so/ /grogs su bkug ces brjod pa na/ /dgug bya de dang bkug pa yi/ /bya ba de gnyis gcig nyid du/ /gyur 'di rnam dbye gnyis pa yi/ /nang tshan de nyid ces/ par 'dod//ston du 'bras bu smin lta bu/ /dus tshod ston pa tshe 'am skabs/ /gnyis dang mthun par 'jug byed pa/ /'di ni rnam dbye bdun pa yi/ /nang tshan tshe skabs zhes bya'o//sbyor tshul rjes 'jug sa yi mthar/ /su 'thob dbus su lta bu dang / /ga ba drag mthar tu 'thob ste/ /rtag tu rab tu shind tu dang / /pha rold tu sogs lta bu dang / /nga da na ma ra la mthar/ /du 'thob steng du stod du dang / /don du lam du 'khor du dang / /yul du ltar dang 'a ma tha' dang / /mtha' med rnams la ra dang ru/ /ci rigs sbyor te mthar mtha' tsu/ /lha sar lha sa ru lta bu'o/ /

100 rdo je rgyal po'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/gsum pa i ldan rkyen nam sgra/ /gi kyi gyi 'i yi lnga 'di/ /ming don phan tshun 'brel ba 'am/ /snga phyi 'brel ba sogs ston pa'i/ /rnam dbye drug pa 'brel sgra ste/ /dper na bod kyi mi lta bu/ /yul can mi de yul bod dang / /'brel zhing bod kyi yin pa nyid/ /go ba 'di 'dra yul yul can/ /'brel ba'i sgra dang khang pa'i sgo/ /lta bu brten bya sgo de nyid/ /rten gzhi khang par 'brel ba ru/ /go 'di rten dang brten 'brelasgra/ /gzhan yang yan lag yan lag can/ /bdag po yul gyi 'brel sgru sogs/ /ji ltar 'jug tshul dbye ba rnams/ /zhib mor brtags te sbyar bar bya//sbyor tshul rjes 'jug ga nga'i mthar/ /gi 'thob stag gi 'brong gi dang / /da ba sa yi mthar kyi 'thob/ /bod kyi rab kyi g.yas kyi dang / /na ma ra la mthar gyi ste/ /mdun gyi lam gyi 'khor gyi dang / /yul gyi ltar dang 'a'i mtha' dang / /rjes 'jug med mthar 'i yi gnyis/ /ci bder sbyar bas thus te dper/ /bka'i dang bka' yo lha'i lha yi/ /lta bu skabs brtsan sbyar bar bya//i ldan de dag 'gal ba 'am/ /mi mthun ston pa'i tshig la'ang 'jug /dper na khyod la nga dga' yi/ /gzhan rnams la ni de ltar min/ /de ltar legs kyi 'on kyang ni/ /zhes pa la sogs lta bu'o//'brel sgra de rnams rim bzhin du/ /sa yig sbyar ba'i gis dang ni/ /kyis gyis 'is yis zhes pa rnams/ /ming gang zhig gi mthar sbyar yang / /sbyar yul de nyid byed pa por/ /ston pas rnam dbye gsum pa ni/ /

sum rtags kyi dper brjod rang blo'i rtsi bcud/ 101 byed pa po ru brjod de dper/ /bla ma sa chos bstan brjod pa na/ byed po bla mas bya ba de/ /chos shig bsta/na par go ba bzhin/ /de yang 'i/ba na byed po la'ang / /gtso bo phal pa gnyis yod de/ /dpa' bos mtshon gyis dgra bsad ces/ /byed po gtso bo dpa' bo dang / /phal pa mtshon yin de lta bu'i/ /gtso phal gnyis kar byed sgra dgos/ /bdag gis bshad ces byed pa po/ /brjod nyid bya ba bshad ston pa/ /bya ba nye bar byas pa dang / /bdag gis phyogs rnams thams cad du/ /yang dang yang du phyin nas myul/ /zhes pa byed po bdag dang ni/ /bya ba myul ba gnyis kyi bar/ /yi ge mang pos chod gyur pa/ /'di 'dra bya ba ring po ru/ /byas pa zhes byar shes par bya//sbyor tshul 'brel sgra'i skabs bzhin te/ /bdag gis bshad dang khong gis gsan/ /khyod gyis byas dang khab gyis btsem/ /zas gyis bgrangs dang rgyan gyis spras/ /dom gyis bzas dang 'khor gyis bskor/ /zol gyis bstod dang mda' yis 'bigs/ /pha mas skyong sogs lta bu 'o//bzhi pa rgyan sdud rkyen nam sgra/ /kyang yang 'ang bcas gsum po de/ /mthun dang mi mthun rgyan gnyis dang / /sdud pa'i sgra ru 'gyur te dper/ /mtshar kyang mtshar zhes brjod pa na/ /snga phyi mthun pa'i tshig gnyis kyi/ /bar du brgyan phyir mthun pa yi/ /tshig gi rgyan dang mdza' yang bslu/ /zhes pa snga mar mdza' ba dang / /phyi mar bslu zhes mi mthun pa'i/ /tshig gnyis kyi bar brgyan pa ni/ /mi mthun tshig rgyan zhes pa'o //

102 rdo rje rgyal po'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/gos 'di 'jam la drod kyang che/ /zhes pa 'jam dang drod che ba/ /gzhi gcig tu sdud 'di 'dra sogs/ /sdud pa zhes byar rjod par byed//sbyor tshul ga da ba sa dang / /da drag can mthar kyang sbyor te/ /'dug kyang bsad kyang btab kyang dang / /bsags kyang brgyand kyang 'byord kyang dang / /bskungs kyang ltar dang nga na ma/ /ra la bcas lngar yang 'thob ste/ /gang yang ldan lang 'jam yang dang / /dkar yang mjal yang lta bu dang / /'a mtha' can dang mtha' med mthar/ /'ang dang yang gnyis gang yang rung / /dper na mdza' yang mdza'ang dang / /'dra yang 'dra'ang lta bu sbyor//lnga pa lhag bcas rkyen nam sgra/ /ste de te gsum gang rung zhig / ming tshig gang gi mthar sbyar yang / /de yi rjes su bstan bya yi/ tshig don gzhan zhig yod ston pas/ /lhag bcas sgra ste der dbye na/ /mtshams sbyor ba dang dam bca' dang / /gzhan 'dren dang bcas rigs gsum yod//de las dang po cing sogs dang / /'jug tshul gcig tu mthun gyur pa/ /mtshams sbyor la yang nang gses gsum/ /dper na btab ste skyes lta bu/ /byed pos sa bon btab pa dang / /lo tog skyes pa'i bya ba gnyis/ /rgyu 'bras snga phyi rim ston dang / /kun nas btus te bsags lta bu/ /snga phyi gnyis ka bya ba la/ /sbyor zhing dus ni rim ceni dang / /las kyis 'khor te lus lta bu/ /snga phyi gnyis ka bya ba dang / /dus ni cig car nyid bcas so//

sum rtags kyi dper brjod rang blo'i rtsi bcud/ 103gang zhig dam bcas pa de yi/ /gsal byed du ni tshig phyi ma/ / 'dren pa dam bca' ste de yang / /dbye ba 'dren dang gtan tshigre/sa 'dren/ /nges tshig 'dren dang rgyas bshad 'dren/ /zhes pa'i dargya ba bzhi yod dper/ /chos ni gnyis te 'dus byas dang / /'dus ma byas pa lta bu ni/ /nang gses dbye ba 'dren pa'i phyir/ /dbye ba 'dren pa zhes bya dang / /bdag gi lus 'di mi rtag ste/ /'dus byas yin pa'i phyir lta bu/ /mi rtag pa yi rgyu mtshan du/ /'dus byas yin pa 'dren pa'i phyir (pa ni)/ /gtan tshigs 'dren pa zhes pa 'o/ /byol song yin te bde 'gro yi/ /lam las byol te ngan 'gro yi/ /gnas su song ba'o zhes lta bu/ /byol song zhes pa'i nges tshig dag /'dren 'di nges tshig 'dren pa 'o/ /shes bya kun te nang don dang / /sgra tshad bzo gso rnams la sbyangs/ /lta bu shes bya kun zhes pa/ /mdor bstan sngon du bshad zin rjes/ /slar yang bkral nas so so ru/ /'dren 'di rgyas bshad 'dren pa'o//khyod ni mkhas te khyod btsun no/ /lta bu brjod bya lhag ma tsam/ /lod pa ston pa 'di 'dra rnams/ /gzhan 'dren lhag bcas zhes bya'o//sbyor tshul ga nga ba ma 'ar/ /sde 'thob bkag ste mthong ste dang / /'bab ste 'jam ste dga' ste dang / /na ra la sa da drag mthar/ /te rkyang 'thob ste nyan te dang / /'bar te phul te byas te dang / /bskyond te bsgyurd te bskuld te dang / /da yi mtha' ru de 'thob pa//bkod de la sogs sbyar bar bya//

104 rdo rje rgyal po'i gsung tsom phyogs bsgrigs/drug pa 'byed sdud rkyen nam sgra/ /gam ngam dam nam bam mam 'am/ /ram lam sam tam bcu gcig rnams/ /'byed dang sdud pa gnyis la 'jug /dper na dkon mchog rnam gsum ste/ /sangs rgyas sam ni dam chos sam/ /dge 'dun bcas so lta bu ni/ /dkon mchogartsoso sor ming bgrangs nas/ /phye 'di 'byed pa zhes pa'o//sangs rgyas sam ni dam chos sam/ /dge 'dun bcas ni dkon mchog go /lta bu sangs rgyas chos dge 'dun/ /gsum de dkon mchog gcig nyid du/ /bsdus pa 'di 'dra sdud pa'o//gzhan yang khyod la yod dam med/ /ces sogs 'dri ba'i tshig rnams dang / /yong ngam ci sogs the tshom gyi/ /tshig rnams kyang ni 'byed pa yi/ /sgra yi khongs su gtogs pa'o//sbyor tshul slar bsdu'i skabs bzhin te/ /dper na 'dug gam bkang ngam dang / /yod dam len nam btab bam dang / /bkram mam dga' 'am yin nam dang / /'gyur ram 'phul lam spras sam dang / 'dzind tam gyurd tam bsgrald tam dang / /bya 'am lta bur sbyar bar bya//bdun pa 'byung khungs rkyen nam sgra/ /nas las gnyis te 'jug tshul ni/ /sa nas rtswa skyes zhes pa dang / /zhal las legs bshad thos lta bu/ /rtswa dang legs bshad gnyis po yi/ /'byung khungs sa dang mkhas pa'i zhal/ /yin par ston pa 'di dag la/ /rnam dbye lnga pa 'byung khungs zer/ /gzhan yang shar nas 'ong zhes dang / /rta las bab ces

sum rtags kyi dper brjod rang blo'i rtsi bcud/ 105brjod pa'i tshe/ /de dag 'byung khungs dngos shar dang / /rta gnyis yin par ma nges kyang / /skabs der de las byung ba dang / /mtshu ngas pas 'byung khungs cha 'dra'o/ /gang gis cho nge 'don pa las/ /gdungartsobs mnar ba shes lta bu/ /las sgra rgyu mtshan la 'jug pa/ /'di yang rnam dbye lnga par gtogs/ /nas las gnyis po dgar ba la/ /'jug pa'i tshul la rigs gnyis yod/ / ri yi nang nas gangs ri mtho/ /chu bo'i nang nas 'bri chu che/ /lta bu dgar gzhi dgar chos dag /rigs mthun rnams la nas sgra 'jug /rlangs 'khor las ni gnam gru mgyogs//nam dus dgun las dbyar kha skyid/ /lta bu dgar gzhi dgar chos dag /rigs mi mthun par las sgra 'jug/ nas sgra sdud pa la yang 'jug /gcig nas brgya bar lta bu ni/ /grangs gnas sdud par 'jug pa dang / /shar nas nub bar lta bu ni/ /yul khams sdud par 'jug pa'o/ /de dag rnams kyang rnam dbye ni/ /lnga pa'i cha shas tsam du gtogs//langs nas phyin dang bsdad nas bzas/ /lta bu nas sgra lhag bcas la/ /'jug pa'i tshul yang rtogs par bya/ /brgyad pa 'bod pa gsal byed sgra/ /kye dang ka ye wa ye rnams/ /kye kye slob dpon ka ye grogs/ /wa ye 'khor rnamasu lta bu ru/ /'bod yul mchog dman bab ltar sbyor//de rnams rjes 'jug la bltos phrad/ /rnam dbyi dang bcas brgyad ces par/ /snga 'brel kun la yongs grags spyang / /'byung khungs dang ni

106 rdo rje rgyal po'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/'bod sgra gnyis/ /rjes 'jug rnams la mi bltos shing / /'bod pa'i sgra ni der ma zad/ /gtso bo ming gi thog ma ru/ /sbyor ba'i tshul sogs bye brag gi/ /dgongs gzhi dgos pa'ang rtogs par bya//gnyis pa rjes 'jug gang yin la/ /mi bltos rang dbang can gyi phrad/ /ni sgra dang sgra de sgra dang / /gang sgra bdag sgra dgag sgra ste/ /drug po de dag 'jug tshul ni//dang po ni zhes bya ba'i sgra/ / dgar dang brnan pa gnyis la 'jug /dper na gser ni dngul las lhag /lta bu mchog tu dgar ba dang / /blun po 'di ni mi yi tha/ /lta bu dman par dgar ba dang / /rdo ni shing las mkhregs lta bu/ /tha dad tsam du dgar ba 'o/ /khyod ni bdag gi grogs lta bu/ /dmigs su bkar nas nan tan du/ /brnan pa'i don dag la 'jug cing / /bya ba gang dang gang yang ni/ /'grub pa 'bad brtson la rag las/ /lta bu tshig gi kha skong la/ /'jug pa'ang brnan pa'i khongs su 'du// —gnyis pa dang sgra sdud 'byed dang / /rgyu mtshan tshe skabs gdam ngag lngar/ /'jug ste dper na gzugs dang ni/ /sgra dang dri dang ro reg rnams/ /'dod yon lnga 'o lta bu ni/ bye brag lnga de 'dod yon zhes/ /gzhi gcig thog tu sdud pa'o//'dod pa'i yon tan lnga zhes ni/ /gzugs dang sgra dang dri dang ni/ /ro dang reg bya rnams lta bu/ /gzhi gcig so sor 'byed par 'jug/

sum rtags kyi dper brjod rang blo'i rtsi bcud/ 107dge ba'i las la 'bad pa dang / /'phral yun bde skyid thob ltatshubu/ /rgyu mtshan ston par 'jug pa'o//ston gyi nam zla shar ba dang / /lo tog 'bras bu smin lta bu/ /tshe skabs gnyis dang don 'dra ba'i/ /dus tshod ston par 'jug pa'o/ /ltos dang gyis dang lta bu rnams/ /gdam ngag gam ni skul tshig la/ /'jug pa rnams ni rtogs par sla//gsum pa de sgra'i 'jug tshul ni/ /tha snyad dbang du gsum dang ni/ /dngos po'i dbang du bzhi yin la/ /dus kyi dbang du gnyis yin te//dper na skyes bu de mkhas so/ /de ni btsun no de bzang ngo lta bu de sgra de dag gis/ /brjod ma thag pa'i skyes bu de/ /nges bzung tshul gyis ston pas na/ /tha snyad 'das ma thag pa zer//de la bris dang de 'khyer shog /lta bu 'bri yul 'khyer bya dag /tshig la dngos su mi gsal yang / /de sgra'i shul du shog bu 'am/ /dngos po gang zhig yodamatshon pas/ /tha snyad rnam grangs gzhan can no/ /'di ru bsdad de ci bya dang / /bsad de shi zhes lta bu'i des/ /brjod bya lhag ma yodatsam las/ /don gzhan mtshon par mi nus pas/ /tha snyad gzhun 'dren lhag bcas so /de rang yin no lta bu'i des/ /don de 'khrul ba med pa ru/ /ston pas bden pa'i dngos po'o//de dag byung ngam zhes lta bus/ /gzhan gyis rtogs par mi 'gyur

108 rdo rje rgyal po'i gsu nga rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/yar/ /lkog tu bya rgyu'i don de nyid/ /go 'di gsang ba'i dngos po'o/ /bdag gi khyim de zhes lta bus/ /rang dang 'brel ba'i khyim ston pa/ /de ni bdag gi ba'i dngos po'o//khyod kyi zla bo de lta bu/ /rang las gzhan pa'i dngos po zhig /ston pas pha rol po'i dngos po'o/ /de rnams la ni dus gsum gar/ /dbye ba med par 'jug par 'gyur//sngon gyi dus der ston pa byon/ /lta bu 'das pa'i dus tshod dang / /ma 'ongs dus der byams pa 'byon/ /lta bu ma 'ongs pa'i dus te/ /dus la 'jug pa gnyis bcas so//bzhi pa gang sgra beem shes sogs/ /bye brag med par spyi la 'jug /dper na gang yin gang zer dang / /gang du 'akro sogs lta bu'o//gzhan yang ci ji su rnams kyang / /gang dang 'dra ba'i spyi sgra ste/ /ci ni zhig dang slad 'dra phyir/ /zhes pa rnams dang sbrags nas 'jug /dper na bya ba ci zhig byed/ /ci ste 'gro na ci slad du/ /ci 'asabyed dam ci phyir bya//ji ni snyed srid ltar bzhin dang / /skad ces rnams dang sprags nas 'jug /dper na ji snyed don kun la/ /ji srid bar du ji ltardobya/ /ji bzhin brtags te gzhung rnams las/ /ji skad bshad bzhin 'jug par bya/ /la sogs nges bzung med par 'jug/su ni gang zag kho nar te/ /sus zer sus byas lta bu'o//lnga nga/ bdag sgra pa ba ma/ /po bo mo bcas drug po 'di/ /ming

da wa sumartagasakyi dper brjod rang blo'i rtsi bcud/ 109 gang dig gi mthar sbyar yang / /sbyor yul de yi bdag po 'am/ /byed pa po ru 'gyur bas na/ /bdag po'i sgra zhes bya bar brjod/ /dper na g.yag pa sne mo ba/ /chang ma zhes rnams brjod pa'i tshe/ /de dag g.yag dang sne mo dang / /chang rnams go bar mi 'gyur bar/ /g.yag la bdag bkol byed mkhan dang / /las kyi sne mor sdod mkhan dang / /chang—tshong ma rnams go byed cing / /de bzhin gsod po mdza' bo dang / 'gro ba mo rnam sa rim pa bzhin/ /gsod dang mdza' dang 'gro ba yi/ /bya ba rnams su mi go bar/ /gsod pa po dang mdza' byed dang / /lam du 'gro mkhan bud med bcas/ /ston cing go bar byed pa'o/ /de ltar sbyor tshul dngul chu ba/ /yab sras bzhed ltar bkod mod kyi/ /si tu'i bzhed par bdag sgra la/ /pa po ma mo bzhi nyid las/ /ba bo bdag kri ra mi bzhed cing / /gzhan gyis 'dod pa'ang bkag yod pa/ /ci rigs dpyad pas rtogs par 'gyur//drug pa dgag sgra ma mi dang / /min med ces pa bzhi po 'di/ /ming tshig gang la sbyar na yang / /sbyor yul de nyid min pa 'am/ /me da pa gang rung ston pas na/ /dgag sgra zhis brjod ma mi gnyis/ /thog mar sbyor te dper brjod na/ /ma yin mi shes lta bu dang / /min me da gnyis po mthar sbyor te/ /bdag min nor med lta ba'o/ /ma ni bar ༄gyi gsal byed la'ang / /'jug ste sa ma 'brog dang ni/ ra ma lug la sogs pa bzhin/ /snga phyi gnyis ka'i don bkag nas/ /bar ma'i don 'ig ston pa'o //

110 rdo rje rgyal po'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/gzhan yang rjod byed tshig bde zhing / /brjod bya'i don rnams gsal ba la/ /phan pa'i tshig phrad ces bya ba/ /cing ces/ ce 'o ce na cig /zhing zhes zhe 'o zhe na zhig /shing shig she 'o she na bcas/ /bcu bzhi 'di rnams 'jug tshul ni/ /ga da ba dang da drag mthar/ /cing sos/sa 'thob ste dper brjod na/ /rgyug cing 'phrog ces skrag ce 'o/ /gtam mngag ce na 'dir shog cig /bstod cing yodaces bsdad ce 'o/ /ci brjod ce na gtam shod cig /gab cing nub ces bkab ce 'o/ /char 'bab ce na gur phub cig /bstand cing bsku lad ces bsgyurd ce 'o/ skyes bskurd ce na de stond cig/nga na ma 'a ra la dang / /mtha' med rnams la zhing sogs 'thob/ /mthong zhing byung zhes bzang zhe 'o/ /de gang zhe na glang zhig dang / /mun zhing 'on zhes blun zhe 'o/ /mda' 'phen zhe na 'ben zhig dgos/ /grim zhing sgam zhes 'jam zhe 'o/ /ci snyam zhe na lham zhig go/ /mnga' zhing gda' zhes dga' zhe 'o/ /dam bca' 'e/ na 'ga' zhig go/ /'ur zhing 'phur zhes 'khor zhe 'o/ /ci ster zhe na nor zhig dang / /mjal zhing 'bul zhes gsol zhe 'o/ /gang 'khel zhe na bal zhig go/ /lta zhing bya zhes 'gro zhe 'o/ /ci nyo zhe na rta zhig go//sa mthar dmigs bsal zhes ma gtogs/ /shing she'o she na shig rnams 'thob/ /sbyangs shing mkhas zhes grags she 'o/ /ci shes she na las shig go/ /lta bu rgya cher sbya ra bar bya//dka' mkha' dga' mnga' la sogs pa'i/ /rkyang pa 'phul can

sum rtags kyi dper brjod rang blo'i rtsi bcud/ 111mtha' dag la/ /'a mtha' nges par sbyor dgos kyi/ /de lta min na dka dag ltar/ /don mi ston nam don log 'gyur/ /de ltar sbyor tshul tshig phrad kyi/ /'jug pa bshad pa dpe bcas rdzogs//mjug tu tsheg shad sbyor tshul ni/ /ming du grub rung ma grub rung / /sbya ra bya tshang ba'i yig tshogs rnams/ /bar gyi tsheg gis bcad par bya/ /de ltar min na gcod klog mtshams/ /'dres nas go don lo ka nga ra 'gyur/ /lhug pa'i don mang gcod mtshams dang / / tshigs nga/ cad ga mthar chig shad bya/ /lhug pa rdzogs tshig mtha' can dang / /tshigs bcad rkang mthar nyis shad sbyor/ /don tshan che mo rdzogs pa dang / /le'u'i mtshams su bzhi shad dgos/ /nga yig ma gtogs yig shad dbar/ /tsheg med de rnams gtso bo ni/ /dbu can 'bri ba'i tshul ltar ro//gangs can brda sprod gzhung lugs mchog /thon mi'i legs bshad sum cu pa'i/ /snying po mdor bsdus dper brjod bcas/ /brjed byang tsam zhig de ltar ro//mtha' bral rtags 'jug rgya mtsho'i nang / /thos brtson gru bo la brten nas/ /dgongs don nor bu 'tshol ba 'di/ /skal pa bzang snya/ma spro bas 'jug/spyir na bod kyi yi ge la/ /dbyangs sam a li zhes pa yi/ /i u e o bzhi po 'di/ /shes rab rang bzhin mo yig yin/ /de yang dngordo/ su sbyar bya ni/ /gi gu zhabs kyu 'greng po dang / /na ro zhes pa de rnams

112 rdo rje rgyal po'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/yin/ /gsal byed dam ni ka li zhes/ /ka nas a bar sum cu rnams/ /thabs kyi rang bzhin pho yin la/ /sde pa phyed dang brgyad du yod/ /de dag sdon 'jug ming gzhi dang / /rjes 'jug mgo can 'dogs can du/ /dbyangs dang bcas te bsdebs pa las/ /ming tshig brjod pa thams cad 'byung //pho yig sum cu tham pa de/ /pho mo ma ning shin tu mo/ /mo gsham dang bcas lngar dbye ste/ /ka ca ta pa tsa rnams pho/ /kha cha tha pha tsha ma ning / /ga ja da ba dza wa zha/ /za ya 'a sha sa bcas te/ /bcu gnyis 'di rnams mo yig yin/ /nga nya na ma bzhi 'di dag /gin rtu mo yi yi ge yin/ /ra la ha a bzhi po ni/ /mo gsham yi ge zhes pa'o/ /a ni mtshan med ces kyang bya/ /de rnams ming gzhe'i yi ge yi/ /rtags kyi dbye ba zhes bya'o/ /de ltar dbye ba'i rgyu mtshan ni/ /yi ge de rnams so so ru/ /ngag nas brjod tshe rang rang gi/ /gnas dang byed pa rtsol ba yi/ /sgra shugs che chung gis byas so//sngon 'jug ga da ba ma 'a/ /lnga yi rtags kyi dbye ba ni/ /ba yig pho yi yi ge dang / /ga da gnyis po ma ning dang / /'a mo ma ne gin tu mo/ /bcas te rnam pa bzhi ru 'byed/ /de ltar 'byed pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ /sdon 'jug de dag rang rang gi/ /ming gzhi dang sbyar klog pa'i tshe/ /sgra shugs che chung gis yin te//dper na bkag dang bsgrags lta bu/ /ba yi 'phul can ji snyed kun/ /sgra shugs che ba'i po zhes dang //

sum rtags kyi dbair brjod rang blo'i rtsi bcud/ 113de bzhin gtong dang dga' lta bu/ /ma ning 'phul can ci yin kun/ /sgra shugs ran pas ma ning dang //'gro dang 'dzin sogs lta bu rnams/ /sgra shugs zhan pas mo zhes dang //mkhyen dang mjal sogs lta bu rnams/ /sgra shugs shin tu zhan pas na/ /shin tu mo zhes bcas brjod do//sngon 'jug rtags kyi 'jug tshul ni/ /sngon 'jug de dag re re bzhin/ /'jug yul gang la 'jug pa dang / /sngon 'jug gang gis 'jug pa dang / /drag zhan bar ma'i sgra dag gi/ /tshul rnams ji ltar 'jug pa dang / /dgos pa ci phyir 'jug pa bcas/ /byed pa bzhi bzhir bshad dgos ste//dang po gang la 'jug pa dang / /gang gis 'jug pa chabs cig tu/ /bstan par 'jug byed pho yig ba/ /'jug yul ming gzhi yi ge pho/ /ka ca ta tsa bzhi dang ni/ /mo yig ga nga ja nya da/ /na dza zha za ra sha sa/ /bcas te yi ge ba n+yag la/ /rkyang brtsegs 'dogs gsum ci rigs 'jug /dper na bskor bcas btab brtson brgyan/ /bsngo brjod bsnyen brtsa bskur brjes bzhes/ /bathod brlag bshad bsags lta bu dang //sngon 'jug ma ning ga yig ni/ /ming gzhi'i pho yig ca ta tsa/ /gsum dang ming gzhi'i mo'i yi ge/ /nya da na zha za ya sha/ /sa bcas bcu gcig de rnams la/ /rkyang pa kho nar 'jug ste dper/ /gces

114 rdo gli rgyal po'i gsung ma phyogasarī bsgrigs/gtam gtsang gnyer gdong gnangs gzhes/ /gzer g.yon gshin gsung lta bu dang //sngon 'jug ma ning da yig ni/ /ming gzhi'i pho yig ka pa dang / /mo yig ga ba nga ma bcas/ /drug la rkyang 'dogs gnyis su 'jug /dper na dka' daphyod dga' dbyangs dngos/ /dmar la sogs pa lta bu'o//sngon 'jug mo yi yi ge 'a/ ming gzhi'i mo yig ga ja da/ ba dza lnga po de dag dang / /ma ning kha cha tha pha tsha/ /lnga ste bcu la rkyang 'dogs gnyis/ /ci rigs su 'jug dper brjod na/ /'gro 'jig 'dod 'byed 'dzin 'khyar 'chal/ /'then 'phying 'tshal bcas lta bu dang //sngon 'jug shin tu mo yig ma/ /ming gzhi'i ma ning kha cha tha/ /tsha bcas bzhi dang mo'i yi ge/ /ga ja da dza nga nya na/ /bcas te yi ge bcu gcig la/ /rkyang dang 'dogs can gnyis su 'jug /dper na mkhyen mchid mthong mtshar mgron/ /mjal mda' mdzod mngon mnyes mnabs ltar//sngon 'jug yi ge lnga po de/ /rang rang 'jug yul ming gzhi la/ /sgra dang byed rtsol drag zhan tshul/ /ji ltar 'jug par byed ce na//bka' bcos bstan brtson brgyan bsngags brje/ /bsten bdag bsnams brjes bzhad bzang brlams/ /bshad bsams la sogs lta bu rnams/ /sngon 'jug pho yi yi ge ba/ /drag pa'i tshul

— sumartagasakyi dper brjod rang blo'i ji bcud/ 115gyis 'jug pa dang //gcig gtam gtsang gnyer gdab gnas gzhal/ gza' g.yar gsham gsal bcas rnams dang / dka' dpal dge dbang dngos dman bcas/ /sngon 'jug ma ning ga da gnyis/ /ran pa'i tshul gyis 'jug pa dang //'ga' 'jig 'dum 'bar 'dzin 'khon 'chi/ /'thams 'phel 'tshal sogs lta bu rnams/ /sngon 'jug yi ge mo yig 'a/ /zhan pa'i tshul gyis 'jug pa dang //mkhas mchog mtha' mtshams mgar mjal mdun/ /mtshes mngar mnyam mnan bcas lta bu/ /sngon 'jug shin tu mo yig ma/ /sgra rtsol mnyam par 'jug pa ste/ /shin tu zhan pa'i tshul gyis so//sngon 'jug yi ge lnga po rnams/ /dgos pa ci phyir 'jug ce na/ /thog mar ming gi rnam gzhag la/ /las gang zhig la byed pa po/ /gzhan dang dngos su 'brel ba yi/ /dbang du byas nas byed po dang / /de yi byed pa gnyis la ni/ /dngos po bdag zer bya yul('di la las kyang zer) dang / /bya ba gnyis la dngos po gzhan/ /zer zhing byed pa po gzhan dang / /dngos su 'brel min ji ltar yang / /bya ba byas zin 'das pa dang / /bya ba byed 'gyur ma 'ongs pa/ /bya ba byed bzhin da lta ba/ /zer ba nges shing ngos bzung nas/ /dngos po bdag gzhan gnyis po dang / /dus gsum bcas pa ston phyir 'jug/de dag so sor bshad pa la/ /dang po sdon 'jug pho yig ba/ /

ci 116 rdorjergyal po'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/bdag gzhan gnyis nas bdag dang ni/ /dus gsum nang nas 'das par 'jug /de yang rnam gsal dper brjod na/ /drin gyis bskyangs dang chu las bsgral/ /legs par bshad ces brjod pa na/ /byed pa po dang 'brel ba yi/ /bya ba de rnams byas zin pa/ /ston pas 'dasadzipar 'jug pa dang / /bskyang bya'i bu dang bsgral bya'i mgron/ /bshad bya'i gtam sogs lta bu ni/ /bya ba'i yul lam las dag dang / /bskyang bar bya dang bsgral bar bya/ /bshad par bya sogs lta bu ni/ /bya las la 'jug 'di dag rnams/ /dngos po gzhan la 'jug pa'o// gnyis pa ma ning ga da gnyis/ /dngos po bdag gzhan gnyis ka dang / /dus ni da lta ba la 'jug /dang po ga yig dper brjod na/ /gcog pa po dang gcog byed dang / /g.yo ba po dang g.yo byed dang / /gsod pa po dang gsod byed sogs/ /brjod tshe gcog sogs bya ba rnams/ /byed po gtso phal ston pa dang / /gachog par byed dang g.yo bar byed/ /gsod par byed sogs brjod pa na/ /byed pa po dang 'brel ba yi/ /byed las ston par 'jug pa rnams/ /dngos po bdag la 'jug pa dang //gcag bya'i rdo dang g.yo bya'i zas/ /bsad bya'i phyugs sogs brjod pa na/ /gcag rgyu'i rdo sogs bya yul lam/ /las zhes bya ba ston pa dang / /gcag par bya dang g.yo bar bya/ /gsad par bya zhes brjod pa na/ /bya ba'i yul dang 'brel ba yi/ /bya las

sum rtags kyi dper brjod rang blo'i rtsi bcud/ 117 —ston par 'jug pa rnams/ /dngos po gzhan la 'jug pa dang //gcog bzhin pa dang g.yo bzhin dang / /gsod kyin mchis sogs brjod pa na/ /bya ba de dag byed skabs shig /ston pas da ltar 'jug pa'o//de bzhin da yig dper brjod na/ /dkri ba po dang dkri byed dang / /dgar ba po dang dgar byed dang / /daphyod pa po dang daphyod byed sogs/ /brjod tshe dkri sogs bya ba rnams/ /byed po gartso phal ston pa dang / /dkri bar byed dang dgar bar byed/ /daphyod par byed ces brjod pa na/ byed pa po dang 'brel ba yi/ /byed las ston par 'jug pa rnams/ /dngos po bdag la 'jug pa dang / /dkri bya'i snal ma dgar bya'i don/ / dpyad bya'i tshig sogs brjod pa na/ /snal ma la sogs bya yul lam/ /las zhes bya ba ston pa dang / /dkri bar bya dang dgar bar bya/ /dpyad par bya sogs brjod pa na/ /bya ba'i yul dang 'brel ba yi/ /bya las ston par 'jug pa rnams/ /dngos po gzhan la 'jug pa dang //dkri bzhin pa dang dgar myas dang / /daphyod bzhin pa sogs brjod pa na/ /da lta ba la 'jug pa'o//gsum pa sngon 'jug mo yig 'a/ /dngos po bdag dang dus gsum las/ /da lta ma 'ongs gnyis la 'jug /de yang rnam gsal dper brjod na/ /'god pa po dang 'god byed dang / /'chad pa po dang rnachad byed dang / /'byin pa po dang 'byin byed sogs/ /brjod

118 rdo rje rgyal po'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/tshe 'god sogs bya ba rnams/ /byed po gatsho phal ston pa dang / /'god par byed dang 'chad pa— byed/ /'byin par byed so gas brjod pa na/ /byed pa po dang 'brel ba yi/ /byed las ston par 'jug pa rnams/ /dngos po bdag la 'jug pa dang //'god bzhin pa dang 'chad kyin yod/ /'byin pa'i skabs sogs brjod pa na/ /bya ba de dag byed bzhin pa/ /ston pas da ltar 'jug pa dang //'byung bar 'gyur dang 'gro rgyu dang / /'thon par bya sogs brjod pa na/ /bya ba de rnams bya rgyu zhig /ston pas ma 'ongs par 'jug pa'o// bzhi pa shin tu mo ma yig /dngos po bdag gzhan gnyis ka dang / /dus gsum bcas pa thams cad la/ /bye brag med par 'jug dper na/ /mthud pa po dang mthud byed dang / /mchod pa po dang mchod byed dang / /mjal ba po dang mjal byed sogs/ //brjod tshe mthud sogs bya ba rnams/ /byed po gartso phal ston pa dang / /mthud par byed dang mchod par byed/ /mjal bar byed sogs brjod pa na/ /byed pa po dang 'brel ba yi/ /byed las ston par 'jug pa rnams/ /dngos po bdag la 'jug pa dang //mthud bya'i sne dang mchod bya'i lha/ /mjal bya'i grogs sogs brjod pa na/ /sne la sogs pa bya yul lam/ /las zhes bya ba ston pa dang / /mthud par bya dang mchod par bya/ /mjal bar bya

— sumartagasakyi daṭwāṃr brjod rang blo'i rtsi bcud/ 119sogs brjod pa na/ /bya ba'i yul dang 'brel ba yi/ /bya ba ston par 'jug pa rnams/ /dngos po gzhan la 'jug pa dang //sne mo mthud zin lha mchod do/ /grogs po mjal sogs brjod pa na/ /bya ba de rnams byas zin pa/ /ston pas 'das par 'jug pa dang / /mthud par bya dang mchod par 'byur/ /mjal rgyu yin sogs brjod pa na/ /bya ba de rnams bya rgyu zhig /ston pas ma 'ongs par 'jug dang / /mthud kyin yod dang mchod bzhin pa/ /mjal ba'i skabs sogs brjod pa na/ /bya ba de rnams byed bzhin pa/ /ston pas da lta bar 'jug pa'o//de ltar sngon 'jug lnga po rnams/ /dgos pa ci phyir 'jug tshul lam/ /bdag gzhan dus gsum gang ston bcas/ /dper brjod cung zad bkod zin nas/ /bya byed las gsum zhes bya ba'i/ /dbye ba'i tshul yang brjod pa la/ /brjod par bya dang bstan par bya/ /lta bu bya las ma 'ongs dang / /rjod par byed dang ston par byed/ /lta bu byed las da lta dang / /brjod zin bstan to lta bu yi/ /bya ba byas zin 'das pa bcas/ /gang zhig yin kyang bya zhes dang / /rjod pa po dang rjod byed dang / /ston pa po dang ston byed sogs / /byed po gtso phal gnyis ka la/ /byed ces zer zhing brjod bya'i gtam/ /bstan bya'i gdam ngag sogs lta bur/ /las zhes bya ba'ang shes par bya//rjes 'jug yi ge bcu po yi/ /rtags kyi dbye ba bshad pa ni/ /

120 rdo rje rgyal po'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/spyir na pho mo ma ning gsum/ /ga da ba sa bzhi rnams pho/ /na ra la gsu ma ma ning dang / /nga ma 'a gsum mo yin no//nang gses grags dang 'dogs lta bu/ /rjes 'jug ga la yang 'jug sa/ /zhugs pa skyes bu rab ces dang / /skyabs dang 'debs sogs rjes 'jug bar/ yang 'jug sa can skyes bu 'bring / /rtag rab bsad bcas lta bu yi/ /ga ba yang 'jug med pa dang / /da sa'i mtha' can rnams bcas la/ /skyes bu tha ma zhes bya ste/ /pho la rab 'bring tha gsum yod//de bzhin bskyangs dang bsams lta bu/ /nga ma gnyis la yang 'jug sa/ /zhugs pa mo tsam zhes pa dang / gang dang 'jam sogs lta bu yi/ /nga ma yang 'jug med pa dang / /dga' sogs 'a mtha' can rnams la/ /shin tu mo zhes zer ba yi/ /mo la rnam pa gnyis yod do//ma ning na ra la gsum de/ /bathand dang bstard brtsald sogs lta bu/ /ming gzhi pho yig rjes rnams su/ /yang 'jug dang bcas zhugs pa na/ /drag dang phrad pas drag pa dang / min dang mgur mjal sogs lta bu/ /ming gzhi mo yig rjes rnams su/ /yang 'jug med par zhugs pa na/ /zhan dang phrad pas zhan pa ru/ /'gyur bas 'gyur ba ma ning dang / /brgyand dang sbyard bsnyald sogaso lta bu/ /ming gzhi mo yig rjes rnams su/ /yang 'jug da bcas zhugs pa na/ /ming gzhi mo yig zhan pa dang / /yang 'jug da yig drag pa'i

sum rtags kyi dper brjod rang blo'i rtsi bcud/ 121bar/ /tshud nas drag zhan sa/nyis ka dang / /phrad pas na tshan sa/nyis ma ning dang / /mkhyen dang cher 'a phel sogs lta bu/ /ming gzhi ma ning rjes rnams su/ /yang 'jug med par zhugs pa na/ /drag zhan gang du'ang mi 'gyur bas/ /mtshan med ma ning bcas gsum ste/ /bsdoms pas rnam pa brgyad yod do//rjes 'jug yi ge bcu po yi/ /rtags kyi 'jug pa bshad pa la/ /'jug yul gang la 'jug pa dang / /'jug byed gang gis 'jug pa dang / /'jug tshul ji ltar 'jug pa dang / /dgos pa ci phyir 'jug pa bcas/ /rnam pa bzhi yod de dag ni//dang po gang la 'jug ce na/ /bkag rkang skad dkon skub bkram bka'/ /skar skyel brkos bcas ka yig la/ /'jug ltar yi ge kun la 'jug/gang gis 'jug par byed ce na/ /rjes 'jug yi ge bcu des 'jug /'jug tshul dper brjod gong gis 'thus//ji ltar 'jug par byed ce na/ /sgra yi 'jug tshul zhig dang ni/ /don gyi 'jug tshul zhig ste gnyis//de yang sgra yi 'jug tshul ni/ /rjes 'jug ga da ba sa bzhi/ / 'degs gtsod thabs zas sogs lta bur/ /ming gzhi gang la zhugs na yang / /sgra gdangs drag par 'gyur bas na/ /drag pa'i tshul gyis 'jug pa dang / /rjes 'jug nga ma 'a gsum po/ /yang skam mkha' sogs lta bu ru/ /ming gzhi gang la zhugs na yang / /sgra gdangs zhan

122 rdo rje rgyal po'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/par 'gyur bas na/ /zhan pa'i tshul gyis 'jug pa dang / /rjes 'jug na ra la gsum po/ /kun gnyer 'phel sogs lta bu ru/ /ming ga'i/ gang la zhugs na yang / /sgra gdangs 'bring bar gnas pas na/ /ran pa'i tshul gyi 'jug pa'o//don la ji ltar 'jug ce na/ /snga ma gang ltar 'gyur ba dang / /phyi ma gang ltar 'gyur gnyis yod//snga ma gang ltar 'gyur ba ni/ /ming gzhi'i yi ge gang zhig la/ /rjes 'jug de dag zhugs pa yis/ /don de gang du 'gyur tshul ni/ /dper brjod bdag gis don bskubs dang / /shing cha da lta gartsod kyi yong/ / /gos lham brje rgyu yin lta bu/ /bya ba dus gsum ston pa dang / /bsgrub bya'i don dang bcad bya'i shing / /brje bya'i gos sos/ra/ lta bu rnams/ /las sam dngos po gzhan ston dang / /gartsod pa po dang gcod byed sogs/ /byed po gtso phal dngos po bdag /ston par 'jug pa la sogs pa/ /bya byed las gsum cir 'gyur rnams/ /gtso bo sngon 'jug de dag gi/ /nus pa'i rjes su 'gyur bas na/ /rtags kyi 'jug pa'i rtsa bar yang / /snga ma sngon 'jug snga bzhin sbyar/ /gsungs pa ltar du 'gyur mod kyi/ /'on kyang de dag khyod kyis byas/ /ngas mthong des shes lta bu yi/ /byas zin 'das pa nyung shas dang / /skul chag dang ni ming rkyang sogs/ /rjes 'jug kho nas rang dbang du/ /ston pa'ang yod pa rtogs par bya//phyi ma gang ltar 'gyur ba ni/ /rjes 'jug gam ni mtha' rten des/ /

sum rtags kyi dper brjod rangablo'ipyi bcud/ 123 waming mtha' dag dang rnam dbye sogs/ /ji ltar 'dren pa'i tshul rnams ni/ /ming tshig snga ma'i rjes 'jug dang / /phyi ma'i brjod pa hra yin la/ /bltos nas 'dren pa de la yang / /ming mtha' ji lta ra 'dren tshul dang / /rnam dbye la sogs 'dren tshul gnyis//dper na ming mtha' 'dren tshul ni/ /rtag pa thab pa bad ka dang / /gnyis ka lta bu de rnams ni/ /rjes 'jug pho yig bzhi po des/ /ming mtha' ka pa gnyis drangs pa/ /'de ni rjes 'ju ci / ro yig gis/ / ming mtha' pho yig drangs pa dang / / /snying ga sprum ma dga' ba rnams/ / rjes 'jug mo yig gsum po des/ /ming rma tha' mo yig ga ma ba/ /gsum po 'di dag drangs pa ni/ /mo yis mo yig drangs pa dang / /men kha dar cha rgyal kha rnams/ /rjes 'ju ga ma ning gsum po des/ /ming mtha' kha cha gnyis drangs pa/ /'di dag rjernga ska 'jug ma ning gis/ /ming mtha' ma ning drangs pa ste/ /'di rnatre 4sa ming myo/tha' de nyid kyi/ /pho mo'i rtags mtshungs ming maba' rnams/ /drangs/ pas rtags mtshungs 'dren tshul lo//bag ma 'jab bu smad ra dang / /lus mo rnams ni rjes 'jug phos/ /ming mtha' mo yig drangs pa dang / /sprang po lam ka la sogs pa/ /mo yis pho yig drangs pa dang / /sgron ma thor bu lo la go rnams/ /ma ning gis ni mo drangs pa/ /rnams ni rtags mtshungs ma yin kyang / /brjod bde ltar du drangs pa'i phyir/ /brjod bde 'dren pa zhes bya'o//

124 rdo rje rgyal po'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/ gzhan yang bum par chu blug ces/ /lta bu bum zhes rjes 'jug mas/ /ming mtha' pho yig pa drangs shing / /pa la don thob rjes 'jug 'as/ /la don las su bya ba'i sgra/ /ra yig drangs pa 'di lta bu/ /rtags mtshungs brjod bde ci rigs su/ /rjes 'jug dag gis ming mtha' drangs/ /ming mthas rnam dbye drangs pa'ang yod//rnam dbye rnams dang tshig phrad kyi/ /rkyen nam sgra rnams 'dren tshul la/ /sgra la bltos pa'i 'dren tshul dang / /don la bltos pa'i 'dre na tshul te/ /rnam pa gnyis kyi sgo nas 'dren//de yang sgra yi 'dren tshul rnams/ /nang gses dper brjod dang bcas pa/ /gong du so sor bkod zin cing / /mdor na rtags mtshungs 'dren pa dang / /brjod bde 'dren pa gnyis su 'dus/ /de yang mthar gtugs kyis bshad na/ /brjod bde 'dren pa kho na 'o//don gyi 'dren tshul tha dad rnams/ /nang gses gang zhig 'jug pa ni/ /ming tshig gang yin de yi mthar/ /sbyar bya'i ming tshig 'og ma de/ /gang yin shes par byas nas sbyor/ /de dag rnam gsal dper brjod na//grogs po lta bu'i ming zhig gi/ /rjes su gang zhig lta bu yi/ /spyi la khrab pa'i sgra yod na/ /grogs po zhes pa'i ming de la/ /rnam dbye dang po thob na yang / /bod kyi skad la ming rkyang dang / /rnam dbye dang po gcig yin pas/ /ming der gang zhig ces sbyar ba/ /grogs po gang

sum rtags kyi dper brjod rang blo'i byu bcud/ 125zheg lta bu dang //gang la bshad ces lta bu yi/ /bya ba byas pa'i don yod na/ /ming der4 rnam dbye gnyis pa sbyor/ /krogs por gtam bshad lta bu 'o// 'a ru ston par byed/ /lta bu byed pa'i sgra yod na/ /ming der gsum pa byed sgra sbyor/ /gros/sa pos lam ston lta bu 'o//gang gi ched du byas pa yi/ /don zhig yod na ming de la/ /rnam dbye bzhi pa dgos ched sbyor/ /grogs por rogs ram byas lta bu//gang zhig gang las byung ba 'am/ /bye ba sogs kyi don yod na/ /ming der lnga pa 'byung khungs sbyor/ /grogs po'i zhal las thos lta bu//gang dang 'brel ba'i khyad chos sam/ /yon tan la sogs shig yod ( na/ /ming der drug pa 'brel sgra sbyor/ /grogs po'i yon tan lta bu 'o//gang zhig gang la brten pa 'am/ /gnas dang yod pa'i don yod na/ /ming der bdun pa gnas gzhi sbyor/ /grogatra5 por blo gros yod lta bu//gang la re ba bcol rgyu sogs/ /'apod par 'os pa'i don yod na/ /ming der brgyad pa 'apod sgra sbyor/ /dper na grogs po kye zhes sa ma/ /ka ye grogs po lta bu 'o//de bzhin phrad kyi 'dren tshul yang / /tshig don gong 'o0/ tshe stongs pa las/ /gong ma 'og mar bsku rgyu zhig /yod na snga ma rtsad pa'i

126 rdorjergyalapo'igasungartsotram̐zis jigs/ phrang// /dang sgra sbyar dgos dper ba rjod na/ /gzugs dang sgra dang dri dang ni/ /ro dang reg bya dang bcas rnams/ /'dod yon lnga 'o lta bu 'o//tshig don snga ma de dag dang / /mtshungs par tshig don 'orga/ ma rnams/ /bsdu rgyu yod na 'og ma dag /sdud sgra kyang yang 'ang rnams spyor/ /dper na dgra yang smon byed na/ /lta bu gnyen rnams bsdu ba dang / /khyod kyang 'gro 'am zhes brdzod na/ /'gro mkhan gzhan ya ngalhayod pa dang / /lha sa la yang phyin lta bu/ /de min gzhan la'ang phyin pa sogs/ /go ba 'di rnams bstan bya'i don/ /'og ma gong mar sngud pa'o//rnam grangs ji snyed bkod pa de/ /gal te don la bskyar yod na/ /rnam grangs 'byed dang sdud pa'i phrad/ /gam soban/sa bcu gcig ci rigs sbyor/ /dper na 'jam pa'i dbyangs mtshan ni/ /smra ba'i rgyal lam blo gter ram/ /zur phud lnga pa'o lta bu dang / /nyi ma'i ming ni snang byed dam/ /rta ljang can nam ma spum mam/ /mkha' nor bcas so lta bu rnams/ /brjod don 'jam dbyangs nyi ma gnyis/ /ming gi rnam grangs du ma yis/ /bskyar te mang por 'byed pa dang / /yang na sgra dbyangs lha mo 'am/ /tshangs sras ma 'am mtsho byung ngam/ /sgra ldan ma ni dbyangs can no/ /ltar dang sprin gyi me tog gam/ /gru char ram ni thrin bcud rnams/ /char pa 'o sogs lta bu ni/ /ming gi rnam grangs du ma yis/ /dbyangs can ma dang char pa gnyis/ /

sum rtags kyi dper brjod rang blo'i rtsi bcud/ 127yang yang bskyar te de gnyis su/ /bsdu bar byed phyir brjod pa 'o//tshig don gnyis ka bskyar ba yi/ /lta zhing lta zhing slar yang lta/ /bltas kyang bltas la mthong yang mthong / /lta bu rnams la mtshams sbyor sgra(phrad) / /zhing cing shing dang sdud pa'i sgra/ /kyang yang 'ang gsum ci rigs sbyor// zhing 'brog chos la sogs pa yi/ /bdag po 'am ni byed po zhig /brjod dgos yod na ming de'i mthar/ /bdag sgra'i pho rtags pa po dang / /mo rtags ma mo sbyar bar bya/ /dper na zhing pa 'brog pa dang / /chos pa chang ma gzhas ma dang/ /byed po mdza' mo lta bu 'o//gang zhig brjod pa'i don de nyid/ /ma yin pa 'am med pa zhig /brjod dgos yod na ming de yi/ /thog mthar dgag sgra'i ma mi dang / /min med gang rung sbyar bar bya/ /dper na de ltar ma byas dang / /mi byed nga min 'de na med/ /lta bu rnams dang ra ma lug /sa ma 'byog sogs ma yig gis/ /snga phyi gnyis ka bkag nas kyang / /bar ma'i don zhig ston pa'ang yod//brjod don snga phyi gnyis mthun zhing / /gzhi gcig thog tu bsdu rgyu zhig /yod na ming tshig snga ma der/ /mthun pa'i tshig rgyan kyang ji ri nga 'ang / /gsum po ci rigs sbyar bar bya/ /dper na sbyangs kyang sbya ngas pa yin/ /shes kyang shes so lta bu dang // brjod don snga phyi mi mthun zhing / /gzhi gcig thog tu bsdu rgyu zhig /lod na ming tshig snga ma der/ /mi mthun tshig rgyan sbyar bar bya/ /

128 rdo rje rgyal po'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/dper na bdag gi grogs po 'di/ /shes rgya che yang nga rgyal chung / /khro ba yod kyang 'dzin pa med/ /lta bu don la snyeg min dang / /mdzes dang mi mdzes bstun nas sbyor//gang rung tshig cig brjod nyid du/ /slar yang brjod bya gzhan yod na/ /snga mar lhag bcas ston pa 'i sgra/ /ste de te gsum sbyar bar bya/ /dper na bslabs te shes zhes dang / /gab ste bsdad sosde nas lta bu rnams/ /mtshams smyor lhag bcas zhes pa ste/ /de bzhin dam bca' lhag bcas dang / /gzhan 'dren lhag bcas la yang sbyor//gang zhig brjod bya'i don de nyid/ /de tsam nyid kyis rdzogs pa zhig /brjod dgos yod na slar bsdu 'am/ /rdzogs tshig gi sgra go la sogs/ /bcu gcig de rnams sbyar bar bya/ /dper na khyod kyis legs bstan to/ /bdag gis res so lta bu 'o//rjes 'jug yi ge bcu po rnams/ /dgos pa ci phyir 'jug ce na/ /yi ge'i khongs nas ming dbyung zhing / /ming gi khongs nas tshig phyung ste/ /tshig gis don rnams ston phyir 'jug/yi ge las ming dbyung tshul ni/ /ming gzhi'i yi ge gang yin der/ /sdon 'jug lnga dang mgo 'dogs bcas/ /nyis sbrel gsum sbrel la sogs pa/ /ji ltar yod kyang rjes 'jug cig /med na yi ge'i gzugs tsam las/ /don gyi ngo bo ston byed kyi/ /ming du grub par mi srid pa/ /sum cu par yang bshad ltar phyir/ /gang zhig sbyar ba'i yi ge rnams/ /ming du grub par bya phyir 'jug/

sum rtags kyi dber brjod rangablo'i ji bcud/ 129ming las tshig rnams dbyung tshul ni/ /sa chu mi nor rkang lag sogs/ /ming rnams gnyis sam mang po zhig /mnyam du sbrel te sbyar na yang / /de dag mtshams sbyor byed pa 'am/ /don rnams gsal bar byed pa yi/ /rnam dbye dang ni tshig phrad rnams/ /rjes 'jug nang nas byung ba dang / /rjes 'jug de dag la bltos nas/ /'jug par byed pa shas che zhing / /de lta'i rnam dbye tshig phrad rna mas/ /ma zhugs na ni ming tsam las/ / khyad par so sor rjod byed kyi/ /mig tu grub par mi grid pas/ /ming las tshig rnams myur phyir 'jug/tshig gis don rnams ston tshul ni/ /rjod byed sgra rnams rab dag cing / /brjod bya'i don rnams gsal ba yi/ /tshig gi phreng ba bstar ba las/ /ji snyed shes bya phra rags kun/ /ji bzhin ston par byed pas na/ /don rnams ston pa'i phyir 'jug go/ /mdor na ming tshig brjod pa kun/ /rjes 'jug bcu yi nus pas ston//'o na yi ge'i 'jug pa spyir/ /dgos pa ci zhig yod ce na/ /slob dpon thon mi sam bho ṭas/ /mo yi yi ge med pa na/ /pho yig brjod pa med par 'gyur/ /zhes pa gsal por gsungs pa bzhin/ /spyir na bod kyi yi ge la/ /pho mo gnyis su phye ba las/ /dbyangs kyi bya ba gsal po ru/ /byed pa i u e o dang / /shugs bstan a bcas lnga po rnams/ /mo yi yi ge zhes bya ste/ /de dag lnga po med na ni/ /pho yig ka nas a bar gyi/ /ka li sum cu kho na yis/ /brjod bya'i don kun ston mi nus/ /de yi rgyu mtshan gang zhe na/ /a li rnams la bltos pa yi/ /ji snyed brjod

130 rdo rje rgyal po'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/pa de snyed kun/ /chad nas brjod par mi nus te/ /dper na i tsam 7med na yang / /gi gu dgos pa'i brjod bya kun/ /brjod par mi nus pa bzhin no//gzhan yang pho yig sum cu der/ /dbyangs dang ldan min ji ltar yang / /rjes 'jug bcu po gang rung zhig /med na ming tshig mi gsal zhing / /ming dang tshig rnams ma gsal na/ /don rnams mtshon zhing go ba yang / /med par 'gyur bas de yi phyir/ /dbyangs rnams ka li sum cu po'i/ /brjod pa'i yan lag cha shas rnams/ /yongs su rdzogs par bya phyir dang / /rjes 'jug yi ge bcu po de/ /ming dang tshig gi sbyor ba rnams/ /rab tu gsal bar bya phyir dang / /ming tshig de rnams 'khor 'das kyi/ /don kun mtshon zhing brjod phyir ro//'o na dgos pa'i snying po 'am/ /nying dgos ci zhig yod ce na/ /de ltar ming tshig brjod pa yi/ /sbyor ba mtha' dag med gyur na/ /rdzod byed tshig gi sbyor ba yis/ /brjod bya'i don rnams lung ston pa'i/ /brda 'chad thams cad mi 'byung zhing / /thun mong thun mong ma yin pa'i/ /rig pa'i gnas lnga la sogs pa/ /ston cing smra ba'ang med par 'gyur/ /des na ming tshig brjod gsum gyi/ /rnam gzhag mtha' dag 'jig rten du/ /grags shing legs par gnas pa'i mthus/ /'jig rten 'jig rten las 'das pa'i/ /lugs sam tshul yang legs byung zhing / /de lta/'i lam du rab zhugs te/ /blang dang 'dor bya ji snyed kun/ /yang dag spyod pa la brten nas/ /'phral yun don kun legs 'grub pa'i/ /

sumartagasakyidabairab zirangablo'irtsibacud/ 131phun tshogs ma lus 'byung de yin//yi ge'i sbyor ba ston byed kyi/ /sum rtags zhes pa'i gzhung 'dil/ /dgos pa ci zhig yod ce na/ /dper na skye 'gro thams cad la/ /gzugs sogs phung po lnga rnams dang / /mig gi khams sogs khams lnga dang / /skye mched bcu gnyis la sogs pa/ /thams cad rang rang gi lus la/ /thog ma nyid nas lhan cig tu/ /'grogs shing tshangs par yod na yang / /de ltar rnam gzhag gzhan dag las/ /ma thos brngo du rang nyid kyis/ /nam yang shes par mi 'gyur bzhin/ /yi ge'i sbyor ba de rnams kyang / /rang rang yul gyi skad rnams la/ /med pa nam yang mi srid cing / /skad las byung ba yin na yang / /gzhan gyis brda do na legs sprad nas/ /ma bslabs na ni rang ming gi/ /sbyor tshul tsam yang mi shes na/ /rgya chen ming tshig brjod pa rnams/ /ji lta ji bzhin par sbyar nas/ /brda sprod byed tshul ga la shes/ /dper na chu phran brgal rgyu tsam/ /lus shugs kyis kyang chod 'gyur mod/ /rgya mtsho lta bu'i gting zab la/ /gru gzings med na ci byar yod/ /de bzhin sa brko rdo bslog sogs/ /bya ba phal rnams ngag lam nas/ /'chad nyan bgyis pas thus mod kyang / /zab don lung rtogs tshan rig rnams/ /yi ger rmongs pas ci bya nas/ /de phyir thon mi sam bho ṭas/ /'chad rtsod rtsom sogs shes kun gyi/ /phyi mo yi ge'i sbyor ba rnams/ /rgya gar sgra la dpe blangs nas / /rang yul gangs can skad lugs kyi/ /chos nyid ji bzhin 'jug pa'i tshul/ /'phyug pa med par ston nus pa'i/ /brda sprod gzhung lugs—

132 rdo rje rgyal po'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/'di brtsams so/ /de ltar gzhung lugs dgos don bcas/ /rmad du byung ba'i tshul mthong nas/ /dgongs don snying po dper brjod bcas/ /tshigs su bcad pa 'di nyid bris/ /skyes thob rtsa ba ches phra la/ /sbyangs pa'i lo 'dab ma rgyas pas/ /legs bshad zil mngar dben gyur kyang / /lhag bsam mtshan pa'i 'dam skyes yin/ /log par gyur dang 'khyogs pa sogs/ /no ngas pa'i dri ma zhugs pa kun/ /mkhyen pa'i spyan ras yangs rnams kyis/ /lung rigs lha chus sbyang du gsol/ /lhag pa'i bsam pa sma med pas/ /'bad las thob pa'i legs tshogs rnams/ /rang dang rang 'dra'i blo gsar pa'i/ /blo gros rgyas pa'i dpal du bsngo/ /zhes yul gangs can pa'i skad kyis brda sprod pa'i bstan bcos sum cu pa dang rtags kyi 'jug pa'i dgongs don dper brjod tshigs su bcad pa rang blo'i rtsi bcud ces bya ba 'di ni deng dus kyi smra ba'i dbang phyug gtsang bkra shis lhun po'i dkyil khang grwa tshang gi chos gra pa ste tshad ma rig nga/'i slob dpon dka' chen 'gyur med rin po che'i slob bu gtsang stod mdog gzhung du skyes pa rdo rje rgyal por 'bod pas rang lo nyer drug tu son pa'i sa pho stag(1938) lo'i gro bzhin zla ba'i yar tshes la 'jam mgon chos kyi rgyal po blo bzang grags pa'i gdan sa ri bo dga' ldan rnam par rgyal ba'i gling du bris pa'o// //
