133rtags 'jug gi dka' gnad mdor basbus/ dang po/ bya byed tha dad pa dang/ tha mi dad pa'i dbye ba'i skor/spyir na dngos po gang zhig gi thog bya ba gang zhig byung ru nga gang zag gamyosku rgyu rkyen zhig la ma bltos pa mi srid cing / de dag byed pa po yin datho/sa pa las/ rang gis rang la bya ba byed pa mi yong mod/ 'on kyang spyir ldog rags pa'i tha snyad tsam gyi dbang du byas nas phye na bya byed tha dad pa dang bya byed tha mi dad pa zhes gnyis yod pa 'di lta ste/(1) dngos po gang zhig la las ka'am bya ba gang zhig byed pa po gzhan gyis dngos su sgrub par byed pa de ni byed pa po ga'/na dang daros su 'brel ba'i las ka'am bya ba ste/ dper na/ bzo pas brag gong dum bur gtor song zhes brjod pa'i tshe na gtor ba de bya ba yin zhing / de pye rke pa pos dngos su bsgrubs pa'i cha nas gtor bya dang gtor byed (sa/tor rgyu'i brag gong dang gtor mkhan bzo pa'am/ spyir btang ltar na las sam bya cho'adinisngarapecin krung dbyang mi rigs slob grwa che mo dang mi rigs dpe skrun khang du rta gas 'jug gi dka' gnad sbyangs bshad byas pa'i zin bris shig yin/

134 rdo rje rgyal po'i gsung rtsom phyotro/ca4 baspis/ chiri /ba'i yul dang las ka byed mkhan) gnyis su dbye rgyu yod pa lta bu'o//(2) dngos po gang zhig la las ka gang zhig byed pa po gzhan dngos su med par rang gi thog nas byung bar snang ba de ni byed pa po gzhan dang dngos su/ ma 'brel ba'i las ka'am bya ba ste/ dper na/ brag gong dum bur 'thor song zhes brjod pa'i tshe na 'thor ba de bya ba yin zhing / 'thor ba'i gnas skabs der byed pa po gzhan dngos su mi snang ba'i cha nas 'thor bya dang 'thor byed ('thor rgyu'i brag gong dang 'thor bar byed mkhan mi'am /spyir btang ltar na las sam bya ba'i yul dang las ka byed mkhan)gnyis su dbye rgyu med pa lta bu'o//gnyis pa/ bya byed tha mi dad pa'i napre gses skor/bya byed tha mi dad par nang gses rags tsam phye na bsgrub par bya ba'i yul lam las kyi dngos po de dang sgrub pa po de ngo bo gcig yin pa'i bya byed tha mi dad pa dang / bsgrub bya dang sgrub byed tha dad yin rung bya ba de 'grub bzhin pa'i gnas skabs su sgrub pa po gzhan dngos su mi snang ba'i bya byed tha mi dad pa/ bsgrub bya dang sgrub byed tha dad yin la/ sgrub par byed pa'i bya ba sngon du song ba'i 'bras bu grub pa'i bya byed tha mi dad pa/ byed pa po zhig gis dngos su rtsol ba bskyed nas bsgrubs par ma bshad kyang de'i nus pas rang shugs su bya ba zhig grub pa'i bya byed tha mi dad pa/ byed pa po gtan nas mi mngon par bya ba grub pa'i bya byed tha mi dad pa bcas lngatreyod/

rtags 'jug gi dka' gnad mdor bsdus/ 135(1)bsgrub par bya ba'i yul lam las kyi dngos po de dang sgrub pa po de gnyis ngo bo gcig yin pa'i bya byed tha mi dad pa ni/ dper na/ bdag 'gro/ lta bu brjod pa'i tshe 'gro zhes pa de bya tshig yin kyang / 'gro bya dang 'gro byed gnyis ka bdag 'gro ba po rang nyid las 'gro bya logs su med pas 'di 'dra la bdag gzhan gyi dbye ba'ang mi phyed cing bya byed tha mi dad pa zer/ yang bskyar bshad na/ 'gro bya phung po de 'gro ba po rang nyid las gzhan du dbye rgyu med pa'i bya byed tha mi dad pa yin pa lta bu'o//(2) bsgrub bya dang sgrub byed tha dad yin rung bya ba de 'grub bzhin pa'i gnas skabs su sgrub pa po gzhan dngos su mi snang ba'i bya byed tha mi dad pa ni/ dper na/ rdza mkhan gyi 'khor lo 'khor ro/ /lta bu brjod pa'i tshe na 'khor zhes pa de bya tshig yin zhing / dang por skor byed(skor mkhan)gzhan yod kyang / 'khor bzhin pa'i gnas skabs su skor ba po gzhan med par rang nyid ngang gis 'khor ba'i skabs der bya byed tha mi dad pa'i cha nas bskor zhes mi brjod par 'khor zhes zer/ yang bskyar bshad na 'khor ba de bya tshig yin zhing / skabs snga mar skor ba po gzhan yod kyang skabs phyi mar med pa ni bsgrub bya(bskor rgyu'i 'khor lo) dang sgrub byed(skor mkhan mi)tha dad yin rung bya ba de 'grub bzhin pa'i('khor bzhin pa'i)gnas skabs su sgrub pa po gzhan dngos su mi snang ba'i cha nas bya byed tha mi dad pa yin pa lta bu'o//(3)bsgrub bya dang sgrub byed tha dad pa yin la/ sgru ba par byed pa'i bya ba sngon du song ba'i 'bras bu grub pa'i bya byed tha mi dad pa ni/ dper

136 rdo rje rgyal po'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/ na/ khos rgya yig shes kyi yod pa red lta bu brjod pa'i tshe na shes zhes pa de bya tshig yin zhing / shes bya dang shes byed kyang tha dad yin pas dang po bslabs yod kyang / de'i 'bras bu khong du chub zin pa'i gnas skabs su bya byed tha mi dad pa'i cha nas bslabs zhes mi brjod par shes zhes zer/yang bskyar bshad na/ shes zhes pa de bya tshig yin zhing / bsgrub bya(shes par bya rgyu) dang sgrub byed(shes par byed mkhan)tha dad yin la/ skrub par byed pa'i(shes par byed pa'i) bya ba sngon du song ba'i 'bras bu grub pa'i(shes pa'i)bya byed tha mi dad pa yin pa lta bu'o//(4) byed pa pos dngos su rtsol ba bskyed nas bsgrubs par ma bshad kyang / de'i nus pas rang shugs su bya ba zhig grub pa'i bya byed tha mi dad pa ni/ dper na/ krung go'i drag po'i dpung gis dgra bo'i dpung tshogs mtha' dag legs par 'thul song lta bu brjod pa'i tshe na 'thul zhes pa de bya tshig yin zhing / gdul bya dang 'dul byed kyang tha dad pa yin/ 'on kyang tshig zin du btul zhes ma brjod par bya ba'i yul lam las kyi dngos po'i thog grub pa'i bya ba 'thul ba tsam bstan pa'i cha nas 'thul zhes brjod pa tsho yin/ yang bskyar bshad na/ byed pa pos(drag po'i dpung)dngos su rtsol ba bskyed nas bsgrubs par(dgra bo btul bar)ma bshad kyang / de'i nus pas bya ba zhig grub pa'i(dgra bo 'thul ba'i)bya byed tha mi dad pa yin pa lta bu'o// (5) byed pa po gtan nanu/ med par bya ba grub pa'i bya byed tha mi dad pa ni/ dper na/ sa nas rtswa skyes/ gnam nas char bab lta bu brjod

rtags 'jug gi dka' gnad mdor bsdus/ 131—pa'i tshe na skyes pa dang bab pa zhes pa de gnyis bya tshig yin rung / de mi/rtsoganaca/ sa'i 'byung ba rang nyid kyi byed pas bskyed pa las byed pa po 'dis byas zhes bshad du med pa ni byed pa po gtan nas med par bya ba grub pa'i tshobya byed tha mi dad pa yin pa lta bu'o/ /gong gsal bya byed tha mi dad pa nang gses mi 'dra ba lnga gang zhig yin rung bya ba sgrub pa po dngos po bdag dang / bsgrub bya'i dngos po gzhan zhes gnyis su dbye rgyu med cing / de bzhin byed pa po dang 'brel ba'i byed las dang bya ba'i yul dang 'brel ba'i bya las zhes pa'ang dbye rgyu med do//gsum pa/ bya byed tha dad pa'i nang gses skor/bya byed tha dad par nang gses phye na dngos po bdag gzhan gnyis dang / bya byed las gsum bcas su dbye rgyu yod/(1) dngos po bdag gzhan gnyis zhes pa ni/ las ka'am bya brdzogang zhig yin rung byed pa po gzhan dang dngos su 'brel ba'i dbang du byas nas byed pa po'i dngos po de nyid dang / de'i byed las dang bcas pa la ni bdag ces bya zhing / yang bskyar bshad na las ka gang zhig yin rung byid pa po mi de dang / byed pa'am byed pa po phal pa lag cha/ byed las bcas ni bdag byed pa po'i dngos po yin/ dper na/ mda' 'phen pa'i tshe na 'phen pa po mi(byed pa po) de dang 'phen byed kyi gzhu(byed pa'am byed pa po phal pa) mda' ltong sprad nas 'phen par byed (byed las〉lta bu bcas la dngos po bdag ces bya'o//

138 rdo rje rgyal po'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/(2) las ka'am bya ba gang zhig yin rung byed pa po gzhan dang dngos su 'brel ba'i dbang du byas nas byed pa po des bsgrub par bya ba'i yul gyi dngos po dang / de dang 'brel ba'i bya las dang bcas pa la ni dngos po gzhan zhes bya zhing / yang bskyar bshad na/ las ka gang zhig yin rung byed pa po des bsgrub par bya ba'i yul gyi dngos po'am/ bsgrub bya'am / bsgrub par bya ba'am las dang / de dang 'brel ba'i bya las dang bcas ni gzhan bya ba'i yul gyi dngos po yin/ dper na/ mda' 'phen pa'i tshe na 'phang bya'i mda'(bsgrub par bya ba'am bya ba'i yul las)de dang / de dang 'brel ba'i bya ba 'phang bar bya(bya las)lta bu gnyis la dngos po gzhan zhes bya'o//bzhi pa/ bya byed las gsum zhes pa'i skor/(1) las ka'am bya ba gang zhig yin rung byed pa po gzhan dang dngos su 'brel ba'i dbang du byas nas bya ba bsgrub par bya ba'i yul lam bskub bya de la las zhes zer/ dper na/ 'phang bya'am/ 'phang bya'i mda' lta bu'o/ /(2) las ka'am bya ba gang zhig yin rung byed pa po gzhan dang dngos su 'brel ba'i dbang du byas nas bya ba byed mkhan byed pa po de dang /byed pa bcas la byed pa zhes zer/ dper na/ 'phen pa po mi dang 'phen byed kyi gzhu lta bu'o/ /(3) las ka'am bya ba gang zhig yin rung byed pa po gzhan dang

da wa rtagasa'ajug gi dka' gnad mdor bsdurta / 139dngos su 'brel ba'i dbang du byas nas bya ba byas zin 'dabasdo pa dang /byed pa po dang 'brel ba'i byed las/ bya ba'i yul dang 'brel ba'i bya las bcas la gi ba zhes zer/ dper na mda' 'phangs so lta bu bya byed las gsum cha tshang ba'i bya ba byas zin 'das pa dang / 'phen par byed lta bu byed las byed pa po'i thog yod pa dang / mda' 'phang bar bya lta bu bya las bya ba'i yul lam las kyi thog yod pa lta bu yin cing / mda' 'phangs pa ltar 'gro ba'i las de'ang bya ba'i yul lam las kyi dngos po de'i thog yod pa de'ang bya ba'i nang du 'du'o/ /de dag mdor bsdus nas jod skabs—/ bya byed las gsum zhes zer/lnga pa/ dus gsum gyi dbye ba'i skor/dus gsum gyi dbye ba bya byed tha dad pa dang / bya byed tha mi dad pa gnyis/ kar yod/ bya ba byas zin pa thams cad 'das tha dang / bya ba byedartsobazhin pa thams cad da lta ba dang / bya ba bya rgyu thams cad ma 'ongs pardzobacas te/ dper na/ mda' 'phangs so lta bu 'das pa dang / mda' 'phen gyi 'dug lta bu da lta ba/ mda' 'phang rgyu lta bu ma 'ongs pa/ mda' pongs shig lta bu skul tshig byed las ma 'ongs pa bcas bya byed tha dad pa dang / nyi ma shar song lta bu 'das pa dang / nyi ma 'char gyi 'dug lta bu da lta ba/ nyi ma 'char rgyu red lta bu ma 'ongs pa/ nyi ma 'char bar gyur cig lta bu skul tshig dang phyogs 'dra ba'i smon chig byed las ma 'ongs rtsopa bcas bya byed tha mi dad pa lta bu'o/ /de'ang zhib tu phye na dus gsum

140 rdo rje rgyal po'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/dus dgur dbye rgyu yod ces/ bshad srol 'dug kyang / rang nyid kyi bsam par 'das pa'i bya ba zhig da lta bajod pa'i tshe na 'das dang ma 'ongs da lta gsum gyi tshig 'jug pa dang / de bzhin ma 'ongs pa'i bya ba zhig da lta brjod pa'i tshe na'ang 'das ma 'ongs da lta gsum ga'i tshig 'jug pa ni nges par du yod mod/ da lta bar da lta ba'i tshig kho na ma gtogs 'jug thabs ba/tan nas med/ de skor dgos pa byung na dper brjod dang bcas zur du 'god rgyu las da lam 'dir bkod med/drug pa/ dngos po bdag gzhan gnyis dang / bya byed las gsum/ dus gsum/ skul tshig bcas gzhi gcig gi thog dper brjod pa'i skor/(1) dper na/ ltad mo bltas pa zhig la cha mtshon na/ ltad mo lta mkhan gyi mi ni byed pa po gtso bo dang / lta byed kyi(lta yaṭasdo kyi)mig ni byed pa po phal pa yin zhing / de gnyis ka dngos po bdag gzhan sa/nyis kyi nang nas bdag dang / bya byed las gre/sum gyi nang nas byed pa yin la/dus pa ska/sum gyi nang nas da lta bar gtogs so/ /lta bar byed lta bu byed pa po dang 'brel bablu byed las gsal byed kyi sgra ni dngos po bdag gzhan gnyis kyi nang nas bdag dang / bya byed las gsum gyi nang nas bya ba yin la/ dus gsum gyi nang nas da lta bar gtogs so/ /blta rgyu'i ltad mo ni las sam/ blta bya'am/ blta bar bya ba de yin zhing / de ni

rtags 'jug gi dka' gnad mdor bsdus/ 141dngos po bdag gzhan gnyis kyi nang tsha/sa gzhan dang / bya byed khari/sa gsum gyi nang nas las yin la/ dus gsum gyi nang nas ma 'ongs par gtos/sa so/ /blta bar bya lta bu bya ba'i yul dang 'brel ba'i bya las gas /la byed kyi sgra ni dngos po bdag gzhan gnyis kyi nang nas gzhan dang / bya byed las gsum gyi nang nas bya ba yin la/ dus gsum gyi nang nas ma 'ongs par gtogs so/ /bltas pa yin lta bu bya byed las gsum cha tshang ba'i bya ba byas zin 'das pa ston pa 'di ni dus gsum nang nas 'das pa yin pa smonu/ ci dgos/ dngos po bdag gzhan gang rung dang / bya byed las gsum gyi nang nas bya bar gtogs so/ /ltos shig lta bu skul chi ge ni byed pa po skul byed kyi tshig yin pas byed las su gtogs shing / dngos po bdag gzhan gyi nang nas bdag dang / bya byed las gsum gyi nang nas bya ba yin la/ dus gsum gyi nang nas ma 'ongs par gtogs so//(2) yang dper na/ mi zhig gis bya ba bsgrubs par cha mtshon na/bya ba sgrub mkhan gyi mi ni byed pa po gtso bo dang / bya ba sgrub byed kyi(sgrub yas kyi) thabs ni byed pa po phal ba yin zhing / de gnyis ka dngos po bdag grezhan gnyis kyi nang nas bdag dang / bya byed las gsum gyi nang nas byed pa yin la/ dus gsum gyi nang nas da lta bar gtogs so/ /skub par byed lta bu byed pa po dang 'brel ba'i byed las gsal byed kyi sgra ni dngos po bdag gzhan gnyis kyi nang nas bdag dang / bya byed las gsum gyi nang nas bya ba yin la/ dus gsum gyi nang nas da lta bar gtogs so/ /bskub rgyu'i bya ba ni las sam/ bsgrub bya'am/ bsgrub

142 rdo rje rgyal po'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/par bya ba de yin zhing / de ni dngos po bdag gzhan gnyis kyi nang naru/ gzhan dang / bya byed las gsum gyi nang nas las yin la/ dus sa/sum gyi nang nas ma 'ongs par gtogs so/ /bsgrub par bya lta bu bya ba'i yul dang 'brel ba'i bya las gsal byed kyi sgra ni dngos po bdag gzhan rsha gnyis kyi nang nas gzhan dang / bya byed las gsum gyi nang nas bya ba yin la/ dus gsum gyi nang nas ma 'ongs par gtogs so/ /basprubs pa yin lta bu bya byed las gsum cha tshang ba'i bya ba byas zin 'das pa ston pa 'di ni dus gsum gyi nang nas 'das pa yin pa smos ci dgos/ dadzas po bdag gzhan gang rung dang / bya byed las gsum gyi nang nas bya bar gtogs so/ /sgrubs/ shig lta bu skul tshig ni byed pa po skul byed kyi tshig yin pas byed las su gtogs shing dngos po bdag gzhan gnyiru/ kyi nang nas bdag dang / bya byed las gsum nang nas bya ba yin la/ dus gsum gyi nang nas ma 'ongs par gtogs so//(3) yang dper na/ mi zhig si/sa yi ge 'bri bar cha mtshon ma// yi ge 'bri mkhan gyi mi ni byed pa po gtso bo dang / 'bri byed kyi('bri yas kyi)smyu gu ni byed pa po phal pa yin zhing / de gnyis ka dngos po bdag gzhan gnyis kyi nang nas bdag dang / bya byed las gsum gyi nang nas byed pa dang / dus gsum gyi nang nas da lta bar gtogs so/ /'bri bar byed lta bu byed pa po dang 'brel ba'i byed las gsal byed kyi sgra ni dngos po bdag gzhan gnyis kyi nang nas bdag dang / bya byed las gre/sum gyi nang nas bya ba yin la/ dus gsum gyi nang nas da lta bar gtogs so/ /

rtags 'jug gi dka' gnad mdar bsdus/ 143'bri rgyu'i yi ge ni las sam/ 'bri bya'am/ 'bri bar bya ba de yin zhing /de ni dngos/ po bdag gzhan gnyis kyi nang nas gzhan dang / bya byed las gsum gyi nang nas las yin la/ dus gsum gyi nang nas ma 'ongs par gtogs so/ /'bri bar bya lta bu bya ba'i yul dang 'brel ba'i bya las gsal byed kyi sgra ni dngos po bdag gzhan gnyis kyi nang nas gzhan dang /bya byed las gsum gyi nang nas bya ba yin la/ dus gsum gyi nang nas ma 'ongs par gtogs so/ /bris pa yin lta bu bya byed las gsum cha tshang ba'i bya ba byas zin 'das pa sgron pa 'di ni dus gsum gyi nang nas 'das pa yin pa smos ci dgos/ dngos po bdag gzhan gnyis gang rung dang / bya byed las gsum gyi nang nas bya bar gtogs so/ /bris zhig lta bu skul tshig ni byed pa po skul byed kyi tshig yin pas byed las su gtogs shing / dngos po bdag gzhan gnyis kyi nang nas bdag dang /bya byed las gsum gyi nang nas bya ba yin la/ dus gsum gyi nang nas ma 'ongs par gtogs so//bdun pa/ zhar byung du skabs thob kyi 'dri tshul skor/gong gsal de dag ni byed pa po gzhan dang dngos su 'brel ba'i bya ba zhig gis dbang du byas nas byed pa po dang / byed pa po phal pa (byed pa)/byed las/ bya ba'i yul gyi dngos po'am las dang / de dang 'brel ba'i bya las skul tshig bcas cha tshang ba zhig bkod pa yin zhing / byed pa po

144 rdo rje rgyal po'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/gzhan dang dngos su 'brel ba'i bya ba zhig yin phyin brjod tshul de dag gi nang du ma 'dus pa gtan nas med/ bya ba thams cad la byed pa po gtso phal gnyis ka dgos pas ma khyab par brten skabs re byed pa po dang byed pa gnyis ka dgos pa'ang yod/ dper na/ ngas smyu gus bris lta bu dang /skabs re byed pa po ma gtogs byed pa po phal pa mi dgos pa'ang yod/dper na/ ngas bris lta bu/ skabs re byed pa po shugs bstan du bzhag ste byed pa po phal pa ma gtogs mi dgos pa'ang yod/ dper na/ 'di sgyu snyegus bris pa red lta bu'o// //

145sum rtags skor gyi dri ba dris lan/ cho'adir bod kyi brda sprod pa'i rig gnas sum rtags skor la mi rigs dpe skrun khang gi bod yig rtsom sgyur khang gi blo mthun 'ga' zhig gis dogs gcod dri ba bton pa dang / de dag so sor kho bos rang nyid kyi 'dod tshul ltar gyi dris lan re lhan thabs su bkod par/1 dri ba/ rtags 'jug gi bya byid las gsum gyi nang tshan byed pa po dang byed pa dang / bya ba'i yul lam las/ de'i bya ba zhes brjod pa'i byed las da lta ba/ dper na/ slob sbyong byed kyi yod/ las ka byed mus yin lta bu dang / byed las ma 'ongs pa dper na slob sbyong byed rgyu/ las ka byed dgos lta bu ngos 'dzin sla yang / bya las ma 'ongs pa rtags 'jug gi dper brjod thog ma gtogs rang re'i yig sgyur gyi brjod bya'i don dngos dang 'brel ba'i dpe zhig mi gsal ba de dper brjod dang bcas pa zhig gsung rogs gnang /lan/ dri don 'di'i gnad gsal po zhig mi 'dug kyang / bya byed las gsuyozhes pa de rtags 'jug gi gzhung don snying po yin pas gal chen lkortsom yig 'di ni spyi lo 1986lor rtsom pa pos mi rigs dpe skrun khang du bod yig zhu chen pa'i 'gan bzhes gnang skabs blo mthun 'ga' zhig gis sum rtags skor gyi dkal nand kha shas khong la dri ba zhus pa'i lan du gsungs pa'i zin bris yin/

146 rdo rje rgyal po'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/po red/ da res kyi dris lan 'dir bya byed las gsum gyi dbye tshul spyir btang ba de gsal tsam brjod na khyed kyi dogs pa de'ang chod las che snyam/de bshad na/ bya byed las gsum zhes par dbye skabs kyi bya zhes pa ni bya ba yin zhing / bya byā de'i nang du shing 'di bdag gis gcod par byed do lta bu byed pa po'i mi0nga la byed sgra sbyar nas bya ba rshakodaX pa ni dmed shā po ༷dngaX 'brel ba'i byed las zhes pa de'o/ /de'ang bdag gis bcad do/ /bdag gis bcad zin lta bu byed las 'das pa dang / bdag gis rjes su gcod par byed do/ /bdag gis gcod par 'gyur lta bu byed las ma 'ongs pa dang /bdag gis gcod bzhin pa yin/ bdag gis gcod kyi yod lta bu byed las da lta ba yin pa bcas dus gsum gar 'jug pa dang / shi0nga gasdud pand+ra gi lta bu gcad bya'i shing dang 'brel nas bya ba bkod pa ni bya ba'i yul lam las dang 'brel ba'i bya las ces pa ste/ de'ang shing bcad do/ /bcad zin lta bu bya las 'dari shrī pa dang / shing gcad rgyu yin/ gcad par bya'o lta bu bya las ma 'ongs pa yin pas 'das ma 'ongs dus gnyis la 'jug pa bcas kyi bya ba de dag tshang ma 'dus pa de dang gcig byed ces pa de'i nang du rgecoXd pa po ste byed pa po de dang / byed pa'am byedzwa pa po phal pa ste sta re sogs laXg ༷ de ༷gnyiXs ༷'dus pa de dang gnyis/ lasdu zhes pa ni bya ba'i yul lam las te gartad byā'i ༷nga de dang gsum bcas yim/ la/ des na shing mkhan gyis/ sta res shing bcad do lta bu ni bya byed las gsum cha tshang ba'i tshig ril po zhig ge//

sum rtags skor gyi dri ba dris lan/ 147yang dngos po bdag gzhan zhes par gnyis dbye skabs su byed pa po dang / byed pā'am byed pa po phal pa/ byed pa po dang 'brel ba'e rnoshaṃ ༷sa gong gsal dus gsum ga bya ba skul byed kyi smrul tshiskya bcas dngos po bdag gi khongs su 'dus zhing / bya ba'i yul lam las te gcad byā'i shing de dang / bya ba'i yul dang 'brel ba'i bya las ma 'ongasaX pa ṅgeng gaXcad sngur byā'o lta bu dang / 'das pa shid bsdud dī lta bu bcas dngos po gzhan gyi khongs su 'du'o//yang dus gsum gyi dbang du btang nas dbye skabs shī ༷'i yus ༷ma las dang / ri gī ldus gnyis te dngos po gzhan rnams ma 'ongs ba dang gaXcig bye5 ༷ sdo dang / byedwa pa'am byed pya sdo phaXl sdu/ byed pa po dang 'brel ba'i byed lhas bcas te dngos po bdag rnams da lta ba dang gnyis/bya byed las gsum cha tshang ste bya ba byas zin 'das pa dang gsum bcas su 'du'o/ /de ltar du 'du ba'i rgyu mtshan ni shing gcod par cha mtshon na dngos po gzhan la 'jug pa'i gcad dang ma 'ongs pa'i gcad gnyis yi ge gcig pa dang / dngos po bdag la 'jug pa'i gcod dang da lta ba'i gcod gnyis yi ge gcig pa/ 'das tshig bcad ces pa bdag gzhan mthun par 'jug pas so/ /de rnams ngos 'dzin ma 'khrul ba dang nges po byung na gong gsal dogs gnas kyi mtha' chod nges yin/deng skabs kyi bsgyur yig nang du bya las ma 'ongs pa gsal min bsgyur yig la zhib 'jug byas pa'i gnas tshul ni/ ‘‘mi dmangs nang khul gyi 'as/la ba rnams thag gcod yang dag par byed(bya)rgyu'i gnad don skor’’khya/sa pa

148 rdo rje rgyal po'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/dang / ‘‘gcig gyur gyi 'char 'god dang phyogs yongs la lta rtog byed(bya)dgos pari’ zhes dang / ‘‘bkod sgrig 'os 'tshams shig byed(bya)dgos pa ’zhes pa rnams bya ba'i yul lam las la 'brel ba'i bya las ma 'ongs pa yin pas rtags 'jug gi 'jug tshul dam por bzung na thag gcod yang dag par bya rgyu/ lta tog bya dgos zhes sbyar dgos shing don yang de ltar yin mod kyang / de ltar zhib cha ma thon par phal skad ltar byed rgyu dang byed dgos zhes byed las da lta ba sbyar 'dug cing / de ltar sbyar bas bya las dang byed las nor ba skyon yin pa smos ma dgos kyang / rtsa ba'i go don phyin ci log pa'am go brda mi 'phrod pa'i skyon tshabs che ba zhig ni ma red snyam/2 dri ba/ gang zhig la byed las dang / gang zhig la bya las zer/de ltar dbye ba 'byed dgos don gang yin/lan/ dper na/ rtsa khrims gsar pa de bkra shis kyis sgyur gyi yod ces sam/ bsgyur pa red lta bu sgyur pa po bkra shis kyi ming dang 'brel nas bya ba sgyur gyi yod ces sam/ bsgyur pa red ces bya ba brjod pa de rigs la byed las zer/ rtsa khrims gsar pa de bsgyur rgyu red ces sam/ bsgyur dgos zhes bya ba'i yul lam las bsgyur bya rtsa khrims kyi ming dang 'brel nas bsgyur zhes sam/ bsgyur bgos/ zhes bya ba brjod pa de lta bu la bya las zer/de ltar dbye ba 'byed dgos don ni/ bkra shis byed pa po yul can dang 'brel ba'i bya ba dang / rtsa khrims bsgyur bya yul lam las dang 'brel ba gnyis kyi khyad par gsal por mtshon pa'i ched du'o//

sum rtags skor gyi dri ba dris lan/ 14903 dri ba/ rtags 'jug tu byed pa po dang / byed pa/ byed las rnams dngos po bdag yin la/ las dngos dang / bya las gnyis dngos po gzhan du 'jog pa yin zhes bshad yod cing / de ltar bdag gzhan gyi dbye ba 'byed dgos don gang yin/ dbye 'byed ma thub na skyon gang zhig yong rgyu red/lan/ bya ba gang zhig yin rung byed mkhan zhig dang / bya rgyu zhig yod cing / de gnyis ngos 'dzin nam dbye 'byed ma shes na 'chad nyan nam bya ba byed skabs brda don 'phrod pa zhig yong gi ma red/ der brten byed pa po la dngos po bdag ces pa'i tha snyad bzhag thog byed pa'am byed pa po phal pa dang / byed pa po dang 'brel ba'i byed las rnams kyang bad ga gi khongs su bzhag bya rgyu'i las bya ba'i yul lam las der dngos po gzhan zhes pa'i tha snyad bzhag thog bya rgyu'i las bya ba'i yul lam las dang 'brel ba'i bya las rnams kyang gzhan gyi khongs su bzhag cing / de ltar du ngos bzung nas bkra shis kyis rang gi nus par brten nas rtsa khrims sgyur bar byed do'am sgyur gyi 'dug lta bu bdag gzhan gyi sbyor tshul rnam gzhag dang mthun zhing don dngos dang brjod tshig gang thad nas gsal po yin pa rnams gnad cher mi mthong yang / sbyor tshul de las sdog ste bkra shis kyis rtsa khrims sgyur yas kyi dpe cha zhig 'khyer 'dug ces brjod na/ ‘‘sgyur yas kyi dpe cha ’zhes pa de rtsa khrims sgyur byed kyi‘‘lag cha'am dpyad gzhi'i dpe cha’’zhig yin nam/ bsgyur rgyu'am bsgyur bya rtsa khrims kyi‘‘ma yig dpe cha’’zhig 4 na ngos 'dzin dka' ba'am gang yin mi shes pas go don log

150 rdo rje rgyal po'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/pa'am mi rtogs pa'i skyon yong zhing / bkra shis kyis bsgyur bya rtsa khrims kyi dpe cha zhig khyer 'dug ces brjod na bya ba'i yul lam las de gsal por go nus shing / rtsa khrims sgyur byed kyi dpe cha zhig khyer 'dug ces brjod na sgyur byed kyi lag cha tshig mdzod dam dpyad gzhi zhig yin pa gsal po go ste 'khrul ba'am go don log pa mi 'byung ngo //4༷ dri ba/ rtags 'jug gi bya ba'i yul lam las zhes pa'i yul dang / sum cu pa'i skabs kyi ri mgor shing 'thu zhes pa lta bu'i yul gnyis kyi khyad par dang / la las rtags 'jug tu bshad pa'i yul lam las zhes pa der las rang las yul gtan nas zer mi rung zhes bshad pa gang yin/lan/ gnad don 'dir 'grel bshad byed pa'i ched du dper brjod cig 'god par bya ste/ ngas grogs por snying gtam bshad ces par cha mtshon na/ nga ni byed pa po red/ des bya ba byed sa'i yul grogs po la bya ba snying gtam bshad pa zhig bstan pa red/ des na/ grogs po de sum cu pa'i rnam dbye gnyis pa las su bya ba'i yul yin pas de la grogs por zhes la don gyi sgra sbyar dgos/ snying gtam ni bshad bya'am las de red/ de rtags 'jug gi bya ba'i yul lam las zhes pa de yin pas snying gtam la la don mi thob pas snyid sa/tam bshad ces brjod dgos/de la la don sbyar na sum rtags kyi rigapa'i gzhung lugs lta ci/ skad cha'ang mi shes pa'i blun rtags su 'gyur ro/ /yul zhes pa de'i go don yang skabs thob kyi dbang gis mi 'dra'o/ /la las rtags 'jug tu bshad pa'i yul lam las zer ba der las

sum rtags skor gyi dri ba dris lan/ 151dang yul zhes gtan nas zer mi rung zhes bshad pa de'i thad ni/ bya byed las gsum bshad pa'i skabs su las rang ma gtogs yul zhes brjod med par brten las kho na brjod pas kyang 'thus mod/ 'on kyang las zhes pa ni las ka'am bya ba la'ang 'jug pas gal srid bya bar 'khrul na de'ang mi rung bar brten mkhas pa snga ma mang pos‘‘yul ’zhes pa rkyang rkyang brjod na sum cu pa'i bya ba'i yul la 'khrul dogs dang‘‘lasari’zhes rkyang rkyang brjod na bya ba la 'khrul dogs kyis bya ba'i yul lam las zhes bkral ba ltar bzung na nges pa gsal ba yong rgyu las skyon ci yod/ lhag par du tshad ma rig pa'i yul dang yul can dbye tshul ltar na yul zhes zer dgos/ 'on kyang‘‘yul’’zhes pa dang‘‘lasami’zhes pa 'di gnyis kar skabs thob kyi go don dbye 'byed shes pa dang yid la nges pa zhig dgos/5 dri ba/ la don thob min gyi gnad don zhig yod pa dper na/khong bsam 'char shod du 'jug khong la bsam 'char shod du 'jug sgrog rtse phyis/ sgrog rtse la phyis/ mi dmangs dgrar 'dzin/ mi dmangs la dgrar 'dzin/ ri mthon po mgo sgur du bcug chu chen po lam gzur du bcugaces pa rnams la la sgra thob bam mi thob/lan/ 'di skor thog mar gnad don 'di 'dra zhig rtogs dgos pa ste/ shod du 'jug ces pa'i la don du sgra 'di rnam dbyedwa gnyis pa'i nang tshan de nyid ston pa'i sgra yin pas tshig 'di las dang bya ba ngo bo gcig pa'i bya ba ston pa'i tshig cig dang / bsam 'char ni bya ba'i rang bzhin yin

152 rdo rje rgyal po'i gsung rtsom sbyogane bsgrigs/pas‘‘bsam 'char shod du 'jug’’ces pa'i tshig 'di rang bya byed las gsum gyi nang tshan bya ba dang / khong ni bya ba'i yul lam las yin/ dper na shing gcod lta bu'i shing de bya ba'i yul lam las dang / gcod bya ba yin pa de gnyis kyi bar la la don gyi sgra mi dgos pa ltar khong bsam 'char shod—du 'jug ces pa'i khor bya ba'i yul lam las de dang / bsam 'char shod du 'jug pa bya ba gnyis kyi bar la'ang la don gyi sgra dgos don med la/skad cha'i tshig la'ang mi 'gro bas gong gsal dper brjod khong bsam —'char shod du 'jug ces pa dang / ri mthon po mgo bo sgur du bcug ces pa/ chu chen po lam gzur du bcug ces pa/ sgrog rtse phyis zhes pa/ mi dmangs dgrar 'dzin zhes pa bcas kyi rigs mtha' dag la la don gyi sgra llegatan nas sbyar mi rung / gal te la don gyi sgra sbyar te khong la bsaga'achar shod du 'jug ceṭwāṃ ska bris na khong bsam 'char shod du 'jug(gzhug)bya de bsam 'char shod sar 'gyur ba dang / ri mthon po mgo bo sgur du 'jug bya de mgo bo sgur sar 'gyur ba dang / chu chen po lam gzur du 'jug bya de lam gzur sar 'gyur ba dang / sgrog rtse dbyi bya de dbyi sar 'gyur hodang / mi dmangs dgrar gzung bya de 'dzin sa'am 'dzin yul du 'gyurob bcas rtags 'jug skabs kyi bya ba'i yul lam las zhes pa dang / sum cu pa'i skabs kyi rnam dbye gnyis pa las su bya ba'i yul gnyis 'khrul nas lcemago rnyog bzo nges yi na pa da dung gsham du gsal por bshad par bya'o//6 dri ba/ khong khong la bsam 'char shod du 'jug las ka de khong

sum rtags skor gyi dri ba dris lan/ 153la byed du 'jug(kha skad la kho'o zer ba de la don yod pa'i rtags min nam)ces pa 'di lta bu la ji ltar bya dgos sam/lan/ khyed kyi 'dri tshig dper brjod 'di dbye zhib byed sa yag po zhig 'dug las ka de khong la byed du 'jug ces pa 'dir la don mi 'jug pa gong du bshad zin par ma zad/ khyed kyi dper brjod‘‘khong khong la bsam 'char shod du 'jug’’ces pa'iri tshig 'di'i nang gi‘‘bsam 'char shod du 'jug’’ces pa de gong du gsal bsha da byas pa ltar bya ba yin /ning /khong snga ma 'di shod du 'jug bya'i mi de ste/ rtags 'jug gi bya ba'i yul lam las zhes pa de yin pas de la la don gyi sgra mi 'jug la/ khong phyi ma — 'di bsam 'char shod sa ste/ sum cu pa'i rnam dbye gnyis pa las su bya ba'i yul de yin pas la don sbyar dgos shing / khyed kyi dper brjod 'dir yang khong la zhes la don sbyar yod pa ni 'grig pa red/ nges par du 'di lta bu zhig sbyar dgos shing / rtsa don de gzhir bzung na gong gi bakhrod tshul go bslog ste khong la khong bsam 'char shod du 'jug ceṭa/ raspo/ / da kyang do na ston tshul rang sor gnas thub la/ gal te de ltar ma yin par rtags 'jug gi bya ba'i yul lam las khong snga ma dang / sum cu pa'i rnam dbye gnyis pa las su bya ba'i yul khong phyi ma gnyis kar la don gyi sgra re spyar te‘‘khong la khong la bsam 'char shod du 'jugari’ces brdzod na ci zer 'di zer med pa zhig tu 'gyur bas 'di'i thad la bod kyi skad rdzidang / brda sprod pa'i rig pa'i gzhung lugs/ dngos su grub pa'i tshig sbyor bcas myo/ kun nas brtag zhib dang lag len ma nor ba dgos so/ /yang phal skad la

154 rdo rje rgyal po'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/kho'o zer ba de la don yod pa'i rtags red/ 'on kyang kho'o zer ba de ga 'dra zhig brjod pa'i skabs la zer der brtag dpyad mdzad 'tshal/7 dri ba/ byed pa po dang byed pa la byed pa po gtso phal gnyis zhesatshopa der la las byed pa po dang byed pa ma gtogs/ byed pa la byed pa po phal pa zer mi rung zer ba de ga 'dra yin nam/ lan/ dper na shing mkhan gyis sta res shing bcad ces par cha mtshon na shing mkhan ni byed pa po dang sta re ni byed pa'o zhes tsam bshad nas bzhag kyang chog mod/ 'on kyang 'dir bya ba shing bcad pa zhig la shing mkhan dang sta re gnyis kar byed sgra sbyar dgos don ci yin snyam pa yong srid/de'i gnad ni shing gcod pa po shing mkhan med na shing gcod pa'i bya ba yong mi srid pas byed pa po shing mkhan la byed sgra nges par du sbyar dgos la/ 'on kyang lag cha sta re med par shing mkhan kho nas shing dum bur gcod mi thub pas sta re des gcod dgos par brten gcod byed sta re la'ang byed sgra sbyar dgos byung ba red/ 'o na gcod mkhan dang gcod byed gnyis la khyad par ga re yod ce na/ gcod mkhan mi de byed pa po dngos yin pas gtso bo dang /sta re de gcod pa'i cha rkyen tsam yin pas gal che chung gi dbang gis phal par gyur pas de ltar du byed pa po gtso phal zhes brjod pa la 'gal ba'am skyon ci yod de/ skyon med par ma zad nges shes skyed par phan pa zhig go//8 dri ba/ bdag sgra'i skor la dngul chu yab sras kyis pa ba ma bdag sgra

sum rtags skor gyi dri ba dris lan/ 155yin zhes gsungs kyang / smra sgo mtshon cha dang si tu paṇa chen gyi bzhed si ltar na pa dang ma gnyis ma gtoṭa ba bdag sgra min zhes bshad pa de gang yin nam/lan/ 'di'i thad sum cu pa'i rtsa bar/ gang ming gi ni ma mtha' na/ /pu liṅga yi sgra med pa/ /de la pu liṅga sbyar na/ /bdag po'i sar ni shes par bya/ /zhes pa'i 'grel pa'i nang du dngul chu ba yab sras sogs kyi bzhed par‘‘pu zhes pa sde dang / liṅga zhes pa rtags te/ pa sde nas byung ba'i pho rtags pa dang / mo rtags ma/ ma ning gi rtags ba gsum gyi sgra sngar med pa de la gsar du pu liṅga'i sgra gsum po gang rung sbyar na de ni bdag po'i don gsal par byed pa'i ṭargar ni shes par bya'o’’zhes gsung thog dbyangs can grub pa'i rno rjes‘‘nga 'a ra la mtha' med la/ /bdag sgra yar gyur ba dang ni/ /cha la pa nyid sbyor ba legs’’zhes gsal bshad mdzad cing / lag len du bstar bar ma zad/ po bo mo gsum yang sbyor bar bzhed 'dug pa de ltar don dngos dang yang mthun par mthong bas kho bo ni de'i rjes 'brangs pa yin/ si tu pan chen gyis‘‘pu liṅgari sgra ni bdag po'i don ston par byed pa'i pa dang po gnyis yin’’zhes gsungs 'dug pa ltar na bdag sgra ma dang mo yang 'jog thabs med kyang / gsham du bod yul du grags pa'i tha snyad ltar byed pa po de skyes par mtshon byed du pa dang po gnyis dang / byed pa po de bud med du mtshon byed du ma dang mo gnyis bzhed cing dper brjod kyang mdzad pa las/ ba dang bo gnyis bdag sgrar mi 'jug ces dgag pa'ang mdzad pa 'di'ang ma dag pa'am nor ba red ceṭa/ mtha' gcig tu brjod dka' 'o/ /de gang yin zhe na/

156 rdorjergyalapo'igasungartsom༈gsabasgrigs/ba dang bo bdag sgrar bzhed pa rnams kyi dper brjod du ba sgra 'jug tshul tsam las/ bo sgra 'jug tshul dper ba rjo da nge sa gsal nyung zhing / rang nyid kyis dbus gtsang gi skad dang / dpe cha tshad ldan rnams la brtag dpyad byas par bo sgra bdag po'i don ston pa zhig ches dkon pas bo sgra bdag sgrar 'jug nges kyi khas len bya rgyu'ang dka' tsam zhig go//yang zhar byung du bshad par bya ba zhig ni/ sngar gyi yig cha khungs dag rnams su bdag sgra zhing pa dang / bzo pa/ rong pa/ shar pa/ 'grul pa/ byed pa po/ gtong ba po/ spyang po/ rgyal po rnams la deng sang 'i/nga ba dang / bzo ba/ rong ba/ shar ba/ 'grul ba/ byed pa bo/spyang bo/ rgyal bo sogs dang / sngar gyi ming mtha' rkang pa dang / khang pa/ stong pa/ bzang po/ 'byung po/ khur po/ ril po/ mang po zhes pa rnams la rkang ba dang / khang ba/ stong ba/ bzang bo/ 'byung bo/khur bo/ ril bo/ mang bo/ rgyal bo sogs ji snyed cig yong 'dug pa 'di dag yul skad kyi shugs las byung bar gor ma chag kyang bod yig gi gcig gyur thad la 'gal rkyen dang / lhag par du sngar gyi yig srol thad la gtor skyon yo nga nges shig yin pas/ pa yig gi klog tshul yul so so'i sgra gdangs mi gcig pa ji ltar klog kyang / yig gzugs gcig gyur byung na ci ma rung snyam pa zhig 'dug pa 'di dag la tshang mas brtag zhib yod par 'tshal/9 dri ba/ bya byed tha mi dad pa'i skor la thag mi chod pa 'ga' re 'dug dper na/ 1 mi la re ba byas pa las/ /rang gis lab/ pa

sum rtags skor gyi dri ba dris lan/ 157bsgul na dga'/ /zhes par bsgul dang 'gul gnyis gang sbyar ba legs/2 de dang lag pa brkyangs/ kha gdangs lta bu dang / gdan la bzhu gas lta bu de dag la khyad par gang yod/lan/ mi la re ba byas pa las/ /rang gis lag pa bsgul na dga'/ /zhes par rang la byed sgra sbyar yod pas lag pa bsgul byar gyur yod stabs/ bya byed tha dad kyi dbang du btang nas bsgul zhes sngu/ra na legs/ 'on kyang tshig 'di'i go don de ba/zhan gyi rogs ram la brten pa las rang gi nus par brten pa lag pa zhig go ba'i ched du byasdo/ na/ go/zhan la re ba byas pa las/ / rang gi lag pa 'gul na dga'/ /zhes rang gi zhes yan lag dang yan lag can gyi 'brel sgra spyar zhing / lag pa 'gul ba de bya byed tha mi dad pa'i dbang du btang nas 'gul zhes sbyar kyang thus/lag pa brkyangs/ kha gdangs/ gnyis kyang bsgul dang 'gul gyi sbyor tshul la 'dra bas skabs dang bstun nas sbyar dgos/ khong bzhus/sa lta bu ni bzhugs bya bzhugs byed gnyis ka khong yin pas(gdan la) bzhugs ni de dag dang mi 'dra ste/ rang nyid bsdad pa tsam ston pa'i skabs/ su bya byed tha dad min pa'i dbang gis byed sgra dang 'brel sgra gang yang sbyar mido tho/sa shing / ‘‘khong’’ ni gang zag yin pas byed sgra sbyar dgos pa'i skabs kyang yong ste/ dper na/ ngas bzhugs rogs gnang zhus kyang khong gis sa/tan cinas bzhugs ma byung lta bu rnams la ni byed sgra nges par du dgos/10 dri ba/ sa nas rtswa skyes/ gnam nas char bab ces pa dang /

158 rdo rje rgyal po'i gsung rtsom phyogs ba 'igs//ma las bu skyes zer ba gnyis ngo bo gcig pa yin nam/ yang na skabs 'gar sa la rtswa skyes/ ma la bu skyes zhes pa rnam dbye gnyis pa'i la don rgyag gi 'dug pa de gang yin nam/lanarna/ sa nas rtswa skyes/ gnam nas char bab/ ma las bu skyes lta bu rnams rnam dbye lnga pa 'byung khungs ston pa'i tshul gcig pa yin/ 'on kyang de dag bya ba'i ngo bo gcig pa yin zer mi rung ngo / /yang sa la rtswa skyes/ ma la bu skyes zhes kyang zer/ de ni gang zhig gang las byung gi dbang du ma byas par/ gzhi gang zhig gi steng du bya ba ci 'dra zhig byung ba ston pa rnam dbye bdun pa rten gnas ston pa'i dbang du byas nas sbyar ba yin la/ de ltar sbyar du'ang rung / ta zig gi sgrung dper/ a ga ma la bu zhig skyes/ byi'u 'tshor ma la phra zhig skyes/ ta zig yum la khyung zhig skyes zhes dang / gzhan du'ang de ltar sbyar ba mang du 'byung la gong gsal dper brjod kyi nang nas gnam las char bab lta bu ni ma la bu skyes sogs dang 'dra ba'i sgrub byed brjod du med kyang brda la ni 'jug cing / gnam la char bab ces la don gyi sgra 'jug pa'ang min no//1 1 dri ba/ ‘‘srung skyob’’dang ‘‘gtor bshig’’sogs kyi mdun du la don dgos sam mi dgos/ rgyu mtshan ci yin/lan/ ngas bltas na‘‘nga0tshos chab srid kyi rtsa don yang dag pa de srung skyob dang dar spel byed dgos/ ’’‘‘ri 'gog dmag 'khrug gtor bshig dang rgyal khab la gnod 'tshe byed mkhan su red’’lta bu rnams la la

sum rtags skor gyi dri ba dris lan/ 159don gyi sgra mi dgos/ gang yin zhe na/ srung ba dang skyob pa'i bya tshig gre/nyis 'dus nas bya ba'i ming srung skyob ces pa dang / gtor ba dang bshig pa bya ba gnyis 'dus nas bya ba'i ming gtor bshig ces pa grub pa yin zhing de dag so sos bya tshig tu 'khyer na dmag 'khrug de bya ba'i yul lam las yin pas/dmag 'khrug gtor/ dmag 'khrug bshig ces pa las la don sbyar mi dngo/sa pa dang / rtsa don yang dag pa de bya ba'i yul lam las yin pas/ rtsa don srung / rtsa don skyob lta bu las la don sbyar mi dgos pas/ srung skyob byed ces dang / gtor bshig byed ces sogs kyi mdun du la don sbyar mi dgoca/ so//12 dri ba/ khyed kyis mdzad pa'i 〈〈rtags 'jug gi dka' gnad mdor bsdus〉〉las bya byed tha mi dad pa'i nang gses gsum pa‘‘khos rgya yig shes kyi yod pa red’’ces pa dang / bzhi pa‘‘krung go'i drag po'i dpung gis dgra bo'i dpung tshogs mtha' dag legs par 'thul song’’zhes pa der byed pa po dngos su yod par ma zad rnam dbye gsum pa'ang bskyon yod pas/ sum rtags kyi gzhung rnams su bya byed tha mi dad pa'i rnam gzhag tu bya ba zhig 'grub pa rig pa'i skabs su byed pa po dngos su mi snang ba'am yang na byed pa po dang las gnyis tha dad du mi snang ba zhig dgos gsungs pa de dang phran bu mi 'dra ba de gang yin nam/lan/ spyir na bya byed tha mi dad pa zhes pa de byed pa po dngos su mi snang ba'am bya byed tha dad du dbye rgyu med pa zhig la zer yang / sdo na chad spyi 'grel pa rnams su nang gses bye brag tu phye ba ma mthong zhing / rang

160 rdo rje rgyal po'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/ genyid kyis brtags na bya byed tha mi dad pa la nang gses mi 'dra ba mang tsam rtemathong nas rigs sam nang gses bye brag pa lngar phye ba yin/ de'i dang po ‘‘bdag 'gro’’zhes pa dang / gnyis pa‘‘'khor lo 'khor’ zhes pa dang /gsum pa khos rgya yig‘‘shes kyi yod pa red’’ces dang / bzhi pa drag po 'i dpung gis dgra bo'i dpung tshogs mtha' dag legs par‘‘'thul song ri’zhes pa dang / lnga pa‘‘sa nas rtswa skyes’’zhes pa rnams bya byed tha mi dad nga/ra 'jog datho/sa nga/'i bya ba sha stag yin/ khyed kyis zhib bsher zhig gnang dang / gsal por mkhyen gyi red/ 'on kyang bya ba de rnams ngo bo mi 'dra ba sha stag red/ lhag par du gsum pa dang bzhi par byed sgra yod pa de ltar thob kyang thob pa zhig red/ de'i 'grel bshad khungs so sor 'khod yod par bskyar du gzigs na mkhyen rgyur brten 'dir mi brjod do/ /gal srid nang gses dbye ba de dag ma shes na rigs mi 'dra ba de dag 'phrad skabs khyed kyi/ dogs pa de lta bu yang phrad srid do//phran gyis bya byed tha mi thad pa de nang gses rigs lngar phye ba de dag dpyad sa/zhir bkod pa ni/ bya byed tha mi dad par nang gses rags tsam phye na bsgrub par bya ba'i yul gyi dngos po de sgrub pa po de dang lhan cig tu gyur pa'i bya byed tha mi dad pa dang / bsgrub bya dang sgrub byed tha dad yin rung bya ba de 'grub bzhin pa'i gnas skabs su sgrub pa po gzhun dngos su mi snang ba'i bya byed tha mi dad pa/ bsgrub bya dang sgrub byed tha dad yin la/ sgrub par byed pa'i bya ba sdon du song ba'i 'bras bu grub pa'i bya byed tha mi dad pa/ byed pa po zhig gis dngos su rtsol ba bskyed nas basbru bas par

sum rtags skor gyi dri ba dris lan/ 161ma bshad kyang de'i nus pas rang shugs su bya ba zhig grub pa'i bya byed tha mi dad pa/ byed pa po gtan nas med par bya ba grub pa'i bya byed tha mi dad pa bcas lnga yod/(1) bsgrub par bya ba'i yul gyi dngos po de sgrub pa po de dang lhan cig tu gyur pa'i bya byed tha mi dad pa ni/ dper na/ bdag 'gro lta bu brjod pa'i tshe/ 'gro zhes pa de bya tshig yin kyang / 'gro bya dang 'gro byed gnyis ka bdag 'gro pa po rang nyid las 'gro bya logs su med pas 'di la bdag gzhan gyi dbye ba'ang mi byed/ yang bskyar bshad na/ 'gro bya phung po de 'gro pa po rang nyid las gzhan du dbye rgyu med pa'i bya byed tha mi dad pa yin pa lta bu'o//(3) bsgrub bya dang sgrub byed tha dad yin rung bya ba de 'grub bzhin pa'i gnas skabs su sgrub pa po gzhan dngos su mi snang ba'i bya byed tha mi dad pa ni/ dper na rdza mkhan gyi 'khor lo 'khor ro lta bu brjod pa'i tshe na 'khor zhes pa de bya tshig yin zhing / dang por skor byed(skor mkhan)gzhan yod kyang / 'khor bzhin pa'i gnas skabs su skor pa po gzhan med par rang nyid ngang gis 'khor ba'i skabs der bya byed tha mi dad pa'i cha nas bskor zhes ma brjod par 'khor zhes zer/ yang bskyar bshad na 'kho ra—ba de bya tshig yin zhing / skabs snga mar skor pa po gzhan yod kyang skabs hūṃ4mar med pa ni bsgrub bya(bskor rgyu'i 'khor lo)dang sgrub byed(skor mkhan mi)tha dad yin rung bya ba de 'grub bzhin pa'i('khor bzhin pa'i)gnas skabs su sgrub pa po gzhan dngos su ma snang ba'i bya byed tha mi dad pa yin pa lta bu'o//

162 rdo rje rgyal po'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/(tī) bsgrub bya dang sgrub byed tha dad pa yin la/ sgrub par byed pa'i bya ba sngon du song ba'i 'bras bu grub pa'i bya byed tha mi dad pa ni/ dper na/khos rgya yig shes kyi yod pa red lta bu brjod pa'i tshe na shes zhes pa de bya tshig yin zhing / shes bya dang shes byed kyang tha dad yin pas dang po bslabs yod kyang / khong du chub zin pa'i gnas skabs su bya byed tha mi dad pa'i cha nas bslabs zhes mi brjod par shes zhes zer/ yang bskyar bshad na/ shes zhes pa de bya tshi ga yi na zhing / bskrub bya(shes par bya rgyu)dngasgrub byed(shes par byed mkhan)tha dad yin la/ sgrub par byed pa'i(shes par byed pa'i)bya ba sngon du song ba'i 'bras bu grub pa'i(shesapa'i)bya byed tha mi dad pa yin pa lta bu'o//(bhe) byed pa pos dngos su rtsol ba bskyed nas bsgrubs par ma bshad kyang / de'i nus pas rang shugs su bya ba zhig grub pa'i bya byed tha mi dad pa ni/ dper na/ krung go'i drag po'i dpung gis dgra bo'i dpung tshogs mtha' dag legs par 'thul song lta bu brjod pa'i tshe na 'asdol zhes pa de bya tshig yin zhing / gdul bya dang gdul byed kyang tha dad pa yin/ 'on kyang tshig zin du btul zhes ma brjod par/ bya ba'i yulabegyi dngos/ po'i thog grub pa'i bya ba 'thul ba tsam bstan pa'i cha nas 'asdol zhes brjod pa yin/ yang bskyar bshad na/ byed pa po sa(drag po'i dngu/nga) dngos su rtsol ba bskyed nas bsgrubs par(dgra bo btul bar)ma bshad kyang / de'i nus pas bya ba zhig grub pa'i(dgrabo 'thul ba'i)bya byed tha mi dad pa yin pa lta bu'o//('a) byed pa po gtan nas med par bya ba grub pa'i bya byed tha mi dad pa ni/ dper na sa nas rtswa skyes/ gnam nas char bab lta bu brjod pa'i

sum rtags skor gyi dri ba dris lan tsho 163tshe na skyes pa dang bab pa zhes pa de gnyis bya tshig yin rung / de ni gnam sa'i 'byung ba rang nyid kyi byed pas bskyed pa las byed pa po 'dis byas zhes bshad du med pa ni byed pa po gtan nas med par bya ba grub pa'i bya byed tha mi dad pa yin pa lta bu'o/ /gong gsal bya byed tha mi dad pa nang gses mi 'dra ba lnga gang zhig yin rung / bya ba sgrub pa po dngos po bdag dang / bsgrub bya'i dngos po gzhan ces gnyis su dbye rgyu med cing / de bzhin byed pa po dang 'brel ba'i byed las dang bya ba'i yul gyi dngos po dang 'brel ba'i bya las zhes pa'ang dbye rgyu med/1 3 dri ba/ brjod par bya dang bstan par bya lta bu bya las ma 'ongs pa dang / rjod par byed dang ston par byed lta bu byed las da lta ba de dag bdag byed pa po dang sbyar thob/ brjod par bya rgyu'i las dang bstan par bya rgyu'i las dang mnyam du sbyor na gang 'dra byed dgos/lan/ byed las ma 'ongs pa dang byed las da lta ba zhes pa de dag bdag byed pa po dang 'brel nas brjod na bdag gis brjod par bya'o/ /bdag gis bstan par bya'o lta bu dang / yang byed las ma 'ongs par de lo spyi zla2pa tsam la rgyal yongs mi dmangs 'thus mi'i tshogs chen 'tshog par byed do/ /('tshog gi red dam 'tshog par 'gyur/ )des rgyal khab kyi 'go khrid gsar pa 'dems bsko byed do/ /(bskogired/ )zhes kyang sbyor srol yod/brjod par bya dang bstan par bya lta bu bya las ma 'ongs pa de dag brjod par bya rgyu'i las sam yul dang 'brel nas sbyor skabs gtam brjod par

wa174 rdorjergyal po'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/bya'o/ /(gtam bshad kyi yin/)ltad mo bstan par bya'o/ /(ltad mo bstan gyi yin/)zhes sbyor dgos/14 dri ba/ thab la me btang zhes pa dang / thang du rta brgyugs zhes pa/ lcags la rtsi btang zhes pa lta bu rnams sum cu pa'i rnam dbye'i thog nas brtags na thab dang / thang / lcags rnams bya ba'i yul dang la sgra gnyis dang du sgra ni yul de dag tu bya ba byas pa ston byed kyi rnam dbye —gnyis pa/ me btang ba dang rta brgyugs pa/ rtsi btang ba rnams ni bya gabacas yin mod/ rtags 'jug gi bya byed las gsum gyi thog nas brtagarusan/ 1 thab dang / thang / lcags bcas gang yin/ bya ba'i yul zer dgos sam/ 2 me dang thab dang lcags bcas ni las dang / la dang du ni rnam dbye zhes zer dgos sam/ yang na me btang / rta brgyugs/ rtsi btang zhes pa ni bya ba byas pa'am las byas pa zhes zer dgos sam/lan/ thabo la me btang / thang du rta brgyugs/ lcags la rtsi btang zhes pa rnams kyi thab dang / thang / lcags rnams sum cu pa'i rnam dbye gnyis pa las su bya ba'i yul yin pa dang / la sgra gnyis dang du sgra bcas rnam dbye gnyis pa gsal byed kyi la don yin pa/ me btang ba dang / rta brgyugs pa/ rtsi btang ba rnams bya ba yin pa bcas 'khrul mi 'dug pa de rang red/ rtaṭa 'jug gi bya byed las gsum gyi thog nas brtag tshul de yang nor mi 'dug kyang nges pa gsal po zhig rnyed mi 'dug dper brjod 'di dag tu byed pa po bkod med pas bya byed las gsum gyi‘‘byed’

sum tags skor gyi dri ba dris lan/ 165ces pa blu da du phud nas bzhag ste thab la/ thang du/ lcags la zhes rnams sum cu pa'i skabs kyi rnam dbye gnyis pa las su bya ba'i yul yin pa gong du gleng zin pas bskyar bzlos ma dgos la/ me btang / rta brgyugs/ rtsi btang zhes pa rnams kyi me dang / rta/ rtsi bcas rtags 'jug tu bshad pa'i dngos po gzhan te bya ba'i yul lam las zhes pa de yin/ de ni bya byed las gsum gyi nang nas‘‘las zhes pa de red/ btang zhes pa gnyis ka dang brgyugs zhes bcas gsum po de bya ba byas zin 'das pa ston pa 'i bya tshig yin/ de ni bya byed las gsum nang gi‘‘bya ’zhes pa de yin/ de dag sa/sal por mtshon ched du‘‘ngas thab la me btang’’ zhes brjod na‘‘nga’’ byed pa po dngos po bdag yin pa dang / ‘‘me’’rtags 'jug gi bya ba'i yul lam las dngos po gzhan yin pa/ ‘‘thab la zhes pa'i thab sum cu pa'i skabs kyi rnam dbye gnyis pa las su bya ba'i yul yin pa lta bu rnams gsal por nges dgos/15 dri ba/ gzhung du rnam dbye bdun pa rten gunas ni(bya ba byed pa'i don mi ston par)gang zhig gang la yod pa'am brten pa'i do na can du sbyar ba rnam dbye bdun pa rten gnas kyi sgra zhes zer yang la las mi dmangs la rgyal kha thob/ yum la sras shig 'khrungs/ dgra bo 'dul ba'i dpa' bo la/ /dmar yag stag gi snying rtsa dgos/ /zhes pa'i tshig de dag nang gi‘‘thob dang ‘‘'khrungs’ ‘‘dgos’ribacas bya tshig spyir btang ba zhig min par bya tshig dmigs bsal can zhig yin zer nas de dag gnas gzhir brtsis 'dug pa de 'grig gam/ 'dir bya tshig dmigs bsal can

166 rdo rje rgyal po'i gsung tsom phyogs bsgrigs/zer ba ni don du bya byed tha mi dad pa red 'dus/ pa de dag la bya tshig chodamigs bsal can zhes pa'i tha snyad sbyar na 'grig gi red dam/lan/ sum cu pa'i gzhung du rnam dbye bdun pa'i mtshan nyid brjod skabs dngos po gang zhig yin rung de de na gnas pa'am yod pa tsam ston pa las bya ba gtan nas mi byed pa zhig dgos zhes brjod pa las bya tshig gtan nas med pa zhig dgos zhes bshad pa ma mthong zhing / gong gsal dper brjod gsum gyi ‘‘thob/ ’’‘‘'khrungs/ mi’‘‘dgos zhes pa gsum hog bya byed tha mi dad pa'i bya ba yin pas bya ba de rigs la bya ba byung ma byung zhes pa ma gtogs byas ma byas zhes pa'i tha snyad mi 'jug pas bya ba byed ces pa la bya ba byung zhes pa'i go don la khyad par yod cing / 'dir thobamopa dang / 'khrungs pa/ dgos pa rnams kyi gzhi'am gnas de rim pa bzhin mi dmangs dang / yum/ dpa' bo rnams su bzung ba'i dbang du btang nas bshad pa yin nges shing / rang nyid kyi 'dod tshul yang de ltar du 'dod/ gzhan du bya byed tha mi dad pa'i bya ba 'di rigs la don 'jug yul rnam dbye gnyis pa dang / rnam dbye bzhi pa/ rnam dbye gnyis pa'i nang tshan de nyid/ rnam dbye bdun pa'i nang tshan tshe skabs bcas gang gis dper brjod du'ang mi tshud pas bya tshig de dag gi rigs rnams 'jog sa'i khungs mi red de/ yang thob/ 'khrungs/ dgos zhes pa de dag la bya nyatshig dmigs bsal can zhes zer dgos don rtsa ba nas med pa min yang /bya byed tha mi dad pa'i khongs su bzhag pas 'thus gshis bya tshig dmigs bsal can zhes ming gsar pa zhig 'dogs dgos don mi 'dug snyam/

sum rtags skor gyi dri ba dris lan/ 16716 dri ba/ de nyid kyi skor/ mkhas pa la las gnas lugs/ su grub dang / gshis lugs su nges zhes pa lta bu chos kyi gnas lugs sa ma gshis lugs ston pa des de nyid kyi nus pa yin pa gsungs pa ltar na de 'drar nges par du de nyid kyi/ sgra sbyor dgos kyang deng sa/nga la las de'i grub lugs su chas/sa zer rgyur‘‘spub lugs chags pa redami’zer ba dang / 'phel rgyas su phyin pa red zer rgyur yang‘‘'phel rgyas phyin pa red’’zer zhing / de nyid kyi sgra bsdus pa lta bu byed kyi 'dug pa de 'grig gam/ des ma tshad khru gang gis mtho ba dang grangs ka gsum gyis mang ba zer rgyur dang‘‘khru gang mtho’’‘‘grangs ka gsum mang’’zhes bar gyi rnam dbye bsdus pa lta bu zhig byed kyi 'dug la de'ang 'grig gam/ de bzhin du gnas gzhi'i skabs kyang ste nga dang 'og sngon rjes lta bu la steng du 'og tu sngon du rjes su lta bu zer bar steng 'og sngon rjes zhes pa rang gis 'thus pa byed kyi 'dug pa 'grig gam/lan/ gnas lugs su grub/ gshis lugs su nges/ zhes nga 'di dag las dang bya ba ngo gcig tu gyur pa zhig yin pas de nyid mchon byed kyi la don su yod pa dang thob pa nges shes thob pas na bskyar bshad ma dgos shing / grub lugs chags pa red/ 'phel rgyas byung ba red lta bu'i grar/ la cha mtshon na grwab lugs de rang sngar med pa zhig gsar du chags pa dang /'phel rgyas ni sngar yod pa zhig yag tu song ba ston pa tsam las ngo bo gcig tu gyur pa'i sgrub byed brjod du med pas la don gyi sgra mi dngo/sa / pe/la te sbyar na 'grel bshad byed dka' ba zhig las dgos don mi 'dug snya/ska/ khru

168 rdo sde rgyal po'i gsung rtsom snyogs bsgrigs/gang gis mtho ba dang grangs ka sa/sum gyis mang ba zer ba'i byed sgra de dag ni khyed kyi gzugs tshad de nga las khru gang gis ma/tho ba 'dug g.yas gral las g.yon gral mi grangs gsu/ma gyis mang ba 'dug lta bu bsdur tshad kyi khyad par ston pa'i byed sgra yin zhing de bsdus na khyad par gyi tshig gsal por mi mtshon pas bsdu mi rung / rten gnas kyi skabs kyi steng dang / 'og sngon/rjes lta bu rnams kyi la don steng du/ 'og tu/ sngon du/ rjes su zhes ma sbyar bar mkhar steng bsdad/ nga rang tsho'i las ka tshang ma tang gi 'go khrid 'og byed pa red/ kho de sngon rjes lus pa zhig red/ slob gso thob rjes yar rgyas chen po byung 'dug lta bu tshig bsdus la don gsal po yong ba rnams kyi la don bsdus chog cing bsdu ba de'i ming la de'i skyes bu'i bsdu ba zhes zer/17 dri ba/ la don 'jug sgo gzhan yod ces pa'i skor smra sgo mtshon cha ru‘‘la ni gnyis pa bzhi pa dang / /drug pa sdud dang sbyor ba dang / /smon dang tshad 'dzin gzhi dang ni/ /tshe sgyuskabs dag tu 'dod pa yin’’zhes la'ike'ajug pa brgyad bgrangs pa las sum cu pa'i rtsa bar byung ba rnams phud/sdud pa dang / sbyor ba/ smon pa/ tshad 'dzin bcas la 'jug pa gsungasako pa'i nang nas sdud pa dang sbyor ba'i smri ti'i rang 'grel du‘‘sdud par 'gyur ba ni lag pa bsnyal la zas bza' zhes pa lta bu'o/ /sbyor ba ni 'di na ni yod la 'di na ni med de zhes pa lta bu'o/ / zhes bkral pa de'i go ba len dka' ba/ deng rabs kyi mkhas pa 'ga'i 'grel tshul dang yang 'dra gi med pa dper na/ tsha sprul rin po che'i〈〈ljon dbang slob deb〉〉du‘‘sdud pa'i sgru

sum rtags skor gyi dri ba dris lan/ 16mi ni 'di mi zhig yin la rig pa can yang yin’’zhes pa dang / ‘‘yang 'di khab yin la 'tshem yang bde po zhig yod’rices pa dang / ‘‘sbyor ba ste tshig snga phyi mtshams sbyor’’ zhes gsungs yod pa dang / yang a khu bstan pa rgya mtsho'i〈〈la don gyi gnad don kha shas〉〉su‘‘sdud pa la yang 'jug ste dper na/ dmar la mkhas pa/ yon tan che la nga rgyal med pa/ srab la 'jam pa rtso/gas ni dmar ba dang mkhas pa'i khyad par gnyis/ gcig gi steng du bsdus pa yin zhes dang‘‘yang mtshams sbyor dngos la 'jug ste/ dper na/ zhwa phud la sdod/ sdod la zo/ rta zhon la song sogs ni bya ba snga phyi mtshams sbyor ba dang bya ba go rim yod pa ston pa tsam yin’ zhes gsungs/de lta bu yin na sdud pa ni rgyan sdud du bshad pa'i sdud pa'i nang tshan gzhi mthun sdud pa dang / sbyor ba ni lhag bcas kyi mtshams sbyor lhag bcas su 'jug par go dgos pa 'dug snyam/ yang snying ga 'dra yin nam/lan/ 〈smra sgo mtshon char〉〉la'i 'jug pa brgyad bshad pa'i rang 'grel du‘‘sdud pa ni lag pa bsnyal la zan bza' zhes pa lta bu'o’’zhes pa 'di thad ni sdud pa zhes pa ni gzhi gcig gi thog tu don nam chos gzhan zhig kyang bsdu ba'i don mtshon pa zhig dgos/ de ni tsha sprul rin po che'i dper brjod‘‘'di mi zhig yin la rig pa can yang yin zhes pa dngaya'adi khab yin la 'tshem yang bde po zhig yod mices dper brjod snga ma bstan bya'i gzhi de mi zhig yin par ma zad rig pa'ang yod mkhan zhig ston pa la rgyan sdud kyi sdud sgra kyang dang sbrags nas la don sbyar ba zhig dang / dper brjod phyi gabastan bya'i gzhi de khab cig yin pa'i thog tshem po rgyag skabs 4

170 rdo rje rgyal po'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/bde bo yang yin pa'i khyad chos kyang lhag pa ston par rgyan sdud kyi sdud sgra yang dang sbrags nas la don sbyar ba zhig yin pa lta bu yin la/ smra sgo'i dper brjod ‘‘lag pa bsnyal la zas bza' zhes pa ni lag pa bsnyal te zas bza' zheṭasmu mtshams sbyor lhag bcas kyi dper brjod du gyur pas sdud pa'i mtshan nyid dang mtshan gzhi'i dper brjod tha dad du gyur pa'o des na 'di lta bu ni sdud pa'i dper mi 'os so/ /yang smra sgo'i rang 'grel du ‘‘sbyor ba('di'i sbyor ba ni tshig snga phyi mtshams sbyor ro)ni 'di na ni yod la 'di na ni med do zhes phyogs gcig na yod pa dang phyogs gcig na med pa'i tshig gnyis kyi mtshams sbyar ba yin pas sbyor ba'i dper brjod tshad ma'o/ /bstan pa rgya mtshos‘‘sdud pa la'ang 'jug ste/ dper na/ dmar la mkhas pa/ yon tan che la nga rgyal med pa/ srab la 'jam pa sogs ni dmar ba dang mkhas pa'i khyad par gnyis/ gcig gi steng du bsdus pa yin’’zhes pa 'di ltar rtsa ba nas ma 'grig ces brjod dka' yang rang nyid kyi 'dod tshul ltar na la sgra 'di ni dmar zhing mkhas pa dang / yon tan che zhing nga rgyal med pa/ srab cing 'jam pa zhes tshig phrad zhing dang cing gi 'jug tshul dang mthun par tshig snga phyi rma tshams sbyor ba'i tshitpārka/ nyams gsal zhing sdud sgra kyang yang sogs kyang med par brten sdud pa'i dper brjod mtshan nyid tshang ba zhig ma red snyam/ yang bstan pa rgya mtshos‘‘yang mtshams sbyor da ngos la 'jug ste/ dper na/ zhwa phud la shod/ sdod la zo/ rta zhon la song / sogs ni bya ba snga phyi mtshams sbyor ba dang bya bar go rim yod pa teo na pa tsam yin’’zhes gsungs pa ni lhag bcas kyi te de ste gsum dang

sum rtags skor gyi dri ba dris lan/ 171'jug tshul mtshungs pa mtshams sbyor lhag bcas yin zhing 'di'ang smra sgo'i tsho nang bshad pa'i spyor ba zhes pa de'o/ /mdor na sdud pa zhes pa ni rgyan sdud kyi kyang yang 'ang gsum dang sbra gas nas la sgras sdud sgra ston pa dang /sbyor ba zhes pa ni la sgras tshig snga phyi mtshams sbyor bar 'jug pa'o//18 dri ba/ rnam dbye gnyis pa las su bya bar shar la 'gro/ shing la lta lta bu bya ba byed sa'i phyogs dang yul ston pa zhig dang / shog bur yi ge 'bri/ shing la sta re rgyag lta bu yul zhig gzhir bzhag nas de'i steng du las shig byed pa ston pa zhig ste gnyis yod ces bshad na 'grig gam/de min bshad tshul gzhan yod dam/lan/ 'dir bkod pa'i shar dang / shing / shog bu bcas tshang —ma byed pa pos bya ba byed sa'i yul yin pas de dag la la don sbyar nas shar la/ shing la/ shog bur/ shing la zhes rnam dbye gnyis pa las su bya ba'i yul de gsal por mtshon pas de rnams phyogs dang gzhi lta bu ma phye bar rnam dbye gnyis pa las su bya ba'i yul yin pa khyad med du bzung na 'grig bya ba de dag ni byed pa po dang 'brel ba'i bya ba sha stag dgos/ bya ba de rnams la dbye zhib byas na shar la 'gro zhes pa'i shar de bya ba'i yul yin pa smos ma dgos shing / 'gro zhes pa'i bya ba de 'gro bya 'gro byed dbye rgyu med pa'i bya byed tha mi dad pa yin kyang 'gro ba po'am 'gro mkhan de gang zag cig yin dgos pas 'gro ba'i bya ba byed pa po dang 'brel ba'i bya ba byed las su ngos 'dzin dgos pa dang gcig shing la lta zhes pa'i shing de

172 rdo rje rgyal po'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/rnam dasnye gnyis pa las su bya ba'i yul yin pa smos ma dgos shing / lta zhes pa'i bya ba de byed pa po dang 'brel ba'i bya ba byed las yin la de ltar sbyor ba'i skabs kyang yodi mod/ 'on kyang shing la mig lta zhes rjod pa'e skabs kyang yod pas/ de ltar rjod skabs shing de rnam dbye gnyis pa las su bya ba'i yul yin pa spros ma dgos shing mig de rtags 'jug gi skabs kyi bya ba'i yul lam las zhes pa de yin pa dang lta zhes pa'i bya ba de byed pa po dang 'brel ba'i bya ba byed las yin pa dang gnyis/ shog bur yi ge 'bri/shing la sta re rgyag lta bu'i shog bu dang shing gnyis sum cu pa'i rnam dbye tha/nyis pa las su bya ba'i la don 'jug sa'i yul yin pa gong ltar dang / yi ge dang sta re gnyis rtags 'jug gi skabs kyi bya ba'i yul lam las zhes pa de yin pa dang(dngos po gzhan)'bri dang rgyag zhes pa'i bya ba de gnyis byed pa po dang 'brel ba'i bya ba byed las yin pa dang gsum(dngos po bdag)bcas bya ba'i nang gses mi 'dra ba de rnams gsal por rtogs dgos so//19 dri ba/ yang a khu bstan pa rgya mtsho'i〈〈la don gyi ba/nad don kha shas〉〉su‘‘spyir las su bya ba 'di yul 'a la don sbyar dgos pa zhig yin dgos mod/ gal te las dang yul tha dad du mi snang ba zhig yin na der la don mi sbyor te/ dper na/ sa la rko/ shing la bcad mi zer bar sa rko/shing bcad zer bas chog ’ces bshad kyang / smra sgor‘‘la'i don gnyis par 'gyur ba ni shing la gcod ces lta bu’’zhes pa gnyis kyi skor ga 'dra yin nam/lan/ a khu bstan pas‘‘dper na/ sa la rko/ shing la bcad

sum rtags skor gyi dri ba dris lan/ 173mi zer bar sa rko/ shing bcad zer bas chog’ ces bshad pa ni de ltar rang red ces/ khas len dgos/ 'on kyang‘‘gal te las dang yul tha dad du mi snang ba zhig yin na der la don sbyar mi dgos te’’ zhes pa'i tshig 'di'i rjod tshul ni 'grig ma song / gang yin zhe na/ brko bya'i sa dang gcad bya'i shing bya ba'i yul lam las de dag dang rko ba dang bcad pa'i bya ba de dag bya byed lanu/ gsum gyi nang gi las dang bya ba tha dad pa rang ma gtong/sa/ las dang yul tha dad du mi snang ba zhig gtan nas min pas tshig 'di tshig thog tu don ma gnas pa zhig go/ /smra sgor‘‘shing la gcod’’ces la don gyi sgra sbyar ba de ni smri ti rgya gar pa zhig yin stabs rgya gar gyi sgra'i 'jug tshul gyi shugs las byung ba'am bod skad dpyis phyin par ma shes pa'i skyon la sa byung ba gang yin cha ma gtogs pa las/ bod skad spyir btang dang gtan nas mi mthun pas de ni nor ba red ma gtogs gzhan shod mi thub/20 dri ba/ bya ba'i yul la 'jug pa'i la don dper na/ ‘‘rtatshol bzhon nas song’mi lta bu'i tshig rnams la skabs re la don ma sbyar bar‘‘rta bzhon nas song zhes 'bri ba ci yin nam/ yadkuo dper na‘‘chab srid slob skyong byed dgos zhes par la don mi sbyor ba dang / ‘‘mi dmangs la zhabs phyi zhu dgos’’zhes par la don sbyor dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan ci yin nam/lan/ ‘‘rta la bzhon’’dang‘‘rta bzhon’’zhes pa gnyis ka brjod srol 'dug de ltar brjod kyang 'thus/ gang yin zhe na/ ‘‘rta la bzhon’ zhes gyub brjod pa'i tsha rta de bzhon par bya ba'i yul lam zhon sar(bzhon pa)

dzo 174 rdorjergyal po'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/bzung nas rnam dbye gnyis pa las su bya ba'i sgra la don gyi‘‘la’’sbyar ba yin la/ ‘‘rta bzhonari’zhes brjod pa'i tshe rta de bzhon bya bya ba'i yul lam las su bzung zhing de mi zhig gis bzhon te song ba'i bya ba ston pa'i tshig tu gyur pa yin pas bya ba'i yul lam las der la don ma sbyar ba yin la de ltar tshig gi sbyor tshul yang mthun zhing / rtags 'jug gi dka' gnad gsal ba'i me long du la don 'chad pa'i skabs su/ las dang bya yul don gcig ste/zhes gsungs pa de'ang‘‘rta la bzhon’’dang‘‘rta bzhon’’zhes pa'i tshig 'di lta bu la dgongs pa yin nges las/ gzhan sum cu pa'i skabs kyi‘‘rnam dbye gnyis pa las su bya ba'i yul’ dang / rtags 'jug gi skabs kyi‘‘bya ba'i yul lam las’’zhes pa gnyis don gcig tu 'gyur thabs med do//‘‘chab srid slob sbyong byed dgos’’zhes par la don mi sbyor ba dang /‘‘mi dmangs la zhabs 'degs zhu dgos’’zhes par la don sbyor dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ ‘‘chab srid slob sbyong byed dgos’’zhes pa'i‘‘chab srid’’de sbyang bya'am bslab bya der la don sbyor mi dgos pa gong gi‘‘rta bzhon’’zhes dang gcig pa yin zhing / yang chab srid de sbyong ba'i yul du bzung ba sum cu pa'i rnam dbye gnyis yin pa'i dbang du btang nas de la sbyong ba'i bya ba byed dgos pa zhig shod na‘‘chab srid la slob sbyong byed dgosami’zhes la don sbyar kyang rung ba gong gi‘‘rta la bzhon’’zhes pa dang gcig pa yin la/ de ltar sbyor ba skad dang yig srol la yod do//‘‘mi dmangs la zhabs phyi zhu dgos’’zhes pa'i‘‘mi dmangs’’de zhabs phyi zhu sa'i yul sum cu pa'i skabs kyi rnam dbye bzhi pa dgos ched kyi

sum rtags skor gyi dri ba dris lan/ 175 ‘lari’sgra 'jug yul yin pas der nges par du la don sbyor dgos pa las/‘‘mi dmangs zhabs phyi zhu dgosami’zhes bris na tshig dang don gnyis kar mi btub pas tshig rigs mi 'dra ba gnyis nya nyung mnyam bsres lta bu rtsa ba nas sbyor mi rung ba zhig go//21 dri ba/ deng sang rtsom pa po mang po zhig gis phal skad la bstun nas ‘‘byed kyi yod pa red/ ’’ ‘‘shod kyi yod pa red/ ’ ‘‘yod kyi red/ ’’‘‘byed kyi 'dug’mices 'bri gi 'dug pa de dag 'brel sgra'i khongs su brtsis chog gam/lan/ rnam dbye drug pa 'brel sgra zhes pa der nang gses phye na yul dang yul can gyi 'brel sgra dang / rten dang brten pa'i 'brel sgra/ ngo bo gcig pa'i 'brel sgra/ khyad gzhi khyad chos kyi 'brel sgra sogs ji snyed cig mchis kyang / mdor bsdus na ming don phan tshun 'brel ba tsam zhig ston pa'i sgra'am phrad yin pas gong gsal‘‘byed kyi yod pa red/ ’’ ‘‘shod kyi yod pa red/ ’ ‘‘yod kyi red/ ’’ ‘‘byed kyi 'dug’’ ‘‘'bri gi 'dug’’ces pa'i kyi sgra dang gi sgra de dag tshig snga phyi 'brel byed kyi 'brel sgra yin pa smos ci dgos/ gal srid 'brel sgra de dag med pa‘‘byed yod pa red/ ’’‘‘shod yod pa red’’sogs su gyur te tshig 'brel med du gyur nas don mi ston no/ /'on kyang tshig de dag ni bya ba byed pa tsam ston pa zhig yin/'ga' res de dag la rjes 'jug na re sbyar nas byed kyin zhes dang 'bri gin zhes pa sbyor ba'ang mthong bas de'i thad la bshad na/ yod kyin red

176 rdo rje rgyal tswa'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/ces pa'i kyi la rjes 'jug na rtsa ba nas mi 'jug cing / bya ba byed bzhin yod pa gsal por ston byed du byed kyin byed kyin dang / 'gro gin 'gro gin zhes sogs rjes 'jug na sbyor ba'ang yod kyang sbyor tshul gyi dbye mtshams ma nor ba bya dgos so//22 dri ba/ rgan lags kyis 'dzum mul mul gyi ngang nas mi dmangs la zhabs 'degs yag po zhu dgos zhes bka' slob gnang gi 'dug ces bshad tshe skabs re byed pa po rgan lags kyi rjes su byed sgra mi sbyor ba ci yin nam/lan/ de ni byed sgra chad pa red zer rgyu las gzhan rgyu mtshan ci yod/'dzum mul mul gyi ngang nas zhes pa ni rnam 'gyur ston tshul tsam yin cing /rgan lags byed pa po dang / bka' slob gnang ba bya ba yin par 'phyug pa yed pas rgan lags zhes pa'i byed pa po der byed sgra nges par du sbyor dgos/23 dri ba/ ‘‘ngas ma byung ba red/ ’’ ‘‘ngas ma 'grig pa red’ ces pa'i byed sgra 'di dag ci 'dra byas nas byung ba red dam/lan/ de rtogs sla bo mi 'dug gam/ ma byung mkhan de dang / ma 'grig mkhan de nga yin pa de la byed sgra ma sbyar na‘‘nga ma byung ba red/ ’’‘‘nga ma 'grig pa red’mices bris na skad cha'i tshig kyang grub mi thub/ ‘‘ma byung ba’’dang‘‘ma 'grig pa ’zhes pa gnyis ka bya tshig bya ba byung ba ston pa nig yin zhing / bya ba de dag byed pa pos bya dgos snyam pa'i kun slong

sum rtags skor gyi dri ba dris lan/ 177bzung nas ched du byas pa zhig min par rang shugs su byung ba zhig yin pas byed pa po dang ma 'brel ba'i bya byed tha mi dad pa yin pa'ang rtogs par bya dgos so/—/24 dri ba/ yi ge rnying pa'i tshig mtha' mang che bar rdzogs tshig 'dug de tsho sbyor sla bo 'dug deng sang rdzogs tshig zhe po mi sbyor bar ma zad/ phal skad kyi tshig mtha' mang che bar‘‘yod/ red/ yin/ min byung / song / bzhag’’sogs rgyag gi 'dug de tsho rgyag stangs bod rigs zhig la cha bzhag na rang shugs su shes kyi yod pas snang dag mi 'dug 'on kyang bod skad yag po rang mi shes mkhan mi rigs gzhan dag gi blo mthun rnams la cha bzhag na khong du chub dka' bas skabs 'gar sbyor nor yang yong gi 'dug der brten rgan lags kyis de'i skor gsung rgyur ma zad/slob gzhi rgyas bsdus ran po zhig bris nas snum par rgyag rgyu'i re ba yod/lan/ khyed kyis gsung ba ltar gyi gnad don de don dngos shig red/ 'jig rten khams kyi dngos po dang bya gzhag gi rjes 'brel ba jod par bya ba'i tshig don gnyis kar mtha' med pas slob deb thung ngu zhig gi thog nas thag gcod dang gtan 'beebs byed thabs med pa red/ 'on kyang rtsa ba'i gnad 'gag dang / chos nyid/ skabs bab kyi sbyor tshul sogs phyogs tsam re mdor bsdus nas bshad na 'di ltar te/dang po/ gnad 'gag ni/ yi ge zhes pa ni mi rigs so so'i skad kyi brda sprod ri mo'i lam nas byed pa zhig yin pas skad ma shes na yi ge 'bri

178 rdo rje rgyal po'i gsung rtsom snyogs bsgrigs/mi shes pa smos ci/ skad shes mkhan gyi nang nas kyang rnam dbye dang /tshig phrad/ dngos po bdag gzhan/ dus gsum sogs kyi rnam gzhag la brtag dpyad zhib 'jug gis khong du chub pa rnams kyis ma gtogs yi ge'i sbyor tshul tshad mar gyur pa zhig byed mi thub pa dngos mthong ltar lags na/dang por mi rigs de'i mang tshogs kyi khrod du zab 'jug byas nas skad slob stong dang / de nas slob dpon bsten nas brda sprod pa'i rig pa'i gzhung lugs la brten nas brtag dpyad zhib 'jug mthar lag len gyi thog gtan 'bebs bcas zab nan byed dgos pa las/ rtsa ba'i skad kyang ji bzhin mi shes par stabs bde ba'i thog nas deng rabs can bzhi'i shes bya lta bu zab cing rgya che ba rnams yig thog tu 'god thub pa'i stong bsam 'dzin mi rung bas bod yig gi las ka byed mkhan mtha' dag gis bod kyi skad yig slob sbyong byed dgos/ de'ang sngar yod kyi dpe deb blta klog dang dbye zhib zab po byed dgos/gnyis pa/ chos nyid dam rang bzhin ni/ mi rigs gang zhig gi skad yin rung rnam pa bzhir dbye chog pa ste/ sngar rgya gar du skad rigs bzhir dbye ba ltar byas te rang cag bod la cha mtshon na legs sbyar zhes mkhas pas bsregs bcad brdar gsum gyis gtan la phab pa'i yig skad dang / rang bzhin zhes grong khyer ram grong sde che ba rnams kyi skad dang /zur chag ces pa yul gyi mtha' 'am lung khug gi skad cha mi tshang zhing sgra nyams pa rnams dang / 'dren ma zhes zlos gar sokas kyi skabs rang gi rigs kyi chas dang mthun pa'i skad dper na dpon chas spras pas/ dngo/ na

sum rtags skor gyi dri ba dris lan/ 179skad dang / zhing pa'i chas spras pa rnams kyis zhing khul gyi skad dang /'brog pa'i chas spras pa rnams kyis 'brog skad(mi rigs gzhan gyi skad du smra ba ni smos ci dgos) du gtam smra zhing glu len pa sogs lta bu ste khyad par bzhi yod pa'i nang nas brtags shing gtan la phab pa'i yig skad ni brjod bya gsal zhing bsdus la tshig nges pa brtan pa dang / rang bzhin gyi skad dang thur chag gi skad ni sngar gyi skad la 'gyur ldog byung zhing / yul so so'i phal skad mi 'dra ba dang tshig sbyor 'dres ma mang po yod pas yig skad la rdzogs tshig yod pa de dag phal skad la mi 'byung ba la sogs pa'i khyad par byung zhing yig skad de ngos 'dzin sla zhing / phal skad de dbus gtsang khams 'brog gi skad rigs mang po de dag yongs la khyab pa zhig khong du chub dka' ba'i rang bzhin de byung ba red/ 'on kyang yul skad so so rang la ni so so'i skad lugs re yod/ da lta'i bod yig 'di phal skad go bde ba zhig dgos pa dar spel(rang gi lta tshul ltar na rigs pa'i gzhung lugs kyi bstan bcos sam rtsom yig rnams la yig skad kho na dang / sgrung dang lo rgyus sogs yig cha gzhan rnams yig skad dang phal skad ci bder bris na legs snyam) byas shing /de'ang bod rigs 'dus sdod rgya che ba dbus gtsang gi skad de gzhi'am gtso bor ma bzung thabs med byung bas tshig mtha'i rdzogs tshig dor te ‘‘'o/da/red/ yin/ min/ byung / song / bzhag’misogs mang po de byung ba red/gsum pa/ skabs bab kyi sbyor tshul ni/ 1 dper na yig skad ltar na sum cu pa'i gzhung gi rjes 'jug la bltos pa'i phrad rnam dbye dang bcas brgyad kyi dang por slar bsdu bstan to lta bu la/ phal skad dumo mo

180 rdo rje rgyal po'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/tshi ྾slar bsdu bstan yod pa red ces dang / 2 de bzhin yig skadalamosko ྾ ྾dang po slar bsdu'o/ /lta bu la phal skad du྾ ྾ dze ྾slar bsdu red ces sam྾ ྾ ྾ ྾slar bsdu yin zhes dang / 3 yig skad du slar bsdu'i phrad dam sgra bcu gcig po de dag ni skabs bab kyi brjod bya'i don de de tsam du rdzogs par ston pa'i tshig mthar sbyar dgos pa las tshig gzha na dag gi mthar sbyar bya ni min no lta bu la/ phal skad du tshig gzhan dag gi mthar sbyar bya min zhes pa las rdzogs tshig gi no sgra mi sbyor bar ma zad/ sbyor rgyu min zhes kyang zer/ 4 yig skad du mi spyir btang pas lo gsum gyi nang la'ang khong du chud dka' ba de ngas lo gcig la khong du chub bo zhes pa lta bu la/ phal skad du྾ ྾ ྾ ྾ngas lo gcig la khong du chub byung zhes dang / 5 yig skad du dge rgan des ngang rgyud bsrings nas slob ma rnams la bshad khrid mdzad do lta bu la/ phal skad du mo ྾ mo ྾bshad khrid gnang song zhes pa rang gis dngos su mthong ba ltar byas nas bya ba de byas zin pa'i tshig cig sbyor ba dang / yig skad du bdag bod la 'gro'o lta bu la/ phal skad du nga bod la 'gro gi yin zhes pa dang / bshad khrinee gnang bzhag('dug)ces slob khrid byas pa rang gis dngos su ma mthong yang shes tshor nges rnyed byung ba ltar byas nas sbyar ba bcas yig skad ltar na rdzogs tshig sbyor par phal skad la‘‘yod/ red/ yin/ min/ byung /song / bzhag 'dug’’ces pa rnams sbyor tshul yin la/ yang nan tan du brjod pa'i tshig la phal skad du'ang rdzo gas tshig mi 'dor bar dngos su sbyor dzha ba'ang yod/

sum rtags skor gyi dri ba dris lan/ 181dper na/ 1 khyod kyi skyon rnams ngas gsal por bshad yod do/ /sgyur bcos byed dang mi byed ni khyod rang gi blos dpyad par 'tshal lo zhes dang / bya ba ngan pa de lta bu ngas mi byed thag chod yin no/ /('ga' shas kyis mi byed thag chod yin dā zer ba ni rdzogs tshig gi to sgra'i zur chag pa'o/ / )zhes dang / da 'akro ran 'dug go/ /tshang ma thon gra sgrigs shig lta bu ji snyed cig thon yong ba'ang shes dgos pa las phal skad la rdzogs tshig rtsa ba nas mi spyod par tshig thag gcod mi rung / gzhan yang khyod la yon tan yod pa red dang khyod la yon tan 'dug ces gnyis ka zer/ khyod la yon tan yod pa red ces pa ni rjod pa po des mi der yon tan yod pa shes tshor byung ba'i brjod tshul dang / khyod la yon tan 'dug ces sam yod ces pa ni brjod pa po des mi der yon tan yod pa dngos su myo/thong ba'i rjod tshul dang / 2 nga la dngul mid ces dang nga la dngul mi 'dug ces pa gnyis ka zer/ nga la dngul med ces pa ni rtsa ba nas med pa'i rjo da tshul dang / nga la dngul mi 'dug ces pa ni rang gis zhib byas nas rang la gnas skabs sam da lta med pa tsam gyi rjod tshul dang / 3 deb 'di khyod kyi red ces dang / deb 'di khyod kyi yin gnyis ka zer/ snga ma ni red ces pa de khyod rang gi yin pa ston pa'i rjod tshul dang / phyi ma ni yin zhes brjod pa po des khyod ces pa der dmigs nas sprad pa'am bzhag pa'i rjod tshul dang / 4 yang deb 'di nga'i red dang / deb 'di nga'i yin gnyis ka zer/ snga ma ni deb zhig der yod pa de rang nyid kyi deb yin pa ngos jin pa'i rjod tshul dang / phyi ma ni deb de mi gzhan gyi min par rang nyid

182 rdo rje rgyal po'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/kyi yin zer ba'i rjod tshul dang / 5 las ka de ngas ma byas so'am byas pa min zhes dang / las ka de ngas byas pa zhig ma red ces gnyis ka zer/ṭwā/ ma ni rang gis byas par khas mi len pa'i rjod tshul dang / phyi ma ni zhib cing brtags nas rang gis byas pa min par nges pa rnyed pa'i rjod tshul dang / 6 khyod nga'i dgra yin zhes dang khyod nga'i dgra red ces gnyis ka zer/ dang po ni rang nyid kyis khyod ces pa de dgra bor ngos 'dzin pa'i rjod tshul dang / gnyis pa ni khyod ces pa de rang nyid kyi dgra bo yin pa ngos zin pa'am ra 'phrod pa'i rjod tshul dang / 7 nga ni khyod kyi dgra yin zhes dang nga ni khyod kyi dgra red ces gnyis ka zer/ snga ma ni rang nyid kyis khyod ces pa de'i dgra bo yin par khas len pa'i rjod tshul dang / phyi ma ni khyod ces pa des rang nyid dgra bor ngos 'dzin gyi yod pa'i rjod tshul yin zhing / sngar gyi yig thog tu de yin de min zhes pa las de red de ma red zhes bris pa mthong rgyu ha cang dkon/ yin min ces pa dang red ma red ces pa gnyis kas drang phyogs dang ldog phyogs kyi don cha re ston pa 'odra rung / skabs bab tu dga' skyo dang bde sdug byams sdang / dal brel sogs kyi 'gyur ba la gzhigs nas gang la gang zhig brjod na tshig la 'jug pa yod dang tshig gi bro bar khyad par yod pas deng skabs kyi rjo da tshul la de dag gnyis ka gang la ci 'os su bed spyad na legs/ de ltar rgyun mar byas na gang la gang sbyor yang rim bzhin nges pa brtan du 'gro nges yin snyam/'on kyang deng skabs rgya rigs sogs mi rigs gzhan dag gis de ltar lag len du 'khyol dka' ba smos ci dgos/ tha na bod rigs gzhon nu rnams

sum rtags skor gyi dri ba dris lan/ 183kyis kyang rang gi skad yig la dang dod mi lding bas rang skad ji bzhin mi shes par ma zad/ rgya skad rgya yig gi rjod tshul gyis shugs rkyen thebs te tshig mgo mjug ldog pa'am gang la ji zer tshad 'dzin mi shes pa'i thog bod skad la rgya skad bsres nas rjod mkhan yang shin tu mang ba sogs kyis skad yig gi rang lugs kyang 'thor la nye bar gyur zin gshis de dag gis rgya rigs la bod skad bod yig shes pa'i rogs ram mam mthun gyur byed thub rgyu lta ci/ bod rigs gzhon gras slob grwa thon pa nyung shas shig deng rabs can gyi las don nang gzhug thub tsam byung ba rab las/ de min ngal rtsol mi dmangs byings ni bod kyi gtam dper/ lcam sku zhabs kyi phebs stangs kyang ma shes/ bu mo nga rang gi 'gro stangs kyang brlag song zhes pa ltar rgya skad rgya yig gi thog nas shes rig thob mi thub la/ bod skad bod yig gi thog nas slob sbyong byed rgyu'ang 'thor brlags tu song ste mthar bod kyi shes rig rjes lus nang nas rjes su mtha' 'khob cig tu phyir ldog rgyu'i nyen khar slebs pa 'di ngos zin pa dang yi ge yon tan kun gyi gzhi rtsa yin zheṭa/ pa de sems thag bcad nas 'bad brtson bya dgos so/ /25 dri ba/ spyi'i cha nas bshad na byed sgra sbyor stangs khag po de tsam mi 'dug yin na'ang sbyor stangs dmigs bsal can kha shas yod pa de tsho rtogs khag po 'dug dper na/ snying pos dben pa dang / don gyis stong ba/ nor gyis dbul ba/ chu yis gang ba/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa/gangs kyis mdzes pa/ don gyis thob pa/ dri mas gos pa lta bu de dag

184 rdo rje rgyal po'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/sum rtags mang che ba'i nang la bshad mi 'dug der brten rgan lags kyis de dag skor yang gsung rgyu'i re ba yod/lan/ thon mi'i sum cu pa'i gzhung du/ de nyid la ni bcu pa spya ra/ /byed pa po ru shes par bya/ /zhes 'brel sgra'i skabs kyi gi kyi gyi 'i yi lnga po de dag la rjes 'jug bcu pa sa yig sbyar bas gis kyis gyis 'is yis lnga po de ming gang zhig gi mthar sbyar rung sbyor yul de byed pa po yin par shes par bya zhes pa dang / rtags 'jug gi dka' gnad gsal ba'i me long du/ rnam dbye gang la sbyor yul des/ /nye 'gyangs gang du bya ba zhig /byas na gsum pa byed sgra ste/ /dper na bdag gis bshad lta bu/ /zhes byed pa po bdag gis bya ba byas pa bshad pa'i dper brjod las tha na byed pa po phal pa'am byed pa la byed sgra 'thob pa'ang bshad med kyang sum rtags kyi 'grel pa bal che bar bkra shis kyis pir gyisaceyi ge ris— pa lta bu byed pa po bkra shis dang byed pa pir gnyis kar byid sgra sbyor zhing bkra shis la byed po dang pir la byed pa po phal pa'am byed pha tsam zhes —zer/ de ltar zer dgos don ni bkra shis gang zag sems ldan mi yin pa dang pir ni beem po sems med lag cha zhig yin stabs byed pa po med na 5pir kho nas yi ge 'bri rgyu'i bya ba byed mi thub pas so/ /yang ngas bshad khyod kyis nyan lta bu ni nga dang khyod gnyis ka gang zag yin pas shod pa po dang nyan pa po zer/ chus 'khyer ser bas brdungs lta bu chu dang ser ba bem po la byed pa zer ba las 'khyer ba po dang rdung pa po mi zer de bzhin du chu dang ser ba byed par gyur pa'i skabs 'dir chu dang ser ba la

sum rtags skor gyi dri ba dris lan/ 185byed pa po phal pa'ang mi zer/ gang yin zhe na/ 'khyer ba dang brdung ba'i bya ba de dag chu dang ser ba rang gis byas pa las de las gtso che ba'i byed pa po gzhan zhig med sas so/ /de dag ni gzhung nas dngos su bstan pa'i byed sgra 'jug tshul yin gyi khyed kyi dri don nang gi chu yis gang ba/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ gangs kyis mdzes pa/ don gyis thob pa/dri mas gos pa zhes pa rnams rim pa lta/ra gang ba dang / khyab pa/ mdzes pa thob pa/ gos pa bcas kyi bya ba de dag chu dang / bsam/ gangs/ don/ dri ma bcas kyi byed pa las byung ba yin pas byed sgra de rigs rnam dbye gsum pa byed sgra dza khongs rang las ma 'das pa zhig yin zhing / snying pos dben pa dang / don gyis stong ba/ nor gyis dbul ba bcas kyi snying po dang /don/ nor rnams byod pa po'am byed pa sa/nga yang min kyang de dag la byed sgra re sbyar bas/ med pa'am ldog phyogs su gyur pa'i bya ba re byung ba bstan yod la brjod tshul du'ang rung bas snying po dang / don/ nor bcas byed par gyur pa yin la byed sgra 'di dag rnam dbye gsum pa rjes mthun pa zhig yin par ngos 'dzin dang 'grel bshad byas chog gzhan yang / 1 chang btung bas bzi/ dka' ba spyad pas 'bras bu thob/ bsam gzhigs byas pas don dngos rtogs lta bu byed sgra rgyu mtshan la 'jug pa dang / 2 bong bu las rta ldab mang pos mgyogs/ da lo'i thon tshad snga lo las ldab gcig gis mtho/ khyed las gang lo bcus/ rgan pa 'dug lta bu byed sgra khyad par ston par 'jug pa dang / 3 khyed kyis rtsis bzhes kyis khong la 'bul rogs gnang / hur btson gyis slob sbyong byed dgos/ gzab nan

186 rdo rje rgyal po'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/gyis/ lta zhib kyis lta bu rnams khyed kyis rtsis bzhes te khong la 'bul rogs gnang / hur brtson byas te slob sbyong byed dgos/ gzab nan byas te lta zhib kyis lta bu byed sgra mtshams sbyor lhag bcas la 'jug pa dang / 4 ngas bshad kyis khyod kyis nyon lta bu byed sgra phyi tshig 'dren byed du 'jug pa dang / 5 lhun gyis grub/ rim gyis chags/ lhang gis dran lta bu rnams byed sgra de dag grub tshul sogs kyi rnam pa ston byed du 'jug pa bcas kyang yod mod/ 'on kyang de dag gi phrad kyis dang gis zhes pa de dag byed sgra'i phrad yin pa tsam las byed sgra ma yin pa'i don gzhan re co/ sor ston pa de ltar du ngos 'dzin dgos pa las de dag kyang rnam dbye gsum pa byed sgrar 'khrul mi rung ngo //26 dri ba/ rjes 'jug na ra la gsum gyi rjes su yang snying yang 'jug da yod med tshod dpag byed khag po 'dug yig rnying nang la'ang gcig gyur byung mi 'dug dper na/ karma si tu'i sum rtags 'grel chen nang la kun gyis dang kun kyis dang / yin rnging dang yin yang zhes pa gnyis re thon te gcig gyur byung mi 'dug de bzhin rang re'i 'gyur yig la'ang gcig gyur byung mi 'dug de dag gcig gyur yong ched rgan lags kyis da drag skor la'ang gsung rgyu'i re ba yod/lan/ da drag 'jug yul ni rjes 'jug na ra la gsum yin cing sbyor tshul thad spyir btang yi ge'i klog tshul sgra gdangs dag pa'am gsal por 'don thub mkhan zhig gis bklags na bstan bya'i don dang bsgyur

suca/ togaṭa5 skor byi / dri ba dris la'o// 187bya'i skad/ bsnyal ba'i bu lta bu'i bstan dang / bsgyur/ bsnyal bcas sgra gdangs zhan pa dang / don bstand/ skad bsgyurd/ bu bsnyald pa lta bu'i bstand dang bsgyurd dang bsnyald bcas sgra gdangs drag pa dang / don ston no/ skad sgyur ro/ bu snyol lo lta bu'i ston dang / sgyur/ snyol bcas sgra gdangs zhan pa dang / don stond cigaskad sgyurd cig bu snyold cig lta bu'i stond dang / sgyurd/ snyold bcas sgra gdangs drag pa yod pas bya tshig dus gsum skul tshig bcas su dbye skabs bstan bya ston byed bstand/ stond cig bsgyur bya sgyur byed bsgyurd/ sgyurd cig bsnyal bya snyol byed/ bsnyald/ snyold cig ces lta bu rnams la/ 'das la bas 'phul yang 'jug yod/ /da lta ba la gnyis ka med/ /ma 'ongs 'phul yod yang 'jug med/ /skul tshig 'phul med yang 'jug yod/ /ces pa ltar dbye 'byed byed bde po yod cing ming tsam dper na/ mi kund rab 'byord pha rold lta bu yig rnying la da drag yod la ngag nas 'don skabs sgra gdangs la'ang yang 'jug gi sgra thon gyi 'dugayin kyang dang yin yang la cha mtshon na rang nyid kyi klog tshul du yind kyang zhes da drag yod pa ltar bklags na brjod bde zhing / yin yang zhes bklags na shin tu brjod mi bde ba zhig 'dug 'on kyang slar bsdu 'i skabs yind to zhes da drag yod pa dang / yin no zhes da drag med pa gnyi 5 rjod bde lod khyad par med pa lta bu 'dug pas nga rang yang rkang pa nyis 'dzugs su lus yod/ de'i rgyu mtshan ni sgra drag zhan gyi khyad par de so so'i klog stangs sgra dag min gyi khyad par dang yul skad kyi skad gdangs la
