188 rdo rje rgyal po'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/khyad par yod pa'i dbang gis yig rnying la'ang ngos bzung dka' ba yod pas na deng skabs yig thog tu da drag 'bri rgyun dor zin pas gcig nas sa/nyis brgyud du 'bri rgyun dngos su mthong rgyu med pas gang la da drag thob dang / gang la da drag mi thob pa'i gdang tshod rnyed dka' ba byung ba red/'on kyang bya tshig dus gsum skul tshig dang bcas pa'i sbyor tshul nges gtan de 'phyugs na don la'ang 'phyugs skyon yong nyen che bas gzab datho/sa pa las gzhan dag la sbyor tshul 'phyugs kyang don phyin ci log tu mi 'gyur bas gnad cher ma mchis snyam pas dris lan de tsam du rdzogs so//gong gsal dri don gsum gyi skor rnyog 'dzing che bas yig srol gsar rnying mang por zhib 'jug gis dper brjod legs 'god dang 'brel gsal bshad byed par dus tshod ring tsam spyod dgos shing de lta'i go skabs ma thob pas snying sdom lta bu mdor bsdus 'di las byung ma song / 'dis khyed tsho'i dri don de dag thag gcod byed rgyur phan pa cung zad yod las che snyam/'on kyang phan thogs 'dug gam mi 'dug khyed rnams kyis gzab nan zhig gzigs dang / da dung kha gsab byed dgos pa dang gsal kha 'don dgos pa 'di 'dug dgos pa yod tshe ngas bskyar bcos byas chog/

189bod kyi sum rtags kyi dka' gnad 'ga' zhig brjod pa/ swasti/ chos kun gsal gzigs mkhyen pa'i spyan yangs shing / /kun la rab brtse'i 'dzum zhal bzhad pa'i ngos/ /rmongs mun yongs sel legs bshad 'od 'phro ba'i/ /sngon byon skyes chen rnams kyi rjes 'brangs te/ /shes bya kun la 'jug pa'i sgo gcig pu/ /lung rigs yon tan 'dod rgu 'byung ba'i gter/ /gangs can skad kyi brda sprod rig pa'i gzhi/ /yi ger grags de'i rtsa gnad cung zad spro/ /zhes sngon du 'gro ba'i tshig gi lam phye nas 'dir brjod par bya ba la/dang po/ bod kyi rig pa'i gzhung lugs spyi'i gnas tshul mdo tsam bshad pa/'jig rten gyi khams chen po 'dzam bu'i gling gi bye brag bod zal mo sgang pa zhes su grags pa gangs ri'i ra bas 'khor yug tu bskor ba'i ljongs 'di'i mi'i 'jig rten chags rabs kyi ngos nas bltas na chags phyi ba'i lkortsoma'adini1986lor lha shār 'tshogs pa'i bod kyi shes rig skor gros mol tshogs 'du'i thog rtsom pa pos sgrogs sbyang mdzad pa'i rang nyid kyi ched rtsom red/

190 rdo rje rgyal po'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/gras shig yin kyang / 'phags mchog phyag na padmo'i gdul bya'i zhing khams su gyur gshis lo rgyus thog spyi lo'i dus rabs bdun pa 'go tshugs tsam nas bzung chos rgyal mes dbon rnam gsum gyi thugs bskyed dang / thon mi sam bho ṭa la sogs pa'i lo tsā ba dang mkhas mchog rab dang rim pa'i bka' drin las rgya gar dang / rgya nag/ kha che/ bal po/ li yul/bru sha sogs kyi yul nas blangs shing bsgyur par ma zad/ legs par spel ba'i rig gnas dang / bod rang khongs kyi nyams myong thog nas bsags pa bcas phyogs bsgrigs te mi rigs kyi skad yig las grub pa'i rigs pa'i gzhung lugs te/ brjod bya'i don mtha' dag gi ming tshig brjod pa 'i gzhi rnams gtan la phab nas tshig sbyor la 'khrul ba tshar gcod pa'i sgo nas gang la ci dgos pa ji myo/ ji bzhin du lung ston pa'am brda sprod byed sgra rig pa dang / mngon sum dang rjes dpag tshad ma gnyis kyis gzhal te rang gzhan gyi rmongs pa dang 'khrul ba tshar bcad nas dngos po che phra so so'i ngo bo'am yin lugs gtan la 'bebs byed tshad ma rig pa/ blo rig pa dang lag rtsal spyad nas mkho rgu dngos po'i dpal yon spel byed bzo rig pa/skye 'gro'i sgyu lus kyi rten la nye bar 'tshe ba'i nad rigs bzhi brgya rtsa bzhir grags pa de dag 'gog sel dang 'brel yun du 'tsho ba'i thabs gso ba rig pa bcas thun mong ba'i rig gnas dang / lhag par du mi rnams kyi nyon mongs pa'i dug gsum sel nas rang gzhan gyi gtan bde sgrub thabs thun tsomong ma yin pa lam bslab pa gsum dang / lung sde snod gsum du grags gnang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos lugs rig pa bcas rig pa'i gnas che ba lnga sko

sum rtags kyi dka' gnad 'ga' zhig brjod pa/ 191dang / gzhun yang brjod bya'i gang dang gang rjod par byed pa'i tshig bcad lhug spel gsum gyi lus mdzes shing yid la 'bab pa zhig yong ba'i rgyan gyi bstan bcos snyan ngag dang / 'dra ba dang 'brel ba sogs rgyu mtshan du byas te tha snyad btags pa don gcig la ming gi rnam grangs mang por phye ba'am/ ming gcig don gyi rnam grangs du mar 'jug pa'i mngon badzood/rang rang gi skad ltar gyi tshig gi sbyor ba legs par sgrig thabs sdeb sbyor/'khrab bya'i nang don mi rigs gang zhig gi chas su zhus/sa pa de'i skad du skye bo rnams kyi bde sdug dang / mdza' brtse'am/ dga' khro/ byams sdang sogs nang blo'i 'gyur ba rnams phyi lus kyi nyams thog nas mtshon pamo bye da pa zlos gar dang / sa la ri mo bris nas nam mkha'i skar tshod thig ceri / pa ltar ston pa mya ngan las 'das khar chos rgyal zla ba bzang po la dus 'khor gyi rtsa rgyud gsungs pa'i phyi dus kyi 'khor lo las byung ba ang grangs kyi ri mos gzhal te nyi zla gza' skar dang / dus bzhi'i bgrod tshul sogs 'khor 'das kyi chos lkog gyur pa mtha' yas pa zhig dang / de 0sa/ gi 'bras bu ngo mtshar ldan pa'i sgo nas ston thub pa skar rtsi sa bcas rig nga 'i gnas chung ba lnga (rig gnas che chung bcu'i skor 'dir tshig tshogs ches dog0 5 kyes so so'i ming tsam las brjod med pas de dag gi bsdu don cung zad rtogs par 'byuosneod na kho bos brtsams pa'i〈〈snyan ngag gi rnam bshad gsal sgron/ 〉〉gyi shog grangs247par gzigs par 'tshal/ ) zhes brjod pa de dag mi rigs rang nyid kyi rig gnas rang skya 'pher ba sna 'dzoms la tshad mtho ba zhig dar zhing / bod kyi stobs shugs kyang 'dzam gling gi gsum cha gnyis la khyab pa zhig byung yod pa 'o/

192 rdo rje rgyal po'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/rgyus kyi deb ther mang po'i nang nas ra 'phrod rgyu yod pa de ltar yang / dus0rabs dgu par glang dar ma 'u dum btsan pos nus shugs gang yod bton nas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bsnubs shing / mthar kho pa rang yang lha lung dpal rdor gyis bsad rjes bod sil bur 'thor te chos srid gnyis brlag tu song bas bod ljongs la nyams nyes tshabs chen shor ba red/ dus rabs bcu gcig pa 'go tshugs pa nas bzung khams nas bla chen dgongs pa rab gsal sogs kyis sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa slar gso byas pa dang / rgya gar nas jo bo rje'i di paṃ ka ra'am dpal ldan a ti sha spyan drangs te 'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas dang lo tsā rin chen bzang po sogs kyis sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar bar byas pa ste/ bstan pa phyi dar zhes pa 'go tshugs shing / de ltar dus rabs bcu gsum par sa skya pa 'gro mgon chos rgyal 'phags pa'i dus skabs su bod khri skor bcu gsum gcig gyur byung ste chos srid spel ba dang / dus rabs bcu bzhi par rje tsong kha pa blo bzang grags pas dge ldan ring lugs dar spel ches cher mdzad pa/ dutra/ rabs bcurtebadun par rgyal dbang lnga pa chem/ pos chos srid kyi thugs 'gan bzhes pa tshosopo/sa kyi skabs bod kyi chos srid dang / rig gnas gzhan dag sogs gang ci nas je dar gyi dus skabs bzang po zhig byung bas rgyal ba'i bka' bstan 'gyur dang / bod rang gi skyes chen dam pa rnams kyi gsung 'bum/g.yung drung bon gyi bka' 'gyur sogs rig pa'i gzhung lugs kyi gter mdzod par ma dang bris ma pod grangs bsam gyis mi khyab brjod kyiṭa/ mi langs pa 'i/ga phyogs kun tu khyab nas yod cing / de da ga nyams su/ blangasachu

sum rtags kyi dka' gnad 'ga' zhig brjo da pa/ 193 nas lag len mthar phyin bstar thub mkhan ming gnas sna tshogs thob yod pa'i mkhas pa'ang yongs khyab dang zam ma chad pa yod pa bcas mi rigs kyi rig gnas kyi rmang gzhi nyams dman mi dgos pa zhig yod pa don dngos thog nas gsal rjen du mngon pa ltar yin kyang / 'dzam gling spyi'i spyi tshogs 'phel rgyas 'gro tshul dang bsdur nas bltas na bod 'dir spyi sgos bkas bkod brgyud 'dzin lam lugs kyi 'ching rgya dang gnya' gnon 'og lus pa'i dbang gis deng rabs tshan rig lag rtsal thad dar rgyas shin tu zhan pa'i rjes lus su gyur yod thog nye dus g.yon lhung gi shugs rkyen dang / lhag par du‘‘rig gnas gsar brje chen po'i skabs dgon pa dang / dpe mdzod che chung / shes ldan mi sna bcas la gtor bshig dang gnod skyon tshabs chen 'khel te rig gnas kyi dpe rnying pha la cher chu brlag tu gyur cing / shes ldan gyi mi sna rgan grasari 'das zad du gyur te nyung ri0sa shig las lhag med pa'i thog lo chung rnams la slob gso 2༷ bzhin ma byung ba'i rkyen gyis shes ldan mi sna dkon po skya zad sdo gtugs lta bur gyur pa bcas mdor na bod ljongs 'di nyid rgyal khab phyi nang gi mi rigs sna tshogs kyi nang rjes lus kyi gras su lhung yod pa'ang don dngos su gyur pas gnad don 'di'i thad thag gcod ma byas thabs med dang / de'ang mi rigs rangasminyid kyi rig gnas rnying pa'i rmang gzhi rgyun 'dzin dang / brtag dpyad zhib 'jug nyams pa sor 'chud ma nyams gong 'phel bcas ma byas na deng rabs kyi tshan rig lag rtsal sogs kyi shes bya dar rgyas yong thabs med pa de'ang don dngos su gyur par brten krung go'i gung khran ta nga ge 'go khrad

——1lo phro rdorjergyal po'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/yang dag pa'i 'og sa gnas tshang mar slob grwa chung 'bring che gsum rim 'dzugs dang 'brel slob gso'i bya bar thugs 'khur che bzhes gnang bar ma zad/ rgyal khab kyi 'gro gron la 'dzems med kyi sgo nas bod kyi rig gnas slar gso dang gong 'phel yong ched bod kyi rig gnas la zhib 'jug byed mkhan las khungs kyang khag mang ched 'dzugs mdzad cing / da lam bod ljongs dang spun zla'i zhing chen khag nas phebs pa'i mkhas dbang dang / shes yon can 'dus pa'i gros tshogs 'di dngos su tshogs thub pa byung ba 'di ni bod rigs mi dmangs tsam du ma zad/ spun zla'i mi rigs gzhan dag rnams kyis kyang dga' spro dang dga' bsu zhu nges shig red snyam/ da lam gyi gros tshogs 'di tsam du ma zad/ rang cag rig gnas kyi bya ba byed mkhan rnams kyis tang dang rgyal khab kyi dgongs bzhed 'grub pa 'i/ga dang / mi dmangs mang tshogs kyi re ba skong thub pa zhig yong ched du nge7/nga gsal rig pa'i gnas bcu phrag de dag nyams pa sor 'chud ma nyam sa gong 'phel gyi sgo nas rang rgyal gyi deng rabs can bzhi myur ba nyid du mngon du 'gyur thabs la blo gros kyi rtsal yod rgu rtsal sprug dgos pa smos ma dgos pa zhig red/gnyis pa/ shes bya rig pa'i gnas de dag gi gzhi ma yi ge'i dgos pa bshad pa/'jig rten pa'i ngag rgyun du/ ‘‘yi ge yon tan kun gyi gzhi ma yin7

sumatagasakyidaka'agand 'ga' zhog ba rjod pa/ rke 195zhes grags pa dang / thon mi sam bho ṭas sum cu pa'e rtsom par dam bca' bar/ ‘‘bslab pa kun gyi gzhi 'dzin cing / /rig byed smra ba rnams kyi rgyu/ /ming tshig brjod pa kun gyi gzhi/ /yi ge'i sbyor ba bshad par bya/ /’’zhes dang / mjug tu/ ‘‘bslab la brtson pa'i gang zag gis/ /dang po nga ro rnams la sbyang / /sdon 'jug ming gzhi rjes 'jug gsum/ /klog gi ched du bslabs pa yin/ /rjes 'jug bcu yi sbyor ba ni/ /mnyan bsam bstan pa'i ched du sbyar/ /yan lag de dag mthu yis ni/ /'bras bu'i ched du don la dbab/ /bslab pa'i rim pa 'di yis ni/ /gang zhig 'bad pa chung ngus kyang / /shes rab myur du grol bar 'gyur/ /de phyir dang por 'di nyid bslab/ /de nas rgyas pa'ang mnyan byas te/ /gzhung nyid bla ma dag las mnyan/ /’’zhes dang /gsar rje'i slob dpon le nyin gyis〈〈gzhon nu tshogs pa'i las 'gan/ 〉〉zhes pa'i nang‘‘yig rmongs kyi rgyal khab gcig nang gung khran ring lugs kyi spyi tshogs 'dzugs mi thub’’ces dang / blo mthun ma'o tse tung gis ‘‘rig gnas med pa'i dmag dpung ni dmag dpung glen pa zhig red/ dmag dpung glen pa zhig yin na dgra bo pham pa zhig bzo mi thubari’ ces bstan pa ltar yi ge ni ji snyed pa'i shes bya mtha' dag ji bzhin du brda sprod pa'am lag len thog nas thob pa'i nyams myong bzang po rnams gzhung lugs su bsgrigs nas 'chad spel sogs gang byed kyang med du mi rung ba zhig yin cing / de'ang rjod byed kyi brda ni mi rigs rang nyid kyi skad las grub dgos pa zhig yin pas sgra gdangs sam sbyor tshul de mi rigs so so'i sgra

196 rdo rje rgyal po'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/gdangs sa/ma sbyor tshul dang gcig mthun zhig ma byung na go brda mi 'phrod pa'am go brda ji bzhin mi 'phrod pa ni smos ci dgos/ de'i thad la brda sprod pa'i gzhung lugs kyi gzhi'am rtsa ba nyag cig tu gyur pa yi ge 'jug pa'i gnas brgyad ces pa de gal shin tu che bar mthong nas sngon chad kyang sbyang bshad thengs 'ga' zhig byed myong ba ltar da lam gnad 'dus la go bde ba zhig ba jod par bya'o//gsum pa/ yi ge 'jug pa'i gnas brgyad bshad pa/spyir yi ge zhes pa ni 'jug pa'i gnas brgyad la brten dgos pa red/ brgyad po de gang dang gang yin zhe na/ sgra dang / skad dang /ming dang / mtshan ma dang / brda dang / tha snyad dang / tshig dang / don bcas so//dang po sgra ni/ rna shes kyi mnyan bya de yin/ de la dbye na/mngon sum kun 'dus las/ ‘‘sgra ni rnam pa brgyad yin te/ ’’ zhes gsungs pa ltar spyir zin pa (sems ldan)las byung ba'i sgra dang / ma zin pa (sems med)las byung ba'i sgra gnyis yod cing / de dag re re la'ang lung du sto/na pa dang mi ston pa gnyis re dang / snyan pa dang mi snya na pa sa/nyis re ste brgyad de/ dang po zin pa'i 'byung ba las gyur pa'i sgra zhes pa skyes bu'i dbang pos/ bzung ba ngag gi sgra dang / thal mo brdabs pa'i sgra lta bu ste de yang lung du ston pa ni skyes/ bu'i ngag nas bshad pa'i sa/tam /khyod su yin/ las ci byed lta bu brjod bya'i don ston pa'i sgra yin zhing / de la

sum rtags kyi dka' gnad 'ga'azhigabarjodab/ 197 — jo da byed kyi sgra'am rnam par rig byeno kyi sgra'ang zer/ sgra de la don gyi cha naṭashrī snyan pa bslab bya dang snying gtam lta bu dang / mi snyan pa 'bar sha dang tshig rtsub lta bu gnyis yod pa dang / lung du mi ston pa ni skyes bus thal mo brdabs pa'i sgra'am rnga brdungs pa'i sgra lta bu ste de ni sgra zhig sgrog pa tsam las brjod bya'i don ston pa'i nus pa med pa zhig yin pas lung du mi ston pari sgra zhes zer/ lung du mi ston pa'i sgra de la'ang snyan pa skyes bus pheg rdob dang pi wang brdungs pa'i sgra lta bu dang / mi snyan pa khu tshur gyis deg pa'am rdog 'phul gyi sgra lta bu gnyis yod pa bcas rnam grangs bzhi dang / gnyis pa ma zin pa'i 'byung ba las gyur pa'i sgra zhes pa ni skyes bu'i dbang pos ma bzung ba sgra sdud 'khor lo'i sgra'am chu sgra lta bu ste/ de yang sgra sdud 'khor los srid byus dang gsar 'gyur sogs dril bsgrags byed pa lta bu ni brjod bya'i don ston pa'i sgra yin zhing / de la lung du ston pa'i sgra zhes zer la/ lung du ston pa'i sgra phal pa tsam zhig yin/ de la'ang rjod byed kyi sgra'am rnam par rig byed kyi sgra 'e/sa brjod chog sgra de la'ang don gyi cha nas snyan pa legs bshad dang rgyal kha'i gsar 'gyu ra lta bu dang / mi snyan pa—gtam ngan dang tshig rtsub lta bu gnyis yod pa dang /lung du mi ston pa ni 'brug sgra dang chu sgra lta bu ste/ de dag ni sgra zhig sgrog pa tsam las brjod bya'i don ston pa'i nus pa med pa zhig yin pas lung du mi ston pa'i sgra zhes zer/ de la'ang sgra sgrog tshul snyan pa dang mi snya na pa gnyis yod pa bcas bzhi ste khyon bsdoms sgra 'i rnam grangs brgyad yod/sgra'i rnam grangs 'byed skabs lung du ston pa dang mi ston pa dzas / redzi na

198 rdo rje rgyal po'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/stangs la rnyog gleng cher med kyang / snyan pa dang mi snyan pa ngos 'dzinanestangs thad 'dir sa bcad tsam zhig bstan pas 'thus pa byas shing / zhib par phye na sgra dang don/ spyi dang bye brag rang dang gzhan gyi 'dod dbangahosogs las 'byung ba brjod kyis mi langs pa rnams rigs pas dpag par 'tshal lo//da ni lung du ston pa'am rjod byed kyi sgra las spros pa cung zad bshad par bya ba la/ yi ge'i sgra ni zin pa'i sgra sems can du lung ston pa'o/ /sgra de sgrub byed dam mtshon byed ni yi ge yin la/ yi ge'i ngo bo ni skad kyitsho gdangs kho na yin/ yi ge zhes pa de rgyu gang las byung zhe na/ tshad ma rnamake'agrel las/ ‘‘yi ge kun slong shes pa las/ /skye zhing shes pas sgra skye'o/ / zhes dang / dpang lo tsā bas‘‘rnam rtog dbang gis rlung g.yos shing / /de yis gnas dang byed pa dang / /rtsol ba bskyed de dbugs dbyung dang / /lhan cig yi ge'i gdangs rnams skye/ /’’zhesang gsungs pa ltar thog mar mi'i blo la yi ge'i rnam pa shar ba'i rtog pa skye zhing / de skyes na yi ge brjod par 'dod pa'ipyikun slong skye/ kun slongang des bskul ba na nang gi rlung g.yos te rlung des gnas dang / byed pa dang rtsol ba rnams bskyed de dbugs dbyung ba dang lhan cig tu yi ge so so'i rnam pa'am sgra'i rnam 'gyur skye bar 'gyur ro//'o na sgra'i rnam 'gyur de dag ji lta bu yin zhe na/ spyir yi ge zhes pa ni sgra gzhir byas pa la gnas rnams su lce sogs bskyod pa las byung ba'i rnam 'gyur tsam yin/ dper na/ gzhi shing gcig la shing bzo ba'i 'du

sum rtatha/ sa kyi dka' gnad 'ga' zhig brjod pa/ 199 byed kyi dbang gis zlum po dang / gru bzhi la sogs pa'i rnam pa sna tshogs yong ba bzhin du gzhi sgra gcig yin kyang gnas dang byed pa'i nus pa 'a sa yi ge'i sgra gang la ci dgos pa rnams 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /de dag bskyar bzlos shig byas nas bshad na yi ge'i rgyu ni gnas dang / byed pa dang / rlung dang / rnam par rtog pa'am rnam par shes pa ste bzhi las 'byung ngo / /de dag gis rgyu ji ltar byed ce na/ dril bu'i sgra dper bzung nas bshad na 'di ltar te/ gnas ni gzhi'i rgyu ste/ dril bu'i khog pa lta bu'o/ /byed pa ni 'byin par byed pa'i rgyu ste/ dril bu'i lce lta bu'o/ /rlung ni bskyod par byed pa'i rgyu ste/ lag pa lta bu'o/ /rnam rtog gam rnam shes ni skul byed pa'i rtsa ba'i rgyu ste/ dril bu 'khrol bar byed pa'i skyes bu lta bu'o//'dir gleng bar bya ba ni rang cag bod gangs can pa'i yi ge yin cing / bod yig la dbye na dbyangs dang gsal byed ces rigs gnyis yod pa red/ de dag la ci'i phyir dbyangs dang gsal byed ces zer zhe na/ sgra tsam dang nga ro tsam gyi nang gses khyad par ma gtogs gam/sa dang byed pa'i rnam 'gyur gsal por mi ston pa der dbyangs sam a li'i yi ge zhes dang / gnas dang byed pa'i rnam 'gyur gsal zhing / mchu sogs 'byed 'dzum gyi dbang gis sgra'i khyad par cung zad gsal bar ston par byed pa'i khyad par can du gyur pa de dag la gsal byed dam ka li'i yi ge zhes zer ro//'o na bod yig la dbyangs gsal rnam grangs ji tsam yod ce na/

200 rdo rje rgyal po'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/dbyangs kyi bya ba gsal por byed pa i u e o bzhi dang / gsal byed ka kha ga nga / ca cha ja nya/ ta tha da na/ pa pha ba ma/ tsa tsha dza wa/ zha za 'a ya/ ra la sha sa/ ha a bcas sum cu tham pa yod/ des bod skad kyi sgra 'dang gi yod pa red/ de lta bu'i dbyangs gsal gyi yi ge rnams ngag nas rjod skabs kyi sgra gdangs kyi gnas tshad ni/ rnam 'grel las‘‘yi ge bdag nyid kun mtha' yang / /mig 'dzum tshad du gnas pa yin/ /’’zhes gsungs pa ltar dbyangs gsal gyi yi ge rnams so sor ngag nas rjod pa'i sgra'i yun tshad ni mig 'byed 'dzum re'i yun tshad dang 'dra ba yin/ yi ge de dag 'byung ba'i lus kyi gnas ni/ smra sgosamatshon cha las/ ‘‘khog pa mgrin pa rkan dang lce / /sna dang spyi bo so dang mchu/ /’’zhes gsungs pa ltar yi ge'i gnas ni skyes bu'i khog pa dang /mgrin pa dang / rkan dang / lce dang / sna dang / spyi bo ste lce rtse'i steng phyogs dang / mchu bcas brgyad yod cing / de dag byed rtsol dar 'phrad tshul sogs ni sum rtags kyi gzhung si tu'i 'grel chen du tsand+ra pa'i yi ge'i mdo gzhir bzung nas bstan par/ gnas dang / byed pa dang / rtsol ba zhes gsum du phye zhing / bod kyi yi ge rnams la sbyor ba'i tshe so so'i gnas ni/ ka kha ga nga 'a ha a rnams kyi skye gnas mgrin pa dang / ca cha ja nya tsa tsha dza zha ya sha i e rnams kyi skye gnas rkan/ ta tha da na za la yornam/sa kyi skye gnas so/ pa pha ba ma wa u o rnams kyi skye gnas mchu/ ra yig gi skye gnas lce rtse dang nye ba'i spyi bo ste lce rtse'i steng phyogs bcas yin zhing / nga nya na ma rnams rang rang gi skye gnas su ma zad sna sgra dang bcas

sum rtags kyi dka' gnad 'ga' zhig brjod pa/ 201pa'o/ /gnas rnams ni gzhi'i rgyu ste/ dril bu'i sbubs dang 'dra'o/ /byid pa ni/ mgrin pa dang mchu las skyes pa rnams rang rang gi skye gnas kyi byed pa can dang / rkan las byung ba rnams lce'i dbus kyi byed pa can dang / so las byung ba rnams lce rtse'i byed pa can dang / ra yig ni lce rtse dang nye ba'i byed pa can bcas so/ /de rnams 'byin par byed pa'i rgyu ste/ dril bu'i lce dang 'dra'o//rtsol ba la phyi nang gnyis las phyi'i rtsol ba ni/ phyi rol du sgra thon pa lta bu'i byed rtsol dang ldan pa'i phyir te/ de la'ang thon che chung gi dbye bas ga nga ja nya da na ba ma dza wa 'a ya ra la ha a i u e o rnams sgra ldan dang /ka kha ca cha ta tha pa pha tsa tsha zha za sha sa rnams sgra med dang / sgra phyir dbyung ba'i tshe dbugs che chung gi khyad par gyis kha cha tha pha tsha zha sha sa ha a i u e o rnams srog chen dang / de min ka ga nga ca ja nya ta da na pa ba ma tsa dza wa 'a ya ra la rnams srog chung dang / srog chen de dag las zha za sha sa rnams rjod pa'i tshe dbugs dro bar 'byin pas dro ba'i yi ge'ang zer ro/ /nang ji/ rtsol ba ni/ mgrin pa gdangs nas brjod dgos pa'i a yig mtshogatogs pa'i srog chen gyi yi ge rnams phye ba'i rtsol ba can dang / a yig mgrin pa ma phye bar rjod pa'i phyir btsum pa'i rtsol ba can dang / yi ge'i gnas rnams 'du 'phrod kyi rtsol ba che ba'i phyir wa ma gtogs pa'i sde pa lnga'i yi ge rnams phrad pa'i rtsol ba can dang / 'du 'phrod kyi rtsol ba de dag las lho/da pa'i phyir ya ra la wa rnams cung zad phrad pa'i rtsol ba can no/ /rtsol ba ni skyed par byed pa'i rgyu ste/ lag pa dang 'dra'o/ /des

202 rdo rje rgyal po'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/ོ/ yi ge de rnams so sor klog pa'i tshe so so'i gnas dang / byed pa dang /rtsol ba rnams dang mthun pa zhig gal che zhing / gsal byed la dbyangs yig sbyor skabs su'ang ka lta bu mgrin pa'i skye gnas can la i e mtshon byed gi gu dang 'greng bu sbyar bas rkan gyi skye gnas dang yang ldan par gyur pa sogs shes par byas nas de dang mthun pa'i klog tshul thon pa dgos so lhag par du dbyangs sbyar ba'i klog tshul ni dag pa shin tu gces par mthong ste/ khams phyogs kyi yul gru 'ga' rer na ro dang 'greng bu yod med kyi klog tshul tha dad du mi 'byung ba dang / 'ga' zhig tu zhabs kyu dang na ro klog tshul gcig tu byed pa sogs kyis mtshon ma dag par 'don pa mang zhing / des yi ge 'bri ba na'ang ma dag pa kho nar 'gyur ro/ /sbyor klog gi skabs su'ang 'phul rten dang mgo 'dogs kyi yi ge rnams so so'i sgra thon dgos pa ni/ rje btsun bsod nams rtse mos‘‘gang dang gang la gang btags pa/ /go rim bzhin du gnas nas dbyung / /de la ra ma go lce rtse 'dar/ /la mgo lce glod rgya yang bskyed/ /sa mgo so yi bar nas dbyung / /lhag ma rnams kyang de bzhin shes/ /gal te ma phyin gyur pa na/ /yi ge phral zhing brjod par bya/ /dper na gra la ga ra 'am/ /sgra la sga ra ji bzhin du/ /de nas 'phul ba bslab par bya/ /gas 'phul thog ma/ra rkan nas dbyung / /das 'phul lce rtse glod pa las/ /ba ma sa 'phul ba thog mar ni/ /mchu btsum pa las khyad par sna/ /'as 'phul gre ba'i phug nas dbyung / /'phul zhing brtsegs pa'i yi ge yang / /

sum rtags kyi dka' gnad 'as/'a zhig brjod pa/ 203go rim bzhin dbyung ma phyin na/ /'di yang phral zhing bklag par ste/ /mkhra la mkha' ra ji bzhin no/ /’’zhes sogs gsungs pas kyang grub mod/ sdon 'bri khung du skyob pa rin po che bzhugs pa'i tshe gna' bo'i dus bzhin du yig klog tshun chad kyang brtsegs 'phul sogs kyi sgra zur phyin pa ra 'don pa'i srol bzang po byung bar grags pa dang / khams phyogs kyi mtha' a mdo dang rgya mo rong sogs byang shar gyi sa cha rnams su 'khod pa'e skye bo dag la'ang gna' bo'i dus su bod yul dbus nas byung ba'i klog tshul ma nyams pa yin par grags pa'i yi ge klog tshul dang / de dag gi yul skad bcas la'ang gyong nyams che tsam las 'phul rten sogs kyi sgra zur dag rtsopar 'don pa 'byung ba mngon sum gyis grub pa sogs kyis kyang mtshon nus so//gzhan yang bod yig gi sdeb ji ltar sbyor ba'i tshul ni sngon gyi bod skadatshadag pa nyid la rjod pa'i sgra ji ltar 'byung ba de ltar mkhan po saṃ bho ṭas sbyar ba yin pas/ skad la 'phul rten sogs kyi sgra zur gsal ba med pa yi ge la de ltar thob pa rgyu mtshan gang zhig gis rtogs par nus/ des na gna' bo'i dus su yig klog tsam du ma zad bod skad nyid la'ang sgra zur thams cad ma nyams par 'don pa zhig yod pa nges kyang / deng sang bod yul dbus mtha' phal che bar rang skad dang yig klog gnyis kar sgra dag par 'don pa med par brten mkhas pa'i khrod na'ang yig gzugs kyi sdeb sbyor dgo/ po phyin klog tshul de dang nges par bstun mi dgos bsams pa'am/ sdeb sbyor ni yi ge 'bri ba'i dbang du byas kyi brjod pa'i dbang du ma byas snyam pa'am

204 rdo rje rgyal po'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/klog tshul yig sdeb dang bstun dgos kyang phyogs tsam las yi ge'i sdeb ji lta bar sgra zur thon pa ni sngar yang ma byung zhing da lta'ang 'don par mi nus so snyam pa mang du yo da par dogs pa dang / legs sbyar gyi skad du rjod pa'i skabs su'ang gangs can gyi brda sbod gzhung lugs shes par rlom pa phyis byung rnams kyis sngags kyi klog tshul zhes brda sprod kyi gzhung dang gtan nas 'gal ba re la yid brtan 'cha' zhing dbyangs gsal gyi mtshams sbyor las byung ba'i rnam 'gyur de rnams yig gzugs kyi skabs su ma gtogs brjod pa ji lta bar sbyor mi nus snyam par 'dug pa ni ya cha'o//des na rang nyid kyis sgra dag par bklag ma shes pa'am ma nus na yang / klog tshul yang dag pa med do zhes brjod par mi bya bar lung dang rigs pa'i dpyad zhib yang dag par byas te sbyor klog gi tshul dngos ji ltar bya ba'ang 'phul can rnams la bshad spe thag pa ltar 'phuldobyed kyi yi ge skerang rang gi skye gnas dang mthun pa'i sgra po ga mar dbyung dgos shing mgo skecan dang 'dogs can rnams la'ang mgo 'dogs kyi yi ge so so'i gnas dang mthun pa'i brjod pa'i sgra so sor dbyung dgos/ dper na/ sgra lta bu la sa ga ra rnams rim par ra nga sgra thon tsam du myur bar klog pa lta bu dang /'a mtha' can phal cher rten byed kyi sgra mi gsal bas de dag ma gtogs gsal bar snang ba'i mtha' rten yang 'jug med pa rnams ni rten yig so so/'i gnas dang mthu na pa'i sgra rjes su rabyung ba dang ya nga 'jug can la ṭashaṃ yig gi yang 'jug can ni pha rol tu tshig grogs gzhan med na sa sgra dngos su mi sa/sa/ la ya nga sgra de 'byung bar nye ba lta burmo sdo klog cing / tshis/ spyogs

suspa rtags kyi dka' gnad 'ga' zhig brjod pa/ 205yod na rjes 'jug snga ma de'i sgra zur gyi rjes su sa sgra thon par dbyung dgos rtsopa dang / da yig gi yang 'jug can ni tshig grogs la bltos mi dartso/sa par rjes 'jug snga ma'i sgra'i mthar da'i sgra 'byung la khad tsam sgra bsnan pa lta bur baglag pa yin no//des na skad gsar bcad kyi dus su 'a mtha' phal cher dang da drag bsdus pa'ang de dag gi sgra brjod pa la ha cang mi gsal bas yin par snang ngo / /de ltar yi ge klog tshul dag par 'dod pa rnams la phyogs tsam smos par zad kyi rgyas par smos su mi langs shing 'di tsam bstan pas kyang kya khya gya rnams dang / spya phya bya rnams dang / ca cha ja rnams phyogs mchungs par klog pa dang / brgya bskya rgya skya/ gya sbya ji rnams mtshungs par klog pa dang / rnga snga dang lnga mnga' rnams mtshungs par klog pa sogs 'khrul ba 'byams klas pa rnams kyi mtshang rig par nus so/ /’’ zhes gsungs pa de dag blor nges pa dang / go don rtogs pa/ lag len du 'khyol ba bcas byed dgos pa ni brda sprod pa'i gzhung lugs kyi shes bya'i rtsa ba'am rmang gzhi med du mi rung ba de yin pas gal shin tu che'o//yi ge'i gzugs ni/ mdo rgya che rol pa las/ lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo'i rtsa'adabs kyi grangs dang mtshungs par drug cu rtsa bzhi tsam bshad yod kyang / don du yul phyogs so so'i skad dang mthun pa'i yig sna ji snyed cig mchis pa las rang cag gangs can par nye bar mkho ba'am spyad bya ni bka' drin gyi mnga' bdag thon mi saṃbho ṭas 'phags yul gyi lañtsa la dpe blangs nas dbu chen dang / wartu la dpe blangs nas 'bru ma'am dbu chung mdzad

206 rna rje rgyal po'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/ cing / de gnyis las gyes pa'am khongs su gtogs pa shar ma dang /'bru ma/ khyug ma/ dkrugs yig ang yig sogs yod pa 'di dag red/smra sgo mtshon cha las/ ‘‘rnam grangs du ma med pa dang / /ming tshig gsal bar byed pa dang / /don rnams rjod par byed pa'i phyir/ /yi ge zhes ni brjod pa yin/ /’’zhes gsungs pa ltar ro//gnyis pa skad ni/ yul phyogs so so dang / mi rigs so sor skad re yod pa red/ des na 'dzam gling 'dir skad rigs mi gcig pa sum brgya drug cu tsam yod par grags shing / de'ang zhib mor phye na skad rigs so so'i nang gses yul skad dang bcas stong phrag brgal ba zhig yod nges/ kyang / sngar rgya gar gyi skad thams cad phyogs bsgrigs kyis bsdus na skad rigs chen po bzhir 'dus te de ni rgya gar du grags pa saṃ skṛ ta legs sbyar lha'i skad ces pa'i bka' dang bstan bcos kyi don ji ma ji bzhin pa thun mong min par ston thub pa zhig dang / pra kṛ ta yul mi rang bzhin pa'i skad ces pa'i bya gzhag dar rgyas che ba grong khyer chen po rnams kyi skad dang / a wa rghaṃ sha zur chag gi skad ces yul skad cha mi tshang ba rnams dang / pi sha tsi sha za'i skad ces pa'i shes rig dar rgyas med pas bskal pa ya thog gi rnam par lus pa klo pa lta bu'i skad bcas bzhi yod cing / yang snyan ngag me long ba/zhung gi dbye tshul ltar na legs sbyar dang / rang bzhin dang / zur chag dang / 'dres ma bcas bzhi'o/ /de'ang mdor bsdus na gsung rab ste bka' dang bstan bcos kyi brjod don ston nus pa saṃ skṛ ta'i skad la legs sbyar zhes gtso bo dang / gzhan rnams zur chag gi khongs gcig

sum rtags kyi dka' gnad 'ga' zhig ba rjod pa/ 207tu bsdu'o/ /〈〈snyan ngag me long〉〉las‘‘bstan bcos rnam/sa la legs sbyar las/ /gzhan rnams zur chag nyid du 'dod/ / ’ces bshad pa ltar ro//'o na bod skad 'di gang gi khongs su 'du zhe na/ sngon gyi mkhas pa 'ab/'a zhig gis 'byung po sha za'i skad yin zhes gsungs yod kyang / zha lu lo chen kyi bzhed par legs sbyar rang du ngos 'dzin mdzad yod pa red/rang nyid kyi lta tshul ltar na/ thon mi sam snyo ṭas srol gtod cing / sngon byon tho pan rnams kyis blo gros kyi rtsal bton thog bkas bcad nas gtan la phab pa'i bka' bstan 'gyur sogs yig thog tu spyod cing bod rigs yongs khyab kyis gleng med du khas len pa deng sang yig skad ces zer ba 'di legs sbyar dang / skye bo'i 'du tshogs che la rig gnas gang ci dar rgyas che ba'i grong khyer gyi skad rnams rang bzhin dang / yul gyi mtha' mtshams sam lung khug spyi tshogs dar rgyas zhan pa'i skad rnams zur chag dang / skad de dag phar 'dres tshur 'dres lta bur gyur pa'i skad rnams 'dres ma bcas su gzung bar bya 'os snyam/gsum pa ming ni/ mngon pa'i lugs la yi ge du ma 'dus pa'i bdag nyid can don gyi ngo bo tsam ston pa zhig yin zhing / 〈〈smra sgo mtshon cha〉〉las kyang / ‘‘gang /nig rnam cha 'dus pa yis/ /don gyi ngo bo nyid brjod na/ /rnam cha mang ngam nyung gyur kyang / /de ni sding zhes rab tu brjod/ /mi’ces bstan pa ltar gang zhig rnam cha ste yi ge'i rname grangs 'duṭa/ pa zhig gis don gyi ngo bo tsam ston na de ni ming zhes bya bar rab tu

208 rdo rje rgyal po'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/bajio da do zhes bstan pa ltar sa chu me rlung dang / nam ma/kha'/ rgya mtsho/mkhas pa legs bshad sogs lta bu don gyi ngo bo zhig ston nus na yi ge'i rnam grangs ji tsam dgos nges med cing / ming la dbye na rigs gnyis te/ sa chu me rlung dang / nam mkha'/ rgya mtsho sogs thog mar de la de ltar btags pa tsam las nges tshig brjod du med pa rnams la 'dod rgyal gyi ming ngam/ thog mar grub pa'i ming zhes dang / mkhas pa dang / le4/preska bshad sogs lta bu sngar yod 'dod rgyal gyi ming de dag la brten pa'am de dajika gzhir byas nas btags shing de ltar btags pa'i nges tshig gam rgyu mtshan brjod du yod pa rnams la rjes grub kyi ming zhes zer 'ing / khyi nag po la dung zhes btags pa lta bu ni rjes grub 'dod rgyal ba'ang zer ba bcas gnyis yod/ 'o na pha dang ma lta bu yi ge re res pha dang ddha/ so so'i ming sto/na thub pas/ nges par du yi ge du ma 'du dgos pa'i khyab par ci yod ce na/ de ltar ma red/ thon mi saṃ bho ṭas‘‘rjes 'jug bcu po ma zhugs na/ /ming gzhan sbyor ba yod mi srid/ /’’ces gsungs pa ltar pha' dang ma' zhes rjes 'artswag 'a yig re 'thob cing de med na ming du mi grub kyang skad gsar bcad kyi skabs su yig zor yang ba'i ched du bsdus te dngos su sbyor mi dgos pa byas pas rjes 'jug 'a de dag ma mngon pa las rjes 'jug med pa ma red/ des na pha dang ma zhes pa ni yi ge gnyis re 'dus nas ming grub pa dang / mtho dang dma' lta bu yi ge gsum 'dus nas ming grub pa dang / dga' ma dang mdza' bo lta bu yi ge bzhi re 'dus nas ming grub pa dang / bkra shis dang dar rgyas lta bu yi ge drug re 'dus nas

sum rtags kyi dka' gnad 'ga' zhig brjod ba/ 2kye9ming grub pa sogs yi ge mang po 'dus nas ming grub pa ji snyed pa rnams lta bu dang / yang ming gnyis gsum sogs 'dus nas don gyi ngo bo tsam ston pa'i ming grub pa'ang yod/ dper na/ bsod nams rgyal po lta bu ming gnyis 'dus nas mi gcig gi ming grub pa dang / spyi tshogs ring lugs lta bu ming gnyis 'dus nas spyi tshogs gcig gi ming grub pa dang / lcags zam chu bo ri lta bu ming gsum 'dus nas ri gcig gi ming grub pa darnga( //dmangs gtso'i ring lugs gsar pa lta bu ming gsum 'dus nas ring lugs gcig gi ming grub pa dang / krung hwa mi dmangs spyi mthun rgyal khab lta bu ming bzhi 'dus nas rgyal khab gcig gi ming grub pa dang / sum pa'i snying po legs bshad ljon pa'i dbang po lta bu ming mang po rnam dbye'i phrad dang bcas pas dpe cha gcig gi ming grub pa sogs kyang yod cing /tang zhes pa ming gcig chab srid kyi tshogs khag gang la'ang 'jug pa zhig dang / gung khran tang zhes gung khran ring lugs pa'i chab srid kyi tshogs khag gang la'ang 'jug pa zhig dang / krung go'i gung khran tang zhes ming gsum 'dus kyis chab srid kyi tshogs khag gcig ston pa'i ming grub pa rnams spyi dang bye brag mi 'dra ba so sor ston pa ming rkyang pa nas gsum brtsegs bar hril po re sgra bsgyur byas pa de dag la g.yar ming yang zer ba dang / krung hwa mi rigs lta bu phyed g.yar phyed sgyur byas pa dang / krung hwa mi dmangs spyi mthun rgyal khab lta bu tha snyad kyi 'go 'am gtso bo krung hwa sgra bsgyur dang byings rnams don bsgyur byas pa/ de min mar khe si dang /le nyin/ ma'o tse tung sogs rgyal khab phyi nang gi mi sna deng / pe cin

210 rdo rgyal po'i gsung rtsom phyogs barmigs/dang / lon ton/ mo si kho sogs sa ming sgra bsgyur byas pa mtha' yas pa zhig yod kyang / mdor bsdus na rang skad nas byung ba gong gari shrīl sa chu me rlung dang / nam mkha'/ rgya mtsho rnams lta bu 'dod rgyal gyi ming dang kto/mkhas pa dang legs bshad lta bu rjes grub gyi ming dang / tang dang gung khran tang / krung go gung khran tang lta bu rnams sgra bsgyur ram g.yar ming dang / krung hwa mi rigs dang / spung hwa mi dmangs spyi mthun rgyal khab lta bu sgra bsgyur don bsgyur bsres pa'am zud g.yar phyed bsgyur byas pa ming bcas bzhir 'du'o/ /ming 'dogs tshul gyi thad la da dung 'dra ba rgyu mtshan du byas nas btags pa legs bshad nor bu'i do shal zhes pa dang /'brel ba rgyu mtshan du byas nas btags pa yig bshad mkhas pa'i kha rgyan zhes pa dang / gzhung tshad kyi grangs bzung nas btags pa sum cu pa zhes pa sogs mang du yod kyang rigs su phye na gong gsal bzhi po de'i nang du 'dus so//bzhi pa mtshan ma ni/ rten la brten pa dang / brten pa la rten/ rgyu la 'bras bu dang / 'bras bu la rgyu/ bya ba la byed pa dang /byed pa la bya ba/ spyi la bye brag dang bye brag la spyi sogs sbyar nas brjod pa las don de dag gi mtshan ma ste thun mong ma yin pa'i rang rtags rnams so sor mtshon par byed pa'i snang ba skyes nus pa'i cha de'o/ /dper na/'bru son/ son 'bru/ yig lkogs/ lkogs shog/ ras khebs/ khebs ras/ bum chu/ chu bum/ mdung rtse/ mdung yu sogs lta bu dngos po gang dang gang gi khyad chos gsal por mtshon par byed thub pa'i ngag

sum rtags kyi dka' gnad 'ga'azhigabarjodapa/ 211—— de'o//lnga pa baja ji/ shing zhes brjod pa'i tshe yal ga dang lo 'dab can gyi rnam pa zhig dang / me zhes brjod pa'i tshe tsha zhing sreg pa'i rnam pa zhigachu zhes brjod pa'i tshe brlan zhing gsher ba'i rnam pa zhig mi zhes brjod pa'i tshe smra shes don go ba'i gang zag cig dud 'gro zhes brjod pa'i tshe glen zhing lkugs pa'i srog chags shig rnams don spyi'i tshul du nyan pa po dang / smra ba po gnyis ka'i blo la 'char bas na ming dang ming can 'brel bar byed pa'i sgra don mtshon nus pa ste go brda sprod nus pa 'dus byas kyi bdag nyid de'o//drug pa tha snyad ni/ bya ba dang dngos po gang zhig yin rung de'i —rang mtshan snyad du med bzhin du nan tan gyis btags shing / btags pa'i tha snyad kyi don de las don rang mtshan pa dngos la 'dor len byed pa'i shes pa ste/ dper na/ gdung 'degs kyi shing la ka ba zhes btags pas 'di ka ba yin no/ /snyam pa'i shes pa de ni btags pa'i shes pa dang / de la slar yang ka ba zhes ngag gi sgra la brjod pa ni brjod pa'i shes pa dang des gdung 'degs kyi bya ba la 'jug pa ni 'jug pa'i shes pa ste/shes brjod 'jug gsu ma tshang ba zhig skye bar byed pa'i gzhi brda sprad nas 'apod pa'i blo de'o//bdun pa dzig ni/ mngon pa ltar na ming du ma 'dus pa zhig dang / sgra pa ltar na ting dang sub kyi rkyen byin pa'i mtha' can zhig〈〈smra sgo mtshon cha〉〉las/ gal te ming gnyis 'dus pa'am/ /'on te mang po

— 212 rdorjergyal po'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/'dus kyang rung / /de dag khyad par ston byed na/ /tshig ces rab tu brjod pa ste/ /’’zhes bstan pa ltar tshig ces pa ni don gyi ngo bo tsam sto na rma ji/ga min par don gyi khyad par ston thub pa zhig dgos so/ /de na ming gnyis yan chad cig 'du dgos par ma zad/ phrad dang rnam dbye sogs ji dgos kyang bsnan nas don gyi khyad par ston pa'i tshig rang rkya —'pher ba zhig grub pa byed dgos/ dper na shog bu 'di dkar po red/lta bu ming gnyis 'dus pa'i tshig yin pa dang / khyed kyis bshad pa de bden pa red/ lta bu ming gsum 'dus pa'i tshig yin pa dang / deng skabs kyi dus bab ha cang yag po 'dug ces pa lta bu ming bzhi 'dus pa'i tshig yin pa dang / gzhan yang / nga rang tsho'i las don gyi 'go khrid byed mkhan gyi srog shing du gyur pa'i stobs shugs ni krung go'i gung khran tang —yin/ krung hwa mi dmangs spyi mthun rgyal khab ni mi rigs mang po yo da pa'i gcig gyur gyi rgyal khab cig yin/ zhes pa dag ni ming mang po 'dus shing rnam dbye dang tshig phrad kyang zhugs pa'i tshig re yin pa lta bu'o/ /de dag la rnam dbye dang tshig phrad kyang gang la ji dgos sbyar yod la de ltar ma sbyar na tshig tu mi grub pa'am grub kyang gsal po mi yong ba dang / lhag par du gsa'as byed kyi yi ge sumyo/ cu'i nang nas sngon 'jug dang rjes 'jug gi yi ge ga nga da na ba ma 'a ra la sa bcas bcu phud pa'i lhag ma ka kha ca cha ja nya ta tha pa pha tsha tsa dza wa zha za ya sha ha a bcas nyi shu po rnams tsaka lta bu gnyis sbrel dang / tshakhapha lta bu gsum sbrel dang / blaziya lta bu dbyangs yig dang bcas pa'i bzhi sbrel sogs ji tsam 'dus kyang don gyi khyad par ston

ji sumartagasakyi dka' gnad 'ga'azhigabarjodab/ 2130—pa'i tshig lta ci/ tha na ming tsam yang mi grub pa'i gnad rnams kyang zhib cing phra bar rtogs par bya dgos so// tshig la nang gses dbye na 'dzad mtha' med pa zhig yin kyang / de dag re re bzhin 'dir brjod kyis mi langs pas de dag gi nang nas rang cag la nye bar mkho ba nyung shas shig kha phyogs mtshon byed kyi dper brjod du bkod par/ gsal zhing 'od 'phro ba 'di ni ni sdu'o lta bu rnam dbye dang po ngo tsam brjod pa dang / ghri maXr kha gtad nas phyin/ lta bu rnam dbye gnyis pa las su bya ba ston pa dang / sbyi swās lus dros/ lta bu rnam dbye gsum pa byed pa po ston pa dang / sbyi swār sgron me'i gsal 'debs mi dgos lta bu rnam dbye bzhi pa dgos ched la dgag sgra zhugs pa ston pa/ ni maX nas 'od 'phros lta bu rnam dbye lnga pa 'byung khungs ston pa dang / ni maX'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'od gsal/ lta bu rnam dbye drug pa chos dang chos can 'brel ba ston pa dang / twe sdur 'od zer yod lta bu rnam dbye bdun pa rten gnas ston pa dang / ka ye grogs po sbyi swā ldes lta bu rnam dbye brgyad pa 'bod sgra dang sprags nas grogs po nyi ma lde bar skul ba ston pa bcas sum cu pa nas bstan pa'i rnam dbye brgyad so so dang / sbyar ba'i tshig tha dad pa re yin pa dang / bstad byā'i shiXng lta bu dngos po gzhan bya ba'i yul lam las ston pa dang / gcad par gi lta bu bya ba'i yul dang 'brel ba'i bya las gsal byed kyi tshig dang / gasdod pū po lta bu dngosi po bdag byed pa po ston pa dang / gasdod byed sdi rnye re rnye ༷bu byed po phal pa'am byed pa po ston pa dang / ga6coshe pand+ra ༷byesdu snya tshu byed pa po

214 rdo rje rgyal po'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/'brel ba'i byed las gsal byed kyi tshig rnams dang / shiXng bsad sbyin lta bu bya ba byas zin 'das pa ston pa dang / gardod bzhun paXm gswod ldi 'asag lta bu bya ba byed mus dang da lta ba ston pa dang / gartad gau'am gaXcad paXr brtsaXm sdo lta bu bya ba byed rgyu ma 'ongs pa ston pa bcas rtags 'jug skabs kyi bdag gzhan dus gsum ston pa'i tshig sogs mtha' dag tshig rigs mi 'dra ba re'o//snyan ngag gi skor nas bshad na/ khyod zhal blu byā bzhi—na du dkar/ /zhes pa lta bu dpe rgyan gyi chos dpe'i tshig rgyan dang / swānge skuX'i 'khri shi0nga rab sdem pa/ /zhes pa lta bu gzigs can gyi ma bsdus pa'i tshig rgyan dang / lho yi rlung gis 'khri shing gi/ /'dab sda rnying pa lhags par byed/ /dud pa'i lus can ma rnams kyi/ /khengs pa gsar du 'joms par byed/ /ces pa lta bu rigs brjod pa thog ma'i gsal byed kyi tshig rgyan dang / dga' ma khyod kyi nu ma dang / /dpyi yi bar na sked pa ni/ /༷da das medu twes bdag gi ni/ /the tshom da dung zlog ma gyur/ /zhes pa lta bu the tshom phul byung gi tshig rgyan sogs don rgyan dang / sgra rgyan gab tshig gi rgyan bcas ji snyed pa rnams kyang tshig gi nang gses re yin no/ /de dag ni mtshon byed tsam zhig yin/ gzhan yang / 〈〈smra sgo mtshon cha〉〉dang 〈〈dpang lo'i tshogs gsum gsal ba/ 〉〉 dge ba'i bshes gnyen dmu ge bsam gtan gyi〈〈brda sprod blo gsal dga' ston〉〉sogs brda sprod pa'i gzhung lugs gsar rnying rnams nas ji ltar bstan pa ltar rtos/sa par bya dgos so//gzhan yang yi ge'i sbyor ba la tshig sdud mang po zhig yod pas ma zad

sum rtagan kyi dka' gnad 'ga' zhig brjod / 215'chad tshul yang 'dra min sna tshogs shig yod pa de dag mtshon byed mkho gal che rigs phyogs tsam zhig phye na las 'dzin gyi bsdu ba dang / ba gnyis pa'i bsdu ba/ de'i skyes bu'i bsdu ba/ 'bru mang po'i bsdu ba/ zlas dbye ba'i bsdu ba/ mi zad pa'i bsdu ba bcas drug yod/dang po/ khyad gzhi khyad chos gzhi mthun par bsdu ba la las 'dzin gyi bsdu ba zer/ dper na/ utpal yang yin la sngon po'ang yin zer rgyu la sngi tpaXl sngon dzo zhes bsdu ba lta bu ste utpal khyad gzhi dang khyad chos sngon po gnyis gzhi mthun par bsdu ba lta bu'o//gnyis pa/ khyad gzhi bgrang bya dang / khyad chos grangs yin pa bsdu ba la ba gnyis pa'i bsdu ba zer/ lnga yang yin lam yang yin/ zer rgyu la lam sdu zhes bsdu ba lta bu'o//gsum pa/ ming tshig bar gyi rnam dbye gnyis pa lartsosogs pa'i rnam dbye drug po gang rung bsdu ba la de'i skyes bu'i bsdu ba zhes zer/ dper na/ rnam dbye gnyis pa bsdus pa ni/ grong la 'gro bar grod ྅gro lta bu dang / gsum pa bsdus pa ni/ rkang pas 'thung bar gīng 'asting zhes pa lta bu dang / bzhi pa bsdus pa ni/ lus stod mi 'khyag pa'i ched du gyon rgyu la stod gog lta bu dang / lnga pa bsdus pa ni/ chu las skyes pa la chu —skyekha lta bu rnong / drug pa bsdus pa ni/ rgyal po'i sras la rgyaldu sngas lta dzu dzwang /bdun pa bsdus pa ni/ yul du sdod mkhan la yusdu sdodu ces bsdus pa lta bu'o//bzhi pa/ 'bru mang po'i bsdu ba ni/ ming tshig gnyis sam mang po yin

216 rdo rje rgyal po'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/rung ma bsdus pa'i skabs kyi brjod bya las don zhig ston ched du bsdus pa'i bsdu ba la 'bru mang po'i bsdu ba zhes zer/ dper na/ shar dang lho zhes pa shār ༷ zhes bsdus pa lta bu ste ma bsdus pa'i skabs su shar dang lho'i phyogs sa/nyis ston cing bsdus na de gnyis ka ma yin par me mtshams ston pa lta bu dang / yang dper na/ padma dang 'dra ba'i bzhin ras zer rgyu la padma'i bswon raXs zhes bsdus pa lta bu ste/ ma bsdus pa'i skabs su padma dang 'dra ba'i bzhin ras mdzes pa ston cing / bsdus na me tog padma'i bzhin ras zer ba lta bur gyur yod kyang / 'di ni padma la bzhin ras zer ba med pas padma'i bzhin ras su mi 'khrul zhing bzhin ras mdzes pa padma lta bu zhig tu go ba lta bu'o//lnga pa/ zlas dbye ba'i bsdu ba ni/ ming gnyis sam mang po'ang rung bar gyi rnam dbye rnams bsdus nas thams cad kyi mthar rnam dbye gcig sbyar ba'i bsdus pa la zlas dbye ba'i bsdu ba zer/ dper na/ g.yas la bltas/ g.yon la bltas/ rgyab la bltas/ mdun la bltas/ zer rgyu la g.yas g.yon rgyab mdun kun la bltas/ zhes bsdus pa lta bu'o//drug pa/ mi zad pa'i bsdu ba ni/ dpang lo'i〈〈tshogs gsum gsal ba〉〉 yi nang du/ gang gi snga ma brjod byar gyur/ /mi zad gyur pa'am grangs med pa'o/ /zhes bstan pa ltar mi zad pa'am grangs med pa zhes pa don ston pa ming yin kyang rtags gsum gyi nges pa med pa de las rnam dbye rnams dbye ba sngon gyi lo tsā ba rnams kyis tshig phrad ces bya bar ming btags pa de snga mar bkaud cing de brjod bya'i gtso bor gyur pa'i tshig sdud

sum rtags kyi dka' gnad 'ga' zhig brjod pa/ 217ni kā mā par/ mi zad par gyur pa zhes dang / tsardo par grangs med pa zhes bya ba'i bsdu ba ste/ u pa kusnya zhes pa'i u pa nyer sgyur nye ba'i don can gyi mi zad pa ste/ tshig dang po na yod pa gtso bo yin pa lta bu'o/ /zhes pa bstan pa ltar legs sbyar gyi skad la sbyar nas bsdu ba byas na don gyi 'gyur ba gsal por thon pa zhig yong nges las/ rang cag bod skad la sbyar rigs pa dang / don gyi 'gyur ba'am khyad par gsal bar mtshon pa'i dper brjod nges rnyed ma mthong bas slad mar dpyad par bya'o//gzhan yang / tshig phrad kyi kyang yang 'ang gsum dang / te de ste gsum/ 'byed sdud kyi gam ngam dam nam bam mam 'am ram lam sam tam bcas bcu gcig spyi sgra'i ci ji su gang bzhi/ nges bzung gi sgra nyid kho na tsam gsum/ bdag sgra'i pa ba ma gsum/ gzhan yang ni sgra dang de sgra dang sgra sogs kyis kyang tshig thun mong min pa re re mtshon pa ji snyed cig mchis pa 'dir de dag re re bzhin dgod par ma nus pa rnams kyi dbye ba dang / 'jug tshul la'ang slob sbyong dang / zhib mjug nar mar dgos pa lags so//brgyad pa don ni/ 'jig rten gyi khams 'dir dar ba'i shes bya mtha' dag ste gnas luṭa spros pa'i mtha' dang bral zhing smra bsam brjod pa'i yul las 'das pa'i don nam bya ba thams cad de/ de dag la sgra skad la sogs gnas brgyad yod pa de dag la yi ge'i 'jug tshul ji ltar zhe na/ sgra don 'brel rung gi blos 'jug dgos/ blo de yang don du dmigs pa'i don spyi'i nus pa dang / sgra byung gis sgra spyi'i rnam pa dang / mthun snang dang thun mong du

218 rdo je rgyal po'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/grags pas zhen pa dang / mngon par zhes pas ming dang ming can 'brel ba skye bar byed pa bcas shig dgos shing de'i tshul yang go bde ba'i phyir dper brjod na/ gdung 'degs kyi shing lta bu zhig mthong ba'i tshe na thog mar 'di'i ming ci yin snyam pa dang / ka ba zhes pa'i sgra thos kyang da dung ka ba zhes pa 'di 'dra gang gi ming yin nam snyam pa'i the tshom las nges bzung med pa'i blo skye/ de'i tsha gzhan gyis go brda sprad ma thag ming dang ming can 'brel ba'i shes pa skye/ de mngon sum lta bur gyur nas phyis de dang 'dra pa'i rnam pa gang yin pa de nyid la mngon par zhen pa'i blo skye/ de las sgra don 'dres rung gi mngon zhen khong du chud par 'gyur bas na/ smra ba pos sgra rang mtshon pa brjod pa'i tshe nyan pa pos dang por sgra tsam gyi rnam pa dang / de nas don gyi rnam rtog de nas sgra don 'dres rung gi blo/ de las snang zhen gyi dmigs pa/ de nas mthun par snang ba'i shes pa/ de nas mngon par zhen pa'i blo tshugs thub pa lta bu tshul bzhin du skye ba yin la/thun mong du ma grags pa'i yul dbus kyi mis mtha' 'khob pa'i sgra brjod pa lta bu la ni yan lag ma tshang bas mtshan nyid 'di ltar dngos su mi yong ngo //de ltar yi ge 'jug pa'i gnas brgyad ces pa 'di nyid bod kyi brda sprod pa 'i bstan bcos 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum la 'jug par spro ba ldan pa'i blo ldan rnams kyi shes rig gi rmang gzhi yin stabs sngar pe cin mi rigs dpe skrun khang gi bod yig rtsom bsgyur pa blo mthun rnams kyi bzhed pa skong ba'i zhabs 'degs dang / blo gsar gzhon nu rnams kyi rig pa'i sgo 'byedadhe

sum rtags kyi dka' gnad 'ga' zhig brjod pa/ 219kyi slob tshan du sman pa dang / rig pa'i gnas lnga dpyis phyin pa'i mkhas pa rnams kyi dpyad gzhi'i sa bon du gyur te phra zhing zhib pa'i legs bshad je mang du 'phel nas gangs can gyi yi ge'i rnam gzhag phra rags mtha' dag ches cher dar ba'i re ba bcas su dmigs te mdor bsdus su bris pa zhig da lam bskyar bsgrig byas pa lags shing / rang nyid kyi shes bya'i chu tshad dma' ba dang / bar lam lo bcu gnyis tsam gyi ring lung khug tu phag rdzir sdod ring la sngon chad cung zad shes pa yang brjed tshar ba rnams da lta na rgas rdzi rdib kyi skabs su dran gso'ang dka' ba sogs kyi dbang du gyur pa'i skyon dang nor 'khrul 'gog tu med par shor ba rnams la skyon 'don dang legs bcos la sman pa'i dgongs 'char ci mchis gsal rjen du 'don gnang dang 'brel rig pa'i gzhung lugs kun la 'jug pa'i sgo shes bya'i rmang gzhi med du mi rung ba yi ge zhes pa 'di dar khyab kyi tshad longs pa zhig yong ba'i ched du mkhyen rab kyi spyan ras yangs pa rnams kyis legs bshad kyi dbyar rnga sgrog pa dang / blo gsar pa rnams kyis don gnyer gyi 'dun pa skom pas chus 'dod pa ltar yong ba'i re 'dun yang zhu'o//ming tshig brjod pa kun gyi gzhi/ /yi ge'i sbyor ba'i rnam gzhag las// ge 'jug pa'i gnas brgyad don/ /phyogs tsam bstan na de ltar ro// bzhi pa/ rtags kyi 'jug pa'i dka' dzo gan da mdor bsdus bshad pa/darna rtags kyi 'jug pa yi/ /snying po bdag gzhan dus gsum gyi//

220 rdo rje rgyal po'i gsungartsomaphyogasabasgrigs/ da gornam bzhag dbye tshul dper brjod bcas/ /bsdus la gsal ba bstan par bya/ /zhes pa ltar/dang po/ bya byed ba mi dad pa dang tha dad pa'i dbye ba'i skor/spyir dngos po gang zhig gi thog bya ba gang zhig byung rung rgyu rkyen zhig la mi bltos pa mi srid cing rgyu rkyen de byed pa po yin dgos pa las rang gis rang la bya ba byed pa mi yong mod/ 'on kyang spyir ldog rags pa'i tha snyad tsam gyi dbang du byas nas dbye na gnyis yod pa 'di lta ste/1 dngos po gang zhig la bya ba gang zhig byed pa po gzhan gyis dngos su sgrub par byed pa de ni byed pa po gzhan dang dngos su 'brel ba'i las sam bya ba ste/ dper na/ brag gong dum bur gtor song zhes brjod pa'i tshe na gtor ba de bya ba yin zhing / de byed pa po zhig gis bsgrubs pa'i cha nas gtor bya dang gtor byed (gtor rgyu'i brag gong dang gtor mkhan mi'am spyir btang ltar na bya rgyu'i las ka dang las ka byed mkhan) gnyis su dbye nas brjod pa lta bu'o//3 dngos po gang zhig gi thog byed pa po gzhan dngos su med par dngos po de rang gi thog nas bya ba zhig byung bar snang ba de ni byed pa po gzhan dang dngos su ma 'brel ba'i las sam bya ba ste/ dper na/ brag gong dum bur 'thor song zhes brjod pa'i tshe na 'thor ba de bya ba yin zhing /'thor ba'i gnas skabs der byed pa po dngos su mi snang ba'i cha nas 'thor bya dang 'thor byed('thor rgyu'i brag gong dang 'thor bar byed mkhan mi'am spyir —

sum rtags kyi dka' gnad 'ga' zhig brjod pa/ 221btang ltar na bya rgyu'i las ka dang las byed mkhan)gnyis su ma phye bar brag gong 'thor ba'i bya ba byung ba tsam zhig brjod pa lta bu'o//gnyis pa/ bya byed tha mi dad pa'i nang gses skor/bya byed tha mi dad par nang gses rags tsam phye na bsgrub par bya ba'i yul gyi dngos po de sgrub pa po de dang ngo bo gcig tu gyur pa'i bya byed tha mi dad pa dang / bsgrub bya sgrub byed tha dad yin rung bya ba de 'grub bzhin pa'i gnas skabs su sgrub pa po gzhan dngos su mi snang ba'i bya byed tha mi dad pa/ bsgrub bya dang sgrub byed tha dad yin la sgrub par byed pa'i bya ba sngon du song ba'i 'bras bu grub pa'i bya byed tha mi dad pa/ byed pa po zhitshi gis dngos su rtsol ba bskyed nas bsgrubs par ma bshad kyang de'i nus pas rang shugs su bya ba zhig grub pa'i bya byed tha mi dad pa/ byed pa po gtan nas med par bya ba grub pa'i bya byed tha mi dad pa bcas lnga yod/1 bsgrub par bya ba'i yul gyi dngos po de sgrub pa po de dang ngo bo gcib/ tu gyur pa'i bya byed tha mi dad pa ni/ dper na/ bdag 'gro'i lta bu brjod pa'i tshe 'gro zhes pa de bya tshig cig yin kyang 'gro bya dang 'gro byed gnyis ka bdag 'gro ba po rang nyid las 'gro bya logs su med pas bdag gzhan gyi dbye ba'ang mi byed/ yang bskyar bshad na/ 'gro bya phung po de 'gro pa po rang nyid las gzhan du dbye rgyu med pa'i bya byed tha mi dad pa lta bu'o//3 bsgrub bya dang sgrub byed tha dad yin rung bya ba de 'grub bzhin ya'i gnas skabs su sgrub pa po gzhan dngos su mi snang ba'i bya byed tha mi

222 rdo rje rgyal po'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/dad pa ni/ dper na/ rdza mkhan gyi 'khor lo 'khor ro lta bu brjod pa'i tshe na 'khor zhes pa de bya tshig yin zhing / dang por skor byed(bskor mkhan ) gzhan yod kyang / 'khor bzhin pa'i gnas skabs su skor ba po gzhan med par rang nyid ngang gis 'khor ba'i skabs der bya byed tha mi dad pa'i cha nas bskor zhes mi brjod par 'khor zhes zer/ yang bskyar bshad na/ 'khor ba de bya tshig yin zhing / skabs snga mar skor ba po gzhan yod kyang skabs phyi mar med pa ni bsgrub bya(bskor rgyu'i 'khor lo)dang sgrub byed (skor mkhan mi)tha dad yin rung bya ba de 'grub bzhin pa'i ('khor bzhin pa'i)gnas skabs su sgrub pa po gzhan dngos su mi snang ba'i bya byed tha mi dad pa yin pa lta bu'o//kle bsgrub bya dang sgrub byed tha dad pa yin la/ sgrub par byed pa'i bya ba sngon du song ba'i 'bras bu grub pa'i bya byed tha mi dad pa ni/ dper na/ khos rgya yig shes kyi yod pa red ces pa lta bu brjod pa'i tshe na shes zhes pa de bya tshig yin zhing / shes bya dang shes byed kyang tha dad yin pas thog mar bslabs yod kyang / khong du chud zin pa'i gnas skabs su bya byed tha mi dad pa'i cha nas shes zer ba las bslabs zhes mi zer/ yang bskyar bshad na/ shes zhes pa de bya tshig yin zhing / bsgrub bya(shes par bya rgyu)dngasgrub byed(shes par byed mkhan)tha dad yin la/ sgrub par byed pa'i(shes par byed pa'i)bya ba sngon du song ba'i 'bras bu grub pa'i (shesapa'i)bya byed tha mi dad pa yin pa lta bu'o//tre byed pos dngos su rtsol ba bskyed nas bsgrubs par ma bshad kyang /

sum rtags kyi dka' gnad 'ga' zhig brjod ba/ 223de'i nus pas rang shugs su bya ba zhig grub pa'i bya byed tha mi dad pa ni/dper na/ drag po'i dpung gis dgra bo'i dpung tshogs mtha' dag legs par 'thul song lta bur brjod pa'i tshe na 'thul zhes pa de bya tshig yin zhing /gdul bya dang 'dul byed kyang tha dad pa yin mod/ 'on kyang tshig zin du btul zhes ma brjod par bya ba'i yul gyi dngos po'i thog grub pa'i bya ba 'thul ba tsam bstan pa'i cha nas 'thul zhes brjod pa yin/ yang bskyar bshad na/ byed pa pos(drag po'i dpung gis)dngos su rtsol ba bskyed nas bsgrubs par (dgra bo btul bar)ma bshad kyang / de'i nus pas bya ba zhig grub pa'i(dragabo 'thul ba'i)bya byed tha mi dad pa yin pa lta bu'o//gzhan yang / nor gyis phongs/ shes byas dben/ dri mas gos/ngas ma 'grig pa red/ khyed kyis ma byung ba red/ skyon gyis ma gos so/ /lta bu brjod pa'i tshe na byed sgra sbyar sa'i nor dang / shes bya/ dri ma bcas kyis bya ba byas pa zhig mi ston par bya ba byung ba zhig ston pa gang zhig la bya ba de'ang byed sgra'i nus pa las ldog pa lta bur phongs/ dbeen/ gos zhes brjod pa de'i rigs dang / ngas byed stangs ma 'grig pa red/ khyed kyis byed stangs nor ba red/ mi de skyon gyis ma gos pa zhig red ces lta bu nga dang / khyed/ skyon bcas la byed sgra sbyar zhing / bya ba 'grig pa dang /nor ba/ gos pa so sor dgag sgra ma yig re sbyar bas yang snying byed sgras bstan pa'i bya ba de rnams ma byung ba'am med par ston pa 'di'i rigs sna tshogs shig yod pa de dag kyang bya byed tha mi dad pa rigs bzhi pa 'di'i nang du 'dus snyam//

224 rdo je rgyal po'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/5 byed pa po gtan nas med par bya ba grub pa'i bya byed tha mi dad pa ni/ dper na/ sa nas rtswa skyes/ gnam nas char bab/ nyi ma las 'od 'phro lta bu brjod pa'i tshe na skyes pa dang / bab pa/ 'phros pa bcas bya tshig yin rung / de dag ni gnam dang / sa/ nyi ma bcas 'byung khungs de dag las rang shugs su byung ba'am grub pa las 'dis zhes bshad rgyu med pa rnams ni byed pa po gtan nas med par bya ba byung ba'am grub pa'i bya byed tha mi dad pa yin pa lta bu'o//gong gsal bya byed tha mi dad pa nang gses mi 'dra ba lnga gang zhig yin rung / bya ba sgrub pa po dngos po bdag dang / bsgrub bya'i dngos po gzhan zhes gnyis su dbye rgyu med cing / de bzhin byed pa po dang 'brel pa'i byed las dang / bya ba'i yul gyi dngos po dang 'brel ba'i bya las zhes pa gnyis su dbye rgyu med do//gsum pa/ bya byed tha dad pa'i nang gses skor/bya byed tha dad pa'i nang geses phye na dngos po bdag gzhan gnyis dzhadang / bya byed las gsum bcas su dbye rgyu yod/1 dngos po bdag gzhan gnyis zhes pa ni/ rtags 'jug gi dka' gnad gsal ba'i me long las‘‘las gang zhig la byed pa po/ /ba/zhan dang dngos su 'brel ba yi/ /dbang du byas nas byed po dang / /de yi byed pa gnyis po ni/ /dngos po bdag yin bya yul dang / /bya ba gnyis po dngos po gzhan//’’zhes bstan pa ltar las sam bya ba gang zhig

sum rtags kyi dka' gnad 'ga' zhig brjod pa/ 22)wayin rung / de byed pa po gzhan zhig dang dngos su 'brel ba'i dbang du byas nas byed pa po mi de dang / de'i byed pa/ byed las dang bcas par ni dngos po bdag ces zer ba dang gcig byed pa po des bsgrub par bya ba'i yul lam las de dang / yul lam las de dang 'brel ba'i bya las bcas pa la ni dngos po gzhan zer ba dang gnyis so//yang bskyar bshad na/ las ka gang zhig yin rung las ka de byed mkhan mi de dang / byed pa'am byed pa po phal pa lag cha/ byed las bcas ni dngos po bdag ste/ dper na/ mda' 'phen pa zhig la cha mtshon na 'atwen mkhun miX(byed pa po)de dang / 'phen byed kyi ldug cha ༷gasngi (byed pa'am byed pa po phal pa)/ mda' ltong sprad nas 'phyan pa(byed las)bcas la dngos po bdag zer ba dang gcig las sam bya ba gang zhig yin rung / de byed pa po gzhan zhig dang dngos su 'brel ba'i dbang du byas nas byed pa po des bya ba bsgrub par bya bas yul lam las de dang / yul lam las de dang 'brel ba'i bya las dang bcas ni dngos po gzhan te/dper na/ gong ltar mda' 'phen pa zhig la cha mtshon na bsgrub par bya ba'i yul lam las matpa'('phang bya)de dang / mda' 'phrung band+ra bya zhes bya ba'i yul lam las daji 'brel ba'i bya las de dag la dngoṅge po rgezharni zhes zer ba dang gnyis so//bzhi pa/ bya byed las gsum dbye tshul skor/las sam bya ba gang zhig byed rung / las ka de la bya ba zhes zer zhing /

226 rdo rje rgyal po'i gsung rtsom phyogs sgrigs/'dir tshig sdud kyis bstan pa'i bya zhes pa de dang gcig las ka'am bya ba byed mkhan de la byed pa po'om byed pa zer zhing / 'dir tshig sdud kyis bstan pa'i byed ces pa de dang gnyis/ bsgrub bya'i don nam bya rgyu'i las ka der bya ba'o yul lam las zer zhing / 'dir tshig sdud kyis bstan pa'i lasdu zhes pa de dang gsum bcas so//1 bya ba ni/ las sam bya ba gang zhig yin rung / de byed pa po zhig ‘ra dngos su 'brel ba'i dbang du byas nas bya ba de gi kyā 'asdu/ ྅da bzhin pa'am/ byas zin pū gang rung ston pa der byā byā zhes zer/ dper na/ mda' 'pherno pa st+waṃg rsha cha mtshon na mda' 'aXng rgyuX'asdu 'phad daswos lta bu brjod na bya ba bya rgyu sdu rdongs sdu dang / 'atwen smru 'duswā gam nyaphen bsgang red lta bu brjod na bya ba byed bgīn ༷ da lta ba dang / 'phaXngs so'am 'phadwas sdong lta bu brjod na bya ba byag zis 'dus ༷ ston pa bcas gsum gyi las ka gang zhig yin rung de la bya ba zhes zer zhing / 'dir tshig sdud kyis bya zhes bstan pa de'o// ༷ ༷3 byede pa ni/ las sam bya ba gang zhig yin rung de byed pa po gzhan zhig dang dngos su 'brel ba'i dbang du byas nas bya ba byed mkhan der byed pa dzo'am byed pū zer/ dper na/ mda' 'phen pa zhig la cha mtshonaX na rshasden mkhanee mi de dang / 'asden byed kyi ldag rdzu gzhu/ mda' ltong sprad naṅge 'phen pagli byed las bcarme la rgyid pa nes zer 0zhing / 'dir tshig sdud kyis byedaX byas bstan pa de'o// ༷kā larme ni/ las dang bya ba gang zhig yin rung / de byed pa po

sum rtags kyi dka' gnad 'ga' zhig brjod pa/ 227gzhan zhig dang dngos su 'brel ba'i dbang du byas te byed pa po des bya rgyu'i las ka'am bsgrub pand+ra sgu bsdi yusha sdi dngos sdo des bya ba'i sdil rlom zlosdu zhermi zerjo/ daXper ṅge/ tshumadabyu' ṅgephen ༷pa sneg pre ༵ matstshan na rnophang bya'i mdu' de dang / mda' 'asdung baX byā lta bu bya ba'i yul lam las de dang 'brel ba'i bya ba der bya las zer ba de gnyis la yul lam las zer —zhing / 'dir tshig sdud kyis rwas zhes bstan pa de'o//lnga pa/ dus gsum gyi dbye ba'i skor/dus gsum gyi dbye ba ni bya byed tha dad pa dang / bya byed tha mi dad pa gnyis kar yod/ byas zin pa thams cad 'das pa dang / bya ba byed bzhin pa thams cad da lta ba dang / bya ba bya rgyu thams cad ma 'ongs pa yin te/ dper na/ mda' 'phadus sdo lta bu 'das pa dang / mdu' 'phen sdi 'du ga lta bu da lta ba/ mda' 'phrung rgyu lta bu ma 'ongs pa/ mda' phodzwas sdeg rme bu skul tshig byed las ma ༷'ongasde pa rshacas bya byed tha dad pa —dang / nyi ma sha1 sod lta bu 'das pa dang / nyi ma 'aXr sdi 'dug lta bu da lta ba/ nyi ma 'artar st+waṃ twed lta bu ma 'ongs pa/ nyi ma 'artar band+ra gyu1 cig lta bu skul tshig dang phyogs 'dra ba smon tshig byed las ma ༷'ongasru pa bcasabya byed tha mi dad pa yin pa lta bu'o/ /de'ang zhib tu phye na/ dus gsum dus dgur dbye rgyu yod ces bshad srol 'dug kyang rang nyid kyi bsam tshulasaltar na 'das pa'i bya ba zhig da lta brjod pa'i tshe na 'das pa dang / ga'ongs pa/ da lta ba bcas kyi tshig 'jug pa dang / de bsdon ma 'ongs

228 rdo rje rgyal po'i gsung rtsom phyags bsgrigs/pa'i bya ba zhig da lta brjod pa'i tshe na'ang 'das pa dang / ma 'ongs pa/da lta ba bcas gsum ga'i tshig 'jug pa ni nges par du yod mod/ da lta bar da lta ba'i tshig kho na ma gtogs gzhan 'jug thabs gtan nas med/de skor la go bsdur bya rgyu'i go skabs byung na dper brjod dang bcas zur du zhu rgyu las da lam 'dir bkod med// drug pa/ dngos po bdag gzhan dang / bya byed las gsum/dus gsum/ skul dzig bcas gzhi gcig gi thog dber brjod pa/dngos po bdag gzhan dang / bya byed las gsum/ dus gsum/skul tshig bcas gzhi gcig gi thog dper brjod na 'di lta ste/1 dper na/ mi zhig gis ltad mo bltas pa zhig la cha mtshon na/ltad mo blta mkhan gyi mi de byed pa po gtso bo dang / blta byed kyi mig de byed pa'am byed pa po shāl pa'am byed pa yin zhing / de gnyis ka dngozlo po bdag gzhan gnyis kyi bdag dang / bya byed las gsum gyi nang nas ñdzud pya yin la/ dus gsum gyi nang nas daX ltaX band+ra gtogs so/ /lha bdwa sdod lta bu byed pa po dang 'brel ba'i byed las gsal byed kyi sgra ni dngos po bdag gzhan gnyis kyi nang nas bdug dang / bya byed las gsum gyi nang nas gi ba yin la/ dus gsum gyi nang nas da lha bta gtogs so/ /blta rgyu'i haṃd mo ni las sam/ blta bya'am/ brnyi shār bya ba'i yul gyi dngos po de yiXn tt+waṃng / de ni dngos po bdag gzhan gnyis kyi nang nas gzhun dang /bya byed las gsum gyi nang nas las yin la/ dus gsum gyi nang nas ga

sum rtags kyi dka' gnad 'ga' zhig brjod pa/ 229 'ongag par gtogs so/ /balha bar gi lta bu bya ba'i yul lam las dang 'brel ba'i bya las gsal byed kyi sgra ni dngos po bdag gzhan gnyis kyi nang nas gzhwan dang / bya byed las gsum gyi nang nas byā byā yin la/ dus gsum gyi nang nas sdu 'odus par gtogs so/ /ngas lhad sdo balhas pā yin lta bu bya ba'i yul lam las dang 'brel ba'i bya ba byas zin 'das pa sto na pa 'di ni dus gsum gyi nang nas 'aXdas pā yin pa smos ci dgos/ dngos po bdag gzhan gnyis kyi nang nas gzhun dang / bya byed las gsum gyi nang nas sdu byā'o/ /ltoXs shig lta bu skul tshig ni byed pa po skul byed kyi chig yin pas byed las su gtogs shing / dngos po bdag gzhan gnyis kyi nang nas bdag dang / dus gsum gyi nang nas sdu 'odwas par gtogs so//de ltar brjod dgos don ni bya byed las gsum dang / bdag gzhan dus spu/sum bcas gzhi gcig gi thog chabs cig tu 'chad skabs tshig mdor bsdus te brjod pa'i brjod tshul zhig ste/ dbyangs can grub nga'i rdo rjes‘‘des na dus gsum du dbye ba/ /bdag gzhan dbye bas ma khyab pa //bsdu ba'i don du shes dgos par//’’zhes dang / ‘‘gzhan yang bas 'phul can phal cher/ /byed pa po ni da lta dang / /bya yul ma 'ongs par bsdus nas/ /'das la bas 'phul yang 'jug yod/ /da lta ba la gnyis ka med/ /ma 'ongs 'phul yod yang 'jug med/ /skabs 'gar 'das dang skul tshig la/ /sa rkyang sbyar bas thus pa'ang yod// ’ces gsungs pa ltar/ dper na/ lha ga sdo/ lta byed kto mig /lha bad byed ces pa rnams dus da lta ba dang 'brerla ṅgeṅge brjodi digozlo rmi shas dme ba dang / lhag par

230 rdo rje rgyal po'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/du lha ba po dang / lha byed kyi mig /lta bar byed ces pa'i byed las bcas kyi ṣpe ge gtso bo lta zheṅge pa de dag da lta ༷lta bzhin pa zhes pa'i lha dang gcig pa yin pas dus rkisum du dbye skabs de dag da lta bar gtogatū zhes pa las dngos po bdag yin phyin tshang ma da lta ba yin zhes brjod pa min la/de bzhin balha swo'i gzuswās dang / balha brwa byā zhes pa lta bu'i bya las gsal byed kyi sgra rnams dus ma 'ongs pa dang 'brel nas brjod dgos pa ñtsashas che zhing / lhag par du blta bya'i gzugs dang / balha bar bya zhes pa'i bya las gsal byed kyi sgra'i yi rlu rshalha zhes pa de dag blta hūṃ ma 'ongs pa'i yi ge blta rgyu yin zhes pa'i balha darsha gcig pa yin pas ༷dus gsum du dbye skabs deX dag ma 'ongs par gatregs zhes brjod pa las dngos po gzhan yin phyin tshang ma dus ma 'ongs pa yin zhes brjod pa'ang min pa nges dgos shing / gsham du bkod pa'i dper brjod gnyis la'ang go don de ltar len dgos so//3 yang dper na/ mi zhig gis bya ba ste las don bsgrubs par cha mtshon na/ bya ba sgrub mkhan gyi mi de byed pa po gtso bo dang / sgrub byed kyi thabs de byed pa po phal pa'am byed pa yin zhing / de gnyis ka dngos po bdag gzhan gnyis kyi nang nas bdag dang / bya byed las gsum gyi nang nas byed pa yin pa/ dus gsum gyi nang nas da lta bar gtogs so//sgrub par byed lta bu byed pa po dang 'brel ba'i byed las gsal byed kyi sgra ni dngos po bdag gzhan gnyis kyi nang nas bdag dang / bya byed las gsum gyi nang nas bya ba yin la/ dus gsum gyi nang nas da lta bar gtogs so//

sum rtags kyi dka' gnad 'ga' zhig brjod ba/ 231bsgrub rgyu'i bya ba ni las sam/ bsgrub bya'am/ bsgrub par bya ba'i yul gyi dngos po de yin zhing / de ni dngos po bdag gzhaḍi gnyis kyi nang nas gzhan dang / bya byed las gsum nang nas las yin pas/ dus gsum gyi nang nas ma 'ongs par gtogs so/ /bsgrub par bya lta bu bya ba'i yul lam las dang 'brel ba'i bya las gsal byed kyi sgra ni dngos po bdag gzhan gnyis kyi nang nas gzhan dang / bya byed las gsum nang nas bya ba yin la/ dus gsum gyi nang nas ma 'ongs par gtogs so/ /ngas bya ba bsgrubs pa yin lta bu bya ba'i yul lam las dang 'brel ba'i bya ba byas zin 'das pa ston pa 'di ni dus gsum gyi nang nas 'das pa yin pa smos ci dgos/ dngos po bdag gzhan gnyis kyi nang nas gzhan dang /bya byed las gsum nang nas bya ba'o/ /sgrubs shig lta bu byed pa bo skul byed kyi tshig yin pas byed las su gtogs shing dngos po bdag gzhan gnyis kyi nang nas bdag dang / dus gsum gyi nang nas ma 'ongs par gtogs so//3 yang dper na/ mi zhig gis yi ge 'bri bar cha mtshon na/ yi ge 'bri mkhan gyi mi de byed pa po gtso bo dang / 'bri byed kyi smyu gu de byed pa po phal pa'am hūṃd pa yin zhing / de gnyis ka dngos po baṭwāṃrge gzhan gnyis kyi nang nas bdug dang / bya byed las gsum gyi nang nas sdod sa yin la/ dus gsum gyi nang nas du lha byār gtogs so/ /bdag gis 'asdi ༷ra byes lta bu byed pa po 'brel pa'i byed las gsal byed kyi sgra ni dngos po bdag gzhan gnyis nang nas bdag dang / bya byed las gsum

blo 232 rdojergyal po'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/nang nas bya ba yin la/ dus gsum gyi nang nas da lta bar gtogs so//'bri rgyu'i yi ge ni las sam/ 'athro bya'am/ 'bri bar bya ba de yin zhing / de ni dngos po bdag gzhan gnyis kyi nang nas gzhan dang / bya byed las gsum gyi nang nas las yin la/ dus gsum gyi nang nas ma 'ongs par gtogs so/ /yi ge 'bri bar bya lta bu bya ba'i yul lam las dang /'brel ba'i bya las gsal byed kyi sgra ni dngos po bdag gzhan sa/nyis kyi nang nas gzhan dang / bya byed las gsum gyi nang nas bya ba yin la/ dus gsum gyi nang nas ma 'ongs par gtogs so//ngas yi ge bris pa yin/ lta bu bya ba'i yul lam las dang 'brel ba'i bya ba byas zin 'das pa ston pa 'di ni dus gsum gyi nang nas 'das pa yin pa smos ci dgos/ dngos po bdag gzhan gnyis kyi nang nas gzhan dang bya byed las gsum gyi nang nas bya ba'o/ /bris shig lta bu skul tshig ni byed pa po skul byed kyi tshig yin pas byed las su gtogs shing / dngos po bdag gzhan gnyis kyi nang nas bdag dang dus gsum gyi nang nas ma 'ongs par gtogs so//de ltar bya byed tha dad pa dang tha mi dad pa dang / dngos po bdag gzhan/ bya byed las gsum/ dus gsum sogs dper brjod dang sbrags yang skor bskyar skor du bshad pa'i dmigs yul ni rtags 'jug gi dka' gnad 'di thad gal gnad che bas don gnyer can rnams la dpyad gzhi sasal po zhig yong ched dang / nges shes 'drongs po yong ched yin lags so//

sum rtags kyi dka' gnad 'ga' zhig brjod pa/ 233bdun pa/ zhar byung du skabs thob kyi 'bri tshul skor/gong gsal rnams ni byed po gzhan dang dngos su 'brel ba'i bya ba zhig gi dbang du byas nas byed pa po dang / byed pa po phal pa'am byed pa/byed las/ bya ba'i yul gyi dngos po'am las dang / de dang 'brel ba'i las/ skul tshig bcas cha tshang ba zhig bkod pa yin zhing / byed po gzhan dang dngos su 'brel ba'i bya ba zhig yin phyin brjod tshul de dag gi nang du ma 'dus pa zhig gtan nas med/ 'on kyang bya ba tha dag la byed pa po gtso phal gnyis ka dgos pa'i khyab pa med par brten skabs rer byed pa po gtso phal gnyis ka dgos pa'ang yod/ dper na/ ngas yi ge 'di lcags smyug gis bris pa yin lta bu dang / skabs rer byed pa po ma gtogs byed pa po phal pa mi dgos/ dper na/ ngas bris so lta bu dang / skabs rer byed po shugs bstan du bzhag nas byed pa po phal pas thus pa'ang yod/ dper na/ yi ge lcags smyug gis bris pa zhig red/ lta bu sogs gang la ci 'os su sbyar bas chog pa'ang rtogs dgos so//sdon med legs bshad gsar pa'i skyes dben yang / /brda sgrod gzhung lugs las byung dka' gnad 'ga'/ /nyung ngu'i tshig gis gsal bshad byas pa 'di/ /blo gsar blo sgo 'byed byed lde mig yin//

234snyan ngag gi rnam bshad gsal sgron/ bstan bcos rtsom pa la 'jug pa'i sngon 'gro dang gleng gzhi/༄༅/ /swasnyi/ zab dang rgya che'i chos kun gsal ler mkhyen/ /spyi dang bye brag gdul bya'i tshogs la brtse/ /lung dang rigs pas blang dor kun ston nus/ /dngos dang brgyud pa'i bshes gnyen yongs la 'dud/ /snyan 'jebs tshig gi sbyor ba rab mtshar bas/ /srid zhi'i shes bya ji lta ji snyed kun/ /ston la ches cher mtshar ba'i khyad chos can/ /snyan ngag ces 'di bslab bya'i gter zhig lags/ /gang de'i brjod bya lus rgyan skyon bcas kyi/ /mtshan nyid ma 'dres so sor ston pa'i gzhung //me long zhes su grags pa'i gzhung gi don/ /gleng ba'i bya ba bzang por 'jug par bya/ /zhes shes bya dang shes par byed mkhan gyi khyad du 'phags pa'i rang bzhin mtshon par bya ba'i ched du bstan bcos rtsom par 'jug —pa'i sgo mchod par brjod cing bshad par dam bca' ba'i sa bcad tsam lkortsom yig 'di ni1979lo nas1981lo'i bar rtsom pa pos khring tur〈bod rgya tshig mdzod chen mo〉〉rtsom sgrig tsho chung nang bshad 'khrid gnang skabs kyi zin bris yin zhing rjes su slar yang bskyar sgrig mdzad pa zhig yin/

snyan ngag gi rnam bshad gsal sgron/ lha35gyi tshig cung zad kyis sngon bsus te 'dir bshad par bya ba ni/ byang chub sems dpa'i rtogs pa brjod pa dpag bsam 'khri shing las/ mthong dang ma mthong bde ba'i lam ni legs bshad kyis gsal sgron me lta bur spyod/ /legs bshad bdud rtsi'i ro ni nyams myong ldan pas mchog tu dga' ba'i char dag 'bebs/ /legs bshad don gnyer yul la gnyer bya kun mkhyen dag kyang don gnyer nyid du 'gyur/ /de slad mkhas pa rnams la legs bshad dang mtshungs dga' ba ci yang yod ma yin/ /zhes gsungs pa dang rjes su mthun par rang cag bod rgya tshig mdzod chen mo rtsom sgrig khang 'dir rgyal khab kyis bstsal ba'i las 'gan gzi brjid can legs par 'grub pa'i cha rkyen du sman pa'i ched dang / bod gangs can pa'i rig pa'i gnas rnams nyams pa sor chud dang ma nyams gong spel gyis deng rabs kyi zhing las dang / deng rabs kyi bzo las/ deng rabs kyi rgyal srung / deng rabs kyi tshan rig lag rtsal bcas ring por mi thogs par mngon du 'gyur ba byed rgyu de dmigs yul du bzung nas shes par bya ba'i gnas gang dang ci'i thad nas bshad khrid kyi byed sgo ji snyed cig spel zhing / rang nyid kyi go skal du snyan ngag me long gi gzhung lugs thad kyi las 'gan gnang ba bzlog tu med pa dang / rang nyid shes rab shin tu dman yang de lta bu'i bya bar 'jug pa'i spro ba bzang po ldan pa zhig yin pas dang bas blangs te gzhung don rgya mtsho'i klong zab gzhal ba'i sgo 'phar dbye bar bya la/ de yang mi mjed 'jig rten gyi khams 'dzam bu'i gling zhes pa 'di nyid chags pa nas bzung dus skabs bgrang las 'das pa zhig

236 rdo rje rgyal po'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/phyin yod cing / 'gro ba mi'i lo rgyus kyang de snyed pa zhig byung yod pa rnams cha tshang ba dang 'phyug pa med pa zhig ni rang cag so so skye bo rnams kyi bsam brjod kyi yul las 'das pa ni smos ci dgos/ chos lugs kyi yig cha dang bshad srol du sngon tshe bskal pa bzang po'i dus zhes da lta'i dus skabs las ches lhag pa zhig byung yod par grags kyang / mi'i tshe tshad dang / lus stobs/ rang byung gi cha rkyen 'ga' zhig sogs kyi thad nas cha mtshon na de ltar byung yod na las/ 'jig rten khams kyi chags rabs dang shul dngos la dpags na mi'i shes bya spyi dang lhag par tshan rig lag rtsal gyi thad nas bshad na bskal pa ya thog gi spyi tshogs nas bzung spyi tshogs 'phel rgyas kyi dus rim mang po zhig 'das pa'i go rim nang mi rnams kyis 'jig rten khams la ngos 'dzin byas pa'i shes rtogs kyi chu tshad je mthor song ste mi rabs snga ma snga ma'i nyams myong rnams phyi ma phyi mas rgyun 'dzin dang / bed spyod/ spel thabs bcas byas nas rig pa'i gzhung lugs bsgrigs shing / de slob sbyong dang lag len byas/ slar yang yar rgyas btang nas spel res byas te rim bzhin yar rgyas byung ba'i shes bya'i gnas rgya je che dang gting je zab tu phyin par ma zad/ 'byung 'gyur 'phel rgyas kyi mdun lam pha mtha' mi mngon pa zhig tu slebs yod pa don dngos nas grub pa ltar gyi rnam grangs brjod kyis mi langs pa dang / gting mtha' dpag tu med pa zhig lags shing / de dag thams cad skye rgus bslab par bya ba zhig yin pa smos ci 'tshal/ sa skya ba ṇḍi tas/ rang blo shes bya'i gnas la ma sbyangs na/ /thams cad mkhyen pa nam mkha'i mtha'

snyan ngag gi rnam bshad gsal sgron/ 231ltar ring / /de ltar dgongs nas rgyal dang rgyal sras kyis/ /shes bya'i gnas kun sbyang zhes legs par gsungs/ /zhes gsungs pa 'di ni rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa mngon du byed pa'i rgyu'i gtso bo dang / rang gzhan gyi don gnyis 'grub pa'i gzhi/ 'phral yun gyi legs pa thams cad kyi 'byung khungs ston pa'i gsung yin pa ltar nges par du bslab dgos pa zhig go /'o na de thams cad bslab dgos sam zhe na/ de'ang sa paṇa gyis/ mkhas gang shes bya'i de kho na/ /ji bzhin rtogs pa yin par 'dod/ /bye brag sbyangs pa'i don shes pa/ /de yang de la mkhas zhes bya/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar shes bya'i gnas bsam gyis mi khyab cing / de thams cad kyi don phyin ci ma log par shes pa ni mkhas pa'i mchog yin zhing / bye brag gang la sbyangs shing shes pa de yang de nyid la mkhas pa zhes zer chog pas rig pa'i gnas gcig la mkhas kyang chog 'o na su dang sus gang dang gang bslab par bya dgos snyam na/ cha med kyi yul du rgyus med kyi mgron po slebs pa ltar ci bya gtol med du mi lus pa'i ched du rgya bod sngon byon mkhas pa dag gis shes bya'i gnas rnams phyogs bsdus kyi rang bzhin ldan pa'i sgo nas bstan pa 'di lta ste/rig gnas spyi dang bye brag tu dbye ba sna tshogs skor/dang po/ rig gnas bco brgyad ces pa la bshad tshul 'ga' zhig yod/ 'dul ba las byung ba'i bshad tshul la'ang gnyis yod pa las dang 1 po ni/ gsang sngags kyi rgyud dang / cho ga zhib mo dang / gtan tshigs

———238 rdorjergyal po'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/rig pa dang / rig byed dang / brda sprod dang / sgra nges sbyor dang /shes gsal dang / nges tshig dang / sdeb sbyor mkhas pa dang / skar ma'i rig pa dang / rtogs byed kyi rig pa dang / chur lhung gi rig pa dang / cher spyod kyi rig pa dang / 'jig rten rgyang 'phen gyi rig pa dang / bye brag pa'i rig pa dang / rgyu drug cu pa dang / khyur mid kyi rig pa dang / gnas 'dug gi rig pa dang bco brgyad do zhes dang /yang / pi wang gling bu tshong rdza mkhan/ /phreng mkhan chang tshong phyugs 'tsho ba/ /'breg mkhan 'bru mar 'tshir ba dang / /mgar ba shing mkhan phywa mkhan po/ /tha ga ko lpags rkyal mkhan pa/ /btso blag smyug ma mkhan po dang / /bshan pa gdol pa shing rta mkhan/ /zhes dang /gnyis pa/ ko sa la'i rgyan las gsungs pa ni/ sman dang / rtsis mkhan dang / mgar ba dang / sen mo 'breg mkhan dang / dri zhim tshong ba dang / shing bzo dang / rtsig mkhan dang / btso blag mkhan dang /tshem bu dang / gar mkhan dang / yig mkhan dang / chang 'tshong ma dang / bshan pa dang / gdol 'tshong pa dang / rin po che'i bzo byed pa sogs so/ /zhes dang / gsum pa/ mdzod las bshad pa ni/ rol mo dang / so tshis dang / grangs can dang / sgra dang / gso ba dang /chos lugs dang / bzo bo dang / 'khrig thabs dang / 'phong spyod dang /gtan tshigs dang / sbyor ba dang / rang gi bcas pa dang / thos pa dran pa dang / skar ma'i dpyad dang / rtsis dang / mig 'phrul dang /sdon rabs dang / sngon byung brjod pa dang bco brgyad do/ /zhes dang /

snyan ngag gi rnam bshad gsal sgron/ 239bzhi pa/ dus 'khor nas bshad pa ni/ tshong pa dang / rdza mkhan dang /phreng rgyud mkhan dang / chang ma dang / phyugs rdzi dang / 'breg mkhan dang / 'bru mar mkhan dang / phywa mkhan dang / mgar ba dang / shing mkhan dang / 'thag mkhan dang / ko lpags mkhan dang / nya pa dang /btso blag mkhan dang / smyug ma mkhan dang / bshan pa dang / gshed ma dang / shing rta mkhan dang bco brgyad do/ /zhes dang / lnga pa/ rig gnas bco brgyad ni/ 'jig rten shes pas bzo rig pa shes pa dang po/zas kyi tshad dang phan gnod shes pas gso ba rig pa gnyis pa/ byā ka ra ṇa sde brgyad la sogs pa shes pas sgra rig pa gsum pa/ rtag chad sgro skur shes pas tshad ma rig pa bzhi pa/ gnas mtho dman shes pas phyi snod kyi 'jig rten rig pa lnga pa/ 'gro ba rigs drug gi mtshan nyid shes pas nang bcud kyi sems can rig pa drug pa/ mtho ris dang ngan 'gro shes pas las rig pa bdun pa/ rang gzhan gyi lus len pa sogs gang du skye ba'i bde sdug shes pas skye gnas rig pa brgyad pa/ tshe snga phyi bar gsum shes pas dus rig pa dgu pa/ rtag 'dzin gyi skyon shes pas 'chi ba rig pa bcu pa/ dbang po rab 'bring tha gsum shes pas shes rab rig pa bcu gcig pa/ gzhan gyi bsam pa shes pas yid rig pa bcu gnyis pa/ khams thams cad 'byung ba lngar shes pas skye ba rig pa bcu gsum pa/ gzugs sogs yul drug sems su shes pas yul rig pa bcu bzhi pa/ thams cad byin gyis brlab par nus pas sngags rig pa bco lnga pa/ rdzas thams cad bdud rtsir shes pa'i sman rig pa shes pa bcu drug pa/ theg pa gsum

240 rdo rje rgyal po'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/gyi lam lnga gsum bco lnga shes pas chos rig pa bcu bdun pa/ 'khor 'das gcig tu shes pas byang chub rig pa bco brgyad pa bcas so/ /zhes shod tshul sna tshogs pa de rnams dang / yang sgyu rtsal drug cu rtsa bzhi zhes grags pa las dbye na/ bzo la gtogs pa sum cu ni/ yi ge dang / lag rtsis dang / grangs rtsis dang / grangs rtsis chen po dang / thor tshugs dang / gom stabs dang / lcags kyu'i thabs dang / ral gri'i thabs dang / zhags pa 'debs pa dang / mda' bo che 'phen pa dang /mdun du bsnur ba dang / phyir bsnur ba dang / gcad pa dang / dral ba dang / dbug pa dang / rgyang nas 'phog pa dang / sgra drag par 'phog shu dang / gnad du 'phog pa dang / mi tshor bar 'phog pa dang / tshabs che bar 'phog pa dang / mchong ba dang / gyad kyi 'dzin stangs dang /bang dang / rkyal dang / brgal ba dang / glang po che'i gnyar zhon pa dang / rta la zhon pa dang / shing rta'i bzo thabs dang / mda' gzhu'i bzo thabs dang / gyad stobs dang sum cu'o/ /rol mo'i bye brag bco brgyad ni/ gar mkhan dang / bro dang / rnga bo che dang / rdza rnga dang /rnga phran dang / rdza rnga che mo dang / 'khar rnga dang / pi wang rgyud gcig pa dang / rdza rnga kha gcig pa dang / lcags kyi sil khrol dang / 'khar ba'i sil khrol dang / pi wang rgyud gsum pa dang / rnga mu kunda dang / sil snyan glu dbyangs dang bstun pa dang / pheg rdob dang / rol mo'i sgra dang /pi wang dang / gling bu dang bco brgyad do/ /glu dbyangs kyi nges pa bdun ni/ bar ma dang / drang srong dang / sa 'dzin dang / drug ldan dang /

snyan ngag gi rnarsha bshad gsal sgron/ 24( walnga pa dang / blo gsal dang / 'khor nyan dang bdun no/ /gar gyi cha byad dgu ni/ sgeg pa dang / dpa' ba dang / mi sdug pa ste lus kyi nyams gsum dang / rgod pa dang / drag shul dang / 'jigs rung ste ngag gi nyams gsum dang / snying rje dang / rngam pa dang / zhi ba ste yid kyi nyams gsum bcas dgu'o/ /de rnams la sgyu rtsal drug cu rtsa bzhi zhes zer/ yang dus 'khor nas bshad pa thang rdzong gzhig par bya ba'i phyir rdo'i 'phrul 'khor dang / chu rdzong 'jig pa gru'i 'phrul 'khor/ ri rdzong 'joms pa me'i 'phrul 'khor/ brtsigs pa 'jig pa gur gyi 'phrul 'khor ram phur pa'i 'phrul 'khor/ go cha 'jig pa lcags mda'i 'phrul 'khor/rang phyogs sam pho brang srung ba ral gri'i 'phrul 'khor/ gzhan bde bar spyode pa'i 'phrul 'khor ni rtsed mo byed pa rlung gi 'phrul 'khor/ me tog dang bza' shing gi ra ba'i don du chu gyen du 'dren pa'i 'phrul 'khor bcas la 'phrul 'khor brgyad ces zer/ gzhan yang / pho rtsal sna dgu ste/ mtheb kyis sha non pa dang gcig rkyal gyis chu gcod pa dang gnyis/ yang rtsal bya lta bu dang gsum ste lus kyi rtsal gsum dang / lo rgyus kyis dge thon pa dngagacig gtam gyis bzhad gad thon pa dang gnyis/ gshags kyis pha rol non pa dang gsum ste ngag gi rtsal gsum/ mdzangs la blo 'gyu ba dang gcig dpa' la bsran tshugs pa dang gnyis/ kha gsal zhing gting mi rtogs pa dang gsum ste yid kyi rtsal gsum bcas dgu dang / gtam yig cis gsum/ mda' rdo mchong gsum/ bang rkyal sbed gsum bcas dgu la pho rtsed sna dgu zer ba sogs gna' rabs su zab zab mtshar mtshar du
