snyan ngag gi rnam bshad las gzhuja don le'u dang po/ 353(1) gnad 'grel bshad pa ni/ rtsa bar/ nakhyu ta dang uṅgārpā/ /trī sgags sog/sa phal cher 'jug bsten pa/ /shin tu mdzes te gzhan du ni/ /grong pa nyid kyi nus pa brten/ /zhes pa ste/nirdzu ta skyugs pa dang / uṅgārṇa yang skyugs pa la 'jug kyang btags ming phal pa yin pas de la brten pa ni mdzes la/ de las gzhan skyugs pa dngos kyi skad dod bā na ta zhes pa lta bu ni grong tshig nyid kyi nus pa brten pa ste grong pa'i tshig nyid du 'gyur bas mi mdzes so/ /zhes so//(2) dper brjod dngos ni/ rtsa bar/ pa sa nyi zer dzigs pa rnams/ /'thungs nas dzul dmar skugs pa yi/ kha yi jag byed zegs ma rnams/ /shin tu thag par byed pa bzhin/ /zhes pa mdzes te mi mdzes pa/ /chung ma skug par byed ces pa'o/ /zhes pa ste/ brjod don rang gi chung ma chang gis ra ro bas skyugs pa'i zegs ma 'thor ba la bsams kyang / rjod byed tshig padma gzhon nus nyi ma'i 'od zer skyug pa rnams 'thungs pas kha bye zhing rgyas te ge sar gyi rdul dmar po rnams skyug par byed cing / kha yi dag byed de kha chu'i zegs ma rnams kyang 'thor zhing skyug par byed pa bzhin no zhes chung ma ra ro ba'i chos skyugs pa gcig kho na padma dang nyi ma la bkod pa'i phyir mdzes pa yin la/de las ldog pa mi mdzes pa ni ming dngos la brten pa chung ma chang gis bzi ste nyag nyog tu skyug par byed ces pa'o zhes so/ /bod mkhas pas/ dpyid dpal yongs su dar ba'i brlan drod rgyun/ /zags rnams 'thungs pas rab— myos keng shu ka'i/ /'khri shing rang lus sgeg pas dmar ba'i sdul/ /

354 rdo je rgyal po'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/yang nas yang du zags par byed pa bzhin/ /zhes gsungs pa'i brjod don dngos rang gi chung ma lang tsho dar la bab pa'i zla mtshan 'bab pa'i chos de rjod tshig tu dpyid dpal yongs su dar ba'i stabs kyis keng shu ka ste rgya skyegs shing gi spyo shugs rgyas pa las rdul dmar 'bab pa'i steng du bkod nas bshad pa'o/ /yang na/ gang gi zil dngar la rol ba'i/ /bung bar brtse ba rab rgyas pa'i/ /dpyid kyi chu skyes gzhon nu mas/ /'dab brgya bskyangs nas yongs su 'khyud/ /ces brjod don dngos rang gi lang tsho'i dpal longs su spyod pa'i mdza' bo der brtse ba rab tu rgyas pa'i gzhon nu mas yan lag dam por 'khyud pa'i chos sam bya ba gcig nyid padma dgod pa'i 'dab ma kha zum nas bung ba mi glod pa ltar du bkod pa zhig go/2 chos du ma bkod pa'i ting nge 'dzin bshad pa la 'dod tshul bstan pa dang / dper brjod pa dang sbrags nas don bshad pa gnyis yod/(1) 'dod tshul bstan pa ni/ rtsa bar/ cig car nyid du chos du ma/ /bkod pa dag kyang 'dod de dpor/ /zhes pa ste/dngos po gang yang rung ba zhig la dus cig car nyid du dngos po gzhan la gnas pa'i chos du ma bkod pa dag kyang ting nge 'dzin du 'dod do/ /zhes so//(2) dper brjod dang sbrags don bshad pa ni/ rtsa bar/ lci ba'i mngal khur gyis ngal zhing / /'khun par byed pa'i zin gyi sbeng / /'de dag g.yo med steng gi ni/ /phang pa dag la yang

snyan ngag gi rnam bshad las gzhung don le'u dang bo/ 355dag nyal/ /zhes pa ste/ chu'i rang bzhin gyis lci ba'i char gyi mngal khur gyis ngal zhing / 'brug sgra dal bus 'khun par byed pa'i char sprin gyi phreng ba 'di dag g.yo med ri bo'i phang par te rtse'am mgul du yang dag par nyal lo zhes so/ /yang na g.yo med nam mkha' la'ang 'jug pa ltar sbyar yang chog go /de'i don ni/ rtsa bar/ grogs mo'i phang par nyal ba dang / /'khun dang skyi ba nyid dang ngal/ /zhes pa 'ani ni mngal ldan ma'i/ /chos mang po rnams gzhan la bstan/ /zhes pa ste/ bud med sbrum ma 'ga' zhig btsa' ba la mngon du phyogs pa'i chos grogs mo'i phang par nyal ba dang / 'khun pa 'don pa dang / lus lci ba dang / ngal ba rnams btags pa ba'i dngos po gzhan sprin la bkod pa rim bzhin ri bo'i phang par nyal ba dang / 'brug gi sgra 'byin pa dang /lus phyi ba dang / dal bus bgrod pa ngal ba ltar snang ba bcas su bkod de bstan pa'o zhes so/ /bod mkhas pas/ nyin mo'i 'byung gnas 'o da kyi rlabs g.yo bas/ /dri bzang khang pa dkar po kha bye tshe/ /sbrang rtsi'i brtul zhugs pa rnams gnyid sad nas/ /chog mi shes pa'i rol rtsed 'thung don gnyer/ /zhes pa'i brjod don dngos bud med chags pas gdung bas kha dri bzang bro ba'i 'dzum dkar ston pa'i tshe 'dod ldan gyi skye bor chags pa spyod pa'i blo skyes nas rol rtsed dang bcas mchu yi sbrang rtsi 'thung ba don du gnyer ro zhes chags pas gdung ba dang / 'dzum ston pa/ 'dod ldan gyi skye bos 'o byed pa bcas kyi chos de dag rim pa bzhin nyi 'od kyi rlabs g.yo ba dang / padma kha bye ba/ sbrang bus 'phur lding

35 6 rdo rje rgyal po'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/dang bcas sprang rtsi 'thung ba rnams su bkod de mdzes par byas pa'o/ /yang na/ lang tsho gsar pa'i dpal ngomās shing / /yid du 'ong ba'i 'dzum dkar can/ /dal bur rgyu ba'i zla ba 'di/ /utpal 'tshol ba'i ched du 'ongs/ /zhes brjod don dngos lang tsho gsar pa'i dpal ngoms pa dang / yid du 'ong ba'i 'dzum dkar can/ gom stabs dal ba bcas kyi bu mo 'di bdag 'tshol ba'i ched du 'ongs pa bcas kyi chos de dag rjod tshig tu rim pa bzhin btags pa ba'i dngos po yar ngo'i zla gsar 'phel ba'i dpal ngoms pa dang / yid du 'ong ba'i 'od dkar 'phro ba/nam mkha' la dal bur rgyu ba/ utpal 'tshol ba'i ched du 'ongs pa bcas su bkod de mdzes par byas pa'o//gsum pa ṇḍing nge 'dzin gyi yon tan gyi mjug bsdu ba ni/ rtsa bar/ting 'dzin zhes bya'i yon tan gang / /'di ni snyan ngag bdog kun te/ /snyan ngag mkhan po don mthun gyi/ /tshogs kyang 'di nyid rjes su 'brangs/ /zhes pa ste/ ting nge 'dzin zhes bya ba'i yon tan 'di ni snyan ngag gi rig pa'i bdog pa kun te yod do cog legs shing khyab che ba zhig yin pas snyan ngag mkhan po ming don mthun pa'i tshogs rnams kyang ting nge 'dzin zhes pa'i yon tan gyi mdzod 'di nyid kyi rjes su 'brangs nas don du gnyer bar byed do/ /zhes so//'dir gnad don gcig gleng dgos pa ni/ le'u dang po 'dir 'chad par bya ba ni rgya gar lho phyogs pa dang shar phyogs pa gnyis 'dod tshul tha dad pa'i lam rnam par dbye ba'i ched du yon tan rnam pa bcu 'e/tha/ so ṭo/'i

snyan ngag gi rnam bshad las gzhung don le'u dang po/ 357lugs tha dad pa re yod dgos shing / sbyar ba nas mdzes pa'i bar yon tan dgu la de ltar yod kyang / bcu pa ting nge 'dzin gyi yon ta3 'dir sngon 'grel phal che bar spyir bstan pa dang / chos gcig bkod pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang / chos du ma bkod pa'i ting nge 'dzin zhes gsum bshad pa tsam las/ lho shar gyi 'phros pa mi 'dug cing / rang nyid kyis bltas kyang rtsa ba'i dper brjod gsum po 'di'i mtshan nyid dang mtshan gzhi gang thad nas lam gnyis tha dad du dbye bya mi rnyed do/ /de ltar na lho shar thun mong ba'i rgyan du ma bzung thabs med du 'gyur la/ thun mong ba'i rgyan yin na 'di ni don rgyan yin pas le'u gnyis par ma bzhag par le'u dang po thun mong ma yin pa'i rgyan du 'jog dgos don ji ltar 'grel/ paṇa chen sargha shris dper brjod snga ma gnyis lho phyogs pa'i yin la/ phyi ma gcig pu nyid ni shar phyogs pa'i yin par byas nas bshad na yang legs so gsungs 'dug kyang / chos gcig bkod pa shar phyogs pa'i lugs dang / chos du ma bkod pa lho phyogs pa'i lugs yin pa lung dang rigs pa gang nas kyang bsgrub dka' ba bcas ni re zhig dpyad par bya bar bzhag go/lnga pa/ don bsngu ba/1 lho shar gnyis kyi lam dbye ba'i skabs kyi don bsdu ba/lho shar gnyis kyi lam dbye ba'i skabs kyi gsum pa don bsdu ba ni/ rtsa bar/ de ltar rang bzhin brtags pa las/ /lam ni 'di gnyis rnam par gye/ /de dag dbye ba snyan ngag mkhan1 /so so

358 rdo rje rgyal po'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/la gnas brjod mi nus/ /bur zhing 'o ma bur sogs kyi/ /mngar ba nyija kyi khyad par che/ /de ltar mod kyis de brjod par/ /dbyangs can mas kyang nus ma yin/ /zhes pa ste/ gong du ji ltar bshad pa ltar sbyar ba la sogs pa dngos dang ldog pa'i tshul du gnas pa'i lugs dag mkhas pa so so'i kun rtog gam bsam pa'i rang bzhin la legs par brtags pa las 'dod tshul gyi khyad par ches cher gsal ba lho phyogs bai dabha dang / shar phyogs gau ḍā ba'i lam 'di gnyis su phye nas bstan la/de dag gi nang gses dbye ba zhib phra ni sngar byung ba'i snyan ngag mkhan po so so'i bstan bcos dang / da lta dang ma 'ongs pa'i snyan ngag mkhan po so so'i dgongs pa'am zhal la gnas pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa rnams mtha' dag 'dir bajo da par mi nus te/ gang yin zhe na/ dper na bur shing dang /'o ma dang / bu ram dang / sogs khongs nas ka ra dang / sbrang rtsi dang / sha kha ra la sogs pa rnams spyi'i chos ro mngar ba tsam du rigs gcig yin kyang / nang gses mngar lugs tha dad cing / de dag re re ste/ bu ram lta bu rigs gcig la cha mtshon na'ang shing rigs tha dad pa dang / skye yul bzang ngan gyi dbang gis mngar shas/ che chung mi 'dra ba mang po yod pa dang / 'o na rigs gcig la cha mtshon na'ang sems can ripaska/sa so so dang / sha shed bzang ngan so so'i 'o ma'i ro la khyad par chen—po 'o da pa sa bye brag ma lus par dbye bar mi nus pa ltar du snyan tshig gi dbye ba zhib mo rnams kyang ji snyed pa'i gang zag de snyed pa'i rnam par rtog pa so so/ 'ari sa 'byung la/ tshig rgyan yang de'i rjes su 'gro bas de dag gi mtha'

snyan ngag gi rnam bshad las gzhung don le'u dar po/ 359 —dzogs pa zhig ni ngag gi dbang phyug lha mo dbyangs can mas kyang brjod par mi nus na dbyug pa can bdag gis ga la nus zhes so//2 snyan ngag gi rgyu bshad pa/thun mong ma yin pa'i rgyan gyi rnam par dbye ba'i gsum pa skabs su snyan ngag gi rgyu bshad pa la gsum ste/ phun sum tshogs pa'i rgyu dang /snod du rung ba'i rgyu dang / rgyu de ldan gyi phan yon bstan pa bcas so//(1) phun sum tshogs pa'i rgyu ni/ rtsa bar/ rang bzhin gyis grub spobs pa dang / /mang du thos pa dri med dang/ /matsān par smyor ba mi dman pa/ /snyan ngag phun sum tshogs pa'i rgyu/ /zhes pa ste/ rgyu med na 'bras bu mi 'byung bas snyan ngag shes par bya ba la'ang rgyu zhig dgos te/ de ni skye ba gzhan snga mar rig pa'i gnas la goms pa sngon du song ba'i mthus tshe 'dir rang bzhin gyis grub pa'i spobs pa ste skyes thob kyi shes rab zab mo dang gcig spyir shes bya'i gnas kun dang bye brag snyan ngag gi bstan bcos kyi tshogs dang / de dang 'brel ba sngon gyi gtam rgyud dang / mngon brjod la sogs pa legs bshad kyi tshogs mang du thos shing the tshom gyi dri ma med pa dang gnyis/ de dag sems pa dang goms pa la mngon par sbyor ba'i gus sbyor dang / rtag sbyor gyi brtson 'grus mi dman pa dang gsum ni snyan ngag gi rig tshul phun sum tshogs pa rang rgyud la skrun pa'i rgyu ste/ rgyu kun 'dzoms pa de'o/ /nes theṭa

byu 360 rdorjergyal po'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/(2) snod du rung ba'i rgyu ni/ rtsa bar/ gal te sngon gyi badzwachags yon tan gyi/ /rjes 'brel spobs pa rmad byung med pa la'ang / /thos dang 'bad pa dag gis ngag bsten na/ /ci zhig ltar yang res par rjes 'dzin byed/ /ces pa ste/ de lta na/ skyes thob kyi shes rab med na snyan ngag shes pa'i thabs med dam zhe na/ yod de/ gal te tshe sngon sbyangs pa'i bag chags sad pa'i yon tan gyi rjes 'brel du byung ba'i skyes thob kyi spobs pa rmad du byung ba med pas rgyu dang po ma grub pa'i gang zag la'ang rgyu gnyis pa mang du thos pa dang / rgyu gsum pa 'bad pa chen ngo/sa ngag ste snyan ngag gi rig pa la 'bad pa byas na dbang po'i khyad par ci zhig ltar yang blo gros 'phel bar 'gyur bas nges par du rjes su 'dzin par byed de/ snyan ngag bstan par bya ba'i snod du rung ba yin pas de la dus su bstan par bya dgos so/ /zhes so/ /'dir rang nyid la bsam tshul zhig mchis pa ni spyir snyan ngag mkhas par byed pa la rgyu gsum tshang dgos shing / lhag par du rgyu gnyis pa mang du thos pa dri med dang / rgyu gsum pa mngon par sbyor ba mi dman pa gnyis ni rgyu dang po las kyang gal che ba zhig red/ gal srid rgyu de gnyis nas gcig ma 'dzoms na'ang snyan ngag gi bya ba la 'jug ga la thub/ rgyu dang po skyes thob kyi shes rab zer ba de yang sngon sbyangs kyi 'bras bu red/ gal te skye/ ba snga mar sbyangs med na skye ba 'dir skyes thob kyi shes rab ga la yong /dpe ra na/ bya ba phal pa khyim du me dro bo dgos 'dod pa tsam la cha mtshon na'ang 'bar rdzas bud shing yag po zhig dgos shing / bud shing de

spranangagagirnam bshad las gzhung don le'u dang po/ 361'byung khungs gang bzang 'tshol zhib mi byed pa dang / dka' spyad kyis ri klung mi myul bar nyal sa dro bo zhig tu gnyid skyid por nyal nas sdod mkhan zhig la mal sa'i nang du 'bud shing rdog po gcig kyang 'dzul mi yong zhing 'bud shing med na me gtong thabs bral ba dang / 'bud shing yod kyang thab dang me rtsa sbyar ba'i 'du 'god nges can zhig ma byas par me rang 'bar zhig yong mi srid pa de dag kun gyis shes chod ltar/ snyan ngag sbyar gzhi'i brjod bya'arma nang don shes bya zhig dgos pa de mkhas pa'i ngag gam/rig pa'i gnas spyi'am sgrung dang lo rgyus kyi deb ther/ lhag par du deng rabs kyi shes rig sogs nas bsdu gsog mi byed par spobs pa ri tsam zhig bskyed/ kha gnam la gdangs nas sdod mkhan la shes bya rnams dbyar gyi char pa ltar gnam nas rang gi mgo thog tu 'bab mi srid pas tshig rgyan gyi rgyu cha'am sbyar gzhi nang don med na snyan ngag stong pa sbyar thabs med cing /nang don 'dzoms kyang le lo dang bag g.yeng du bsdad nas 'bad brtson ma byas na rang bzhin lhun grub kyi snyan ngag cig 'byung thabs med pa'ang kun gyis shes chod yin pas gang zag de dag la snyan ngag gi gzhung lugs bstan kyang 'bras bu mi thob/ de ni shes rig gang dang ci la'ang khyab pa'i chos nyid cig yin cing / de ltar du ma gyur par thos brtson la 'bad na/ji skad du/ rang la dgos pa'i bstan bcos rnams/ /nyi ma re la tshig re zungs/ /gang zhig nyin brgya song ba na/ /tshig brgya dag ni shes par 'gyur/ /zhes pa ltar 'byung ba ni sus kyang rtospos thub cing /sbyangs 'bras kyang thon rgyu yod pa de‘‘gsal po can la gsal skyor dang / /

— 362 rdothergyal po'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/nag chung sran mar dbri la skyor ’gyi dpe ltar blo gsar rnams kyi ched du gsol ba lags na 'bad brtson mi glod pa ni gal che shos de yin no//(3) rgyu de ldan gyi phan yon nam yon tan bstan pa ni/ rtsa bar/de phyir grags 'dod rnams kyis rtag tu ni/ /snyom las med par rim pas dbyangs can bsten/ /snyan ngag chung ca la yang ngal —byas mi/ /mkhas pa'i mdun sa dag tu 'du—ga la dbang / /zhes pa ste/ gong du bstan pa bzhin snyan ngag gi rig pa bsten pa ste/ sbyangs na nges par du snyan ngag shes pa'i skal pa dang ldan par 'gyur te/ de'i phyir gnas skabs mkhas pa'i grags pa dang / rnyed bkur/ mthar thug mchog gi grags pa'i gzhi bla na med pa'i byang chub 'dod cing don du gnyer ba rnams kyis dus rtag tu le lo dang snyom las med par thos pa dang /sems pa dang / goms pa'i rim pas dbyangs can te snyan tshig gi gzhung lugs bsten pa ste sbyang bar bya zhing / yang na lha mo dbyangs can ma gus pas bsten par bya'o/ /gang yin zhe na/ dbyangs can ma ni rig pa 'di nyid kyi lhag pa'i lha yin pa'i phyir ro/ /de lta bu'i dka' ba spyad nas snyan ngag sbyangs par dgos pa ci yod ce na/ snyan ngag chen po sargas bcings pa'i sgo nas dam pa'i chos gsal bar byed pa'i bstan bcos brtsams pa dang / dkon mchog gsum la bstod pas ni rang gi yi dam gyi lha yang mnyes nas zhal dngos su bstan te byin gyis rlob pa'ang 'byung skeste/ dper na slob dporin tsand+ra go mis 'jam dbyangs dang / shā badzra de bas spyan ras gzigs la tshig rgyan dang sdeb sbyor phul du byung ba'i sgo nas

snyan ngag gi rnam bshad las gzhung don le'u gnyis pa/ 363bstod pas dngos su rjes su bzung ba'i lo rgyus lta bu dang / mthar thug thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang thob pa bcas ni rgyu 'bras kyi chos nyid bslu ba med pa yin zhing / rgya la de lta bu datho/sa rdon chen po yod pa'i nges pa blo gros kyi bu ga dog por mi 'chud pa rnams kyis kyang 'jig rten lugs kyi blang dor gsal ba'i snyan ngag chung ngu tshigs su bcad pa 'ga' re tsam la skyon spangs shing yon tan sgrub pa'i sgo nas ngal ba bsten na byed pa po rmongs pa'i ngang tshul las ring du grol te mkhas pa'i 'dug sa dag tu 'dug la dbang ba ste mkhas pa'i go 'phang 'thob par gdon mi za'o zhes gsungs shing de ni rang cag rnams kyis brtags shing dpyad na'ang mthong chos mngon gyur rtsod bral zhig yin pas gnad 'di skad cig kyang brjed du mi rung ba zhig go /snyan ngag me long las lho shar gyi lam rnam par phye ba'i skabs te le'u dang po'o// rismras pa/ snyan ngag bstan bcos me long nang / /'char ba'i lus dang thun min gyi/ /rgyan gyi rnam gzhag rab bkra ba/ /bsdusardzil gsal ba 'di na rdzogs// gzhung don le'u gnyis pa/snyo shar thun mong du 'god pa rdon rgyan sna so lnga khyuja mdoja bstad pa/bcad lhug spel ma'i snyan ngag lus/ /mdzes byed rgyan gyi phreng babyu

364 rdo rje rgyal po'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/ sprelas/ /don rgyan sum cu so lnga yi/ /rnam gzhag tshul rnams spro bar bya/ /da ni rtsa ba'i sa bcad gnyis pa bar du dge ba thun mong gi rgyan 'chad pa la gnyis te/ spyir mdor bstan/ bye brag so sor bshad pa'o//dang po spyir mdor bstan pa ni/ rtsa bar/ snyan ngag mdzees par byed pa yi/ /chos rnams rgyan zhes rab tu brjod/ /de ni da lta'ang rnam rtog ste/ /de dag ma lus sus 'chad nus/ /'on kyang rnam rtog sa pon ni/ /sngon gyi slob dpon rnams kyis bstan/ /de nyid rab tu legs skur phyir/ /yongs su ngal 'di bdag gis so/ /zhes pa ste/ snyan ngag gi lus tshigs su bcad pa dang / lhug pa dang / spel ma rnam pa gsum po gang zhig yin rung de mdzes par byed pa'i yon tan nam chos brjod pa gang dang ci rung ba rnams la rgyan zhes sdon rabs pa rnams kyis brjod la/ (tshig 'di ni mdor bstan yin la rgyan spyi'i mtshan nyid kyang yin no/ ) 'o na mtshan nyid de lta bu ldan pa'i rgyan de la rnam grangs ji tsam yod ce na/ de ni snyan ngag mkhan pos brjod 'dod kyi mdzes 'chos ji lta bu zhig bkod kyang rgyan du 'gyur bas sngar 'di tsam yod ces brjod du med la 'byung 'gyur ji tsam yong yang dpog par mi nus pas de dag ma lus pa zhig ni sus kyang 'chad par mi nus mod/ 'on kyang skye bo rnams 'jug pa'i sgo mtshon par bya ba'i ched du rigs mthun bsdus pa'i sgo nas mtshan nyid bzhag cing / rnam rtog skye nus kyi sa bon tsam ni sngon gyi slob dpon mkhas pa rnams kyis bstan yod la/ de dag gsal zhing legs par sbyar ba'i ched du dbyug pa

snyan ngag gi rnam bshad las gzhung don le'u gnyis pa/ 365can bdag gis yongs su ngal bas bstan bcos 'di brtsams so/ /zhes so gnyis pa bye brag so sor bshad pa la gnyis te/ mtshams sbyar nas dam bcas pa dang / bshad tshul dngos rnam par phye ba'o//dang po mtshams sbyar nas bshad par dam bcas pa ni/ rtsa bar/ lam ni rnam par dbye don du/ /rgyan 'ga' zhig ni sngar yang bstan/ /thun mong dag rtu rgyan gyi ni/ /rigs gzhan rab tu bstan par bya/ /zhes pa ste/ lho shar gyi lam srol gnyis rnam par dbye ba'i ched du sbyar ba rab dang sogs yon tan du grags pa'i rgyan 'ga' zhig le'u dang po'i skabs su yang bstan zin la/ da ni lho shar thun mong du 'dod pa'i rgyan gyi rigs gzhan rnams legs par bstan par bya'o/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa bshad tshul dngos rnam par phye ba la don gyi rgyan dang / sgra'i rgyan dang / gab tshig gi rgyan bcas gsum yod/dang po don gyi rgyan la yang ming gis mdor bstan pa dang / dbye bas rgya sa par bshad pa/ spyis mjug bsdu ba bcas gsum yod/dang po ming gis mdor bstan pa ni/ rtsa bar/ rang bzhin brjod dang dbe dang ni/ /gzugs can gsal byed bskor ba dang/ /'gog dang don gzhan bkod pa dang / /ljog pa can dang srid pa can/ /bskus dang phul byung rab brtags dang / /rgyu dang phra mo cha dang rim/ /dga' dang nyams ldan gzi bajid can/ /rnam grangs baspod dang kun tu phan/ /rgya che bsnyon

366 rdo je rgyal po'i gsutha rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/dor sbyar ba dang / /khyad par mtshungs par spyor ba dang / /'gal dang skabs min bstod pa dang / /zlol bstod res par bstan pa dang / /lhan cig brjod dang yongs brjes shis/ /rab spel de nas dgongs pa can/ /'di dag tshig rnams dag gi ni/ /rgyan du sngon gyi mkhas pas bstan/ /zhes pa ste/ rang bzhin brjod pa dang 1/ dpe rgyan dang 3/ gzugs can dang tā/gsal byed dang tre/ bskor ba dang smo/ 'gog pa dang smo/ don gzhan bkod pa dang 7/ ldog pa can dang 8/ srid pa can dang 9/ bsdus brjod dang 1༷/ phul byung dang 11/ rab brtags dang 13/ rgyu rgyan dang bhe3/ phra mo dang 1tre/ cha shas dang 15/ rim pa can dang 1smo/dga' ba dang 17/ nyams ldan dang 18/ gzi brjid can dang 19/rnam grangs brjod pa dngasde 3༷/ kun tu phan pa dang 11/ rgya che ba dang 33/bsnyon dor dang mi3/ sbyar ba dang 1tre/ khyad par can dang 35/mtshungs par sbyor ba dang 3༄/ 'gal ba dang 3me/ skabs min bstod —pa dang 38/ zol bstod dang 39/ nges par bstan pa dang 3༷/ lhan cig brjod pa dang tābhe/ yongs brjes dang tā1/ shis brjod dang tā3/rab spel dang 3byu/ dgongs pa can 3smobacas ming du bstan pa sum cu so lnga po 'di dag rjod par byed pa'i tshig rnams kyi rgyan du sngon gyi slob dpon rā ma sharma la sogs pa rnams kyis bstan to/ /zhes so//gnyis pa dbye ba rgyas par bshad pa la rgyan sum cu so gsum bshad pa dang / rgyan gzhan du 'dod pa 'dir 'dus tshul bshad pa/ rgyan phyi

snyan ngag gi rnam bshad las gzhung don le'u gnyis pa/ 367ma gnyis bshad pa/ blos gar gyi mtshan nyid kyang rgyan du bstan pa bcas bzhi yod do//1 rang bzhin brjod pa bzhi/dang po rgyan sum cu so gsum bshad pa'i don rgyan dang po rang bzhin brjod pa'i rgyan bshad pa la gsum ste/ mtshan nyid bstan pa dang / dper brjod pa/ don bsdu ba'o//dang po mtshan nyid bltan pa ni/ rtsa bar/ dngos po rnams kyi rang bzhin dang / /gnas skabs sna tshogs dngos gsal byed/ /de ni rang bzhin brjod pa ste/ /dang po'i rgyan yin rigs sogs dber/ /zhes pa ste/ brjod par bya ba'i dngos po rnams kyi rang bzhin gnas skabs sutshogleng bar bya ba'i khyad gzhi rigs dang / bya ba dang / yon tan dang / rdzas te bzhi po gang yang rung ba de'i yon tan nam khyad chos rnams bstod smad dang 'khyog bshad kyis ma bslad cing shugs bstan tsam min par dngos su tshig gi byed pas gsal bar byed pa'i rgyan de la ni rang bzhin brjod pa'i rgyan zhes bya ste don rgyan gyi dang po yin la/ de'i nang gses rigs sogs so sor dper brjod na zhes so//gnyis pa dpe sbyor la/ rigs dang bya ba yon tan rdzas/ /rang bzhin brjod pa'i rgyan la bzhi/ /zhes pa ltar/ rigs kyi rang bzhin brjod pa dang / bya ba'i rang bzhin brjod pa/ yon tan gyi rang bzhin brjod pa/ rdzas kyi rang bzhin brjod pa bcas bzhi yod do//

— 368 rdojergyal po'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/ —(1) rigs kyi rang bzhin brjod pa ni/ rtsa bar/ mchu ne dmar zhing gug pa dang / /gshog pa ljang zhing mnyen pa dang / /mgrin par kha dog gsum phreng can/ /ne co 'di dag tshig 'jam ldan/ /zhes pa ste/ mchu kha dog dmar zhing dbyibs gug pa dang /gshog pa kha dog ljang zhing reg bya mnyen pa dang / mgrin pa kha dog dkar sngo dmar ba'i ri mo gsum gyi phreng ba ldan pa'i ne tso 'di dag tshig 'jam por smra ba'i sgra dang ldan no/ /zhes ne tso spyi la khyab pa'i chos sna tshogs bstod smad dang 'khyog bshad ci yang med par ji ma ji bzhin du brjod pas rigs can ne tso yongs rdzogs gsal bar byas pa'o/ /yang na/ spu sgro'i kha dog rnam par bkra/ /sha yi gtsug phud lkog shal can/ /dus su sgrog pa'i skad snyan po/ /bya pho mtsha' lu 'di dag mdzes/ /zhes spu sgro'i kha dog bkra ba dang / sha'i gtsug phud dang lkog shal ldan pa/ dus nges can du sgrog pa'i skad snyan pa bcas khyim bya de pho la yod pa'i khyad chos rnams sgro skur med par ji ma ji bzhin brjod pas rigs can bya de spyi gsal bar byas pas rigs kyi rang bzhin brjod pa'o/ /a lag sha ngag dbang bstan dar gyis/ mgrin pa ring zhing phra ba dang / /lto ba ldir zhing che ba dang //mchu ni 'phyang zhing zhabs zhum pa'i/ /ka la sha 'di bdud rtsi'i snod/ /ces gsungs pa lta bu'o//(2) bya ba'i rang bzhin brjod pa ni/ rtsa bar/ mgrin pa'i nang nas snyan sgrog cing / /mig ni kun tu 'phrul ba yi/ /phug ron rtsed 'dod dga' ma la/ /yongs su bskor nas mchu dag

snyan ngag gi rnam bshad las gzhung don le'u gnyis pa/ 369skyor/ /ces pa ste/ mgrin pa'i nang nas dbyangs gsal ba min pa snyan par sgrog cing / myos pa'i mig dmar po phyogs kun tu g.yo zhing 'phrul ba'i phug ron dag rtsed dga'i bya ba rtsom par 'dod pas rang gi dga' ma ste chung ma la yongs su bskor nas mchu dag sbyor bar byed ces 'dod pas myos pa'i phug ron gyi bya ba sgrog 'phrul/ bskor/ sbyor ces pa rnams bcos med ji ma ji bzhin brjod pas gsal bar byas pa'o/ /yang na/dus bzhi kun tu dka' spyad kyis/ /sa shun ma lus zhing du sbol/ /'debs bsdu'i bya ba rgyun mthud du/ /byed pa zhing pa'i brtson shugs che//zhes dus bzhi kun tu dka' ba spyod pa dang / sa zhing sbol ba/ 'debs bsdu'i bya ba rnams rgyun mar byed pa sogs bya ba rnams ji ma ji bzhin du brjod pa'o//(3) yon tan gyi rang bzhin brjod pa ni/ rtsa bar/ dga' ma yi ni reg pas 'dir/ /lus la spu long rgyas pa dang / /yid ne bde bar byed pa dang / /mig dag zum par byed cing 'jug /ces pa ste/ rang gi dga' mar 'khyud pa'i reg pas bdag gi lus la chags pa'i spu long rgyas pa dang / yid bde bas tshim par byed pa dang //mig gnyis phyed btsums su zum par byed cing / rtsed dga'e bya ba la 'jug par byed do zhes dga' ma'i reg bya khyad par du 'phags pa'i yon tan nam nus pa de brjod pas gsal bar byas pa'o/ /yang na/ nyi ma'i 'od zer 'phros pa yis/ /'jig rten yongs su gsal byed cing / /'byung ba'i drod dang rtsi thog rgyas/ /skye rgu dga' bde'i dpal la 'god/ /

370 rdo rje rgyal po'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/ces/ nyi ma'i 'od zer gyi yon tan nam nus pas 'jig rten gsal bar byed pa dang / klobyung drod dang lo tog rgyas par byed pa/ skye rgu dga' bder 'god pa rnams ji ma ji bzhin du brjod pa'o/ /(4) rdzas kyi rang bzhin brjod pa ni/ rtsa bar/ mgrin sngon lag na thod pa ni/ /gnas pa zla ba'i cod pan dang / /skum zhing dmar ba'i ral pa can/ /khyu mchog rgyal mtshan 'khrangs par 'gyur/ /zhes pa ste/ sngon rgya mtsho bsrubs pa las byung ba'i dug mgrin par gnas pas sngon por gyur la/ tshangs pa'i steng gdong bcad pa'i sdig pa sbyang phyir slong snod dur khrod kyi mi thod lag na gnas pa dang /rgya ddha/tsho las byung ba'i zla ba phyed pa'i cod pan dang / snum zhing kha dog dmar ba'i ral pa can/ khyu mchog gi mgo bos mtshan pa'i rgyal mtshan lag tu thogs pa lha dbang phyug de bsod nams kyi bgo skal du 'khrungs par gyur to zhes dbang phyug nyid la ldan pa'i rdzas sna tshogs brjod pas rdzas can dbang phyug gcig nyid gsal bar byas pa'o/ /yang na/ mthon mthing thor tshugs rab ldem zhing / /sna tshogs dar gyis mdzes sku bklubs/ /phang par rgyud mang sbreng ba yi/ /dbyangs can lha mo ngag gi lha/ /zhes mthon mthing gi zur phud dang / dar sna tshogs kyi na bza'/ phang pa'i rgyud ca/nga bcas dbyangs can mar ldan pa'i rdzas de dag brjod pas rdzas can lha mo dbyangs can ma nyid 'khrul med du mtshon pa'o//gsum pa don bsdu ba ni/ rtsa bar/ rigs dang bya ba yon tan snas/ /rang bzhin brjod pa 'di 'dra ne/ /bstan bachos kun

snyan ngag gi rnam bshad las gzhung don le'u gnyis pa/ 371la rgyal srid nyid/ /snyan ngag la'ang 'de 'dod do/ /zhes pa ste/ spyi sgra gcig gis mtshon te rigs can mang po go bar byed pa'i rigs dang / bya ba'i las ka brjod pa bya ba dang / dngos po gang yang rung ba las byung ba'i yon tan dang / rang mtshan du 'dzin pa'i rdzas sna tshogs shig brjod pas dngos po bye brag pa gcig ston pa rdzas te bzhi dngos po la ji ltar gnas pa de brjod tshul yang rang bzhin las ma 'khyogs par drang por brjod pa 'di ni sgra tshad la sogs pa'i bstan bcos chen po kun la don dang tshig gi nyams phun sum tshogs pa ster ba zhig yin pas rgyal po'i rgyal srid dang 'dra ba nyid de/ snyan ngag gi rig pa'i rgyan rnams kyi dang po la yang 'di 'dod do/ /zhis so/ /mdor bsdus na brjod bya dngos po gang dang gang zhig yin rung de dag rigs so so spyi la khyab pa'i mtshan nyid dam rang bzhin ji lta bu dang ji snyed pa rnams gtso bor bton cing drang por brjod nas rigs can de dag mtshon par byed pa ni rigs kyi rang bzhin brjod pa dang / brjod bya dngos po gang dang gang zhig yin rung de'i bya ba smra bsam dang 'gro 'dug sogs gtso bor bton cing drang por brjod pa ni bya ba'i rang bzhin brjod pa dang / brjod bya dngos po gang dang gang zhig yin rung de'i mthu'am nus pa gtso bor bton cing drang por brjod pa ni yon tan gyi rang bzhin brjod pa dang / brjod bya dngos po jigang dang gang zhig yin rung de la yod pa'i rdzas ji snyed pa rnams gtso bor bton cing drang por brjod nas rdzas can de nyid 'khrul med du mtshon par byed pa ni rdzas kyi rang bzhin brjod pa bcas so// /

372 rdo rje rgyal po'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/2 dpe rgyan sum cu so gnyis/don rgyan gnyis pa dpe rgyan bshad pa la bzhi ste/ mtshan nyid spyir bstan pa dang / dbye ba dper brjod pa/ skyon yon gyi dmigs phye ba/mtshungs gsal gyi sgra bshad pa bcas so//dang po mtshan nyid spyir bstan pa ni/ rtsa bar/ ji lta ji zhig ltar mtshungs par/ /gsal bar gang du rtogs byed pa/ /de ni dpe 'es bya snye de'i/ /spros pa 'dir ni rab bshad bya/ /zhes pa ste/mtshon byed dpe'i steng na khyad chos ji lta bu zhig yod pa de mtshon bya don gyi dngos po la'ang mtshungs par yod pa ngag gi sbyor bas rtogs par byed pa de la ni dpetshorgyan zhes bya ste/ de'i dbye ba rnams 'dir bshad par bya'o/ /zhes so//gnyis pa dbye ba dper brjod pa la/ chos dpe dngos dang bzlog pa dang / /phan tshun dpe dang nges med bsdus/ /phul byung rab btags rmad byung rmongs/ /the tshom gtan 'bebs sbyar ba dang / /mnyam nyid smad dang bsngags pa'i dpe/ /brjod 'dod 'gal ba dgag dang mdzes//de nyid brjod dang thun mong min/ /byung min srid min mang ba dang / /rnam 'gyur phreng ba ngag don gnyis/ /zla bo dngos po mtshungs sbyor dang //rgyu yi dpe ste sum cu gnyis/ /zhes pa ltar chos dpe dang 1/ dngos po'i dpe dang 3/ bzlog pa'i dpe dang kā/ phan tshun gyi dpe dang tre/ nges pa'i dpe dang 5/ nges med kyi dpe dang 5/ bsdus pa'i dpe dang me/

snyan ngagagi rnam bshad las gzhung don le'u gnyis pa/ 373phul byung gi dpe dang 8/ rab btags kyi dpe dang 9/ rmad byung gi dpe dang 1༷/ rmongs pa'i dpe dang 11/ the tshom gyi dpe dang 11/ gtan 'bebs kyi dpe dang 1kā/ sbyar ba'i dpe dang 1bhe/ mnyam nyid kyi dpe dang 1smo/ smad pa'i dpe dang 1smo/ bsngags pa'i dpe dang bhe7/ brjod 'dod kyi dpe dang 18/ 'gal ba'i dpe dang 19/ dgag pa'i dpe dang 3༷/ mdzis pa'am ngo bstod kyi dpe dang 11/ de nyid brjod pa'i dpe dang 31/ thun mong min pa'i dpe dang 3kā/ byung min gyi dpe dang 14/ srid min gyi dpe dang 1smo/ mang ba'i dpe dang 1smo/ rnam 'gyur gyi dpe dang 3me/ phreng ba'i dpe dang 18/ ngag don gyi dpe dang 19/ zla bo dngos po'i dpe dang 3༷/ mtshungs sbyor gyi dpe dang kle1/rgyu'i dpekle1bcas sum cu rtsa gnyis yod do//(1) chos dpe ni/ rtsa bar/ mdzes ma khyod kyi lag mthil ni/ /chu skyes bzhin du kun tu dmar/ /zhes pa chos dpe dngos su ni/ /mtshungs pa'i chos dag bstan phyir ro/ /zhes pa ste/mdzes ma zhes bos nas khyod kyi lag pa 'jam zhing gzhon sha chags pa'i mthil ni chu skyes pad ma bzhin du kun tu dmar bar snang ngo zhes pa ni dpe dang dpe can gnyis kyi mtshungs chos kha dog dmar ba de dngos su tshig gis gsal bar byas pa'o/ /yang na/ rgya gar yul du daṇḍi ltar/ /ljongs 'dir bod mkhas grags pa che/ /snyan ngag gzhung du bstan pa bzhin/ /gang gi dper brjod mtshan nyid tshang / /zhes dpe daṇḍi pa dang / dpe can bod mkhas pa gnyis kyi mtshungs chos snyan grags che ba dang dper

374 rje rgyal po'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/brjod mtshan nyid tshang ba de dag tshig gis dngos su gsal bar byas pas chos dpe'o/ /bod mkhas pa mi pham dge legs rnam rgyal gyis/ ne'u gsing g.yu yi maṇḍal phyis 'drar sngo/ /me tog phreng tshogs skar tshogs bzhin du bkra/ /bung ba'i mgrin sgra rgyud mang ltar snyan pa'i/ /dpyid kyi dus 'dir lha yul lta bur mdzes/ /zhes gsungs pa lta bu'o//(2〉 dngos po'i dpe ni/ rtsa bar/ khrod kyi gdong zhi pad ma bzhin/ /mig dag utpal sngon po bzhin/ /zhes pa chos gcig rtogs byed pa/ /de ni dngos po'i dpe nyid do/ /zhes pa ste/khyod kyi gdong ni pad ma gzhon nu bzhin no/ /mig gnyis po 'di ni utpal sngon po bzhin no zhes dpe dang dbai can gyi dngos po tsam bkod pa'i shugs las gdong dang pad ma mtshungs chos dkar la dmar ba dang / mig dang utpal mtshungs chos gnag cing dkyus ring ba gcig par rtogs par byed dgos pa 'di ni dngos po'i dpe zhes bya ba'o/ /zhes so/ /yang na/ shes par bya ba'i rnam grangs ni/ /mkha' la 'char ba'i skar tshogs 'dra/ /snyan 'jebs tshig gi bstan bcos 'di/ /zla ba gsar pa'i dpal dang mtshungs/ /zhes dpe skar tshogs dang zla ba gsar pa gnyis dang / dpe can shes bya spyi dang snyan ngag gnyis kyi dngos po tsam bkod pa'i shugs las shes bya rnam grangs mang ba skar ma dang 'dra ba dang / snyan ngag yi gar 'ong ba zla ba gsar pa dang mtshungs par rtogs dgos pas dngos po'i dpe'o//(3) bzlog pa'i dpe ni/ rtsa bar/ khyod kyi gdong bzhin

snyan ngag gi rnam bshad las gzhung don le'u gnyis pa/ 375pad ma ni/ /rnam par rgyas par gyur zhes pa/ /de ni grags pa bzlog pa'i phyir/ /bzlog pa'i dbe zhes bya bar 'dod/ /ces pa ste/ lus phra khyod kyi gdong pa bzhin du pad ma 'di dag ni mdzes pa rnam par rgyas par gyur to zhes pa de ni 'jig rten na dpes don 'jal bar byed pa'i grags tshod las bzlog nas gdong dpe can des pad ma dbe'i dngos po gzhal ba'i phyir/ bzlog pa'i dpe zhes bya bar 'dod do//zhes so/ /yang na/ skye bo dam pa'i blo gros ltar/ /zla ba'i ma ma'i gting dpag dka'/ /gang gi 'phrin las ji lta bar/ /rgya mtsho'i dba' rlabs dus su g.yo/ rī /zhes dpe blo gros dang 'phrin las gnyis bkod cing / dpe can rgya mtsho dang rba rlabs bkod pa ni spyir btang dpe dang dpe can 'god tshul las ldog pas ldog pa'i dpe'o//(4) phan tshun gyi dpe ni/ rtsa bar/ khyod kyi zhal bzhin chu skyes te/ /chu skyes bzhin du khyod kyi zhal/ /zhes pa phan tshun khyad 'phags ni/ /rjod par byed 'di phan tshun dpe/ /zhes pa ste/gzhon nu khyod kyi gdong bzhin du chu skyes pad ma 'di yid du 'ong ba zhig go /pad ma bzhin du khyod kyi gdong 'di yang mdzes so zhes phan tshun dper len res kyis gnyis ka khyad du 'phags par brjod pa 'di ni phan tshun gyi dpe zhes bya'o/ /zhes so/ /yang na/ zab rgyas shes bya'i pha mtha' ni/ /lha yi rdzing ring rjes su mchi/ /shes par bya ba'i rnam grangs ltar/ /kun gsal dbyings kyi skar tshogs mang / /zhes shes bya rgya che ba'i dper nam mkha' dang / skar ma grangs mang ba'i dper shes bya'i

376 rdo rje rgyal po'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/rnam grangs bkod pa ni dpe dang dpe can gnyis phan tshun res mos su bkod pas phan tshun dpe'o//(5) nges pa'i dpe ni/ rtsa bar/ khyod zhal pad ma nyid dang mtshungs/ /gzhan ni 'ga' zhig dang lang min/ /zhes pa mtshungs pa gzhan bsgrog phyir/ /'di ne thes pa nyid kyi dpe/ /zhes pa ste/ khyed kyi zhal ni pad ma kho na dang mtshungs kyi/ de las gzhan pa'i dpe ni 'ga' zhig kyang med do zhes mtshungs pa'i dngos po gzhan bzlog pa'i phyir/ dpe gcig kho nar nges pas 'di 'dra ni nges pa'i dpe zhes bya'o/ /zhes so/ /yang na/ dpyod kyin je rgyas je zab tu/ /'gyur ba daṇḍi'i gzhung bzang 'di/ /rin chen 'byung gnas nyid dang mtshungs//de min dper 'os srid na dben/ /zhes daṇḍi'i gzhung lugs zab pa dang rgya che ba'i dper 'os pa rgya mtsho chen po ma gtogs med par brjod pas dpe gcig tu nges pa'o//(6) nges med kyi dpe ni/ rtsa bar/ re zhig khyod gdong pad ma yi/ /rjes 'gro gzhan yang de 'dra ba/ /gal te yod na de byed 'byur/ /zhes pa 'di ni nges med dpe/ /zhes pa ste/ re zhig ste thog ma kho nar khyod kyi gdong ni pad ma dkar po 'di'i rjes su 'gro la/ gzhan yang srid pa 'di na de dang 'dra ba'i mdzes pa can 'ga' re yod na khyod gdong gi dpe de bzhin du byed par 'gyur ro zhes dpe gcig la nges pa med par gzhan yang yod srid par brjod pas nges med kyi dpe zhes bya'o / /zhes so/ /yang na/ snyan ngag mkhan po bod mkhas pa/ /

snyan ngag gi rnam bshad las gzhung don le'u gnyis pa/ 3spya7dbyug pa can dang yang dag mtshungs/ /gzhan yang de lta'i mkhas mchis kun/ /gang gi dpe ru nges par 'dren/ /zhes snyan ngag mkhan po bod mkhas pa ni dbyug pa can dang mtshungs la/ gzhan pa de lta bu'i mkhas pa mchis kun kyang de'i dper 'dren no zhes dpe gzhan yang yod pas nges med kyi dpe'o//(7) bsdus pa'i dpe ni/ rtsa bar/ khyod gdong mdzes pa kho na yis/ /bla ba'i rjes su 'gro min te/ /dga' skyed las kyis kyang zhes pa/ /'di 'dra bsngus pa'i dpe yang yod/ /ces pa ste/khyod kyi gdong mdzes sdug ldan pa kho nas zla ba'i rjes su 'gro ba ste mtshungs pa min gyi/ gzhan gyi yid la dga' ba skyed pa'i byed las kyis kyang mtshungs so/ /zhes so/ /yang na/ glog sgron gsal ba kho na yis/ /padma'i gnyen dang mi 'dra ste/ /skye 'gro yongs kyi lus dbang la/ /bde drod ster ba 'dis kyang ngo / /zhes glog zhu gsal ba kho na tsam gyis nyi ma dang 'dra ba ma yin la/ de'i 'od skye 'gro'i lus la phog na bde drod skyed pa 'dis kyang ngo zhes ngo bo 'od gsal bar ma zad/ bde drod skyed pa'i byed las kyis kyang mtshungs par bstan pa'o//(8) phul byung gi dpe ni/ rtsa bar/ khrod kyi zhal ni khyod nyid la/ /mthong zhing zla ba mkha' la mthong / /'azhi nyid kho na tha dad de/ /gzhan med cus pa phul byung dpe/ /zhes pa ste/ khyod kyi zhal te bzhin ras ni khyod nyid kyi lus kho na la mthong zhing / zla ba nya bang ba ni nam mkha'i dbyings su mthong ngo / /mthong yul mi gcig pa

378 rdo the rgyal po'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/'di kho na ma gtogs/ gzhan tha dad du 'byed chos ci yang med do zhes 'byed chos mi 'dra ba mang du yod kyang med pa ltar 'ud kyis brjod pas phul byung gi dpe zhes bya'o/ /zhes so/ /yang na/ rlangs 'khor 'dzin ma'i steng rgyu zhing / /gnam gru bar snang khams la 'phur/ /gzhan ma'i khyad chos tha dad pa/ /bdag blos nam yang rtogs mi 'gyur/ /zhes dpe can rlangs 'khor dang dpe gnam gru gnyis 'phrul 'khor la brten pa dang mgyogs po'i chos mtshungs pa tsam la 'ud kyis bstod de dpe gnam gru nam mkhar 'gro ba dang dpe can rlangs 'khor sa steng du 'gro ba gnyis 'gro lam tha dad pa tsam las mgyogs bul dbyer med pa ltar brjod pa'o//(9) rab btags kyi dpe ni/ rtsa bar/ de yi bzhin dpal nga nyid la/ /yod ces zla ba snyems mi dgos/ /padma la yang de mod phyir/ /zhes pa 'di ni rab btags dpe/ /zhes pa ste/mdzes ma de yi bzhin ras kyi dpal mtha' dag nga nyid kho na la yod kyi/gzhan la med do zhes zla ba khyod de tsam du snyems pa 'chang mi dgos/ padma gzhon nu 'di la yang dkar ba dang mdzes pa sogs kyi dpal de lta bu yod pa'i phyir ro zhes zla ba la de lta bu'i rtog pa med kyang yod pa ltar btags —nas brjod pa 'di ni rab btags kyi dpe'o/ /zhes so/ /yang na/'dus byas mi rtag 'gyur ba'i chos/ /mtshon zhes chu 'dzin snyems mi bya//srid 'di'i dngos po mchis so cog /chos nyid de las 'da'azhe mi srid/ /ces dpe chu 'dzin sems med la dpe can 'dus byas mi rtag pa'i mtshungs chos de yod snyam pa'i khengs pa 'byung mi srid kyang / de ltar snyems mi

snyan ngag gi rnam bshad las gzhung don le'u gnyis pa/ 379dgos/ chos de ni dngos po mchis so cog la yod ces rab btags kyis ba rjod pa'o//(10〉 rmad byung gi dpe ni/ rtsa bar/ smin legs gal te padma 'ga'/ /rnam par 'phrul ba'i mig ldan na/ /khyod kyi bzhin gyi dpal 'dzin te/ /zhes pa 'azhi ni rmad byung dbe/ /zhes pa ste/kye smin legs ma zhes bo sa nas/ gal te me tog padma 'ga' zhig rnam par 'phrul ba'i mig zung gi mdzes pa dang ldan par gyur na khyod kyi bzhin ras kyi dpal 'di lta bu 'dzin par byed de mtshungs par 'gyur ro zhes so/ /yang na/ phra zhing ldem pa'i chu skyes 'di/ /yan lag lnga yis rab mdzes shing / /rin chen rgyan dang ldan gyur na/ /yid 'ong khyod kyi dpe ru 'os/ /zhes yid 'ong ma'i dper me tog pad ma la yan lag lnga dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis spras pa zhig ma byung na mtshon mi nus par brjod de gang de'i mdzes pa rmad du byung bar bstan pa'o//(11) rmongs pa'i dpe ni/ rtsa bar/ lus phra khyod gdong ri pong can/ /zhes btags khyod gdong bsams pa yis/ /zla ba yi yang rjes su bsnyegs/ /zhes 'di mongs pa'i dbe ru bshad/ /ces pa ste/ lus phra ma khyod kyi gdong pa ni ri bong can zhes zla ba yin par btags la/ khyod kyi gdong yin par bsams nas don du gnyer ba'i blo yis zla ba 3di yi rjes su yang bsnyegs te phyin to zhes yang gi sgras dpe dpe can gnyis ka ngo ma shes par 'khrul bar bstan pa'i phyir rmongs pa'i dpe zhes bya bar bshad do/ /yang na/ khyod kyi snya na 'gyur glu dbyangs

380 rdo rje rgyal po'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/ rnams/ /rkang drug sgra ru rab 'khrul te/ /gang gi glu dbyangs mnyan 'dod pas/ /'dab brgya ldan pa'i tshal kun myul/ /zhes dpe can gzhon nu ma zhig gis dal bur len pa'i glu dbyangs snyan po de dang dpe bung ba'i glu dbyangs gnyis dbyer ma chod par gzhon nu ma de 'tshol bar bung ba'i sgra sgrog sa me tog gi tshal du myul bar bshad pa ni rmongs pa'i dpe'o//(12) the tshom gyi dpe ni/ rtsa bar/ pad nang bung ba 'khor ram ci/ /khyod gdong la mig g.yo 'am ci/ /bdag gi sems ni rnam par g.yo/ /zhes pa 'di ni the tshom dpe/ /zhes pa ste/'di na dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs can zhig gi steng na mthon mthing rnam par 'phrul ba'i dngos po zung zhig yod pa 'di dag ni padma'i nang du bung ba 'khor ba yin nam/ khyod kyi gdong la mig rnam par g.yo ba ci zhig yin snyam du bdag gi sems ni som nyi'i dbang gis rnam par g.yo bar gyur to//zhes the tshom gyi sgo nas 'dra bar bstan pas 'di ni the tshom gyi dpe zhes bya'o/ /zhes so/ /yang na/ ci 'di khreng tu'i bar snang la/ /chu 'dzin rnam par 'khrig gyur tam/ /yang na ljongs 'di'i steng phyogs su//dar dkar bla res bres sam snyam/ /zhes khreng tu'i nam mkha' sprin gyis bsgribs te gnam sngon po dang rgyu skar gang yang mthong rgyu med pas na 'di nam mkhar sprin 'khrigs pa yin nam/ yang na dar dkar gyi bla re bres pa ci yin snyam pa'i the tshom du gyur pa'i tshul gyis 'dra bar bstan pas the tshom gyi da pe'o//

snyan ngag gi rnam bshad las gzhung don le'u gnyis pa/ 381(13) gtan la 'bebs pa'i dpe ni/ rtsa bar/ zla ba skyengs byed mtshes pa 'di/ /bla bas tshar gartsod padma min/ /de phyir khyod kyi gdong nyid do/ /zhes pa 'de ni gtan 'bebs dpe/ /zhes pa ste/ ci 'di na zla ba yang skyengs par byed pa'i mdzes pa can zhig 'dug pa 'di ni padma min te/ de yin na zla bas tshar gcod cing zum par byed mod/ 'dis ni zla ba yang skyengs shing ngo tsha bar byed nus pa'i phyir na padma min/ yid 'ong ma khyod kyi gdong nyid do/ /zhes pa 'di ni gtan tshigs kyi sgo nas nges shing khong du chub pas yin lugs gtan la 'bebs pa'i dpe'o/ /zhes so/ /yang na/ mtha' dang rgyan ris mi mngon zhing / /char yang 'di las 'bab 'gyur bas/ /'di ni bla re ma yin la/ /chu 'dzin nyid du nges pa rnyed/ /ces nam mkha' sgrib byed 'di bla re yin na mtha' 'ja' dang mdzes rgyan yong rgyur 'di la de dag med par ma zad/ char ba'ang 'di las 'bab pas chu 'dzin nyid yin par nges pa rnyed pa'am gtan la phebs pa'i dpe'o//(14) sbyar ba'i dpe ni/ rtsa bar/ bsil zer can gyi dgra zla dang / /dpal dang ldan dang dri bzang gis/ /khyod kyi gdong ni chu skyes bzhin/ /zhes pa sbyar ba'i dpe ru bshad/ /ces pa ste/ bsil zer can zla ba'i mdzes pa gdong gis pham par byed pa dang /padma zla bas zum par byed pa'i phyir gnyis ka zla ba'i dgra zla yin pas sgra sbyar la/ gdong mdzes pa'i dpal phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan pa dang /yadma las khyab 'jug gi chung ma dpal mo byung bas sgra sbyar ba'am/ yang na

382 rdo rje rgyal po'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/gnyis ka mdzes pa'i dpal dang ldan pa don sbyar zhing / gdong kha dri zhim pa dang padma dri bsung bzang po dang ldan pa don sbyar/ de'i dbang gis khyod kyi gdong ni chu skyes bzhin no zhes sbyar ba gsum dang dpe gsal byed mnyam du gnas pas sbyar ba'i dpe zhes su bshad do/ /zhes so/ /yang na/ mchog tu zab pa'i gting mnga' zhing / /pha mtha'i tshad kyang gzhal mi nus/ /rin chen gter gyi rab phyug pa/ /dam pa'i thugs ni rgya mtsho 'dra/ /zhes dpe can skye bo dam pa'i thugs dang / dpe rgya mtsho gnyis kyi khyad chos gting zab pa dang pha mtha' mi mngon pa don sbyar zhing / dam pa'i thugs legs bshad rin po che'i 'byung khungs yin pa dang / rgya mtsho nor bu rin po che'i 'byung khungs yin pa sgra sbyar/ mjug tu mtshungs pa gsal byed kyi sgra 'dra zhes yod pas sbyar ba'i dpe'o//(15) mnyam nyid kyi dpe ni/ rtsa bar/ mtshungs pa sgra yi brjod pa'i phyir/ /mnyam nyid dbe ste ji ltar na/ /skyed tshal phreng 'di bu mo bzhin/ /mdzes ldan snga la kā na na/ /zhes pa ste/ don gyi chos mtshungs sgra don sbyar ba der ma zad/ brjod bya don gyi mtshungs chos med kyang mtshungs pa'i chos sgra mnyam pa la byas te brjod par bya ba'i phyir sgra mtshungs sam sgra mnyam nyid kyi dpe zhes bya ba'ang yod/ de nyid ji ltar yin zhe na/ skyed mos tshal me tog dang nags kyi phreng ba can 'di ni bu mo gzhon nu bzhin te/ skyed mos tshal ni sā la spos dkar gyi shing dang / kā na na nags te sā la'i nags kyi mdzes pa dang ldan pa zhes skad rang sor bzhag pas 'grub la/ bu mor brjod pa'i skabs su chigañtsa

snyan ngag gi rnam bshad las gzhung don le'u gnyis pa/ 383gcod mtshams tha dad de/ sa bcas pa/ a la ka lan bu/ ā na na gdong yin pa de mtshungs sgras mtshams sbyar bas yi ge'i gzugs gcig kyang / don lan bur bcas pa'i gdong mdzes ldan zhes rbad de tha dad par gnas shing / sgra mtshungs pa'ang mtshams sbyor yod med gnyis kyi sgo nas bshad dgos pa dang / sgra mtshungs pa tsam las gzhan pa don gyi mtshungs chos ci yang med do/ /de'i phyir sgra mnyam nyid kyi dpe'o/ /zhes so/ /yang na/ 'bad dang rtsol bas ka ca'i rigs/ /gsog dang srung ba'i ngal ba 'di/ /bung bas sbrang rtsi gsog pa bzhin/ /'jug par bya ba'i tha ma yin/ /zhes dpe can mi rnams kyis dngos po gsog srung byed pa dang / dpe bung bas sprang rtsi gsog srung byed pa gnyis kyi mtshungs chos 'jug par bya ba'i tha ma yin zhes pa ngag nas brjod skabs sgra mtshungs pa tsam zhig las/ tha ma yin zhes pa'i sgra'i gcod mtshams kyi dbang gis don tha dad pas mtshungs chos gang yang med pas sgra mnyam nyid kyi dpe'o//(16) smad pa'i dpe ni/ rtsa bar/ padma rtsal mang zla ba 'dzad/ /de dag las ni khrod kyi bzhin/ /mtshungs pa la yang khrad par bcas/ /zhes pa smad pa'i dpe ru 'dod/ /ces pa ste/padma ni ge sar las byung ba'i rdul mang zhing / zla ba ni mar ngo la cha shas bri nas 'dzad 'gro ba zhig yin pas de dag dang ni khyod kyi bzhin ras mtshungs par mdzes la/ rdul gyi sgra skyon nam dri ma la yang 'jug pas de dag khyod kyi gdong la med pa dang / 'grib pa med par cha shas rtag tu gang bas stad par dang bcas pa'o/ /zhes dpe la sgad pa'i sgo nas mtshungs par

384 rdo rje rgyal po'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/ ma zad gdong lhag par ston pas smad pa'i dpe'o/ /zhes so/ /yang na/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor mar ngor bri/ /'dab ma brgya pa mtshan mo zum/ /de dag dang ni khyod kyi bzhin/ /mtshungs par ma zad khyad du 'phags/ /zhes dpe zla ba mar ngor bri ba dang / pad ma mtshan mo bzhad mi thub pa zhig yi na zhes smad pa'i sgo nas de dag dang khyed kyi bzhin ras mtshungs par ma zad khyad du 'phags so zhes dpe la smad pa'i sgo nas dper byas pas smad pa'i dpe'o//(17) bsngags pa'i dpe ni/ rtsa bar/ padmas tshangs pa mchog tu bskyed/ /zla ba bde 'byung gtsug gi rgyan/ /de dag khyod gdong mtshungs zhes pa/ /de ni bsngags pa'i dber brjod do/ /zhes pa ste/ khyab 'jug gi lto ba'i padmas 'jig rten gyi mes po tshangs pa mchog tu bskyed cing / zla ba ni bde 'byung ste lha'i nang na dbang che bar grags pa dbang phyug chen po'i gtsug gi rgyan du 'dzin pas phul du byung ba'i dngos po de dag dang khyod kyi gdong mtshungs so zhes dpe la bsngags pa'i sgo nas mtshungs par ston pas bsngags pa'i dpe'o/ /zhes so/ /yang na/ ri bong 'dzin ni mkha' yi rgyan/ /chu skyes kun gyi yi gar 'ong / /de zung dang ni khyod kyi bzhin/ /mdzes pa'i khyad chos gcig tu gyur/ /zhes dpe zla ba nam mkha'i rgyan dang / pad ma ni kun gyi yi gar 'ong ba zhig yin zhes bstod cing / de dag dang khyod kyi bzhin ras mtshungs so zhes dpe la bstod pa'i sgo nas dper brjod pas bstod pa'i dpe'o//(18) brjod 'dod kyi dpe ni/ rtsa bar/ yon tan ldan

snyan ngag gi rnam bshad las gzhung don le'u gnyis pa/ 385nam skyon 'gyur yang / /zla ba khyod gdong mtshungs zhes pa/ /brjod 'dod bdag gi yid la yod/ /ces pa brjod 'dod dpe zhes rig /ces pa ste/ 'di ltar brjod pas yon tan du 'gyur ram skyon du 'gyur ni mi shes/ 'on kyang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor nya gang ba 'di dang khyod kyi gdong mtshungs so zhes brjod par 'dod pa zhig bdag gi yid la yod do zhes brjod 'dod kyi bsam pa'i dbang gis mtshungs par bstan pas brjod 'dod kyi dpe zhes bya bar rig par bya'o/ /zhes so/ /yang na/ brtan cing brjid pa mtshon byed dam/ /gal te skyon du 'gyur yang rung / /khyod kyi sku dang ri yi dbang / /mtshungs zhes brjod par bdag rang 'dod/ /ces brjid pa dang brtan pa sogs kyi yon tan mtshon par 'gyur ram/ beem po'i rang bzhin gyi skyon mtshon par 'gyur mi shes kyang khyed kyi sku dang ri yi dbang po gnyis mtshungs par brjod 'dod do zhes brjod pa brjod 'dod kyi dpe'o//(19) 'gal ba'i dpe ni/ rtsa bar/ 'dab brgya pa dang ston zla dang/ /khyod kyi bzhin dang gsum po ni/ /phan tshun rnam par 'gal zhes pa/ /de ni 'gal ba'i dper brjod do/ /zhes pa ste/'dab brgya pa ste padma dang / ston dus kyi zla ba dang / khyod kyi bzhin ras gsum po 'di mdzes chos kyi yon tan gcig pa la/ phan tshun rnam pa tha dad pas 'gal te dgra zlar gyur to zhes pa de gli gcig tha dad kyi 'gal bar brjod pas 'gal ba'i dper brjod do/ /zhes so/ /yang na/nyin gyi rta bdun bdag po dang / /mtshan la 'phro ba'i glog sgron 'od/ /

386 rdo rje rgyal po'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/mkhas mchog gang gi dgongs pa gsum/ /phan tshun 'gal bar ma gyur tam/ /zhes nyin mo'i nyi ma dang / mtshan mo'i glog zhu/ mkhas pa'i dgongs pa gsum gsal ba'i chos sam yon tan gcig kyang / phan tshun rnam pa tha dad pas 'gal bor sems so zhes brjod pas 'gal ba'i dpe'o//(20) dgag pa'i dpe ni/ rtsa bar/ dri ma ldan zhing blun gyur pas/ /zla ba la ni khyod gdong dang / /'gran pa'i nus pa nam yang med/ /ces pa dgag pa'i dbe nyid do/ /zhes pa ste/nag po'i ra ri'i dri ma dang ldan zhing sems med blun pa/ bem po'i rang bzhin can du gyur pa zla ba 'di la ni khyod kyi gdong dri ma dang bral zhing shes rig ldan pa 'di la 'gran pa'i nus pa nam yang med do zhes mtshungs pa dgag pa'i sgo nas dper bkod pas dgag pa'i dpe zhes bya'o/ /zhes so//yang na/ rnam par shes pas ma bzung zhing / /dbang po lnga yis ma brgyan pa/ /bsil zer can la khyod zhal dang / /'gran pa'i nus pa cha tsam med/ /ces rnam shes kyis ma bzung ba dang / dbang po lnga yang med pas zla ba la khyod zhal dang 'gran pa'i nus pa med ces dgag pa brjod pa'i sgo nas dper bkod pas dgag pa'i dpe'o//(21) mdzes pa'am ngo bstod kyi dpe ni/ rtsa bar/ khrod gdong ri dwags mig gis mtshan/ /zla ba ri dwags nyid kyis mtshan/ /de lta na yang 'dir mtshungs nyid/ /khyad 'phags min zhes mtshes pa'i dpe/ /zhes pa ste/ khyod kyi gdong ni ri dwags e na ya'i mig gis

snyan ngag gi rnam bshud las gzhung don le'u gnyis pa/ 387mtshan la/ zla ba ni ri dwags kyi gzugs nyid kyis mtshan mod/ de lta na'ang 'dir yon tan mtshungs pa nyid de/ zla ba la khyad par 'phags pa'i chos gzhan yod pa min no zhes cha shas tsam dang cha shas rdzogs pa'i yon tan mtshungs par byas te mdzes pa'i phyir mdzes pa'am ngo bstod kyi dpe'o/ /zhes so/ /yang na/ 'od dkar can ni zla ba dngos/ /khyod gdong zla ba'i mdangs kyis mdzes/ /de lta na yang skye bo'i blor/ /dga' ba skyed par gcig tu mtshungs/ /zhes 'od dkar can ni zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dngos dang / khyed kyi gdong ni zla ba'i mdangs kyis mdzes pa tsam zhig yin pa gnyis dga' ba skyed pa'i bya ba byed par gcig tu mtshungs zhes dpe zla ba dngos dang dpe can gdong zla ba'i mdangs tsam ldan pa gnyis mtshungs par brjod pas ngo bstod kyi dpe'o//(22) de nyid brjod pa'i dpe ni/ rtsa bar/ 'de ne bzhin nyid padma min/ /'di dag bung ba ma yin mig /ces pa rnam gsal mtshungs pa las/ /'di ni de nyid brjod pa'i dbe/ /zhes pa ste/ dkar zhing mdzes pa 'di ni khyod kyi bzhin ras nyid yin te/me tog padma min no/ /snum zhing g.yo ba 'di dag bung ba 'khor ba ma yin te/ khyod kyi mig go zhes dpe dang dpe can gyi mdzes pa rnam par gsal bar mtshungs pas tha dad med pa lta bur gyur pa las/ brtags shing dpyad pas gdong dang mig gi dngos po de gnyis so sor rtogs nas brjod pas 'di ni de nyid brjod pa'i dpe'o/ /zhes so/ /yang na/ 'di dag lha yi gar mkhan min/ /sgyu rtsal tshogs pa'i gzhon nu yin/ /snyan 'gyur

388 rdo je rgyal po'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/dri za'i rgyud mang min/ /sna tshogs rol cha'i sgra dbyangs so/ /zhes dpe lha yi gar mkhan dang / dri za'i rgyud mang dag dang / dpe can sgyu rtsal tshogs pa'i gzhon nu dang / rol cha rnams khyad chosga 'dra ches panu/ tha mi dad pa lta bur snang yang / brtags shing dpyad pas sgyu rtsal tshogs pa'i gzhon nu dang rol cha yin pa so sor rtogs nas brjod pas de nyid brjod pa'i dpe'o//(23) thun mong min pa'i dpe ni/ rtsa bar/ zla ba padma dag gi ni/ /mdzes pa las 'das khyod kyi gdong/ /bdag rang nyid dang mtshungs par gyur/ /zhes pa thun mong min pa'i dpe/ /zhes pa ste/ srid pa 'di na mdzes pa'i dper byed pa zla ba dang padma dag gi mdzes pa las 'das pa khyod kyi gdong pa 'di mtshon nus kyi dpe gzhan med pas rang nyid kho na dang mtshungs par gyur to zhes mtshungs pa gzhan ma rnyed pa ltar brjod cing / rang gi dper rang nyid bkod pa 'di 'dra ni thun mong min pa'i dpe'o/ /zhes so/ /yang na/ srid na mgyogs pa 'dab chags kyis/ /cha tsam 'gran par mi nus pa/ /mkha' la 'phur ba'i 'phrul gru yi/ /dpe ru lcags bya rang nyid 'jog /ces srid pa 'dir mgyogs pa'i tshad du byed pa bya yis kyang cha tsam yang 'gran par mi nus pa gnam gru mgyogs pa'i dper 'os pa gzhan mi rnyed pas lcags bya rang nyid 'jog go zhes brjod pas thun mong min pa'i dpe'o//(24) byung min gyi dpe ni/ rtsa bar/ padma'i mdzes pa'i snying po kukud/ /'ga' zhig dag tu basbubasna pakubazhin/ /khyod 'al rnam

snyan ngag gi rnam bshad las gzhung don le'u gnyis pa/ 389par marjes zhes pa/ /de ni byung min dbe zhes rig /ces pa ste/'jig rten khams 'di'i mi tog padma'i mdzes pa ci yod kyi snying po kun phyogs 'ga' zhig tu bsdus nas bkod pa bzhin khyod kyi zhal ras 'di rnam par mdzes so zhes de lta bu'i dpe ni sngar ma byung zhing yod pa yang ma yin pa'i dpes gdong 'jal bar byed pas na byung min gyi dpe zhes rig par bya'o/ /zhes so/ /yang na/ srid na snyan pa'i tshig sbyor kun/ /gcig tu bsdus 'dra'i nyams 'gyur can/ /snyan ngag gzhung lugs sbyong ba la//rang cag 'bad pas 'jug par rigs/ /zhes srid pa 'dir yod pa'i tshig sbyor snyan rgu ma lus pa phyogs gcig tu bsdus pa'i nyams 'gyur zhes pa sngar byung ma myong ba'i dpes snyan ngag gi yon tan brjod pas byung min gyi dpe'o//(25) srid min gyi dpe ni/ rtsa bar/ bla ba'i gzugs las dug bzhin dang/ /tsan dan las ni me bzhin du/ /zhal 'di las ni chub mo'i mig /ces pa grid pa min pa'i dbe/ /zhes pa ste/ zla ba'i gzugs bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin las dug dang / tsan dan mtha' gcig tu bsil ba las me'i dngos po 'dzag mi srid pa bzhin dam pa khyod kyi zhal 'di las rtsub mo'i tshig 'byung ba nam yang mi srid do zhes dpe don kun la rnam dbye lnga pa sbyar zhing / 'byung mi srid pa'i bsam pas mtshungs par byed pas srid pa min pa'i dpe'o/ /zhes so/ /yang na/rdo las me tog mi skye zhing / /chu las rtsi bcud mi thon ltar/ /blum/ po mun nyal mkhan po las/ /legs bshad thos pa ci la srid/ /ces rdo

390 rdo rje rgyal po'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/las me tog skye mi srid pa dang / chu las mar thon mi srid pa'i dpe gnyis kyis blun po las legs bshad mi 'byung ba bstan pas srid min gyi dpe'o//(26) mang ba'i dpe ni/ rtsa bar/ tsan dan chu dang zla ba'i zer/ /zla shel sogs bzhin khyod kyis ni/ /reg pa bsil zhes khyad par dag /gsal bar byed 'azhi mang ba'i dpe/ /zhes pa ste/ tsan dan dang / gangs kyi chu dang / zla ba'i zer dang / zla ba chu shel gyi nor bu dang / sogs khongs nas kha ba dang / lho'i rlung gzhon bcas bzhin du dga' ma khyod kyi lus kyi reg pa mchog 'di shin tu bsil lo zhes dpe gcig gis kyang reg bya bsil ba mtshon nus mod/ dga' ma ri reg pa bsil ba khyad du 'phags pa ston pa la dpe mang po bkod pas mang ba'i dpe'o/ /zhes so/ /yang na/ ka ra bu ram sbrang rtsi dang / /bdud rtsi'i ro bzhin myong gin du/ /je legs je bzang shes bya la/ /dka' ba spyod pa don dang ldan/ /zhes shes bya rnams ji tsam nyams su myong ba de tsam du je legs je bzang du 'gro ba'i khyad chos gsal bar ston pa'i dper ka ra dang / bu ram/ sbrang rtsi/ bdud rtsi bcas mang po bkod pas mang ba'i dpe'o//(27) rnam 'gyur gyi dpe ni/ rtsa bar/ lus phra khrod kyi bzhin ras ni/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor nas bton bzhin/ /padma'i nang nas phyung b.rizhin/ /zhes pa 'di ne rnam 'gyur dbe/ /zhes pa ste/ lus phra ma khyod kyi bzhin ras ni zla ba nya gang ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus nas zul gyis bton pa bzhin dang / padma gzhon nu kha bye

snyan ngag gi rnam bshad las gzhung don le'u gnyis pa/ 391ma thag pa'i nang nas gsar du phyung ba bzhin no zhes rnam 'gyur yid du 'ong ba'i tshig sbyor bkod pa 'di ni rnam 'gyur gyi dpe'o/ /zhes so/ /yang na/ shes rab ldan pa'i brtson pa ni/ /rta bdun shugs kyis drangs pa bzhin/ /gang gi legs par bshad pa yang / /nyi 'od nang nas phyung dang mtshungs/ /zhes brtson 'grus rgyun mi chad pa rta bdun gyi shugs kyis drangs pa dang / legs bshad don gsal ba nyi 'od kyi nang nas byung ba'i rnam 'gyur dang 'dra bar brjod pas rnam 'gyur gyi dpe'o/ /(28) phreng ba'i dpe ni/ rtsa bar/ 'odakyis nyi bzhin nyi ma yis/ /nyin bzhin nyin gyis mkha' la bzhin/ /rnam par gnon pas khyod la dpal/ /'dzin zhes de ni phreng ba'i dpe/ /zhes pa ste/ nyi ma la rang gi 'od kyis dpal 'dzin pa bzhin du nyi mas nyin par la dang nyin par gyis kyang nam mkha' la dpal 'dzin pa de bzhin du pha rol pa gnon pas kyang rgyal po khyod la dpal phun sum tshogs pa 'dzin no zhes snga ma rim bzhin dpe dang phyi ma rim bzhin dpe can phring bar spel bas phreng ba'i dpe'o/ /zhes so/ /yang na/ chu las padma padma las/ /ze'u de las zil mngar ltar/ /mkhas pa gcig las gcig brgyud pa'i//gzhung lugs zab mos 'jig rten mdzes/ /zhes rig pa'i gzhung lugs mkhas pa gcig nas gcig brgyud pa'i dper chu las pad ma dang / pad ma las ze'u 'bru/ ze'u las zil mngar bcas byung ba rim par phreng rgyud du bkod pas phreng ba'i dpe'o//(29) ngag don gyi dpe la mtshan nyid bshad pa dang / dper

392 rdo je rgyal po'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/brjod pa gnyis yod pa'i dang po mtshan nyid bshad pa ni/ rtsa bar/ gang yang ngag don nyid kyis ni/ /gal te ngag don nyer 'jal na/ /ngag don dpe ste bzhin sgra ni/ /gcig dang du mas de rnam gnyis//zhes pa ste/ gang yang tshig gi don tsam ma yin par byed can drug ci rigs dang 'brel ba'i 'jal byed dpe'i ngag don gyis gzhal bya don gyi ngag don nye bar 'jal ba ni ngag don gyi dper brjod la/ ngag don gyi dpe de yang bzhin sgra gcig yod pa dang / bzhin sgra du ma yod pa gnyis so/ /byed can drug ni byed po las dang byed can ched/ /'byung khungs gzhi rnams byed can drug /drug brgyad spangs pa'i rnam dbye'i gzhi/ /zhes so/ byu /gnyis pa dper brjod las dang po ba shi na sgra gcig pa'i dper brjod ni/rtsa bar/ khrod gdong mig ni mi brtan zhing / /so yi 'od zer rab gsal ba/ /'dam skyes bung ba g.yo ldan ni/ /ne sar dag gis mtshon bzhin mjos/ /zhes pa ste/ khyod kyi gdong mdzes pa dang / mig mi brtan pa ste g.yo ba/ so'i 'od zer rab tu gsal ba zhes gzhal bya don gyi ngag don gsum 'dam skyes me tog padma dang / bung ba rnarma par g.yo ba dang ldan pa/ ge sar gyi phreng bas mtshon pa bcas ltar mdzes so zhes 'jal byed dpe'i ngag don gsum re re bzhin gyis thad kar 'jal ba la bzhin sgra gcig las med pa'o/ /zhes so/ /yang na/ snying tsha/sa dga' ba'e 'dzum dkar can/ /brtse bas 'dud pa'i grogs mo 'de/ /chu skyes 'dab ma rab bzhad pa/ /ze'u 'brus non bzhin yid la 'bab/ /zhes dpe can gzhal bya don gyi ngag don snying nas dga'

snyan ngag gi rnam bshad las gzhung don le'u gnyis pa/ 393ba'i 'dzum dkar ldan pa dang / brtse bas 'dud pa'i grogs mo de 'jal byed dpe'i ngag don chu skyes 'dab ma bzhad pa dang / ze'u 'bru'i ljid kyis padma dbyibs gug pas rim pa bzhin thad kar gzhal ba la bzhin sgra gcig las med pas ngag don gyi dpe bzhin sgra gcig pa'o/ /gnyis pa bzhin sgra du ma'i dpe ni/ rtsa bar/ padma can bzhin lus phra ma/ /padma bzhin du de yi gdong / /sbrang rtsi spyod pas bzhin du ne/ /bdag gis 'thungs ging 'thungs shang rtses/ /zhes pa ste/ padma can te padma'i ljon pa bzhin du lus phra ma khyod nyid dang / de las byung ba'i padma bzhin du de yi gdong dang / sbrang rtsi spyod pa ste bung ba bzhin du 'dod ldan bdag gis 'thungs shing 'thungs shing rtses so zhes bzhin sgra du ma yod cing / 'thungs dang rtses zhes pa'i bya tshig dang 'brel ba zhig go /yang na/ mdzes sku ri bo bzhin du brtan/ /gsung dbyangs khu byug sgra bzhin snyan/ /thugs dkyel mkha' bzhin yangs pa yi/ /bshes gnyen khyod kyis rtag tu skyongs/ /zhes dpe can gzhal bya don gyi ngag don sku brtan pa dang / gsung snyan pa/ thugs dkyel che ba bcas 'jal byed dpe'i ngag don ri bo dang / khu byug gi dbyangs/ nam mkha' gsum bkod de rim pa bzhin so sor gzhal ba la bzhin sgra gsum yod pas ngag don bzhin sgra du ma can no//(30) zla bo dngos po'i dpe la mtshan nyid bshad pa dang / dpe brjod bshad pa gnyis yod pa'i dang po mtshan nyid ni/ rtsa bar/ dngos po 'ga' zhig nyer bkod nas/ /de yi chos mthun rab bkod

394 rdo je rgyal po'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/pa/ /mnyam pa nyid du rtogs pa can/ /zla bai dngos po'i dpe yin dper/ /zhes pa ste/ brjod bya'i dngos po 'ga' zhig nye bar bkod nas de'i chos mthun pa'i dpe zhig phyis sam mjug tu bkod pas de mnyam pa nyid du shugs las rtogs pa can de ni zla bo dngos po'i dpe zhes bya ste/ dper brjod na zhes so/ /gnyis pa dper brjod ni/ rgyal po rnams ni skyes byur kyang / /da lta khyod 'dra gcig kyang med/ /yongs 'du dag la rkang 'thung ni/ /gnyis pa res par yod ma yin/ /zhes pa ste/ sngon rabs su rgyal po ji snyed pa rnams skyes par gyur kyang / da lta'i bar du khyod 'dra ba'i yon tan dang ldan pa'i rgyal po ni gcig kyang med la/ lha'i shing yongs 'du sa brto‘ra la 'gran nus pa'i rkang 'thung ste ljon shing gnyis pa nges par yod pa min no/ /zhes so/ /yang na/ snyan ngag gzhung 'grel mang yod kyang / /daṇḍi'i dgongs rgyan lta bu med/ /nya rgyas zla ba'i dkyil 'khor ni/ /gnyis pa nam yang yong mi srid/ /ces dpe can snyan ngag gi gzhung 'grel mang yang daṇḍi'i dgongs rgyan lta bu meed ces brjod cing / de dang chos mthun pa'i dpe ni zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gcig ma gtogs gnyis pa nam yang yong mi srid pa 'di'o zhes brjod pas zla bo dngos po'i dpe'o//(31) mtshungs sbyor gyi dpe la mtshan nyid bshad pa dang / dpe bshad pa gnyis las dang po mtshan nyid bshad pa ni/ rtsa bar/ lhag pas dman pa bya ba yi/ /cho ga gcig la rab bsngus nas/ /gang smras de ni mtshungs pa dag /smyor ba'i dbe ru bshad de dber/ /

snyan ngag gi rnam bshad las gzhung don le'u gnyis pa/ 395zhes pa ste/ dpe lhag pas don nam dpe can dman pa bya ba'i cho ga gcig la rab tu bsdus nas gong du gang smras pa de ni bya ba 'dra ba'i sgo nas mtshungs par byas pas mtshungs pa dag sbyor ba'i dpe ru bshad de/ dper na zhes so/ /gnyis pa dpe bshad pa ni/ rtsa bar/ pu lo ma dgras mtho ris dang / /khyod ni sa srung mel tshe byed/ /de yis dregs ldan lha min dang / /khrod kyis mi yi bdag po 'joms/ /zhes pa ste/ lha ma yin pu lo ma zhes pa'i dgra bo brgya byin ni mtho ris lha yi gnas dang / rgyal po khyod ni sa chen po 'di srung ba'i phyir mel tshe byed la/ brgya byin gyis dregs ldan lha min gyi bdag po dang / khyod kyis mi'i bdag po gzhan 'joms par byed ces rang sde srung zhing gzhan sde 'joms pa'i bya ba brgya byin dang gcig par bsdus pa'o/ /zhes so/ /yang na/ thub pa'i dbang po rgya gar dang / /'jam mgon bla ma bod du 'khrungs/ /gang gis rdo rje gdan gnas dang / /khyod kyis ri bo dga' ldan bskyangs/ /zhes dpe thub pa'i dbang po rgya gar du 'khrungs pa dang / dpe can tsong kha pa bod du 'khrungs pa so so'i yul yin pa dang / ston pas gdan sa rdo rje gdan bskyangs pa dang / tsong kha pas gdan sa ri bo dga' ldan bskyangs pa mtshungs par brjod pas mtshungs sbyor gyi dpe'o//(32) rgyu'i dpe ni/ rtsa bar/ rgyal po mdzes pas zla ba dang / /gzi byin gyis ne nyi ma dang / /brtan pas rgya mtsho'i rjes su byed/ /ces pa 'di ni rgyu dper dran/ /zhes pa ste/ rgyal po khyod mdzes pa'i rgyus zla ba dang / gzi byin che ba'i rgyus nyi ma dang /

396 rdo rje rgyal po'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/zab cing brtan pa'i rgyus rgya mtsho chen po gting mi g.yo ba'i rjes su byed do zhes mdzes pa dang / gzi byin dang / brtan pa rnams rgyur bkod cing mtshungs par sbyar bas rgyu'i dpe zhes dran par bya'o/ /zhes so/ /yang na/ gzhung 'di zab pas rgya mtsho dang / /snying pos phyug pas dbyig gi mdzod/ /gces par 'os pas nor bu 'dra/ /blo ldan rnams kyis mnyan par 'os/ /zhes snyan ngag gi gzhung 'di don zab pas rgya mtsho dang / snying pos phyug pas dbyig mdzod/ gces par 'os pas nor bu bcas dang 'dra zhes rgyu mtshan la 'jug pa'i byed sgra gsum gyis 'dra bar bstan pas rgyu'i dpe zhes pa'o//gsum pa skyon yon gyi dmigs phye ba la spyir btang yon tan du 'dod pa dang / dmigs bsal skyon du brtsi ba gnyis yod/dang po ni/ rtsa bar/ blo ldan mi dgyes med gang la/ /nges par dbe yi skyon dag ni/ /tha dad rtags dang tshig la med/ /dman dang lhag pa nyid la'ang med/ /ma ning 'di 'gro bud med bzhin/ /bud med 'di smra skyes pa bzhin/ /bdag gi grogs 'di srog rnams bzhin/ /rig pa rnams skub nor bzhin no/ /sa gzhi skyong ba khyod bzhin du/ /lha yi rgyal po rnam par mdzes/ /tsha zer can gyi nus pa la/ /mi bdag gzi yis 'gong bar nus//zhes pa de lta bu la sogs/ /skal bzang nam yang gtong min nyid/ /ces pa ste/ snyan ngag smra ba'i blo dang ldan pa rnams mi dgyes pa med pa'i tshig gang zhig la nges par du dpe'i skyon du 'gyur ba dag ni

stan ngag gi rnam bshad las gzhung don le'u gnyis pa/ 397rtags tha dad pa dang / tshig tha dad pa dang / dpe dman lhag gi sbyor ba gang la yang med/ dper na/ ma ning 'di'i 'gro tshul bud med bzhin du mdzes la/ bud med 'di'i smra ba ni skyes pa bzhin du spobs pa dang ldan par smra'o zhes rtags tha dad kyang skyon med pa dang / bdag gi grogs 'di tshe rabs du ma'i srog rnams bzhin gces la/ rig pa'i gnas rnams sgrub tshul ni nor bu rin po che bzhin no zhes gcig tshig dang mang tshig tha dad kyang skyon med pa dang / sa gzhi skyong ba'i mi'i rgyal po khyod bzhin du lha'i rgyal po rnam par mdzes so zhes dpe dman pa dang / tsha zer can nyi ma'i nus pa la mi bdag gi gzi brjid kyis 'gong bar nus zhes dpe mchog yin spyang skyon med pa bcas te brjod ma thag pa de lta bu la sogs ni legs pa'i skal ba bzang po nam yang gtong ba min pa nyid de nam yang yon tan dang ldan par brtsi'o/ /zhes so//gnyis pa dmigs bsal skyon du brtsi ba ni/ rtsa bar/ spyor ba 'ga' la ngag rig rnams/ /mi dgyes pa yod ji ltar na/ /ngang mo bzhin du zla ba dkar/ /mtsho rnams bzhin du mkha' dri med//khri bzhin dpa' bai rje la gus/ /nyi ma bzhin du me 'khyer gsal//'di 'dra spangs te mkhas rnams kyis/ /rgyu yang 'der ni bsam par byos/ /zhes pa ste/ tshig gi sbyor ba 'ga' zhig la snyan ngag gi rig pa ldan pa rnams mi dgyes pa yang yod/ dpe ji ltar yin zhe na/ rkang pa dang por rtags tha dad pa dang / rkang pa gnyis par tshig tha dad pa dang /rkang pa gsum par dpe dman pa dang / rkang pa bzhi par dpe mchog

398 rdo rje rgyal po'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/bcas yin cing / sbyor tshul 'di 'dra ba rnams ni thos pa tsam na mi mdzes pa'i blo skye ba'i phyir 'di 'dra ba'i rigs spangs te mkhas pa rnams kyis dpe don phun sum tshogs pa'i rgyu yang skabs 'dir yang dag par bsam par byos shig ces so//bzhi pa mtshungs pa gsal byed kyi sgra bshad pa la spyir gzhung 'di'i dngos bstan rnam grangs drug cu rtsa lnga yod pa de dag sde tshan bzhir phye nas bshad srol ltar phye na dpe don gsal bar byed pa nyer gnyis dang / 'dra ba'i don gsal ba bco brgyad/ dpe rgyan gsal byed bco lnga/ de lta bu la sogs pa'i sgra bcu bcas yod do//1 dpe don gsal bar byed pa nyer gnyis ni/ rtsa bar/ bzhin ltar lta bu ji ltar sgra/ /mthun mtshungs yang dag mtshungs dang mnyam/ /yang dag gsal dang nges par gsal/ /rab gsal gzugs kyi bla po dang / /gnyen po dang ni dgra bla dang / so sor rtog dang 'gal dang 'dra/ /blta bcas dang ne bgru ba dang //rigs mthun rjes su smra ba dang / /zhes pa ste/ bzhin dang / ltar dang / lta bu dang / ji ltar dang / mthun dang / mtshungs dang / yang dag mtshungs dang / mnyam dang / yang dag gsal dang / nges par gsal dang / rab tu gsal dang / gzugs kyi zla bo dang / gnyen po dang / dgra zla dang / so sor rtog dang / 'gal dang / 'dra dang /blta dang / bcas dang / bslu ba dang / rigs mthun pa dang / rjes su smra ba zhes rnams so/ /

snyan ngag gi rnam bshad las gzhung don le'u gnyis pa/ 3992 'dra ba'i don gsal ba bco brgyad ni/ rtsa bar/ gzugs brtan dang ni so sor ndeb/ /gzugs mtshungs mnyam dang yang dag gzhal/ /mtshan nyid mthun 'dra mtshungs pa dang / /mthun phyogs dper byas dbe dang rtog /dman dang cung zad dman sogs dang / /rab ngu smra dang so sor bablog /rigs mthun mnyam byas sgra dag dang / /gang yang dman min don can tshig /ces pa ste/ gzugs brnyan dang / so sor sdeb dang / gzugs mtshungs dang / gzugs mnyam dang / yang dag gzhal dang / mtshan nyid mthun dang / mtshan nyid 'dra dang / mtshan nyid mtshungs dang /mthun phyogs dang / dper byas dang / dpe dang / rtog dang / dman dang / cung zad dman dang / rab tu smra dang / so sor bzlog dang /rigs mthun dang / mnyam par byas bcas te gang yang rung ba dman pa ma yin pa'i don can gyi tshig rnams so//3 dpe rgyan gsal byed bco lnga ni/ rtsa bar/ ri bong mtshan ma'i gdong can sogs/ /'bya mang po yi tshig rtsad dang / ༈'gran dang rgyal dang sdang ba dang / /'khu dang mi mthun sgrog pa dang / /'thab pa dang ni 'phya ba dang / /sma 'bebs byed dang smad pa dang / /rtso 'dri ba dang 'gog pa dang / /dgod dang phrag dog mi brngod dang / /zhes pa ste/ 'bru mang po'i tshig sdugadang / 'gran dang / rgyal dang / sdang ba dang / 'khu ba dang / mi mthun sgrog pa dang / 'thab pa dang / 'phya ba dang / sma 'bebs byed

400 rdo rje rgyal po'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/pa dang / smad pa dang / co 'dri ba dang / 'gog pa dang / dgod pa dang / phrag rdog dang / mi bzod ces rnams so//4 de lta bu la sogs pa'i sgra bcu ni/ rtsa bar/ de yi skalabazang 'phrog byed dang / /de yi mtshes pa zum byed dang / /de dang 'gran las tshar gartsod dang / /de dang mtshungs las lhag par mdzes/ /de yi rjes su rkang 'jog dang / /de yi nus pa la 'jug dang / /de yi rjes 'gro rjes su 'ching / /de yi ngang tshul de 'gog dang / /de yi rjes su byed ces pa'i/ /sgra rnams mtshungs pa gsal byed yin/ /zhes pa ste/ de'i skal bzang 'phrog byed dang / de yi mdzes pa zum byed dang / de dang 'gran las tshar gcod dang / de dang mtshungs las lhag par mdzes dang / de yi rjes/ su rkang pa 'jog pa dang / de yi nus pa la 'jug dang / de yi rjes su 'gro ba dang / de yi rjes su 'ching ba dang / de yi ngang tshul de 'gog dang /de yi rjes su byed ces pa rnams so/ /de rnams kyi dper brjod ni bod mkhas pa'i〈〈snyan ngag dpe rgyan gsal byed kyi dper brjod sgra ldan lha'i 'dzum zer〉〉zhes pa deb 'di'i mjug tu zur du yod pa ltar ro//5 gzhung 'di'i nang du dngos su bstan med kyang gzhan yang mtshungs pa gsal byed la 'jug pa cha dang / grogs dang / spun zla dang /mthong dang / thos dang / dran dang / reg dang / pham dang / snyeg dang / 'dzeg dang / sems pa sogs ji snyed cig mchis shing / de dag krung go mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag gi sgrig khrims chen po gsum

snyan ngag gi rnam bshad lasagazhungadonale'uganyisapa/ 101—dang do snang byed dgos pa brgyad la sbyar nas dper brjod na/ /bya ba gang byed bkar nyan pa/ /gser thig lag tu len pa'i cha/ /dmangs nor rang gis mi len pa/ /ha la'i dug gi grogs su 'dzin/ /dgra nor gzhung la 'byul ba ni/ /dkor mdzod gnyer ba'i spun zlar byed/ /gang bshad gtam gyi tshig 'jam pa/ /gces phrug skyong ba'i ngag tu mthong / /nyo tshong drang gzhag byed pa'i tshul/ /tshangs chen rgad po'i ngag tu thos/ /g.yar ba'i dngos po phyir sprod pa/ /bcol nor skyel ba'i tshul du dran/ /dngos por skyon shor tshab 'jal ba/ /skyes bzang sprod pa'i dpal la reg /gzhan la gshe brdung mi byed pas/ /mig mi 'dzum pa'ang pham la nye/ /lo tog sogs la mi gnod pa/ /mig 'bras srung ba'i rjes su snyeg /bud med rnams la mi brnyas pa/ /gcen gcung gus pa'i dazhwa la la 'dzeg /bzung dmag brnyas brdung mi byed pa/ /skyong bar byed pa'i las su sems/ /zhes pa lta bu yin zhing / sgrig khrims chen po gsum ni/ 1 bya ba gang byed rung bkod par nyan dgos pa/ 2 na nga tshogs kyi khab skud tsam yang blangs mi chog pa/ 3 dgra lag nas rngob pa'i dngos po mtha' dag gzhung la 'bul dgos pa bcas so/ /do snang byed dgos pa brgyad ni/ 1 skad cha drang por bshad dgos pa/ 2 nyo tshong drang gzhag byed dgos pa/ 3 g.yar ba'i dngos po phyir spro da dgos pa/ 4 dngos por skyon shor na skyin tshab sprod dgos pa/ 5 mi la nyes rdung dang gshe gshe btang mi chog pa/ 6 lo tog la skyon btang mi chog pa/ 7 bud med la btsan brnyas byas mi chog pa/ 8 bzung

402 rdo rje rgyal po'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/dmag la brnyas brdung byas mi chog pa bcas so/ /mtshungs pa gsal byed kyi sgra 'di rnams dpe rgyan gyi tshig sbyor la shin tu mkho ba'i cha rkyen zhig yin pas 'di dag khong du chub na yo byad 'dzoms pa'i bzo pas gang la ci bzos yong ba ltar dbe don gsal ba'i tshig sbyor phun sum tshogs pa yid la bsams pa ltar byed thub pa zhig yong bar brten 'di la byang chub pa zhig bya rgyu ni shin tu gal che'o/ /mtshungs pa gsal byed kyi sgra 'di da ga las bzhin dang / ltar dang / 'dra dang / mtshungs dang / lta bu sogs ni mtshungs pa dngos su ston pa'i sgra dang / 'gran dang / rgyal dang / 'khu dang / mi mthun sgrog pa dang / de yi skal bzang 'phrog byed dang / de yi mdzes pa zum byed sogs ni rab btags kyi rnam pa 'dres nas mtshungs par ston pa'i sgra yin pa rnams zhib mos dpyad par 'tshal/ 'o na mtshungs pa gsal byed kyi sgra gang rung zhig med na dpe rgyan sbyor mi thub bam zhe na/de'ang min/ mtshungs sgra dngos su med kyang ngag don nam don gyi nus pa'i dbang gis mtshungs par go bas dpe rgyan du bzhag pa'ang mang du mchis/ dper na/ phul byung gi dpe dang / rmongs pa'i dpe/ the tshom gyi dpe/ gtan 'bebs kyi dpe/ 'gal ba'i dpe/ de nyid brjod pa'i dpe/ mtshungs sbyor gyi dpe sogs la gong du bshad pa'i mtshungs pa gsal byed kyi sgra de rigs med kyang don du 'dra bar go ba lta bu yin zhing / sbyor tshul ni skabs su bab pa'i brjod bya'i dpe don gyi tshig la gang zhig 'jug bde ba sbyar bas 'thus pa las/ 'di la 'di sbyor dgos nges pa med pa zhig go/

snyan ngag gi rnam bshad las gzhung don le'u gnyis pa/ 4033 gzugs can gyi rgyan nyi shu tham pa/don rgyan gsum pa gzugs can gyi rgyan bshad pa la gsum ste/ mtshan nyid spyir bstan pa dang / bye brag dper brjod pa/ dpe gzugs gnyis thun mong gi don bsdu ba bcas so//dang po mtshan nyid spyir bstan pa ni/ rtsa bar/ tha dad snang min gyur pa yi/ /dpe ni ngo bo can 'dod dper/ /zhes pa ste/dpe dang dpe can tha dad du snang ba ma yin par gzhi mthun du bsdusari/ shing /gcig tu sgro btags te brjod pa'i dpe 'di nyid ni ngo bo can nam/gzugs can nam/ tshul can gyi rgyan zhes su 'dod do/ /zhes so//gnyis pa bye brag so sor dper brjod pa la/ bsdus pa'i gzugs can ma bsdus pa/ /bsdus shing ma bsdus mtha' dag dang / /cha shas dang ni cha shas can/ /yan lag gcig sogs ldan mi ldan/ /mi mnyam khyad 'phags 'gal ba rgyu/ /sbyar ba dpe bzlog 'gog pa dang / /mnyam 'jog gzugs can gyi gzugs can/ /bsnyon dor gzugs can dang nyi shu/ /zhes pa ltar/ bsdus pa'i gzugs can dang 1/ ma bsdus pa'i gzugs can1/ bsdus shing ma bsdus pa'i gzugs canakā/ ca/tha' dag gzugs canatre/ cha shas gzugs can5/ cha shas can gyi gzugs canazhu/yan lag gcig sogs gzugs caname/ ldan pa'i gzugs can8/ldan min gzugs can9/ mi mnyam pa'i gzugs can10/ khyad par gzugs can11/ 'gal ba'i gzugs can13/ rgyu'i gzugs can1kā/

404 rdo rje rgyal po'i gsutha rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/sbyar ba'i gzugs can14/ dpe'i gzugs can15/ bzlog pa'i gzugs canabhesmo/ 'gog pa'i gzugs can1me/ mnyam 'jog gzugs can18/gzugs can gyi gzugs canabhe9/ bsnyon dor gzugs can 30bcas nyi shu tham pa yod do//1 bsdus pa'i gzugs can ni/ rtsa bar/ dpung pa 'khri shing lag pa ni/ /padma sor mo yal 'dab bo/ /zhes pa ste/ dpung pa 'khri shing dang / lag pa padma/ sor mo yal 'dab bcas so sor gzugs su bkod cing / dpe dang dpe can 'di dag gi bar du dpung pa'i 'khri shing zhes pa lta bu rnam dbye drug pa 'brel sgra thob kyang / sgra mdo ka lha par/gzhi mthun pa yi tshig dag ni/ /las 'dzin byed par rnam shes bya/ /zhes bsha da pa ltar las 'dzin nam khyad par gyi bsdu bas rnam dbye bsdus pa'o//zhes so/ /yang na/ khyod thugs klong zab rgya mtsho las/ /byung ba'i legs bshad ma ṇi ka /blo gsar klu yi dbang po yi/ /spyi bo mdzes pa'i rgyan du gyur/ /zhes thugs rgya mtsho dang / legs bshad nor bu/ blo gsar pa klu bcas kyi gzugs su bkod cing / dpe dang dpe can gyi bar la thugs kyi rgya mtsho zhes lta bu'i 'brel sgra re thob pa de dag bsdus pas bsdus pa'i gzugs can no//2 ma bsdus pa'i gzugs can ni/ rtsa bar/ lag pa'i 'khri shing sor mo (yi〉 rnams/ /lal 'dab sen mo'i 'od zer ne/ /me tog rtu byur dpyid kyi dpal/ /khyod ni nged la mngon sum rgyu/ /zhes pa 'di ni ma brtsas te/ /snga ma brtsas pa'i gzugs can

snyan ngag gi rnam bshad las gzhung don lemu gnyis pa/ 4du5no/ /zhes pa ste/ lag pa'i 'khri shing sor mo rnams kyi yal 'dab/sen mo'i 'od zer ni me tog tu gyur pa'i mdzes ma dpyid kyi dpal khyod nged kyi mig sngar mngon sum du rgyu'o zhes pa 'di ni dpe dang dpe can bar gyi rnam dbye ma phyis pas ma bsdus pa dang / dper brjod snga ma de ni bsdus pa'i gzugs can no/ /zhes so/ /yang na/ lus kyi 'khri shing rab ldem zhing / /lang tsho'i 'dab brgya rnam par rgyas/ /brtse dga'i zil mngar 'bum 'dzag pa'i/ /mdza' mo khyod 'dra srid na dkon/ /zhes lus 'khri shing dang / lang tsho 'dab ma/ brtse dga' zil mngar bcas kyi gzugs su bkod cing / dpe dang dpe can bar la lus kyi 'khri shing zhes pa lta bu'i 'brel sgra re thob pa rnams ma bsdus par bkod pas ma bsdus pa'i gzugs can no/ /yang na/ mkhyen pa'i sdong po cher rgyas par/ /brtse ba'i 'bras bu g.yur za zhing / /nus pa'i grib bsil khyab che ba'i/ /bshes gnyen khyod 'dra bsten par 'os//3 bsdus shing ma bsdus pa'i gzugs can ni/ rtsa bar/ bzhin bla 'dzum pa'i zla 'od ces/ /gzugs can bsngus shing ma brtsas pa'o/ /zhes pa ste/ bzhin ras kyi zla ba zhes pa'i drug sgra phyis nas bzhin zla zhes dang / 'dzum pa'i zla 'od ces pa'i drug sgra ma bsdus pas gzugs can bsdus shing ma bsdus pa zhes bya'o/ /zhes so/ /yang na/thabs kyi mchog dkar gzhu mo dang / /shes rab nyag phran la brten nas//rmongs pa'i dgra bo 'joms mkhas pa'i/ /bshes gnyen dpa' bo'i phul khyod mtshar/ /zhes thabs gzhu dang / shes rab mda'/ rmongs pa dgra

406 rdo je rgyal po'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/bo/ bshes gnyen dpa' bo bcas kyi gzugs su bkod cing / thabs kyi mchog dkan dang / rmongs pa'i dgra bo zhes pa'i 'brel sgra ma bsdusamishing /shes rab nyag phran dang / bshes gnyen dpa' bo zhes 'brel sgra bsdus pas bsdus shing ma bsdus pa'i gzugs can no//4 mtha' dag gzugs can ni/ rtsa bar/ sor mo dmar ba'i 'dab phreng dang / /sen mo'i 'od kyi ge sar can/ /khyod kyi zhabs kyi 'dam skyes ni/ /sa skyong rnams kyi spyi bor 'dzin/ /zhes pa ste/ sor mo rab tu dmar ba'i 'dab ma'i phreng ba dang / sen mo'i 'od kyi ge sar ldan pa/ mi'i bdag po khyod kyi zhabs kyi 'dam skyes te padma 'di ni sa gzhi skyong ba gzhan rnams kyi spyi bor cod pan gyi tshul du 'dzin no/ /zhes so/ /de'i don bshad pa ni/ rtsa bar/ sor mo la sogs 'dab sogs dang / /rkang pa padma nyid byas nas/ /de 'os gnas su rnam bkod pa/ /'di ni mtha' dag gzugs can no//zhes pa ste/ sor mo 'dab ma dang / sogs kyis bstan pa sen mo'i 'od ni ge sar du byas la rkang pa padma nyid du byas shing / de gzung bar 'os pa'i gnas spyi bor rnam par bkod pa 'di ni yan lag dang yan lag can ma lus pa gzugs su bkod pas mtha' dag gzugs can no/ /zhes so//yang na/ spyi tshogs gsar pa'i skyed tshal na/ /bde skyid me tog bzhad pa'i dbus/ /longs spyod('dod yon) zil mngar la rol ba'i skye rgu bung ba'i tshogs 'di skyid/ /ces spyi tshogs skyed tshal dang / bde skyid me tog longs spyod zil mngar/ skye rgu bung ba bcas rten dang brten pa ma

snyan ngag gi rnam bshad las gzhung don le'u gnyis pa/ 407lus pa gzugs su bkod pas mtha' dag gzugs can no//5 cha shas gzugs can ni/ rtsa bar/ gtum mo blo bur nyid du ni/ /khrod gdong mchu yi lal 'dab g.yo/ /jul gyi chu yi thigs pa yi/ /dog pa sku tig 'od can 'dzin/ /'dir ni zul chu dog par byas/ /mchu yang yal 'dab nyid byas kyi/ /gdong ni rnam pa gzhan ma byas/ /de phyir cha shas gzugs can no/ /zhes pa ste/ kye gtum mo zhes bud med khro ba can ma bos nas/ rkyen gang yang med par glo bur du khyod kyi gdong la mchu yi yal 'dab 'dar zhing g.yo la/ rngul gyi chu'i thigs pa'i dog pa mu tig gi 'od can yang 'dzin no/ /zhes dang / de'i don ni/ skabs/ der rngul chu dog pa ste 'bras bu dang / mchu yal 'dab kyi gzugs su bkod kyi/ khyad gzhi gdong ni rnam pa gzhan gyi gzugs su ma bkod pa'i phyir cha shas gzugs can no/ /zhes so/ /yang na/ sa rgya che zhing mi mang ba'i/ /rgyal khab chen po krung go yi/ /zhing chen si khron pad tshal gyi/ /bde skyid 'dab brgya bzhad bzhin mchis/ /zhes cha shas can krung go gzugs su ma bkod cing / cha shas si khron pad tshal dang / bde skyid 'dab ma'i gzugs su bkod pas cha shas gzugs can no//6 cha shas can gyi gzugs can ni/ rtsa bar/ gdong pa'i 'dam skyes smin 'khyog cing/ /jul gyi chu ni zags pa dang / /mig dag kun rtu dmar ba 'dis/ /byus pa'i gnas skabs gsal bar byed/ /'dir ni gdong pa'i cha shas dag /rnam 'byur ma byas
