464 rdo rje rgyal po'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/cing / de sgrub byed du gnyis skyes dbang po ste bram ze'i rgyal po la skyon 'ga' zhig ldan yang rig byed la sogs pa'i chos kyis gzhan rjes su 'dzin par nus so zhes bstan bya'am bshad par bya ba zla ba dri ma dang ldan yang dga' ba skyed pa dang / sgrub byed bram ze skyon dang ldan yang gzhan rjes su 'dzin nus pa 'gal bar bkod pas 'gal ba'i don gzhan bkod pa'o/ /zhes so/ /yang na/ stobs dang nus pa chung na yang / /lhag bas ma—ldan na gzhan don 'grub/ /'khos dman byi ba smug chung gis/ /glang chen bslangs pa'i gtam rgyud yod/ /zhes stobs dang nus pa chung yang lhag bsam bzang po ldan na gzhan don bsgrub par nus zhes bsgrub byar bkod cing / sgrub byed du/ srog chags kyi nang nas 'khos ka shin tu dman pa'i byi bas stobs ches che ba glang chen g.yang bkar ba bslangs pa'i lo rgyus yod pa lta bu'o zhes stobs chung bas che ba bskyabs pa 'gal ba'i don gzhan bkod pa'o//5 mi 'os pa'i don gzhan bkod pa ni/ rtsa bar/ sbrang rtsi 'thung ba'i mgrin snyan las/ /byung ba bung ba'i sgra dag kyang / /rna bar chub pa nyid 'byung ba/ /'dod ldan rnams kyi sdeg 'azhi 'dra/ /zhes pa ste/ sprang rtsi 'thungs te myos pa'i mgrin pa snyan po las byung ba bung ba gzhon nu'i sgra 'jam po dag kyang rna ba'i lam du rtsub par 'gyur ba 'di ci yin zhes dam bcar bkod cing / de sgrub byed du 'jam pa rtsub par ma zad/ bsil bas gdung bar byed pa sogs 'dod ldan rnams kyi sdig pa'am myong bya'i rang bzhin ni 'di 'dra'o zhes bkod pa ni

snyan ngag gi ne—/ bshad las gzhung don le'u gnyis pa/ 461—'jam pa'i dngos po rtsub par 'gyur ba mi 'os pas mi 'os pa'i don gzhanabakod pa'o/ /yang na/ blun po rnams la legs bshad kyang / /rna getsha ba'i mtshon du 'gyur/ /'o ma skye 'gro'i bdud rtsi de/ /sbrul la byin na dug tu 'gyur/ /zhes legs par bshad pa'ang rna ba tsha bar byed pa'i mtshon du 'gyur ro zhes 'byung mi 'os pa zhig bsgrub byar bkod cing / de'i sgrub byed du/ de ltar yang srid de/ 'o ma zhes pa 'di skye 'gro kun gyi lus gso ba'i bdud rtsi yin kyang / sbrul la byin na dug tu 'gyur ro zhes 'byung mi 'os pa'i don gzhan bkod pa'o//6 'os pa'i don gzhan bkod pa ni/ rtsa bar/ chu skyes 'dab mari mal stan 'dis/ /bdag gi lus 'di gdung bar byed/ /greg pa'i bdag nyid greg za dang / /'dra bas rigs pa ma yin nam/ /zhes pa ste/ chu skyes padma'i 'dab ma'i mal stan 'jam pa'i rang bzhin 'dis 'dod pa skyed de bdag gi lus 'di gdung zhing sreg par byed ces dam bcar bkodatsho cing / de sgrub byed du de ni rigs te padma ni sreg pa'i bdag nyid me dang 'dra ba ste kha dog dmar zhing gdung ba skyed thub pa'i dngos po chos mthun pa'i phyir ro zhes bkod pa 'di ni gdung bar byed 'os pa bstan pa'i phyir 'os pa'i don gzhan bkod pa'o/ /zhes so/ /yang na/ mkhas pa'i legs bshad zab mo yis/ /log rtog rtsa ba dum bur gcod/ /legs bshad lung rigs dbal rno bas/ /de ltar 'gyur 'di 'os shing rigs/ /zhes legs bshad kyis log rtog gi rtsa ba gcod pa ci yin nam zhes bsgrub byar bkod cing / de'i sgrub byed du de ni 'os pa zhig

466 rdo rje rgyal po'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/ste lung rigs kyi dbal shin tu rno bas so zhes 'os pa'i don gzhan bkod pa'o//bhā 'os shing mi 'os pa'i don gzhan bkod pa ni/ rtsa bar/bsil zer can gyis nyams byed mod/ /dpyid kyis bdag ni ci la gdung / /dri ma can gyis spyod pa'i la—sa/ /dag pas mi 'os pa min nam/ /zhes pa ste/ bsil zer can zla bas bdag gi sems gdung zhing nyams par byed pa rigs mod/ dpyid kyi dus dag pa'i rang bzhin can 'dis bdag ci la gdung ste gdung bar mi 'os so zhes dam bcar bkod cing / de sgrub byed du ra ri'i dri ma can gyis spyod pa'i las de lta bu dri mas ma gos pa'i dngos pos byed mi 'os pa min nam zhes bkod de snga ma dngos po bye brag pa'i byed las 'os shing mi 'os de phyi ma spyi khyab cig gis bsgrubs pas 'os shing mi 'os pa'i don gzhan bkod pa'o zhes so/ /yang na/ dgra bos sdang bar byed mod kyi/ /rang gi gnyen gyis ci la sdang / /gdug rtsub can gyi spyod tshul dag /brtse ba ldan pas byed 'gyur ram/ /zhes dgra bos sdang bar byed mod kyi/ gnyen gyis ci'i phyir sdang ste sdang bar mi 'os zhes bsgrub byar bkod cing / de'i sgrub byed du/de ltar te/ gdug rtsub can gyi spyod tshul de dag brtse ba dang ldan pas byed par mi 'os so zhes 'os shing mi 'os pa'i don gzhan bkod pa'o//8 mi 'os shing 'os pa'i don gzhan bkod pa ni/ rtsa bar/ku myad ldan yang greg byed na/ /padma'i 'byung gnas cis mi byed//bla bas bzung rnams rtsab pa na/ /nyi mas bzung ba 'jam mi

tsho snyan ngag gi rnam bshad las gzhung don le'u gnyis pa/ 467'gyur/ /zhes pa ste/ ku mud ldan pa'i tshal na yang sreg par byed na padma'i 'byung gnas te padma'i tshal du cis sreg par mi byed ces dam bcar bkod cing / de sgrub byed du zla ba mtha' gcig tu bsil bas bzung ba'i reg bya yang rtsub na nyi ma tsha ba'i rang bzhin can gyis rjes su bzung ba'i dngos po rnams 'jam par mi 'gyur ro zhes bkod de snga ma dngos po bye brag pa gnyis kyi byed las mi 'os shing 'os pa de phyi ma spyi khyab kyi reg bya 'jam rtsub bkod nas bsgrubs pas mi 'os shing 'os pa'i don gzhan bkod pa'o/ /zhes so/ /yang na/ blo gros ldan pas mi rtogs na/ /blun po'i tshogs kyis ci la rtogs/ /mig ldan rnams kyis mi mthong na/ /long bas mthong ba srid 'gyur ram/ /zhes blo gros dang ldan pas kyang mi rtogs na blun po rnams kyis ci la rtogs te mi rtogs zhes bsgrub byar bkod cing / de sgrub byed du/ de ltar te/ mig dang ldan pas kyang mi mthong na long bas mthong ba mi srid do zhes sda ma mi 'os shing phyi ma 'os pa'i don gzhan bkod pa'o//8 ldog pa can gyi rgyan bcu/don rgyan brgyad pa ldog pa can gyi rgyan bshad pa la gnyis te/ mtshan nyid spyir bstan pa dang / bye brag so sor bshad pa'o//dang po mtshan nyid spyir bstan pa ni/ rtsa bar/ sgras zin pa'am rtogs pa yi/ /dngosasnyepo gnyis ni mtshungs gyur pa/ /der ni dbye ba brjod pa gang / /de ni ldog 'i sdo can zhes brjod/ /ces pa

468 rdo rje rgyal po'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/ste/ mtshungs pa gsal byed kyi sgras dngos su zin pa'am/ don nam shugs las rtogs pa'i sgo nas brjod 'dod kyi dngos po 3nyis mtshungs par gyur pa nig sgar khyad chos gang rung la brten nas so sor 'byed cing ldog par ston pa der ni ldog pa can gyi rgyan zhes brjod do zhes so//gnyis pa bye brag dper brjod pa la/ gcig ldog gnyis ka'i ldog pa can/ /sbyor dang 'gog dang gtan tshigs can/ /sgras zin pa yi dper brjod lnga/ /dbye ba tsam dang lhag pa nyid/ /sgra mtshungs pa dang rtogs par mtshungs/ /rigs mthun ldog pa can dang lnga / /bcas te rnam grangs bcu nyid do/ /zhes pa ltar gcig gi ldog pa can dang 1/gnyis ka'i ldog pa can dang 3/ sbyar ba'i ldog pa can dang 3/ 'gog pa'i ldog pa can dang tre/ gtan tshigs kyis ldog pa can dang 5/ dpe dang dpe can dbye ba tsam gyi ldog pa can dang smo/ dpe can lhag pa'i ldog pa can dang 7/ mtshungs chos 'byed byed gnyis ka sgras zin pa'i ldog pa can dang 8/ mtshungs chos shugs dang 'byed byed sgras zin pa'i ldog pa can dang 9/ rigs mthun 'byed pa'i ldog pa can 1༷dang bcas bcu tham pa yod do/ /'on kyang de rnams rigs mthun par bsdus na sgras zin mtshungs pa'i ldog pa can dang / rtogs pas mtshungs pa'i ldog pa can dang / 'byed byed mtshungs pa'i ldog pa can dang / rigs mthun 'byed pa'i ldog pa can bcas bzhir 'du'o//1 gcig gi ldog pa can ni/ rtsa bar/ brtan dang che ba'i bdag nyid dang / /wa ba rgya sogs yon tan gyis/ khrod dang rgya

snyan ngag gi rnam bshad las gzhung don le'u gnyis pa/ 469mtsho mtshungs tha dad/ khrod lus 'azhi 'dra nyid kyis so / /gcig la gnas nga 'i chos kyis ni/ /gnyis ka la gnas tha dad dag /rtogs pa'i yul du gyur pa'i phyir/ /'di ni gcig gi ldog pa can/ /zhes pa ste/ rang bzhin du bskyod par mi nus pas brtan pa dang / khong yangs shing rgya che ba'i bdag nyid can dang / lā ba khya'i sgra rme dzes pa dang / lan tshwa'i ro dang / zab pa la sogs la 'jug pas rgyal po mdzes pa dang / rgya mtsho lan tshwa ba'i ro dang ldan pa la sogs pa'i yon tan gyis rgyal po khyod dang rgya mtsho chen po mtshungs la/ tha dad pa'i dbye ba ni khyod kyi lus skyes bu dam pa'i mtshan nyid can 'di nyid kyis so/ /zhes pa dang / de'i gnad ni gcig la gnas pa ste rgyal po la yod pa'i skyes bu dam pa'i mtshan nyid brjod pas de gnyis kyi khyad chos tha dad pa tshegs med du rtogs pa'i yul du gyur pa'i phyir 'di ni gcig gi ldog pa can no/ /zhes so/ /yang na/ nyin bzhin yar rgyas grags che ba/ /krung go yar zla'i dpal dang 'dra/ /tha dad 'byed chos rang rgyal 'di/ /'dzin ma'i phang na chags 'di'o/ /zhes nyin re bzhin yar rgyas dang grags pa che ba'i cha ni krung go dang yar ngo'i zla ba mtshungs la/ tha dad du 'byed chos ni rang rgyal 'di nyid sa steng na chags pa 'di'o zhes de gnyis 'dra ba gang zhig la rang rgyal sa gzhi'i steng du gnas pa phyogs gcig gi khyad chos kyis ldog par bstan pas gcig gi ldog pa can no//2 gnyis ka'i ldog pa can ni/ rtsa bar/ chu yi phung po dag dang khrod/ /mtshams las mi 'da' zab pa ste/ /'di ni mig

470 dngha rdorjergyalapo'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/sman dang mchungs la/ /khyod ni gser gyi 'odardzucan ོ // / — / stu sbor 'de ni gnyis ka yi/ /'byed chos yon tan nag po dang / /ser po gahis ka tha dad bstan/ /'di ne gnyis ka'i ljos/ nga can/ /zhes pa ste/ chu yi phung po rgya mtsho dang khyod ni mtshamarme las ye'ada' ba ste/rgya mtsho chu mā tshams dang rgyal po lugs las mi 'da' zhing / rgya ma tsho'i gting dang khyod kyi blo zab pa ni 'dra la/ de gnyis kyi khyad par ni rgya mtsho mig sman gyi kha dog dang mtshungs pa zhig yin la/ khyod ni skyes bu chen po'i lus gser gyi 'od can no/ /zhes dang / de'i gnad ni/ 'dir 'byed chos rgya mtsho'i kha dog nag po dang / rgyal po'i mdog ser po gnyis kas tha dad du bstan pa'i phyir 'di ni gnyis ka'i ldog pa can no/ /zheṭa5 so/ /yang na/ mes rgyal dang ni zla gsar gnyis/ /yar rgyas grags che'i chos mtshungs mod/ /rang rgyal 'dzin ma'i steng gnas shing / /zla ba nam mkha'i dbyings su rol/ /zhes mes rgyal dang zla ba gnyis yar rgyas dang grags pa che ba'i khyad chos mtshungs mod kyang tha dad du 'byed chos ni rang rgyal sa gzhi'i steng du gnas pa dang / zla ba nam mkha' la rol pa 'di'o zhes phyogs gnyis kyi khyad chos kyis ldog par bstan pas gnyis ka'i ldog pa can no// ci3 sbyar ba'i ldog pa can ni/ rtsa bar/ khrod dang rgya mtsho dublo ro/ /ma hā sa twa te dzoḥ bcas/ /'di yis khrod gnyis tha dang de/ /de zhi chushrī dnghathodag khrod mkhas so/ /'de ni sbyar ba'i tshul ldan phyir/ /srur ba can zhes gzung bar mdzod/ /ces pa ste/

snyan ngag gi rnam bshad las gzhung don le'u gnyis pa/ 471'dir thog mar 'di ltar shes dgos pa ste/ dublo ri zhes pa ldog dka' ba dang / chu ngan pa ba tshwa can la 'jug pa dang / mahā satwazhes pa snying stobs che ba dang sems can chen po la 'jug pa/ te dzaḥ zhes pa gzi brjid dang me la 'jug pa bcas rtogs par bya dgos la/ de rgyal po la sbyar nas rjod skabs rgyal po khyod gzhan gyis sdog dka' zhing snying stobs dang gzi brjid ldan pa dang / rgya mtsho la sbyar nas rjod skabs rgya mtsho chu ngan 'i/nga sems can chen po chu srin dang / rgod ma kha'i me ldan par sbyar zhing / 'byed chos rgya mtsho chu'i bdag po bem po dang / khyod mkhas shing rig pa'i bdag nyid yin pa 'dis tha dad do/ /zhes dang / de'i gnad ni 'di ni sbyar ba'i tshul gsum dang ldan pa'i phyir sbyar ba'i ldog pa can zhis su gzung bar mdzod cig ces so/ /yang na/ zab cing mi g.yo 'dzad med gter/ /khyod kyi thugs dang rgya mtsho yi/ /ldog chos khyod thugs shes pa dang / /zla ba'i ma ma bem po'i dngos/ /zhes 'dir sbyar gzhi skye bo dam pa'i thugs dang rgya mtsho byas shing / zab pa dang / mi g.yo ba thugs dang rgya mtsho gnyis ka yin pa don sbyar zhing / thugs yon tan 'dzad pa med pa'i gter dang / rgya mtsho chu bo 'dzad pa med pa'i gter yin pa sgra sbyar nas mtshungs par bstan cing / tha dad 'byed chos thugs shes pa dang / rgya mtsho bem po'i zhes brjod pas sbyar ba'i ldog pa can rna//4 'gog pa'i ldog pa can ni/ rtsa bar/ 'gog pa can dang gantan tshigs can/ /gnyis po de yang bstan par bya/ /zhes

472 rdo rje rgyal po'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/mtshams sbyar zhing dam bcas te/ lugs dang ldan zhing brtan pa yi/ /rin chen 'byung gnas yin mod kyang / /dri ma ldan zhing chu srin gnas/ /khrod kyi ñtsagran zlar 'gyur ma yin/ /zhes rmepa ste/ rgyal po 'jig rten gyi khrims snalugs dang ldan zhing gzhan gyis bskyod par mi nus pas brtan la/ rin po che mang po 'dzin pas 'byung gnas yin pa dang /rgya mtsho yang dus kyi rlabs dang mtshams las mi 'da' ba sogs lugs dang ldan zhing / 'dom bdun nam bcu gnyis man chad kyi gting mi g.yo bas brtan la/ rin po che'i 'byung gnas yin mod kyang / ba tshwa la sogs pa'i dri ma dang ldan pa chu srin gdug pa'i gnas de rgyal po khyod kyi 'gran zlar 'gyur ba ma yin no zhes 'gog pa'i tshul gyis dbye ba brjod pas 'gog pa'i ldog pa can no/ /zhes so/ /yang na/ /bde dang gsal ba'i dpal ster zhing / /drag zhan ris med kun skyong yang / /shes rab dben pa'i nyi ma yis/ /mi rje khyod la 'gran mi nus/ /zhes bde dang gsal ba'i dpal ster nus pa dang / drag zhan nam mtho dman ris med du skyong ba 'dra yang / shes rab med pa'i nyi ma 'dis mi'i rje bo khyod la 'gran par mi nus zhes mi rje dang nyi ma gnyis chos 'ga' zhig nas 'dra yang nyi ma beem po 'i dngos por mi'i rje bor 'gran pa'i nus pa med ces bkag pas 'gog pa'i ldog pa can rne//5 gtan tshigs kyi ldog pa can ni/ rtsa bar/ ri gling rgya mtshor bcas pa yi/ /sa gzhi mtha' dag 'dzin mod kyang / /lag 'gro rnams kyi rjer gyur phyir/ /lhag ma can ne khyod pas

snyan ngag gi rnam bshad las gzhungadonale'uganyisapa/ 473wa dman/ /zhes pa ste/ ri dang / gling dang / rgya mtshor bcas pa'i sa gzhi'i khyon mtha' dag dpung pas 'dzin pa ni rgyal po khyod dang klu bdag lhag ma can yin mod/ 'on kyang lag 'gro ste klu ni dud 'gro yin pas de dag gi rje bor gyur pa'i phyir lhag ma can klu mtha' yas zhes pa de ni khyod las dman no zhes rgyal po dang klu lhag ma can gnyis mtshungs pa'i khyad chos du ma yod kyang / lhag ma can de klu dud 'gro'i rje bor gyur pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis mi'i rgyal po khyod las dman no zhes ldog par ston pas 'di ni gtan tshigs kyi ldog pa can no/ /zhes so/ /yang na/ gzhan sar 'dzul nas srid 'phrog pa'i/ /spyi tshogs btsan rgyal ring lugs 'dis/ /rgyal spyi'i khrims kyang yal bor bas/ /btsan rgyal ring lugs gzhan las lod/ /zhes rgyal khab gzhan gyi sa char 'dzul nas srid dbang 'phrog mkhan spyi tshogs btsan rgyal ring lugs zhes pa 'dis rgyal spyi'i khrims kyang yal bar bor ba ste dor bas na btsan rgyal ring lugs gzhan rnams las kyang lod pa zhig go zhes rgyal spyi'i khrims lugs dor ba de rgyu mtshan nam gtan tshigs su byas nas btsan rgyal ring lugs gzhan las kyang lod par bsnyan pas gtan tshigs kyi ldog pa can no//mtshams 'dir rgyan snga ma'i don bsdu zhing mtshams sbyar ba la/ rtsa bar/ sgra dag 'jug pa mtshungs pa yi/ /snog pa can ni 'de lta ste/ /rtogs par 'chur bas mtshungs pa yang / /yod la de ni rjes su skub/ /ces pa ste/ sgra dag 'jug pa'am sgras zin pa'i mtshungs pa las ldog pa can ni bshad zin pa 'di 'dra ste/ da ni don gyi shugs las

474 rdo rje rgyal po'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/rtogs par 'gyur bas mtshungs pa'i ldog pa can yang yod pas de ni rjes su sgrub cing bstan par bya'o zhes so//6 rtogs pas mtshungs pa'i ldog pa can gnyis kyi rten gyi dbye ba'i ldog pa can ni/ rtsa bar/ khrod kyi bdong dang padma ste/ /'di gnyis kyi ni khyad par yang / /padma chu las skyes pa dang / /khrod gdong khrod la bten pa'o/ /zhes pa ste/ mdzes ma khyod kyi gdong dang padma 'di gnyis kyi khyad par ni padma 'di chu las skyes pa dang / khyod kyi gdong khyod rang la brten pa 'di'o/ /zhes mtshungs chos mdzes pa shugs las rtogs shing / rten nam khyad gzhi tha dad pa'i dbye ba tsam bstan pas rten dbye ba'i ldog pa can nam dpe dang dpe can gyi ldog pa can no/ /zhes so/ /yang na/ slob dpon daṇḍi pa zhes dang / /bod mkhas dge legs rnam rgyal gyi/ /'byed chos daṇḍi rgyar 'khrungs shing / /bod mkhas ljongs 'dir 'khrungs de'o/ /zhes snyan ngag mkhan slob dpon daṇḍi pa dang /bod mkhas pa dge legs rnam rgyal gnyis mi 'dra ba'i 'byed chos ni daṇḍi pa rgya gar du 'khrungs pa dang / bod mkhas pa ljongs 'dir 'khrungs pa'i 'khrungs yul mi 'dra ba 'di'o zhes de gnyis kyi yon tan mtshungs pa shugs las rtogs shing / 'khrungs yul tha dad pa ldog pa tsam bstan pas rten dbye ba'i ldog pa can no//7 rtogamu/ pas mtshungs pa'i ldog pa can gnyis kyi dpe can lhag pa'i ldog pa can ni/ rtsa bar/ ri dwags mig la smin zheg dang / /rtsos pa'i dmar bas reg pa med/ /khyod kyi mig ne gnyis po

snyan ngag gi rnam bshad las gzhung don li'u gnyis pa/ 475'di/ /yon tan de dag nyid kyis brgyan/ /snga mar dbye ba tsam zhig bstan/ /'der ne lhag pa nyid bstan to/ /zhes pa ste/ri dwags kyi mig la mdzes pa'i dper byed pa smin ma rnam par g.yo ba'i rol sgeg dang chags myos kyi dmar bas reg pa med la/ khyod kyi mig gnyis po 'di ni yon tan de dag gis kyang brgyan no zhes pas mtshungs chos shugs las rtogs shing / de'i gnad ni/ dper brjod snga mar rten tha dad kyi dbye ba tsam zhig bstan la/ 'dir ni dpe can gyi yon tan lhag par bstan pas dpe can lhag pa'i ldog pa can no zhes so/ /yang na/ yid bzhin nor bur shes pa dang / /blang dor ston pa'i nus pa med/ /mkhas pa'i dbang po khyod nyid ni/ /yon tan de dag zung gis phyug /ces dpe yid bzhin gyi nor bur shes bya dang / blang dor ston pa'i nus pa med cing / mkhas dbang khyod ni yon tan de dag gnyis kyis phyug pas lhag go zhes brjod pas dpe can lhag pa'i ldog pa can no//8 mtshungs chos 'byed byed gnyis ka sgras zin pa'i ldog pa can ni/ rtsa bar/ slar mang mtshungs pa'i lkog pa can/ /gzhan dag rab tu bstan par bya/ /khyod kyi gdong dang pa dkar/ /rgyas zhing dri bzang ldan pa ste/ /padma la ji bung ba 'khor/ /khyod kyi gardong la mig rab g.yo/ /zhes pa ste/ lus phra ma khyod kyi gdong dang me tog padma dkar po gnyis rnam par rgyas shing dri bzang po dang ldan no zhes mtshungs chos dngos su bshad cing / padma la ni bung ba 'khor zhing sding la/ khyod kyi gdong la mig rab tu g.yo zhes khyad par 'byed chos

da 416 rdorjergyal po'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/kyang dngos su bshad pas 'di ni mtshungs chos 'byed byed gnyis ka sgras zin pa'i ldog pa can no/ /yang na/ khyod kyi thugs dang rgya mcho gnyis / /zab cing rgya che'i yon tan ldan/ khyod thugs shes bya'i gter chen dang / /rgya mtsho chu bo'i gter chen no/ /zhes khyod kyi thugs dang rgya mtsho gnyis ka zab cing rgya che ba'i yon tan ldan pa 'dra la 'byed chos ni khyod kyi thugs shes bya'i gter chen dang / rgya mtsho chen po chu bo'i gter tsam mo zhes brjod pas mtshungs chos 'byed byed gnyis ka sgras jin pa'i ldog pa can no//9 mtshungs chos shugs dang 'byed byed sgras zin pa'i ldog pa can ni/ rtsa bar/ bla ba 'di ne mkha' yi rgyan/ /ngang pa 'di ni chu yi rgyan/ /mkha' 'abha rgyu skar phreng ba can/ /chu 'di ku myad rgyas pa can/ /'azhir ne bla ba ngang pa dag /dkar ba nyid sogs rtogs pa dang / /mkha' dang chu ni dag par yang / /rtogs byar mtshungs zi 'i dbye ba byas/ /zhes pa ste/ zla ba 'di ni nam mkha' mjesgyus pa'i rgyan ye na la/ ngang pa 'di ni chu'i rgyan yin/ de bzhin nam mkha' 'di rgyu skar gyi phreng ba can ri ri khrire / chu 'di ni me tog ku mud rgyas pa can no/ /zhes dang / de'i gnad ni/ zla ba dang ngang pa dag dkar ba dang mdzes pa'i mtshungs chos don gyis rtogs par 'gyur zhing /'byed byid mkha' dang chu'i rgyan so sor gyur pa dngos su bstan la/ de bzhin du nam mkha' dang chu dag cing sngo ba'ang shugs las rtogs par 'gyur zhing / 'byed byed rgyu skar phreng ba dang ku mud rgyas pa dngos snyo

snyan ngag gi rnam bshad las gzhung don li'u gnyis pa/ 411bstan pa'am sgras zin par byas pa'o/ /slar yang don bsdu ba ni/ rtsa bar/ snga ma la ni sgra bcas mtshungs/ /gnyis ka la lang tha dad 'byed/ /bung ba mig la sogs pa mtshungs/ /de phyir mtshungs pa'i snog pa can/ /zhes pa ste/ dpe snga mas rgyas shing dri bzang ldan pa zhes sgras zin pa'i mtshungs pa dang / snga phyi gnyis kar tha dad pa'i 'byed chos bung ba dang mig dang / mkha' dang / chu dang / rgyu skar dang / ku mud bcas mtshungs par bstan pa'i phyir 'di dag ni 'byed byed mtshungs pa'i ldog pa can no/ /zhes so/ /yang na/ grong gseb rnams ni zhing pa'i gnas/ /grong khyer 'di dag bzo pa'i gnas/ /zhing pas bza' mkho'i 'bru rigs 'don/ /bzo pas nyer mkho'i dngos zog 'don/ /zhes grong gseb rnams ni zhing pa'i gnas yin pa dang / grong khyer 'di dag bzo pa'i gnas yin zhes sa yul gnyis su gnas pa'i mi las rigs mi 'dra ba brjod pas 'byed byed sgras zin cing / gnyis ka thon skyed kyi sa khul yin pa shugs las rtogs dgos pa dang / zhing pas bza' mkho'i 'bru rigs dang / bzo pas nyin mkho'i dngos po 'don par brjod pas 'byed chos thon rdzas mi 'dra ba sgras zin cing / zhing pa dang bzo pa gnyis ka ngal rtsol pa yin pa shugs las rtogs dgos pas mtshungs chos shugs dang 'byed byed sgras zin pa'i ldog pa can do//10 rigs mthun 'byed pa'i ldog pa can ni/ rtsa bar/ rin chen snang mes mi 'phrog cing/ /nyi ma'i 'od kyis mi blog pa/ /lang tsho las byung na chung gi/ /mun pas lta ba 'gog par byed/ /

418 rdo je rgyal po'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/mun pa'i rigs la myan pa 'di/ /lta ba 'gog pa nyid kyis mtshungs/ /gzhan dag gis ni tha dad bstan/ /'di ni rigs mthun snog pa can/ /zhes pa ste/ rin po che'i snang bas mi 'phrog pa ste mi zhi zhing / nyi ma'i 'od kyis mi zlog pa ste gsal bar mi nus pa lang tsho dar ba las byung ba'i na chung gi mun pa 'dis blang dor gyi gzugs la lta ba 'gog pa ste sgrib par byed do zhes dang / de'i gnad ni/ yongs su grags pa'i mun pa dang na chung las byung ba'i mun pa 'di lta ba 'gog pa nyid kyis rigs mtshungs kyang / khyad par gzhan nor bu dang nyi ma'i 'od kyis sel bar byed mi nus pas phyi'i mun pa dang mtshan nyid tha dad par bstan pa'i phyir 'di ni rigs mthun 'byed pa'i ldog pa can no/ /zhes so/ /yang na/zab rgu'i sman gyis mi 'joms shing / /gtar sreg thabs kyis mi phan pa'i/ /chags sdang drag po'i nad ngan gyis/ /lus sems gnyis ka mnar bar byed/ /ces srid 'dir zab par grags pa'i sman gyis mi 'joms shing gtar sreg gi thabs kyis kyang mi phan pa'i nad ngan drag po chags sdang zhes pa 'dis lus sems gnyis mnar bar byed ces brjod pas spyir 'byung ba 'khrugs pa'i lus kyi nad dang / chags sdang gis bskyed pa'i sems kyi nad gnyis rigs mtshungs kyang / mi 'dra ba ni chags sdang gi nad de sman gyis mi 'joms pa dang gtar sreg gis mi phan pas tha dad yin par brjod pas rigs mthun 'byed pa'i ldog pa can no//de ltar ldog pa can gyi rgyan bcu yod pa de rigs 'dra ba so sor bsdus na(1)gcig gi ldog pa can dang / gnyis ka'i ldog pa can dang /

snyan ngag gi rngari/ bshad lar gzhungadonale'uganyisapa/ 479 wa sbyar ba'i ldog pa can dang / 'gog pa'i ldog pa can dang / gtan tshigs kyi ldog pa can bcas lnga sgras zin mtshungs pa'i ldog pa can dang / (2)rten gyi dbye ba'i ldog pa can dang / dpe can lhag pa'i ldog pa can gnyis rtogs pas mtshungs pa'i ldog pa can dang / (3)mtshungs chos 'byed byed gnyis ka sgras zin pa'i ldog pa can dang / mtshungs chos shugs dang 'byed byed sgras zin pa'i ldog pa can gnyis 'byed byed sgras zin pa mtshungs pa'i ldog pa can/ (4)rigs mthun 'byed pa'i ldog pa can bcas bzhir bsdu'o//9 srid pa can gyi rgyan gsum/don rgyan dgu pa srid pa can gyi rgyan bshad pa la tha/nyis te/ mtshan nyid kyis spyir bstan pa dang / dper brjod nas rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /dang po mtshan nyid kyis spyir bstan pa ni/ rtsa bar/ rab tu grags pa'i rgyu bablog nas/ /gang zhig thu gzhan cung zad tsam/ /gang du rang gi ngo po nyid/ /ston pa de ji brad pa can/ /zhes pa ste/'jig rten na rab tu grags pa'i rgyu bzlog pa ste rgyu bkag nas gang zhig de dang rjes su mabun pa'i rgyu gzhan cung zad cig ston pa'am rgyu rtsa ba nas med par gang tredu rang gi ngo bo dngos po'i chos grub pa zhig ston pa de ni srid pa can gyi rgyan no/ /yang bskyar bshad na spyir rgyu med pas 'bras bu skyed mi srid kyang 'dir dngos po gang yang rung ba so sor 'jig rten na rab tu grags pa'i rgyu de med par brjod nas de'i 'bras bu rang nyid dngos su

———480 rdorjergyal po'i gsung rtsom myags bsgrigs/brjod pa la rgyu gzhan cung zad cig shugs las mtshon pa'am/ rgyu gtan nas med pa ltar du brjod kyang 'bras bu rang gi ngo bo nyid ston pa'i ngag gis srid pa lta bur bstan pas srid pa can gyi rgyan zhes bya'o/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa dpor brjod nas rgyas par bshad pa la/ rgyu 'bras cung zad ston pa la/ /phyi dang nang gi khyad par gnyis/ /rang gi ngo bo nyid ston pa/ /gcig ste srid pa can la gsum/ /zhes pa ltar/ phyi'i rgyu gzhan cung zad ston pa'i srid pa can dang 1/ nang gi rgyu gzhan cung zad ston pa'i srid pa can dang 3/ rang gi ngo bo tsam ston pa'i srid pa can 3bcas gsum yod do//1 rab tu grags pa'i rgyu bzlog kyang phyi'i rgyu gzhan cung zad ston pa'i srid pa can ni/ rtsa bar/ ma 'thungs phyos pa'i ka dalnga/ /ma phyis dri ma med pa'i mkha'/ /grungs par ma byas dag pa'i chu/ /'gro ba'i yid ni 'phrog par byed/ /ces pa ste/ 'jig rten na myos pa'i rgyu chang sogs 'thungs pa yin par grags kyang / de bzlog nas ma 'thungs par yang myos pa'i ca co sgrog pa'i bya ka dasbra ste mthil ril dang /de bzhin du ma phyis kyang dri ma med pa'i nam mkha' dang / ke ta ka sogs kyis grungs (bgrung )par ma byas kyang dwangs pa'i chu 'di rnams kyis 'gro ba'i yid 'phrog par byed do/ /zhes myos pa'i rgyu 'thungs pa dang / dri ma mi 'byung ba'i rgyu phyis pa/ dwangs pa'i rgyu snyog ma bgrung pa bcas bkag cing / ngag gi sbyor ba de dag gis dus ston ka yin pa —shugs las shes pa'i rgyu cung zad bstan pa'o/ /yang na/ ma bsros sa gzhi'i drod rgyus

snyan ngag gi rnam bshad las gzhung don le'u gnyis pa/ 481shing / /ma byugs rtsi shing nags tshal sdo/ /ma bskul khu byug glu len pa'i/ /dus 'dis skye 'gro'i bde dge skyed/ /ces dros pa'i rgyu bsros pa dang / sngo ba'i rgyu byugs pa/ glu len pa'i rgyu bskul ba bcas bkag kyadzo/ ngag gi sbyor ba de dag gis phyi rol gyi dus dpyid ka yin pa shugs las shes pa'i rgyu cung zad dam zur tsam ston pa'o//2 nang gi rgyu gzhan cung zad ston pa'i srid pa can ni/ rtsa bar/sman ma bskus par dkar min mig /mnan pa min par smin ma dma'/ /tshon ma bsgos par dmar ba ni/ /mtshes ma khrod kyi mchu 'de'o/ /zhes pa ste/ mig sman ma bskus par mig dkar min te gnag pa dang / ma mnan par smin ma 'byar zhing dma' ba dang / tshon gyis ma bsgos par dmar ba ni mdzes ma khyod kyi mchu 'di'o zhes mig gnag pa'i rgyu mig sman bskus pa dang / smin ma dma' ba'i rgyu mnan pa/ mchu darna ra ba'i rgyu tshon bsgos pa bcas bkag cing / ngag gi sbyor ba de dag gis mdzees ma lang tsho dar ma yin pa shugs las shes pa'i rgyu cung zad bstan pa'o/ /yang na/ mnan pa me da kyang sdid kyis non/ /ma bcings par yang sgul skyod dka'/ /ma bsdus gnyer mas yongs khyab pa/ /khyod kyi lus 'di 'jig la nye/ /zhes non pa'i rgyu mnan pa dang /skul skyod dka' ba'i rgyu bcings pa/ gnyer mas khyab pa'i rgyu bsdus pa rnams bkag kyang / khyod kyi lus 'di 'jig la nye zhes pa'i ngag gi sbyor ba de dag gi nang nas mi de rgad po zhig yin pa shugs las rtogs pa'i rgyu cung zad bstan pa'o //

482 rdo rje rgyal po'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/rgyan de gnyis kyi mjug sdom ni/ rtsa bar/ gang phyir ma 'thungs la sogs skyes/ /tsus pa nyid sogs rgyu gzhan can/ /rgyu med dag kyang brjod 'dod pa/ /de phyir 'di ni 'gal ba med/ /ces pa ste/ ma 'thungs pa dang / ma phyis pa dang / ma bgrungs pa dang /ma bskus pa dang / ma mnan pa dang / ma bsgos pa bcas las byung ba'i 'bras bu myos pa dang / dri ma med pa dang / dwangs pa dang / gnag pa dang / dma' ba dang / dmar ba bcas rim par sbyar ba 'di dag gis dper brjod snga mar dus dang / phyir mar lang tsho dar ba shugs las rtogs pa'i rgyu dang bcas pa yin la rab tu grags pa'i rgyu bkag pa'i phyir rgyu med pa yin zhes brjod par 'dod pa ni 'dir 'gal ba med do/ /zhes so//3 'bras bu rang gi ngo bo tsam ston pa'i srid pa can ni/ rtsa bar/bsgos pa med par kha dri zhim/ /bcos pa min par lus po mtshes/ /rgyu med par yang zla ba dgra/ /rgyu mtshan med bar 'dod pa grogs/ /bsgos pa med sogs dzig gis 'dir/ /thu ji dngos su rab snog cing / /dri zhim nyid sogs 'bras bu brjod/ /de phyir 'di ni grid pa can/ /zhes pa ste/ sus kyang ched du bsgos pa min par rang bzhin gyis kha'i dri zhim la/ bcos pa gang yang med par lus kyi gzugs byad mdzes shing / 'khon pa'i rgyu med par yang zla ba dgra zlar gyur/ mthun pa'i rgyu mtshan med par 'dod pa ni 'di yi grogs su gyur zhes dang / de'i gnad ni bsgos pa med/ bcos pa

snyen ngag gi rnam bshad las gzhung don le'u gnyis pa/ 483 min/ rgyu med/ rgyu mtshan med ces pa rnams kyi tshig gis rgyu rnams dngos su bzlog cing bkag nas dri zhim pa dang / lus mdzes pa dang / zla ba dgra zlar gyur pa dang / 'dod pa grogs su gyur pa bcas 'bras bu rang gi ngo bo tsam bstan pa'i phyir 'di ni ngo bo tsam ston pa'i srid pa can no/ /zhes so/ /yang na/ ma bskyed 'dzam gling yangs pa'i gzhir/ /ma phye so sor gnas pa'i sar/ /ma bcos mi rigs 'dus pa yi/ /rgyal khab rnam pa sna tshogs yod/ /ces yangs pa'i rgyu bskyed pa dang / so sor gam/sa pa'i rgyu phye ba/ 'dus pa'i rgyu bcos pa bcas bkag kyang / yangs pa dang / so sor gnas pa/ 'dus pa bcas 'bras bu rang gi ngo bo tsam ston pa'o/ /yang na/ stobs shugs med la spobs pa che/ /drin bsam mi shes gzhung ngan pa/ /rgyu mtshan med par krung go dang / /su'u len dgra grogs so sor 'dzin/ /('di g.yod nan la sbyar nas bshad pa zhig yin)rgyan 'di dang gong ma gnyis kyi khyad par ni 'di la rgyu med pas 'bras bu bskyed pa tsam las shugs la go rgyu med la/ snga ma gnyis la rgyu med pas 'bras bu bskyed pa'i shugs las don gzhan dus dang na tshod lta bu sogs go rgyu yod pa'o//10 bsdus brjod kyi rgyan bzhi/don rgyan bcu pa bsdus brjod kyi rgyan bshad pa la gnyis te/ mtshan nyin kyis mdor bstan pa dang / dper brjod nas rgyas par bshad pa'o//dang po mtshan nyid kyis mdor bstan pa ni/ rtsa bar/ dngos po

484 rdo rje rgyal po'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/'ga' la bsam byas nas/ /de dang mtshungs pa'i dngos po gzhan/ /bskus pa'i tshul gyis rjod byed pa/ /de ni bsngus pa brjod par 'dod/ /ces pa ste/ brjod 'dod kyi dngos po 'ga' zhig yid la bsam par byas nas de dang mtshungs pa'i dngos po gzhan zhig brjod don bsdus pa'i tshul gyis rjod par byed pa de ni bsdus pa brjod pa'i rgyan du 'dod do/ /zhes pa dang / 'dir ji skad du/ gang du don dam sgra yi don de nyid/ /nye bar mtshon par byas shing rang gi don/ /gsal bar gyur pa snyan ngag khyad par te/ /sgra tsam zhes par mkhas pa rnams kyis bshad/ /ces pa ltar rgya gar gyi mkhas pa rnams kyis sgra tsam gyi rgyan zhes par yang 'dod do//gnyis pa dper brjod nas rgyas par bshad pa la/ spyi dang khyad gzhi tha dad dang / /khyad par tha dad tha dad min/ /sdon med bsdus pa brjod bcas bzhi/ /zhes pa ltar spyi'i bsdus brjod dang 1/ bye brag khyad gzhi tha dad dang khyad chos gcig pa'i bsdus brjod dang 1/ khyad par tha dad dang tha dad min pa'i bsdus brjod dang 3/ sngon med bsdus brjod byubacas bzhi yod do//1 spyi'i bsdus brjod ni/ rtsa bar/ bung ba ji ltar 'dod pa bzhin/ /padma rgyas las zing rtsi 'thung / /bri zhim rgyas pa ma yin yang/ /me tog kha ma bye smyor ltos/ /chags ldan bud med dar ma la/ /dga' ba'i rtse dgas bcings pa dag /bu mo 'ga' zhig dag la yang / /'dod pa 'phel ba ston par byed/ /

snyan ngag gi rnam bshad las gzhung don le'u gnyis pa/ 75thu ces pa ste/ bung ba 'ga' zhig gis rang ji ltar 'dod pa bzhin du padma rgyas pa dag las sbrang rtsi'i bcud 'thung bar byed la/ des kyang ma tshim par dri zhim rgyas pa ma yin pa'i me tog kha ma bye ba dag la yang mchu sbyor ba la ltos dang zhes ma rangs pa'i tshig brjod pa'o/ /de'i don ni chags ldan skyes pa 'ga' zhig gis bud med lang tsho dar bab ma la dga' ba'i rtse dgas bcings pa ste dga' ba'i rtse dgar rol zhing / 'dod pa bsten ma ran pa'i bu mo chung ngu dag la'ang 'dod pa 'phel ba'i rnam 'gyur ston par byed ces pa'o/ /yang na/ rab yangs rang rgyal sa chen gyi/ /mi bsrun rlung 'tshub rab zhi zhing / /dro zhing bde ba'i dpal 'bar bas skye rgu'i bde skyid gsar du bzhad/ /ces pa'i don ni/ rab yangs rang rgyal sa chen gyi/ /rig gnas gsar brje'i mjug 'gril zhing / /dus rabs gsar pa'i 'go tshugs pas/ /skye rgu'i bde skyid gsar du bzhad/ /ces nye dus kyi rang rgyal gyi gnas tshul sbyar nas brjod cing / rig gnas gsar brje'i mjug 'gril ba de mi bsrun pa'i rlung 'tshub zhi ba dang / dus rabs gsar pa'i 'go tshugs pa de dro zhing bde ba'i dpal 'bar bar bsdus pa'i tshul gyis brjod pa'o//mtshams 'dir bye brag gi dbye ba bstan pa ni/ rtsa bar/ khrad par can nam tha dad kyang / /khyad par rnam pa mtshungs pa'ang yod/ /khyad par tha dad tha dad min/ /'azhi ni gzhan pa dag kyang yod/ /ces pa ste/ 'dir bye brag gi nang gses phye na khyad par can nam khyad gzhi ba dad la khyad chos rnam pa mtshungs pa dang / khyad choska

486 — rdorjergyalapo'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/tha dad dang tha dad ma yin pa yang yod la/ 'di las gzhan pa sngon med bsdus brjod kyang yod do ces so//2 khyad gzhi tha dad kyang khyad chos gcig pa'i bsdus brjod ni/rtsa bar/ rtsa brtan 'bras bu'i khur gyis ni/ /blong rnams rtag tu rgyas nga ra byed/ /grib ma skum pa'i smon pa che/ /'di ni bdab gis lang dag thob/ /ces pa ste/ dpag bsam gyi ljon pa rtsa ba brtan cing 'bras bu'i khur gyis slong ba rnams rtag tu dga' zhing 'byor pa rgyas par byed pa de'i skyabs kyi grib ma snum pa 'di bsod nams dang ldan pa bdag gi mgon du yang dag par thob bo zhes bsam don skyes bu dam pa dang / de bsdus pa'i tshul gyis brjod don ljon pa gnyis khyad gzhi tha dad pa'i khyad chos ljon pa rtsa ba brtan pa dang skyes bu rang bzhin brtan pa/ljon pa 'bras bus phyug pa dang skyes bu sde bzhi'i 'bras bus phyug pa/ ljon pa dang skyes bu gnyis kas rang la re ba byed pa po rnams dga' ba rgyas par byed pa/ ljon pa'i lo ma'i grib bsil dang skyes bu'i skyabs kyi grib bsil gnyis ka rgya che la phan thogs pa bcas gcig par bsdus nas brjod pa'o/ /yang na/ gdug can rlung gis mi g.yo zhing / /'bras bu bzang po g.yur za la/ /grib bsil sa chen yongs khyab pa'i/ /ljon pa 'di ni gsar du 'khrungs/ /zhes 'di rgyal khab kyi gtso 'dzin lta bu skye bo khyad du 'phags pa zhig dpag bsam gyi ljon pa lta bu zhig tu bsdus te brjod pa ste/skye bo dang ljon shing khyad gzhi tha dad kyang gdug rtsub rlung gis mi g.yo ba dang / 'bras bu bzang po ldan pa/ grib bsil yangs pa bcas khyad chos

snyan ngag gi rnam bshad las gzhung don le'u gnyis ba/ 48spyagacig pa'am 'dra ba'i bsdus brjod do//3 khyad chos tha dad dang tha dad min pa'i bsdus brjod ni/ rtsa bar/ yal ga'i khyon ni mi chung zhing / /me tog 'bras bu phun sum tshogs/ /dam pa'i grib bsil brtan ldan pa'i/ /zhinga'aji bdag gi skal bas snyed/ /ces pa ste/ gang la yal ga'i khyon mi chung zhing me tog dang 'bras bu phun sum tshogs pa/ dam pa ste phan pa'i grib bsil dang rtsa ba brtan po yod pa'i shing 'di bdag nyid kyi skal ba bzang bas rnyed do zhes bsam don skyes bu dam pa zhig ljon par bsdus nas bshad cing / rkang pa snga ma gnyis kyi khyad chos lo ma mi chung ba dang / me tog dang 'bras bu phun sum tshogs pa de dag shing sdong kho nar ma gtogs skyes bur med pas khyad chos tha dad dang / rkang pa phyi ma gnyis kyi khyad chos grib bsil ldan pa dang / rang bzhin nam rtsa ba brtan pa de dag shing sdong dang skyes bu gnyis kar mtshungs par yod pas tha dad min pa'i phyir tha dad dang tha dad min pa'i bsdus brjod do/ /yang na/ rlung gi rta bdun la brten nas/ /nyin bzhin gling bzhi yongs skor zhing / /snang ba gsal zhing bde ster ba'i/ /nyi ma 'di ni ljongs 'di'i rgyan/ /zhes skye bo khyad du 'phags pa zhig nyi mar bsdus te brjod cing / rlung gi rta bdun la brten pa dang nyin bzhin gling bzhi skor ba'i khyad chos nyi ma la ma gtogs snye bo la med pas tha dad dang / snang ba gsal ba dang bde ba ster ba'i khyad chos skye bo dang nyi ma gnyis ka la yod pas tha mi dad par brjod pas tha dad dang tha dad min pa'i bsdus brjod do//

488 rdo the rgyal po'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/rgyan de gnyis kyi gnad bstan pa ni/ rtsa bar/ gnyis ka la lang skyes bu 'ga'/ /ljon pa nyid kyis nye bar bsngags/ /chos rnams thams cad snga ma la/ /thun mong gzhan par rnam pa gnyis/ /zhes pa ste bye brag gi bsdus brjod bshad zin pa'i dper brjod gnyis ka bsam don skyes bu mchog cig brjod tshul ljon par bsdus pa'i tshul gyis bsngags la/ de yang dper brjod snga mar skyes bu dang ljon pa'i khyad chos thun mong ba'am gcig pa dang / dper brjod phyi mar rkang pa snga ma gnyis kyi khyad chos tha dad pa dang / rkang pa phyi ma gnyis kyi khyad chos thun mong ba'am gcig pa zhig brjod pas tha dad dang tha dad min pa rnam pa gnyis ldan zhig go/ /zhes so//4 sdon med kyi bsdus brjod ni/ rtsa bar/ sprul ngan 'grogs pa dang bral zhing / /rang bzhin gyis ni mngar ba'i nang / /kye ma chu yi gter 'di zhi/ /dus kyis yongs su skam par 'gyur/ /rgya mtsho la ni de mtshungs pa'i/ /skyes bu'i snog pa gsal byed cing / /snga ma'i chos ni lhog pa' sbyir/ /'di ni sngon med brtsas par brjod/ /ces pa ste/ sbrul dang ('di'i rgya dper byā la zhes pa sbrul dang skye bo ngan par 'jug pas sbrul ngan zhes bsgyur ba'o)'grogs pa dang bral ba ste sbrul dang mi 'grogs shing / rang bzhin gyis mngar ba chu yi gter 'di ni dus kyi dbang gis yongs su skam par 'gyur ro zhes brjod cing / bsam don ni skye bo ngan pa dang mi 'grogs shing /rang bzhin gyis rgyud bzang ba'i skyes bu dam pa 'di ni tshe yi dus la bab dwa

da wa snyanangagagirnam bshad las gzhung don le'u gnyis pha/ 489 ci pas 'da' bar 'gyur ro zhes skyes bu dam pa 'da' ba shes nas yi 'byung rke tsho ba'i tshig go /de'i gnad ni/ brjod don 'dis khyad gzhi rgya mtsho la yod pa'i chos de dag dang ldan pa'i ldog pa bsam don skyes bu dam pa zhig gsal bar byed cing / spyir btang du rgya mtsho ni sbrul te klu dang 'grogs shing rgya mtsho'i chu ba tshwa can ro lan tshwa ba zhig yin kyang / 'dir de las ldog ste sbrul dang mi 'grogs shing chu'i ro mngar ba sngon chad med pa'i rgya mtsho zhig bshad pa'i phyir 'di ni sngon med kyi bsdus brjod do zhes so/ /yang na/ ri bong mtshan mas ma gos shing / /'phel 'grib 'gyur ba mi mnga' ba'i/ /ngo mtshar zla ba gsar pa 'di/ /skye bo dga' ba'i dpal du shar/ /zhes skye bo khyad par can zhig zla bar bsdus nas brjod cing /ri bong gi mtshan mas ma gos pa dang / 'phel 'grib dang 'gyur ldog med pa'i zla ba de 'dra med pas sngon med kyi bsdus brjod do//1 1 phul byung gi rgyan bzhi/don rgyan bcu gcig pa phul byung gi rgyan bshad pa la gsum ste/mtshan nyid spyir bstan pa dang / bye brag dper brjod pa dang / bsngagayopas mjug bsdu ba'o//dang po mtshan nyid spyir bstan pa ni/ rtsa bar/ khyad par gyi ni brjod 'dod gang / /'jig rten mtshams las brgal gyur pa/ /lul du byung bar brjod pa 'ani/ /rgyan gyi dam pa yin te dber/ /zhes pa ste/ brjod bya'i dngos po gang yin pa de khyad du 'phags par

490 rdo sde rgyal po'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/brjod 'dod kyi blos 'jig rten na yongs su grags pa'i mtshams las brgal ba'i brjod tshul nyams phul du byung ba zhig gis brjod pa 'di ni rgyan gyi mchog tu gyur pa yin te/ dper brjod na zhes so//gnyis pa bye brag dper brjod pa la/ khyad par the tshom nges pa dang / /grags pa brjod pa'i phul byung bzhi/ /zhertswa pa ltar khyad 'phags brjod pa'i phul byung dang 1/ the tshom phul byung dang 1/ nges pa'i phul byung dang 3/ grags pa phul byung 4bcas bzhi yod do//1 khyad 'phags brjod pa'i tsal byung ni/ rtsa bar/ ma mi kā yi zeng ba can/ /lus kun khyab pa'i tsandan gce/ra/ /dkar ba'i gos can sngon 'gro ma/ /bla ba'i 'od la mtshon ma yin/ /zhes pa ste/ me tog gi bye brag shin tu dkar ba ma li ka yi phreng ba du mas brgyan cing / lus kun la tsardon dkar po'i byug pa khyab par byugs pa/ ka shi ka'i ras dkar po'i gos can/ sdon 'gro ma ste rang gi mdza' bo'i mdun du 'gro ba'i bud med khyod mtshan mo zla 'od kyi 'og tu 'gro ba'i tshe 'di sngon 'gro ma yin snyam pa dang / 'di zla 'od yin snyam pa so sor mtshon mi nus pa ste so sor mi mngon no/ /gang yin zhe na/ dkar po'i thog la dkar po bab pa 'o ma'i mtsho la ngang mo rol ba lta bur gyur pas so/ /zhes spyir 'jig rten na zla ba'i 'od dang gzugs can ma zhig dbye ba 'byed mi thub pa mi srid kyang / sngon 'gro ma'i dkar ba'i yon tan gyi khyad 'phags brjod 'dod kyis zla 'od dang so sor 'byed mi nus zhes 'ud kyis brjod pa'o/ /yang na/ lang tsho gsar pa'i lus ldem zhing / /sdo ljang dar gyis lhab lhub

snyan ngag gi rnam bshad las gzhung don mu gnyis pha/ 491bklubs/ /dkar gsal bzhin gyi mig g.yo ma/ /chu skyes tshal nas 'byed parodaka'/ /zhes na tshod phra ba'i lus ldem pa dang / kha dog sngo ljang gi gos lhab lhub tu gyon pa/ gdong dkar ba'i ngo la mig g.yo ba'i bud med khyod me tog pad ma'i tshal du gnas pa'i tshe padma yin par 'khrul nas dbye ba 'byed dka'o zhes 'ud kyis bstod de mdzes chos phul du byung— bar brjod pa'o//de ltar bshad nas mtshams sbyar ba ni/ rtsa bar/ bla ba'i 'od ni lhag pa nyid/ /khyad 'phags ldan brjod de bzhin du/ /the tshom phul byung la sogs kyang / /gsal phyir cung zad bstan par bya/ /zhes pa ste/ zla ba'i 'od ni 'jig rten na ches dkar ba khyad par can zhig yin pa de dang sngon 'gro ma gnyis so sor dbyer mi nus pa ltar 'ud kyis brjod pa'i phyir khyad 'phags ldan pa'i phul byung zhes brjod la/ de bzhin du the tshom phul byung la sogs kyang gsal bar bya ba'i phyir cung zad bstan par bya'o zhes so//2 the tshom phul byung ni/ rtsa bar/ dga' ma khyod kyi nu ma dang / /dbyu yi bar na sked pa ni/ /yod dam med ces bdag gi ni/ /the tshom da dung bablog ma gyur/ /zhes pa ste/ dga' ma khyod kyi nu ma zung dang dpyi'i bar 'di na sked pa zhig yod dam med snyam pa'i bdag gi the tshom ni da dung bzlog par ma gyur te the tshom ma sangs so zhes pa ste/ 'jig rten na de 'dra'i the tshom dngos gnas skyed mi srid kyang sked pa phra ba'i ngo mtshar brjod 'dod kyis de lta'i the tshom byung ba ltar byas

492 rdo rje rgyal po'i gsungartsomaphyogasabasgrigs/ nas bshad pa'o/ /yang na/ dus bzhi 'khor mor nyin re bzhin/ /sa zhing nang du khyosnas byed pa'i/ /zhing pa rnams kyi lus 'di la/ /ngal rgyu yod med som nyir gyur/ /zhes dus bzhi 'khor mor nyin ltar zhing las byed pa'i zhing pa 'di rnams kyi lus la ngal rgyu yod dam med snyam zhes the tshom gyi tshig gis zhing pa'i ngal rtsol gyi brtson shugs la bstod pas the tshom phul byung ngo //3 nges pa'i phul byung ni/ rtsa bar/ ni tazi ni khyod la ni/ /sked ba yod ces nges par nus/ /'o ma 'dzin pa'i khur gnas pa/ /rnam pa gzhan du srid ma yin/ /zhes pa ste/ ni tambi na'i sgra mtshang ra rgyas ma la mjug pas de bos nas khyod la sked pa yod ces nges par du kha mtshon gcod nus/ ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'o ma 'dzin pa ste nu ma'i khur khog stod dang mtshang ra'i bar la rten yul rnam pa gzhan gang du'ang mi srid pas so zhes sked pa yod pa dngos su ma mthong bas de ltar gtan tshigs kyis bsgrub dgos pa mi srid kyang / yod par rtags kyis bsgrub dgos pa ltar du bshad pas sked pa phra ba phul du byung ba mtshon zhing sked pa yod pa'i nges pa'ang rnyed pas na nges pa'i phul byung gi rgyan no/ /yang na/so nam la brtson zhing pa rnams/ /ngal rgyu yod ces los brjod nus/ /de ltar min na lus po las/ /rngul chu'i thigs pa ci me 'bab ces zhing pas blar mtshams ma chad par ngal rtsol byed pa la bltas na ngal rgyu med pa ltar snang yang / kho tshor ngal rgyu yod ces los brjod nus/ de ltar min na lus po las rngul chu ci la 'bab ces brjod pa ni rngul chu 'bab

snyan ngag gi rnam bshad las gzhung don le'u gnyis pa/ 493pa'i rgyu mtshan la brten nas ngal rgyu yod par nges pa brjod pas ngesdo/ pa'i phul byung ngo //4 grags pa phul byung ni/ rtsa bar/ khyod kyi grags pa'i phung po ni/ /dpag nus min yang 'der shong ba/ /sa skyong srid pa gsum gyi ni/ /khongs dag e ma shin tu yangs/ /zhes pa ste/skyes bu khyod kyi snyan grags kyi phung po'i tshad ni 'di tsam yod ces sus kyang dpag par nus pa zhig min yang 'jig rten 'dir shong ba red/ sa gzhi skyong ba zhes bos nas/ sa 'og sa steng sa bla gsum gyi khongs 'di dag ni e ma shin tu yangs pa zhig go zhes grags pa gzugs su ma grub pa zhig shong dka' ba mi srid kyang / gang gi grags pa che ba phul du byung ba brjod 'dod kyis snod kyi 'jig rten yangs pa'i ngo mtshar brjod pa'i sgo nas bsgrubs pa'i phyir grags pa phul byung gi rgyan no/ /yang na/ khyed kyi mkhyen brtse nus gsum gyi/ /grags pas sa chen gang bzhin du/ /da dung kun gyis sgrog byed pas/ /nam mkha' mi ral ya mtshan che/ /zhes gang de'i sngar gyi snyan grags che bas sa chen 'jig rten gang nas yod pa'i thog la da dung mi kun gyis sgrog pa shong dka' bas nam mkha' mi ral ba ya mtshan che'o zhes 'jig rten gyi tshul las 'das pa'i 'ud kyis bstod pas grags pa phul du byung ba brjod pa'o//gsum pa bsngags pas mjug bsdu ba ni/ rtsa bar/ rgyan ne gzhan pa rnams las kyang / /ngag gi dbang pos mchod gyur pa/ /phul byung zhes ni brjod pa 'di/ /gcig pu nyid ni dpung gnyen

494 rdo rje rgyal po'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/brjod/ /zhes pa ste/ rgyan gzhan ji snyed pa de rnams las kyang ngag gi dbang pos mchod pa ste mkhas pas bsngags pa phul byung zhes pa'i rgyan gcig pu 'di nyid ni dpung gnyen nam dpal zla med pa zhig yin no/ /zhes so//12 rab btags kyi rgyan drug don rgyan bcu gnyis pa rab btags kyi rgyan bshad pa la bzhi ste/mtshan nyid spyir bstan pa dang / bye brag dper brjod pa dang / log par rtogs pa dgag pa dang / gsal byed kyi sgra bshad pa bcas so/ /dang po mtshan nyid spyir bstan pa ni/ rtsa bar/ sems ldan dag gam cig shos kyi/ /rnam pa gzhan du gnas pa'i tshul/ /gang du rnam gzhan rab rtog pa/ /de ne rab rtog tu rig dber/ /zhes pa ste/ sems ldan dag gam de'i cig shos sems med kyi dngos po'i rnam pa de nyid rnam pa gzhan du ste gnas lugs dngos gnas kyi tshul de nyid gang zhig tu de ma yin pa'i rnam pa gzhan zhig tu rab tu rtog pa ste sgro btags nas brjod pa de ni rab rtog gi rgyan du rig par bya'o/ /zhes so//gnyis pa bye brag dper brjod pa la/ don gyi sems ldan sems med gnyis/ /sgra yi snyam dang dogs dang nges/ /'dra dang min nam bzhin zhes pa'i/ /rab btags rnam grangs drug tu gyur/ /ces pa ltar rab rtog la bye brag phye na se mas ldan gyi rab rtog dang / sems med kyi rab rtog gnyis las med cing / rab rtog gsal byed kyi sgra rtsa bar dngos su

han sdag gi rnam bshad las gzhung don le'u gnyis pa/ 495bstan pa ltar na snyam sgra can dang / dogs sgra can dang / nges sgra can dang / 'dra sgra can dang / min nam sgra can dang / bzhin sgra can bcas drug yod do/ /zhes so//1 sems ldan rab rtog la snyam sgra sbyar ba ni/ /rtsa bar/ nyin gung nyi mas gdungs pa yi/ /glang po dag ni mtshor 'jug pa/ /nyi ma'i phyogs gyur padma rnams/ /gzhom par 'dod pa ma yin snyam/ /khras dang btung dang pad rtsa dag /bza' phyir lag ldan mtshor 'anug pa/ /de ne 'khon lan glan phyir zhes/ /snyan ngag mkhan gyis rab btags brdzod/ /ces pa ste/ nyin mo'i gung la nyi ma'i zer gyis gdungs pa'i glang chen 'di dag padma'i mtshor 'jug pa'i dgos pa ni nyi ma la lan glan par ma nus te de'i phyogs su gyur pa'i padma rnams gzhom zhing brdzi bar 'dod pa min nam snyam zhes dang /de'i gnad ni glang chen khrus bya ba dang / chu btung ba dang / pad rtsa bza' ba rnams kyi ched du chur 'jug pa la de ni nyi ma la 'khon lan glan pa'i ched du padma bcom par 'gro ba min nam zhes snyan ngag mkhan gyis rab tu sgro btags nas brjod pas sems ldan rab rtog go /yang na/ shes rab lha mchog 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /rno ngar ral gri gdeng ba 'di/ /nam zhig nyon mongs dgra bo yi/ /'tshe bar dogs pa min nam snyam/ /zhes 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis tshophyag mtshan ral gri gdeng ba 'di nam zhig na nyon mongs pa'i dgra bos 'tshe ba 'byung bar dogs pa min nam zhes shes rab kyi lha 'jam dbyangs la de lta'i dogs pa yong mi srid kyang sgro btags

496 rdo rje rgyal po'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrikas/te brjod pas sems ldan rab rtog snyam sgra can no//2 sems med rab rtog 'dra sgra can ni/ rtsa bar/ 'azhi ni bdag gi ring ba dag /'gog byed rna ba'i rgyan zhes te/ /khyod kyi mig gis rna ba yi/ /utpal dag la 'gongs pa 'dra/ /mig zur char ni lhung gyur pa/ /mig gi 'od kyis utpal la/ /reg pa min yang snyan ngag mkhan/ /de ltar rab tu btags te brjod/ /ces pa ste/ utpal 'di ni mig bdag gi yon tan dkyus ring ba 'gog par byed pa'i phyir rna ba'i rgyan gyi zol bzung nas 'ongs pa zhig go bsams te mdzes ma khyod kyi mig zur gyis rna ba'i rgyan du btags pa'i utpal dag la 'gongs shing 'dzing bar byed pa 'dra'o zhes dang / de'i gnad ni/ mig zur gyi char utpal lhung ba la mig zur lta ba de rab btags kyi sa bon byas nas mdzes ma 'ga' zhig gi mig gi 'od kyis rna ba'i utpal la reg pa ste mig 'od utpal la 'phog srid pa'am mi srid kyang mig zur bltas pa de sdang mig gi tshul du bzung nas snyan ngag mkhan gyis utpal sems med la de ltar rab tu btags te brjod pas sems med rab rtog go /zhes so/ /yang na/ jo mo glang ma'i ke la sha/ /'dzam gling rtser gyur khengs pa yis/ /da dung shugs kyis ker langs te/ /nam mkha' dbral bar rtsom pa 'dra/ /zhes jo mo glang ma ri bo bem po'i dngos por mtho ba 'dzam gling gi yang rtser gyur pa'i khengs pas da dung nam mkha' dbral ba'i 'du shes yong mi srid kyang sgro btags te de ltar yod par brjod pas sems med rab rtog 'dra sgra can no//

han ngag gi rnam bshad las gzhung don le'u gnyis pa/ 49spya3 bzhin sgra can ni/ rtsa bar/ mun pa lus la 'byug pa bzhin/ /mkha' ne mig sman char 'bebs bzhin/ /zhes 'de yang ro rab rtog gi /mtshan nyid ldan pa gin tu mang / /zhes pa ste/ dbyar dus kyi she mun la skyes bu'i lus mi mthong ba dang nam mkha' ngam nag pa rab rtog gi sa bon byas te/ mun pa ni skyes bu'i lus la 'byug pa bzhin dang nam mkha' 'di ni mig sman gyi char 'bebs pa bzhin no zhes dang / yang ngo zhes pa'i sgras rgyan 'di yang sems med rab rtog gi bye brag cig yin zhing / gzhan yang rab rtog gi mtshan nyid ldan pa shin tu mang ngo zhes so/ /yang na/ chu bo yar klungs gtsang po 'di/ /dgun gyi grang reg ma bzod par/ /dar gyi yol ba'i 'og brgyud nas/ /rgya mtsho'i ngos su 'bros pa bzhin/ /zhes yar klungs gtsang po grang reg ma bzod par dar te 'khyag pa'i yol ba'i 'og brgyud nas rgya mtsho'i ngogs su 'bros pa ltar 'ud kyis brjod pa rab btags bzhin sgra can no//mtshams 'di3 ༄bshad par bya ba zhig ni/ rtsa ba'i nang du rab rtog gi dper brjod gong dubye bshad pa gsum las med kyang / gshamadu bshad pa ltar rab rtog gsal byed kyi sgra mang po yod pa nas dngos su bstan pa drug yod cing / de'i nang nas snyam sgra dang / 'dra sgra dang / bzhin sgra gsum gong du song zin pa phud de min dogs sgra dang / nges sgra dang /min nam sgra bcas kyang dper brjod par bya'o//4 dogs sgra can ni/ bod mkhas pas/ gang gi mig gi mdzis —pa phul byung ba/ /dbyangs kyi rgyal mo'i mtshar sdug bang mdzod las/ /

498 rdo rgyal po'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/brkus pa'i nyes pas skrag pa'i utpal dang / /ri dwags rnams ni nags su bros par dogs/ /zhes dang / yang na/ mtha' yas shes bya'i gnas dag gi /zab dang rgya che'i khyad chos rnams/ /ldan pa rgya mtsho'i rba rlabs 'di/ /khengs pa sgrog phyir 'phyo bar dogs/ /zhes rgya mtsho'i rba rlabs drag por 'phyo ba 'di mtha' yas pa'i shes bya'i khyad chos zab pa dang rgya che ba de rang nyid la ldan zhes pa'i khengs pa sgrog pa'i ched du yin par dogs zhes rab btags kyis brjod pa dogs sgra can no//5 nges sgra can ni/ bod mkhas pas/ mdzes ma khyod kyi bzhin gyi yon tan rnams/ /bag med bzung ba'i padmo ga'o/na nu'i tshogs/ /gang gi skra tshogs dag la bcings mthong ste/ /rgyu skar rgyal po mkha' la 'dzeg par nges/ /zhes dang / yang na/ nya rgyas zla ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dis/ /mdzes ma'i bzhin dang 'gran snyam yang / /ra ris gos pas nongs gyur te/ /chu 'dzin phag la yib par nges/ /zhes zla ba spren gyis bsgribs pa de rab btags kyi gzhi byas te nya rgyas kyi zla ba 'dis mdzes ma'i bzhin gyi dkyil 'khor la 'gran snyam yang zla ba rang nyid la ra ris gos pas nongs te sprin gyi phag tu yib par nges so zhes brjod pa rab btags nges sgra can no//6 min nam sgra can ni/ bod mkhas pas/ mig sgan mdog 'chang srod kyi phra men mas/ /nyi gzhon dum bur gtubs pa'i phye ma kun/ /mkha' la stor ba min nam skar kyiogs rnams/ /rang rang 'od kyi snang ba 'phro bzhin 'du/ /zhes dang / yang na/ zhing pas nus shugs cher

snyan ngag gi rnam bshad las gzhung don le'u gnyis pa/ 499bskyed nas/ /dus bzhi'i so nam la 'bad 'di/ /bzo grwa'i 'phrul 'khor bed med kyi/ /zog ror bsgyur 'dod min nam ci/ /zhes don zhing pa'i ngal rtsol nus shugs la bstod cing / kho tshos nus shugs che bskyed kyis dus bzhi'i so nam gyi bya ba tshang ma lus shugs kyi ngal rtsol kho na la brten nas 'bad pa 'di bzo grwa'i 'phrul 'khor bed med zog ror bsgyur bedod min nam zhes 'ud kyis brjod pa rab btags min nam sgra ldan no//gsum pa log par rtog pa 'gog pa ni/ rtsa bar/ 'dir ni bzhin gyi sgra yis 'ga'/ /dpe nyid du ni 'khral ba skyed/ /ting the'i mtha' yis dbe ma yin/ /zhes pa yid ches gsung 'das nas/ /dpo dang dpor bya nyid dag ni/ /mtshungs pa'i chos la bstos pas na/ /'byug pa dang ni mun pa la/ /chos 'de mthong bar gyur tam ci/ /gal te 'byug pa nyid 'dod na/ /'byug rtses bya ba gzhan pa ci/ /de nyid chos dang chos can yang / /zhes pa ma smyos 'chad ma yin/ /gal te byed pa dbe yin na/ /bya tshig la 'de dbang bral 'gyur/ /rang gi bya bskub mi nus pa/ /gzhan gyi bstos byar mi 'byur ro/ /gang gis 'byug pa 'di dang ni/ /myan pa mtshungs zhes smra na yang / /lus la zhes dang ma 'brel te/ /de yang yon tan mtshungs par blta/ /dber na khrod gdong zla ba bzhin/ /zhes pas mtshes pa rtogs 'byur te/ /de bzhin 'byug pa 'di la ni/ /'byug pa las gzhan rtogs ma

byo00 rdo rje rgyal po'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/yin/ /de phyir 'byug pa 'di dang ni/ /mun pa byed po lus kyang las/ /nye bar jir don skyes bu yis/ /de ltar rab btags zhes 'dod bya/ /zhes pa ste/ rab btags kyi rgyan 'dir bzhin sgra yod pa'i dbang gis skye bo 'ga' zhig dpe rgyan du 'khrul bar 'gyur mod/— ting nge'i mtha' can 'di lta bu ni dpe rgyan ma yin/ dpe yin na de phan gyi rkyen ster dgos zhes sogs sho lo ka bdun gyis bkag 'dug kyang / legs sbyar gyi skad la bzhin sgrar ting nge'i mtha' can dang de phan gyi rkyen gyi khyad par de ltar yod par nges kyi/ bod skad la ni bzhin sgra de byad kyi bzhin dang / byed bzhin pa zhes pa'i bzhin dang / mtshungs pa gsal byed kyi bzhin bcas 'jug tshul mi 'dra ba gsum yod kyang /'dir bshad pa 'byug pa bzhin dang / char 'beebs bzhin zhes pa gnyis ka mtshungs pa gsal byed du ma gtogs gzhan 'grel bshad byed thabs dka' zhing / gzhung 'dir dngos su bstan pa'i rab rtog gsal byed kyi sgra gzhan drug gi nang du'ang 'dra zhes pa mtshungs pa gsal byed kyi sgra yod pas rab rtog la dpe rgyan 'dres kyang brjod bya dngos de rab btags yin pas skyon med/ dpe rgyan gyi nang du'ang rab btags kyi dpe yod pa de'ang dpe rgyan la rab btags 'dres pa zhig yin pa ltar ro/ /der brten dgag sgrub kyi dgos pa cher ma mthong bas 'dir log par rtog pa 'gog pa'i rtsa ba'i tshig de rang sor bkod pa las 'grel bshad bkod med/ zhib par dpyad pa'i bya ba la 'jug par spro ba mchis na snyan 'grel gzhan dag la gzigs par 'tshal/

snyan ngag gi rnam bshad las gzhung don le'u gnyis pa/ 501bzhi pa rab btags gsal byed kyi sgra bshad pa ni/ rtsa bar/snyam dang dogs dang nges dang 'dra/ /min nam zhes pa la sogs pa'i/ /sgra yis rab btags gsal bar byed/ /bzhin gyi sgra yang de 'dra'o/ /zhes pa ste/ snyam dang / dogs dang / nges dang /'dra dang / min nam dang / sogs khongs nas rtog go dang / rnam par rtog dang / mthong ngo dang / ji lta ba zhes pa'i sgra rnams kyis rab btags kyi rgyan gsal bar byed cing / bzhin gyi sgra yang de dang 'dra 'o/ /zhes bshad pa'i rab btags gsal byed kyi sgra de rnams phal cher dpe rgyan gyi mtshungs pa gsal byed la 'jug pa sha stag go/mtshams 'dir gsham du bshad bya'i rgyan gsum gyi bsngags pa spyir brjod pa zhig ni/ rtsa bar/ rgyu dang phra mo cha dag ni/ /tshig rnams dag gi rgyan gyi mchog /ces pa ste/ rgyu'i rgyan dang / phra mo'i rgyan dang / rim pa can gyi rgyan bcas gsum po 'di ni don rgyan rnams kyi nang nas rgyan gyi mchog yin no/ /zhes so//13 rgyu'i rgyan bcu drugadon rgyan bcu gsum pa rgyu'i rgyan bshad pa la gsum ste/ mtshan nyid spyir bstan pa dang / dper brjod kyis so sor bshad pa dang / de dag gi mjurge bsdu ba'o//dang po mtshan nyid spyir bstan pa ni/ rtsa bar/ rgyu ni byed po shes byed de/ /de dag rnam pa du ma dber/ /zhes pa ste/ rgyu'i rgyan ni

5skye2 rdo rje rgyal po'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/byed po'i rigs skyed byed dang / nyams byed dang / sgyur byed lta bu gang yang rung ba zhig gis rgyu byas pa'i 'bras bu zhig dngos shugs gang rung du thob pa'am byung ba zhig go zhing shes par byed pa'i bag gi sbyor ba'i rgyan zhig ste/ de dag gi nang gses rnam pa du ma ste mang po yod pa rnams re re bzhin dper brjod na zhes so//gnyis pa dper brjod kyis so sor bshad pa la/ rgyu ni dngos por gyur pa dang / /rnam grangs 'ga' yis dngos med du/ /bgrangs pa'i rgyu dang mtshar ba'i rgyu'o/ /dngos po'i rgyu la byed po dang / /shes byed rnam pa gnyis su yod/ /byed po la yang dbye ba gsum/ /'grub bya rnam 'gyur 'thob byed do/ /'grub bya la'ang rnam gnyis te/ /skye byed rgyu dang nyams byed rgyu/ /shes par byed pa'i rgyu la gnyis/ /phyi dang nang gi shes byed rgyu'o/ /dngos med rgyu ni med dgag bzhi/ /ma yin dgag pa gcig dang lnga/ /snga nas med dang zhig nas med/ /phan tshun med dang spangs nas med/ /bzlog pa skyed byed rgyu rnams so/ /ring 'bras de dang lhan cig skyes/ /de bzhin 'bras ma thag skyes dang / /rigs min rigs par byed ces pa'i/ /mtshar ba'i rgyu ni re zhig lnga/ /dril bas rgyu rgyan bcu drug go /zhes pa ltar rgyu rgyan la dbye na tshan pa gsurma ste/ dngos po'i rgyu dang / dngos med kyi rgyu dang / mtshar ba'i rgyu bcas khag gsum yod la/ dngos po'i rgyu la'ang byed po'i rgyu dang shes byed kyi rgyu gnyis/ byed po'i rgyu la'ang 'grub bya'i rgyu dang / rnam 'gyur gyi rgyu dang / thob byed kyi rgyu gsum/

snyan ngag gi rnam bshad las gzhung don le'u gnyis pha/ 503'grub bya la yang rnam pa gnyis bcas su phye ste yang snying dper brjod pa skyed byed kyi rgyu dang 1/ nyams byed kyi rgyu dang 3/ rnam 'gyur gye rgyu dang 3/'thob byed kyi rgyu dang tre/ phyi'i dus shes byed kyi rgyu dang 5/ nang shes byed kyi rgyu smobacas drug la dngos po'i rgyu zer la/ snga nas med pa'i byed rgyu dang 7/zhig nas med pa'i byed rgyu8/ phan tshun med pa'i byed rgyu9/ spangs nas med pa'i byed rgyu 1༷bcas med dgag bzhi/ ldog pa skyed byed kyi rgyu ma yin dgag gcig bcas lnga la dngos med kyi rgyu 11zhes zer/ ring 'bras kyi rgyu 11dang lhan cig skyes pa'i rgyu dang 13/ rgyu las 'bras bu snga ba dang 14/ rigs min gyi rgyu dang 15/ rigs pa'i rgyu 1smobacas lnga la mtshar ba'i rgyu zhes zer ba bcas khyon bsdoms rgyu rgyan bcu drug yod do//1 skyed byed kyi rgyu ni/ rtsa bar/ ma la ya yi drung gis ni/ /tsardzan sngon pa gsar pa yi/ /lal 'dab skyod par byed pa 'dis/ /kun gyi dga' ba skyed par byed/ /dga' ba skyed par 'os pa yi/ /rang bzhin nye bar jir ba 'di/ /rgyan nyid du ni rab bstan te/ /snog pa la yang de dang mtshungs/ /zhes pa ste/lho phyogs ma la ya nas 'ongs pa'i rlung gis tsardon gyi ljon pa gsar pa'i yal 'dab skyod par byed pa 'dis 'jig rten gyi khams yongs kyi dga' ba skyed par byed do zhes dang / de'i gnad ni/ dga' ba skyed par byed 'os pa'i rgyu rlung tsardon gyi ljon pa la bdar ba bsil ba'i rang bzhin dang sbyar 'di nyid rgyu'i rgyan du rab tu bstan la/ de las ldog pa dga' ba nyams par byed pa yang de dang mtshungs so zhes so/ /yang na/

504 rdo je rgyal po'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/legs sgrig bskyar bcos dag bsher dang / /gong spel bzhi yi srid byus kyis/ /rgyal 'bangs dpal 'byor cher 'phel bas/ /rgyal yongs mi dmangs dga' bar byed/ /ces legs sgrig dang / bskyar bcos/ dag bsher/ gong spel bcas lag len bstar nas rgyal 'bangs dpal 'byor ches cher 'phel bas rgyal yongs mi dmangs mtha' dag dga' bar byed do zhes dga' bar byed pa'i rgyu dpal 'byor 'phel bas byas pa 'di lta bu ni skyed byed kyi rgyu'o//2 nyams byed kyi rgyu ni/ rtsa bar/ ma la ya yi chu rgyun la/ /reg cing tsandan nags bskyod pa/ /glung 'di mgron po rnams dag ni/ /nyams par bya phyir nye bar gnas/ /de ltar gyur pa'i glung gis ni/ /'bral ba'i rims las byung gyur pa/ /yid 'ong la sred skye po la/ /nyams pa skub par byed par nus/ /zhes pa ste/ma la ya'i ri ngos nas 'bab pa'i chu rgyun la reg cing tsardon gyi nags tshal bskyod pa'i dri bzang 'thul ba'i rlung 'di mgron po bud med dang bral ba rnams dga' ba nyams te 'chi bar bya phyir nye bar gnas so zhes dang /de'i gnad ni/ de ltar dga' ba skyed par gyur pa'i rlung gis bud med dang bral ba las chags pa'i rims nad kyis mnar ba'i gdung ba 'bar te yid du 'ong ba'i yul la chags pa'i skye bo la dga' ba nyams pa yang byed nus so/ /zhes so/ /yang na/ legs sgrig bskyar bcos dag ba4sher dang / /gong spel bzhi yi srid byus kyis/ /rang rgyal stobs 'byor cheram̐ rgyas pas/ /ma rungs dgra bo'i dga' ba nyams/ /zhes dpal 'byor gyi srid byus

snyan ngag gi rnam bshad las gzhung don le'u gnyis pa/ 50thulegs sgrig dang / bskyar bcos/ dag bsher/ gong 'phel bcas lag len bstar nas rang rgyal gyi stobs 'byor ches cher rgyas pas ma rungs pa'i dgra bo rnams kyi dga' ba nyams par byas so zhes spyir stobs 'byor rgyas pas dga' ba skyed par byed pa'i rgyu des ma rungs pa'i blos rang rgyal dgra bor 'dzin pa rnams kyi dga' ba nyams par byed pas nyams byed kyi rgyu'o// —skabs 'dir rgyu gsum gyi rnam dbye bshad cing mtshams sbyar ba ni/rtsa bar/ 'grub par byed dang rnam 'gyur la/ /de nyid la bltos rgyu nyid de/ /thob bya'i las la phal cher nas/ /bya ba la bstos rgyu nyid do/ /'grub par byed pa'i rgyu dag ni/ /bstan te lhag ma gnyis po yi/ /dper brjod gnyis ni bkod byas nas/ /shes par byed pa bstan par bya/ /zhes pa ste/ 'grub par byed pa sngar med skyed pa rlung des dga' ba dngos por gyur pa skyed pa dang nyams pa dngos med skyed pa gnyis byed la/ rnam 'gyur gyis sngar yod rnam pa gzhan du bsgyur ba de ni(yang )de dag gi yul spyi dang bye brag la bltos pa yin zhing / 'thob bya las kyi rgyu'i lam phal cher ni rig byed bklags pa las 'thob par 'gyur ba lta bu yin pas bya ba la bltos pa'i rgyu yin la/phal cher gyi sgras de kho nar ma zad pa'o/ /'grub byed kyi rgyu'i dbye ba gnyis po de bstan zin te/ da ni lhag ma rnam par 'gyur byed dang /'thob byed las kyi rgyu'i dper brjod gnyis bkod cing / shes byed kyi rgyu yang bstan par bya'o/ /zhes so//

506 rdo rje rgyal po'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/3 rnam 'gyur gyi rgyu ni/ rtsa bar/ lo 'dab gsar 'khrangs nags tshal dang/ /'dam skyes rab tu rgyas pa'i rdzing / /zla ba rgyas pa 'dod pa yis/ /mgron po lta ba'i dug tu byas/ /zhes pa ste/ lo 'dab gsar pa 'khrungs pa'i nags tshal dang / 'dam skyes padma rab tu rgyas pa'i rdzing bu dang / zla ba'i dkyil 'khor nya rgyas pa ste yid du 'ong ba'i dngos po gsum bsgyur byar byas nas/ sgyur byed sems rgyud kyi 'dod pas bral ba'i nyen pa'i mgron po chags pa dang 'brel ba'i dbang gis mig la gdung ba skyed par byed pa lta ba'i dug tu byas so ste mthong ba'i dug tu gyur to zhes so/ /de ltar yul gyi rang bzhin rnal ma dga' ba skyed 'os pa de dag rnam pa gzhan du 'gyur ba ni byed po 'dod pa'i dbang du gyur pa'i rgyu las byung ba'o/ /zhes so/ /yang na/ 'phral yun kun dge'i legs bshad dang / /sha tsha can gyi bslab bya'i tshig /zol med drang po'i skyon 'don rnams/ /blun po khro ba'i rkyen du 'gyur/ /zhes legs bshad dang / bslab bya'i tshig skyon 'don bcas thos na dga' bar 'os pa zhig yin kyang / blang dor gyi tshul la rmongs shing rang shed kyi mthar lhungs pa'i blun po rnams khro ba skye ba'i rkyen nam rgyur 'gyur ba ni rnam 'gyur gyi rgyu'o//4 'thob byed kyi rgyu ni/ rtsa bar/ khengs pa goms par bya'o zhes/ /grogs mo mdza' bo'i gnas bkod la/ /bu mo smin 'khrog mig yon gyis/ /mchu ni g.yo 'ing lta bar byed/ /ces pa ste/ bu mo zhig na re/ khengs pa goms pa ste tshugs thub par gyis la

’na ngag gi rnam gad las gzhung don le'u gnyis pa/ 501'dir 'dug cig ces gdams nas rang gi grogs mo de mdza' bo'i gnas su bkod pa ste bzhag/ cing / smin ma 'khyog po'i mig zur yon po dang mchu sgros 'dzum pas cung zad g.yo ba dang bcas te lta bar byed ces mig zur lta ba dang mchu g.yo ba'i rnam 'gyur gyi shugs las 'thob bya mdza' bo dang 'grogs pa'i rgyu byed pas na 'thob byed kyi rgyu'o/ /yang na/ ba khyod ༄sgo gsum dang ba yis/ /'di ru sdod ces rab gdams te/ /bshes gnyen mkhas pa'i drung bzhag ste/ /pha rgan rang gi gnas su song / /zhes pha rgan zhig gis rang gi bu de dge rgan zhig gi drung du khrid de khyod 'dir sgo gsum dang ba dang ldan par gyis la sdod cig ces brjod nas bzhag pa des bu de la shes bya'i yon tan 'thob par byed pas 'thob byed kri/ rgyu'o// 5 phyi'i dus shes byed kyi rgyu ni/ rtsa bar/ nyi ma nub gyur zla ba mdzeb / /'dab chags rnams ni nags su song / /zhes pa 'di yang dus kyi skabs/ /gorgyu'ir byed la legs pa nyid/ /zhes pa ste/ nyi ma chu lha'i phyogs su nub cing / zla ba 'od zer gyis mdzes la/ 'dab chags bya'i rigs rnams nags su rang gi tshang du nyal bar song zhes bya ba'i ngo bo de tsam zhig bajo da pa'i shugs las phyi srod dus kyi gnas skabs 'khrul med du shes pa'i rgyur gyur pas rgyu'i rgyan shin tu legs pa nyid do zhes so/ /yang na/ skar tshogs nam mkha'i mthar bros shing / /shar phyogs bar snang skya bor gyur/ /bya bye'u gshog sgra sgrog pa'i dus/ /bdag kyang mal las ldang bar bya/ /zhes skar tshogs nam mkha'i mthar

50skye rdo rje rgyal po'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/bros pa ste mi mngon par gyur pa dang / shar phyogs kyi bar snang skya bor gyur pa/ bya bye'u rnams tshang nas ldang ba'i gshog sgra sgrog pa bcas brjod pas nam langs kyi dus tshod gsal por rtogs par byed pas phyi'i dus shes byed kyi rgyu'o//6 nang shes byed kyi rgyu ni/ rtsa bar/ grogs mo 'dod pas gzir ba'i yid/ /zla ba'i zer gyis mi snog cing / /tsandan chu yis mi bathod pa/ /lus kyi drod kyis legs par rtogs/ /zhes pa'i smyor ba rnams la ni/ /yid 'ong shes byed rgyu dag mtshon/ /zhes pa ste/ grogs mo khyod kyi yid 'dod pas gzir ba de ni zla ba'i 'od zer bsil pos kyang mi bzlog cing / tsardon gyi chu grang mos kyang sel mi thub pa lus kyi drod 'dod pa'i chos su 'bar ba 'dis legs par rtogs so zhes tshig gi sbyor ba 'dis skyes bu zhig bu mo de'i yid la bab pa rtogs pas nang shes byed kyi rgyu legs par mtshon pa'o/ /yang na/ ma yis bu la brtse ba de/ /byams pa'i mig dang mi 'bral zhing / /snyan pa'i ngag gis bos byas nas/ /zhim pa'i zas kyis gso bas rtogs/ /zhes byams pa'i mig dang mi 'bral ba dang / snyan pa'i ming nas 'bod pa/ zhim po'i zas kyis gso ba bcas bya ba de dag gi tshul las ma de bu la shin tu brtse ba rtogs pas nang shes byed kyi rgyu'o//dngos med kyi rgyu lnga bshad par dam bcas pa ni/ rtsa bar/ dngos med rgyu ne yid 'phrog pas/ /'ga' zhig rab tu bstan par bya/ /zhes pa ste/ dgag tshig gi sgo nas brjod pas dngos po med pa yang yin

na ngag gi rnam bshad las gzhung don li'u gnyis pa/ 509la rgyu yang byed pas dngos med kyi rgyu ste/ des mkhas pa rnams yid 'phrog par byed pas dper brjod 'ga' zhig bstan par bya'o zhes so/ /de la rgyu med pas 'bras bu yod pa skyed pa bzhi dang rgyu med pas 'bras bu yang med pa skyed pa gcig bcas lnga yod do//7 snga na med pa'i byed rgyu ni/ rtsa bar/ rig pa dag ni ma goms dang / /blo ldan rnams dang ma 'grogs dang / /dbang po dag ni ma bsdams pas/ /mi rnams rab tu gdung bar gyur/ /zhes pa ste/ rig pa'i gnas rnams la goms par ma byas pa dang / blo gros dang ldan pa rnams dang ma 'grogs pa dang / mig la sogs pa'i dbang po rnams yul la g.yeng ba ma bsdams pa bcas kyis mi rnams 'gyod cing sdug bsngal gyis gdung bar gyur to zhes snga na byas pa med pa'i rgyu de rnams kyis 'bras bu sdug bsngal dngos por gyur pa bskyed pas na snga na med pa'i byed rgyu'o/ /yang na/ bshes gnyen dam pa ma bsten zhing / /rgya chen gzhung la ma sbyangs la/ /blang dor tshul la ma bsams pas/ /da ni 'gyod pas gdung bar gyur/ /zhes bshes gnyen ma bsten pa dang /gzhung lugs la ma sbyangs pa/ blang dor gyi tshul ma bsams pa bcas bya 'os pa'i bya ba sngar ma byas pa'i rgyu de rnams kyis 'bras bu 'gyod pa dngos por rgyur pa baspred pas na snga na med pa'i rgyu'o//8 zhitpā nas med pa'i byed rgyu ni/ rtsa bar/ 'dod pa'i gtam gyis phyos pa song / /lang tsho yi ne rims dag nyams/ /jongs pa zad cing spred pa 'phos/ /bsod nams gnas la yid dag byas/ /

510 rdo je rgyal po'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/zhes pa ste/ sngar 'dod pa'i gtam gyis myos yod pa song ste zhig lang tsho dar la bab pa'i dus kyi chags pa'i rims nad de yang nyams te zhig 'khor ba la zhen pa'i rmongs pa yang zad cing zhig chags yul gzugs la sogs par sred pa yang 'phos nas zhig da ni skyon de dag gang yang med pas bsod nams te dge legs kyi gnas la yid rtse gcig tu dag par gnas par byas te/ gnas par gyur to zhes sngar yod zhig pa'i rgyu dngos med des 'bras bu dge legs kyi blo dngos por gyur pa bskyed pas na zhig nas med pa'i byed rgyu'o/ /yang na/ gzhon nu'i rnam par g.yeng ba yol/ /sger don 'du 'dzi'i 'ching rgya grol/ /'tsho ba'i khur med bde zhing skyid/ /da ni mi dmangs zhabs 'degs 'bad/ /ces lo na rgan tsam du son pa las byed pa bsam pa rnam par dag pa zhig la sbyar zhing / gzhon nu'i rnam g.yeng yol ba dang / sger don 'du 'dzi'i 'ching rgya las grol ba/ 'tsho ba phogs thob la brten pas rang nyid la khur med pa bcas sngar yod pa'i skyon rnams zhig nas med par gyur pa'i rgyu dngos med des 'bras bu bde zhing skyid pa dang / mi dmangs kyi zhabs 'degs la 'bad pa dngos por gyur pa bskyed pas zhig nas med pa'i byed rgyu'o//9 phan tshun med pa'i byed rgyu ni/ rtsa bar/ nags tshal 'di dag khyim ma yin/ /chu klung 'di dag bud med min/ /ri dwags 'di dag bu tsha min/ /de phyir bdag gi yid dga' 'o/ /zhes pa ste/ nags tshal yid du 'ong ba 'di dag 'jig rten pa'i khyim min/ chu klung 'di dag gya gyu'i sems 'chang ba'i bud med min/ ri dwags 'di

snyan ngag ge ra mo/ bshad las gzhung don le'u gnyis pa/ 511dag 'khor bar 'ching bar byed pa'i bu tsha min/ de'i phyir bdag gi yid dga' 'o zhes ri khrod la gnas pa'i bya btang zhig gis smras pa ste/ nags dang khyim sogasaṃ phan tshun yin pa med pa'i rgyu dngos med des 'bras bu dga' ba dngos por gyur pa bskyed pas na phan tshun med pa'i byed rgyu'o/ /yang na/ steng na gnon mkhan dpon po med/ /'og na bskyang bya'i 'khor g.yog med/ /bar na sdang ba'i dgra bo med/ /de phyir bdag gi snang ba skyid/ /ces rang nyid lta bu la cha mtshon nas sngar spyi tshogs rnying pa ltar steng nas gnon mkhan dpon po zhes pa med pa dang / 'og na bskyang bya'i 'khor g.yog ces pa'ang med pa/ bar na rang nyid la sdang ba'i dgra bo zhes pa'ang med pa bcas rgyu dngos med de dag gis 'bras bu snang ba skyid pa dngos por gyur pa bskyed pas phan tshun med pa'i byed rgyu'o//10 spangs nas med pa'i byed rgyu ni/ rtsa bar/ gin tu ma brtags spyod pa ni/ /'phags pa rnams la yod ma yin/ /de phyir de dag rnams kyi ni/ /phun tshogs thams cad rtag tu 'phel/ /zhes pa ste/ ma brtags par gya tshom du spyod pa'i spyod tshul phal pa'i rigs skyes bu dam pa rnams la nam yang med do/ /de'i phyir de dag rnams kyi phun sum tshogs pa thams cad rtag tu 'phel lo zhes spyod pa phal pa sngar nas spangs te med par gyur zin pa'i rgyu dngos med des 'bras bu phun sum tshos/sa pa 'phel ba dngos por gyur nga/ bskyed nga/sa na spangs nas med pa'i byed rgyu'o/ /zhes so/ /'di rnams la rgyu dngos med kyis 'bras bu dngos

512 rdo rje rgyal po'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/po skyed pa'i rgyu med dgag bzhi zhes zer/ yang na/ spyi tshogs ring lugs lam lugs la/ /thon skyed rgyu chas sger dbang med/ /de phyir thon skyed 'brel ba'i nang / /dge mtshan ldan pa'i rngas pa thon/ /zhes spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi lam lugs la thon skyed rgyu chas sger la dbang med la/ de phyir thon skyed kyi 'brel ba'i nang du thon skyed gong du 'phel bar dge mtshan lda na pa'i nus pa thon zhes sger la dbang ba med pa'i rgyu dngos med des 'bras bu thon skyed gong du 'phel ba dngos por gyur pa bskyed pas spangs nas med pa'i byed rgyu'o//11 rgyu dngos med kyis 'bras bu dngos med 8skyid pa bzlog pa skyed byed kyi rgyu ma yin dgag ni/ rtsa bar/ skyed tshal sa hā kā ra rnams/ /ste ma ma 'khyangs pa min na/ /mgron po rnams kyi bud med ni/ /til bcas khyor chu sbyin byar gyur/ /zhes pa ste/ skyed mos tshal gyi sa hā kā ra zhes shing a mra'i sdong po rnams la 'bras bu chags pa der snye ma ma 'khrungs pa min na zhes dgag sgra nyis brtsegs kyis brjod pas don 'bras bu chags par go ba'i rgyu des thag ring du phyin pa'i mgron po'i bud med chags pas brgyal ba de til bcas khyor chu sbyin byar gyur to zhes skabs 'dir dgag sgra nyis brtsegs yod pa'i phyi ma ma yin dgag dngos med des 'bras bu dran pa nyams pa dngos med bskyed pas na bzlog pa skyed byed kyi rgyu'o/ /'dir gnad 'grol dgos pa ni rgya gar gyi gtam rgyud cig la shing a za'i sdong po'i 'bras mthong na bud med rnams 'dod pas brgyal zhing dran pa nyams 'gro ba'i bshad srol yod pa ltar sbyar zhing / til bcas

snyan ngag gi rnam bshad las gzhung don le'u gnyis pa/ 513khyor chu sbyin byar gyur zhes pa ni brgyal ba'i skabs su gdong par til dang bcas pa'i khyor chu gtor na dran pa gso thub pas de ltar byed srol ltar bshad la/ do na ni a pra'i sdong po'i 'bras bu mthong na bud med chags pas mnar te brgyal bar 'gyur ro zhes so/ /'dir rgyu dngos med kyis 'bras bu dngos med bskyed pa zhes pa ni min na zhes pa'i ma yin dgag des 'bras bu dran pa nyams pa dngos med bskyed pa yin zhes bshad dgos so/ /yang na/ krung go'i mi dmangs dung phyur bcur/ /shes nus med pa ma yin pas/ /gral rim gral rim bshu gzhogacibacas/ /ming gi lhag ma nyid du byas/ /zhes krung go'i mi dmangs dung phyur bcu po 'di dag shes bya dang nus pa med pa ma yin pas na gral rim dang gral rim gyi bshu gzhog ces pa rnams ming tsam las ma lhag par byas so zhes med pa ma yin zhes rgyu dngos med des 'bras bu gral rim dang gral rim gyi bshu gzhog ces pa ming tsam las ma lhag pa bskyed pas rgyu dngos med kyis 'bras bu dngos med bskyed pa'o//de dag gi don bsdu ba ni/ rtsa bar/ yod dang med pa'i rang bzhin gyi/ /'bras bu skyed pa dag la 'dir/ /sngar med la sogs rang bzhin gyi/ /dngos po yi gi nyid do/ /zhes pa ste/yod pa sgrub pa'i rang bzhin dang / med pa dgag pa'i rang bzhin gyi 'bras bu skyed pa de dag la 'dir snga na med pa dang zhige nas med pa la sogs med pa'i rang bzhin gyi rgyu de dag gis 'bras bu dngos po bskyed pas na dngos po'i rgyu zhes brjod pa'o/ /'dir dngos po zhes dang gong du

514 rdo rje rgyal po'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/dngos med du bzhag pa mi 'gal/ gang yin zhe na/ dgag tshig la dngos med du btags pa tsam yin gyi dngos med kho nas 'bras bu bskyed pa med pas so —mtshar ba'i rgyu bshad pa la gnyis te/ dbye bas mdor bstan pa dang / dpes rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /dbye bas mdor bstan pa ni/rtsa bar/ ring 'azas de dang lhan cig skyes/ /de bzhin 'bras ma thag skyes dang / /rigs min rigs pa byed ces pa'i/ /mtshar ba'i rgyu rnams grangs med do/ /'di dag smyor ba'i lam rnams la/ /btags pa'i tshul la bten na ni/ /shin tu mtshes pa dag mthong ste/ /de yi dber brjod ji ltar na/ /zhes pa ste/ mtshar ba'i rgyu la ring 'bras kyi rgyu dang / lhan cig pa'i rgyu dang / rgyu las 'bras bu snga ba dang / rigs min gyi rgyu dang / rigs pa'i rgyu bcas dang /gzhan yang grangs med pa yod la/ don la ched du ma byas pa'i 'bras bu dang / rgyu 'bras dus gcig pa/ rgyu las 'bras bu snga ba sogs yong mi srid kyang de dag tshig tu sbyor ba'i lam ste tshig gi sbyor tshul la btags pa'i tshul gyis brjod na tha snyad du rung zhing legs pas shin tu mdzes par mthong ste/ de yi dper brjod ji ltar yin bshad na zhes so//12 dpes rgyas par bshad pa la ring 'bras kyi rgyu ni/ rtsa bar/lus can khyod mig zur zhes pa/ /rgyal byed luṅge med dag gi mtshon/ /gang de gzhan la rab 'phangs pa/ /de yis bdag gi yid kyang brtsom/ /nes pa ste/ kye lus can ma/ khyod kyi mig snyer

’na ngag gi rnam bshad las gzhung don le'u gnyas pa/ 51byozhes zer ba 'gro ba kun las rgyal bar byed nus pa lus med 'dod lha'i mtshon char gyur pa de skyes pa gzhan la 'phangs pa de yis gādag gi yid kyang bcom mo )sa kyang sgra des 'phang yul der ma zad bahwag gi yid kyang bcom pa bstan la/ spyir mtshon cha'i las ni gang la 'phangs pa de las 'bigs mi nus kyang / 'dir 'phang yul skyes pa gzhan des ma tshad par bdag kyang bcom pa mtshar che bas ring 'bras kyi rgyu zhes bya'o/ /yang na/su'u len dbang 'phrog ring lugs pa/ /a spru han la 'dzul ba des/ /pa ki si dang yi lang yang / /bde ba bral ba'i gnas su gyur/ /ces su'u len a hphu han gyi sa cha'i nang du 'dzul ba des a glu han de rang tsam gyis ma tshad par de'i nye 'dabs kyi rgyal khab pa ki si dang yi lang yang bde ba'i go skabs bral bar brjod pas ring 'bras kyi rgyu'o//13 rgyu 'bras lhan cig pa ni/ rtsa bar/ skyes bu lus skyes kyis byus pa'i/ /rnam 'phrul sna tshogs lhan cig nyid/ /bud med rnams la bu mo ne/ /yongs su nub pa'i na tshod skyes/ /zhes pa ste/skyes pa zhig lus skyes te 'dod pas myos pa'i rnam 'phrul sna tshogs gsal ba ste ston pa dang lhan cig rang du bud med rnams la bu mo gzhon nu'i na tshod yol nas 'dod pa bsten ran gyi na tshod du slebs so zhes spyir rgyu sngon dang 'bras bu phyir yong mod/ 'dir de gnyis mnyam du byung ba mtshar ba'i phyir rgyu 'bras lhan cig pa'i rgyu zhes bya'o/ /yang na/ 'od stong ldan pa'i dkyil 'khor 'di/ /shar ri'i rtse nas 'char ba dang / /lhan cig smag rum mthar bros shing / /sa steng bde drod rab tu rgyas/ /zhes rgyu

516 rdo rje rgyal po'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/nyi ma shar ba dang lhan cig tu 'bras bu mun pa mthar bros pa ste sangs shing /sa steng gi bde drod rgyas pa cig car du byung ba brjod pas rgyu 'bras lhan cig pa'o//14 rgyu las 'bras bu snga ba'i rgyu ni/ rtsa bar/ sngar nyid ri dwags mib/ can ma'i/ /chags pa'i rgya mtsho rgyas par gyur/ /phyis nas 'od zer rab 'phro ba'i/ /bla ba yi ni dkyil 'khor shar/ /zhes pa ste/ sngar te sngon la ri dwags mig can gzhon nu ma'i chags pa'i rgya mtsho rgyas nas phyis zhig nas bdud rtsi'i 'od zer rab tu 'phro ba'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor nya gang ba shar ro zhes chags pa rgya mtsho'i gzugs su bkod cing / spyir dpe la cha mtshon na zla ba shar nas rgya mtsho rgyas pa dang / dpe can la cha mtshon na skyes pa'i rnam 'gyur gyis bud med la chags pa skye bar byed kyang / 'dir de las ldog ste zla ba ma shar gong nas rgya mtsho rgyas par brjod pas skyes pa'i rnam 'gyur gang yang med par bud med kyi yid 'a chags pa skyes pa bstan pas 'bras bu rgyu'i sngon la byung ba'i phyir mtshar che ba rgyu las 'bras bu snga ba'i rgyu zhes bya'o/ /yang na/ thog mar tang gi srid byus kun/ /ji ma ji bzhin lag len bstar/ /phyis nas gsar brje'i khe phan ched/ /de ltar 'os pa gsal por rtogs/ /zhes thog mar tang gi srid byus rnams ji ma ji bzhin du lag len bstar zhing / phyis nas sam rjes su gsar brje'i khe phan gyi ched du de ltar bya 'os pa rtogs zhes brjod pas lag len sngon la bstar zhing de ltar bstar dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan rjes su rtogs pas rgyu las 'bras bu snga ba'o//

snyan ngag gi rnam bshad las gzhung don le'u gnyis pa/ 51715 rigs min gyi rgyu ni/ rtsa bar/ lha gcig khyod kyi zhabs gnyis po/ /dmar ba'i nyi gzhon la reg pa/ /rgyal po rnams kyi lag pa yi/ /padma zum par byed pa ci/ /zhes pa ste/ rgyal po zhig la lha gcig ces bos nas/ khyod kyi zhabs mthil gnyis rab tu dmar ba'i nyi ma gzhon nu 'di lta bu la reg pas mtha'i rgyal po rnams kyis 'dud pa'i lag pa'i padma zum par byed pa 'di ci yin te mi rigs so zhes 'dir bstod yul rgyal po'i zhabs nyi ma dang / rgyal po gzhan gyi lag pa padma'i gzugs su bkod cing / spyir nyi mas padma rgyas par byed pa zhig la 'dir btags pa'i nyi mas padma zum par byed pa mi rigs shing mtshar che bas rigs min gyi rgyu zhes bya'o/ /yang na/ 'ga' res bsam pa rnam dag gis/ /skyon cha gsal por bstan pa de/ /rnam rtog log pa'i skye bo(la)dag /khong khro 'bar ba'i me rtsar 'gyur/ /zhes bsam pa rnam dag gis skyon cha gsal por bstan pa de rnam rtog gam bsam phyogs log pa'i skye bo dag la khong khro 'bar ba'i me rtsar 'gyur zhes pa phan sems kyis skyon bstan pa khong khro lang ba'i rgyur 'gyur ba rigs min gyi rgyu'o//16 rigs pa'i rgyu ni/ rtsa bar/ khrod kyi zhabs sen zla ba yi/ /'od zer kunda dri med rnams/ /sa skyong rnams kyi lag pa yi/ padma zum par byed la dbang / /zhes pa ste/ khyod kyi zhabs sen mchog tu mdzes pa'i zla ba 'di'i 'od zer kurdo dri ma med pa'i mdangs 'phro ba rnams sa skyong gzhan rnams kyis 'dud pa'i lag pa'i padma zum par byed pa la dbang ngo ste zum par byed do zhes bstod yul gyi rgyal po'i zhubs

518 rdo rje rgyal po'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/sen zla ba dang / rgyal po gzhan gyi lag pa padma'i gzugs su bkod cing btags pa'i zla bas padma zum par byed rigs shing mtshar bas rigs pa'i rgyu zhes bya'o/ /yang na/ zab mo'i gzhung lugs mang thos shing / /bsam zhing dpyad par byas pa yis/ /gang gang shes bya'i don rnams kun/ /de de bzhin du rtogs par 'gyur/ /zhes rigs pa'i gzhung lugs mang du thos pa dang / bsam zhing dpyad pa'i bya ba byas pas gang la sbyangs pa'i shes bya rnams kyi don de dag de bzhin du rtogs par 'gyur ba ni 'os shing rigs pa'i rgyu'o//gsum pa rgyu rgyan de dag gi mjug bsdu ba ni/ rtsa bar/ zhes pa rgyu yi rnam rtos gi /lugs ni 'di 'dra dag tu bstan/ /zhes pa ste/ rgyu'i rgyan gyi rnam rtog gi lugs ni dbye ba gsum dang de dag so so'i nang gses dang bcas pa gong du bshad pa 'di 'dra zhig tu bstan zin to zhes so//14 phra mo'i rgyan gnyis/don rgyan bcu bzhi pa phra mo'i rgyan bshad pa la gnyis te mtshan nyid bshad pa dang / dper brjod pa'o//dang po mtshan nyid bshad pa ni/ rtsa bar/ zur dang rnam pas mtshon pa'i don/ /phra phyir phra mo zhes par bshad/ /ces pa ste/blo sngon du btang ba'i lus kyi brda'am zur gyis ston tshul phra mo dang / blo sngon du btang ba min yang nang sems kyi 'gyur ba lus nyams su thon pa'i
