794 rdo ṅge du'/ po'e rte/sung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/pa thun mong ba'iri rig nga 'i gnas mang po dang / thun mong ma yi na pa theg pa chen po'i sa/su nga rab mang po sbyangs te tshad mthon por son nas bod du 'byon par brtsams pa'i tshe mkhan po li byin gyis‘‘khyod ni rig gnas kun gyi rtsed mor son/ /da ni sprul pa'i rgyal po'i dgongs pa 'grub/ /bod yul 'gro kun yi ge sgra tshad dang / /lung rigs man ngag rnams kyis tshim par mdzod//’mices gsungs so/ /thon mi sam bho ṭas yon phul nas gtang rag gi tshig brjod par/ ‘‘thugs la btags so rgyal ba'i sras/ /bka' drin che 'o ngo mtshar can/ /byin gyis rlobs shig thugs rje can/ /rig pa dri med nam mkha' la/ /thabs shes gnyis kyi rgyu skar shar/ /'gro ba'i ma rig mun pa sel/ /bde gsal yid kyi rgya mtsho la/ /rig pa blo yi chu phran 'khor/ /smon lam dag pa'i chu bya lding / /sgra tshad yi ge'i nor bu bzhugs/ /'gro ba'i dbul phongs sel bar byed/ /sgyu lus dri med sdong po la/ /thabs shes gnyis kyi yal ga rgyas/ /bslabs shes yon tan me tog shar/ /sgra tshad yi ge'i 'bras bu smin/ /bod kyi blon po thon mi la/ /ma lus gnang ba thugs la btags/ /rgya gar yul du yong ba yin/ /mkhas grub khyod dang mjal ba yin/ /yon tan gaji/ ma yi ge yin/ /ma lus khong du chud pa yin/ / bod yul dbus su 'gro ba yin//rgyal pos dga' ston mdzad pa yin/ /rgyal srid chos bzhin skyong ba yin //rgyal pos dbu mdzad blon 'bangs la/ /sgra tshad yi ge spel ba yin/ /kun la rgyas par byed pa yin/ /thugs la btags po rgyal ba'iri srasdo ///’’zhes gsol zhing zhabs spyi bos blangs te bod du phebs so//

bod kyi yig srol dar tshul brjod pa 'i gtam/ 195de ltar snying stobs kyi rtsal bton te dka' ba dpag tu med pa spyad pa 'i blon po thon mi sam bho ṭa zhes pa des sprul pa'i rgyal po'i bzhed don yi ge dang sgra tshad sogs rig pa'i gnas mang po thugs su chungo/ ste ded da pon rgya mtsho'i gling nas 'khor ba ltar bod du phyir phebs par rgyal po thugs dgyes pa'i bkur bsnyi dang dga' ston chen po mdzad cing / sku ma ba/ ra ma rur lālca lha'i yi ger dpe blangs nas dbu chen dang / wartu klu'i yi ger dpe blangs nas dbu med de lhun grub tshang ma bod kyi yig gzugs brtsams/dbyangs gsal gyi yig 'bru rgya gar gyi dbyangs yig bcu drug nas bod la mi mkho ba ā zhi u ṛ ro '-i lo i o i aḥ bcas bcu rngaka cis/ dor nas a i u e o lnga blangs/ rgya gar gyi gsal byed sum cu so bzhi nas bod la mi mkho ba sturga/ po'i yi ge gha dzha snyo dha bha lnga dang / log pa'i yi ge ṭa ṭha ḍa ṇa dzi lnga/mthar gnas kyi yi ge kṣa bcas bcu gcig dor te/ ka kha ga nga / ta tha da na/ pa pha ba ma/ tsa tsha dza wa/ nya ya ra la sha sa ha bcas yi ge nyi shu rtsa gsum blangs nas de dag po/ni pya / ra/'i thog bod skad la med du mi rung ba'i yi ge stod du ca cha ja gsum dang / smad du zha za 'a gsum ste yig 'bru drug bsnan/ a dbyangs yig yin kyang dbyangs kyi bya ba gsal por mi byed cing / gsal byed kyi nang du ming gzhir mkho che bas gsal byed kyi gras su bzhag ste yang snying bod yig la dbyangs i u e o bzhi ste/ gi gu dang / zhabs kyu/ 'greng po/ na ro bcas bzhi dang / gsal byed ka kha ga nga / ca cha ja nya/ ta tha da na/ pa pha ba ma/ dza tsha4dza wa/ zha za 'a ya/ ra la sha sa/ ha a bcas sum cu tham par gtan la phab pa red/

196 rdo rje rgyal po'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/bod yig gi khyad chos ni/ ‘‘lhun grub tshang ma bod yig la/ /dbyangs bzhi gsal byed sum cu ste/ /ming gzhi gtso po nyi shu dang / /kun la 'jug pa'i yi ge bcu/ /dgos pa che ba'i sngon 'jug lnga/ /medacikyang chog pa'i wa yig gcig /ra la sa gsum mgo bo 'dra/ /gi gu 'greng po na ro ste/ /steng du zhwa ltar lding ba gsum/ /ya ra la wa zhabs kyu ste/ /gdan ltar mdzes pa lnga rnams bskrun/ /pho mo ma ning rtags dbye dang / /rnam dbye brgyad dang tshig gi phrad/ /dngos po bdag gzhan dus gsum sogs/ /tshig zur bsgyur bas thon par mdzad/ /dbu dang tsheg shad lugs kyang ldan// zhes pa ltar lhun grub tshang ma bod kyi yi ge'i khyad chos rtsa ba'i dbyangs bzhi dang gsal byed sum cu tham pa de dag ming gzhi gtso bor byed pa'i yi ge ka kha ca cha ja nya ta tha pa pha tsa tsha dza wa zha za ya sha ha a bcas nyi shu dang / rjes 'jug ga nga da na ba ma 'a ra la sa bcas bcu/sngon 'jug ga da ba ma 'a lnga/ med kyang chog pa'i yi ge wa gcig mgo 'dogs ra la sa gsum/ steng du 'god rgyu'i gi gu dang / 'greng po/ na ro gsum/ smad 'dogs ya ra la wa bzhi dang zhabs kyu bcas lnga/ tsheg shad bcas kyi rnam gzhag yod pa dang / de dag pho mo ma ning gi rtags dbye tshul dang / rnam dbye dang tshig phrad sbyor tshul/ dngos po bdag gzhan dang dus gsum gyi 'jug tshul sogs sdeb sbyor ram tshig zur bsgyur bas brjod don gsal por thon pa'i khyad chos can mthong chos myong grub tu gyur ba ltar yin zhing / thon mi'i mdo sde'i sgra mdo dang / sum rtags sogs brda sprod pa'i bstan bcos brgyad mdzad lugs/ kyang yongs grags

bod kyi yig srol dar tshul brjod ba'i gtam/ 797ltar ro//de ltar rgya gar gyi yi ge gzhi'am dper byas pa yin na rgya gar gyi dbyangs gsal la 'dor len dang / bod yig gsar snon byed dgos don gang yin/ bya rim ga 'dra zhig byung yod ce na/ rgya gar gyi skad la dbyangs ring po dang thung ngu sogs kyi rnam gzhag mang po yod pa de dag bod skad la mi dgos pas dbyangs lngar bsdus shing / a yig gong du bshad pa ltar dgos pa'i dbang gis gsal byed kyi gras su bzhag pas dbyangs yig bzhir gyur la/ rgya gar gyi skad kyi sgra la gsal byed nang gi stug po dang log pa'i yi ge de dag med du mi rung yang / bod yig la rang nyid kyi khyad chos sngon 'jug dang / mgo can/ 'dogs can bcas sbyor ba'i rnam sa/zhag yod pas rang skad kyi sgra gdangs gang dang ci dgos pa mtha' dag thon pas stug po dang log pa'i yi ge de dag dor zhing / de byings gsal byed nyi shu rtsa gsum bod skad la mkho bas blangs pa yin/ gsar du snon dgos don ni/ rgya gar gyi skad la eka zhes pa bod du gcig yin pa de'i ming gzhi ca dang / rgya gar gyi skad lu dharma zhes pa bod skad du chos yin pa de'i ming gzhi cha/ rgya gar gyi skad la lo ka zhes pa bod skad du 'jig rten yin pa de'i ming gzhi ja/ rgya gar gyi skad la dabha zhes pa bod skad du zho yin pa de'i ming gzhi zha/ rgya gar gyi skad la bharghaṃ zhes pa bod skad du zasaspre yin pa de'i ming gzhi za/ rgya gar gyi skad la dusta zhes pa bod skad du 'o ma yin pa de'i ming gzhi 'a bcas te ca cha ja zha za 'a drug bod skad la nye bar mkho yang de dag gtan la 'bebs pa'i thabs nges pa

kṇi98 rdo rje rgyal po'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/can zhig ma rnyed pas bod yig gsar skrun gyi thad dang / rgya bod skad rigs mi 'dra ba gnyis bar sgra 'ga' zhig bsgyur ba'i thad gang la'ang dka' tsam byung bas slob dpon thon mi thugs mug nas yud tsam zhig kha spub tu gzims te bzhugs tsa na skye bo dam pa'i lhag bsam sma med pa'i thugs bskyed 'grub pa'i cha rkyen bzang po yang 'bad med du 'byung ba bden 'bras g.yo ba med pa'i chos nyid ltar de ma thag cig la slob dpon gyi mdun du mi dkar po lcags zhwa dang lcags gos gyon pa zhig byung bar slob dpon gyis khyod gang nas byon gsungs par/ de na re/ zhang zhung nas 'ongs zer/ gang du 'gro gsungs par/ za 'or du 'gro zer/ gang byed du 'gro gsungs par/ ja nyo ru 'gro zer/ nam slebs gsungs par/ ci cha zhes zer ba'i mus la mi de gar song cha med du gyur pa red/ skabs de nyid la slob dpon gyi thugs la spro ba gsar pa zhig 'phel te mi de'i skad cha la dpyad pas zhang zhung nas 'ongs zhes pa'i tshig las zha dang / za 'or zhes pa las za dang 'a ciganyis/ ja nyo ru 'gro zhes pa las ja/ ci cha zhes pa las ca dang cha gnyis bcas yi ge drug rnyed cing gtarmon la phab ste bsnan pa'o//gsum pa/ de ltar dbyangs gsal gnyis dang / sngon rjes/ mgo 'dogs bcas kyi sbyor tshul rnam gzhag bzos pa de la dge mtshan dzilta bu zhig yod ce na/ nye dus mdo smad dan tig pa tshe tan zhabs drung gis mdzad pa'i byis pa klog la 'jug pa'i ka dpe thon mo'i bzhad sgra zhes pa'i nang du bstan par/ bod kyi yi ge la bklag par byar yod pa'am brjod du rung tshad kyi grangs ni sa skya pa bsod nams rtse mos byis pa bde blag tu

bod kyi yig srol da ri tshurabarjodapa'igatam/ 799wa 'jug pa zhes pa'i nang du brtsis pa ltar na chig khri brgyad stong bdun brgya zhe lnga dang / kho bos bris pa'i yi ge'i thob thang du brtsis pa ltar na chig khri bdun stong lnga brgya so gnyis yod cing / bod kyi ming tshig la da lta dgos nges kyi grangs ni sa skya pa bsod rtses stong phrag brgyad du 'du gsungs pa de ni deng skabs mi mkho bar brten lo tsā ba snga ma rnams kyis yig tshogs chung ched du bsdus pa'i da drag can sum/ stong nyi shu sogs kyang bgrangs par nges shing / kho bos brtsis pa ltar na da drag can sum stong dgu bcu yod pa phud/ ka kha rkyang pa nas brtsams te mjug gi wa btags can gyi mthar thug pa'i bar la bar tsheg gis phye ba'i yi ge mi 'dra ba grangs bzhi stong lnga bcu nga gsum(1956 lo'i par mar grangs 3922yod)yod pa de dag ni bklag par byar yod pa tsam du ma zad/ ming ngam ming gi thog mtha' ci rigs su 'jug tu yod pa'i yi ge 'ba' zhig yin zhes gsungs 'dug pa ltar brjod du rung tshad brtsis na chig khri brgyad stong brgal ba zhig yod cing / bod skad la nye bar spyad bya ni bzhi stong brgal tsam 'di las mi dgos par bzhed pa 'di nyid dpyad zhib nan tan mdzad pa'i snying po deb thog tu bton pa kun gyi mthong chos yid rton rung ba zhig yin la/ des da lta'i chos srid gnyis su gtogs pa'i shes bya gsar rnying gi brjod bya ji skyed pa mtha' dag ji lta bar yig thog nas brda sprod thub par ma zad/ da dung da lta mi mkho bar lhag nas bsdad pa chig khri bzhi stong tsam yod pa de rnams ni 'byung 'gyur dgos pa byung na spyad chog pa'i phugs gsog gter mdzod po zhig yin pa bcas mdor na brjod bya don gyi gting mtha' ji

800 rdo rje rgyal po'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/tsam brjod nus rang nyid kyi blo gros kyis ma bslus na rjod byed tshig la mkho ba'i yi ge'i thad nas mi ldeng ba'am mi gsal ba'i dka' ngal mi 'byung ba zhig yin pas 'dzam gling gi yig rigs mi gcig pa byug cur nye ba'i nang du nyams dman mi dgos pa zhig yin no//de ltar bod yig gi gzugs dang sbyor tshul gyi rnam gzhag bcas kyi srol phye zhing gtan la legs par phab ste gangs ri'i ljongs 'dir thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i rig pa'i gnas kun gyi phyi mo'am rtsa ba brda sprod pa'i gzhung lugs kyi srol bzang dar bar mdzad pa'i dga' ston gyi gdan sar sprul pa'i rgyal po rang nyid kyang sku dngos su byon pa'i che ba 'degs pa dang rten 'brel gyi ched du blon po thon mi sam bho ṭas yig phud du snyan ngag gi sgra rgyan bya dka' ba'i lam nas drangs pa'i rgyal po la bstod pa phul bar/‘‘zhal ras gsal la rang mdangs gang ba bzang / /gdam ngag zab la ma chad mtha' dag dang / /las ngan bag chags thams cad gsal mdzad pa/ /'phags pa ma pham yang dag dam pa la/ /bde gshegs bden nges ye shes te/ /ting 'dzin gzhi nyid rig cing gzigs/ /nyon mongs tshogs bcom mgon po mchog /dug gsum bdud 'dul kun tu thul/spyan ras gzigs dbang thugs kyi sras/ /srong btsan sgam por mtshan gsol ba/ /chos rgyal khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// ’zhes sho lo ka dang por dbyangs a gcig tu nges pa dang / sho lo ka gnyis pa'i skong pa dang por dbyadas e dang / rkang pa gnyis par dbyangs i/ rkang pa gsum par dbyangs o/ rkang pa bzhi par dbyangs u bcas re rer nges pa'i rgyan

bod kyi yig srol dar tshul brjod pa'i gtam/ 801gyis mdzes par spras te phul bas rgyal po shin tu dgyes shing / sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po cher dgongs te thonacimi la bkur bste dang phu dud kyang mdzad/ de la blon po gzhan rnams phrag dog gis kun nas bslangs te rje bos 'bangs la 'di lta bu'i bkur bsnyi mi 'os so zhes bsgrags par brten blon po thon mis de dag gi 'gran sems gcog pa'i ched du 'di skad smras so/ /‘‘drin chen gyi blon po thon mi ngas/ /lam bgrod par dka' ba'i rgya gar du/ /lus tsha grang che yang dka' ba spyad/ /khong mkhas pa bram ze li byin la/ /yid gus pa'i tshul gyis mos gus byas/ /nor rin chen gser gyi phyag rten phul/ /don rnyed par dka' ba'i yig 'bru bstan/ /blo the tshom sel ba'i mdzub khrid byas/ /tshig dbyangs yig rnams la mkhas par bslabs/ /rgya'i yi ge lnga bcu tham pa de/ /bod yig 'bru so bzhir gtan la phab/ /rang mkhas pa'i nges shes blo la shar/ /'phrul yon tan thams cad khong du chub/ /dus da lta dga' la phyi ma skyid/ /yul mtha' 'khob bod kyi rgyal khams 'dir/ /mi mkhas pa slebs pa'i snga ma yin/ /nga mun pa sel ba'i sgron me yin/ /rje rgyal po nyi zla'i tshul du bzhugs/ /grogs blon po'i khrod na nga tsam med/ /bod kha ba can gyi mi rnams la/ /nga thon mi bka' drin mi che 'am//mi’zhes brjod pas blon po rnams gcig la gcig lta zhing / 'gran sems med par gyur to//‘‘de ltar sprul pa'i chos rgyal chen po des/ /yon tan kun gyi gzhi ma 'dri klog gis/ /bod yul rmongs pa'i mun pa kun bsal te/ /chos dang srid kyis rgyal khams bde bar mdzad//’’ces pa ltar sprul pa'i rgyal po

wa57wa rdorjergyasdapo'igasungartsom phyogs sgrigs/des yon tan kun gyi gzhi ma yi ge 'bri klog gi srol btod nas bod yul glu'adi nyid mun pa'i gling du sgron me bteg pa ltar bde gsal gyi dpal yon skel ci dgar rol chog pa byung ste shar phyogs rgya dang mi nyag nas bzo dang rtsis kyi dpe blangs pa dang / lhotshophyogs rgya gar nas dam pa'ispyochos bsgyur ba/nub phyogs ta zig dang bal po nas zas nor longs spyod kyi gter kha phye ba/byang phyogs hor dang yu gur nas khrims dang las kyi dpe blangs pa sogs kyi sgo nas rang gi stobs 'byor dang mnga' thang spel te mtha' bzhi dbang du bsdus te 'dzam gling gi phyed tsam gyi khyon kha lo bsgyur zhing chos srid kyis rgyal khams bde bar bkod do//de rjes dbon sras mang srong mang btsan dang / 'dus srong mang po rje/ khri lde gtsug ldan mes ag tshom/ khri srong lde btsan/ mu ne btsan po/ khri lde srong btsan sad na legs mjing yon/ mnga' bdag khri ral pa can bcas rim bzhin byung / mes ag tshom man chad rgyal rabs lnga la shin tu skyid pa'i gdung rabs lnga zhes grags/ de'i ring la chos srid dang dpal 'byor gang thad nas dar rgyas chen po byung zhing / lhag par du khri srong lde btsan gyi dus la rgya gar nas pa rnyi ta bi ma la mi tra dang / mkhan po bornyisatwa/ slob dpon padma 'byung gnas/ rgya nag gi ha shang ma hā ya na sogs paṇa grub mang po gdan drangs/ bai ro tsa na sogs bod kyi lo tsā ba mang bo bcas kyis sangs rgyas kyi bka' sde snod gsum bsgyur ba sogs dam pa'i chos gtso bor byas pa'i rig pa'i gnas rgya cher dar bar mdzad pa 'i skabs dang / mnga' bdag khri ral gyi dus la dzi na mi tra la sogs

bod kyi yig sngol dar tshul brjod pa'i gtam/ 803pa rgya gar gyi paṇḍi ta mang po gdan drangs te bod kyi lo tsā ba ska cog zhang gsum sogs kyis bka' dang bstan bcos 'gyur bcos dang / gsar bsgyur/ dkar chag 'god sgrig sogs skad gsar bcad kyis bcos te yig rnying gi da drag dang / gug kyed brtsegs 'dogs can rnams kyi 'a mtha'/ ma yig gi ya btags khag gcig sogs dor te da lta'i yig srol 'di lta bur gtan la phab pa'i skabs de gnyis la yi ge'i lag len dar rgyas che shos su byung zhing / rgyal po de dag gi mnga' dbang yang 'dzam gling gi gsum gnyis tsam la khyab par grags/de rjes glang dar ma rgyal sar slebs nas chos bsnubs te rab tu byung ba rnams rtags dang phral/ glegs bam rnams la la chu la bskyur/ la la me la bsregs/ la la gter bzhin du sbas byas te lo dgu bcu go brgyad kyi ring la dbus gtsang gnyis la chos kyi ming tsam yang med par gyur pa dang chabs cig yi ge 'bri klog gi lag len yang nyams dmas shin tu che ba byung ste bod du yig srol thog mar btod pa nas bzung gra shod gnyis kyi bar du dar rgyas byung ba de la snga dar zhes pa dang / rgyal po glang dar mas bstan pa bsnubs rjes yi ge nyams dmas chen po byung zhing / mkhan po sgro gnya' khri zhes pas snga ma'i yig rigs la brtags te gra shod gnyis kyi lugs su bris spyang ji bzhin ma byung ba de la bar dar zhes dang / de rjes lo chen shes rab dbang phyug man chad la slar yang dar rgyas byung ba de la phyi dar zhis pa bcas rim par byung tshul zhig 'dug pa 'di'i yig cha zhib gsal zhig ma rnyed kyang / gang ltar srong btsan sgam po'i dus su gsar du dar ba

804 rdo rje rgyal po'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/nas khri ral pa can bar gyi dar rgyas byung ba dang / glang dar mas bstan pa bsnubs rjes yig srol nyams pa/ bstan pa phyi dar gyi 'go tshugs te lo tsā ba rin chen bzang po sogs kyi dus nas bshad sgrub kyi bstan pa slar yang dar te rgyal ba'i bka' mdo rgyud dang / gnas lnga rig pa'i gzhung lugs/ lo paṇa rnams kyi lung man ngag gi bstan bcos sogs je rgyas je mang du song ba'i lo rgyus la bsams na gong du bshad pa ltar yi ge la'ang snga dar dang / bar dar/ phyi dar rnams byung bar bshad chog cing / da lta bar de'i mu mthud pa zhig yin lags/mdor bsdus na da lta bod 'di deng rabs kyi tshan rig dang bzo las kyi lag rtsal thad nas rjes su lus pa tsam ma gtogs de byings chos lugs dang / sgra tshad/ bzo gso/ snyan ngag mngon brjod/ sdeb sbyor/zlos gar/ skar rtsis bcas rig gnas kyi gzhi gang gi thad la'ang mi rigs rang nyid kyi rig gnas rang thag rang gcod thub pa zhig yod pa 'di ni chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po'i thugs bskyed dang / blon po thon mi sam bho ṭa'i 'bad rtsol gyi bka' drin gyis mi rigs rang nyid kyi yi ge dar ba de rang las byung ba yin par ngos 'dzin zab mo dang / 'byung 'gyur yang mi rigs rang nyid kyi yi ge med na bod mi rigs ril po 'di slar yang rmongs pa'i mun gling du 'phyan rgyu las ma 'das pa'i ngos 'dzin zab mo dang 'bril ljongs 'di'i bde rtsar 'khur bsam ldan pa'i skye bo spyi dang / lhag par du blo gros kyi 'dab brgya gsar du bzhad bzhin pa'i gzhon nu rnams kyis yi ge 'bri klog la byang chub par byas pa'i cha rkyen 'og thun mong dang thun mong ma

yin pa'i shes bya spyi dang bye brag gang la'ang dka' ba khyad bsad kyis sbyangs nas rang rgyal gyi deng rabs can bzhi mngon du 'gyur ba'i dgos pa dang mthun pa zhig nges par du mdzad par 'tshal// smo

806yi ge dag po zhig yong ba byed bsam na thog mar yi ge klog stangs kyi sgra dag po zhig dgos/ chode yang yi ge dag po zhig yong ba byed bsam na thog mar yi ge klog stangs kyi sgra dag po zhig dgos/ de skor la si tu'i 'grel chen du‘‘gsum pa bslab tshul gyi go rim la 'doms pa ni/ bslab la brtson pa'i gang zag gis/ /dang por nga ro rnams la sbyang/ /sngon 'jug ming gzhi rjes 'jug gsum/ /klog gi ched du bsla/ri / pa yin/ /rjes 'jug bzhi yi sbyor ba ni/ /mnyan bsam bstan pa'i do na du sbyar/ /yan lag de dag mthu yis ni/ /'bras bu'i ched du don la dbab/ /bslab pa'i rim pa 'di yis ni/ /gang zhig 'bad pa chung ngus kyang / /shes rab myur du grol bar 'gyur/ /de phyir dang por 'di nyid bslab/ /de nas rgyas pa'ang mnyan byas te/ /bslab pa gang la dad pa yi/ /gzhung nyid bla ma lkortsom yig 'di ni rtsom pa pos krung dbyang mi rigs slob grwa chen po dang nub byang mi rigs slob grwa chen po'i bogayig 'dzin grwa'i slob ma tshor〈〈yi ge 'a jug pa'i gnad brgyad bshad pa〉〉zhes pa'i slob tshan khrid dus zur khrid gnang ba'i le'u zhig yin zhing /〈〈yi ge 'jug pa'i gnad brgyad bshad pa〉〉tshe/sa bya ba deb 'di'i nang 'khod pa'i〈〈sum rtags kyi dka' gnad 'ga' zhig brjod pa〉〉nes par gsal/

yi ge dag po pong ba la thog mar sgra dag po rnag dgos/ 807dag las mnyan/ / zhes pa'i bstan te/ rig pa'i tshul gang zhig bslab par bya ba la brtson pas 'jug par byed pa'i gang zag las dang po ba des ni thog ma nyid du nga ro zhes bya ba yi ge rkyang pa rnams rang rang gi skye gnas dang mthun pa dang / dbyangs ldan rnams kyang so so'i nga ro dbyung tshul bcas yi ge re re nas klog pa'i sgra gdangs la sbyar bar bya zhing / de nas sngon 'jug lnga dang / 'phul rten gyi 'jug yul ming gzhi sum cu dang rjes 'jug bcu ste/ de gsum ci rigs pa tsheg bar gcig tu sbyor ba'i tshul yang klog legs par shes pa'i ched du bslab par bya ba yin pa dang / klog la byang nas rjes 'jug ste der sngon 'jug kyang 'dus pas de dag rtags 'jug nas bshad pa ltar sgra don gang la 'jug pa/ yi ge gang gis 'jug pa/ tshul ji ltar 'jug pa/ dgos pa ci'i phyir 'jug pa ste/ rnam pa bzhi'i sbyor ba rnams ni/ rang la slob cing 'doms par byed pa po bla ma sogs las legs par bshad pa mnyan pa dang / nyan pa de'i don rang nyid gyis tshul bzhin du bsam pa dang / don de rang nyid kyis khong du chud nas gzhan la bstan pa rnams kyi don du sbyar te mkhas par bslab par bya'o/ /klog dang brda dag gi yan lag de gnyis kyi mthus ni gang bslab par bya ba de shes pa'i 'bras bu thob par bya ba'i slad du don la dbab nas nyams su bstar bar bya'o/ /de ltar bslab pa'i rim pa 'dis ni skyes bu gang zhig thos bsam la brtson 'grus chen po dang ldan pa rnams smos ci dgos te/ 'bad pa chung ngu tsam byas pas kyang tshig don la rmongs pa med pa'i shes rab myur du grol bar 'gyur ro/ /rgyu mtshan de'i phyir mkhas

808 rdo rje rgyal po'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/par 'dod pa rnams kyis thog mar sum cu pa'i gzhung 'di nyid bslab par bya zhing 'di shes nas rtags 'jug la sogs pa 'di'i skabs phyi ma rnams dang / de nas brda sprod pa'i gzhung rgyas pa gzhan dang gzhan rnams kyang mnyan par byas nas khong du chud pa na/ bslab pa gang la dad cing slob par 'dod pa de'i gzhung lugs yan lag dang bcas pa nyid dge rgan rnams las mnyan par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa 'di yang shes dgos pa gnad che bas zhar byung du bkod pa lags so/ / / /

mo tshad ma'i 'byung khungs/ rgoblo wargyu gang las byung / rkyen gang gis grub/ngo bo gang zhig yin/tshad ma rig pa zhes pa ni rang gzhan skye bo kun gyi tshig don 'khrul pa rnamyori/sa/ dgag bzhag spang gsum gyi sgo nas tshar gcod dam sel ba'i sgo nas dngos po rnams kyi ngo bo'am don dngos gtan la 'bebs pa'i rig gnas shig yin cing / 'dzam gling thog gi sa khul dang / mi rigs/ chos lugs grub mtha' bcas 'dra dang mi 'dra mtha' dag gis gna' rabs dang deng rabs gang du'ang gal chen por 'dzin pa'i thun mong ba'i rig gnas khyad du 'phags pa zhig kyang yin/ de'ang thog mar rgya gar du tshad ma rig pa zhes pa dang / rgya nag tu ming pen zhes rtsod pa'i rig pa dang /ma'o gling gi zhi la rgyal khab tu la'o ci zhes gtan tshigs rig pa bcas tha snyad mi 'dra ba gsum gyi thog nas dar ba ltar bod kyi tshad ma rig pa 'di'ang bod kyi btsan po mes dbon rnam gsum gyi dus skabs nas bzung chortsom yig 'di ni rtsom pa pos mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis bskrun pa'i〈〈tshad ma rig pa'i skor rgya gzhung rtsa 'grel bdam bsgrigs〉〉zhes pa'i dpe tshogs zhes bya ba la ji pa'i 'go brjod yin/

skye10 rdo rje rgyal po'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/lo paṇa rnams kyis rgya gar nas drangs pa zhig red/ de'ang yul/ dus/gang zag bcas mi 'dra ba'i dgos pa'i dbang gis gzhung lugs rgyas bsdus dang / 'chad tshul mi 'dra ba ji snyed cig mchis shing / lhag par du cha pa chos kyi seng ges bod rang lugs kyi tshad ma rig pa'i gzhung lugs bsdus gra'i rnam gzhag gsar gtod mdzad pa nas bzung 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gang thad nas dar rgyas ches che ba byung yod pa don dngos su gsal mthong ltar red/ 'on kyang cha pa chos seng rang gis mdzad pa'i bsdus gzhung de da phan lag son mig mthong ma byung / de'i dgongs don ltar bsgrigs pa bse ngag dbang bkra shis kyis mdzad pa'i〈〈tshad mari dgongs 'grel bstan bcos chen po rnam 'grel gyi don gcig tu dril ba blo rab 'bring tha gsum du ston pa legs bshad chen po mkhas pa'i mgul rgyan skal bzang re ba skong ba zhes bya ba〉〉yi nang du gang zag rnams kyi blo dang 'tshams par 'jug bde ba'i ched du thog mar bsdus chung ste dbyibs dang kha dog sogasabyukyi rnam gzhag dang / yod rtogs med rtogs kyi rnam gzhag yin log min log gi rnam gzhag ldog pa ngos 'dzin gyi rnam gzhag gcig dang tha dad kyi rnam gzhag rgyu 'bras chung ngu'i rnam gzhag yurme dang yul can gyi rnam gzhag spyi dang bye brag gi rnam gzhag bcas bsdus tshan brgyad dang /de nas 'gal 'brel gyi rnam gzhag dang / mtshan mtshon gyi rnam gzhagacha pa'i lugs kyi rdzas ldog gi rnam gzhag rang lugs kyi rdzas ldog gi rnam gzhag khyab mtha' 'god tshul gyi rnam gzhag stab pa sgo brgyad kyi rnam gzhag khas len song tshul gyi rnam gzhag bcas bsdus tshan bdun dang /

tshad ma'i 'byung khungs/ 811de nas drug sgra'i rnam gzhag dang / thal 'gyur chung ngu'i rnam gzhag dus gsum gyi rnam gzhag rang mtshan spyi mtshan gyi rnam gzhag sel 'jug dang sgrub 'jug gi rnam gzhag rigs brjod dang tshogs brjod kyi rnam gzhagadagag sgrub kyi rnam gzhag gzhan sel gyi rnam gzhag 'gal 'brel che ba'i rnam gzhag thal 'gyur che ba'i rnam gzhag rgyu 'bras che ba'i rnamagazhag bcas bsdus tshan bcu gcig rnams te khyon bsdoms le tshan nyi shu rtsa drug nang gses dang bcas/ pa dang / mkhas grub dge legs dpal bzang gis mdzad pa'i〈〈tshad ma sde bdun gyi rgyan yid kyi mun sel〉〉zhes pa'i nang du rtsa ba'i sa bcad shes bya yul gyi rnam gzhag dang / shes byed blo'i rnam gzhag shes pa yul la ji ltar 'jug pa'i tshul gyi rnam gzhag bcas gsum du phye zhing / rtsa ba'i sa bcad dang po shes bya yul gyi rnam gzhag la spyir rnam grangs bshad pa dang / mtshan nyid bshad pa/ dbye ba bshad pa gsum dang / bye brag mngon 'gyur dang lkog 'gyur bshad pa dang / rang mtshan dang spyi mtshan bshad pa/ rang gi mtshan nyid gtan la dbab pa/ spyi'i mtshan nyid gtan la dbab pa/ ngo bo'i sgo nas dbye ba/ yul can 'dzin tshul sogs kyi sgo nas dbye ba bcas drug dang /rtsa ba'i sa bcad gnyis pa shes par byed pa blo'i rnam gzhag la dang po tshad min gyi blo bshad pa la rtog pa bshad pa dang / rtog med log shes bshad pa/ gnyis pa tshad ma'i blo bshad pa la/ 1 tshad ma'i blo'i mtshan nyid bshad pa/ 3 tshad ma'i dbye ba bshad pa/ gsum pa mngon sum tshad ma bshad pa la nang gses dbang po'i mngon sum tshad ma

—rsha812 rdo rje rgyal po'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/bshad pa/ mdo sde pa'i lugs kyi rkyen gsum rnam par gzhag pa/ rnam rig pa'i lugs kyi rkyen gsum rnam par gzhag pa/ yid kyi mngon sum tshad ma bshad pa/ rang rig mngon sum tshad ma bshad pa/ rnal 'byor mngon sum tshad ma bshad pa/ tshad ma'i 'bras bu rnam par gzhag pa/bzhi pa rjes dpag tshad ma bshad pa la/ 1 rang don rjes dpag bshad pa/ 1 gzhan don rjes dpag bshad pa/ kā gzhan don rjes dpag dngos bshad pa/ nang gses chos mthun dang chos mi mthun gyi sgrub ngag gnyis/ yan lag gcig kho na can gyi sgrub ngag yang dag yod med dpyad pa/ bhe gzhan don rjes dpag dngos su bstan bya gtan tshigs bshad pa/ nang gses gtan tshigs yang dag bshad pa dang / tshul gsum so so'i ngos bzung zhing 'gal mi 'gal dpyad pa/ bltos gzhi gsum ngos bzung zhing chos can gzhi ma grub pa'i rtags yang dag yod med dpyad pa/ rgol pa gang gi ngor rtags yang dag yin min dpyad pa/rtags yang dag gi rtags chos don gsum ngos bzung ba bcas dang / lnga pa rtags yang dag gi dbye ba bshad pa la 'bras bu'i rtags yang dag bshad pa dang / rang bzhin gyi rtags yang dag bshad pa/ ma dmigs pa'i rtags yang dag bshad pa/ drug pa rtags yang dag gi sgrub bya'i sgo nas dbye ba la dngos po stobs zhugs kyi rtags yang dag bshad pa dang / yid ches kyi rtags yang dag bshad pa/ grags pa'i rtags yang dag bshad pa/bdun pa rtags yang dag sgrub tshul gyi sgo nas dbye ba la don sgrub kyi rtags yang dag bshad pa dang / tha snyad sgrub kyi rtags yang dag bshad pa/

da ma'i 'byung khungs/ 813brgyad pa ldog phyogs kyi gtan tshigs ltar snang bshad pa la ma grub pa'i rtags bshad pa dang / 'gal ba'i rtags bshad pa/ ma nges pa'i rtags bshad pa/ dgu pa gzhan don rjes dpag gi shugs kyi bstan bya bsgrub bya bshad pa la rang don gyi rtags yang dag gi bsgrub bya bshad pa dang /gzhan don gyi rtags yang dag gi bsgrub bya bshad pa gnyis/ bcu ba sgrub ngag gi lam sbyong bshad pa la sun 'byin bshad pa/ thal 'gyur gyi lan gdab tshul bshad pa dang / zhar la 'ongs pa'i don dpyad pa gnyis bcas dang /rtsa ba'i sa bcad gsum pa shes pa yul la ji ltar 'jug tshul bshad pa la/ 1 dgag pa dang sgrub pa bshad pa dang / 1 'gal ba dang 'brel pa bshad pa/ 3 brjod bya dang rjod byed gtan la dbab pa/4 spyi dang bye brag bshad pa/ ྾ sgrub pa dang gzhan sel bshad pa/smo rdzas dang ldog pa bshad pa/ 7 gcig dang tha dad bshad pa/8 mtshan mtshon bshad pa/ 9 dus gsum bshad pa bcas dgur dbye nas bstan pa rnams khong du chub na shes bya'i gnas gang dang gang gi thad la'ang smag rum nang du sgron me bteg pa lta bu zhig yong rgyur brten gong du gsal ba'i tshad gzhung gnyis par bskrun gyis 'grems spel zhus zin/'on kyang / shes rig gang zhig yin rung spyi tshogs 'phel rgyas kyi chos nyid dang bstun nas dar spel byed dgos pa zhig yin pas sngar yod da ma rig pa de deng rabs spyi tshogs kyi shes rig spyi'i dar rgyas kyi bab

814 rdo rje rgyal po'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/dang mthun pa zhig tu yar rgyas gong 'phel gtong snyam na rig gnas de'i rtsa ba'i 'byung khungs dang / spyi tshogs dus rabs gang zhig la mkhas pa su zhig gis ji ltar bstan yod sogs mtha' gsal mthil mthong yong ched du thog mar rgya gar du tshad ma'i rig par tha snyad btags pa ni sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi bshad srol la 'jam dpal gyis dgra bcom pa chos skyob la gsungs/ des tshad ma'i bstan bcos smra ba'i sgrom zhes pa mdzad/ des mkhas pa mi dbang lha la bshad/ des dbyig gnyen la bstan/ des tshad ma rang las mkhas pa phyogs kyi glang po la bshad pa sogs kyi lo rgyus yod pa/ rgya gar du dar ba'i tshad ma'i skor bstan 'gyur nang du bsdus pa po ti nyi shu tsam yod pa rnams kyi nang nas tshad ma rig pa'i thog ma'i 'byung rtsa'am khungs gtug sa grags che ba rgya gar gyi slob dpon phyogs kyi glang pos mdzad pa'i tshad ma kun las btus pa'i rtsa 'grel dang / dpal chos kyi grags pas mdzad pa'i tshad ma sde bdun rtsa 'grel sogs bdam bsgrig byas shing / de yang phyogs glang gi kun las btus pa'i nang du mngon sum gyi le'u dang / rang don rjes dpag gi le'u/ gzhan don rjes dpag gi le'u/dpe dang dpe ltar snang ba brtag pa'i le'u/ gzhan sel brtag pa'i le'u/ltag chod brtag pa'i le'u bcas drug tu phye zhing / chos grags kyis rgyas pa'i bstan bcos tshad ma rnam 'grel nang du rang don rjes su dpag pa'i le'u dang / tshad ma grub pa zhes bya ba'i le'u/ mngon— sum gyi le'u/gzhan don gyi tshig le'ur byas pa zhes bcas bzhi dang / 'bring ba rnam par nges pa la mngon sum gtan dbab pa la 'jug pa'i le'u dang / rang

tshad ma'i 'byung khungs/ 815gi don gyi rjes su dpag par rnam par nges pa'i le'u/ gzhan don rjes su dpag pa'i le'u bcas gsum/ bsdus pa rig pa'i thigs par mngon sum gyi le'u dang / bdag gi rjes su dpag pa'i le'u/ gzhan gyi don rjes su dpag pa'i le'u bcas gsum so sor phye zhing / rtags bye brag tu ston pa gtan tshigs thigs pa dang / mu stegs kyi btags pa'i 'brel pa 'gog pa 'brel pa brtag pa/ snang ba sems yin kyang gzhan rgyud 'thad pa rgyud gzhan grub pa/ rtsod tshul ston pa rtsod pa'i rig pa bcas te gyes pa yan lag gi bstan bcos bzhi bcas sde bdun du phye nas bstan yod pa de dag rnams dang / gzhan yang ljongs 'dir nyi zla ltar yongs su grags pa'i skyes chen dam pa sa paṇa kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i tshad ma rig gter zhes bya ba yul brtag pa dang / blo brtag pa/ spyi dang bye brag brtag pa/ sgrub pa dang gzhan sel brtag pa/ brjod bya dang rjod byed brtag pa/ 'brel pa brtag pa/ 'gal ba brtag pa/ mtshan nyid brtag pa/ mngon sum brtag pa/ rang don rjes dpag brtag pa/ gzhan don rjes dpag brtag pa bcas le tshan bcu gcig tu phye nas bstan pa rtsa 'grel dang / mkhas grub dge legs dpal bzang gis mdzad pa'i rnam 'grel gyi sgyig chen rig pa'i rgya mtsho stod cha smad cha deb gnyis/ rgyal tshab dar ma rin gyis mdzad pa'i tshad ma rnam nges kyi ṭig chen dgongs pa rab gsal stod cha dang smad cha deb gnyis dang / rnam 'grel gyi tshig le'ur byas pa thar lam phyin ci ma log pa gsal bar byed pa dang / rigs pa'i thigs pa'i 'grel pa legs bshad snying po'i gter sogs rim bzhin par skrun

816 rdo rje rgyal po'i gsung rtsom snyogs bskregs/dang 'brel 'grems spel zhu rgyu yin cing / de'i dmigs yul ni mkhyen rab mkha' ltar yangs pa rnams kyis gzigs sbyong dang / 'chad spel/mtha' dpyod/ phyogs sdom bcas kyi sgo nas gong 'phel btang ste snga rabs kyi 'chad tshul dang spyod yul de dag las brgal te deng rabs can bzhi'i 'dzugs skrun gyi tshan rig shes bya spel thabs su bsgyur nas skye bo mtha' dag gi blo gros spel byed dam bsam pa'i dpal yon dar 'phel yong ba'i dgos pa khyad par can de'i ched du yin lags na gzigs pa po rnams kyi de don thugs la bcangs te mdzad phyogs lhur bzhes thog gus tsho'i dpe skrun zhu phyogs skor la'ang legs spel nyes 'gog gi dgongs 'char lhug por stsol gnang yong ba bcas zab dbyings mu rol ba zhu/ /

817sngog 'don byed rin che ba'i bang mdzod/'di ga krung go'i bod kyi shes rig zhib 'jug lte gnas kyi khongs gtogs krung go'i bod kyi shes rig dpe skrun khang gis bod ljongs yongs khyab tu grags pa'i rig gnas che chung bcu dang / lo rgyus/ chos 'byung /rtogs brjod sogs deng skabs kyi dgos mkhor gzhigs pa'i slob sbyong dang / lag len/ dpyad gzhi bcas kyi skor la bod rang nyid kyi mkhas pa sngon byung dang da yod rnams kyi gsung rtsom ji yod nang nas bdam bsgrigs kyi dpe tshogs〈〈gangs ljongs shes rig gi nying bcud〉〉ces pa 'grems spel byed pa'i nang gses su gtogs pa'i ‘skar rtsis’’zhes pa ni thog mar sngon gyi drang srong rnams kyis gza' dang rgyu skar gyi 'gros la brten nas dus kyi rnam gzhag dang bzang ngan gyi 'bras bu sogs ston pa'i rtsis brtsams shing drang srong rnga bong la sogs pas byas pa'i rgyun las 'chad pa'i bstan bcos phyi rol pa la mang du byung yod kyang / bar du kla klo'i ston pa bdun pa mun pa can sbrang rtsi'i blo gros kyis grub rtsis sbas te byed rtsis rkyang pa bstan pa gza' skar sogs mi rtogs par gyur/ de 'og me yos lo rigs rtsom yig 'di ni rtsom pa pos 'di ga dpe skrun khang gis bskrun pa'i〈〈gangs ljongs shes rig gi nying bcud〉〉ces pa las〈rtsis dpe phyogs bsgrigs〉〉zhes bya ba la bris pa'i 'go brjod yin/

818 rdo rje rgyal po'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/ldan rgyal dkas bsdus rgyud kyi dngos bstan byed rtsis phyag bzhes su mdzad de rtsis gzhi gsar du tshugs shing / de ni‘‘ston pas mdo rgyud rnams dang dus 'khor gyi/ /'jig cirten khams ler gsungs la bu dol dang / /khyad par rang byung rgyal bas rtsis bsdus mdzad/ /7ces pa ltar ston pa shākya thub pas phal po cher bsdus rtsis su grags pa dngarka / rgya che rol par rtsis la sbyangs pa las brtsams pa'i grangs kyi rtsis kyi rig pa sogs gsungs pa dang / khyad par du byang phyogs sham bha la'i chos rgyal bdun kyi dang po chos rgyal zla ba bzang pos/ ston par khyim spang ma dgos par nyams su blangs chog pa'i chos shig zhu zhes zhus pa ltar/ rgya gar lho phyogs dpal miri dang nye ba dpal ldan 'bras spungs mchod rten chen po'i drung du dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i chos 'khor bskor te 'jig rten khams le gsungs nga ra brten mkhas pa rnams kyis lag len ci rigs par brten nas ang ki'i rtags kyi ri mo 'bri ba dang / dbri bsnan bsgyur bgod bcas te yi ge'i yan lag lnga dang / don gza' dang tshes skar ma sbyor ba byed pa ste/ rtsisakyi yan lag lnga gza' lnga dang khyim longs spyod sgra gcan dus me nyi zla 'dzin pa bcas kyi rtsis kyi nyi ldog la sogs pa dang / dus sbyor zhag gsum gyi rnam par dbye ba de dag gi dge dang mi dge 'bras bu brtan pa ste/ de dag ston par byed pa'i bstan bcos phyi dus kyi 'khor lo'i 'grel ba rnams las byung ba sogs las gyes te bod du thog mar rab byung dang po'i me yos lo(103gyi)la dus 'khor rgyu 'grel dar zhing / de nas rim gyis 'phel rgyas byung ste bu ston rin chen grub dang / kun mkhyen do po bas dar spel

sngog 'don byed rin ba'i bang mdzod/ 819mdzad de phug pa byang bdag sogs kyi rang srol gtod/ phyis nas phug mtshur lugs gnyis su gyes pa ste/ mkhas dbang nor bzang rgya mtsho dang phug pa lhun grub rgya mtshos〈〈pad dkar zhal lung 〉〉brtsams shing / bsam rgyal ba sogs kyis spel bar phug lugs su grags pa dang / byang pa rigs ldan chen pos〈〈dus kyi 'khor lo'i tshul rang blo'i rnam dpyod kyis dpyad nas bkral ba〉〉dang / mtshur bu 'jam dbyangs chen po don grub 'od zer gyis〈〈rtsis kyi gzhung lugs chen po〉〉brtsams par dpa' bo gtsug lag phreng bas 'grel mdzad par mtshur lugs su grags pa de dag gi rgyun mthud nas sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtshos〈bai dkar〉〉dang / smin gling lo chen dharma shis 〈〈nyin byed snang ba〉〉mdzad pa sogs kyi rgyun las phug lugs grub rtsis dang rje dpon mkhas pa chen po nges legs bstan 'dzin gyis〈〈nyer mkho bum bzang 〉〉brtsams pa sogs las mtshur lugs grub rtsis zhes lugs srol tha dad pa gnyis dang / bsdus rgyud las dngos su bstan pa'i rtsis ni mu stegs byed kyi lugs dang yang mthun pas byed rtsis su grags pa bcas yod pa'i skor la sngon byon mkhas pa rnams kyis je rgyas je gsal du mdzad pa'i jis gzhung dang re'u mig man ngag sogs rgyas pa po ti longs pa dang bsdus pa shog ngos re zung las med pa yan chad brtsis na bgrang bar dka' ba zhig mchis kyang / rdo don snying po brtsi bya dus dang gzugs kyi tshad gnyis rtsi byed grangs kyis gzhal ba'i sgo nas phyi rol 'jig rten khams kyi dus bzhi'i 'pho 'gyur dang / nyi zla gza' skar gyi 'khor phyogs dang baspyod pa dal myur rtogs ched dang / de dag gi gnas tshul dpags pa'i

— 820 rdo rje rgyal po'i gsutha rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/ dge len skyon 'dor byed ched yin pa dang / de'ang sngon chad lo brgya stong mang po'i sngon la ji byung brjod thub ba dang / phyis 'byung lo brgya stong mang po'i rjes la ji yong ston thub pa gcig mthun tshan rig gi rang bzhin 'khrul med ldan pa ma shes su mi rung ba sha stag yin pas/ 'dzam gling spyi mthun gyi rig gnas shig yin par ma zad/ bod kyi sa mtho zhing grang ngar che bas/ nam bab dang bstun nas skye 'gro'i lus kyi 'phrod bsten byed dgos pa gal che ba dang / lhag par du zhing las so nam thad kyi lo tog 'debs skyong bya rgyu de/ dbyar zhag brgyad cu zhes dus thung ngu de'i thog tag tag 'khel ba zhig ma byung na/ ston 'bras lag tu mi lon pa dang / phyugs rigs rnams kyang nam bab ltar gnas spo 'tsho skyong nges can zhig ma byung na/ byugs rigs kyi sha shed dang skye 'phel la 'gal rkyen yong bas/zhing 'brog gi las rigs la skar rtsis de bas kyang dgos gal che ba dmigs bsal mthong chos su gyur par brten/ tang krung dbyang dang rgyal srid spyi khyab khang gis thugs 'khur che bzhes dang / bod ljongs sman rtsis khang sogs 'brel yod sde tshan khag gi rogs ram 'og 'di ga bod kyi shes rig zhib 'jug lte gnas kyis rtsis dbe mi rnyed pa dang / dkon pa'i dka' ngal sel te bya ba'i cha rkyen sgrub ched du 'gro gron dang las rnyog gang la'ang ma 'dzems par lcags par btab pa'i deb tu bsgrigs shing / ṭa/ de min rgya rtsis sam nag rtsis su grags pa rnams bcas rtsis dpe gang na ci yod deb rtags ka kha ga nga'i rim par bkod nas deb bcu tsam zhig 'grems spel bya rgyu yin/ lhag par skar rtsis kyi don smos ci/ tha na ang grangs gcig

sngoga'adonabyedarinacheba'ibasdodamadzod/ 821—nor 'khrul byung na'ang / rtsis gzhi 'khrugs 'gro ba'i nyen tshabs shin tu che bar brten/ sgrig zhus kyi las don la sgo kun nas mtha' gsal mthil mthong gi 'gan len gdeng 'khel bzhes thub pa'i mkhas dbang bla brang bkra shis 'khyil kye rdor grwa tshang gi rtsis ram pa dang / krung go'i bod brgyud mtho rim nang bstan slob gling gi bod brgyud nang bstan zhib 'jug khang gi rgyun ring zhib 'jug mkhan/ krung go'i bod kyi shes rig zhib 'jug lte gnas kyi las 'dzin pa bsam 'grub rgya mtsho dang / phyag rogs lha sa sman rtsis khang gi gnam rig skar rtsis zhib 'jug so yi so krang gzhon pa dang zhib 'jug pa gzhon pa ngag dbang bzang po dang rgan bsam grub rgya mtsho'i slob ma yum skyabs rgyal(nub byang mi rigs slob grwa chen mo'i slob ma)bcas ched du gdan zhus kyis nan bsher mdzad yod pas gzhung don dang / ming tshig yi ge gang thad la nor skyon med par cha 'jog yid ches 'pher ba zhig yin pas gzhung 'dir slob sbyong dang lag len bya rgyu'i don gnyer can rnams kyis 'bad brtson che bskyed kyis spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi bsam pa'i dpal yon dang dngos po'i dpal yon spel rgyu'i thog don 'khyol yong ba zhig mdzad dgos par ma zad/ sdon byon mkhas pa rnams kyi mjug mnan te zhib 'jug brtag dpyad nan tan gyi sgo nas 'phel rgyas btang ste rig gnas 'di rang yang deng rabs can du 'gyur ba zhig bya —dgos pa ste/ dper na/ sngon chad skar rtsis kyi ang grangs bsgyur bgod snon 'phri gang byed tshang ma sa ris la brten nas bya rgyu dka' ngal dang las 'gor gnyis che de las byed thabs gzhan med kyang / da lta glog gi rtsis
rgyag 'khor lo bed spyad nas brtsis na myur la nor 'khrul chung ba yong ba 'di lta bu zhig sgo kun nas yar rgyas gtong thabs kyang gzab nan yong ba bcas dgongs rol 'tshal/1988lo'i zla tshes la/

823ye shes lha mo dang mgar ba stobs rgyal/ da dbus gtsang dmangs khrod kyi gling /sngar bod kyi rgyal po glang dar ma zhes pa lha lung dpal gyi rdo rjes bsad rjes bod kyi rgyal rabs gong ma'i gdung brgyud kyis gcig gyur tu dbang sgyur ba'i rgyun chad de bod sil bur gnas pa'i skabs shig la/ lha sa'i skyid chu'i lho rgyud kyi bdag po sne'u dpon bsod nams rin chen nam/sne'u sde pa zhes pa 'khor 'bangs kyi 'don rgya che zhing / mnga' thang rgyas pa/ btsan shugs che ba/ me las rngabs tsha ba/ chu las rba drag pa/phyir rang dang 'dra ba'i sde dpon rnams la chags sdang che ba/ nang du 'khor 'bangs la mnar gcod che ba sogs mdor na sa steng 'dir nga las lhag pa su zhig med rlom par byed pa'i gdug rtsub can zhig yod pa red/de'i lcam skal bzang lha mo zhes pa snga mo nas 'das pas sras mo ye shes lha mo zhes pa rang lo bcu bdun tsam du son pa zhig las bu rgyud gzhan gang yang med pa red/ sras mo de lang tsho'i mtshar sdug gi cha yongs su rdzogs pa/ shes rab gsal ba/ khengs pa chung ba/ 'khor g.yog la chortsom yig 'di ni1959lor krung dbyang mi rigs slob grwar dmangs khrod kyi sgrung bsdu sgrig byed skabs dge rgan rgyal mtshan dpal 'byor gyis zhus pa'i sa bon ltar rtsomagyipa pos dbus gtsang khul gyi phal skad du bris pa zhig yin/

824 rdo je rgyal po'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/byams pa/ snying rje che ba/ rang gi mnga' khongs su gtogs so cog gi ma ltar gyur pa zhig yod pa red/gzhan yang sde pa de'i 'khor du gtogs pa phyag mdzod grags pa dang / gnyer pa rgya mtsho/ drung yig skal bzang dar rgyas/ las dpon bsod rdor sogs dpon la ngo bstod dang gus tshul mkhas pa/ mi ser thog dbang shed dang bza' bsnyad che ba yang mang po zhig yod pa red/ rje blon de dag gis mnga' 'bangs rnams bran du bkol zhing / khral dang bogs ma sogs khrag btsir brnag btsir byas pa'i longs spyod la ci dgar rol bzhin par 'tsho ba skyel gyi yod pa red/ de'i tshe rdzong de'i mi ser gras yin pa mgar ba nyi ma don grub ces pa 'das pa'i bza' zla dman bag gro zhes pa zhig dang / bu stobs rgyal zer ba zhig yod pa red/ ma bu de gnyis sdod gnas lha sa'i rgya 'bum sgang du yin kyang rnam kun sne'u dpon gyis ji ltar bka' bgo ba'i lcags bzo dang / las ka gzhan dag gang ci'i 'u lag rgyun ma chad par brgyugs nas sdod dgos pas rang khyim gyi 'tsho ba'i 'du 'god 'khoms pa bral ba zhig red/'on kyang bu stobs rgyal zer ba de lag rtsal mkhas pa zhig yin stabs ma bu gnyis kyi lho gos skyo po rang min zhing / bu kho rang yang dbang po yar dar la song gshis snang ba yangs shing / gzugs bzang ba/ sha mdog bkra ba/ gos dang lus chas kyang cha tshang tsam zhig yod pa red/lo gcig dpyid blo dang po shar ma thag tu sne'u dpon gyi las dpon

ye shes lha mo dang mgar ba stobs rgyas/ 825bsod rdor zer ba des dpon bsod nams rin chen gyi gzim chung du phyin nas/ ‘‘dpon po/ da so nam gyi las ka tshugs pa red/ der ma zad nga rang tsho las rgya che bas lcags bzo'i las ka mang po byed rgyur bsdad 'dugalha sa nas nga rang tsho'i mgar ba stobs rgyal bka' 'gugs gnang nas lcags bzo tshugs dgos pa 'dug’’ces zhus pa red/ de'i lan du bsod nams rin chen gyis‘‘de ga rang red/ khyod kyis bshad pa de dngos gnas red/ phyag mdzod 'dir bos shog’’bshad pa red/ bsod rdor gyis phyag mdzod skad btang nas dpon po'i gzim chung du slebs pa red/ dpon gyis‘‘wa ye/ phyag mdzod/ nga tsho'i 'dir lcags bzo byed rgyu mang po zhig 'dug sang nyin lha sa nas mgar ba stobs rgyal 'gugs mkhan bang chen zhig thongs/ da ga si lan btang na snya se ko se bshad nas lam sang slebs mi yong / bskul dam tsha thag chod cig thongs’’zhes bshad pa red/ phyag mdzod grags pas‘‘lags lags so/ da ga rang zhus chog byas na nga rang tshos lcags dang sol ba la sogs kyang gra sgrig byed dgos kyi red/ gnyer tshang du go bsdur byas chog’’ces zhus te gnyer tshang du phyin nas drung yig bskul dam 'bri ru bcug bang chen 'u lag cig shog ces bshad pa ltar pho gsar zla ba bkra shis zer ba de der bcar ba red/ phyag mdzod kyis‘‘wa ye/ zla ba bkra shis/ lha sar 'gro mkhan khyod yin nam/ g.ya'/bskul dam 'di mgar ba stobs rgyal la sprod/ khyod rang dang mnyam du sang nyin rang 'dir khrid shog a’’zhes batha/da/ khos lce 'dom pa gang tsam brnar nas‘‘lags lags so/ sang nyin snga po phyin chog pa’’zhes lag pa

826 rdo rje rgyal po'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/gnyis kyis yi ge blangs nas log phyin pa red/de'i sang nyin bang chen zla ba bkra shis rgya 'bum sgang du mgar ba stobs rgyal gyi khyim du slebs nas bskul dam de sprad de‘‘da lta shog’’ces bshad pa red/ stobs rgyal gyis‘‘da lta rang bcar chog zla ba bkra shis lags bzhugs gdan 'jags’’zhes bshad/ ma bag gros‘‘zla ba bkra shis lags phyag phebs byung / sku ngal ma byung ngam/ bzhugs gdan 'jags dang / ngas mchod chang gtsang ma zhig blangs yong’mizhes zer zhing / khyim mtshes chang ma'i nang nas chang ban chung gang blangs nas drangs/ de'i ring la stobs rgyal gyis lag cha sogs nyer chas rnams bsdogs nas 'gro gra bsgrigs/ a mas‘‘stobs rgyal/ da lcag tsam rgyug dpon pos bka' bkyon 'khel yong / phyag las de tsho zhabs phyi yag po zhus/ lhag par ngas mngag cha zhig brgyag rgyu yod/ 'jig rten gyi gtam dper/ pho gsar gar 'gro gar sdod du/ /gyod dang kha mchu'i chags sgo sdang / /rang sems rang gis ma mnan na/ /snying gcong bzo ba yud tsam yin/ /zhes zer ba ltar spyir na so gzhon pa zer mkhan de skyon mang bas mtho bla ma dpon po'i thugs dkrugs pa dang / dma' khral zla khral rogs la 'khon 'gras bzos pa mang bas de ltar byung na ga la 'grig lhag par rang sems rang gis mnan nas dman sa 'dzin ma thub na snying gcong khog tu mi 'chur ba dang / 'gyod pa rtas mi zin pa zhig bzo bar khyug tsame zhig yin pas gzab gzab gyis/ zla ba bkra shis lags/ kho la rogs ram gnang rogs gnang’’zhes bshad/ stobs rgyal dang zla ba bkra shis gnyis kas

yi shes lha mo dang mang/ra ba stobs rgyas/ 821‘‘a ma sems khral byed mi dgos/ 'phyugs mi yong’’zer nas phyin pa red/stobs rgyal dang zla ba bkra shis gnyis sne'u rdzong du slebs nas phyag mdzod khang du bcar bar phyag mdzod grags pas‘‘'o 'grig ga khyod gnyis lcag po slebs byung / stobs rgyal kho sdod sa mdzo ra shar gyi zur zhig tu bzos/ gnyer tshang nas chang rtsam zhig gsol ras zhus ’zhes bshad pa red/ kho gnyis kyis‘‘lags lags so’’zhes phyir yong ste mdzo ra shar du ko gdan zhig bting 'dug pa der stobs rgyal gyi lag cha dang lto phad rnams bzhag gnyer tshang nas chang rtsam zhu rgyu sogs zla ba bkra shis kyis rogs ram byas pa red/sang nyin de lcags dang / sol ba sogs dgos bya rnams gnyer tshang nas sprad/ lag g.yog las rogs su zla ba bkra shis dang / pa sangs zer ba gnyis btang ba red/ gnyer pa rgya mtshos‘‘wa ye/ stobs rgyal/ khyod rang la dgos pa'i rgyu cha dang / lag g.yog sogs tshang ma rtsis sprad tshar ba yin/ da res kyi bzo rgyu tshang ma gal chen po sha stag yin/gzab gzab ma byas na ske la mdzes pa'i rba dar med par rkub la tsha ba'i rta lcag 'khel yong zhes zer/ stobs rgyal gyis‘‘lags lags so/ lags lags so7zhes bshad/de nas bzung zhogs pa nam langs pa nas mtshan mo srod ma yol bar nyin re bzhin lcags bzo byas te bsdad/ nyin gsum par dpon po bsod nams rin chen gos chen li hang gi mtshal phyu ma zhig dang / 'ja' lham/

828 rdo rje rgyal po'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/rda mo bcas gyon/ lag tu phreng ba zhig 'khyer/ gzim dpon lhag pa don grub kyi lag tu nyi gdugs dang zhal dkar/ dpung par ling thang / zhal lta ma skal bzang sgrol mar gsol ja dang / zhal tog bcas bskur te mnyam khrid kyis zhabs skor la skyod zhor du stobs rgyal lcags bzo byed sa'i sge'u khung nas blta tsam byas te kho 'dir shog lab ces dpon gyi mdun du bkug pas stobs rgyal skrag pa dang 'tshab pa sprags te lag tu skam pa dang tho ba 'khyer 'khyer bar yar langs te lce 'dom gang tsam brnar/ sgyid pa gzhu ltar bkug mig sar phab nas bsdad par/ dpon bsod nams grags pas‘‘kwa lcams bzo lugs rgyug po 'dug gam/ las rjes ga 'dra yong gi 'dug nam dus gtugs tshar 'dug las gshogs gang che yong ba ma byas na 'thus mi yong’ zhes bshad par/ stobs rgyal gyis‘‘la la la/dpon po'i sku bsod dbang thang che drags par brten lugs mi rgyug pa rtsa ba nas mi 'dug zhabs phyi hur thag 'bad thag zhus chog pa ’zhes bshad pa red/ dpon pos‘‘'o 'grig 'dug lag g.yog tsho/ kho la chang yag po ster’’zhes bshad de 'gro grabs skabs sras mo ye shes lha mo dpon bsod nams grags pa'i rjes su 'brangs nas mgar tshang du 'dzul yong nas phar lta tshur lta thengs gcig byas rjes mgar ba stobs rgyal la lta skyor zhig byas/rang gi ske rags kyi zur lteb gnyis lag pas 'then tsam re byās te/ ka ba'i 'khris su gsar brdung byas pa'i khyem zhig yod pa de lag tu blangs nas ‘‘pā lags/ khyem 'di bzo lta yag po zhig byung 'dug lag par yang bde po zhe drags yod pa red/ khyem yag po 'di 'dra zhig byung na ngas kyang las

rlu shes lha rjo dang mgar ba stobs rgyas/ 829ka byed thub pa 'dug’ ces zer bar/ dpon bsod nams grags pas ‘‘thu'i/ phar zhog de tsho lag tu len ma dgos pa yag gi red’’zer bas bu mo cung zad ngo tsha ba'i tshul byas shing slar yang stobs rgyal la lta skyor zhig byas te dpon dang sras mo sogs phyir log pa red/ stobs rgyal ni dpon po yab sras gnyis ka phebs byung bsams pa zhig 'char zhing / skrag snang che thog dpon dang sras mo sogs kyis bshad gleng byas te sdod ring la yar langs mgo sgur nas yun ring tsam sdod dgos byung bas dpral ba dang mjing pa sogs nas rngul chu'i thigs pa gzegs pa zhig byung ba red/sras mo de gzim chung du log nas bsam blo 'khor bar mgar ba stobs rgyal zer ba 'di skye sa dman rung kho'i gzugs po'i stobs dang /gdong gi rnam pa/ shes rig bkra ba/ spyod tshul legs pa 'di lta bu ni/mi tshang phyug po'i bu nga yin zer mkhan la'ang med pa zhig 'dug snyam nas sems chags shing ci drag snyam pa zhig byung ba red/ de nas bzung sras mo ye shes lha mo mgar tshang du nyin rer thengs gsum tsam re lta bar 'gro zhing / stobs rgyal la gtam gleng 'dra byed bsams rung dngos su smra yang ma shes stabs lta tsam lta tsam byas te log 'gro ba red/ mgar ba stobs rgyal gyis da res nga'i las ka 'dir do dam nan po zhig byed kyi 'dug sras mo sku ngo ma nyin rer thengs gnyis gsum re phebs kyi 'dug pas gzab gzab ma byas na nyo bya gzed rgyu rang red bsams nas las ka hur thag byas nas sdod pa las/ sras mo'i gdong la lta tsam yang byed phod kyi med pa red/ sras mos kyang stobs rgyal gyi 'khris su phyin na zhed snang byed pa

830 rdo the rgyal po'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/dang / dka' ngal yong ba ha go nas bsam par/ a gsar zhag gsum rta la yod/ /rta de las sdug na sdug thabs med/ /zer ba ltar ngas kho la dga' nas phyin kyang / kho la mi phan par ma zad/ dka' ngal 'phar ma bzo gi 'dug da thabs gzhan zhig btang nas kha la zhim pa'i bza' btung 'dra ster/ rna bar snyan pa'i gtam 'dra bshad na dga' bsams nas rang gi zhal lta ma khra kog la chang zhim po dam be gang bskur te‘‘khra kog 'di stobs rgyal la sprod shog da dung bza' 'dod pa dang btung 'dod pa yod na sprad chog ga re dgos pa yod ces skad cha zhig kyang dris shog’’ces mngags te btang zhing / khra kog gis chang de stobs rgyal la sprad nas sras mos mngags pa'i lan rnams chad lhag med par sprad pa red/ kho'i bsam par mi rnams kyis sras mo 'di 'khor g.yog la byams po zhig yin zer ba de dngos 'brel red/ nga la chang gnang bar ma zad/ da dung gang dgos lan 'khyer shog gsungs pa bka' drin chen po red/ yin na'ang ngas ga re dgos tshad gnang rogs gnang ga la zhu nus bsams te/ ‘‘khra kog lags/ thugs rje che/ da lta zhu dgos gang yang med/ thugs rje che zhes bshad pa red/ khra kog gis sras mor stobs rgyal gyis zer ba ltar zhus pa red/ de ltar thengs kha shas byas kyang stobs rgyal gyi bsam par sras mo 'di 'khor g.yog la gzigs skyong mkhas po zhig red bsams pa tsam las gzhan pa snang ba ci yang ma byung ba red/yang sras mo'i sems la/ des kyang kho la bza' btung gi lta rtog cung zad sgrub pa las rang gi re ba smin pa'i nus pa gang yang thon gyi mi

ye shes lha mo dang mgar ba stobs rgyas/ 831'dug bsams pa red/ yang bsam blo zhig btang nas nga rang gis kho la bza' btung zhig skyel ba dang sbrags nas skad cha zhig gtong dgos bsams te ka ra dang / shing tog 'thum zhig khra kog gi lag tu bskur te mgar tshang du phyin nas 'thum de stobs rgyal la sprad de bshad par‘‘stobs rgyal/ 'di zo'o/ khyed la dka' ngal mi 'dug gam’’zhes bshad par/stobs rgyal yar langs te lag pa gnyis kyis 'thum de tshur blangs/ phyag 'bul zhig zhus te‘‘bka' drin che/ sras mo bka' drin can/ nga la dka' ngal gyi gnas tshul gang yang mi 'dug ’ces bshad pa red/ sras mos‘‘'o 'grig ga khyod rang dang lag g.yog tsho mthun po yod dam bshad par/ stobs rgyal gyis‘‘la yod/ nga tsho mthun po yod/ lhag par zla ba bkra shis lags dang / pa sangs lags gnyis kyis nga la rogs ram chen po gnang gi yod’ bshad pa red/ sras mo'i bsam par da 'grig gi 'dugastobs rgyal dang / lag g.yog 'di tsho mthun po yod na khra kog ni nga rang gi zhal lta ma red/ gtam gleng cung zad byas chog pa 'dug bsams te bshad par/ ‘‘stobs rgyal ngas khyod la skad cha zhig 'dri rgyu yod/ khyod kyis lan drang por e 'debs’’ces bshad par/ stobs rgyal zhed rtsag tsam byung ste5la/ la/ la drang po los zhu’’zer/ de nas sras mo ye shes lha mos 'dzum pa'i mdangs phyung tshigs sabacad pa'i dbyangs su dris par/‘‘spyir nya mo skye sa chu nang skyes/ /lus bde khyug chu bo'i nange du longs/ /blo chu la dga' 'chol sdug 'chol de/ /nya gser mig bskos thang smos ci dasgos/ /sgos lha sa snyid chu'i gtsang po 'di/ /yid gtad yul rab

832 rdo je rgyal po'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/ cig yin snyam mam/ /nam skam la 'don snyam blo dogs gnyis/ /khyed nya mo'i blo la ga re yod/ /spyir shwa ba skye sa ri la skyes/ /lus gru bzhi spang ri'i logs su longs/ /blo spang la dga' 'chol sdug 'chol de/ /shwa rwa bcu'i bskos thang smos ci dgos/ /sgos dge 'phel dbu rtse'i ri bo 'di/ /blo gtad yul rab cig yin snyam mam/ /nam mtha' la 'tshud snyam blo dogs gnyis/ /khyed shwa ba'i blo la ga re yod/ /spyir sbrang chung ldum ra'i nang du skyes/ /lus nag chung ze'u 'bru'i khrod du longs/ /blo sdum rar dga' 'chol sdug 'chol de/ /rkang drug pa'i bskos thang smos ci dgos/ /sgos lo 'dab rgyas pa'i pad ma 'di/ /blo gtad yul rab cig yin snyam mam/ /nam 'dab brgya zum snyam blo dogs gnyis/ /khyed bung ba'i blo la ga re yod/ /mgar stobs rgyal skye sa sne 'ur skyes/ /lus 'dom gang rdzong gi nang du longs/ /blo dpon la dga' 'chol sdug 'chol de/ /bu stobs rgyal bskos thang smos ci dgos/ /sgos bu mo ye shes lha mo nga / /blo gtad yul rab cig yin snyam mam/ /nam khro la cha med blo dogs gnyis/ /khyed stobs rgyal blo la ga re yod/ /’ ces bshad par/ stobs rgyal gyi bsam par/ a'o/ sras mo 'dis ga re 'dri ba red/ da ci drag ngas lan yag po zhig ni 'debs mi shes/ gal srid shod stangs nor na ni kha sang a mas‘‘bla ma dpon po'i dgongs pa dkrugs yong’’zer ba de yong rgyu rang red bsams nas dbugasbra ring shor zhing / dpral ba nas jul nag 'phyur bzhin par yud tsam lus par/grwas mos‘‘stobs rgyal/ khyod lha ma byed/ ngas dris pa'i gtam der

rlu shes lha mo dang mgar stobs rgyas/ 833dogs pa byed dgos don gang yang med/ lan drang po zhig rgyob dang’’zer/ stobag rgyal gyi bsam par/ g.ya'/ da lan ma brgyab par kha rog bsgrud nee sras mo dgongs pa 'khrugs pa thag chod/ gal srid dgongs pa 'khrugs na yab la zhu gi red/ de ltar zhus na yab ha cang bka' gnyan po zhig red bsams nas yar langs te lag pa gnyis thal mo sbyar zhing /ngag 'dar sil sil gyi ngang nas‘‘sras mo yid bzhin nor bu/ nga shes rgya chung / sbyangs pa zhan pas bka' lan 'bul mi sprobs kyang / nga tsho 'khor 'bangs la ma ltar brtse ba'i bka' drin can khyed lha dgongs 'khrugs dogs su zol med kyi gtam tshig gsum zhus chog par gal srid nor 'khrul byung na bka' bkyon mi 'byung ba mkhyen ’zhes tshigs su bcad de bshad par/‘‘nya chu nang skyes pa sngon las red/ /blo chab la 'chol ba kun srol red/ /chab chu bo'i 'tsho skyong zhan rabs med/ /nya gser mig blo gtad ci la 'gyur/ /sgos lha sa skyid chu'i gtsang chen 'di/ /chu bzang po yan lag brgyad ldan yin/ /nya lto dkar 'tsho ba'i gnyen gcig der/ /blo log pa'i dogs pa ci la 'char/ /shā ri la skyes pa sngon las red/ /blo spang la 'chol ba kun srol red/ /rtswa bcud kyi 'tsho skyong zhan rabs med/ /shā rwa bcu blo gtad ci la 'gyur/ /sgos dge 'phel dbu rtse'i ri bo 'di/ /ri bzang po rtswa sna kun 'dzoms yin/ /shwa rwa bcu 'tsho ba'i gnyen gcig der/ /blo log pa'i dogs pa ci la 'char /musgang lham rar skyes pa sngon las red/ /blo ze'u 'brur 'chol ba kun srol

834 rdo rgyal po'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/red/ /zil mngar gyi 'tsho skyong zhan rabs med/ /sbrang rkang drug blo gtad ci la 'gyur/ /sgos lo 'dab rgyas pa'i pad ma 'di/ /bcud bzang po'i zil mngar kun 'dzoms yin/ /sprang rkang drug 'tsho ba'i gnyen gcig der/ /blo log pa'i dogs pa ci la 'char/ /nga sne 'ur skyes pa sngon las red/ /blo dpon la 'chol ba kun srol red/ /zas gos kyi 'tsho skyong zhan rabs med/ /nga stobs rgyal blo gtad ci la 'gyur/ /sgos sras mo ye shes lha mo khyed/ /byams snying rje can gyi dpon mo yin/ /nga stobs rgyal 'tsho ba'i mgon gcig der/ /blo log pa'i dogs pa ci la 'char mizhes bshad/ /sras mo'i bsam par khos ngas bshad pa'i skad cha de'i go don rtogs ma song / yin na'ang kho'i lan 'debs stangs yag thag chod 'dug kha 'bras legs par ma zad/ shes rig kyang ha cang bkra ba zhig red/ 'di nga'i grogs su byung na skye sa dman rung 'gyod pa med bsams nas zur mig gis lta zhing / 'dzum dmul ba'i sgo nas skad cha shod grabs yod skabs der yod lag g.yog zla ba barsha shis dang / zhal lta ma khra kog sogs tshang ma'i bsam par sras mo 'dis mi la nyams sad kyi bka' mol khyad mtshar zhig gsungs song yang / stobs rgyal gyis bshad pa'i skad cha de ni dngos genas drang gnas red/ sras mo 'dis nga tsho tshang mar byams skyong kho na las/ sdang ba'i bya ba dang / khros pa'i bka' bkyon tshig gcig gnang ma myong bas blo log pa dang / dogs pa skye dgos don ci yod bsams pa byung ༈bas kho tsho tshang mas mgrin gcig tu‘‘stobs rgyal gyis zhus pa de dngos

rlu shis lha bo dang mgar ba stobs rgyas/ 835gnas red/ kho'i skad cha de g.yo zol dang mdzes mtshon ma red’’ces zer/ lhag par zla ba bkra shis kyi bsam par/ stobs rgyal gyis bshad pa'i skad cha de ni dngos gnas red/ nga rang dang stobs rgyal gnyis blo nye sa zhig yin/ kha sang a ma bag gros kyang stobs rgyal la rogs ram byed rogs zhes mngags byung / da res kho'i skad cha'i rgyab gnon byas nas skad cha tshig kha shas bshad na sras mo dgongs pa dwangs ba yong rgyur brten kho la cung zad phan pa 'dug bsams nas‘‘sras mo sku zhabs/ stobs rgyal gyis zhus pa de dngos gnas red/ khos da lta kha nas zhus pa tsam du ma zad/ rnam kun gyi bya spyod kyi thog nas ra 'phrod 'phrod pa yin/ kho dpon zhen che ba dang / zhabs 'degs la lhag bsam dag pa ga 'dra zhig yin khos bzos pa'i ca lag 'di tshor gzigs na dgongs pa dwangs kyi red/ lhag par sras mo khyed rang gis gzigs skyong dang gsol ras gnang ba de dag gi bka' drin spyi bor 'khur gyi 'dug khos nga tshor sras mo 'di'i bka' drin 'khyer sa med/ nga rang tshos zhabs phyi hur thag byas nas zhu dgos zhes zer mus yin/ ma gzhi nas stobs rgyal la de ltar bka' 'dri juganang dgos don gang yin/ mi ngan gyis zhu log phul te thugs dogs shig 'khrungs pa ma red dam’’zhes bshad pa red/sras mo'i bsam par/ mngon shes med pa'i mi 'phung zer ba'i dpe ltar rang red/ kho tsho tshang mas nga'i bsam phugs ni ga la rtogs/ skad cha'i go ba yang lon ma song bsams shing / cung zad 'tsher ba'i tshul dang bcas te‘‘ma red/ ma red/ nga'i sems la dogs pa med/ nga'i bsam

skye36 rdo rngo rgyal po'i gsung rtsom tsags baspreg /tshul ni dris pa'i skad cha la drang po'i lan zhig e yong bsams pa yin/khyod tshos grib nag 'drer mthong mi rung / nga tsho mgo dang ske 'bral thabs med par sdod dgos pas da dung rjes su skad cha yong zhes bshad nas log phyin pa red/de nas mgar ba stobs rgyal dang / lag g.yog zla ba bkra shis sogs der yod rnams kyis sras mos sprad pa'i chang de mnyam du btung / rnam kun sras mo 'di skad cha nyung po zhig yin/ de ring gi bka' de ci yin nam/ gsung sgo rgyas la ya mtshan che ba zhig byung zhes sogs gleng mol mang tsam byas/ mthar chang gis bzi ste las ka yang ji bzhin mi thub stabs las mtshams kyang snga tsam bcad nas bsdad pa red/sang nyin snga dro phyag mdzod grags pa dang / drung yig sogs 'char can ltar yong nas bzo las zin pa rnams rtsis len dang / rgyu cha gsar pa rtsis sprod byed skabs rnam kun gyi las rjes dang bsdur na las rjes chung tsam yod par brten phyag mdzod grags pa'i bsam par/ rnam kun gyi las rjes la dpags na kha sang las ka yag po ma byas thag chod red/ mi 'ari tshor tsha zhing nan pa zhig ma byas na skyag langs la shor nas las ka je zhan je sdug tu btang yong / lhag par ngas las don la nan mdog kha tsam byas na dpon po'i snyan la 'khyol rgyur brten nga rang la gzigs pa che ru 'gro bar yang phan pa 'dug bsams nas‘‘wa ye/ stobs rgyal/ kha sang khyod tsho ga re byed kyi bsdad pa yin/ las rjes 'di las ston rgyu mi 'dug ga re byas pa red’’zer/

ye shes lha mo dang mgar ba stobs rgyas/ 831stobs rgyal skrag nas ci zer 'di zer med par/ ‘la dgongs dag la dgongs dag’’ces zer zhing mig hur hur du lus pa red/phyag mdzod kyis‘‘kwa khyi nyams sprang pos longs na rgyug pa 'phred la gzer ba'i dpe de ma red dam/ mtho dpon po nas dma' las dpon yan chod kyis mi shes pa med kyang lab ma dgos pa gtso bor bzung nas bsdad stabs kho tshos mi shes/ kho tshos ci yang zer mi thub bsams pa red/ khyod rang gis ma shes na las ka 'di ske mgo lus kyi bdag po'i zhabs phyi red/ ma 'a da da kyang zhu dgos par ma zad/ bong bu la nyal stangs bco brgyad yod na tshong par slong stangs bcu dgu yod pa red/las gang bskul dang / bkod pa gang shod de nga'i lag tu yod’’ces mig phar hrig dang tshur hrig byas te brdung la nye ba'i skabs su ye shes lha mo der 'byor zhing / sras mo 'khor g.yog la nyes brdung lta ci/ kha brdung tsam gtong du mi 'jug mkhan zhig yin stabs/ ‘‘phyag mdzod lags/ ga re byas song’’zhes bshad par/ phyag mdzod kyis‘‘gnas tshul rnams bsgrangs te mi 'di tshos rang dpon la sha zhen gtan nas byed kyi mi 'dug pas bkod pa sa 'khol ba zhig shod dgos pa 'dug’’zer/ sras mos‘‘dpon 'bangs tshe gang mnyam gshibs byed dgos pas nyin re zung las ka 'thus sgo tshang min yong srid cing / de tsam la lam seng nyes brdung gtong dgos don med/ da res g.yugs zhog’’ces dang / mgar ba stobs rgyal la kha bslogs nas mig 'dzum dang mchu brda zhig byas te/ ‘‘khyod tshos kyang da nas zhabs phyi hur thag zhus ’zhes bshad pas/ tshang mas‘‘lags lag sa

838 rdo rje rgyal po'i gsung rtsom ‘gas bsgrigs/so/ lags lags so’’zer/ phyag mdzod grags pa'ang kha rog ma bsdad thabs med byung ba red/sras mo ye shes lha mo ni nyin mtshan khor yug tu mgar ba stobs rgyal ma gtogs dran rgyu med kyang / de nyin gtam gleng ba'i 'khoms pa'ang ma rnyed par ma log thabs med byung ba red/ gzim chung du slebs nas thabs shig dran te sang nyin stobs rgyal nga'i gam du 'bod dgos pa 'dug snyam ste rang gi nyer mkhor 'os pa'i khrus gzhongs dang / sla nga / mthur ma/ gri'u sogs bzo rgyu'i lcags cha 'ga' zhig bsags te bzhag nang par dpon bsod nams rin chen dpon g.yog lha sar phyin/ phyag gnyer sogs lung pa'i phu mdar rang rang gi byed sgor thon zin ma thag sras mos ‘‘wa ye/ khra kog khyod song nas mgar ba stobs rgyal 'dir bos shog kho 'dir slebs na nga'i nyer mkho gal che ba kha shas bzo rgyu'i skor la skad cha kha shas 'dri rgyu yod pas khyod rang gis sbri gsang byas nas mi btang ma yong zhes bshad pa red/khra kog gis stobs rgyal bos te gzim chung du slebs mtshams mo rang sgo 'gag tu sras mo'i sku 'jug 'khrud pa ltar byas te bsdad pa red/ sras mos‘‘stobs rgyal/ nga la nye bar mkho ba'i lus 'dom gang shong ba'i khrus gzhongs dang / zas zhim po g.yo sa'i sla nga / sha tsho po chod pa'i gri chung sogs bzo rgyu 'ga' zhig yod pas nga'i bsam ltar zhig khyed kyis e bzosmo zhes dris par/ stobs rgyal gyis‘‘sras mos bka' gang gnang ltar zhabs phyi zhu gi yin’’zhes bshad par/ ‘‘'o na rgyu cha 'di dang 'di yin’ zhes

mi shes lha mo dang mgar ba stobs rgyas/ 83spreston pa'i tshul byas par/ ‘‘rgyu cha yag po 'dug bka' gnang ba ltar bzo rgyu'i mthun rkyen 'dzoms 'dug ces zhus/ sus mos‘‘byas na 'grig song / da dung gal che ba zhig 'dri rgyu yod/ khyed cung zhig lhod tsam byas nas sdod dang’ zhes bshad/stobs rgyal gyi bas/ma par yang kha sang nang zhin milan 'debs stangs mi shes shing / ma btab par 'jog thabs med pa zhig yong rgyu thag chod bsams kyang‘‘lags lags so’’zhes ka ba'i mdun der langs nas bsdad cing / sras mos gdan gyi thur du rkub stegs shig byas te bsdad/sras mo'i bsam par kha sang ngas skad cha dris pa thad kar ma bshad stabs khos go ba thebs ma song / de ring yang thad kar ma bshad na lan phyin ci lolha pa zhig las yong rgyu med pas da ngo tsha dang mdzes zol med par go ba'i gtam zhig bshad nas bsams pa'i don de 'grub pa zhig bya dgos bsams te/ phastobs rgyal/ kha sang ngas skad cha dris pa de'i do sgod kyis go ma song / de ring skad cha de'i gnad don gsed 'grol byas nas shod kyi yin/ dper na/phanya chu nang skyes pa sngon las dang / /blo chab la 'chol ba kun srol danyis/ /sbyir 'jig rten 'khor ba'i chos nyid red/ /tshul 'di la rang gnyis smreng dgos med/ /nya gtsang po'i chu rgyud ma bskor bar/ /dbus snyid chur gnas pa'i re ba yod/ /de e byed nya mo'i lag tu 'dug /chu 'di la kha gting gnyis su med/ /shwa ri la skyes pa sngon las dang / /blo spang la 'chol ba kun srol gnyis/ /snyir 'jig rten 'khor

840 rdo rje rgyal po'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/ba'i chos nyid red/ /tshul 'di la rang gnyis gleng dgos med/ /shwa ra bcu la klung ma myul bar/ /ri dbu rtser gnas pa'i re ba yod/ /de e byed shwa ba'i lag tukṣ-i 'dug /ri 'di la 'pho 'gyur gnyis su med/ /sbrang ldum rar skyes pa sngon las dang / /blo pad mar 'chol ba kun srol gnyis/ /spyir 'jig rten 'khor ba'i chos nyid red/ /tshul 'di la rang gnyis gleng dgos med/ /sbrang rkang drug 'phur lding ma byas par/ /tshal 'di la gnas pa'i re ba yod/ /de e byed sbrang bu'i lag tu 'dug /'dab brgya par g.yo 'gul gnyis su med/ /khyed sne 'ur skyes pa sngon las dang / /blo dpon la 'chol ba kun srol gnyis/ /spyir 'jig rten 'khor ba'i chos nyid red/ /tshul 'di la rang gnyis gleng dgos med/ /bu stobs rgyal grogs gzhan ma btsal bar/ /dman nga dang 'grogs pa'i re ba yod/ /de e byed khyed kyi lag tu 'dug /dman nga la kha zhe gnyis su med ces dang / /gzhan yang‘‘stobs rgyal/ 'jig rten gyi khams su pho re dang mo re 3ba dgos pa kun srol red/ nga bu mo lte/ shes lha mo la gtan grogs spyod dgos/ snying sdug byed dgos zer mkhan dbang dang rgyu yod pa'i bu mang po byung yang / rang gi blo la bab pa zhig yong ma myong la/su zhig la'ang gtam lan snyan pa zhig 'jal ba'am/ gdong dkar ba zhig ston pa tsam yang byed ma myong / khyed skye sa dman rung gshis rgyud bzang ba dang / rang gnyis dpon g.yog gshibs yun ring bas byas pa yin nam/tshe sngon milas shig gis ded pa ji ltar yin ni mi shes/ gang ltar nga'i bsam pa khyod la rtse gcig tu chags nas nyal ba'i rmi lam dang bcas pa'i

yi shis lha yo dang mgar ba stobs rgyas/ 841nyin mtshan dus drug tu nga'i mig lam nasdo/ skad cig tsam yang mi 'bral ba zhig yong 'dug par brten ngas che tshul dang / spam rdzu/ ngo tsha bcas yongs su dor nas khyod la lhug por bshad pa yin/ khyod kyis kyang rnam kun gyi gus gus zhum zhum dang / mkhas mkhas snyan snyan rnams dor nas nga'i re ba smin pa'i lan zhig rgyob dang ’zhes bshad pa red/stobs rgyal ha las shing / zhed drags nas skra rtsa nas tshag sgra dang /rna ba nas lding sgra sgrog pa'i snang ba 'char zhing / snying 'phar nas dbugs gnon mi thub pa zhig gi ngang nas bsams par/ g.ya'/ kha sang nang nas yong khar a mas zer ba de tag tag red/ skye sa rus khungs mtho zhing /gzugs dang kha dog mdzes pa/ gshis kha dang spyod tshul bzang po 'di lta bur nga blo mi mos pa ci la yong / gal te khong gi ya bteg pa'i las ka zhig byas na mi mgo la khyi lag brgyab pa zer ba de yong gi red/ de byung na dpon bsod nams rin chen gyi dgongs pa 'khrug pa zhig dang / sras mo khong rang la gtagā ngan sa la mi shong ba zheg nga rang sems ngal che la bka' chad bka' bkyonacho dngha'akhur dgos pa zhig bcas yong rgyu red/ da res ngas drin a ma'i bslab bya de snying du bcangs nas sras mo 'dir dge skyon gyi gsal 'debs shig zhus na gsan yong snyam ste pus mo sa la btsugs/ lag pa thal mo sbyar nas‘‘a tsi/ ske mgo lus kyi bdag po/ lto pho ba rgyong mkhan misbyin bdag bka' drin can lha sras ye shes lha mo lags/ khyed sku ri rab las mtho zhing / gsung rta rnga las phra ba'i dpe ltar nga mgar ba'i bu la bka' de lta bu gnang ga la nyan/ dpe zhig zhus na 'di lta bu red ces sras mo'i

842 rdo rje rgyal po'i gsung rtsom ‘gab bzigal gtam lan du tshigs su bcad de bshad par/‘‘ya gi'i gangs ri mthon po seng ge dkar mo'i gnas red/ /gangs la khyi rgan gnas pa'i lo rgyus ga nas yong ba/ /gal te gnas 'dug zer na ltas ngan min na gang yin/ /gangs ri dkar po'i zhabs 'dren sa la shong thabs ci yod/ /ma gi'i g.yu mtsho sngon mo me tog pad ma'i gnas red/ /mtsho la yo mo skyes pa'i lo rgyus ga nas yong ba/ /gal te skyes 'dug zer na ltas ngan min na gang yin/ /g.yu mtsho sngon mo'i zhabs 'dren sa la shong thabs ci yod/ /pha gi'i nor stod gling ga 'gros chen rta pho'i gnas red/ /gling gar rkyang rgan gnas pa'i lo rgyus ga nas yong ba/ /gal te gnas 'dug zer na ltas ngan min na gang yin/ /lcang gling phra mo'i zhabs 'dren sa la shong thabs ci yod/ /sne'u dpon gyi sras mo mi chen lcam gyi 'os red/ /sras mor mgar bas 'chang ba'i lo rgyus ga nas yong ba/ /gal te 'chang 'dug zer na ltas ngan min na gang yin/ /ye shes lha mo'i zhabs 'dren sa la shong thabs ci yod/ /mi’ces dang /yang bshad par‘‘sras mo/ sku bsod kyi bdag po khyed lta bur nga yid mi smon pa ci la yong / 'on kyang rang gi skye sa de rang gis ngos zin na khyed la lag pa 'chang rgyu phar zhog tha na mig che ba zhig kyang lta ga la phod/ de ni mi snyob rting pa bteg bteg byas na ting pa'i rtsa thag bcad yong zhes pa'i dpe de rang red/ lhag par sras mo khyed la cha mtshon na thob go sa 'di las mtho na mtho thabs med pa sde'u dpon gyi sras mo red/ nor longs spyod ni klu rgyal gyi bang mdzod lta bu yod/ sku mdzes sdug ni mi mi 'dra lha 'dra ba

rlu shes lha mo dang mgar ba stobs rgyas/ 843zhig red/ grogs su 'khugs re byed mkhan mi drag gi sras gcig min gnyis min yod pa de 'dra zhig dang gnyen phar sgrig tshur sgrig gang gnang rung 'jig rten gye lugs 'os shing rigs pa zhig red/ los ngan mgar ba'i bu nga lta bu'i mi kha zhig byung yang khyed mgo nag mi'i dkyil du zhal 'degs mi thub pa zhig yong rgyu ma gtogs med/ nga gnyis grogs dang mthun sdeb byas pa mis shes na ngas bla ma dpon po'i khrims myong dgos pa smos ci/ khyed rang gi mtshan shas dpe nag po sa steng du mi shong ba zhig 'jog rgyur brten bka' de lta bu mi gnang ba mkhyen’’zhes bshad pa red/sras mo ye shes lha mos‘‘stobs rgyal/ khyed rang gis bshad pa'i gtam de dag mi tshang mas rgyun du shod pa'i skad cha 'char can zhig red/ de ngas shes kyi red/ dge skyon dang khe nyen yang blor ma 'khor ba min/ lo dang zla ba bstud nas bsam blo btang ba yin/ spyir btang skye sa dang / longs spyod kyi thad nas bshad na khyed rang gis zer ba de rang red/ 'on kyang nga'i bsam blo ni spyir btang gi bsam blo 'khor stangs dang rtsa nas tha dad du phyin tshar 'dug gal te de ltar min na ngas khyed la gtam de lta bu shod kyang ga la shod/ gtam dper/pho rab cig la gtam bshad na/ /go shes nyan shes gnyis ka che/ /bsams don 'grub pa'i gtam lan 'debs/ /rang gzhan gnyis ka'i byus 'go thon/ / pho 'bring zhig la gtam bshad na/ /go shes chung yang nyan shes che/ /kha gsal go bde'i gtam lan 'debs/ /rang gzhan gnyis ka 'jug pa bde/ /pho tha zhig la gtam bshad na/ /go shes nyan

844 rdo rje rgyal po'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/shes gnyis ka med/ /nya nyung bsres pa'i gtam lan 'debs/ /rang gzhan gnyis ka'i 'gro sdod brlag /zer ba ltar ngas bshad pa'i gtam der lan ga 'dra zhig 'debs/ lag len ga 'dra zhig bstar/ khyed rang gis bsam blo yag po gtong dgos/ gal te da lta lam seng nga'i bsam pa ltar byed ces tshig thag gcod dka' ba yod na do nub bsam blo btang ste sang gnangs skad cha byas chog’’ces bshad par/ stobs rgyal gyis‘‘lags lags so/ lags lags so’’zhes zer bzhin par phyi 'gros su gom gsum spos shing / sras mo'i nyer mkho bzo byed kyi lcags lhob gnyis lag tu 'khyer te log phyin pa red/sras mo'i bsam par de ring tshig mtshams de tsam la ma bzhag na thabs med/ khong tsho dpon blon rnams kyang phyir 'khor grabs yod/legs nyes gang la thug kyang bya ba de mthar ma bskyal thabs med yin snyam ste bsdad pa red/stobs rgyal zhed pa dang dngangs pa lhan cig tu byung bas spu zing zhing rngul nag 'phyur 'phyur gyi ngang nas mgar tshang du slebs par brten bkra shis sogs lag g.yog tshos‘‘stobs rgyal/ yun ring 'gor byung / sras mos bka' bkyon phebs ma byung ngam/ ga re red/ rngul nag de tsho phar phyis’mizhes bshad pa red/ stobs rgyal gyis‘‘ma byung / bka' bkyon phebs ma byung / nga rang sngar dpon po'i gzim chung la bcar ma myong stabs zhed nas gom pa yang spo mi nus pa byung / des byas pa red’’ces bshad pas tshang ma gad mo theg theg pa zhig byung ba red/

yi shes lha bo dang mgar ba stobs rgyas/ 845de nas bzung stobs rgyal kho rang yang sras mo der gting nas dga' po zhig byung ste/ a tsi/ 'di dngos gnas red dam/ rmi lam red/ nga mgar ba'i bu la mi chen gyi sras mo 'di lta bu ga la thob srid/ gal te mngon sum yin na dga' ba la bsams/ yang bsam blo zhig btang ste rmi lam ma red/ da bar du sras mo 'dis nga la mnyes pa dang gsung gleng gnang ba de dag mngon sum rang yin/ yin na'ang mi srid pa'i bya ba 'di lta bu lag len du bstar thabs ci la yod bsams nas bsam blo gsor thag 'then 'then du 'khor bzhin par sdod dgos byung ba red/yang sras mo'i bsam par/ a tsi/ da ci drag nga la bsam rgyu ni stobs rgyal las mi 'dug nga gnyis skye sa mi 'dra bas kho dang gtam gleng yang byed dka' ba red/ gal te khos yi ge zhig shes kyi yod na yig thog nas 'phros gleng byas chog kyang / khos yi ge ga la shes/ 'on kyang tshod lta zhig byed dgos bsam nas sras mo rang gi nyer mkho bzo rgyu'i skor rnams kyi tho zhig bris par/ ‘‘lus 'dom gang shong ba'i khrus gzhongs bzo rgyur lcags rgya ma30 dang / rgyan pa ṭa'i rgyu char rag gan rgya ma 5/ zas zhim po g.yo sa'i sla nga bzo rgyur lcags rgya ma5sprad yod/ sha tsho po chod pa'i gri chung gi lcags ci 'dra zhig dgos’’zhes pa zhig bris te/ ‘‘khra kogakhyod rang tho 'di 'khyer nas mgar tshang du phyin te yi ge 'di'i nang du gsal ba de dag tag tag yin min lan 'khyer shog a'’’zhes bshad cing /sems kyi nang du mgar tshang nang du yod pa'i mi gzhan de tsho'i nang du yi ge shes mkhan med pas stobs rgyal gyis shes min lam seng ha go gi red

846 rdo rje rgyal po'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/bsams nas bsdad pa red/zhal lta ma khra kog gis yi ge de 'khyer nas mgar tshang du phyin te/ ‘‘wa ye/ kho tsho/ sra/me mos phyag tho 'di'i nang du 'khod pa de dag tag tag yin min lan 'khyer shog gsung gi 'dug’’ces bshad par/ bkra shis kyis‘‘nga tshos yi ge ga la shes/ sras mo mkhyen gsal red/ sku zhabs drung yig lags la gzigs rogs gnang zhus na dga' ’zer/ stobs rgyal gyis4ngas thabs chag klog shes kyi yod’’ces yi ger bltas nas/ ‘‘khra kog lags/ phyag tho nang gsal tag tag red/ phyag shan gyi rgyu cha ngar lcags rang dgos kyi red/ yin na'ang mang po mi dgos stabs gzhung rkyang gi lcags hrug legs pa zhig nas btang chog gi red ces zhus rogs gnang’’zhes bshad pa ltar khra kog gis sras mor zhus pa red/sras mo'i bsam par/ da 'grig song / ngas kho la ka bshad cig 'bri dgos pa 'dug bsams te bris par/‘‘ka ye nyon dang blo sems dkar zhing kha la nyan pa'i bu stobs rgyal/ /ga nas bsams kyang bcos su med pa nga gnyis las 'di ci 'dra red/ /ca co'i gtam gyi rdo don snying po cha 'jog 'pher ba'i lan zhig dgos/ /ja ro dor ba'i rgya ja lta bus nya mo tshim pa'i thabs ci yod/ /ta la'i 'dab 'dra'i rgya shog steng du tha tshig yi ger spel don ni/ /da phan bshad pa'i snying gtam de dag na gzhon khyed kyis ma brjed dam/ /pa ṭa'i ris ltar bkra ba'i rang blo pha ma btsan yang 'gyur thabs med/ /ba ber ngang du dor te bzhag na ma shi dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal 'dug /tsa ri'i gnas

yi shes lha bo dang mgar ba stobs rgyas/ 847ltar btsan pa'i rdzong 'dir tsha drag gdung bas mnar ba nga / /dza dzor lo mas bkab pa'i ༄khron pas wa mo chu nang 'dzud pa ltar/ /zha zhum tshul 'chos gtam gleng mkhas la za zir ngang nas dus bskyal na/ /'a 'ur gtam gyi bsun gtser spangs te ya med gcig pur 'chi las ci ra ba gcig tu lhan cig gnas te la chen shi gson mi thug pa'i/ /sha tsha'i 'du shes an tsam yod na sa 'dir nga yi re ba skong / /a ho nyon dang ji 'dra legs 'dug ha log 'gyod pa'i gzhi ma yin/ /a tsi e dga' re ba stong bslog ha cang ngan pa'i spyod tshul rigs/ /’’zhes pa bris te rgya chas dam po zhig byas te rang gi zhal lta ma khra kog la sprad de‘‘khra kog yi ge 'di 'khyer te mi gzhan su zhig kyang med pa'i skabs shig la stobs rgyal gyi lag tu 'azod pa gyis/ der ma zad nga nad ngan pa zhig gisaci mnar 'dug pa nyin re bzhin je sdug red/ de skor ngas stobs rgyal la re ba zhig 'chol dgos 'dug lhag par re ba 'di khos bsgrubs na ni drag pa'i go skabs e yong lta rgyu 'dug de min nga 'chi ba las ma 'das shing / gal te ma shi rung las su rung6 ba'i mi zhig yong ba mi 'dug pa'i gnas tshul kyang bshad de lan zhig 'khyer shog g.yo dang khram la mkhas pa'i mi 'di dag gis tshor yong / gzab gzab gyis’’zhes bshad pa red/khra kog ni ha las shing hon thor te/ g.ya'/ sras mo 'dis ga re gsung gi yod pa red/ nga dang khong gnyis mnyam du gshibs gshibs pa yin/ khong nad drag pos mnar ba phar bzhag tha na cham pa zhig thebs pa'ang ngas shes ma byung / gal te bsnyun gzhi zhig yod na'ang kho stobs

848 rdo rje rgyal po'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/rgyal la re dgos ga re yod/ khos ni gang yang mi shes bsams nas‘‘a tsi/sras mo sku zhabs/ khyed gang gsung gi yod/ dkon mchog gi thugs rjes da lta khyed kyi sku gzugs tsa ri'i smyug ma las ldem zhing / lhum ra'i me tog las mtshar ba der bsnyun gzhi khab btsugs pa tsam yang med/ rnam rtog ma slong rogs gnang / bsnyung bsnyung tsha tsha ma byung ba yag gi red/ gal te sku bsnyun pa'i dbang du btang na'ang kho stobs rgyal gyis lcags bzo ma gtogs gang yang mi shes/ khyed kyi bsnyun gzhi la phan pa'i thabs sne gcig mi shes pa tshig thag bcad chog lar nas ga re bsnyun gyi 'dug gam/gsungs dang / bsnyun gzhi yod na yab chen la snyan seng zhus te em rje gdan 'dren ma zhus na 'grig gi ma red’rices zer ba dang chabs cig 'tshab 'tshab 'tshub 'tshub byas par brten sras mo'i bsam par a'o/'dis 'tshab 'tshub che lugs la bltas na nga na 'dug ces mi su thug la zer rgyur ma thad/ yab chen la'ang zhu rgyur thag chod song bsams nas blo 'tshab pa'i ngang nas‘‘ma red/ ma red/ khra kog khyod rang brel 'tshab ma byed/ nga na thag chod na gi 'dug yin na'ang mi la lab mi rnyin/ lhag par yab chen la ga nas zhu phod/ khyod nga la blo dkar ba'i g.yog mo rang gi spun dang 'dra ba zhig yin/ gsang dgos don med pas bshad choganga'i na tsha 'di rang re bud med la dmigs bsal du yod pa'i nad ngan de red/ de'i skor stobs rgyal la thabs shig yod pa ngas shes byung / der brten ngas khyod yi ge skyel bar btang ba yin/ yi ge nges par du 'phrod pa gyis/ mis shes ma yong / yig lan zhig kyang 'khyer shog lar nas nga'i

ji shes lha rjo dang mgar ba stobs rgyas/ 849nad 'di'i gnas tshul skor dang / thabs ci drag skor shod sa dang / go bsdur byed sa khyod las med pas nga gnyis rim bzhin 'phros pa byas chogagal te phyi nang gi mi su zhig gis shes 'dug rung gtam 'khyar sa khyod rang ma gtogs med do zhes bshad/khra kog gi bsam par/ bud med la dmigs bsal du yod pa'i nad de ga 'dra zhig yin nam bsams te/ ‘‘sras mo sku zhabs/ bud med la dmigs bsal du yod pa'i nad ces pa ga ri yod/ na tsha de skyes par na rgyu med pa red dam/ bud med yod tshad nad des na gi red dam ’zhes bshad par/ sras mos‘‘de red/ na tsha 'di bud med la ma gtogs skyes par na rgyu yod pa ma red/ bud med yin tshad na gi red zer thag mi chod/gcig byas na khyod rang yang na shas che’rizhes bshad/ mo skrag cing de 'dra'i nad ga 'dra zhig yin nam bsam gyin klad pa'i nang nas na thing thing lta bu zhig byung ste/ a'o 'di min nam bsams nas lag pa gnyis kyis mgo btsir nas‘‘sras mo sku zhabs/ na tsha de mgo la yod pa red dam’’zhes dris par/ sras mos‘‘ma red/ lkugs ma khyod ga re zer/ mgo pho mo tshang mar yod pa red ces bshad pas mo'i dogs pa de sel stabs mgo de'ang drag pa lta bu byas pa red/khra kog gi bsam par/ nga rang skugs ma red/ mgo pho mo tshang mar yod pa red/ na rgyu yang tshang mar yong gi red/ da bud med la dmigs bsal du na tsha yong sa de gang du 'dug bsams te mos spyi gtsug nas rkang mthil bar du zhib bsher zhig byas mthar gzhan yan lag dang nying lag
