850 rdo ji rgyul ko'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrogs/thams cad 'dra 'dra red/ nu ma 'di gnyis skyes pa dang mi 'dra ba zhig 'dug 'di red dzhabasams nas/ ‘‘sras mo/ da ngas shes song / nu ma bsnyun gyi 'dug gam’’bshad par/ sras mos‘‘khyod ga re zer ba red/phru gu med na nu ma'i nang 'o ma slebs rgyu med/ 'o ma med na nu mar dmigs bsal na tsha'ang yong rgyu ga la yod’’ces bshad/ yang khra kog gis bsam blo zhig btang ste/ a ye/ da phan sras mo 'dir zla mtshan bab pa mthong ma byung / na tshod kyi bab kyis zla mtshan 'bab kyi yod pa red/ khong la nyams myong med stabs nad drag po zhig red snyam nas skrag pa red bsams te gad mo chen po zhig bgad de/ yo.a le/ sras mo/ khyed thugs 'jigs 'khrungs mi dgos/ de na tsha ma red/ de la zla mtshan zer ba red/ khyed rang gis gsungs pa ltar bud med tshang mar 'bab kyi red/ khyed rang la thugs mkhyen yod pa 'dra/ nga la deng sang 'bab kyi 'dug ha ha/ khyed rang yang dgutwo lo son par brten zla mtshan 'bab kyi yod pa red/ nga gnyis gcig las gcig glen rtags che ba byung 'dug’’ces bshad pas sras mo'i bsam par mngon shes med pas mi 'phung zer ba de dngos 'brel red bsams nas gad mo zhig shor bar/ khra kog gis‘‘'o/ de rarored dam zhes zer/ sras mos‘‘zla mtshan 'bab pa na tsha min pa ngas sheg nga la zla mtshan 'bab rgyu med par brten na tsha byung ba red/ khyod rang nga la sha tsha yod pa zhig yin na ngas mngags pa'i las ka de gyis dang mizhes bshad pa red/khra kog yang lo na phra zhing shes bya dman pas ci zer gyi phugs ma cho da

spa shes lha mo dang mgar ba stobs rgyas/ 851pa'i the tshom gyi ngang nas‘‘lags lags so/ ngas bka' don ltar zhus chog’ ces phyin nas skabs legs po zhig btsal te yi ge de stobs rgyal la sprad de/‘‘stobs rgyal/ sras mo'i phyag bris gal chen po zhig yin gsung gi 'duga'adi'i nang gsal don rnams khyed kyis zhabs phyi legs par zhu dgos par ma zad/ gtam phyir gyar byung tshe nga rang gnyis las sla bo mi yong gsung gi 'dug der ma zad yig lan yang 'khyer shog gsung gi 'dug’ ces bshad par/ stobs rgyal gyi sems la da kha sngon gsung ba'i rnyog dra de'i skor yin pa thag chod/ ngas lam seng yig lan 'bri mi shes par ma zad/ dus skabs kyang mi 'dug bsams nas‘‘khra kog lags/ da lta khyed rang gis phyag bris nga la gnang sa'ang rnyed dka' ba 'di lta bu byung / nga la 'di klog rgyu'i dus tshod dang bka' lan 'bul rgyu'i dus skabs rnyed pa ni de bas spyang dka' ba mkhyen gsal yin stabs da lta bka' lan 'bul thabs bral ba red/ phyag bris kyi dgos don gang yin bltas nas bka' lan bris tshar 'phral khyed kyi phyag tu phul chog’’ces bshad pa ltar bya rgyur thag bcad de khra kog phyir log nas sras mor gnas tshul rnams zhus pas/ sras mos‘‘'o 'grig 'dug gtam ma gyar ba gyis shig’’ces bshad cing / 'dis ma shes par nga'i bya ba de 'grub thabs yong ba mi 'dug pas mo dang nye tsam bya dgos pa 'dug bsams nas khra kog la sngar las kyang byams skyong che ru btang ba red/stobs rgyal gyis yi ge bsngogs te bltas par/ dang po yig ngo mi chod/gnyis pa klog stangs mi shes/ gsum pa go ba mi lon par ci drag la thug

852 rdo rje rgyal po'i gsung rtsom snyogs bsgrigs/rung / gseng dang dbar yod tshad la klog gin bsdad pas mthar blo la 'khyor ba zhig byung zhing / brjod bya'i don la bltas na gal te ngas kha ya ma byas na sras mo ram̐dis rang srog 'dor ba'i nyen kha 'dug lhag par nga mgar ba'i bu zhig la khong rgyal po 'i sras mo zhig gis de tsam yag po byas kyang ngas bka' drin bsam shes ma byas na rgyu 'bras dang khrel ngo tshar ga la btub/ gal te sras mo 'di dang 'brel ba byas rung gtan gyi grogs su ni yong thabs med/ mis shes tshor byung na nga dpon po me las rngab tsha ba 'di'i khrims 'og tu sdug bsngal myong dgos pa dang / khong la mi kha ngan pa sa steng du mi shong ba zhig yong rgyu las med snyam pas som nyi'i gsor thag 'then 'then du bsdad/ yang ka bshad kyi tshig de dran/ sras mo'i gdong de yid la 'khor te da ga la thug kyang thug rab na mis ma shes tsam zhig kyang yong las che/ mthar shes rung las la gang bskos las 'gyod pa med bsams nas yig lan bris par/‘‘rngams rngams rdzong gi gzim chung khra mo'i nang / /mdzes mdzes rgyan gyis spras pa'i lha sras mo/ /dgyes dgyes spyan ras g.yo ba'i mtshar sdug can/ /dman dman stobs rgyal phyogs su yud tsam dgongs/ /byams byams drin gyis bskyangs pa'i bka' drin dang / /snyan snyan gsung gis yang nas yang gdams pa/ /gsal gsal ka bshad bstsal ba'i brjod don gsum/ /dwangs dwangs yid kyi dkyil du gsal ler yod/ /mtho mtho nyi ma'i 'od zer rab 'phro bas/ /dma' dma' pad ma'i dga' tshal skyong ba ltar/ /che che dpon gyi sras mo gang nyid kyis/ /chung chung

yi shes lha mo dang mgar ba stobs rgyas/ skye53bdag 'dra gzigs pa ya mtshan che/ /dam dam brtse bas ba skyed pa'i snying gtamyo/ preng / /lhug lhug gnang ba'i re ba ji lta ba/ de de bdag gis sgrub pa'i dam bca' zhig /kyog kyog yig chung 'di yi lam nas 'bul/ /gsang gsang thabag brgya'i sgo nas bsgrubs pa'i las mtha' mtha' yongs su grags pa chos nyid bzhin/ /mang mang mi yis shes tshe ci drag thabs/ /gang gang legs sam lha yi sras mo mchog /sdug sdug bdag ni 'di nas zags sa med/ /btsan btsan dpon gyi bka' chad bka' bkyon nam/ /nan nan khrims kyi 'og tu 'tshud pa sogs/ /gang gang byung yang bzod pa'i sems thag chod/ /che che dpon mo'i mtshan gyis rab bajid la/ /snyan snyan grags pas sa steng 'gengs khyed la/ /ngan ngan mi khas 'gos te mtshan shas na/ /gang gang drag bsams zas bcud nyal gnyid bral/ /'phral 'phral sprin dbar nyi lta'i bde ba dang / /ring ring sku tshe gang gi dge skyon gnyis/ /so so'i rin thang che chung mi mnyam pa/ /zab zab dgongs pas dpyod stangs ma 'dzol mdzod/ /tha tha'i bu brgyud nyams dman bdag lta bur/ /rgod rgod mtho snyeg spobs pa bral lags rung / /brtse brtse dgongs pa nam yang mi lhod pa'i/ nan nan bka' de mi sgrub dbang ci yod/ /snyan snyan bung ba'i dbyangs lta'i 'gyur 'gugs dang / /zab zab don gyi ro bcud ches zhan yang / /dkar dkar lhag bsam mtshon pa'i zhu 'phrin du/ /gus gus phyag dang bcas te phul ba lags/ ji/’’zhes bris te rgya chas byas te sprad chog chog byas nas balhags bsdud pa red/

854 rdo rje rgyal po'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/nyin gcig sras mos zhal lta ma khra kog chang skyel du btang ba'i thog stobs rgyal gyis yi ge de bskur cing / khra kog gis yi ge de 'khyer nas sras mor phul ba red/ sras mos yi ge de bklags te da nga'i bsam don de 'grub pa 'dug snyam ste dga' spro chen po byung rung / khra kog gi mig sngar nyams snang med lta bur ma zad/ da dung cung zad gdong nag pa ltar byas nas bsdad pas/ khra kog gis‘‘sras mo/ yi ge'i nang la ga re 'dug kho la thabs 'dug gam ’zhes dris par/ sras mos‘‘kho'i yi ge ha cang zhan po zhig 'dug pas 'di'i yig gzugs dang brjod bya gang thad nas klog shes pa zhig mi 'dug thabs shig yod rgyu yod pa 'dra’’zhes bshad par/ khra kog gis‘‘kho mgar bas yi ge de las ga la shes/ ma gzhi nas nga tsho'i las ka de spag kha la bza' rgyu'i lam ltag khung nas bskor ba zer ba'i dpe de byung ba red/ kho la yi ge sprod sa mi rnyed pa dang / khos yi ge klog mi shes pa/ yig lan 'bri mi shes pa sogs kyi bar la nyi ma yang mang po de tsam song / gal te kho la bka' 'dri gnang dgos nges dang / kho la shod rgyu yod nges yin na yar bkug nas bka' 'dri gnang na chu tshod skar ma gcig gnyis shig gi yun red/ de 'dra'i dka' ba dang rnyog dra dgos don mi 'dug ces bshad par/ sras mo ye shes lha mo'i bsam par/ g.ya'/da 'grig song / ngas mo la phar shod ma shes par bsdad yod/ da byed bde po byung song bsams nas‘‘da ga rang red/ khyod rang gis zer ba dngos gnas red/ kho yar bkug nas skad cha zhig 'dri rgyu las 'os mi 'dug yin na'ang de gsang ba chen po zhig dgos pa yin pas ga re byas na

ye shes lha mo dang mgar ba stobs rgyas/ 855yag pa 'dug’’ces bshad/ khra kog gis‘‘de gnad 'gag mi 'dug yab chen ni bzhugs pa phyed dang ma bzhugs pa phyed red/ phyag gnyer sogs ni de las kyang brel ba che ba 'dug rdzong nang du gtan du sdod mkhan rang cag dpon g.yog gnyis red’’ces bshad par/ sras mos‘‘'o red/ 'o na de rang byas chogari’ces bshad/ khra kog gis‘‘ma gzhi nas kha sang bsnyun gzhi che mdog kha po zhig gnang gi 'dug da lta ga 'dra 'dug7ces bshad par/ sras mos‘‘kha sang de ring sdug tu rang phyin mi 'dug’’ces bshad/khra kog gis‘‘stabs yag nga ni sems khral gyis gnyid kyang 'khugs kyi mi 'dug’’ces sogs gleng bzhin bsdad pa red/de nas bzung sras mo ye shes lha mo dang / zhal lta ma khra kog mgar ba stobs rgyal gsum kha mthun nas skabs dang gseng thob tshad la 'phrad cing mthun sdeb byas/ sras mo ni stobs rgyal las bsam rgyu med pa de dang sdeb rgyu byung bas ded dpon nor bu'i gling du slebs pa ltar smra mi shes pa'i dga' spro thob/ stobs rgyal ni spyir dpon chen gyi sras mo/ yang sgos rang gi mgo thog dpon gyi sras mo lang tshos phyug pa de lta bu zhig sdug mgar ba'i bu kho lta bu la thob yong bsam pa rmi lam du'ang yong mi srid pa zhig byung ba'i dga' spro dang / nam zhig mis shes na las ka yag po zhig mi yong ba thag chod bsams pa'i sdug bsngal gnyis gsor thag 'then 'then du gnas/zhal lta ma khra kog dang / lag g.yog bkra shis sogs sras mo dang stobs rgyal gyi phyogs su gnas pa rnams sras mo byams skyongasnrosngar las che bas bza' tung 'bol la lus la zan pa'i sdug sbyong gtong mkhan dang / rna bar

856 rdo rje rgyal po'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/bsun pa'i bshad bshad gtong mkhan med pas snang ba skyid por gnas chog pa bcas myung zhing / sras mo dang stobs rgyal gyi bya spyod tram̐r la dogs pa cung zad skyes kyang / nges gtan ma shes stabs dpe mi srid pa'i bya ba 'di lta bu nges gsal shod rgyu med par gtam gleng byed mi nyan bsams te kha nas 'don ma nus/de nas mi ring bar sras mo ye shes lha mo la phru gu chags te e yin/e yin snyam pa'i ngang nas zla ba gsum tsam lon tshar ba red/ skabs der sras mo'i bsam par/ da ni lan chags kyi phru gu zhig kyang chags 'dugasngon gyi las la ldog thabs med/ nga rang gis byas pa'i las kar song gshis 'gyod pa'ang med/ stobs rgyal gyis zer ba ltar mi kha ngan pa sa la mi shong ba zhig yong rgyur thag chod song / sus ga re zer yang khyad med/yab chen gyis mkhyen na bka' bkyon drag po zhig phebs pa smos ci dgos/tha na nga rdzong 'di nas 'bud kyang srid/ de la ni gnad 'gag mi 'dugatshe gang lto slong nas bza' dgos byung rung kho dang mnyam gshib bya rgyu byung na de gas 'grig 'on kyang yab chen bsod nams rin chen sku dbang btsan thog da res khong gi bu brgyud gang zer yang gcig las med pa nga'i bya ba 'di lta bu zhig byung gshis mtha' bzhi'i dpon rang dang 'dra ba rnams la gdong ston mi shes pa zhig byung ba dang / ngo bstod dang dbyen dkrug la dga' ba'i bloji cho/ 'khor 'di rnams gleng mo mang ba sogs kyis stobs rgyal kho la mnar gcod drag po zhig yong rgyu thag chod pa red/ de la phan pa'i thabs shig ci drag snyam pa'i sdug bsngal gyi gcong rdo snying dbus su tshud pas

ye shes lha mo dang mgar ba stobs rgyas/ 857lus kyi sha skam/ gdong gi bkrag shor/ skad kyi shugs nyams te nam mjug ston kha'i me tog gi mdog bzhin nyin re bzhin je zhan je sdug tu 'gro gi yod pa de stobs rgyal gyis shes te/ ‘‘sras mo/ khyed kyi sku'i mtshar sdug pad ma gsar pa 'dra ba de sad kyis bcom pa lta bu zhig tu gyur 'dugalas ngan nga dang bsdebs nas nyams grib phog pa min nam/ sku la bsnyun gzhi ga re 'dug thugs la sdug bsngal ga re 'dugami’ces dris par/ sras mos‘‘stobs rgyal/ nga la na tsha dang sdug bsngal gang yang mi 'dug khyod blo g.yeng byed mi dgos’’zhes bshad pas/ stobs rgyal gyis‘‘bka' mol de dngos gnas ma red/ khyed kyi sku mdangs shor shor su zhig la'ang mthong rgyu mi 'dug sras mo khyed kyi zhal ras mjal dus nga'i snying la gzer btab pa lta bu'i na tsha zhig yong gi 'dug drang po zhig gsung rogs gnang / sman bcos rim gro yang mdzad rgyu med dam/ nga gnyis kyi 'brel ba 'di bcad na e drag’’ces bshad par/ sras mos‘‘stobs rgyal/ de ltar ma red/nga gnyis kyi 'brel ba 'chi bdag gshin rjes ma gtogs gcod mi thub/bcad kyang nga'i nad la phan pa yong rgyu med/ sman bcos rim gro byas kyang phan rgyu yod kyi ma red/ nga'i na tsha 'di ni btab pa'i lo tog skye ba dang /bsnyal ba'i chang lang ba chos nyid yin pa lta bu red/ khyod blo chung stabs sems khral byung dos/sa kyis ngas ma bshad pa yin/ da ni ma bshad kyang phan pa mi 'dug dngos gnas bshad na nga la phru gu chags 'dug chags pas ma tshad zla ba gsum lhag tsam phyin 'dug khyod sems khral byed me dasdos’’zhes bshad par/ stobs rgyal zhed thag chod nas dngangs bzhin

858 rdo rje rgyal po'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/par kho rang khyim nas yong khar a mas bshad pa'i skad cha de lhang nger dran te/ ‘‘a ma/ a ma/ khyed la mngon shes yod pa ma red dam/ rang sems rang gis mnan nas dman sa 'dzin ma thub na snying gcong khog tu mi 'chur ba dang / 'gyod pa rtas mi zin pa zhig bzo bar khyug tsam yin zer ba de da byung ba red/ sras mo khyed skyer skyer mi'i dkyil la ga 'dra byas nas phebs kyi yin/ yab chen la ga 'dra zhu/ phyed dgra dang phyed gnyen du gyur pa'i mi spyi dang / sgos 'khor 'bangs 'di rnams la zhal ras ga 'dra byas nas ston/ a tsi/ bya ba nag po 'di 'dra zhig ma byung gong la nga los shi dgos mizhes ngu bzhin par smre bsngagayobaton/ sras mos‘‘stobs rgyal/khyod de ltar sdug bsngal byed mi dgos/ khyod kyis zer ba'i gnas tshul de tsho snga ma nas nga'i sems la 'khor yod/ nga de la mi skrag ngas khyod dang mnyam du bsdebs pa'i mi kha ngan pa de theg par ma zad/ gson na mnyam gson dang / shi na mnyam shi byed rgyu'i sems thag bcad tshar ba yin /mis gang zer la khyad par med/ 'on kyang rang re'i yab chen sku dbang btsan zhing / blon 'khor rnams ngo dga' che bas khyod la dbang shed kyi bya ba ji yong ma nges pas de skor la thabs shes shig 'tshol dgos 'dug khyod rang gis kyang bsam blo thongs/ ngas kyang bsam blo btang chog ces sogs gleng mus su zhal lta ma khra kog yong nas‘‘sras mo sku zhubs/ yab chen chibs sgyur gnang gi 'dug’ ces zer bas gtam mjug bsdu 'khoms med par stobs rgyal mgar tshang du log dgos pa byung ba red/de nas bzung stobs rgyal khrag rlung dang zhed snang gnyis 'doms kyis

yi shes lha mo dang mgar ba stobs rgyas/ skye5nyasnying kha nas thon grabs lta bus gdung bas mnar te mal sar lus/ sras mos mngags pa ltar lag g.yog rnams kyis nad g.yog dang rogs ram gang legs byas thog sras mo rang nyid kyang gseng dbar byung tshad la yong nas sman dang lto ster ba sogs byas kyang drag dus gtam lan 'jal thub tsam dang / sdug dus rig 'tsho zin la ma zin du nyin shas bsdad kyang drag skyed ma byung stabs bkra shis kyis phyag mdzod khang du phyin/ stobs rgyal glo bur du na zhing drag skyed med pa'i gnas tshul rnams bshad nas dgongs pa zhus mthar phyag mdzod grags pas dpon bsod nams rin chen la snyan seng zhus par/ dpon gyis‘‘mi sdug chags de tshor g.yo sgyu chen po yong /kho da res las rgyun ring tsam 'gor stabs na rdzu bsgrigs nas log rtsis byed pa red/ rgyug shan zhig btang na na dang ma na ha go yong’’zhes zer/ phyag mdzod kyis‘‘lags de 'dra rang ma red/ lto za ma thub par yang nyi ma lnga drug song / gal te shi na kho mgar ba yin stabs ro grib byas te ston thog la'ang sad ser 'dra mi yong ngam bsam gyi 'dugami ces zhus par/ dpon gyis‘‘a'o/ de 'dra yin na kho rang gi nang du slog rang re'i rdzong nang du mgar ba shi na 'grig gi ma red/ ston thog kyang rtsa ba chen po red/ lam seng slog’ ces bshad/de nas phyag mdzod mar yong nasaXwa ye/ bkra shis kho na thag chod yin na dgongs pa gnang song / da lta rang log rgyug lab’’ces bshad/bkra shis mar yong nas‘‘stobs rgyal/ stobs rgyal’’zhes bos par khos mig phyed tsam zhig gdangs nas bltas te/ ‘‘lags ’zer/ bkra shis kyis

860 rdo rje rgyal po'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/‘‘ngas dgongs pa zhus pa yin/ dgongs pa 'khrol song / da lta rang log gsung gi 'dug’’ces bshad/ stobs rgyal gyi sems la sras mo de lhang nger dran zhing / nga nang la log chos shi yang shi/ da sras mo 'a/di ga 'dra byas 'gro bsams nas mig chu lhug lhug tu yar langs te 'gro rtsis byas kyang /yar lang yang thub la mi thub byed kyi 'dug pas lag cha dang nyal chas sogs 'khyer thub rgyu lta ci/ stong par yang 'gro thub re med par lus pas lag g.yog de dag gis sems kyis ma bzod par gleng par‘‘rang dbang med pa'i mi zer ba de 'di 'dra red/ kho thang thang yin dus dpon po'i zhabs 'degs su bcar dgos pa smos ci/ lus nad kyis mnar dus dgongs pa 'khrol na lha rgyal ma gtogs lta rtog dang rogs ram gang yang mi 'dug nga rang tsho na na'ang 'di lta bu zhig red’’ces gcig gis gcig la lta gin bsdad yod pa red/sras mos stobs rgyal bslog rgyu yin pa shes/ te da kho gnas skabs nang du log gtong rgyu las 'os med/ 'on kyang skyel mkhan gtong thabs dang /mngag gtam tshig gsum zhig rgyag e thub lta dgos bsams te mgar tshang du shar rgyag phyin skabs gnas tshul de dag mthong ste bshad par/ phakho na tsha sdug po 'di tsam yo da pa'i nad pa sgo nas 'bud thub tsam byas pas ga la yong / phyag mdzod khang la zhus nas khyod lag g.yog mi gcig skyel bar rgyugabyung na rta zhig kyang gtong rogs gnang zhus zhes bshad cing / mig phar lta tshur lta byas nas stobs rgyal la skad cha zhig shod rtsis byas kyang / lag g.yog dang de min mi mang po zhig slebs nas 'dug pas gal che ba shod mi

/yi shes lha mo dang mgar ba stobs rgyas/ 861bde stabs/ ‘‘stobs rgyal/ khyod na tsha ga 'dra 'dug’’ces dris/ stobs rgyal gyis‘‘lags lags/ a'u tsi 'dug ’ces bshad/ sras mos‘‘da byas na dgongs pa 'khrol ba red/ nang la log nas gzugs por 'phrod bsten yag po gyis/ sems sdug ma byed/ mgyogs po 'phrad yong / ngas kho tsho mi gcig rogs la gtong rogs zhus chog’’ces bshad/ stobs rgyal gyis mig mchi mas gang ste‘‘lags/ thugs rje che/ thugs rje che’’zhes bshad cing /bsam par ngas na tsha sdug mdog kha po byas na sras mo 'dir thugs khral yong gi red bsams nas na tsha cher med pa ltar byas nas bsdad/ sras mos gtam de lhag shod sa ma rnyed stabs yar log mi 'gro thabs med byung ba red/ gzim chung du slebs pa dang‘‘khra kog stobs rgyal log grabs 'dug kho'i na tsha 'di ngas bzos song / de ring kho la skad cha tshig gsum bshad dgos bsams rung go skabs rnyed ma byung / khyod rang gis nga'i tshab byas nas kho 'gro khar lag rtags 'di sprad nas kho sems ma pham gzugs por 'phrod bsten yag po gyis/ gal te kho rang mgyogs po ma drag na nga lha sar slebs yong zhes lab shog lag rtags 'di mis ma mthong ba dang /nga lha sar slebs yong zer ba de mis ma go ba gyis’’zhes bshad/ khra kog gi bsam par/ sras mo tshod zin po 'dis mgar nag kho la de tsam dga' dgos pa gang yin/ 'on kyang ngas mngags pa de byed kyi min zer mi phod bsams nas‘‘sags lags so/ ma gzhi nas 'di'i nang du gang yod/ngas gcig bltas ka kho la 'di ga re yin zer dgos samami’ zer bar/sra mos‘‘a yo/ de brtsad gcod mi dgos/ de kho'i lag tu 'apod na

862 rdo the rgyal po'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/'grig pa red/ de yin 'di yin 'grel bshad byed mi dgos/ da rgyug dang / kho 'gro ran yod 'gro’’zhes bshad pas khra kog gis lag rtags de am phrag tu bcug ste phyin pa red/ stabs yag nas lag g.yog kho tsho stobs rgyal skyel mkhan gyi skor la phyag mdzod khang du phyin pa dang kha thug 'khel te lam seng sprod sa rnyed pa red/ mngags pa'i skad cha de dag kyang chad lhag med par bshad pa red/ 'on kyang sras mos lha sar slebs yong gsung 'dug byas pa des stobs rgyal ha las te‘‘su lha sar slebs yong gsung gi yod na khra kog lags khyed rang red dam’’zer bar/ khra kog gis‘‘nga slebs yong zer ba min/ sras mo phebs yong gsungs pa red mices bskyar du skad che tsam gyis bshani pa de lag g.yog pa sangs zer ba sgo 'gram na yod pas go ste‘‘khra kog lags/ sras mo lha sar phebs kyi redadam’’zer bar/ mos lam seng spyang grung byas te bshad par/ ‘‘da ga rang red/ nga tsho'i sras mo 'di nga rang tsho tshang ma'i pha ma lta bu ma red dam/ pha mas bu tshar byams skyong los gnang / khyod rang ha las mdog kha po'i skad cha bzhag na dga' gi red/ skad cha mang drags na nyo cha 'khel yong’’zhes bshad par/ kho'i bsam par 'dis sras mo la zhus na nga la bka' bkyon zhig phebs yong bsams nas/ ‘‘red/ red/ sras mo 'di nga rang tsho su la'ang thugs rje chen po red/ de dngos gnas red/ skad cha nyung na dga' gi red’’ces bshad pa red/bkra shis kyis phyag mdzod khang du phyin nas stobs rgyal 'gro mi thub pa— dang / sras mos bka' gnang ba de tsho phyag gnyer la zhus pas phyag mdzod

yi shes lha mo dang mgar ba stobs rgyas/ 863kyis‘‘he/ kho na nas shi na'ang thabs ga re yod/ nga tshos na ru bcug pa ni min/ khos dpon la zhabs phyi zhu dgos pa 'os red/ kho la dpon pos zhabs phyi zhu ba'i lugs srol ga la yod/ gzhung rkyang la rta gtong rgyu dang /mi gtong rgyu yod kyang / kho la thob thang yod pa ma red’’ces bshad/ gnyer pa rgya mtshos‘‘phyag na/dzod sku zhabs kyis gsungs pa de rang red/ stobs rgyal kho rang gi nang la log par nga tshos skyel mkhan gtong dgos byung na rjes su mi ser dang 'u lag na tshad skyel rgyu 'khel gyi red/ de 'dra'i lugs srol ga la yod/ sras mos ma mkhyen pa red’mizer/ drung yig skal bzang dar rgyas kyis‘‘sras mos lugs srol mkhyen na'ang 'dra/ ma mkhyen na'ang 'dra/ gang ltar nga rang tsho tshang mas bdag po de'i bka' gnang ba la brtsi mi dgos sam/ ngas byas na brtsi dgos/ gal te brtsi mi dgos na phyag gnyer gnyis kyis de ltar gsung gi 'dug ces sras mo la zhus na 'grig gi red ’ces bshad pas phyag gnyer gnyis ka zhed nas phyag mdzod grags pas bshad par/ ‘‘drung yig lags/ ma red byas / nga gnyis kyis spyir btang dpon 'bangs kyi lam lugs shod kyi yod pa red/ sras mo'i bka' la brtsi gi min zer rgyu ma byung / da byas na bkra shis rang rta gcig khrid nas kho skyol shog tshur slebs song na rta dang rta chas tshang mar bsang skor yag po zhis gyis’’zer/ gnyer pas kyang‘‘de rang red/ de rang red’’zer/ bkra shis kyis‘‘lags lags so’ zhes phyin te rta gcig khrid nas stobs rgyal lha sar skyel bar phyin pa red/stobs rgyal dang / bkra shis gnyis lha sar slebs skabs a ma bag

864 rdo je rgyal po'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrogs/gro sgo rtsar bsdad yod pa dang tag tag kha thug 'khel ba red/ a mas stobs rgyal mthodā ma thag snying tsha long long ba zhig byung ste‘‘a tsi/ ga re byas song / stotres rgyal na gi 'dug gam/ dpon po'i bka' bkyon phyag 'jug 'khel ba ma red dam mizhes dris/ bkra shis kyis stobs rgyal rta nas 'bebs bzhin par‘‘a ma bag gro/ de 'dra ma red/ bka' bkyon phyag 'jug 'khel ba ma red/ na nas nyi ma kha shas song / drag skyed yong rgyu med par ma zad/ las ka yang byed thub kyi mi 'dug byas tsang dgongs pa zhus nas yong ba zedami’ces bshad/ a ma dang bkra shis gnyis kyis g.yas skyor g.yon skyor gyis nang du khrid/ stobs rgya la ni a mar bltas nas mig chu khrom khrom du sdod pa las gtam lan yang 'jal thub kyi mi 'dugabakra shis kyis na stangs dang gnas tshul rnams zhib par bshad de da res sras mo'i bka' drin gyis ma gtogs stobs rgyal nang du 'khyol ba med ces bshad/ de'i mjug tu stobs rgyal gyis‘‘de rang yin/ des ma tshad bkra shis lags kyis sku ngal 'dzems med kyis rogs ram de dag ma gnang na nga a ma dang 'phrad rgyu mi yong thag chod yin/ khong gi bka' drin ma brjed pa byed dgos yod’’ces bshad/ bkra shis kyis‘‘ga re zer gyi yod pa red/ngari sdo rogs ram byas pa de tsam zhig la bka' drin chen po yin zer ga la dgos/ nga rang tsho mi nyam chung gcig gis gcig la rogs ram ma byas na/mi drag pas nga rang tshor rogs ram ga la rgyad/ bla ma dpon po la ni bka' bkyon ma gtogs gnang rgyu med/ dper na/ stobs rgyal la cha mtshon na/ khos da ras gcig pur zla ba mang po'i ring la kha la lto za long med

yi shes lha mo dang mgar ba stobs rgyas/ 865par zhabs phyi zhus pa red/ na nas nyal sar lus pa'i nyin mo de dgongs pa 'khrol na lha rgyal red/ sman bcos sogs lta rtog byed mkhan su gang yod pa ma red/ gal te shi ba yin na/ khyi ro dbyug dbyug byed thag chod red/ gnas tshul de mthong dus nga tsho tshang ma sems skyo po zhe drags byungami’zhes sogs sems kyi gting nas khong khro za ba'i skad cha mang po bshad par a ma bag gros‘‘bkra shis lags/ zhal rog bzhugs/ skad cha de 'dra dpon po'i snyan la 'khyol na dpe bsags pa red/ khyed rang gis da lta gsungs pa de bden pa red/ nga tsho nyam chung la nyam chung gis ma gtogs phan thogs mi yong / thugs rje che/ nga tsho ma bu gnyis kyis bka' drin brjed mi yong / mchod chang 'di gtsang ma yin/ bzhes dang’’zhes sogs gleng zhing / bkra shis kyis‘‘chang de btung zin ma thag da nga ma phyin na bka' bkyon 'khel yong / stobs rgyal rang gzugs po la ca ga dag po gyis/ nga lha sar yong zhor la lta skor du slebs yong / a ma bag gro rang em rje zhig gdan 'dren zhu bar phyin pa yag gi red’mices bshad/ stobs rgyal gyis gtam lan cher 'debs mi thub rung / lag brda dang sbrags ‘‘thugs rje che’’zhes bshad/ a mas‘‘lags red/ btsan po'i zhabs phyi zer mkhan de dka' las chen po red/ dus thog tu ma 'byor na bka' bkyon 'khel yong / phebs rogs gnang / rjes la lha sar phebs zhor byung na nga tsho'i nang la nges par du phebs rogs gnangarimizhes bshad cing /bkra shis log phyin pa red/ 4zu1de nas a mas nyal sa skyid po zhig bzos te stobs rgyal der nyal rde

866 rdo rje rgyal po'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/ bcug gyon chas rnams 'bud ska/bas sras mos gnang ba'i lag rtags de am dbrag nas thon pa red/ stobs rgyal gyis de'i nang du gang yod kyang ma shes stabs a mas gnas skabs ma mthong tsam byung na bsams rung a ma'i lag tu thebs tshar stabs byed thabs ma byung ba red/ stobs rkyul bsnyal tshar nas a ma'i bsams par sgril sgril 'di kho'i rnam kun gyi lag dang mi 'dra ba zhig 'dug gang yin nam bsams nas bltas par/ de'i nang du ar cor dkar po zhig gi nang dngul srang gsum dang / gser gyi tshigs kheb gcig skra shub stong chab gcig bcas yod par ma zad/ yig chung zhig kyang yod pa red/ a mas‘‘stobs rgyal/ ras sgril 'di ga re red/ yi ge 'di'i nang du ga re bris yodari’ces dris par/ stobs rgyal gyis‘‘a ma/ de sras mo ye shes lha mos gnang byung / nang du gang yodashes ma byung / yi ge ga 'dra zhig 'dug nga la ston dang rizhes bshad pas a ma lam seng dogs pa bzas nas 'di yag ma song bsams shing / yi ge de stobs rgyal la sprad pa red/ khos yi ge de bklags par/‘‘stobs rgyal/ khyod sems khral byed mi dgos/ sngon gyi las la bzlog thabs med/ khyod rang gi gzugs por ca ga dang sman bcos yag po gyis/ nga la bsam rgyu ni khyod ma gtogs med/ gal te khyod mgyogs po ma drag na nga khyod 'phrad par slebs yong / nga la zer dgos pa'i don yod na khra kog dang bkra shis brgyud nas yig 'phrin bskur shog khyod kyis nga ma brjed/ ngas khyod brjed mi yong’’zhes zer ba bris yod pa red/stobs rgyal gyis mig chu gtong bzhin par yi ge yang bskyar thengs

— wa jishisalhamodang mgar ba stobs rgyas/ 86lhagacig dzeeklags te/ ‘‘a ma/ nga na ba'i don yang 'di rang yin’’zhes lo rgyus rnams ma lus par bshad/ a mas nyan te namo phyed bar bsdad pa red/ a mas bsam blo zhig btang ste da tshar ba red/ byed thabs mi 'dug khong sne'u dpon gyi sras mo kho stobs rgyal lta bu'i gtan grogs su yong rgyu ga la yod/ yong rgyu ni chags sgo zhig red/ 'on kyang 'gyod pa byas nas phan pa mi 'dug sras mo'i yi ge'i nang du yod pa ltar las la gang bskos las bsam par gang dran yong rgyu su la'ang med bsams te 6‘stobs rgyal/ las ka gang dang gang yin na'ang ma byas gong nas bsam blo nan tan btang ste byed 'os pa zhig yin na byas/ byed mi 'os pa zhig yin na 'jog dgos pa red/ byas tshar te yag po byung na dkon mchog gis gnang byung bsams pa dang / sdug po byung na sngon gyi las yin bsam pa bya rgyu ma gtogs 'gyod pa byas nas phan pa til 'bru tsam med/ de las khyod rang gi sems khyod rang gis bcun nas bsam blo lhod lhod byas nas ma btang na shi ma ran gong nas shi yong’ zhes sogs bslab bya dang gnas lugs mang po bshad pas stobs rgyal gyi sdug bsngal sel ba la'ang cung zad phan thogs pa red/ de nas em rje 'dra bsten/ a mas sems gso bslab bya 'a5 byas te bsdad pas skabs re drag tsam dang / skabs re sdug tsam ngang du gnas/ sne'u rjo nga du sras mo ye shes lha mo ni spyir stobs rgyal la brtse ba dang /lhag par kho nad gzhi lci bar brten sems ngal gyis nyin mtshan 'khyol dka' ba yod pas nyin gcig yab chen gyi drung du phyin nas‘‘pā lags/

868 rdo rje rgyal po'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/deng sang nga bde po rang mi 'dug sang gnangs shig lha sar mchod mjal la gtong rogs gnang’’zhes bshad par/ yab chen gyis‘‘'grig gi red/zhabs brtan kha shas shig kyang bsgrub dngo/sa yod/ gra sgrig gyis/ gza' tshes legs pa zhig la rgyug’’ces bshad/ sras mos phyag mdzod dang /gnyer pa sogs la sras mo rang lha sar 'gro rgyu yin pa dang / zhabs brtan bsgrub dgos pa sogs bshad nas gra sgrig byed du bcug pa red/nyin gcig gnyer tshang du nyer mkho bsdog rgyu'i skor la gros bsdur byed skabs sras mo 'di gshis rgyud legs pa dang / chos la dkar ba yin tshul sogs dang / da res zhabs brtan rgya chen po zhig gnang gi yin pa 'dra zhes sogs gtam gleng sna tshogs byung zhing / de skabs sngar stobs rgyal gyi lag g.yog byed mkhan pa sangs zer ba des rgod chung sig sig gis da ga rang red/ sras mo lha sar phebs kyi red zer ba ngas kha seng nas go byung / nga tsho'i sku ngo tsho la ni bsnyun bsnyun tsha tsha gang yang med/ zhabs brtan de su/'i zhabs brtan yin nam zer ba sogs cung zad 'phya ba'i rnam pa'i tshig zur zhig thon stabs phyag mdzod grags pa dogs pa bzos kyang der gtam lan tsam ma brgyab par bzhag ste/ de'i phyi dro phyag mdzod rang gi las shag tu pa sangs bkug ste thabs rnam du ma'i sgo nas skad cha mang po dris mthar stobs rgyal rdzong du sdod pa'i ring gi gnas tshul 'go nas mjug bar dris par sras mo ye shes lha mo'i byed stangs gang ci cung zad 'dra ma chags pa mang tsam byung ba dang / mthar stobs rgyal 'gro khar khra kog btang ste khong rang lha sar slebs yong bshad pa bcas zhib cing phra ba thon

ye shes lha bo dang mgar ba stobs rgyas/ 869stabs phyag mdzod grags pa'i bsam par sra sa mo 'di dang stobs rgyal gyi 'brel ba'i thad khungs lung gsal dag cig shod rgyu med pa ma gtogs tshul min gyi las ṅka zhig byung thag chod red bsams nas khra kog bkug ste dris par/ ‘‘khra kog kha sang stobs rgyal log 'gro khar khyod rang gis ga re bshad pa yin/ sras mo lha sar phebs yong gsung gi 'dug ces bshad pa yin nam ’zhes dris par/ khra kog gis bsams par/ g.ya'/ kho pa sangs zer mkhan des bshad pa red/ 'on kyang nga la sras mos mi su gang gis ma shes pa gyis gsungs yod pas ngas de bshad pa yin zhes khas blangs na ga la 'grig gal te mtha' la bkag nas dris byung na'ang ngas lan rgyag stangs shes yong bsams nas‘‘phyag mdzod sku zhabs/ nga la de 'dra shod rgyu med5bshad/ phyag mdzod kyis‘‘khyod rang bsam blo yag po thongs/ ham pa 'gro sa yod pa ma red/ skad cha de dag khungs skyel mkhan yod pa red’’ces mig hrig hrig byas nas bshad pa red/ khra kog gis‘‘da ga rang red/khungs skyel mkhan yod na de gas 'grig pa red/ nga la nyams tshod bzhes dgos don mi 'dug 'o na da res sras mo lha sar phebs rgyu de stobs rgyal gyi rtsa la phebs kyi red gsung gi yin nam/ de'i khungs de phyag mdzod sku zhabs kyis skyel rogs gnang’’zhes bshad par/ phyag mdzod kyi bsam par/ a'o/ bu mo 'di'i skad cha'i shugs la bltas na sras mos de 'dra gsungs yod mdog kha po ma byung / lar nas bzo lta khrig khrig cig 'dug ste don rtsa ya yu che la khungs lung dag 'bud byed rgyu med stabs gzab gzab ma byas na skyon lhags yong / de las yab chen la zhu stangs mkhas po

870 rdo rje rgyal po'i gsung rtsom lhags bsgrigs/zhig byas ) da res sras mo phebs rgyu dgag thabs byas na dga' ba 'dug bsam te‘‘khra kog khyod rang rlung lang mdog kha po ma byed/ shā/ṭa/ ka ga re yin na'ang rim ’bzhin mtha' gsal yong gi red/ nga gnyis rtsod pa rgyag dgos don mi 'dug bu mo zer mkhan de gshis kha yag po dgos pa red/gshis kha yag po med na mna' mar brin mi yong’’zhes rtsed mo'i rnam pa ltar bshad pas khra kog kha gcus sna gcus byas nas log phyin pa red/phyag mdzod kyis dpon bsod nams rin chen gyi gzim chung du phyin nas‘‘mi dbang chen mo/ kha sang bka' gnang ba ltar zhabs brtan gyi dgos cha phal cher gra sgrig byas pa yin/ yin na'ang nga'i bsam par sras mo dang zhabs phyi kha shas shig rkyang rkyang phebs na zhabs brtan de tsho yag po zhig sgrub thub e yong / der ma zad lha sa lung pa za ra zi re tsha po red/sras mo sku na phra ba dang / sku'i lang tsho dar bar brten mi ngan g.yo sgyu can gyi bslu khrid 'dra mi yong ba'i nges pa med pas rang bzhin du phebs su 'jug rgyu blos btsod kyi ma red/ de las nyin shas shig nas nga tsho phyag gnyer tsho yang zhabs phyir bcar te mnyam du phebs na yag gi min nam bsam gyi 'dug’’ces zhus par/ dpon gyis‘‘de ga rang red/ phyag mdzod kyis zer batshode yag po 'dug bu mo zer mkhan gyod kyi gzhi ma yin/lha sa lung pa ni tshoṭongos gnas za ra zi re tsha po red/ do rdo tan tan byas na yag gi red/ lhag par khyod tsho phyag gnyer tsho'ang bu mo'i zhabatra/ phyir phyin nas zhabs brtan de tsho bsgrubs na zhabs brtan legs par 'grub rgyur ma zad/ mis bltas na nyams dod pa dang 'dra chags pa'ang yong gi red/

ryā shes lha mo dang mgar ba stobs rgyas/ 871de rang byas chog’’ces bshad/sras mo ye shes lha mos gnas tshul de dag shes te yab chen la gtong rogs gnang zhes bskyar du u btsugs kyis zhus par yab chen gyis bka' ma 'khrol bar ma zad/ gal te 'gro na'ang phyag gnyer sogs zhabs phyi mang po khrid na ma gtogs phyin mi chog ces tshig thag bcad pa red/ de'i tshe na sras mo ni stobs rgyal dran pa dang kho na ba'i sems khral gyis nyin mtshan mi 'khyol pa'i ngang nas bsams par/ mi ngan de tshos zhus rjes su yab chen thugs blo 'gyur te nga mi gtong bar ma zad/ btang rung phyag gnyer mnyam du khrid na stobs rgyal 'phrad sa mi rnyed pas nga lha sar phyin yang stong pa red/ sngon gyi las la bzlog rgyu med/ rang gi lus la 'khris pa'i phru gu'i pha de shi yang ma bltas par 'jog thabs ga la yod/ rgyu 'bras la'ang mi btub/ nyin 'gyangs zhag 'gyangs su sdug sgom byas nas bsdad cung stobs rgyal 'phrad ma thub pa'i 'gyod pa zhig 'phar du smyong rgyu las/khog pa'i nang du yod pa'i phru gu zla grangs thim mtshams skye rgyur de mtshams ni mi tshang mas ma shes thabs med red/ da ga la thug kyang yab chen la kha bsangs nas zhus te stobs rgyal 'phrad tsam byed par mi 'gro bar thabs mid snyam pa'i sems thag bcad nas gzim chung nang du phyin te yab chen la phyag 'tshal dang bcas zhus par/5tshe 'dir bka' drin can gyi/ /yab chen bsod nams rin 3na/ /snyan dbang gzhan la ma g.yeng / /nga yi phyogs su gson dang / /yab chen dgyes pa skyed pa'i/ /gtam snyan zhu rgyu med de/ /

872 rdo rje rgyal po'i gsung rtsom spyogs bsgrigs/sngon bsags las kyis bskos pa'i/ /gnas lugs tshig gsum zhu rgyur/ /'dab chags brgya yi nang nas/ /'ug rgan nyin mo longs song bya chen dgongs pa ma tshoms/ /'ug rgan rang gi las red/ /'gros chen rgod ma'i mngal nas/ /smug chung dre'u skyes song / /mdo chen da gongs pa ma tshoms/ /rgod ma rang gi las red/ /mi chen dpon gyi brgyud la/ /mgar ba'i phru gu chags 'dug /yab chen dgongs pa ma tshoms/ /bu mo rang gi las red/ /las su bskos pa'i stobs rgyal/ /'di phyi'i mtshams la slebs yod/ /lan gcig ma bltas zer na/ /las la btub pa mi 'dug /lan chags phru gu'i spa ba/ /bskyur nas phod pa mi 'dug /yab chen dgongs pa ma tshoms/ /'phrad du gtong rogs gnang dang/ /’ tses bshad pa red/dpon bsod nams rin chen ha las shing khong khro langs pa'i ngang nas‘‘khyod ga re zer gyi yod/ khyod ga re zer gyi yod/ spyo ba ma red dam/ smyo 'a/ba rgyag pa ma red dam’’zhes bshad pa red/sras mos‘‘yab chen dgongs dag nga spyo med/ 'on kyang spyo ba dang khyad par byung ma song / sngon las ldog tu med pas ded de stobs rgyal dang mthun sdeb byung bar ma zad/ mngal du phru gu zhig kyang yod/ bya ba nag po 'di lta bus sne'u dpon gyi zhabs 'dren srid na med pa zhig zhus song /tshar ba'i las la 'gyod kyang phan pa byung ma song / yab chen bka' drin can gyis nga la thugs brtse bas dgongs te stobs rgyal 'phrad par khyug tsam phyin chog pa'i bka' 'khrol zhig cis kyang skyabs 'jug gnang rogs

ye shes lha mo dang mgar ba stobs rgyas/ 873gnang ’zhes dpon bsod nams rin chen gyi spus mor mgo bo btsāgs nas bshad pa red/dpon bsod nams rin chen gyis rkang pa g.yas pas rdog 'phul zhig brgyab/ thu shal dang bcas te rigs brgyud chad khar bu ngan skye zer ba de red/ nga sne'u dpon la rigs brgyud 'dzin pa'i bu ni ma bskos/ bu mo zhig yod snyam rung de ni mi rabs kyi zhabs 'dren 'di lta bu zhig tu gyur pa red/ da sa steng 'dir rang dang 'dra ba'i sde dpon nga che nga btsan zer mkhan rnams la gdong ga 'dra byas nas ston/ 'bangs mi ser la ji ltar shod bsams nas bshad par/ ‘‘smras/ zhabs 'dren ma/ nga sne'u dpon la gdung brgyud spel ba'i sras shig med kyang / gnyen tshan spel ba'i sras mo zhig yod bsams nas khog pa'i snying ltar bzung nas byams skyong byas yod/ da cha bsams pa ltar gyi phan thogs rgyu lta ci/ pha rabs bu rabs kyi zhabs 'dren 'di lta bu byed pa dpe srid dam/ nga sne'u dpon zer ba 'di gong la nyi zla ma gtogs med snyam pa zhig yin/ nga'i bu mo zhis dgra gnyen gang sar ngoms ngoms byed rgyu des sa steng du de las sdug na sdug thabs med pa dang / de las btsog na btsog thabs med pa mgar ba'i bu dang mnyam sdeb byas pa red/ da dung ngan byas ngo 'khyer gyi phru gu yod tshul dang / stobs rgyal 'phrad par gtong dgos zer ba de 'brong bsad pas ma tshad rnga ma dar rtsog tu btsugs pa'i dpe ltar ham pa tshod med kyi skad cha red’’ces skra nas bkug ste nyes brdung drag po zhig btang skabs 'khor rnams kyis shes te bar du 'tshangs nas dgongs dag thugs

874 rdo rje rgyal po'i gsung rtsom phyogs phasgrigs/bden gyi zhu 'bul mang po byas/ myo/thar dpom/ bso/da nams rin chen gyis ‘‘da nas bzung khyod nga'i phru gu yin pa'i 'du shes mi byed/ phyag gnyer rnams kyis mo bros sa dang thar sa med pa'i khang pa zhig tu bcug nas zhogasang nyin gnangs nyin rim bzhin khrims dang mthun pa'i skad cho byed rgyu yin/ mi ngan stobs rgyal zer mkhan de da lta rang 'gugs mkhan gtong dgos ’zhes bshad pa red/'khor g.yog rnams ha las shing da dngos gnas zhabs 'dren byas song / dpon po bsod nams rin chen la thugs khag mi 'dug bsam pa dang / rnam kun sras mo 'di 'khor g.yog la bka' drin chen po yin/khong la sku ngal 'di lta bu byung ba ci drag bsam pa'i sems khral/ dpon bsod nams rin chen sku rlung bzhengs stabs nga tsho la'ang bka' bkyon gang zhig phebs yong bsam pa'i zhed snang bcas bsam blo mi 'khor rgu 'khor ci yang 'khor skabs phyag mdzod grags pas‘‘dpon po la thugs khag med/ da zhabs 'dren zhus song / ngas kha sang nas dpon por zhus pa yin/ sras mo 'di'i gnang stangs la dogs pa zhig byung / gal te de dus lha sar btang ba yin na yong rgyu 'di rang yong nges red zer zhing /sras mo mar khrid nas gang du bcug zhog rgyu'i thad la phyag gnyer dang bcas 'khor g.yog rnams gros byas te sras mo rang gi gzim chung du bcug ste bzhag nas phyi mi su dang thug 'phrad byed sa med pa dang / sras mo phyi rol —du thon sa med pa bzos te bzhag pa red/de nas stobs rgyal 'gugs par pa sangs dang rogs phur bu don

rlu shes lha mo dang mgar ba stobs rgyas/ 875grub btang ba red/ pa sangs lha sar slebs skabs stobs rgyal gyi a ma'i bsam par da yang khral gang zhig bskul du yong ba yin nam/ sras mo dang stobs rgyal gyi gnas tshul de ni da lta phyir gyar med bsam gyin du‘‘pa sangs lags/ phyag phebs gnang byung / sku don gang yin zhes dris par/ pa sangs kyis‘‘a ma bag gro/ da dpe bzhag tshar 'dug sras mo ye shes lha mo lags su stobase rgyal gyi phru gu yod pa red zer gyi 'dug sras mo la yab chen gyi bka' bkyon dang phyag 'jug drag po phebs song / nga gnyis stobs rgyal 'gugs par gtong ba gnang byung / lam seng khrid shog gsung gi 'dug’’ces zer gyin stobs rgyal gyi 'khris su phyin te thag pa bton nas 'ekhyig grabs byas par stobs rgyal nad babs lci bas gang yin ci yin dri ba tsam yang byed mi thub par mig hur hur du bsdad yod pa red/ a mas ‘‘pa sangs lags/ khyed rang gis bka' gnang ba de ltar byung thag chod red/ stobs rgyal gyi skad cha shod stangs nas ngas shes byung / des ma tshad kho'i na tsha 'di'ang don dag de rang gis byas 'dug rang gis sdug tshod 'dzin ma thub pas byas pa red/ a nes btsugs pa'i zam par a ne thar ba byed dgos pa'i dpe ltar kho rang ma bcar thabs med red/ 'on spyang kho'i gzugs po'i mdog ni khyed gnyis kyis gzigs chod 'di rang red/ kho sang shi gnangs shi'i mtshams la slebs nas bsdad yod/ da lta khrid pa gnang rung sne'u rdzong du ro zhig min pa slebs e yong bsams pa zhig 'dug na khyed gnyis kyis nyin gsum ring bka' 'gyangs dang 'brel rang dpon la snyan seng zhig skyabs 'jug gnang rogs gnang / de nas

876 rdo rje rgyal po'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/drag na drag pa dang / shi na shi ba'i thag cig chod pa 'dug’’ces sogs na stangs dang / kho rang ma smad gnyis ka sdug bsngal gyi khung bur tshud de bsdad pa'i gnas tshul rnams zhib cing phra ba bshad cing migyi/ chu lu chu rdol ba bzhin btang bas stobs rgyal gyis ha go nas‘‘nga'i las ka la 'di ma gtogs yong rgyu med/ sdug nga shi yang rung / bla ma dpon po'i bka' chad bka' bkyon ga re phebs kyang rang nyos kyi bya ba yin/ da sras mo 'di gang drag’’ces ngus pa red/ pa sangs dang phur bu don grub gnyis kyis ma bu gnyis ka'i shod tshul nas kho gnyis kyi sdug bsngal ji yod de shes shing / stobs rgyal gyi nad gzhi yang sdug po yod pa mthong bas snying rje zhing yid skyo nas mnyam du mig chu shor/ mthar pa sangs kyis‘‘da res nga gnyis kyis khrid na rdzong du 'khyol min dngos gnas tan tan mi 'dug ma bzhag rang bzhag red/ 'on kyang rang bzhin du bzhag ste log na zhu stangs mi shes khar nga tshor dpon po'i bka' bkyon phebs kyi red/ nyi ma gsum nas stobs rgyal drag tu phyin na bcar rgyu dang / ma phyin na 'di byas 'di min gyi rgyu rkyen zhu bar a ma bcar rgyu/ gang ltar 'di skor thag ma chod bar bros byol du mi 'gro ba'i 'gan len khag theg cig 'dzugs rgyu yod na de ring bzhag chog7ces bshad pa red/a mas khyim mtshes shing bzo ba bkra shis rdo rje zer ba rnam kun phan tshun nye bo byedacimakhan zhig yod pa de bos te gong du bshad mi ltar gnas lugs rnams bshad par bkra shis rdo rjes‘‘stobs rgyal mi shi ba'i khag theg ngas byed mi thub/ kho gzugs po'i kha mdog 'di las med par bros ga 'a/

shes bo dang gar ba stobs rgyas/ 8snya7thub/ bros shor med pa zhu rgyu'i khag theg ngas byas chog’’ces khas blangs pa ltar gan rgya zhig bzos te do bdag dang khag theg gnyis kas the'u btsugs pa de pa sangs kyis 'khyer te log phyin te phyag mardzod khang du gan rgya phul te gnas lugs rnams zhus/ phyag mdzod kyis‘‘khyod gnyis la kho khrid shog zer byung ngam/ na tsha ga 'dra 'dug ltos shog zer byung /dpon po'i bka' de logs su bzhag nas khyod gnyis kyis thag gcod dgos don gang yin/ wa ye/ las dpon/ kho gnyis gang du'ang btang mi chog khyod rang la rtsis sprad yod/ ngas dpon por dgongs skor zhu bar phyin chog ces bshad de dpon po'i gzim chung du phyin nas gnas lugs rnams zhus pa red/dbon des‘‘sprang slong de tsho'i byed stangs de rang yin/ mi 'di tshos ngan pa kha mthun byed kyi yod pa red/ zur du skad cha ma byas par thabs med/ las dpon la rtsis sprod byas nas zhog mgar ba stobs rgyal 'gugs par las dpon bsod rdor dang / rogs pa mi gnyis gsum zhig bskyar du thongs/ gson po yin na gson por khrid rgyu dang / shi 'dug zer na sdug ro 'khyer rgyu med par log mi chog ces nan tan shod ’ces bshad/ phyag mdzod kyis las dpon bsod rdor la dpon gyi bka' rnams chad lhag med par bsgyur thog‘‘las dpon khyod rang go chod pa'i ched du gtong ba gnang ba red/ stobs rgyal khrid rgyu med na gang min byas yong’’zhes bshad pas/ bsod rdor gyis‘‘lags lags so/ thugs g.yeng mi dgos’’zhes bshad cing / rogs pa 'u lag mi gsum khrid nas lha sar phyin

byu 878 rdorjergyal tho'i gsung rtsom stogs bagligs/te bshad long dang nyan long med par stobs rgyal bsdams te khrid pa red/stobs rgyal ni rlung gis bzi ba'i nad yin thog shad long nyan long med pa'i bsdams bkyigs byas stabs da dung nad gzhi sdug tu phyin te ci dran 'di dran yang cher med par gyur pa red/ a ma ni gzhan bya thabs bral bas stobs rgyal gyi rjes su ngu bzhin phyin pa red/stobs rgyal sne'u rdzong du slebs ma thag rdo bcal du phyag mdzod yong ste rta lcag sum brgya tham pa btang zhing / rkang pa gnyis la brdung lcags lag pas theg tsam zhig brgyab ste btson du bcug pa red/de'i gnas tshul rnams sras mo ye shes lha mos shes nas bsam par/a tsi/ stobs rgyal kho lus nad kyis mnar te nyal sa'i nang du lus nas shi gson ci yong mi shes pa zhig yod pa'i thog ya nga snying rje med pa'i khrims gcod drag po de tsam byas par brten shi rgyur thag chod pa red/ ngas kho ma shi gong du 'phrad tsam byas te gtam tshig gsum bshad nas stobs rgyal gyi yid la las dbang gi phru gus 'brel ba'i khyo shug gi 'du shes dor ma byung bsam pa zhig bzos na kho blo thag chod cing shi bzos bde ba yong gi red/gal te kho shi na nga gson dang ma gson khyad med bsams nas yab chen gyis gtsos pa'i mi tshang ma nyal zin ma thag glo bur du gzim chung nas thon te phyin par sras mo rang srung mkhan dang stobs rgyal gyi btson srung tshang mas bkag 'gog gang thub byas kyang / sras mos‘‘khyed rnams rang dbang med pa'i bran g.yog sha stag red/ khag mi 'dug nga yang khyod tsho dang cha 'dra ba zhig red/ rang gis bsams pa'i grogs shig tsam yang btsalda mi chog pa'i

ye shes lha mo dang mgar ba stobs rgyas/ 879gnas tshul 'di lta bu red/ stobs rgyal ni khrims 'og 'chi rgyur thag chod tshar song / nga dang stobs rgyal gnyis lan chags kyi phru gu 'brel tshar ba zhig yin ltabs kho shi khar 'phrad tsam zhig ma byas par thabs ga la yod/khyod rnams kyis thugs rjes gzigs’ zhes skyo ba'i gtam sna tshogs dang bcas phyag 'tshal grabs byas par rnam kun sras mo de mi ser la byams pa dang / skabs de'i gnas tshul rnams yid la 'khor te tshang ma yid 'byung skyes nas 'phrad du bcug ste stobs rgyal yod pa'i btson khang nang du btang ba red/ stobs rgyal zug gzer gnyis 'doms kyis mnar bas sa phag chag dum zhig sngas su bcug ste shi ma gson du nyal yod pa'i thog sras mo ye shes lha mos mthong ba dang 'thams pa dus gcig tu byas te‘‘stobs rgyal zhes bos par/ sras mo'i skad de go ma thag snying nas lhang nger dran nas mig cig lta skabs slar yang‘‘stobs rgyal’mizhes spos par brten sras mo slebs pa shes shing / gcig gis gcig la 'thams nas yud tsam gnyis ka brgyal sa 1 lus pa red/de nas sras mosatshistobs rgyal khyod kyi na tsha ga 'dra 'dug da nga gnyis kyi las 'di gang drag ces bshad par/ stobs rgyal gyi sems la da shi rgyu las med par na tsha che chung gi skad cha ga re yod bsams nasarang gi gnas tshul dang / sras mor sems gso'i ched du bshad bar‘‘sras mo/ nga ni 'chi rgyu ma gtogs mi 'dug de ni nga rang gi las / khyed thugs khral rsha gaganang rogs gnang / dpe zhig zhus na 'di lta bu red’’ces tshigs su

880 rdo rje rgyal po'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/bcad de bshad par/yodabyar ldum ra'i nang gi pad tshal du/ /'u gser sbrang g.yu sbrang mnyam du 'dzoms/ /dus skadaricig bde bar rol ba dang / /mtha' 'bral ba 'khor ba'i chos nyid red/ /nga gser sprang nang nas lus zungs rdzong/sa/ /sgos phyi nas 'tshe bas gshog drug bcom/ /da 'chi rgyu ma gtogs thabs ci yod/ /de gser sbrang rang gi las bskos red/ /khyed g.yu sbrang thugs ngal don med yin/ /nam 'tsho'i bar spro zhing bag phebs kyis/ /rang nyid kyi sku la gces spras mdzod/ /tshe phyi mar 'dzoms pa'i smon lam 'debs/ /mtsho pad ma can gyi rlabs phreng dbus/ /'u gser bya pho mo mnyam du 'dzoms/ /dus skad cig bde bar rol ba dang / /mtha' 'bral ba 'khor ba'i chos nyid red/ /nga rdzo bya nang nas nad kyis mnar/ /sgos phyi nas mda' mos gzugs gzhi rmas/ /da 'chi rgyu ma gtogs thabs ci yod/ /de pho bya rang gi las bskos red/ /khyed mo bya thugs ngal don med yin/ /nam 'tsho'i bar spro zhing bag phebs kyis/ /rang nyid kyi sku la gces spras mdzod/ /tshe phyi mar 'dzoms pa'i smon lam 'debs/ /yul sne'u rdzong gi nang rol du/ /'u stobs rgyal sras mo mnyam du 'dzoms/ /dus skad cig bde bar rol ba dang / /mtha' 'bral ba 'khor ba'i chos nyid rid/ /nga stobs rgyal nang nas gdung baspobazi/ /sgos phyi nas khrims kyis phung po mnar/ /da 'chi rgyu ma gtogs thabs ci yod/ /de stobs rgyal rang gi las bskosarid/ /khyid sras mo thugs ngal don med yin/ /nam 'tsho'i bar kro zhing bag beebs kyis/ /rang nyid kyi sku la gces sprus mdzod/ /chaphyi

ye shes lha mo dang mgar ba stobs rgyas/ 881mar 'dzoms pa'i smon lam 'debs/ / ’zhes dang / slolar nas khyed lha yi sras mo 'dra ba de las ngan ngas sdug la sbyar song’’zhes smre bsngags dang bcas te bshad cing / sras mos‘‘khyod kyi sems kyi sdug bsngal dang lus kyi na tsha 'di dag thams cad ngas bzos pa yin/ da cha skyid gangs dkar chu bo mnyam 'thung / sdug ko mog gi rdzab chu mnyam 'thung zer ba de bya rgyu smos ci/ shi na mnyam shi bya rgyu dang / gson na mnyam gson ma gtogs bya rgyu med/ dpe bshad na 'di lta bu red’ ces bshad par/4dbyar ldum ra'i nang gi pad tshal du/ /'u gser sprang g.yu sbrang mnyam du 'dzoms/ /dus skad cig bde bar rol ba dang / /mtha' 'bral ba'i chos nyid nga yis shes/ /khyed gser sbrang 'byung bas bcom gyur na/ /nga g.yu sbrang 'tsho dang ma 'tsho med/ /sang shi dang gnangs shi khyad par med/ /dus gcig la mnyam du shi ba dga'/ /nang phung po'i nus pa ma rdzogs shing / /phyi 'byung ba'i 'tshe ba ma byung yang / /bya bye'u'i kha rtsar mchong ba'am/ /me dmar mo'i nang du lcebs nas 'chi/ /mtsho pad ma can gyi rlabs phreng dbus/ /'u pho bya mo bya mnyam du 'dzoms/ /dus skad cig bde bar rol ba dang / /mtha' 'bral ba'i chos nyid nga yis shes/ /khyed pho bya mda' mos bsad gyur na/ /nga mo bya 'tsho dang ma 'tsho med/ /sang shi dang gnangs shi khyad par mid/ /dus gcig tu mnyam du shi na dga'/ /nang phung po nad kyis ma mnar zhing / /phyi mda' mo'i nyer 'tshe ma byung yang / /khyi rda li'i kha rtsar mchong ba'am/ /brang rdo yi zur la brdabs nas 'chi/ /yul sne'u rdzong

882 rdo rje rgyal po'i gsung rtsom phyogs bagligs/gi nang rol du/ /'u khyo shug las kyis mnyam 'dzorma sa byung / /dus skad cig bde bar rol ba dang / /mtha' 'bral ba'i chos nyid nga rkagis shes/ /khyed stobs rgyal khrims 'og shi gyur na/ /nga bu mo gson derngo ma gson med/ /sang shi dang gnangs shi khyad par med/ /dus gcig la mnyam du 'chi ba dga'/ /nang 'byung bzhi'i nad kyis ma zin zhing / /phyi khrims kyi chad pas ma mnar yang / /brag mthon po'i rtse nas mchong ba'am/ /chu sngon mo'i nang du lcebs nas 'chi/ /’’zhes sogs gleng zhing / gcig gis gcig la 'thams nas ngu bzhin par yod skabs sras mo'i srung cha dang / stobs gyali byi btson srung bcas mnyam rub kyis so sor kha phral te khrid phyin pa red/sang nyin snga dro sras mo ye shes lha mo yab chen gyi sku mdun du gtong dgos zhes 'khor g.yog rnams la bshad pa ltar btang ste yab chen gyi mdun du slebaswā nas dar dkar po zhig yab chen gyi mdun btang / phyag 'tshal dang bcas te bshad par/ ‘‘yab chen mi yi dbang po khyed/ /yud tsam nga yi phyogs su gson/ /'u thug bzod par ma nus pa'i/ /snyan gtser tshig gsum zhu rgyu yod/ /gdung rabs shel gong dri med du/ /skyes pa'i bu mo las ngan —ngas/ /mgar ba'i bu dang mnyam du bsdebs/ /bya ba nag po thal nas song / /tshul 'di 'jig rten lugs dang gcig /btsan brjid rgyal po'i khrims dang gnyis/ /mi dbang yab chen dgongs pa gsum/ / thams cad 'gal ba'i bya ba red/ dar lcog skyod mkhan rlung po bzhin/ /

yi shes lha mo dang mgar ba stobs rgyas/ 883stobs rgyal sdod sar mi 'jog mkhan/ /las ngan nga yis byas pa las/ /kho la le khag ṇḍil tsadzi med/ /che la khrims kyi chad pa gcig /chung la bka' yi chad pa gnyirbe/ gang mchis sdig pa sha rjes ltar/ /las ngan bdag la gcod par zhu/ /gal te ye shes lha mo la/ /thugs brtse cung zad mchis lags na/ /nga yi dga' grogs stobs rgyal la/ /khrims gcod mdzad pa ci la 'os/ /stobs rgyal btson nas grol dang gcig /bka' chad gsung nyes yang dang gnyis/ /nga dang gtan du gshibs rgyu gsum/ /brtse ba chen pos 'dzin par zhu/ /rang la mi gces su zhig med/ /yag po mi 'dod su zhig med/ /dpral ba'i gnyer ma 'phyi rgyu med/ /bskos pa'i las la ldog rgyu med/ /nga dang mgar phrug stobs rgyal gnyis/ /lus sems gcig tu 'brel gyur pas/ /gson na tshe gang mnyam gson yin/ /shi na da lta mnyam shi yin/ /nga la byams dang kho la sdang / /ske 'dod lba ba mi 'dod 'dra/ /rna khug nag po gzhog 'dod de/ /rang sdug rang gis nyo ba yin/ /skor sgo log pa'i rtsis mkhan gyis/ /nya stong 'khrul dus 'gyod kyang phyis/ /khe nyen ma mthong dpon po yis/ /dge skyon log dus 'gyod kyang phyis/ /’’zhes zhus pa red/yab chen bsod nams rin chen ngo rdza ri las nag cing / mig rtsa khrag las kyang dmar ba/ mchu sgros cha lang deb deb kyi ngang nas bshad par/‘‘he he/ chu mo'i gting tshod longs na nya mo sbar 'dzin rgyag zer ba'i dpe de ma red dam/ khyod sne'u rdzong gi dpon mo'i ming 'dzin mkhan zhig gis

884 rdo rje rgyal po'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/rigs ngan mgar ba dang bsdebs pas ma tshad/ da dung shi na mnyam shi dang / gson na mnyam gson yin zer/ 'jig rten lugs mthun gyi pho mo'i 'brel ba yin na de ltar shod 'os kyang / khyod kyi byed stangs de khrims dang lugs srol mtha' dag dang 'gal ba'i spyod ngan zhig red/ spyod ngan de ltar byas pas ma tshad/ da dung gtam de lta bu shod phod kyi 'dug gam/khyod la ngo tsha rgyu dang / zhe khril rgyu med rung / nga khrims kyi 'go la sdod mkhan zhig gis de lam du 'jog thabs med/ khyod rang gi srog la 'phang ba mid na kho'i mnyam du shi yang nga la khyad par med/ thog mar stobs rgyal kho la khrims kyi bda' 'ded yan por ma song ba zhig byas/ de rjes khyod rang dang / khyod dang mnyam du kha mthun byed mkhan de dag bcas re re bzhin du rgyu ma phu 'ded btang chog khyod 'tshab 'tshub byed mi dgos/rim bzhin ltad mo mthong yong’’zhes zer bar/ sras mo ye shes lha mos slar yang gtam zhig shod grabs byas par dpon bsod nams rin chen gyis‘‘khyod nga'i rna ba tsha ba'i skad cha mang po shod mi dgos/ don rdog rdog ga ler gsal yong / mar rgyug g.yog ngan tsho/ mo mar khrid’’ces langs grabs byas stabs zhal lta ma khra kog dang / drung yig skal bzang rin chen sogs kyis sras mo bskyor nas khrid phyin pa red/ sras mo'ang bya thabs zad cing yid skyo ba'i ngang nas phyir log mi byed thabs med byung /de nyin dpon bsod nams rin chen gyis phyag mdzod grags pa sogs bkug ste stobs rgyal la nyes chad gcod stangs thag bcad nas shog nye zhig bkod pa de phyag gnyer thun mong la sprad nas‘‘sang nyin nga'i bka' de dag

yi shis lha mo dang mgar ba stobs rgyas/ skye85bsgyur/ nyes chad de dag bcad zi na pa gyis’’zhes mngags pa red/sang nyin de rdzong gi rdo bcal du phyag gnyer gnyis gral du bsdad cing / mgar ba stobs rgyal btson srung gnyis kyis khrid yong ste rdo bcal gyi mthil du spus mo btsugs te bzhag mtha' skor nas gad pa dang / ko lcag pa sogs kyis bskor nas bsdad pa'i thog phyag mdzod grags pas‘‘kwastobs rgyal/ nyon ang / mi ngan khyod kyi byed 'dzol skor la bka' chad 'di ltar phebs song’’zhes yi ge de bklags par/ ‘‘bod khri skor bcu gsum sa 'di na/ lnge/thob che ba de yan med pa de/ /dpon sne'u pa yi gdung brgyud dngos/ /nga dpon po bsod nams rin chen yin/ /dpon 'dra 'dra'i nang nas lhag pa de/ /rje chos rgyal gong ma'i sku tsha yin/ /stobs mnga' thang longs spyod 'gran zla med/ /thob che ba mi yi rje bo yin/ /sras mo ye shes lha mo 'di/ /gdung brgyud sras kyi dod po yin/ /pha shul bu mos skyong mkhan dang / /dpon mo'i thob thang 'dzin mkhan yin/ /'on kyang mi srid srid pa la/ /mgar ba nag pos sbags 'dres byung / /ma tshad mngal du nal bu chags/ /mi kha ngan pas sa steng khyab/ /rigs brgyud bzang po dri mas sbags/ /dpon 'bangs bar gyi go bab log /'jig rten lugs kyi tshul dang 'gal/ /de lam 'jog thabs ga la yod/ /thob thang can gyi dpon brgyud la/ /mig gis thad blta mi sngog par/ /ham pas sbags pa'i nyes chad du/ /mig 'bras gnyis de dmar 'don gyis/ /dpon 'bangs go bab ma brtsis par/ /mgo lus bdag po dpon mo la/ /lag pa brgyab pa'i nyes chad

— 886 rnajirgyal po' gsungacam phyatho/sablosgrags/ dnghal/ /lag mgo gnyis ka gcod 'breg gyis/ /'jig rten tshul lugs 'gal ba'i rigs1/ /re re bzhin du brjod mi langs/ /de dag yongs kyi nyes/ chad du/ /byin pa gnyis nasag ling re bkogs/ /ma rgan bag gros stobs rgyal kho/ /lcags dmar skam 'chun ma byung ba'i/ /nyes par mkhar dbang gzhung bzhes thog /lo gsum mgar ba'i lag g.yog skul/ /de mtshungs le can su yod rnams/ /re re bzhin du ther 'don gyis/ /rang rang byed 'dzol la dpags pa'i/ /nyes pa'i khrims gcod rim bzhin byed/ / ’ces gsal ba ltar rang rang go skal khrims gcod kyi bya ba byed mkhan rnams kyis bya rgod sha la rub pa ltar ya nga snying rje med par ma shi dmyal ba zhig grub pa'i khrims gcod bzod glags med pa zhig byas pa red/stobs rgyal la ni dgongs dag ces pa tsam gyi gtam tshig kyang shod dbang med cing / yid la sra sa mo ye shes lha mo khra lam lam du 'khor bzhin par mnar gcod de dag myong dgos pa byung bar ma zad/ khrims bcad zin ma thag shi ba red/ stobs rgyal gyi a ma bag gros gnas tshul de dag mthong bas dran med du brgyal nas bem ro ltar gum mer lus pa red/khrims gcod pa phyag gnyer sogs kyis stobs rgyal shi ba shes stabs da mi grib chen gī sdug ro rdzong nang du 'jog mi nyan sne'u'i ri zur gyi rags 'go'i mtsho rṣag gting ring sa der skyur shog ces lus kyi drod ma yal bar sgyur bar btang ba red/de'i tshe na sras mo ye shes lha mos gnas tshul de dag shes te bsams

ye shes lha mo dang mgar ba stobs rgyas/ 887par/ da ni las ka tshar song / sne'u dpon blon gyi dgra bo ni btul tshar song / nga sa steng 'dir sdod pa'i kho thag kyang chod tshar song nga yang stobs rgyal gyi phung po dbyug sa de rang du mchongs nas shi dgos/ shi khar yab chen dang 'khor g.yog tshang mar go nges kyi gtam zhig kyang brjod dgos bsams shing / ngu shar dang ku shar 'dres 'dres/ 'phag 'tshag dang mchong rgyag 'dres 'dres/ kha chu dang sna chu 'dres 'dres kyi ngang nas yab chen gyi gzim chung phyogs su phyin yang / 'khor g.yog rnams kyis yab chen dgongs pa tshoms na bskyar du nyes brdung 'khel yong bsams te bkag nas ma btang bas rdzong gi bar 'khyams nang du phar rgyug tshur rgyugs mchong gnam mchong cham rgyag rgyag snyo ba lta bu'i ngang du bshad par/‘‘thul song thul song dgra bo thul song sne'u dpon gyi dgra thul song / /'grub song 'grub song bsam don 'grub song dpon blon rnams kyi don 'grub song / /lhag 'dug lhag 'dug da dung lhag 'dug mgar pa'i chung ma nga lhag 'dug /ma zhog ma zhog 'di mur ma zhog las mjug ma bskyal bskyur ma zhog /mi sdod mi sdod bu mo mi sdod sa steng 'di ru nga mi sdod/ /chas 'gro chas 'gro bu mochas 'gro stobs rgyal 'tshol ba'i ched chas 'gro/ /ltos shig ltos shig ltad mo ltos shig dpon blon tshang ma da ltos shig /nyon cig nyon cig glu chung nyon cig bu mo 'gro kha'i glu nyon cig /bzhugs shig bzhugs shig ga le bzhugs shig thob thang can gyi dpon bzhugs shig /rol 'i/ga rol zhig ci dgar rol zhipaṃ/ ma/nga' thang longs spyod la rol zhig /sdod cis/ sdod cig ga le sdod cig dpon zhen

888 rdo rgyal po'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/ sprecan gyi 'khor sdod cig /bkur zhig bkur zhig gong du bkur zhig sku brgyud mtho ba'i dpon bkur zhig /mdzod cig mdzod cig spro po mdzod cig dpon 'bangs ma lus spro mdzod cig /yong ngo yong ngo spro po yong ngo dpon 'bangs ma lus spro yong ngo / /da 'gro da 'gro bu mo da 'gro phyi ma'i lam chen du da 'gro/ /skyobs shig skyobs shig bla mas skyobs shig ye shes lha mo nga skyobs shig /’’ces zer zhing ku shar dang bcas te rgyugs phyin par/ mi rnams sras mo ye shes lha mo snyo ba lta bu'i bya spyod dang / ngu ma dbyangs su sgrog pa'i tshig don de dag la blo g.yeng ba lta bur lus pa'i ngang nas sras mo sne'u rdzong gi rgyal sgo'i nang nas thon shor te skad cig la sne'u ri zur gyi gtsang po'i rags mgo stobs rgyal gyi phung po yod sa der slebs pa red/ rdzong nang gi 'khor g.yog gang yod sras mo'i mjug tu rgyugs yong ste zin la nye ba'i mtshams su sras mo ye shes lha mos rang gi gos kyi am dbrag tu rdo 'chur tshad cig blug rdo lug gi grod pa tsam zhig pang gdan nang bsgril te rgyab tu 'khur zhing / 'khor 'bangs rjes su brgyugs yong mkhan rnams la phyi ltas shig byas te/ ‘‘sne'u dpon blon rnams yid tshim pa gyis shig’’ces bshad de stobs rgyal gyi ro yod sa de rang gi thad kha'i mtsho khug der mchongs pa red/ 'khor g.yog rnams gcig rjes gnyis mthud kyis der 'byor te/ ‘‘da dpe bzhag song / dpon bsod nams rin chen la ci zhu/ gom pa gang gis bslus song / da bzos song /khyod yin nga min’’zhes ku co dir re sdod pa las gzhan bya thabs gang yang ma rnyed de kha sha dar thag 'then spruthen gyi ngang nas phyir ma log ka med byung

ye shes lha mo dang mgar ba stobs rgyas/ 889ba red/de'i gnas lugs rnams dpon bsod nams rin chen gyis shes te snying dang 'dra ba'i sras mo gcig pu de med par gyur pas yid 'phreng ya nga ba dang / 'gyod pa che ba bcas kyi sems nad kho na'i 'og tshe 'da' dgos pa zhig byung ba bcas mdor bsdus su bkod pa rdzogs so/ /mnug tu 'god thu/smras pa/ nga che nga btsan dpon po'i lugs ngan des/ /mtha' ma rang gzhan gnyis ka 'phung la sbyor/ /de phyir dang por 'jig rten tshul lugs la/ /bag yod 'phral phugs legs pa'i gnad ma 'phyug /mi dmangs 'dam ltar brdzi ba'i spyi tshogs nang / /de lta'i gnas tshul brjod kyis ga la langs/ /de phyir sgrung 'di dpyod ldan sus mthong yang / /gsar brje'i dge mtshan bsam bzhin spro ba 'phel/ /deng 'dir tang gi 'go khrid yang dag 'og /brtan barming mthun sgril zab mo'i rmang gzhi'i steng / /bde dge'i dpal yon 'phyur ba'i dus skabs 'dir/ /skye rgu deng bzhi'i byed sgor rol 'di legs/ / / /

mdun shog jus 'god pa/ pe glun/dpe sgrig lasnyegan 'khur pa/ dbyangs can seng ge rdo rje rgyal po'i gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs/lha spung go'i bod kyi shes rig dpe skrun khang gis bskrun/mtsho sngon zhing chen zhin hwa dpe tshong khang gis bkram/mtsho sdin mi rigs par khang gis ri ra brgyab/1992lo'i zla6 phar par gzhi dang po bsgrigs/1992lo'i zla 6 par da sdor thengs dang rnga brgyab/1bya2smo 7—80057—040—1(5 1deb spus legs rer glio ra14 30 deb dkyus ma rer sgor/ 11 90
